cmp:0n6t52p0k48g97.why: The two divine names come in the basmala and again right after the praise in al-Fatiha. The repeat is worth pondering: mercy frames lordship from both sides.
cmp:0n6t52p0k48g97.relation: Mercy is named before and after the Lord of the worlds, so lordship is read through mercy.

cmp:1nivdrt11r000f.why: Five surahs open with the same praise and part right after it (Lord of the worlds, who created, who sent down, to whom belongs, originator). A classic place for memorizers to mix up surah openings.
cmp:1nivdrt11r000f.relation: Each opening praises God for a different work: lordship, creation, revelation, ownership, origination.

cmp:1v43xau07br7xg.why: Al-Jathiya closes with the praise that opens al-Fatiha, spelling out the Lord of the worlds as Lord of the heavens and the earth. A small but real echo for pondering; a memorizer may also slip from one to the other.
cmp:1v43xau07br7xg.relation: The brief praise of al-Fatiha is unfolded at the end of al-Jathiya.

check.why: Book card; the praise that opens al-Fatiha closes al-Jathiya with the Lord of the worlds spelled out. Keep is right.

cmp:1onz5230jajd2p.why: God as King or Owner in three settings: of the Day of Judgement, of all dominion, of people. Good for pondering the scope of His kingship, and the book discusses the two forms of the word.
cmp:1onz5230jajd2p.relation: His kingship over the Day, over all rule, and over mankind.

cmp:014drdf04bsrdf.why: A single ayah. The book remarks on the repeated pronoun inside 1:5, but there is no second place to compare, so as a card it shows nothing.

cmp:0calfu80rl1ytg.why: The path asked for in 1:6 is defined in 1:7 by repeating the word. Worth pondering: the straight path is not abstract but the path of a people God favoured.
cmp:0calfu80rl1ytg.relation: The request for the straight path is answered by naming whose path it is.

cmp:12w2hdc1sngny4.why: A single ayah (1:7). The book's note concerns the repetition of the word path across 1:6 and 1:7, which another card already shows; alone it compares nothing.

cmp:1sx25ql1mvxezp.why: Which surahs open with the bare three letters and which add a fourth letter or continue the ayah. Essential for memorizers, since these openings are easy to confuse.

cmp:0yxvz0w0sv5thy.why: The Book is guidance for the God-fearing (2:2) and the earlier scriptures guidance for people (3:4). The different addressees of guidance are worth pondering.
cmp:0yxvz0w0sv5thy.relation: Guidance offered to all people, yet benefiting only those who fear God.

cmp:0nfi4us1804pro.why: Same sentence on the disbelievers whom warning does not move, in two surahs; 2:6 opens with a particle, 36:10 with a conjunction. A clear memorizer pair.

cmp:1c5i7yg1wmmu06.why: The hypocrites claim belief in God and the Last Day (2:8), while others are described as not believing in God nor the Last Day (4:38, 9:29). Memorizers must keep the added negation apart; the claim and the denial are worth pondering together.
cmp:1c5i7yg1wmmu06.relation: A false claim of faith beside open lack of faith, in the same words.

check.why: Book card; the claimed belief in God and the Last Day against its negation is a real memorizer point and worth pondering. Keep.

cmp:11za7m90ds08jb.why: Three ayat in one passage on the hypocrites end with not perceiving or not knowing. The book explains why each ending fits: deceiving and corruption are not perceived, while calling believers fools is a failure of knowledge. Useful for memorizers and for pondering.

cmp:05ikwqs1gj5l9q.why: Same triple description of the deaf, dumb and blind, ending differently in one surah: they will not return (the hypocrites) and they do not understand (the disbelievers likened to herded animals). Classic memorizer pair.
cmp:05ikwqs1gj5l9q.relation: Two kinds of blindness: those who will not come back and those who cannot understand.

cmp:0suy0jw0p4dd3m.why: A single ayah (2:21), the first call to all mankind. Nothing to compare inside the card.

cmp:0muwxke1lpa0se.why: The challenge to produce a surah (2:23, 10:38) or ten surahs (11:13), with small differences in wording. A key memorizer set and a stage-by-stage challenge worth pondering.
cmp:0muwxke1lpa0se.relation: The same challenge to bring a surah like it, phrased for different audiences.

cmp:0loqpqf156l3cx.why: The same announcement to the angels opens the story of Adam three times: a vicegerent (2:30) and a human from clay (15:28, 38:71). Same story; memorizers must track the wording.
cmp:0loqpqf156l3cx.relation: One event told with a different focus: Adam's role in 2:30, his substance in 15 and 38.

cmp:18owk8f1inraz1.why: Iblis's refusal told seven times, each with a different continuation (refused, was not among those who prostrate, said, was of the jinn, was arrogant). A central memorizer set and one story worth reading together.

cmp:1kmmyzz0z4fxkf.why: Two commands to descend within two ayat: the first states enmity and a stay on earth, the second promises guidance. The book asks why the command is repeated; good for pondering.
cmp:1kmmyzz0z4fxkf.relation: The descent comes first as consequence, then as the start of a life under guidance.

cmp:04vslnt0wo5ml1.why: The command to descend in al-Baqara, al-A'raf and Ta-Ha, with different wording (plural or dual, enmity or guidance). Same story; a strong memorizer set.

cmp:1ums17s1axoxxc.why: Same command to seek help through patience and prayer, first to the Children of Israel, then to the believers, with different endings. A memorizer pair and a link worth pondering.
cmp:1ums17s1axoxxc.relation: The command once given to Israel is given again to the believers.

cmp:17x5rsk1r17sya.why: Same warning of the Day, with intercession and ransom swapped in order. A classic memorizer pair; the books explain the swap.

cmp:0gbn0390li6xnd.why: Deliverance from Pharaoh's people told three times with small changes (slaughter or kill, saved or rescued, spoken by God or by Moses). Same story; a core memorizer set.

cmp:0fcdg8m146mf2w.why: Same closing clause: God did not wrong them but they wronged themselves. Two places are the same story of manna and quails; the third applies it to those whose spending is ruined. Good for memorizers and for pondering self-wrong.
cmp:0fcdg8m146mf2w.relation: Whatever the setting, the harm is traced back to the people themselves.

cmp:1cjqizz0z7vxip.why: The command to enter the town in al-Baqara and al-A'raf, with many small swaps (enter or dwell, eat with or without the conjunction, the order of prostrating and saying the word). One of the richest memorizer pairs.

cmp:1fbst8q080b7uq.why: The same story with its sequel: the command to enter the town and the wrongdoers changing the word. The sequel also differs (sent down or sent, transgressing or wronging), so the two ayat together are needed for memorizers.

cmp:1wem4xy0kk9d0c.why: The reason for humiliation and wrath given three times: disbelief in God's signs and killing prophets. The small swaps (prophets in two plurals, without right with or without the article, the added killing of those who command justice) are classic memorizer traps.
cmp:1wem4xy0kk9d0c.relation: The same charge sheet against those who killed the prophets, in al-Baqara and Al Imran.

cmp:175r0kv0c88p3h.why: Extends the same charge to 4:155, where the verbs become nouns (their disbelief, their killing). Good for memorizers to see the verbal and noun forms side by side.

cmp:1w6kqlo055zoym.why: The list of believers, Jews, Christians and Sabians in three surahs, with the order and case of the Sabians changing and 22:17 adding Magians and polytheists with a different ending. A classic memorizer set; also worth pondering how the end differs (reward versus judgement between them).
cmp:1w6kqlo055zoym.relation: Two ayat promise reward to whoever believes; the third leaves the judgement between all groups to God.

cmp:0udz98k19p3p1c.why: The covenant and the mount raised over them, word for word, then two different continuations: remember what is in it, or hear (and they said: we hear and disobey). Memorizer pair and a telling contrast.
cmp:0udz98k19p3p1c.relation: The same covenant, recalled first as a call to remember and then as the scene of their open disobedience.

cmp:1gcfd1615lebcc.why: Their claim that the fire will touch them only for a few days, with the plural adjective in two forms. A famous memorizer pair; the books explain the difference.

cmp:096imnh1m8nsrl.why: A single ayah (2:100). There is no second place in the card to compare.

cmp:1tvufnp0hzz8jr.why: The warning not to follow their desires after knowledge has come, three times with different wording (after that which, after what, from after what) and different endings. A key memorizer set.

cmp:1ygftrd1r01aq7.why: The same warning in its two al-Baqara places, differing in the relative word and the ending. Valid pair, though it is contained in the three-ayah card on the same words.

cmp:0t11ukc0ae9o2i.why: The same statement on guidance, with its two halves inverted: God's guidance is the guidance (2:120) and the guidance is God's guidance (3:73). A sharp memorizer trap and worth pondering.
cmp:0t11ukc0ae9o2i.relation: One truth said from both ends, both answering the People of the Book.

cmp:1oo397p079cd3f.why: Abraham's prayer for the town: a town (indefinite) in 2:126, this town (definite) in 14:35, followed by different requests. Classic memorizer pair; the books link it to the town before and after it was built.
cmp:1oo397p079cd3f.relation: The same prayer, first for a place yet to become a town, then for the established town.

cmp:1fqlh380pfag7y.why: In Abraham's prayer purification comes after teaching (2:129); in the answer it comes before (3:164, 62:2). A famous memorizer point and worth pondering.
cmp:1fqlh380pfag7y.relation: The prayer and its fulfilment, with the order of purifying and teaching reversed.

cmp:1pvcnkn09ge9qv.why: The four places of the messenger who recites, purifies and teaches the Book and wisdom, with the order and pronouns changing. Core memorizer set.

cmp:0r286150sg1pf1.why: The same refrain, word for word, closing two passages on Abraham and his sons. Memorizers need to know it occurs twice; the repeat drives home that each nation answers for its own deeds.

cmp:0nuoww51q2nzwr.why: The command to turn to the Sacred Mosque three times in one passage, each with a different continuation. The books discuss the purpose of each repeat; core memorizer set.

cmp:0bu1jda1wss6t2.why: Do not fear them, fear Me: once with the final pronoun written (2:150) and twice without it (5:3, 5:44, the latter with people named). A fine memorizer point.
cmp:0bu1jda1wss6t2.relation: The same command to fear God alone, at the qibla change, the completion of religion, and judging by the Torah.

cmp:0b65ega0qz19qa.why: The messenger sent from among you: as a favour on the believers (2:151, 3:164) and as one who cares for you (9:128). Worth pondering the closeness of the messenger to his people.
cmp:0b65ega0qz19qa.relation: The messenger from among themselves, described by his mission and by his care for them.

check.why: Book card; the messenger from among them, as favour and as one who cares. 2:151 and 3:164 are a classic memorizer pair. Keep.

cmp:18bdjwz1xn6aoj.why: Those who conceal what God sent down and those who sell His covenant for a small price, with different punishments (cursed, eating fire, no share in the Hereafter). Same theme; memorizers must keep the endings apart.
cmp:18bdjwz1xn6aoj.relation: Concealing the truth and selling it cheaply, and how each is punished.

check.why: Book card; concealing and selling God's word, with endings a memorizer must keep apart. Keep.

cmp:1kb727v04cpjon.why: The exception for those who repent and amend: with 'and made clear' in 2:160, with 'after that' in 3:89 and 24:5. A memorizer set; the added clarifying fits those who had concealed.
cmp:1kb727v04cpjon.relation: Repentance fitted to the sin: those who concealed must also make clear.

cmp:1xv3c6m083nzj0.why: Signs for people who use reason, in four places, each listing different signs. Memorizers need to know which closing goes with which ayah; the set invites pondering what reason should draw from creation.

cmp:0bezcjt1c9xgdz.why: God reviving the earth after its death, six times, with or without the extra particle and with different endings (resurrection, signs, most do not reason). Worth pondering as a proof of resurrection and useful for memorizers.
cmp:0bezcjt1c9xgdz.relation: The reviving of dead earth used again and again as the sign of the dead being raised.

cmp:1sezamr0zeqgql.why: The three places where rain revives the earth with the past verb, one adding the particle before 'after its death'. A fine memorizer distinction the books explain.

cmp:0qsueth1xztcub.why: Blind following of forefathers, three times, with found or met, do not reason or do not know, and Satan in the third. Classic memorizer set and the same theme.
cmp:0qsueth1xztcub.relation: The same excuse of the forefathers, answered each time by exposing what the forefathers were.

cmp:0lh789l0asllbh.why: The exception for one forced by necessity, with the endings changing (no sin on him; your Lord is forgiving; God is forgiving). Same ruling, core memorizer set.

cmp:176g62404i8w8g.why: What is dedicated to other than God: the word order of 'to it' and 'to other than God' flips between 2:173 and the other places. A famous memorizer trap explained by all three books.

cmp:1jrj90s0atifam.why: Two neighbouring ayat on bequests, parallel in form, closing with different names of God: hearing and knowing for one who alters a will, forgiving and merciful for one who sets it right. Worth pondering how each ending fits.
cmp:1jrj90s0atifam.relation: The one who corrupts a will is told God hears and knows; the one who mends it is told God forgives.

check.why: Book card; two adjacent ayat on bequests with fitting closing names. Keep.

cmp:0wtnx0f1l7xbcb.why: The concession for the sick appears three times: with 'among you' in 2:184 and 2:196, without it in 2:185, and in 2:196 for the pilgrim with a ransom instead of later days. Close neighbours that memorizers mix up.

cmp:12rftp3127rxhl.why: These are God's limits: do not come near them (fasting and seclusion) and do not overstep them (divorce). Classic memorizer pair; the books explain why each verb fits.
cmp:12rftp3127rxhl.relation: Limits around desire are not to be approached; limits of rights are not to be crossed.

check.why: Book card; do not approach against do not overstep. A classic pair. Keep.

cmp:1a5vj8f1tgmvt5.why: Of the many 'they ask you about' ayat, only 20:105 answers with the extra particle before 'say'. The book explains it; useful for memorizers.

check.why: Book card; the extra particle before the command to say in 20:105 is the known memorizer point. Keep.

cmp:1k6arc21mtow84.why: The book groups three classic pairs from al-Baqara, Al Imran, al-Anfal and al-Hashr: fight them until there is no persecution (with 'all of it' in 8:39), victory only from God (word order of 'hearts' and 'by it'), and opposing God and His messenger (doubled letters and the messenger omitted in 59:4). Each pair is a strong memorizer trap, though the three pairs are different topics.

cmp:1qypawl1xw3htn.why: Did you think you would enter Paradise (or be left alone) before trials and before God makes known those who strive? Three places with different continuations; a classic memorizer set and the same theme of testing.
cmp:1qypawl1xw3htn.relation: Paradise and acceptance are not reached without being tested.

check.why: Book card; the classic set on being tested before Paradise. Keep.

cmp:03jy1gb0z4v44j.why: Two ayat in al-Baqara end with the same closing, that God makes the signs clear so you may reflect. Memorizers must know which rulings and parables carry this ending.

check.why: Book card; the same closing on two rulings in al-Baqara. Keep.

cmp:0n9wasq0sizmq2.why: A single ayah (2:221). The book comments on the repeated prohibition inside it, but there is no second place to compare.

cmp:1fp9u0h1lobxph.why: Keeping in kindness or releasing in goodness (2:229) versus releasing in kindness (2:231). A small swap that memorizers trip on.

cmp:0nrmo3s15ich3y.why: When the waiting term ends: keep them in kindness or release them (2:231) or part from them (65:2). Same ruling; a classic memorizer pair.

cmp:03300io0bhub28.why: A single ayah (2:231). Nothing in the card to compare it with.

cmp:18439pa00xx94u.why: The same reminder closes divorce rulings in two surahs, with and without 'among you' and with 'that' in two forms. Memorizer pair on the same subject.

cmp:1c9z3s61q7ad64.why: Two laws on widows, with the same 'no blame on you for what they do with themselves', differing in 'in what is right' versus 'of what is right' and in the closing names. Classic pair the books explain.

cmp:1fwii7w1w5l8b0.why: God is full of bounty to people but most are ungrateful: five places, ending 'most people' or 'most of them'. Memorizers need the split; the refrain invites pondering ingratitude.
cmp:1fwii7w1w5l8b0.relation: God's bounty is constant; human thanks is the exception.

cmp:10eu2ho06bivz6.why: A single ayah (2:253). The book's note is internal to it; nothing to compare.

cmp:1axysim1lxjei4.why: Seven ears of grain in two places with two plural forms (2:261 and 12:43). The book explains the choice of plural; a neat point for memorizers and for pondering abundance against scarcity.
cmp:1axysim1lxjei4.relation: Seven ears multiplying charity, and seven ears in the king's dream of plenty and drought.

check.why: Book card; two plural forms for the seven ears. Keep.

cmp:02pipdg1hxxc8a.why: They have no power over anything they earned, with the two halves reversed in 14:18. Two parables of wasted deeds; a classic memorizer pair.
cmp:02pipdg1hxxc8a.relation: Charity spoiled by showing off and the deeds of disbelievers both end as nothing in hand.

check.why: Book card; the two halves reversed between two parables of lost deeds. Keep.

cmp:1p2lvp70u9x6uf.why: A single ayah (2:271). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1krzppu087ijag.why: God does not love a certain kind: the sinful disbeliever, the boastful, the treacherous. Both boastful ayat run on to those who are stingy and enjoin stinginess, which shows the link between pride and avarice. Useful for memorizers (every versus whoever was) and for pondering.
cmp:1krzppu087ijag.relation: Pride and stinginess named together twice: the boaster is the one who withholds.

cmp:1qrbyjk0xiewym.why: The same set without the run-ons: God does not love every sinful disbeliever, whoever is boastful, whoever is treacherous. The wording (every versus whoever was) shifts and memorizers mix the endings.

check.why: Book card; whom God does not love, with shifting wording. Keep.

cmp:1tnh65913hm10h.why: He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills, five times, reversed in 5:40 and with different endings. A classic memorizer set; the order invites pondering where mercy is put first and why.
cmp:1tnh65913hm10h.relation: Forgiveness comes first except in 5:40, which follows the punishment of thieves.

cmp:1ql19r90hk77p3.why: Revealing the Book with the intensive verb (3:3) and the plain one (18:1). The book discusses the two verb forms; a small point useful to memorizers.

check.why: Book card; the two verb forms for sending down the Book. Keep.

cmp:09rrlzr1jxrflt.why: Within two ayat the Quran is sent down with one verb form and the Torah, Gospel and Criterion with another. The book explains the difference (gradual versus all at once); worth pondering.
cmp:09rrlzr1jxrflt.relation: The Quran came down in stages, the earlier scriptures at once.

cmp:0yeroni0rcnm1c.why: Only the name of the Torah is shared; 3:3 lists the scriptures sent down and 3:93 is about food made lawful before the Torah. Different subjects, nothing for a memorizer to confuse.

check.why: Book card; only the name of the Torah links them and the subjects differ. An honest drop, and the card stays visible anyway.

cmp:0zfglar1qys38v.why: Places where the earth is named before the heaven, against the usual order. The book explains why; memorizers need to know these exceptions.
cmp:0zfglar1qys38v.relation: Earth comes first where the speech is about people on earth.

cmp:0btskml170kbe5.why: God does not break His promise: spoken of Him in 3:9, spoken to Him in 3:194. A classic memorizer pair within one surah.
cmp:0btskml170kbe5.relation: The same truth, first as a statement, then as a direct plea.

cmp:1989vmk12rpwak.why: Neither wealth nor children will avail the disbelievers, three times, ending as fuel of the fire or as companions of the fire forever, with and without the opening and the conjunction. Classic memorizer set.

cmp:0lq78tb1jnqfir.why: Like the way of Pharaoh's people: denied Our signs, disbelieved in God's signs, denied their Lord's signs, then seized or destroyed. Two of these are only two ayat apart in al-Anfal. Core memorizer set and worth pondering the two stages (seizing, then drowning).
cmp:0lq78tb1jnqfir.relation: The same precedent applied twice in al-Anfal: first their disbelief and seizure, then their denial and drowning.

cmp:0wiin9j1e74ik5.why: A single ayah (3:11). The comparison is already in the three-ayah card on the same words.

cmp:1ucuxhu060at00.why: A single ayah (3:18). The book remarks on the testimony repeated inside it; there is no second place to compare.

check.why: Book card with one row; nothing to compare across places. Honest drop; the entry stays visible.

cmp:0n1at260a0xun0.why: Submitting one's face to God, with two prepositions: to God in 3:20 and towards God in 31:22. A fine memorizer point the book explains.

cmp:0g8svw608ps07i.why: He brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living, four times, with a noun instead of a verb in 6:95 and different surroundings. Core memorizer set and a sign worth pondering.
cmp:0g8svw608ps07i.relation: Life from death and death from life, used as a proof of God's sole power.

cmp:1odzayb0lgys9z.why: God warns you of Himself twice within three ayat: first closing with the return to God, then with His kindness to servants. Memorizer pair and worth pondering: the warning is itself a mercy.
cmp:1odzayb0lgys9z.relation: The same warning ends once with the return to God and once with His compassion.

check.why: Book card; the warning repeated with two closings. Keep.

cmp:153woeb0mjt9c5.why: Jesus's call to worship God his Lord and theirs, three times, with or without the conjunction and the pronoun of emphasis. Same speaker and message; a classic memorizer set.

cmp:0vznhez13e9kpr.why: The disciples' answer, 'bear witness that we are Muslims', with two forms of the pronoun in 3:52 and 5:111. Same story; a fine memorizer trap.

cmp:0rowcvh1erma9v.why: Disbelieving after their faith (3:86) and after their Islam (9:74). The book explains why: the first had borne witness to the truth, the hypocrites only outwardly submitted. Worth pondering and a memorizer trap.
cmp:0rowcvh1erma9v.relation: Apostasy after real faith versus hypocrites who had only professed Islam.

cmp:0s5ztsw1sjryle.why: Turning people away from God's path and seeking crookedness in it: said to the People of the Book (3:99) and by Shu'ayb to his people (7:86), with small wording changes. Memorizer pair and a shared theme.
cmp:0s5ztsw1sjryle.relation: The same obstruction of believers, in Madinah and in Midian.

cmp:1n9n5vr0s6jqh9.why: God did not wrong them but they wronged themselves, with and without 'were' (3:117, 16:33). A classic memorizer pair the book explains.

cmp:1ijnhy41oezpmo.why: Ranks with God: degree in the singular and degrees in the plural in neighbouring ayat (4:95, 4:96), and ranks in other surahs. The book explains the singular and plural; worth pondering how ranks follow deeds.
cmp:1ijnhy41oezpmo.relation: People are ranked by what they did: one degree over those who stayed behind, and many degrees of reward.

check.why: Book card; ranks by deeds, singular and plural degree in 4:95 and 4:96. Keep.

cmp:010pzxc1n1gjlw.why: Saying what is not in their hearts: with their mouths (3:167) and with their tongues (48:11). Two hypocrite groups, a classic memorizer pair.
cmp:010pzxc1n1gjlw.relation: The same gap between word and heart in the hypocrites of Uhud and the Bedouins who stayed behind.

cmp:1qybkxb00jnpnz.why: That is for what your hands sent forth, and God is not unjust to servants: twice the plural (3:182, 8:51), once the dual addressed to one man (22:10). Memorizer set and a firm statement of divine justice.

cmp:12avxti079iwc2.why: Patience as a matter of resolve, three times with three openings (indeed that is, then indeed that is, indeed that is surely). The book explains the added emphasis; good for memorizers and for pondering patience.
cmp:12avxti079iwc2.relation: Patience under harm from others, under trials, and in forgiving: each is called true resolve.

cmp:13dzhd00d2h6ws.why: Their refuge is Hell: an evil resting place (3:197) versus an evil destination (9:73, 66:9, which are identical). Memorizers must know the identical pair and the odd one.

cmp:0va2u5p0e1b4pl.why: Created you from one soul, then its mate: created, made, then made. Same subject, a classic memorizer set the book explains.

cmp:1fvxhpa0wzn6s8.why: He who created you: from one soul, from clay, produced you from one soul. Same subject of human origin with different verbs and continuations; useful for memorizers.
cmp:1fvxhpa0wzn6s8.relation: Human origin traced to one soul and to clay, each followed by a different lesson.

cmp:0xrtnvx0l81jlz.why: Provide for them and speak to them kindly: to the weak-minded and to relatives at the division of inheritance. Same command in neighbouring ayat; worth pondering that giving is paired with kind words.
cmp:0xrtnvx0l81jlz.relation: Material help always joined to kind speech.

cmp:07iuo660x7nt3o.why: A single ayah (4:12). The book's note is on the repeated phrases inside it; nothing to compare.

cmp:03loa2b0qcudf3.why: Gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding there: with or without 'forever', with or without the preposition before 'beneath' (9:100). These small additions are classic memorizer traps, even though the promise is a common formula.

check.why: Book card; the small additions in the gardens formula are the memorizer traps. Keep.

cmp:08cqszw1bczt66.why: The same reward and ending, with and without the conjunction before 'that is the great success'. A tight memorizer pair.

cmp:19hsvdr0jjays7.why: Fifteen places of the gardens formula with different subjects and endings. As one card it is too wide to learn from; the real traps are already in the smaller cards on the same promise. Two rows of 61:10 to 61:12 do not carry the phrase themselves.

check.why: I would keep this book card. The reasons given for the drop are that it is wide and that smaller cards already hold the traps. The owner never made that a rule, and the book chose this set. The rows carry real memorizer differences: 9:100 lacks the particle before beneath it, some rows add forever, and the endings differ (the great triumph, that is the great triumph, the big triumph, reward of the doers of good). That is the core of what a memorizer must keep apart. The runOn flag is fine.

cmp:192yph20u66yyq.why: It is an immorality and an evil way: marrying the father's wives adds 'and hateful' (4:22), fornication does not (17:32). Memorizer pair, and the addition is worth pondering.
cmp:192yph20u66yyq.relation: Marrying a father's wife is called not only immoral but also detestable.

cmp:0xt3jsi13ropji.why: The same word for chaste women in three neighbouring rulings, meaning married women, free women and chaste believing women. Worth pondering how one word shifts sense, and memorizers must keep the following words apart.
cmp:0xt3jsi13ropji.relation: One word read three ways: married, free, and chaste.

cmp:1qkq39c0up7106.why: Chaste women followed by different words (of the punishment in 4:25, of the believers in 5:5). The pair is contained in the three-ayah card on the same word, but is a valid memorizer comparison.

check.why: Book card; chaste women followed by different words. Keep.

cmp:07g8wxv0pq6nzx.why: A witness from every nation and the Prophet as witness over these: once as a question of awe (4:41), once as a statement with the Book's purpose (16:89). Memorizer pair on the same scene.
cmp:07g8wxv0pq6nzx.relation: The same scene of witnesses on the Day, once as a question and once as a description.

cmp:09gagx01kaxpdk.why: The dry ablution ruling word for word, with 'from it' added only in 5:6. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1yv226w1nfowlu.why: Three ways of addressing the People of the Book: 'you who were given the Book' (4:47) and 'People of the Book' (5:19, 5:59). The book discusses why the address changes; modest memorizer value.

check.why: Book card; the two forms of addressing the People of the Book. Modest but real. Keep.

cmp:1rb8ckz0q5bvcl.why: The same ayah on shirk twice in one surah, ending with 'invented a great sin' and 'strayed far'. The books link each ending to its context (the People of the Book, the polytheists).
cmp:1rb8ckz0q5bvcl.relation: Shirk as a lie against God, and shirk as going far astray.

cmp:1263tnu1ri1f2s.why: Who is truer than God in speech: two different words for speech closing two ayat of al-Nisa. A classic memorizer pair.

check.why: Book card; two words for speech closing the same question. Keep.

cmp:1js7lzt1dk21t9.why: We sent down the Book to you with two prepositions (towards you in 4:105, upon you in 39:41), and 'for people' added in 39:41. Fine memorizer point the book explains.

cmp:0yqvsc51n2tgg3.why: Whoever opposes the messenger, or God and His messenger, with the doubled or merged letters and with the messenger dropped in 59:4. Classic memorizer set.

cmp:09zcda20w0h3tw.why: To God belongs what is in the heavens and the earth, repeated six times in a short stretch of al-Nisa with different endings. The book asks why; memorizers need the endings and the one place without the second 'what is in'.
cmp:09zcda20w0h3tw.relation: Each repetition backs a different point: His encompassing, His self-sufficiency, His being enough as guardian.

cmp:1vzrsuw1obdkfe.why: They ask your ruling; say God gives you His ruling: about women (4:127) and about inheritance without heirs (4:176), with and without the conjunction. Memorizer pair framing al-Nisa's two rulings sections.

cmp:021w12303dlhhh.why: Two neighbouring ayat on marriage, both with 'and fear God, then God is', ending 'aware of what you do' and 'forgiving, merciful'. Memorizer pair and a fitting contrast of endings.
cmp:021w12303dlhhh.relation: Doing good is met with His knowledge; making amends is met with His forgiveness.

cmp:17fqoo01n13yp2.why: Three neighbouring ayat that close with God's attributes after the separation of spouses and the repeated ownership of the heavens and earth. Useful to see how each ending fits, though it overlaps the larger card on the same repetition.

check.why: Book card; the repeated ownership of the heavens and earth with a different closing each time. Keep.

cmp:013tjpq02b8zu4.why: Two back-to-back ayat both opening with God's ownership of the heavens and earth. The book asks why it is repeated; a small but real memorizer point.

cmp:0ap5opb0z38loh.why: Stand firm for justice as witnesses for God, and for God as witnesses in justice: the order is reversed. A famous memorizer pair; the books explain the reversal from the context (kin versus enemies).
cmp:0ap5opb0z38loh.relation: Justice even against oneself and kin, and justice even towards enemies.

cmp:1u1p1mn1w9ophz.why: God will not forgive them or guide them, to a way (4:137) or to a road (4:168, which runs on to: except the road of Hell). Memorizer pair; the run-on explains the word chosen.
cmp:1u1p1mn1w9ophz.relation: The road they are denied is answered by the only road left to them.

cmp:07bo39d1hdnbcz.why: If you show or hide something, God is: pardoning and able (4:149), knowing all (33:54). Memorizer pair with endings fitted to their context.

cmp:1qwxx430ijd7lb.why: Livestock is lawful except what is recited to you, followed by two different continuations (not hunting in ihram; avoid idols and false speech). Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1fjj4k00tcq914.why: Seeking bounty and pleasure: from their Lord (5:2) or from God (48:29, 59:8). A fine memorizer distinction the book explains.

cmp:1qrcmxq1bfrj7q.why: Let not hatred of a people lead you to transgress (5:2) or to be unjust (5:8). Memorizer pair and the same ethical point.
cmp:1qrcmxq1bfrj7q.relation: Enmity must not push you into aggression nor out of justice.

cmp:1wk3g901mi9r1e.why: He completes His favour on you so that you may give thanks (5:6) or submit (16:81). Memorizer pair with endings fitted to purification and to shelter.
cmp:1wk3g901mi9r1e.relation: Favours of the body and home are meant to lead to thanks and to surrender.

cmp:1yh96p41hi5o24.why: Fear God; God knows what is in the breasts (5:7) and is aware of what you do (5:8). Neighbouring ayat with endings fitted to a covenant of the heart and to deeds of justice.

cmp:0rkcj5616gtzf8.why: God promised those who believe and do good: theirs is forgiveness (5:9), or of them forgiveness (48:29), with the reward in two cases. Memorizer pair the books discuss.

cmp:1b2n0fe0ht7ff2.why: They forgot a share of what they were reminded of: the Jews (5:13) and the Christians (5:14), each with a different consequence. Memorizer pair and a parallel worth pondering.
cmp:1b2n0fe0ht7ff2.relation: Both peoples broke the covenant the same way and received different consequences.

cmp:1ekbxaa02yksfc.why: Distorting words from their places (5:13) and from after their places (5:41). A classic memorizer point the books explain.

cmp:0ilyqqe0puh4ko.why: The same call to the People of the Book, our messenger has come making things clear, continuing once with what they hid of the Book and once with the gap between messengers. Memorizer pair four ayat apart.
cmp:0ilyqqe0puh4ko.relation: The messenger comes both to expose what they concealed and to end their excuse that no warner came.

cmp:0wofk720sgxevk.why: They have disbelieved who say God is the Messiah (5:17, 5:72) or the third of three (5:73). The same sentence with two false claims; memorizers must keep the continuations apart.
cmp:0wofk720sgxevk.relation: The two Christian claims answered with the same verdict and different proofs.

cmp:0nz7n5x19olqmf.why: Two neighbouring ayat answer two claims (the Messiah is God; we are God's sons) with the same clause of God's dominion, ending differently. Memorizer pair and a clear parallel for pondering.
cmp:0nz7n5x19olqmf.relation: Both claims are answered by recalling that everything belongs to God.

cmp:0l5xy0e0n1qjrs.why: Who has any power against God if He wills: with and without 'for you', and followed by destroying the Messiah or by harm or benefit. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0vqcopb0zdutcj.why: Moses says 'remember God's favour upon you when', with 'O my people' only in 5:20, and two different favours named. Memorizer pair from the same story.
cmp:0vqcopb0zdutcj.relation: Moses reminds his people once of prophets and kingship, once of rescue from Pharaoh.

cmp:1w0jgt41ojqu7w.why: If they had all that is on earth and as much again to ransom themselves: two forms of the ransom verb and different endings. Memorizer pair on the same image.
cmp:1w0jgt41ojqu7w.relation: No ransom will be accepted, however great.

cmp:1ebz7i11rgdzhv.why: God's dominion with forgiving and punishing in reversed order: punishment first in 5:40 after the thief's penalty, forgiveness first in 48:14. Memorizer pair worth pondering for the order.
cmp:1ebz7i11rgdzhv.relation: The order of punishment and forgiveness follows the context.

cmp:193qkip1o1czbl.why: Whoever does not judge by what God revealed: disbelievers, wrongdoers, sinners, in three neighbouring ayat. A famous memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:193qkip1o1czbl.relation: One failure described three ways according to the context of each ayah.

cmp:1fcxqpb1waak4x.why: We sent after them Jesus son of Mary (5:46), then our messengers and Jesus (57:27). Same theme of succession of prophets; memorizer pair.

cmp:16b64cl0e14trh.why: To God is your return, all of you: with God named or a pronoun, with or without 'all'. Short phrase but a real memorizer trap across three surahs.

cmp:15n1f9s15g46fm.why: Obey God and obey the messenger, with 'and beware' and 'then know' only in 5:92. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1wjxsff1chju37.why: Two pleas that close with the Mighty, the Wise rather than the Forgiving, the Merciful: Jesus on his people and Abraham's followers. Worth pondering why might and wisdom close a plea for forgiveness.
cmp:1wjxsff1chju37.relation: Forgiveness asked of the One who is mighty enough to forgive and wise in whom He forgives.

cmp:1gaqk7d07boi95.why: A single ayah (5:119). Nothing in the card to compare.

check.why: Book card with one row; nothing to compare. Honest drop.

cmp:026kdwl10nneg5.why: They denied, and the news of what they mocked will come to them: longer with 'the truth when it came' and 'will' in a different form in 6:5. Memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:00fglom1lkpg7o.why: The same pair with their next ayat: after the denial, 'have they not seen' with and without the conjunction, pointing once to destroyed nations and once to plants on earth. Memorizer value in the sequel.

cmp:0vg9etg0jm13h6.why: How many generations We destroyed before them: eight places, varying 'from before' and 'before', a generation or the generations, and the opening particle. Core memorizer set; one lesson from history.
cmp:0vg9etg0jm13h6.relation: Past nations destroyed, used each time to warn the present one.

cmp:0qcrmuq0l7syyu.why: The three places where 'have they not seen' comes without the conjunction. The book explains the bare form; a precise memorizer point.

cmp:187imii1rcnfy6.why: Have they not seen (6:6) against and have they not seen (26:7): the conjunction is the whole difference. Memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:1elomu41cet1ka.why: Travel in the land then look, or and look: 'then' only in 6:11. The four endings also differ. Classic memorizer set.
cmp:1elomu41cet1ka.relation: Travel to learn from the end of deniers, criminals, polytheists, and from the start of creation.

cmp:0vsnmwp1kf6lhf.why: Look how was the end of: deniers (twice), criminals, those before. Memorizers must match each ending and the 'then' or 'and' before it.

cmp:0a4in6a12hnyms.why: Those who lost themselves, so they do not believe: the same clause twice in al-An'am, once after the Day of gathering and once after the People of the Book who know the Prophet. Memorizer pair.
cmp:0a4in6a12hnyms.relation: Losing oneself is the reason for disbelief whether one doubts the Day or denies what one knows.

cmp:1gwzfcf15z5kyv.why: The clear triumph appears only in these two places, both tied to God's mercy. Memorizer pair and a link worth pondering.
cmp:1gwzfcf15z5kyv.relation: The clear triumph is being taken into God's mercy.

cmp:1hclwim14lqvfs.why: If God touches you with harm none removes it but He; then two continuations for good (He is able over all things; none can repel His favour). Classic memorizer pair.

check.why: Book card; the same opening with two continuations for good. Keep.

cmp:1gchsgq1ctdkmq.why: Who does greater wrong than one who invents a lie against God: nine places, with 'and who' or 'so who', and different continuations and endings. One of the core memorizer sets.

cmp:18exejc0waojyc.why: The same set as the larger card minus 18:15. A valid memorizer set, though nearly identical to the other card.

cmp:1y5w2mb1viqnlb.why: Six of the places of 'who does greater wrong than one who invents a lie against God', with their different continuations. A valid memorizer set, contained in the larger card on the same words.

cmp:1hth38x1vc6tc3.why: The three places that continue 'or denies His signs', with 'and who' or 'so who' and three endings (wrongdoers do not prosper, their share of the Book, criminals do not prosper). Tight memorizer set.

cmp:13pgmgj0a9p0u5.why: Identical except the opening conjunction and the last word: wrongdoers in 6:21, criminals in 10:17. A sharp memorizer pair.

cmp:0yqxoge09lhupe.why: Among them is one who listens to you, in the singular (6:25) and plural (10:42), and one who looks at you (10:43). Memorizer set the book explains.
cmp:0yqxoge09lhupe.relation: Listening without hearing and looking without seeing: the deaf and the blind of heart.

cmp:0ul4iea0ezebdk.why: One who listens to you: singular verb in 6:25, plural in 10:42 with the same singular pronoun. The book explains it; a precise memorizer point.

cmp:11dr15u0i0cux2.why: If you could see when they are made to stand before the Fire (6:27) and before their Lord (6:30). Two scenes three ayat apart; memorizer pair and worth pondering together.
cmp:11dr15u0i0cux2.relation: Standing before the Fire they wish to return; standing before their Lord they confess.

cmp:0vrw1w31xcob3b.why: It is only our worldly life: the deniers of resurrection in three surahs, with and without 'we die and live' and different endings. Same claim; classic memorizer set.

cmp:076ilhu1me5xki.why: Worldly life as play and amusement, with the two words in either order and different continuations. A classic memorizer set; worth pondering.
cmp:076ilhu1me5xki.relation: The worldly life called play and diversion, set against the lasting home.

cmp:02mhnpr0qn086j.why: The home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear God: three forms of the opening (with the preposition, plain, and with the construct) and two verb forms. Classic memorizer set.

check.why: Book card; three forms of the abode of the Hereafter. Keep.

cmp:1xqzzvg15ipepo.why: Why has no sign been sent down to him from his Lord: a sign (6:37) or signs (29:50), two verb forms, and two different answers. Memorizer pair on the same demand.
cmp:1xqzzvg15ipepo.relation: The demand for miracles is answered once with God's power and once with the Prophet's role as warner.

cmp:0ue48or12tjc0r.why: Say: have you considered, in two forms (with and without the extra pronoun suffix) across al-An'am and Yunus, each about punishment coming suddenly. Memorizer set the books explain.

cmp:05z9zlq0wit2a8.why: The three al-An'am places of 'have you considered', two with the suffix and one without. Contained in the larger card but a valid memorizer set.

cmp:0ay28ph1a69fwj.why: The form 'have you considered' with the extra suffix: twice in al-An'am and once in Iblis's words (17:62). The book discusses this form; modest memorizer value.

check.why: Book card; the form of have you considered with the added suffix. Keep.

cmp:0yz1jet1g29pqf.why: Seized them with hardship and affliction so they might humble themselves, with two forms of the verb. Classic memorizer pair on the same sunna.
cmp:0yz1jet1g29pqf.relation: Hardship sent to nations to bring them to humility.

cmp:1xsiflz1v3kfwh.why: Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds, closing four scenes: the wrongdoers cut off, the people of Paradise, the end of al-Saffat, the final judgement. Worth pondering: every decisive end is met with praise.
cmp:1xsiflz1v3kfwh.relation: Praise as the last word after each judgement and in Paradise.

cmp:04kdukm1wt6x56.why: See how We vary the signs: then they turn away (6:46) or so that they may understand (6:65). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:1sh7d7l1nwzs61.why: The same disclaimer by Muhammad and by Noah: no treasures, no knowledge of the unseen, not an angel, with small wording differences. Memorizer pair and a parallel between prophets.
cmp:1sh7d7l1nwzs61.relation: Two prophets disclaim the same powers in the same words.

check.why: Book card; the same disclaimer by two prophets. Keep.

cmp:1aj8b7x1w2jg7x.why: Humbly and secretly (6:63) against humbly and in awe (7:205): two words differing by one letter's position. A famous memorizer trap.

cmp:0lo2qbt19n87ev.why: Punishment from above and from beneath (6:65) beside the earth swallowing them and a storm of stones from the sky (67:16 to 67:17). The run-on gives the second half of the parallel. Worth pondering, though the shared wording is thin.
cmp:0lo2qbt19n87ev.relation: The same two directions of punishment, from above and from below.

check.why: Book card; punishment from above and below in both places. Keep, runOn flag is appropriate.

cmp:0vvkfud1tyjt37.why: Four places on play and amusement with the order of the two words changing. Contained in the larger card on worldly life, but a valid memorizer set.

cmp:0trlupj10q567l.why: Benefit and harm, in either order, across nine places. The order is the memorizer trap the book explains (benefit first except where harm is the point); the theme of powerless idols is shared.
cmp:0trlupj10q567l.relation: Idols and people alike own no benefit or harm; only God does.

cmp:1jvcwk0040gwxs.why: No reward asked; it is only a reminder to the worlds, with two forms of the word reminder. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0n2ovwi1qshdu6.why: It is only a reminder to the worlds: the longer form of the word in 6:90, the short form in 81:27. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0ei7csy1jwey6e.why: Guarding their prayer: singular in 6:92 and 70:34, plural in 23:9. A classic memorizer point.

cmp:15y5fap0pzcixp.why: You have come to Us as We created you the first time, continuing differently (leaving behind what was given; rather you claimed). Same scene of resurrection; memorizer pair.
cmp:15y5fap0pzcixp.relation: Coming back to God alone and bare, as at creation.

cmp:0xl48fb1trean3.why: Three neighbouring ayat opening 'it is He who' and closing with signs for people who know, who understand, who believe. The books explain why each ending fits its sign; a core memorizer set.
cmp:0xl48fb1trean3.relation: Stars call for knowledge, the origin of souls for deep understanding, plants for faith.

cmp:1a6ebw91s0o5cp.why: Look at its fruit when it bears (6:99) against eat of its fruit when it bears (6:141), in two passages on gardens and olives and pomegranates. Memorizer pair and a link worth pondering.
cmp:1a6ebw91s0o5cp.relation: The same fruit is first a sign to look at, then a provision to eat and pay its due.

cmp:1okpkk00k6voxa.why: That is God your Lord: 'no god but He' and 'creator of all things' in opposite order, with different endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:040ljv5054jaa3.why: Had your Lord willed (6:112) and had God willed (6:137) they would not have done it, so leave them with what they invent. Memorizer pair within one surah.

cmp:0t5t3h00k0g0uc.why: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is guided: present or past verb, with or without the preposition, the guided as a participle or a verb. Core memorizer set.

cmp:0o7vs1r07piuih.why: Three of the four places of 'your Lord knows best who strays', with the same small variants. Contained in the larger card but a valid memorizer set.

cmp:1nsh28v0tiurpz.why: Identical except 'who strays' in the present without the preposition (6:117) and 'who strayed' with it (68:7). A sharp memorizer pair.

cmp:14wy4od04ajotl.why: Thus their deeds were made to seem good to the disbelievers (6:122) and to the extravagant (10:12). Memorizer pair with the subject changing.

cmp:09lddf81nq7hqc.why: Your Lord would not destroy towns unjustly while their people were heedless (6:131) or doing good (11:117). Memorizer pair and worth pondering together.
cmp:09lddf81nq7hqc.relation: No town is destroyed while unwarned, nor while its people set things right.

cmp:1q52j8y0hfw8eo.why: O my people, act according to your position; I am acting: 'then you will know' twice and 'you will know' without the particle in Shu'ayb's words. Classic memorizer set.

cmp:1v8zpeb02n25w3.why: The polytheists' argument from God's will in two surahs, with 'we would not have associated' or 'we would not have worshipped other than Him', and different endings. Classic memorizer pair on the same claim.
cmp:1v8zpeb02n25w3.relation: Blaming God's will for their shirk, answered as the excuse of every earlier denier.

cmp:05jnl0z078atgn.why: This He enjoins on you so you may reason, remember, be mindful: three consecutive ayat of the ten commandments. A famous memorizer set the books explain.
cmp:05jnl0z078atgn.relation: Each set of commands ends with the faculty it most needs.

cmp:01cpxly0takm5o.why: Do not kill your children out of poverty, We provide for you and them; or for fear of poverty, We provide for them and you. A famous memorizer pair and a meaning worth pondering.

cmp:16aq6ml0tntufl.why: I am the first of the Muslims (Muhammad, 6:163) and the first of the believers (Moses, 7:143). Memorizer pair and a parallel between two prophets.
cmp:16aq6ml0tntufl.relation: Each prophet declares himself first in submission or faith.

cmp:17uyq440uxjw82.why: He made you successors on the earth: with and without the preposition, and with two continuations (ranks to test you; whoever disbelieves bears it). Memorizer pair.

cmp:0ohjryj1x0pwkn.why: Your Lord is swift in punishment and forgiving: with the emphatic letter only in 7:167. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1t7rx050lczz7v.why: Successors on the earth: the construct form in 6:165 and with the preposition in 10:14 and 35:39, each followed by a test or a warning. Memorizer set.

cmp:1k94v8e1xp93m2.why: The book groups two classic pairs: the successors ayat (6:165, 35:39) and 'if God took people to account' (16:61, 35:45), which differ in for their wrongdoing or for what they earned, and on it or on its back. Both pairs are strong memorizer traps.

cmp:1defh4p0ujbhrv.why: The angels' prostration: 'so they prostrated except Iblis' in 7:11 against 'the angels prostrated, all of them together' in 15:30 and 38:73. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:06hrd900zj8rsw.why: God's question to Iblis in three forms: what prevented you from prostrating, what is with you that you are not among those who prostrate, what prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My hands. Same story, classic memorizer set.

cmp:1ei0y6d0822umx.why: The dialogue with Iblis in al-A'raf and al-Hijr, with God's order to leave: descend from it or get out of it. Same story, and the run-on rows give the sequence the book compares.

cmp:0jx4in21wcqatm.why: The whole exchange with Iblis in three surahs: the question, his answer, the expulsion and the curse ('the curse' or 'My curse'). Same story laid out step by step; very useful for memorizers.

cmp:1sxdigr1tdoc6j.why: Iblis asks for respite and is granted it: without 'my Lord' and 'so' in al-A'raf, with them in al-Hijr and Sad, and the answer with or without 'so'. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:00hmyay01evsbk.why: Give me respite until the Day they are raised: bare in 7:14, with 'my Lord, so' in 15:36 and 38:79. Classic memorizer set.

cmp:1o9php50jvxy9z.why: You are among those given respite: without 'so' in 7:15, with it in 15:37 and 38:80, matching Iblis's request. Memorizer set.

cmp:1n2rbh01ndxcj4.why: Iblis's oath because God let him stray: to sit on the straight path and come from every side (al-A'raf), or to make things fair-seeming and mislead all except the sincere (al-Hijr). Same story; the run-ons complete each threat.
cmp:1n2rbh01ndxcj4.relation: Two descriptions of Satan's method: ambush from every side, and adorning the earth.

cmp:15wgoc41p15b6m.why: Iblis's oath in three forms: because You let me stray (with 'so' or 'my Lord') and by Your might. Same story; classic memorizer set.

cmp:0emusgg0g8diu6.why: A single ayah (7:18). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:15zwbtd0b2ye2b.why: For every nation a term; when it comes they cannot delay or advance it: with and without the conjunctions. Memorizer pair on the same truth.

cmp:1fq9i6v1fk5k6j.why: Only the stock threat 'taste the punishment for what you used to' is shared, with two different endings and unrelated subjects (leaders and followers quarrelling in Hell; Quraysh's prayer at the House). Little to learn beyond the last word.

I would keep. Two books name this pair, and it is a textbook memorizer trap: the same threat ending in two different verbs. The last word is exactly what a reciter confuses, so the difference is the lesson, not a reason to drop.

تكفرون

cmp:0bmiih001b0czg.why: We removed whatever rancour was in their breasts: in Paradise with rivers and praise (7:43) and as brothers on facing couches (15:47). Memorizer pair and the same scene.

cmp:1odgxi40ve6d4e.why: God's curse on the wrongdoers, followed in both places by the same description of them (who turn from God's path and seek it crooked), with an extra pronoun in 11:19. The run-on carries the real match for memorizers.

cmp:0l2aqwr0xcjmtz.why: The same four wind ayat, with 25:48 running on to reviving a dead land. Same theme and memorizer value as the other card on these ayat.

cmp:090gg7s0bm9zes.why: Noah and Hud open with the same call, ending 'I fear for you the punishment of a great day' and 'will you not fear God'. Memorizer pair; same theme of prophets calling their people.
cmp:090gg7s0bm9zes.relation: Each prophet brings the same call to worship God alone.

cmp:11y5bcj0i634ir.why: We sent Noah to his people: with or without 'and', with 'so he said' or directly 'I am a clear warner'. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:0fn94ie1ge2xt0.why: Noah's sending in three surahs; the Hud row reads on to 'that you worship none but God; I fear for you the punishment of a painful day'. Same story; the run-on matches it to 7:59.

cmp:02cfn5r1tbbyk9.why: Noah's call to worship God alone in three forms, with 'a great day' and 'a painful day'. Memorizer set on the same story.

cmp:1p22yjh07qnlof.why: Opening of Noah's and Hud's stories: with or without 'and', with 'so he said' or 'he said'. Same theme; memorizer set.

cmp:0fcagna1f8z9g8.why: The chiefs of Noah's and Hud's people answer: with or without 'who disbelieved', 'said' or 'so said'. Same theme; core memorizer set.
cmp:0fcagna1f8z9g8.relation: Each people's leaders reject their prophet with the same scorn.

cmp:0pya3470044cxh.why: The chiefs of each people in al-A'raf: plain, who disbelieved, who were arrogant. The description changes with the prophet; a memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:0pya3470044cxh.relation: The leaders' label shifts from disbelief to arrogance as the stories go on.

cmp:0dwq46s0jeguna.why: The chiefs of Noah's people in three surahs, with 'said' or 'so said' and 'who disbelieved' added in two. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:0885m9k12f3t2s.why: Noah's sending and his people's chiefs, across al-A'raf, Hud and al-Mu'minun. Same story; memorizer set overlapping the other cards on these ayat.

check.why: Book card; Noah and the chiefs of his people across three surahs, same story. Keep.

cmp:1qoo2fq0ocay0i.why: Noah and Hud: I convey my Lord's messages, then 'and I advise you' or 'and I am a trustworthy adviser to you'. A classic memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:0qr0zwf1g74lhz.why: Conveying my Lord's messages: Noah and Hud at the start, Salih and Shu'ayb at the end turning away (message singular, then plural). Memorizer set and a frame of the stories.

cmp:0jom9p2051fd3w.why: Noah's people denied him and We saved him and those with him in the ark: two verb forms, 'who' or 'those', 'made them successors' added, and different endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:02jv4v60abwj8c.why: The rescue of Noah in four surahs, with two verb forms and different objects (those with him, his family). Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:0cu4v7z0l7ems3.why: Names you and your fathers have named, for which God sent down no authority: in Hud's, Joseph's and al-Najm's settings, with two verb forms. Memorizer set and a shared argument against idols.

cmp:162htwg17h5w2a.why: Do not touch the she-camel with harm or a punishment will seize you: painful, near, of a great day. Same story; classic memorizer set.

cmp:0v4slh51n58hel.why: This is God's she-camel: in three surahs, and in al-Shu'ara with her day of drinking, running on to the warning. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:0fuuqpb1q1nthh.why: Thamud carving houses from the mountains, in three surahs: with and without 'from', ending secure or skilful. Same people; memorizer set.
cmp:0fuuqpb1q1nthh.relation: Thamud's craft, remembered as a favour, as false security, and as arrogance.

cmp:05f09vv1b0hltt.why: And they lay fallen in their home (after the earthquake) or homes (after the shout). A famous memorizer distinction the book explains by the kind of punishment.
cmp:05f09vv1b0hltt.relation: The earthquake strikes one dwelling at a time; the shout reaches all homes at once.

cmp:00ngmkt1gqcu6t.why: The same singular and plural of home after the earthquake and the shout, in four of the places. A valid memorizer set contained in the larger card.

cmp:0s83otd07mncwf.why: Home in the singular and plural, including Salih's warning 'enjoy yourselves in your home three days' (11:65). The book uses it to explain the singular in Hud; useful for memorizers.

cmp:1v7tu5h1a762fp.why: Lot's rebuke in al-A'raf and al-Naml: the first ayah and its sequel, with 'none preceded you' or 'while you see', 'indeed you' or 'do you', excessive or ignorant. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:1a434au055k0am.why: Lot's story step by step in al-A'raf and al-Naml (rebuke, answer, rescue except his wife) and the people's answer in al-Ankabut. Same story; good for memorizers to compare whole passages.

cmp:0t1yxnv0jacxkx.why: Lot's story laid out in four surahs, from rebuke to the rain of stones. Same story; a large but useful memorizer comparison of the whole passage.

cmp:1rodf4l07yu3i7.why: The only answer of his people was: expel them, expel Lot's family, or bring us God's punishment. With 'and' or 'so'. Same story; classic memorizer set.

cmp:1qaby3e1mk32l8.why: Shu'ayb's call in three surahs: 'he said' or 'so he said', and what follows (a clear sign; do not reduce the measure; hope for the Last Day). Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:181kkxx149v9rv.why: Three accounts of Shu'ayb's people's punishment: the earthquake, the shout, the day of the canopy. Same story; worth pondering how one event is named three ways.
cmp:181kkxx149v9rv.relation: One destruction described as earthquake, shout and shadow cloud.

cmp:10lzszu0dczqp4.why: Their messengers came with clear proofs but they would not believe what they had denied before; thus God seals hearts. With 'it' added and the subject of sealing and the ending changing. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1smhgba19xadqa.why: Messengers came with clear proofs and they would not believe: three places, one (10:13) without 'what they denied' and ending with the criminals' recompense. Memorizer set.

cmp:0q3u5v004004by.why: Moses sent to Pharaoh and his chiefs: with or without Aaron, the signs before or after, and the chiefs' reaction (wronged, were arrogant, followed Pharaoh). Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:122jl3h05tocd5.why: The council about the magicians in al-A'raf and al-Shu'ara, ayah by ayah: who says 'a learned sorcerer', 'send' or 'raise', 'sorcerer' or 'great sorcerer', and how the magicians come. Same story; a strong memorizer comparison.

cmp:00ylbiy0jaix0s.why: He wants to drive you out of your land: with 'by his magic' or 'by their magic', and different continuations. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:1jequ341w2wjty.why: You believed in him (7:123) or believed him (20:71, 26:49) before I permitted you, with different continuations. Same story; classic memorizer set.

cmp:1agb2ts0zeask2.why: The home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear God: plain in 7:169, with the construct form and past verb in 12:109. Memorizer pair, contained in the three-ayah card.

cmp:0dbuo1p0lnnfev.why: Owning no benefit or harm, in either order, for the Prophet and for the idols. Memorizer set on the order of the two words.

cmp:1le64h80lv92do.why: That is because they opposed God and His messenger: the doubled letters and the messenger mentioned again only in 8:13. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1fb56fl1e24tgp.why: Like the way of Pharaoh's people, twice in two ayat: disbelieved and seized, then denied and destroyed by drowning. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:1fb56fl1e24tgp.relation: The first states their disbelief and seizure; the second their denial and the manner of destruction.

cmp:1qk1utx0glxl8n.relation: The ranks of the early believers set out step by step.

cmp:1guhthg13dr59m.why: Know that you cannot escape God, in two neighbouring ayat, ending 'God disgraces the disbelievers' and 'give tidings of punishment'. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1emgbn40qfnbhs.why: They respect no tie or covenant: towards you (9:8) and towards a believer (9:10), with different continuations. Memorizer pair two ayat apart.

cmp:18sd4nj0hhcr2l.why: God turns to whom He wills, ending knowing and wise (9:15) or forgiving and merciful (9:27), with 'then ... after that' in the second. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0rr5gok1vmwhv2.why: Same opening, with harm and benefit in reversed order between 10:18 and 25:55. Tight memorizer pair.

cmp:0rdpqiw1bnlrfy.why: Who provides for you from the sky (singular or plural) and the earth, followed by two different answers. Memorizer pair on the same argument.

cmp:1lkum5j1h2xfvr.relation: The challenge narrows from ten surahs to one.

cmp:0nu6o181rjys1a.why: Can you make the deaf hear even though they do not reason, or guide the blind even though they do not see. Two neighbouring ayat; memorizer pair and a clear parallel.

cmp:1czznjj0z6md6p.why: A single ayah (10:45). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:075cddf1wbogz9.why: Not an atom's weight escapes Him: on earth or in the heaven (10:61) against in the heavens or on earth (34:3, 34:22). A famous memorizer point the books explain.

cmp:0k8dpa21rlp9n8.why: Earth before heaven or heaven before earth, singular or plural, across five places on God's knowledge and the idols' powerlessness. Memorizer set on word order.

cmp:12tn7771o7el81.why: Let not their words grieve you: 'and' or 'so', then two reasons (all might is God's; We know what they hide and show). Memorizer pair and the same consolation.
cmp:12tn7771o7el81.relation: The Prophet consoled first by God's might, then by God's knowledge.

cmp:1rwjgsf1cmjl0r.why: Night for rest and day for seeking, ending 'signs for people who hear' in both. Memorizer pair on the same sign.
cmp:1rwjgsf1cmjl0r.relation: Sleep and waking as a sign meant for those who listen.

cmp:01ioz1z1voy2l7.why: I was commanded to be among the Muslims (10:72, 27:91) or the believers (10:104). Memorizer set; the book explains the change.

cmp:0r34yiv1r4rin3.why: We provided the Children of Israel with good things, and they did not differ until knowledge came; your Lord will judge between them. The run-on gives the matching part of al-Jathiya. Memorizer pair on one theme.

cmp:02azhc80c836lw.why: Among the believers (10:104) or among the Muslims (27:91), both after a statement of whom the Prophet worships. Memorizer pair.

cmp:058j0ki1csa792.why: Whoever is guided is guided for himself: whoever strays, strays against himself (10:108) or say I am only a warner (27:92). Memorizer pair.

cmp:14igpf616q04ei.why: Guided for himself and astray against himself, then I am not your guardian (10:108) or you are not their guardian (39:41), with 'is guided' dropped in 39:41. Memorizer pair.

cmp:062xhyr15caa19.why: If We let him taste favour after harm, he will say: evils are gone from me (11:10), or this is mine (41:50). Same picture of human ingratitude; memorizer pair.
cmp:062xhyr15caa19.relation: Relief makes man either boastful or self-deluded.

cmp:180nb7h1kofm83.why: If they do not respond: to you (plural) then know (11:14), or to you (singular) then know (28:50), with a merged or separate particle and different conclusions. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1817loq15ciqkw.why: Do not be in doubt: with the verb shortened (11:17, 11:109) or full (32:23), and doubt about different things. Memorizer set the book explains.

cmp:0yta7m113fsd21.why: The book collects places where the verb 'to be' is shortened or kept full (do not be in doubt; I have not been; you were nothing). Memorizer value for the shortened forms, though the subjects vary widely.

check.why: Book card; the shortened form of the verb to be across several places. Keep.

cmp:10drfn61p9a840.why: No doubt in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers (11:22) or the losers (16:109). A classic memorizer pair.

check.why: Book card; the greatest losers against the losers. Keep.

cmp:1p2kr0a1fzsk8c.why: Noah, Salih and Shu'ayb each say: have you considered if I am on clear proof from my Lord, then mercy from Him (two orders) or good provision. Same theme; core memorizer set.
cmp:1p2kr0a1fzsk8c.relation: Three prophets answer their people in the same words, each adding what fits him.

cmp:1otxi8q0x9yl5s.why: Noah and Salih: and He gave me mercy from Himself, with 'from Him' before or after mercy. Tight memorizer pair.

cmp:1ts5tze0pe0d2q.why: My reward is only from God, from the One who created me, from the Lord of the worlds; asking no wealth or no reward. Same theme of prophets; memorizer set.

cmp:1crwsrv080r0x3.why: Noah told to load a pair of every kind and his family except those already sentenced: 'carry' or 'put', with 'of them' and different endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:16zeqfh1pij5z7.why: When Our command came: with 'and' or 'so', followed by rescue of Hud, Salih and Shu'ayb or the overturning of Lot's town. Same theme in one surah; core memorizer set.

cmp:10ounnu11sihh2.why: They were pursued by a curse in this world and on the Day: 'this world' named for 'Ad, omitted for Pharaoh's people. Memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:1w6zcdb1m6wpkl.why: We are in suspicious doubt about what you call us to: Thamud to Salih (one nun dropped) and past nations to their messengers. Memorizer pair and the same refusal.
cmp:1w6zcdb1m6wpkl.relation: Every people's doubt, phrased the same way.

cmp:0hjlr3r19j342r.why: The shout seized the wrongdoers: masculine verb for Thamud, feminine for Midian. A famous memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:0zpigc81r7eofi.why: A single ayah (11:68). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1bkuacu1vzef30.why: Abraham's guests greet him: in Hud he answers with peace and brings a calf before fearing them; in al-Hijr he says at once 'we are afraid of you'. Same story; memorizer value in the order of events.
cmp:1bkuacu1vzef30.relation: The same visit, told with the fear before or after the meal.

cmp:1eo7xgb0x4nocl.why: When Our messengers came to Lot he was distressed for them: 'when' or 'when that', and two continuations (a hard day; do not fear). Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:0yb9wnt1qkbtfz.why: Travel with your family in part of the night: let none of you look back except your wife, or follow behind them. Same story; memorizer pair.

cmp:0wy88ld1i6l2s9.why: We turned it upside down and rained on it (11:82) or on them (15:74) stones of baked clay, layered only in Hud. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:01kvv751y0tupn.why: We sent Moses with Our signs and clear authority: with Aaron in 23:45, to Pharaoh and his chiefs in 43:46. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:1fl8yvu0axht7o.why: Your Lord would not destroy the towns: unjustly while their people set things right, or until He sends a messenger to their mother town. Memorizer pair and a principle worth pondering.
cmp:1fl8yvu0axht7o.relation: No town is destroyed without a messenger and without its own wrongdoing.

cmp:01d4jt80dtvuzu.why: We sent it down (12:2) or made it (43:3) an Arabic Quran so you may reason. A tight memorizer pair.

cmp:1ldwz870v4hkvl.why: A single ayah (12:6). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0ah47ge0p7x5gs.why: Jacob says the same words over the loss of Joseph and later of Benjamin, then ends differently: God is the one whose help is sought, and perhaps God will bring them all back. Memorizer pair and a moving development.
cmp:0ah47ge0p7x5gs.relation: The same patience, first enduring, then hopeful.

cmp:0ftw9pp1d4prjv.why: When he reached maturity We gave him judgement and knowledge: Joseph, and Moses with 'and grew firm'. Memorizer pair and a parallel between two prophets.
cmp:0ftw9pp1d4prjv.relation: The same gift to Joseph and Moses at maturity, called the reward of the good-doers.

cmp:00g5lsc111l27k.why: When he reached his full strength: Joseph, Moses (and grew firm), and the man who reaches forty and prays. Memorizer set and worth pondering what maturity brings.
cmp:00g5lsc111l27k.relation: Maturity brings prophets wisdom and brings the believer gratitude and repentance.

cmp:0drfpmp10prj0j.why: God forbid: Joseph refusing his master's wife, and Joseph refusing to take anyone but the one with the cup. Memorizer pair in one surah, worth pondering.
cmp:0drfpmp10prj0j.relation: The same refusal protects his own chastity and later his justice.

cmp:1avrokr0kr2ieb.why: The women say 'God forbid' twice: this is no human (12:31), and we know no evil of him (12:51). Memorizer pair and a telling development.
cmp:1avrokr0kr2ieb.relation: The women who first marvelled at Joseph's beauty later testify to his innocence.

cmp:1k47b980kilemc.why: We see you are of the good-doers, said to Joseph by the prisoners and later by his brothers. Memorizer pair and a fine echo.
cmp:1k47b980kilemc.relation: Joseph's goodness is recognised both in prison and on the throne.

cmp:0bj45mf17lznht.why: O my two prison companions, said twice: first calling them to one God, then interpreting their dreams. Memorizer pair in one passage.
cmp:0bj45mf17lznht.relation: Joseph puts the call to faith before the dream interpretation.

cmp:054jy781a1spqk.why: Two ayat of Yusuf each carrying a double 'perhaps' (that I may return to the people, so they may know; so they may recognise it, so they may return). The book discusses the repeat; minor memorizer value.

check.why: Book card; the double perhaps in two ayat of Yusuf. Keep.

cmp:1o8a18x1o9ok4t.why: Joseph's brothers swear 'by God' four times in Yusuf, each with a different continuation. Memorizer set and a telling arc.
cmp:1o8a18x1o9ok4t.relation: Their oaths move from protesting innocence to confessing they were wrong.

cmp:1sij1ot0cimj59.why: Have they not travelled and seen the end of those before them: with 'so' or 'and', and different continuations. Memorizer set within the larger travel set.

cmp:1u3xb3006eaffq.why: Have they not travelled in the land: seven places with 'so' or 'and', and different continuations. Core memorizer set; one lesson from history.
cmp:1u3xb3006eaffq.relation: Travel as a means of seeing the end of earlier nations, and of opening the heart.

cmp:10npr4r164e4tf.why: We sent before you only men: with or without 'from', and different continuations. Memorizer set the books explain.

cmp:0sm3les1ubnyy6.why: We sent only men to whom We revealed: 'from before you' (12:109) against 'before you' (21:7). Memorizer pair.

cmp:0hjaq7z0yj2aj1.why: We sent before you only men or messengers, with 'from' present or absent. Memorizer set overlapping the other cards on these ayat.

cmp:0znqbet1280179.why: These are the verses of the Book and a clear Quran, or of the Quran and a clear Book, after different letters. Memorizer set on surah openings.

cmp:01kgq2x1umx0dh.why: He subjected sun and moon, each running for an appointed term: 'for' in three places and 'to' in 31:29. A famous memorizer point the book explains.

cmp:13acfwj0ms8ydz.why: Each running for a term: 'for' in 13:2 and 35:13, 'to' in 31:29. Memorizer set contained in the four-ayah card on the same words.

cmp:1nxz8w70m4j8q3.why: Two neighbouring ayat on the earth's signs, ending for people who reflect and for people who reason. Memorizer pair; the endings fit each sign.
cmp:1nxz8w70m4j8q3.relation: The broad layout of the earth calls for reflection; differing fruits from one water call for reason.

cmp:0xv55pp1uyp9ul.why: The disbelievers ask why no sign was sent down, twice in al-Ra'd, answered differently (you are only a warner; God leads astray whom He wills). Memorizer pair.
cmp:0xv55pp1uyp9ul.relation: The same demand answered once by the Prophet's role, once by God's will in guidance.

check.why: Book card; the same demand twice in al-Ra'd with different answers. Keep.

cmp:1pav83h1goq45j.why: To God prostrates whoever (13:15, 22:18) or whatever (16:49) is in the heavens and the earth, with different lists. Memorizer set and a theme worth pondering.
cmp:1pav83h1goq45j.relation: All creation bows to God, willingly or unwillingly, even shadows.

cmp:0vx02201hmza3q.why: To God prostrates whoever or whatever is in the heavens and the earth: 'who' with willing and unwilling, 'what' with creatures and angels. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1vgengz18nn82n.why: Idols own no benefit or harm for themselves (13:16) or no harm or benefit (25:3). The order is a classic memorizer trap.

cmp:0sw2jhz10s1cqp.why: A single ayah (13:17). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1utpyp80kgefrc.why: Those who join what God commanded to be joined (13:21) and those who cut it (13:25). A direct contrast in the same words; memorizer pair worth pondering.
cmp:1utpyp80kgefrc.relation: Contrast: the people of reason keep ties God ordered; the cursed cut them.

cmp:057jb5o0o2v16s.why: God extends provision to whom He wills and restricts it: with or without 'of His servants' and 'for him', and different endings. Core memorizer set.

cmp:07ht2ut1g9qmkn.why: Four of the five places of God extending and restricting provision. Contained in the larger card but a valid memorizer set.

cmp:0nlcy7w1ccvycu.why: I gave respite to the disbelievers then seized them: how was My punishment, or how was My reproach. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1d6mquv1e7m2e7.why: Thus We sent it down as an Arabic judgement (13:37) or an Arabic Quran (20:113). Memorizer pair.

cmp:16vds290ztysi7.why: We sent messengers before you, then 'no messenger may bring a sign except by God's leave', with different middles and endings. Memorizer pair.

cmp:06xpobg15uooi4.why: We sent messengers before you (13:38) or before you messengers (30:47). The word order is the memorizer trap.

cmp:1pw0wax0pkp8en.why: God suffices as witness between me and you: 'witness' before or after 'between me and you', and different endings. Classic memorizer set.

cmp:1iu1w8n1vi75q1.why: To the path of the Mighty, the Praised (14:1, 34:6) or of the Praised alone (22:24). Memorizer set.

cmp:01qhoop1uh4nc1.why: Let the believers rely on God, then let those who rely rely on God: two neighbouring ayat with the same words of the messengers. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.

cmp:09x3dnn0w8sxuz.why: He created the heavens and earth and sent down water from the sky: with 'for you' added and different results. Memorizer pair.

cmp:14ov5po05mdijq.why: If you count God's favours you cannot number them: man is unjust and ungrateful (14:34), God is forgiving and merciful (16:18). Memorizer pair and a striking contrast.
cmp:14ov5po05mdijq.relation: The same countless favours, met by man's ingratitude and by God's forgiveness.

cmp:015xb7y0fv4id2.why: So that people of understanding take heed, in two forms of the verb (14:52, 38:29). Memorizer pair.

cmp:0wgjvu814jpy0e.why: Verses of the Book and a clear Quran (15:1) against verses of the Quran and a clear Book (27:1). A neat inversion for memorizers.

cmp:1c5wy1x1do7epz.why: A single ayah (15:7). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0cov1m71xd0z8v.why: We sent before you among the sects of old, or how many prophets We sent among the ancients; then 'no messenger or prophet came to them but they mocked him'. The run-ons hold the matching sentence.

cmp:0yuvrck0g67j8e.why: Thus We insert it in the hearts of the criminals: present tense in 15:12, past in 26:200. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1c5tb240w4lp0e.why: O Iblis, what is with you (15:32) or what prevented you (38:75). Same story; memorizer pair.

cmp:0z0ay4s1ys7sh2.why: Abraham given glad tidings of a boy: knowing (15:53, 51:28) or forbearing (37:101). The books link the knowing boy to Isaac and the forbearing one to Ishmael; good for memorizers and pondering.
cmp:0z0ay4s1ys7sh2.relation: Two sons promised with two different qualities.

cmp:1s21vvz0j7qywb.why: In that are signs for those who discern (15:75) and a sign for the believers (15:77, 29:44): plural or singular with different audiences. Memorizer set.

cmp:0hn3rfl12jlgod.why: Two ayat apart in al-Hijr: signs for the discerning, then a sign for the believers. Memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:0e8a5230lzvejv.why: Lower your wing to the believers (15:88) or to those of the believers who follow you (26:215). Memorizer pair and the same gentle command.
