cmp:1pxqlqi16mxyds.why: God is full of bounty to people, but most do not give thanks. 10:60 says most of them where the others say most people. A fine memorizer difference with a lesson on ingratitude.
cmp:1pxqlqi16mxyds.relation: God's bounty is great and people's thanks are few, said after revival, respite and night and day.

cmp:0af82a21txjaey.why: Most people do not give thanks, after God's bounty to people. 12:38 has Yusuf saying it of the bounty of faith given to his family and to people. A good companion to cmp:1pxqlqi16mxyds.
cmp:0af82a21txjaey.relation: The bounty of faith and of creation alike meet ingratitude from most people.

cmp:1coqi2s04mkz9g.why: Two consecutive ayat in the story of Talut, opening with the same words of their prophet. First he announces Talut as king, then the sign of his kingship. A memorizer must keep the order.
cmp:1coqi2s04mkz9g.relation: One story: the prophet's appointment of Talut and the sign that confirms it.

cmp:0854rpl1q5ony3.why: A rare closing: in that is a sign for you if you are believers. It comes after the sign of Talut's kingship and after the miracles of Isa. Both are signs offered to the Children of Israel to confirm whom God sent.
cmp:0854rpl1q5ony3.relation: Signs given to the Children of Israel to confirm a king and a messenger, both closing the same way.

cmp:048czwn0pgmmar.why: Were it not that God repels some people by others: a rare clause, after Dawud kills Jalut and in the first permission to fight. In both it explains why fighting injustice is needed, to prevent corruption and to protect places of worship.
cmp:048czwn0pgmmar.relation: Why God allows fighting: without it the earth would be corrupted and houses of worship destroyed.

cmp:036zi1l1jvjz7n.why: These are God's signs which We recite to you in truth: the same sentence in three surahs, each followed by something different. A classic memorizer set.
cmp:036zi1l1jvjz7n.relation: The recited signs bring three conclusions: the Prophet's mission, God's justice, and no excuse left for disbelief.

cmp:111wodm1no93fo.why: Before a day comes: two pairs, one where there is no trade or friendship, one that cannot be turned back. All four urge action now, before the Day. The two endings are a memorizer point.
cmp:111wodm1no93fo.relation: Spend, pray and answer your Lord now, before a Day when nothing can be bought or turned back.

cmp:12omqpj1col7hj.why: Two commands to spend, close together in al-Baqara, with the same call and verb. Then they diverge: spend from what We provided before the Day, and spend from the good things you earned. A memorizer pair on one theme.
cmp:12omqpj1col7hj.relation: Spending in al-Baqara: when to give, before the Day, and what to give, the good not the bad.

cmp:1xp64yr09ttvgt.why: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth: a frequent declaration, here in nine places, each followed by a different name or warning. Useful to a memorizer, but the phrase is common and the subjects vary.
cmp:1xp64yr09ttvgt.relation: God's ownership of all things, joined each time to another of His attributes.

check.why: The declaration of God's ownership with a different follow-on each time. Useful for a memorizer. Keep.

cmp:0be4jcz05eoe5f.why: God, there is no god but Him: the declaration followed in each place by a different attribute or consequence. A classic memorizer set, and each row adds a facet of God's oneness.
cmp:0be4jcz05eoe5f.relation: The declaration of oneness joined to life, gathering, the beautiful names, the throne and reliance on God.

cmp:0bfvn0u03r496e.why: He knows what is before them and what is behind them: the same clause in four places, each continuing differently. It also covers knowledge and intercession, the themes of the Throne verse. Good for both purposes.
cmp:0bfvn0u03r496e.relation: God's complete knowledge, tied to intercession only by His leave and to all affairs returning to Him.

cmp:0yzdf32090tkoc.why: All three rows are inside cmp:0bfvn0u03r496e, which shows the same clause in four places. Adds nothing alone.

check.why: All three rows are inside the kept four-place card on the same clause. Truly adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:15w6zf2165dtf0.why: Both rows are inside cmp:0bfvn0u03r496e, which shows the same clause and what follows it in four places. Adds nothing alone.

check.why: Both rows are inside the kept four-place card, which shows this same continuation. Truly adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:13ikiby084exce.why: The two places that join the declaration of oneness to the Living and the Sustaining are both inside cmp:0be4jcz05eoe5f, where the match is shown with the other continuations.

check.why: Both rows are inside the kept card on the declaration of oneness, which shows the same match beside its other continuations. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:1emem5y0la3ay4.why: Two consecutive ayat on those who spend their wealth in God's cause: one gives the parable of the grain, the other the condition of no reminders of favour and no harm. The same subject, built step by step.
cmp:1emem5y0la3ay4.relation: Spending in God's cause: its multiplied reward, and the condition that keeps that reward.

cmp:02n5en20u3a1uw.why: Two parables of those who spend their wealth: the grain that grows seven ears, and the garden on high ground. Both are about sincere spending and its growth. Good for pondering, and their openings differ slightly.
cmp:02n5en20u3a1uw.relation: Two images of the same truth: spending for God's sake grows many times over.

cmp:1d21wc01jofgya.why: The same opening describes two opposite spenders: those who spend for God without reminders or harm (2:262, 2:274) and those who spend to be seen and do not believe (4:38). One promised reward with no fear, the other given Satan as a companion.
cmp:1d21wc01jofgya.relation: Contrast: sincere spending and spending for show, opened with the same words, end in opposite fates.

cmp:0tbk8g5027x5rn.why: Both describe the one who spends to be seen by people and does not believe in God and the Last Day. A memorizer must keep the singular form with one negation (2:264) apart from the plural form with a repeated negation (4:38).
cmp:0tbk8g5027x5rn.relation: Same theme: showing off ruins charity; 2:264 gives the parable of the bare rock, 4:38 names Satan as the companion.

cmp:1yfojvt1sz9t4d.why: The same promise of full recompense on the Day, each soul paid what it earned without wrong, closes three ayat. The memorizer must separate the two openings of the clause (2:281 and 3:161 against 3:25).
cmp:1yfojvt1sz9t4d.relation: Same theme: full and just recompense, in the context of the final return (2:281), the gathering (3:25) and the one who defrauds (3:161).

cmp:0bg07hf1kbmkz5.why: Many places of God's ownership of the heavens and the earth with different tails, a real memorizer set. But in the four glorification openings (59:1, 61:1, 62:1, 64:1) the same words have a different structure: what is in the heavens glorifies God, it is not a statement of what belongs to Him.
cmp:0bg07hf1kbmkz5.changes: Split into the ownership statements and the glorification openings, since the shared words are a different phrase structure in the second group. Run-on rows kept as they were.
cmp:0bg07hf1kbmkz5.relation: God owns all that is in the heavens and the earth, and each place draws a different consequence: reckoning, the return of all matters, forgiveness, encompassing knowledge, self-sufficiency, sufficiency as guardian, just recompense.

check.why: In the glorification openings the same words are a different structure: what is in the heavens is the subject that glorifies, not a statement of what belongs to God. This is the same kind of case as the owner's 2:107 example. The split is right, and both halves stand as cards.

cmp:18thk590qsrikf.why: He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills, each time tied to His dominion over the heavens and the earth, with four different endings to keep apart. Even the claim of the Jews and Christians (5:18) is answered with the same rule.
cmp:18thk590qsrikf.relation: Same theme: forgiveness and punishment rest on God's will and ownership, not on lineage or claims.

cmp:1uy93c51vi1uyf.why: Only the stock closing that God is able to do all things after a verb of willing is shared. The subjects differ (reckoning of hidden thoughts, the divinity of the Messiah, punishment and forgiveness, spoils given without fighting), and the rows run on into unrelated ayat.

cmp:052obg20w4nebi.why: Shared only a stock closing about God's will and His power over all things. One ayah is about the reckoning of what is in the soul, the other about spoils taken without battle; nothing to ponder together.

cmp:1d601c203ofhpy.why: The Book sent down with the truth, confirming what came before it, in two places that differ in their opening verb and preposition and in what follows (the Torah and Gospel, or guardianship over earlier scripture). A clear memorizer pair.
cmp:1d601c203ofhpy.relation: Same theme: the Quran confirms the earlier scriptures; 5:48 adds that it stands guard over them.

cmp:0pcyr5f1h6le5r.why: The only two places that close with this declaration of oneness joined to the Mighty and the Wise, both in the opening of Al Imran, so a memorizer can mix them. One follows the shaping in the womb, the other the testimony of God, the angels and the people of knowledge.

cmp:087c0ij1lh0jn5.why: Only a short opening is shared, and what is sent down differs in each place: the Book, rain, tranquillity. A stock opening with three different subjects; not a mutashabih and too thin for pondering.

check.why: A stock opening, with the Book, rain and tranquillity as three different subjects. Drop.

cmp:00w0sqi08drgm0.why: The same sentence that wealth and children will not help the deniers against God, in two places of one surah, ending differently: fuel of the Fire in one, companions of the Fire abiding forever in the other. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1pg3ixm1crbr8g.why: These two ayat are already in the fuller card of the same phrase (3:11, 8:52, 8:54), which shows the third variant too. This pair adds nothing beyond it.

cmp:11vc3bc0dr9s42.why: Two messages ordered to the deniers, both tied to Badr: one warns they will be overcome and gathered to Hell, the other offers forgiveness of the past if they stop. The short shared command frames threat and invitation side by side.
cmp:11vc3bc0dr9s42.relation: Contrast: the warning of defeat and the open door of forgiveness, both addressed to the same deniers.

check.why: The same addressees, one warned and one offered forgiveness; a contrast worth keeping, though thin. Keep.

cmp:0hajxa31spsasn.why: The exact closing that this is a lesson for those with insight occurs only here: after the two armies at Badr and after the alternation of night and day. A memorizer needs it, and it shows that history and nature are both read as signs.
cmp:0hajxa31spsasn.relation: Similarity: an event of history and a daily sight of nature are both called a lesson for those who see.

cmp:1fu4xqk1vg3lio.why: The promise of gardens with rivers flowing beneath, abiding there, recurs with a different tail each time (the great triumph, the reward of the doers of good, an excellent reward for the workers, forever, pleased with them). The tails are exactly what a memorizer confuses, and the books treat this set as a mutashabih.
cmp:1fu4xqk1vg3lio.relation: Same promise given to many kinds of people: the God-fearing, the obedient, the truthful, those who believe and do good, those who love none of God's enemies.

cmp:1qk8bgx06f7gh5.why: A near copy of the fuller card of the same promise (the gardens with rivers flowing beneath, abiding), only missing the three places with the gardens of Eden and the lofty chambers. It adds nothing that the fuller card does not show.

check.why: Every row is inside the kept 19-row gardens card, which also has the places this one lacks. Truly adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:1snhr9x0kvu3th.why: The supplications of the righteous, each introduced the same way: forgive us and protect us from the Fire (3:16), turn away the punishment of Hell (25:65), grant us comfort in our spouses and children (25:74). Useful for the memorizer and a short lesson in what the believers ask for.
cmp:1snhr9x0kvu3th.relation: Same theme: the prayers that mark the God-fearing and the servants of the Merciful.

cmp:0el53tg1j6h0g4.why: Three places say the earlier communities split only after knowledge reached them, out of rivalry among themselves. The verbs and what follows differ, which is the memorizer's task, and the lesson is the same: division came from envy, not from ignorance.
cmp:0el53tg1j6h0g4.relation: Same theme: religious division born of rivalry after clear knowledge.

cmp:0j380y40v3hoe0.why: The people of the Book divided only after the proof came to them, said twice with different words for the dividing and for what came (knowledge, the clear proof). A memorizer pair with one lesson.
cmp:0j380y40v3hoe0.relation: Same theme: the people of the Book differed after the truth was made clear to them.

cmp:0qmlek415okxxy.why: Only the common opening about those who disbelieve is shared. One describes killing the prophets and those who command justice, the other separating God from His messengers and believing in part. Different charges, a stock opening, nothing to set side by side.

cmp:0d967g6147e7n0.why: The same closing that the deniers have no helpers in this world or the next, after their deeds are made void (3:22) and after they are punished severely (3:56). A memorizer pair in one surah with one lesson: nothing saves them in either life.
cmp:0d967g6147e7n0.relation: Same theme: the loss of the deniers in both worlds, once in their deeds and once in their punishment.

cmp:0ylmag41fdj2cw.why: The same address about those given a portion of the Book, three times, each naming another fault: turning away from God's judgment, buying error, believing in idols and false gods. A clear memorizer set and a portrait of one group.
cmp:0ylmag41fdj2cw.relation: Same subject: three faults of those who were given a share of the scripture.

cmp:15uftyl12a4eot.why: Only a short causal opening is shared. One gives the reason for the Jews' false security about the Fire, the other the hypocrites' promise to obey the haters of revelation. Different subjects and nothing to learn together.

cmp:1mz318p1ly29y5.why: God knows what is in the heavens and the earth, four times with different frames and endings (all-powerful, all-knowing, the secret councils). A memorizer set, and each place applies the same knowledge to something hidden: what is in breasts, one's religion, private talk.
cmp:1mz318p1ly29y5.relation: Same theme: nothing is hidden from God, applied to hearts, claims of faith and secret talk.

cmp:1tf8a1c0gu7tya.why: Both ayat are already in the fuller card of the same phrase (3:29, 5:97, 49:16, 58:7), which shows their different endings with the others. The pair adds nothing.

cmp:0gyfaml17084nt.why: Only the stock closing about God's power over all things is shared. One is about God knowing what is in hearts, the other about His dominion over the heavens and the earth; the rows run on into unrelated ayat.

cmp:0c2yh5k09bjrje.why: A question of where something came from gets two opposite answers. Mary says her provision is from God; after Uhud the believers are told their disaster is from themselves. The same question and answer frame makes the contrast stand out.
cmp:0c2yh5k09bjrje.relation: Contrast: blessing is traced to God, the defeat to the believers' own doing.

cmp:0wlehk11kjkg89.why: Two addresses of the angels to Mary three ayat apart, one with the conjunction and one without, the first about her being chosen and purified, the second the good news of Jesus. A memorizer must keep the openings and messages in order.
cmp:0wlehk11kjkg89.relation: Same story: the two announcements of the angels to Mary.

cmp:1v2fsft17dm3rj.why: Story closings that call the story news of the unseen revealed to the Prophet, who was not present (Mary in 3:44, Joseph in 12:102), and news of the towns narrated (11:100). The two unseen closings are near identical and must be told apart.
cmp:1v2fsft17dm3rj.relation: Same theme: the stories are proof of revelation, since the Prophet did not witness them.

cmp:0w14ctw0o1f4js.why: Jesus says he confirms the Torah before him, then in one place permits some of what was forbidden and in the other gives the good news of a messenger named Ahmad. A memorizer pair with a clear thread.
cmp:0w14ctw0o1f4js.relation: Same speaker and claim: Jesus confirms what came before him and points to what comes after.

cmp:15jjtaf111oncb.why: Jesus' call for helpers and the disciples' answer, told as the event in 3:52 and given to the believers as a model in 61:14. The shared exchange is long and exact; what follows differs.
cmp:15jjtaf111oncb.relation: Same story: the disciples answering Jesus, then held up as the example the believers should follow.

cmp:01ybi3u1ul3ivk.why: Three times God addresses Jesus by name: the promise to take him up and purify him, the reminder of favours, and the question on the Day whether he told people to worship him and his mother. The openings differ in the conjunction and in adding his mother's name, which is the memorizer's point.
cmp:01ybi3u1ul3ivk.relation: Same person: God's three addresses to Jesus, from his raising to the questioning on the Day.

cmp:1t8w6tt018lgyd.why: The fate of the deniers in three places where a passage sets the two groups against each other, each with a different continuation: punishment in both worlds, brought into the punishment, rebuked for their arrogance. The opening conjunction also differs, a known memorizer trap.
cmp:1t8w6tt018lgyd.relation: Same theme: the deniers' end, each time the second half of a contrast with the believers.

cmp:0t4l6k21hr9ep8.why: The believers' reward stated six times in the same frame, with different conjunctions and different rewards (full wages, mercy and grace, a garden where they rejoice, gardens of refuge, mercy as the clear triumph). The memorizer needs the tree, and each place is half of a contrast with the deniers.
cmp:0t4l6k21hr9ep8.relation: Same theme: the reward of those who believe and do good, set against the deniers in each passage.

cmp:1huderv0m8ezrr.why: Short emphatic verdicts that open alike: this is the true story, this is the great triumph, this is the clear trial, this is certain truth. A memorizer can mix the short ones, but the subjects differ and the link rests only on the opening.

check.why: Short emphatic verdicts that a reciter can mix up. Keep with the shortOpening flag.

cmp:09ygkyj1at9hxd.why: The command to address the people of the Book, six times, each with a different question or call: a common word, why do you deny, why do you bar the way, do you resent us, you stand on nothing, do not exceed bounds. One addressee and a set the memorizer must order.
cmp:09ygkyj1at9hxd.relation: Same addressee: the Prophet's calls and rebukes to the people of the Book.

cmp:1qigl1z02qygfj.why: Three rebukes in one passage, each asking the people of the Book why: why argue about Abraham, why deny God's signs while you witness, why mix truth with falsehood. Close together and alike, a clear memorizer set.
cmp:1qigl1z02qygfj.relation: Same addressee: three charges against the people of the Book in one passage.

cmp:0ahewlq1i9f7dg.why: A party wished to lead the believers (3:69) or the Prophet (4:113) astray, and the answer is the same: they mislead only themselves. The tails differ (they do not perceive, they cannot harm you).
cmp:0ahewlq1i9f7dg.relation: Same theme: the plot to mislead turns back on those who plot.

cmp:131g71j15e3wsp.why: The same question why you deny God's signs, once with a direct address and the ending that they witness it, once with the command to say it and the ending that God witnesses what they do. A sharp memorizer pair.
cmp:131g71j15e3wsp.relation: Similarity: they witness the truth, and God witnesses their deeds.

cmp:0o07j9m1xew0u2.why: Bounty is in God's hand, He gives it to whom He wills, said in two answers to the people of the Book, with two endings (All-Encompassing and Knowing, or Possessor of great bounty). A classic memorizer pair on one theme.
cmp:0o07j9m1xew0u2.relation: Same theme: the people of the Book cannot restrict God's favour to themselves.

cmp:0aty2ze00a37f2.why: Two groups of the people of the Book in one passage, those who betray trusts and those who twist the scripture, closed by the same charge that they speak lies about God knowingly. The memorizer must link each lead-in to the closing.
cmp:0aty2ze00a37f2.relation: Same theme: two kinds of deliberate lying about God by people who know.

cmp:0nmoknw1ps1ehm.why: The only two places that say what is not fitting for a human: a prophet given the Book cannot call people to worship him, and no human is spoken to by God except by revelation, from behind a veil or through a messenger. One has the conjunction, one does not. A thin but real link around the limits of a human messenger.
cmp:0nmoknw1ps1ehm.relation: Similarity: both set the limits of a human who receives revelation.

check.why: The only two places on what is not fitting for a human receiving revelation. Keep.

cmp:080n0wj09xpue3.why: God took a covenant twice in one surah: from the prophets, who affirmed it, and from those given the Book, who threw it behind their backs. Same words, opposite responses.
cmp:080n0wj09xpue3.relation: Contrast: the prophets kept the covenant, the people of the Book sold it for a small price.

cmp:0lazdrn02iyanb.why: The religion of Abraham, upright and not of the polytheists, in three commands to follow it, each with a different lead-in (God has spoken the truth, my Lord guided me, We revealed to you). A memorizer set with one theme.
cmp:0lazdrn02iyanb.relation: Same theme: Islam presented as the religion of Abraham.

cmp:1asq4hm0dfnfk2.why: Calls to the believers that set a condition on their own action: obey the people of the Book or the deniers and you will be turned back (3:100, 3:149); fear God or help Him and He will give criterion and victory (8:29, 47:7). But 49:6 is a different structure: the condition is a sinner bringing news, not an act of the believers.
cmp:1asq4hm0dfnfk2.changes: Removed 49:6, where the condition is a sinner's report, not the believers' act.
cmp:1asq4hm0dfnfk2.relation: Contrast: obeying others turns the believers back, obeying God brings help and forgiveness.

check.why: I would keep all five rows. In 49:6 the conditional particle and the clause are the same structure; only the subject of the condition differs. The rules allow removing an ayah only when the shared words are a different word or structure. The other rows also differ in subject, so 49:6 is no more out of place than they are, and a reciter can slip into it from the same opening.

cmp:1wic4ou1b2z75i.why: Four warnings not to be like others: those who split after clear proofs, those who say we hear and do not hear, those who went out in pride and for show, those who forgot God. Each names a type to avoid, a useful set to ponder and to memorize.
cmp:1wic4ou1b2z75i.relation: Same theme: four negative models the believers are told not to resemble.

cmp:1541cq808tkw7c.why: Six prohibitions on taking certain people as intimate friends or allies, each naming a different group (outsiders, the deniers, Jews and Christians, mockers of the religion, fathers and brothers who prefer disbelief, God's enemies). One theme with branches a memorizer must keep apart.
cmp:1541cq808tkw7c.relation: Same theme: whom the believers must not take as allies, and why.

cmp:04otx9a12yfe7m.why: God gave victory at Badr when the believers were few and weak, and at Hunayn their large numbers did not help them. The same opening sets the two battles side by side.
cmp:04otx9a12yfe7m.relation: Contrast: victory in weakness at Badr, near defeat in self-admiration at Hunayn.

cmp:00e000z1rbrnpv.why: Two prohibitions on consuming wealth wrongly, addressed to the believers in the same words: usury multiplied and taking each other's property by falsehood. Same theme with clear branches for the memorizer.
cmp:00e000z1rbrnpv.relation: Same theme: unlawful gain, through usury or through cheating among yourselves.

cmp:1ogwstj117ekxh.why: The command to travel in the land and see the end of earlier peoples, four times, with different lead-ins and different names for them (the deniers, the criminals, those before who were mostly polytheists). A known memorizer set with one lesson.
cmp:1ogwstj117ekxh.relation: Same theme: history as a warning, read by travelling and looking.

cmp:1pyusbk0pekqpg.why: Did you think you would enter Paradise, or be left alone, before God makes known those of you who strive? Two near-identical questions with different tails (the patient, those who took no intimate ally besides God). A sharp memorizer pair on one theme.
cmp:1pyusbk0pekqpg.relation: Same theme: faith is tested before reward.

cmp:0133lth0r89av7.why: Muhammad is only a messenger, messengers passed before him; the Messiah son of Mary is only a messenger, messengers passed before him. The same sentence answers two errors: abandoning the faith if the Prophet dies, and deifying Jesus.
cmp:0133lth0r89av7.relation: Similarity: both prophets are human messengers like those before them, one against despair, one against deification.

cmp:0vk3wvv0kk3tb3.why: No soul can die except by God's permission, and no soul can believe except by His permission. The same frame applies God's leave to both death and faith.
cmp:0vk3wvv0kk3tb3.relation: Similarity: life's end and faith's beginning both depend on God's permission.

cmp:1bxfplw0e0uzpg.why: Associating with God what He sent no authority for: the cause of the terror cast in the deniers' hearts (3:151) and one of the things God forbade (7:33). A substantive shared clause that a memorizer must link to two different frames.
cmp:1bxfplw0e0uzpg.relation: Same theme: shirk has no proof, and it is both a sin forbidden and a cause of punishment.

cmp:1mwzeqh0lly3ib.why: Two calls to the believers not to be like others: like the deniers who say the dead would have lived had they stayed home, and like those who hurt Moses. Same frame, two models to avoid.
cmp:1mwzeqh0lly3ib.relation: Same theme: the believers warned off the speech of the deniers and the slander of Moses' people.

cmp:0jt50lu1atjo6q.why: What is not fitting for a prophet, twice: to defraud, and to take captives before the enemy is subdued. One opens with the conjunction and one without; both set a standard for a prophet's conduct.
cmp:0jt50lu1atjo6q.relation: Same theme: the limits of a prophet's conduct in war.

cmp:1lqy5fk0hr8glk.why: Three warnings against a wrong reckoning: do not think the martyrs dead, do not think the boasters safe from punishment, do not think the deniers can escape on earth. The same opening sets right three false assumptions.
cmp:1lqy5fk0hr8glk.relation: Contrast: the slain are alive, and those who seem safe are not.

cmp:13od4x21q353tc.why: Do not grieve over those who hasten into disbelief, said to the Prophet twice, each followed by their end (no share in the Hereafter, disgrace here and great punishment there). A memorizer pair with one consolation.
cmp:13od4x21q353tc.relation: Same theme: consolation to the Prophet over those racing into disbelief.

cmp:00rqf070kt48gd.why: Let not the deniers or the misers think: that respite is good for them, that withholding is good for them, that they have outrun God. Same opening, three false assumptions corrected; good for memorizing and pondering.
cmp:00rqf070kt48gd.relation: Same theme: what looks like gain or escape is a trap.

cmp:0x3w7t2192cdck.why: Statements of what God would never do: leave the believers without sifting them, punish a people while the Prophet is among them or while they seek forgiveness, misguide a people after guiding them before making clear what to avoid. A lesson in God's ways.
cmp:0x3w7t2192cdck.relation: Same theme: the principles of God's dealing with people, stated as what He would not do.

cmp:0rt6tej0g722qf.why: Every soul will taste death, three times, each followed by a different truth: wages paid in full on the Day, testing by bad and good, the return to God. The tails are what the memorizer must keep apart.
cmp:0rt6tej0g722qf.relation: Same theme: death is certain, and what comes after it is recompense, testing and return.

cmp:1qeoxzl1tbzjot.why: The same closing that worldly life is only the enjoyment of delusion ends two ayat about death, reward and the passing of this life. A memorizer pair with one lesson.
cmp:1qeoxzl1tbzjot.relation: Same theme: the world deceives, and the reward is in the Hereafter.

cmp:193xxh81bdkz5o.why: The shared words only name a group, those given the Book before you, in three unrelated rulings: patience with their insults, marrying their chaste women, not taking mockers as allies. A rare phrase with different subjects.

check.why: Only the name of a group is shared, in three unrelated rulings. Drop.

cmp:0wr4ea41x8kbfe.why: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and He is over all things, closing once with all-powerful and once with witness. The ending changes with the context: power in 3:189, witness over the persecutors of the believers in 85:9.
cmp:0wr4ea41x8kbfe.relation: Similarity: the same sovereignty, shown as power and as watchful witness.

cmp:1mkvmbv19dp4u1.why: Two promises of gardens three ayat apart, closing with a reward from God and a welcome from God, then what is with God is best. A memorizer trap in one passage.
cmp:1mkvmbv19dp4u1.relation: Same theme: what is with God is better, said twice in one closing passage.

cmp:0df0e5r1yl0bmb.why: All three ayat are already in the fuller card of the gardens promise, which shows these tails among the rest. As a separate card it repeats a branch of that tree.

check.why: All three rows are in the kept 19-row gardens card. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:0rvyvx3076jz9h.why: Mankind is told to fear their Lord three times, each with a different reason: He created you from one soul, the quake of the Hour is tremendous, a day comes when no parent can help a child. Good for memorizing and pondering.
cmp:0rvyvx3076jz9h.relation: Same theme: the reasons given to all people for fearing God, from creation to the Hour.

cmp:1r739jb1k3e4jt.why: Only the stock closing that God is Knowing and Wise is shared. One is the law of inheritance, the other the human will under God's will; different subjects, and the rows run on into unrelated ayat.

cmp:1ut8g8g178higo.why: Whoever obeys God and His Messenger, or believes and does good, He admits to gardens: four conditional promises whose tails differ (abiding, abiding forever, and in 48:17 no abiding but the threat to whoever turns away). It brings in 48:17, which the large gardens card does not have.
cmp:1ut8g8g178higo.relation: Same theme: entry to the gardens is tied to obedience and faith with deeds.

cmp:0optggb1m8emxv.why: A repeat: these three ayat are all in the card of the same conditional promise that also holds 48:17, and in the large gardens card. Nothing new to learn here.

cmp:0ga01c51qyywpp.why: A repeat branch of the large gardens card, which already shows these three tails (the great triumph, the reward of the doers of good, the reward of whoever purifies himself).

check.why: All three rows, including 20:76, are in the kept 19-row gardens card, which shows these tails. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:16qlo010vw4twh.why: Both ayat are in the four-row card of the same conditional promise (4:13, 48:17, 64:9, 65:11), which shows this pair's difference beside the other two. The pair adds nothing.

check.why: Both rows are in the kept four-row card and kept tree cards. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:18o47qe1lo7o0e.why: The gardens promise closed by the great triumph, five times, including 9:100 where the rivers flow beneath it without the preposition, the best known trap of this formula. A focused branch worth its own card.
cmp:18o47qe1lo7o0e.relation: Same theme: the great triumph, promised to the obedient, the forerunners, the believers with their light, and those who believe and do good.

cmp:1s09e370tblb9d.why: A repeat: both ayat are already in the large gardens card and its branches, where their different tails are shown. The pair adds nothing.

cmp:1v3k8eo1ez7uq0.why: Only the stock closing that God knows all things is shared. One ayah is about not coveting what others were given, the other about what is shown or hidden concerning the Prophet's wives; different subjects, and the rows run on into unrelated ayat.

check.why: A stock closing on God's knowledge after unrelated rulings. Drop.

cmp:1hoc0oi0v5jpy8.why: Only a stock closing about God being witness or reckoner over all things is shared. The subjects are inheritance of allies, returning a greeting, and whom the Prophet's wives may appear before; nothing to ponder together.

cmp:0drqcy30hpxkob.why: Only the closing that God is witness over all things is shared, after a law of inheritance and a ruling on the Prophet's wives. A stock closing with different subjects.

cmp:0te25ou0ctvqgc.why: Two kinds of people God does not love, in the same frame: the proud and boastful, after the command to treat kin, neighbours and the needy well, and the treacherous sinner, after the warning not to defend the dishonest. A memorizer pair that names two traits to avoid.
cmp:0te25ou0ctvqgc.relation: Similarity: arrogance toward people and treachery are both traits God does not love.

cmp:0j25a0o06wyol8.why: Those who are stingy and order people to be stingy, in the same words twice, with different tails: they hide God's bounty and a humiliating punishment awaits, or whoever turns away, God is Free of need and Praiseworthy. A memorizer pair on one fault.
cmp:0j25a0o06wyol8.relation: Same theme: stinginess that spreads to others, and God's independence from it.

cmp:16wvejt0l3o6cd.why: The shared words only describe disbelief in God and the Last Day, in two unrelated settings: spending for show, and fighting those of the people of the Book who do not hold the true religion. A stock description with different subjects.

cmp:00kcg3b1ghx1xl.why: Those whom God has cursed, twice, each with a consequence: no helper will be found for them, or He made them deaf and blinded their sight. One describes the people of the Book who favour idol worshippers, the other the hypocrites who would spread corruption.
cmp:00kcg3b1ghx1xl.relation: Same theme: what God's curse brings, abandonment and loss of hearing and sight.

cmp:0z1u7h81hhbqtu.why: A repeat branch: all six ayat are in the large gardens card, which shows the forever branch among the others.

check.why: All six rows are in the kept 19-row gardens card, where the forever branch shows as a branch. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:152wjus058cnaa.why: A repeat branch: the same forever branch of the gardens formula, already in the large gardens card and in the six-row forever card.

check.why: All five rows are in the kept 19-row gardens card. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:0pbwygr0in1799.why: The same long promise to those who believe and do good, word for word, twice in one surah, then two different tails (pure spouses and deep shade, a true promise of God). In the large gardens card this tight pair is lost among nineteen rows.
cmp:0pbwygr0in1799.relation: Same promise repeated, once describing the reward and once affirming God's truthfulness.

cmp:1t2fmsb0el1yd5.why: Only the common phrase of gardens with rivers flowing beneath is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp:146w1to1u4jlpw.why: Only the common phrase of gardens with rivers flowing beneath is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp:1s1cpo11caw0h5.why: Three commands to obey God and the Messenger, each with a different addition: those in authority and referring disputes back, do not turn away while you hear, do not void your deeds. A memorizer set with one theme.
cmp:1s1cpo11caw0h5.relation: Same theme: obedience to God and His Messenger and what breaks it.

cmp:054ythy08mu3mc.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same command (4:59, 8:20, 47:33), which shows their difference beside the third.

cmp:0c4vu050o9wt1n.why: Only the stock condition, if you believe in God and the Last Day, is shared, attached to two unrelated rulings: referring disputes to God and the Messenger, and carrying out the punishment for fornication. Different subjects.

cmp:0ka6w5g0tmma64.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same call (4:61, 5:104, 63:5), which shows how the hypocrites and the imitators of their fathers each refuse it.

cmp:1os83bn1sm7nxj.why: When they are called to come to what God revealed and to the Messenger, or to come so the Messenger may ask forgiveness for them, they turn away, cling to their fathers' ways, or twist their heads in pride. Three refusals of one invitation.
cmp:1os83bn1sm7nxj.relation: Same theme: three ways of refusing the call to God's revelation and His Messenger.

cmp:1npataf1sz3ahj.why: We sent no messenger before you except..., six times with different completions: to be obeyed, men from the towns, in the tongue of his people, revealed to them that there is no god but God, Satan casting into his wish. The classic memorizer set of this opening, and a summary of what messengers were.
cmp:1npataf1sz3ahj.relation: Same theme: the nature and mission of the messengers, each place adding one fact.

cmp:0ehj2220l2ljr6.why: Those whom God has favoured among the prophets, twice: the company the obedient will join (4:69) and the prophets of the line of Adam, Noah, Abraham and Israel who fall down weeping at His verses (19:58). A rare clause with one subject.
cmp:0ehj2220l2ljr6.relation: Same theme: who the favoured ones are, and the way to join them.

cmp:1fh8p9b0esz4cd.why: Whoever obeys God and the Messenger, then: those are with the favoured, or with fear and piety, those are the winners. A memorizer pair that differs in the Messenger's naming and in the reward.
cmp:1fh8p9b0esz4cd.relation: Same theme: the reward of obeying God and His Messenger.

cmp:03zpzgv08tsxsn.why: Rebuking questions of the form what is wrong with you that you do not... The two long ones rebuke the believers for not fighting for the oppressed and not believing; the three short ones rebuke the idols that cannot speak, the damned who cannot help each other, and Noah's people who do not revere God. These are two different groups.
cmp:03zpzgv08tsxsn.changes: Split into the two calls to the believers that open with the conjunction (4:75, 57:8) and the three short rebukes without it (37:25, 37:92, 71:13).

check.why: I would keep one card and not split it. All five rows are the same rebuking question, what is wrong with you that you do not. Whether the conjunction is there is exactly the difference a reciter needs to see side by side, so splitting on it hides the point. It is not two different things in the sense the rules mean. Keep the shortOpening flag.

cmp:08svh6h0kv5jzh.why: The whole clause, rely on God, and God suffices as Guardian, given to the Prophet three times: after the hypocrites plot by night, at the opening of al-Ahzab, and with the command to ignore the deniers' harm. One lesson: when opposed, rely on God.
cmp:08svh6h0kv5jzh.relation: Same theme: reliance on God as the answer to plots and opposition.

cmp:07txsud0e5wnoh.why: Will they not ponder the Quran? Asked twice: had it been from other than God they would have found much contradiction, or are there locks on their hearts? The two answers explain why people fail to reflect.
cmp:07txsud0e5wnoh.relation: Similarity: the Quran's consistency invites reflection, and locked hearts block it.

check.why: Will they not ponder the Quran, asked twice with two answers. Keep.

cmp:0bwjsqy13ndzjm.why: He will gather you to the Day of Resurrection, no doubt in it, three times with different lead-ins and tails (who is truer in speech, those who lost themselves, most people do not know). A clear memorizer set on one certainty.
cmp:0bwjsqy13ndzjm.relation: Same theme: the certainty of the gathering and how people respond to it.

cmp:1ugidyy0db1s7w.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same sentence (4:87, 6:12, 45:26), which shows this pair's difference beside the third.

cmp:1vrxcsj1x3g78j.why: Whom God sends astray, you will find no way for him: said twice in one surah, both times of the hypocrites (the two opinions about them, their wavering between two sides). A memorizer pair with one subject.
cmp:1vrxcsj1x3g78j.relation: Same subject: the hypocrites, whose own choices left them without a way.

cmp:0f7ue8o0hxo2ga.why: Whoever cannot find a slave to free must fast two consecutive months: the expiation for accidental killing and for the pre-Islamic divorce oath. Same ruling in two cases, worth knowing side by side.
cmp:0f7ue8o0hxo2ga.relation: Similarity: the same expiation for two different wrongs, killing by mistake and the oath of separation.

cmp:07xv6x11wyunit.why: What is not fitting for a believer: to kill a believer except by mistake, and to have a choice once God and His Messenger have decided. Two limits on a believer, in the same frame.
cmp:07xv6x11wyunit.relation: Similarity: a believer's life and a believer's choice both bounded by God's law.

cmp:1nly3111n24ny3.why: Only the stock closing that God is aware of what you do is shared, after rulings on fighting, marital reconciliation, just witness, and following revelation. Different subjects, and the rows run on into unrelated ayat.

cmp:0ngj0ig1k79tua.why: We sent down to you the Book with the truth, then its purpose: to judge between people by what God showed you, or to worship God sincerely. A memorizer pair that names two aims of revelation.
cmp:0ngj0ig1k79tua.relation: Same theme: the Book is for just judgment and for sincere worship.

cmp:1jz5rii0r7cqfe.why: Only the common phrase of gardens with rivers flowing beneath is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp:1qxogyv143qy3r.why: Only the common phrase of gardens with rivers flowing beneath is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp:10yxau81bs7dy6.why: They will find no protector or helper besides God, said of the evildoer, of the arrogant who refuse to worship, and of the hypocrites trying to escape God's will. A substantive shared clause and one lesson: none can shield from God.
cmp:10yxau81bs7dy6.relation: Same theme: no protector against God's judgment, whoever the wrongdoer is.

cmp:0dybvvo1haiphc.why: Whoever does good, male or female, while a believer: three promises with different rewards (enter the Garden and not wronged, a good life, provision without measure). A key memorizer set and a lesson on equal reward for men and women.
cmp:0dybvvo1haiphc.relation: Same theme: equal reward for men and women who believe and do good.

cmp:1bap2ip195qyib.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same promise (4:124, 16:97, 40:40), which shows this pair's difference beside the third.

cmp:13khpei0d5uny2.why: Whoever does good deeds while a believer, three times, each with a different assurance: enters the Garden, fears no injustice, his effort is not denied. A memorizer set with one theme; the openings differ in their conjunction too.
cmp:13khpei0d5uny2.relation: Same theme: no good deed of a believer is lost.

cmp:031xqig1jp7pa8.why: A repeat: both ayat are already in the card of God's ownership of the heavens and the earth (with 4:132 next to them), where their different endings are shown.

check.why: Both rows sit in the ownership half of the kept card on what belongs to God, where their endings show. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:0gvlb710tb5f0j.why: If you disbelieve, to God belongs what is in the heavens and the earth: said in one surah to the people of the Book and to all mankind, with two different endings (Free of need and Praiseworthy, Knowing and Wise) and a missing repetition in 4:170. A sharp memorizer pair.
cmp:0gvlb710tb5f0j.relation: Same theme: disbelief does not harm God, who owns everything.

cmp:1kjfaqy01b094u.why: What is in the heavens and the earth is His, and God suffices as Guardian: closing a short ayah and closing the warning against the Trinity in the same surah. A memorizer must link this ending to both.
cmp:1kjfaqy01b094u.relation: Similarity: God's ownership of all things answers both the call to trust Him and the claim that He has a son.

cmp:1lgo8ko1xk47a6.why: If He wills He can remove you and bring others, or a new creation. A short memorizer pair that reminds that people are replaceable.
cmp:1lgo8ko1xk47a6.relation: Same theme: mankind's existence hangs on God's will.

check.why: If He wills He removes you; a short pair with a lesson. Keep.

cmp:0tcmmjk0kx73s6.why: Whoever wants the reward of this world, worldly life and its finery, the hasty life, honour, the harvest of the next world: each desire gets its answer. A memorizer set and a lesson on what one seeks.
cmp:0tcmmjk0kx73s6.relation: Contrast: those who want the world get only it, honour and the next world belong to God.

cmp:1fxjscx08i0end.why: Be upholders of justice, witnesses for God (4:135), and be upholders for God, witnesses in justice (5:8): a famous inverted pair. But 61:14, be helpers of God, shares only the call and the verb, and is a different subject.
cmp:1fxjscx08i0end.changes: Removed 61:14, which shares only the opening call and has a different subject; the card keeps the inverted pair on justice.
cmp:1fxjscx08i0end.relation: Same theme: justice even against oneself and even toward enemies.

cmp:1lge44p0yaz3r7.why: Those who believe in God and His messengers: they will be given their wages, and they are the truthful and the witnesses. A memorizer pair about the reward of complete faith.
cmp:1lge44p0yaz3r7.relation: Same theme: the rank of those who believe in all the messengers.

cmp:00lb8z60d06f6k.why: Because of their breaking of their covenant, said twice of the Children of Israel, each listing what followed: hearts sealed, or a curse, hard hearts and distorted words. A clear memorizer pair with one lesson.
cmp:00lb8z60d06f6k.relation: Same theme: breaking the covenant leads to hardened, sealed hearts.

cmp:0mymw9v1m9ozjf.why: The Messiah Jesus son of Mary, messenger of God: once in the Jews' boast that they killed him, which is denied, and once in the warning to the Christians not to exaggerate. The same title answers two opposite errors.
cmp:0mymw9v1m9ozjf.relation: Contrast: one group claimed to kill him, the other raised him above a messenger; the same words set both right.

cmp:1ailx0w07opesi.why: Those who disbelieve and bar from God's way, five times, each with a different result: far astray, punishment upon punishment, deeds made void, no harm to God, no forgiveness if they die so. A classic memorizer tree.
cmp:1ailx0w07opesi.relation: Same theme: the end of those who both disbelieve and block others.

check.why: Five places of the same clause with five results; a classic set. Keep.

cmp:0fmz4h00r9vhra.why: A repeat: these three ayat are in the five-row card of the same phrase, which already shows all their branches.

cmp:1t57i2o0hasa5a.why: Three places where God's ownership of the heavens and the earth is stated without repeating the second relative, each drawing a different point: your disbelief does not harm Him, His promise is true, He knows your state. A memorizer set distinct from the longer ownership card.
cmp:1t57i2o0hasa5a.relation: Same theme: God's ownership as the ground of His independence, His promise and His knowledge.

cmp:0sctgg81057um0.why: Only the heavens-and-earth wording and the stock closing Knowing and Wise are shared. One calls mankind to believe, the other speaks of tranquillity and God's hosts; different subjects.

cmp:1a9n8hc02nylz4.why: O mankind, there has come to you: the Messenger with the truth, a proof and a clear light, an admonition and healing. Three announcements naming what was sent, with a feminine verb in the third.
cmp:1a9n8hc02nylz4.relation: Same theme: what God sent to all people, described three ways.

cmp:1oco3br0311mpl.why: Do not go to extremes in your religion, said twice to the people of the Book, once about the Trinity and once about following earlier misguided peoples. A memorizer pair with one warning.
cmp:1oco3br0311mpl.relation: Same theme: excess in religion as the root of the people of the Book's error.

cmp:1pbw4dm05d55ew.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same clause (4:123, 4:173, 33:17).

cmp:0zwhvt41bw41gw.why: Only the stock closing, fear God, God is severe in punishment, is shared, after the rule of cooperation in piety and after the distribution of spoils. Different subjects.

cmp:0k80aht1mqkgsb.why: The list of forbidden foods, once with its full detail and once briefly with the concession for necessity. A memorizer must keep the opening and the continuation of each apart.
cmp:0k80aht1mqkgsb.relation: Same ruling: forbidden foods, with the exemption for the one forced by need.

cmp:1fbk4b00sdtb64.why: Only the stock closing, fear God, God is aware of what you do, is shared. One ayah commands justice even toward enemies, the other to look at what one has sent ahead for tomorrow; different subjects.

cmp:08chs4w0tmgd02.why: Those who believe and do good have forgiveness and..., three times with different second rewards (a great wage, a noble provision, a great wage of another word). A memorizer set where the tails decide.
cmp:08chs4w0tmgd02.relation: Same theme: forgiveness and reward for faith with deeds, set against the deniers' punishment in 35:7.

cmp:0ejarmt0a7r05r.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same promise (5:9, 22:50, 35:7), which shows their difference beside the third.

cmp:0tf8dhb0pg39bj.why: God has promised those who believe and do good: once forgiveness and a great reward, once succession in the land, security and an established religion. The same promise opens on a reward in the next world and one in this world.
cmp:0tf8dhb0pg39bj.relation: Similarity: God's promise to the believers covers both the Hereafter and their life on earth.

cmp:0ujkmci1l2bt4m.why: Those who disbelieve and deny Our signs are the companions of Hellfire, word for word three times, each closing a contrast with the believers. A memorizer must know where it stands alone and where it follows a long ayah.
cmp:0ujkmci1l2bt4m.relation: Same theme: the deniers' end, each time set against the reward of the believers.

cmp:16nrv25004n0hr.why: Remember God's favour upon you when an enemy came against you: the people who meant to stretch their hands against you (5:11) and the armies of the Confederates (33:9). A strong pair. 33:41, remember God much, has a different object and subject.
cmp:16nrv25004n0hr.changes: Removed 33:41, where the object of remembering is God Himself, not His favour in a past danger.
cmp:16nrv25004n0hr.relation: Same theme: remembering how God held back the enemy.

cmp:1t68rs500dra9n.why: Only the common gardens phrase is shared. One is the covenant with the Children of Israel, the other the Day of mutual loss; different subjects, and the gardens cards already show this phrase.

check.why: Only the common gardens phrase, with different subjects. Drop.

cmp:0zvt84a097uii4.why: They have disbelieved who say God is the Messiah son of Mary: twice in one surah, answered once by God's power to destroy the Messiah and once by the Messiah's own call to worship God alone. A strong memorizer pair with one subject.
cmp:0zvt84a097uii4.relation: Same theme: two refutations of the claim that God is the Messiah, one from God's power and one from Jesus' own words.

cmp:0mr21xz1o5cye3.why: The link is God creating what He wills and His power over all things, in two different settings: the refutation of the Messiah's divinity and the creation of animals from water. Mostly a stock closing; thin for a card.

check.why: A stock closing on God's power in two unrelated settings. Drop.

cmp:0aor9uz1svesx3.why: Recite to them the story of...: the two sons of Adam, the one who shed God's signs, Noah, Abraham. Four story openings with the same command, a memorizer set that also names stories chosen as lessons.
cmp:0aor9uz1svesx3.relation: Same theme: stories the Prophet is ordered to recite, each a lesson about acceptance, apostasy, steadfastness and monotheism.

cmp:0ej6sl10kcoo45.why: Punishment in this world and a punishment in the Hereafter, for those who wage war on God and His Messenger (5:33) and for the Banu Nadir who opposed God and His Messenger (59:3). Same theme with different tails. Other places with the same tail, such as 2:114 and 5:41, are not in the card.
cmp:0ej6sl10kcoo45.relation: Same theme: opposing God and His Messenger brings loss in both worlds.

check.why: Opposing God and His Messenger punished in both worlds, the same theme. Keep.

cmp:0zd2ycb1a7zwo7.why: If they had all that is on earth and as much again, to ransom themselves: three times, with different lead-ins and tails. A clear memorizer set with one lesson: nothing ransoms from the punishment.
cmp:0zd2ycb1a7zwo7.relation: Same theme: no ransom will be accepted on the Day.

cmp:0z2dyag0z2ws4a.why: Then they turn away after that, and those are not believers: said of the Jews who seek the Prophet's judgment while they hold the Torah, and of the hypocrites who claim obedience then refuse to be judged. Both about turning from God's judgment.
cmp:0z2dyag0z2ws4a.relation: Same theme: claiming faith while refusing God's judgment.

cmp:0r2fqqb0fx6ftz.why: Judge between them by what God revealed and do not follow their desires, in two consecutive ayat that differ in their opening and continuation. A memorizer pair in one passage.
cmp:0r2fqqb0fx6ftz.relation: Same command repeated: rule by revelation, not by people's desires.

cmp:0la29yq0egzkaa.why: Had God willed He would have made you one community, but...: to test you in what He gave you, or He sends astray and guides whom He wills. 42:8 has the same sentence with the third person and its own continuation, and is now a separate two-row card.
cmp:0la29yq0egzkaa.changes: Added 42:8, which has the same sentence with a pronoun change, so all three continuations are in one card.
cmp:0la29yq0egzkaa.relation: Same theme: why God did not make mankind one community.

check.why: Adding 42:8, which carries the same sentence with a pronoun change, completes the family of the one community. Keep with the change.

cmp:17yt6671slkoqd.why: To God is your return all together, then He will inform you: of what you differed about, or of what you did. Two places in one surah, a memorizer trap.
cmp:17yt6671slkoqd.relation: Same theme: all return to God, who will settle both differences and deeds.

cmp:15ikwva1oe18wo.why: A partial card of the sentence that God could have made mankind one community; both ayat belong in the card with 16:93, where all three continuations are shown together.

check.why: Once 42:8 joins the card with 5:48 and 16:93, this pair is fully shown there. Drop.

cmp:1o8rqyj1hn3f21.why: Only the stock closing that God does not guide the wrongdoing people is shared, after unrelated subjects: allies, livestock law, following desire, rejecting the Quran.

cmp:08co1l016hkzng.why: The believers speak, and the hypocrites are exposed: once wondering at those who swore they were with them, once asking for a sura that reveals who fears fighting. The short shared opening frames the same unmasking.
cmp:08co1l016hkzng.relation: Same theme: the hypocrites unmasked through what the believers say.

check.why: A rare opening, and in both places the believers' words unmask the hypocrites. Keep.

cmp:1gtkhql0u0shnd.why: That is God's bounty, He gives it to whom He wills, three times with two endings (All-Encompassing and Knowing; Possessor of great bounty). A classic memorizer set: the bounty is a people He loves, a vast garden, a Prophet among the unlettered.
cmp:1gtkhql0u0shnd.relation: Same theme: God's bounty given by His choice.

cmp:01im3jr0g3y2ab.why: Those who establish prayer and give zakat, and then: they bow (5:55), or they are certain of the Hereafter (27:3 and 31:4, word for word). The memorizer must catch the one different tail.
cmp:01im3jr0g3y2ab.relation: Same theme: the description of the believers by prayer, zakat and certainty.

cmp:0e7hcad1y89nop.why: You see many of them..., twice in one surah, about the people of the Book: rushing into sin and devouring the unlawful, and taking the deniers as allies. One has the conjunction and one does not; both close with how evil their deeds are.
cmp:0e7hcad1y89nop.relation: Same subject: the faults of many of the people of the Book.

cmp:0x157cv1xkpijn.why: What is revealed to you will surely increase many of them in transgression and disbelief: a long exact clause in two ayat of one surah, after the claim that God's hand is tied and after the call to uphold the Torah and Gospel.
cmp:0x157cv1xkpijn.relation: Same theme: revelation hardens those who resist it.

cmp:0ouwbn50vw1gej.why: If the people of the Book, or the people of the towns, had believed and feared God, We would have removed their sins and admitted them to gardens, or opened blessings from heaven and earth. Same condition, one reward in the next world and one in this.
cmp:0ouwbn50vw1gej.relation: Similarity: faith and piety bring reward in both worlds.

cmp:1fsiuic107o3cg.why: Only the stock closing that God does not guide the disbelieving people is shared, after the command to deliver the message and after those who prefer this world. Different subjects.

cmp:175v4dc1579510.why: Worshipping besides God what has no power: over harm or benefit for you, or over provision from the heavens and the earth. A memorizer pair and a clear argument against idols.
cmp:175v4dc1579510.relation: Same argument: what is worshipped besides God owns nothing.

cmp:1mzkesr1t1h5yx.why: Do you worship besides God what does not benefit or harm you? Asked by the Prophet of the Christians (5:76) and by Abraham of his people (21:66). The same argument in two mouths, with harm and benefit in reverse order.
cmp:1mzkesr1t1h5yx.relation: Same argument used by two prophets against two kinds of false worship.

cmp:0e2z7ou1orebzg.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the large gardens card, where their tails are shown with the others. The pair adds nothing.

cmp:17sdt5r18q2xn7.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the large gardens card, which shows the branch of that is the reward of the doers of good and of whoever purifies himself.

cmp:0qiw7y21x6yenc.why: Eat of what God has provided you, lawful and good, then: fear God in whom you believe, or be grateful for God's favour. A memorizer pair whose tails differ.
cmp:0qiw7y21x6yenc.relation: Same command: lawful provision joined to piety and to gratitude.

cmp:0gge80g04bm432.why: Fear God in whom you are believers: the only two places of this closing, after lawful food and after compensating husbands whose wives went to the deniers. The memorizer must know both; the subjects differ.

check.why: A rare exact closing found only in these two places. Kept on the owner's shared-rare-clause precedent.

cmp:1hkvhp31cgxlq9.why: O you who believe, ... is only...: wine, gambling, idols and divining arrows are filth from Satan's work; the polytheists are impure and may not approach the Sacred Mosque. Two declarations of impurity, followed by a command to keep away.
cmp:1hkvhp31cgxlq9.relation: Similarity: what is declared impure, a practice and a belief, and the believers kept away from both.

check.why: Two declarations of impurity to the believers, each followed by keeping away. A real likeness for pondering. Keep.

cmp:0obyv8h02jf07t.why: A repeat: these three ayat are in the four-row card of the same phrase (with 3:29), which shows all their endings.

cmp:0cwy37c1li74ym.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the four-row card of God knowing what is in the heavens and the earth.

cmp:1wrqusu1nvfgyg.why: That God knows what is in the heavens and on earth: once with the plural heavens and the repeated relative, once with the singular sky and no repetition. A fine memorizer distinction.
cmp:1wrqusu1nvfgyg.relation: Same theme: God's knowledge of everything, recorded in a Book (22:70).

cmp:00woalg0cjqypw.why: Only the short opening, know that God, is shared. One is about His severe punishment and mercy, the other about reviving the earth after its death. A stock opening with different subjects.

cmp:0b59mwe1fpfaas.why: God knows what you show and what you hide: the closing of two rulings, the Messenger's duty is only to deliver and entering uninhabited houses. A rare exact closing that a memorizer must place; the subjects differ.

check.why: A rare exact closing in two places; a memorizer must place it. Keep.

cmp:1lzan9b0sbt8xh.why: God did not make...: the pagan cattle taboos, and two hearts in one chest, wives made mothers by an oath, adopted sons made sons. Both strike down customs people attributed to God or to nature.
cmp:1lzan9b0sbt8xh.relation: Same theme: God denies having made the customs people invented.

cmp:1g7t0xb0t0pu69.why: When told to follow what God revealed, they say: what we found our fathers on, and the answer: even if their fathers knew nothing, even if Satan was calling them. A strong memorizer pair on blind imitation.
cmp:1g7t0xb0t0pu69.relation: Same theme: blind following of the fathers, answered twice.

cmp:1ntnzzp18oxa95.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of God's addresses to Jesus (with 3:55).

cmp:1uauzpf108gppb.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding forever, God pleased with them and they with Him, then two closings: that is the great triumph, and that is for whoever fears his Lord. A long identical run with a different last clause, a sharp memorizer pair.
cmp:1uauzpf108gppb.relation: Same reward: mutual pleasure between God and the truthful, the God-fearing.

cmp:1c3af3g0y7ktb2.why: The same two elements, God pleased with them and they with Him, and gardens abiding forever, in reverse order, and 9:100 drops the preposition before the rivers. A known memorizer trap.
cmp:1c3af3g0y7ktb2.relation: Same reward: the truthful on the Day and the first forerunners share God's mutual pleasure.

cmp:1ranwgg1ri7984.why: It is He who created you: from clay, from one soul, from dust, then some of you disbelieve and some believe. Four openings alike, each moving to a different lesson (term of life, spouses, stages of life, faith and denial).
cmp:1ranwgg1ri7984.relation: Same theme: creation as an argument, each time leading to another truth about man.

cmp:1ao1v5c05z89d6.why: The same ayah word for word in two surahs: no sign of their Lord comes to them but they turn away from it. A memorizer must know where it occurs and what follows each.
cmp:1ao1v5c05z89d6.relation: Same theme: habitual turning away from God's signs.

cmp:02ehmyv1kpw28n.why: Despite the one-word title, these rows share a whole pattern: nothing comes to them, a sign, a messenger, a new reminder, a prophet, but they turn away, mock, or listen while playing. It is a known memorizer family whose variants are hard to keep apart.
cmp:02ehmyv1kpw28n.relation: Same theme: every kind of message is met with mockery or turning away.

cmp:166ema519tawzf.why: How many generations We destroyed before them: the same phrase in four places (6:6, 32:26, 36:31, 38:3) is now split across three two-row cards, all with 6:6. One card shows the variants together (from a generation, from the generations, before them without the preposition).
cmp:166ema519tawzf.changes: Added 32:26 and 36:31, which carry the same phrase and are now in separate two-row cards with 6:6.
cmp:166ema519tawzf.relation: Same theme: the destroyed generations as a warning to the deniers.

check.why: Merging the family of how many generations We destroyed before them is good, but the merged card should not leave out 19:74, 19:98 and 50:36. They carry the same phrase, before them from a generation, and are closer to 38:3 than 32:26 is. I would merge 6:6, 19:74, 19:98, 32:26, 36:31, 38:3 and 50:36. 20:128 can stay with 32:26 in its book card.

cmp:0qa830h1e6qoaz.why: A partial card of the phrase how many generations We destroyed before them; both ayat belong in the fuller card proposed with 36:31 and 38:3.

check.why: Given a merged card of the generations phrase, this pair is fully shown there. Drop.

cmp:01ath6q0ad73ii.why: A partial card of the phrase how many generations We destroyed before them; both ayat belong in the fuller card proposed with 32:26 and 38:3.

check.why: Given a merged card of the generations phrase, this pair is fully shown there. Drop.

cmp:09i4mbb0ooi84j.why: The deniers would say this is nothing but clear magic: even if a written book were sent that they could touch, and when told they will be raised after death. The same reply to two different signs.
cmp:09i4mbb0ooi84j.relation: Same theme: whatever the sign, the deniers call it magic.

cmp:0e4gffg082nv1m.why: They said, why has not ... been sent down to him: an angel, or signs from his Lord. Same demand of the deniers, two answers (the matter would be decided, signs are with God and I am only a warner).
cmp:0e4gffg082nv1m.relation: Same theme: the deniers' demands for proofs and the reply.

cmp:0lcrrfa1myysam.why: The two identical ayat are already in the three-row card of the same opening (with 13:32), which also shows the third variant. The pair adds nothing beyond it.

cmp:0wp7e9r1byq237.why: Messengers before you were mocked: twice with the same continuation (what they mocked surrounded them), once with a different one (I gave respite then seized them). Consolation to the Prophet, and a memorizer trap.
cmp:0wp7e9r1byq237.relation: Same theme: mockery of messengers is met by God's punishment.

cmp:0yltb760vump4i.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the fuller card of the travel-in-the-land command (6:11, 27:69, 29:20, 30:42).

cmp:0icaqmp0ug0vml.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the fuller card of the travel-in-the-land command (6:11, 27:69, 29:20, 30:42).

cmp:16a6j4q0d6z638.why: Say, shall I take other than God: as a protector, as a lord. Two questions in one surah with one answer: He is the Creator and the Lord of all things.
cmp:16a6j4q0d6z638.relation: Same theme: refusing any protector or lord but God.

cmp:1l2k4ke056v2p0.why: I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the punishment of a great day: twice as a short command and once inside the reply to those who want a different Quran. A memorizer set with one stance.
cmp:1l2k4ke056v2p0.relation: Same theme: the Prophet himself fears disobeying God.

cmp:04ablrr1r6s245.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the three-row card of the same sentence (with 10:15).

cmp:15vrwpm178z8r4.why: He is the Subduer over His servants, twice in one surah, then the Wise and Aware, or He sends guardians until death comes. A memorizer pair.
cmp:15vrwpm178z8r4.relation: Same theme: God's supremacy over His servants, in His wisdom and in their death.

cmp:0anycdl0s2khvj.why: Who does more wrong than one who invents a lie against God: eight places with different continuations (or denies His signs, or claims revelation, to mislead people, they will be shown to their Lord). The classic memorizer family of this phrase.
cmp:0anycdl0s2khvj.relation: Same theme: lying about God as the greatest wrong.

cmp:0178uu10mwlbib.why: A repeat: these five ayat are all in the eight-row card of the same phrase, which shows their branches.

cmp:0j71lux1mi6xsb.why: A repeat: these four ayat are in the eight-row card of the same phrase, which shows their branches with the others.

cmp:1ce53gu1shr6iy.why: The Day We gather them all, then say to those who associated: where are your partners, and stay in your place, you and your partners. Same scene, two continuations, a memorizer pair.
cmp:1ce53gu1shr6iy.relation: Same scene: the idolaters confronted with their partners on the Day.

cmp:1vjgrmy0jbl1es.why: What they used to invent has left them: closing three scenes where the deniers lied against themselves or lost themselves. A memorizer set with one lesson.
cmp:1vjgrmy0jbl1es.relation: Same theme: false gods abandon their worshippers when it matters.

cmp:0h4kcxs1ngy6i8.why: We placed coverings on their hearts lest they understand it, and deafness in their ears: three times, with different lead-ins and continuations. A classic memorizer set.
cmp:0h4kcxs1ngy6i8.relation: Same theme: those who turn from the reminder lose the ability to understand it.

cmp:04zn5d50iochxj.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same sentence (with 17:46).

cmp:0su9od31cxlzsb.why: Even if they see every sign they will not believe in it: said of the deniers who come to dispute, and of the arrogant whom God turns from His signs. A rare clause with one subject; 7:146 adds the paths of right and error.
cmp:0su9od31cxlzsb.relation: Same theme: arrogance and hard hearts make every sign useless.

cmp:1syphd30f6axod.why: Among them are some who listen to you: then hearts covered and ears deaf, or they leave asking what he just said, hearts sealed. Two pictures of listening without understanding.
cmp:1syphd30f6axod.relation: Same theme: hearing the Prophet without taking anything in.

cmp:0ziqo3l14fbjbj.why: There is nothing but our worldly life, and we will not be raised: the deniers' creed in two places, one with the addition we die and we live. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0ziqo3l14fbjbj.relation: Same claim: denial of resurrection, in Mecca and among earlier peoples.

cmp:1m9p6my048ipxa.why: Is this not the truth? Yes, by our Lord. Then taste the punishment for your disbelief: the same dialogue in two scenes, standing before their Lord and shown the Fire. A sharp memorizer pair.
cmp:1m9p6my048ipxa.relation: Same scene: the deniers forced to admit the truth when it is too late.

cmp:026ntfl0hp7xyz.why: Those who denied the meeting with God have lost: once with their regret when the Hour comes suddenly, once on the Day of gathering when they feel they stayed only an hour. A memorizer pair on one theme.
cmp:026ntfl0hp7xyz.relation: Same theme: the loss of those who denied the meeting with God.

cmp:0urjxfi1et9g8u.why: Lost indeed are those who...: denied the meeting with God, killed their children foolishly. Two places in one surah that a memorizer must tell apart; both name a kind of loser.
cmp:0urjxfi1et9g8u.relation: Similarity: denial of the Hereafter and the killing of children are both called loss.

cmp:0zpb4ut05yoj2f.why: The home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear God; will you not reason? Closing a verdict on the worldly life and the rebuke of those who took the bribe of this lower world. A memorizer pair with one lesson.
cmp:0zpb4ut05yoj2f.relation: Same theme: the Hereafter over the passing goods of this world.

cmp:1fcdrok011rkt6.why: Why has no sign been sent down to him from his Lord? The deniers' demand recurs in five places with different answers (God is able, the unseen is God's, you are only a warner, God guides who turns to Him, signs are with God). This pair and the 6:37 and 10:20 pair are two pieces of one family.
cmp:1fcdrok011rkt6.changes: Added 10:20, 13:7 and 29:50, which carry the same demand, so all answers are seen together.
cmp:1fcdrok011rkt6.relation: Same theme: the demand for a miracle, and the answers given to it.

check.why: The deniers' demand for a sign, with the different answers gathered in one card. Adding 10:20, 13:7 and 29:50 is right. Keep with the change.

cmp:10m03wv19wtten.why: A partial card of the demand for a sign from his Lord; both ayat belong in the fuller card proposed under the 6:37 and 13:27 pair.

check.why: Fully shown in the merged card of the demand for a sign. Drop.

cmp:1a79zyv1p4rer5.why: Why has not ... been sent down: a sign to him, this Quran to a great man of the two towns. Two objections of the deniers to revelation with the same opening.
cmp:1a79zyv1p4rer5.relation: Same theme: the deniers dictating what revelation should be.

check.why: Two objections of the deniers to how revelation came, with the same opening. Keep.

cmp:1ggx97h1t4yzb7.why: There is no creature on earth but...: communities like you, or its provision is on God. Two statements about all creatures, a memorizer pair.
cmp:1ggx97h1t4yzb7.relation: Same theme: God's care for every creature, recorded in a Book.

cmp:04uzqvh1acgawr.why: Those who deny Our signs, five times with five fates: deaf and dumb in darkness, touched by punishment, companions of the Fire, deeds voided, drawn on by degrees. A memorizer tree with one subject.
cmp:04uzqvh1acgawr.relation: Same theme: the many sides of the fate of the deniers of the signs.

cmp:10egrlr1ecfs95.why: Have you considered, if God's punishment came to you: two questions in one surah, one about whom they would call, one about who would be destroyed. A memorizer pair.
cmp:10egrlr1ecfs95.relation: Same theme: what remains when the punishment comes.

cmp:0vzppnx0l0lxwd.why: We sent messengers to communities before you: then We seized them with hardship so they might humble themselves, or Satan made their deeds fair to them. A rare phrase with two outcomes.
cmp:0vzppnx0l0lxwd.relation: Same theme: earlier nations, tested by hardship or deceived by Satan.

cmp:0wpxijf0n81i9l.why: Only the stock opening, We sent to, is shared. One is about communities seized with hardship, the other about Salih sent to Thamud; different subjects.

cmp:043rayl17gnbqv.why: When they forgot what they were reminded of: then We opened the doors of everything until they rejoiced and We seized them suddenly, or We saved those who forbade evil and seized the wrongdoers. Two outcomes of forgetting the reminder.
cmp:043rayl17gnbqv.relation: Same theme: forgetting the reminder is followed by sudden seizure, with the forbidders of evil saved.

cmp:13bjlmm1p8mu2u.why: Whoever believes, or fears God, and reforms: no fear on them nor will they grieve. Both follow the sending of messengers and both are followed by the fate of those who deny Our signs. A memorizer pair with the same structure.
cmp:13bjlmm1p8mu2u.relation: Same theme: the messengers' message splits people into the reformers and the deniers.

cmp:0qn1t0q16ilpyq.why: We send the messengers only as bearers of good news and warners: then who believes and reforms is safe, or the deniers argue with falsehood and mock. Two continuations of one sentence.
cmp:0qn1t0q16ilpyq.relation: Contrast: the same mission received by believers and by mockers.

cmp:1qa65760xu34dy.why: I follow only what is revealed to me: three times, each in an answer about the Prophet's limits (no treasures nor knowledge of the unseen, no power to change the Quran, nothing new among messengers). A memorizer set with one stance.
cmp:1qa65760xu34dy.relation: Same theme: the Prophet as a follower of revelation, nothing more.

cmp:1s3gapm08n3mzo.why: Those who call on their Lord morning and evening seeking His face: do not drive them away, and keep yourself patient with them. Two commands to the Prophet about the same poor believers.
cmp:1s3gapm08n3mzo.relation: Same subject: the humble worshippers the Prophet must keep close.

check.why: Two commands about the same humble worshippers. Keep.

cmp:1qh3s3x05rfmm7.why: Say, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides God: then, I will not follow your desires, or since the clear proofs came to me. A memorizer pair with one stance.
cmp:1qh3s3x05rfmm7.relation: Same stance: refusing false worship, by revelation and clear proof.

check.why: The same refusal of false worship with two continuations. Keep.

cmp:1yrlvb51tp2fal.why: For them a drink of boiling water and a painful punishment because they disbelieved: an exact long clause in two places, after those given up to destruction for what they earned and after the just recompense of creation's return.
cmp:1yrlvb51tp2fal.relation: Same theme: the deniers' recompense in the Hereafter.

cmp:1knjsn307twgmn.why: Calling or worshipping besides God what can neither benefit nor harm: the believers' refusal, Abraham's question, the deniers' practice. The same argument against idols in three voices.
cmp:1knjsn307twgmn.relation: Same argument: what cannot benefit or harm is not worth worship.

cmp:0zd0m460na6qug.why: It is He who created...: the heavens and the earth in truth, or in six days, the night and day, man from water. The first two are a close memorizer pair; together they list signs of creation.
cmp:0zd0m460na6qug.relation: Same theme: creation as evidence of God, from the cosmos to human kinship.

cmp:0zdfnam1o7b3u0.why: And when Abraham said: to his father Azar, to his Lord about the safe city, to his father and his people. Three moments of Abraham against idol worship.
cmp:0zdfnam1o7b3u0.relation: Same person: Abraham's stand against idols in his family, his people and his prayer.

cmp:08vxsj811axje6.why: He said this is my Lord, then when it set he said...: the star and the moon in consecutive ayat, each with a different conclusion. A memorizer must keep the order of the argument.
cmp:08vxsj811axje6.relation: Same story: Abraham's argument from the setting of the heavenly bodies.

cmp:049s10d1w1uk6d.why: Unless my Lord wills something, my Lord encompasses all things in knowledge: Abraham to his people, and Shuaib's followers to theirs. The same submission to God's will in two prophets' answers.
cmp:049s10d1w1uk6d.relation: Same stance: two prophets refuse their people's religion and leave the outcome to God's knowledge.

cmp:0rdfrtr0shg5nn.why: We gave him Isaac and Jacob, three times with different continuations (each We guided, as an extra gift, prophethood in his line). A memorizer set on God's gift to Abraham.
cmp:0rdfrtr0shg5nn.relation: Same theme: the line of prophets given to Abraham.

check.why: God's gift of Isaac and Jacob with three continuations. Keep.

cmp:10bcnya1mo52k2.why: That is God's guidance, by it He guides whom He wills: after the list of prophets, and after the description of the Quran that makes skins shiver. Two tails, a memorizer pair.
cmp:10bcnya1mo52k2.relation: Same theme: guidance belongs to God, whether in His prophets or His Book.

cmp:0ym9qq00j8fkq2.why: They did not esteem God as He should be esteemed: when they denied revelation, in the parable of idols that cannot make a fly, and before the Day when the earth is in His grip. A memorizer set with one theme.
cmp:0ym9qq00j8fkq2.relation: Same theme: what failing to know God's greatness looks like.

cmp:0of0qkz1y1gbbh.why: This is a blessed Book We sent down, twice in one surah: confirming what came before and warning the Mother of Towns, then follow it and fear God. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0of0qkz1y1gbbh.relation: Same subject: the Quran described as blessed and to be followed.

cmp:1sy3bj90fz0ksx.why: Today you are recompensed with the punishment of humiliation because you used to...: at death for lying about God, and before the Fire for squandering good things in arrogance. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1sy3bj90fz0ksx.relation: Same theme: humiliation as recompense for arrogance.

cmp:0u0dq3z0xucf7d.why: It is He who made for you...: the stars to guide you, the night as a garment, night and day in succession. Three signs of time and light.
cmp:0u0dq3z0xucf7d.relation: Same theme: the heavens and the cycle of night and day as signs and provisions.

cmp:0i4r1qq1fucy8w.why: He sent down water from the sky and We brought forth by it: every kind of plant, pairs of plants, fruits of varied colours. Three places that shift from He to We in the same way, a known memorizer pattern.
cmp:0i4r1qq1fucy8w.relation: Same theme: rain and the variety of what it brings out.
