cmp:1cosf1b1fc2owv.why: He is the One who sent down water from the sky, once with the conjunction and plants, once without it and drink and pasture. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1cosf1b1fc2owv.relation: Same theme: rain as provision for people and their animals.

cmp:01meo0216sdlng.why: Creator of all things, and over all things a Guardian: once inside a fuller declaration of oneness with the command to worship Him, once alone. A memorizer pair.
cmp:01meo0216sdlng.relation: Same theme: the Creator of everything is also its Guardian.

cmp:1dw2vm00z3syn6.why: That is God, your Lord: three declarations with different tails (no god but He, the Creator, so worship Him; the Truth, what is after truth but error; Creator, no god but He, how are you turned away). The order of the clauses is the memorizer's trap.
cmp:1dw2vm00z3syn6.relation: Same theme: God named as Lord, Creator and Truth, with a rebuke to those who turn away.

cmp:15r7q9e1ii6cnw.why: Only the opening, had God willed, links 6:107 (they would not have associated) to the other two, which share a longer sentence and belong with 5:48 in the card of the one community. The opening alone is too common to make a card.

check.why: 6:107 shares only the common opening, had God willed. The other two belong in the one-community card. Drop.

cmp:025ybkh0dy4czz.why: Thus We made for every prophet an enemy: the devils of men and jinn, or the criminals. A memorizer pair with one consolation.
cmp:025ybkh0dy4czz.relation: Same theme: enmity to prophets is a law, and God suffices as guide and helper.

cmp:060zuq71aqhnr1.why: They follow nothing but conjecture and they only guess: said of the majority on earth and of those who call on partners. A clear memorizer pair with one verdict.
cmp:060zuq71aqhnr1.relation: Same theme: false belief rests on guessing.

cmp:1pdun5k1qjzwye.why: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is guided: a near identical clause in 6:117 and 68:7, and also in 16:125 and 53:30, which this card lacks. The other three rows (15:25, 15:86, 32:25) share only the short opening, your Lord is He, with different subjects.
cmp:1pdun5k1qjzwye.changes: Kept the ayat with the full clause about who strays and who is guided, added 16:125 and 53:30 which carry it, and removed 15:25, 15:86 and 32:25, which share only a two-word opening.
cmp:1pdun5k1qjzwye.relation: Same theme: only God knows who is truly guided.

check.why: The three short rows share only a two-word opening with different subjects. The real family is the clause on who strays and who is guided, and adding 16:125 and 53:30 completes it. Agree with the change.

cmp:0kfmc9c1hcrqys.why: Only a short rebuking opening, what is wrong with you that you do not, is shared. One is about eating what God's name was mentioned on, the other about spending in God's way; different subjects.

cmp:0gf8ftw1p5jodi.why: The Day He gathers them all: then the jinn are reproached for misleading many humans, or the angels are asked whether these worshipped them. Two confrontations between the worshipped and their worshippers.
cmp:0gf8ftw1p5jodi.relation: Similarity: on the Day the jinn and the angels are both questioned about those who served them.

cmp:0eu8mfa0hig7ko.why: They testified against themselves that they were disbelievers: the jinn and men asked about the messengers, and the liars about God when death comes. An exact closing in two scenes of confession.
cmp:0eu8mfa0hig7ko.relation: Same theme: the deniers' own confession on the Day.

cmp:01rhp0y12457tc.why: Did not messengers come to you from among you, reciting signs and warning you of meeting this Day of yours? Asked of jinn and men, and by the keepers of Hell. The same question and confession in two scenes.
cmp:01rhp0y12457tc.relation: Same scene: the messengers came, and the deniers admit it.

cmp:0z1j7dr1rrg6mh.why: O company of jinn and men: the only two places of this address, once asking whether messengers came to them and once challenging them to pass beyond the heavens and the earth. One shows they were warned, the other that they cannot escape.
cmp:0z1j7dr1rrg6mh.relation: Similarity: jinn and men addressed together, accountable and unable to flee.

check.why: The only two addresses to jinn and men together. Keep.

cmp:09r0p6f1m3nu1v.why: For each are degrees according to what they did: then your Lord is not unaware, or so He may pay them fully without wrong. A short memorizer pair on one principle.
cmp:09r0p6f1m3nu1v.relation: Same theme: ranks follow deeds, with full and just pay.

cmp:0dwx7km17eu1xa.why: My people, work according to your position, I am working; you will come to know: once with the addition about whose end will be good, once shorter. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0dwx7km17eu1xa.relation: Same theme: the Prophet leaves the outcome to be seen.

cmp:1bp7xko11dsclc.why: Eat, and do not be wasteful, He does not love the wasteful: after the harvest of gardens and after adornment at every mosque. The same balance in two places.
cmp:1bp7xko11dsclc.relation: Same theme: enjoying God's provision without excess.

check.why: Eat and do not waste, in two places. Keep.

cmp:1w7gmee0v4s4bk.why: Only the short opening, He is the One who produced, is shared. One lists gardens, palms and crops, the other hearing, sight and hearts; different subjects and nothing to set side by side.

cmp:0k104ge0rkvrhc.why: Has He forbidden the two males or the two females, or what the wombs of the two females contain: the same question in consecutive ayat about the eight kinds of livestock, with different closings. A memorizer pair in one argument.
cmp:0k104ge0rkvrhc.relation: Same argument: the pagan food taboos have no basis.

cmp:1jf2l441kkrx7y.why: The forbidden foods with the exemption for whoever is forced, not desiring nor exceeding: then your Lord is forgiving, or God is forgiving. Different framing (I find nothing forbidden but, He has only forbidden) and a different name at the end.
cmp:1jf2l441kkrx7y.relation: Same ruling: what is forbidden to eat and the mercy for necessity.

cmp:0mk1x9p1son3uj.why: To the Jews We forbade...: the detailed list and the reference back to it, both with the point that this was a penalty for their wrong, not God's injustice.
cmp:0mk1x9p1son3uj.relation: Same theme: the extra prohibitions on the Jews came from their own transgression.

cmp:0c376qb11w5xl5.why: If they deny you, say: your Lord has vast mercy, or my deeds are mine and yours are yours. Two answers to denial, with different conjunctions.
cmp:0c376qb11w5xl5.relation: Same theme: how the Prophet answers denial, with mercy and with disavowal.

cmp:1dsly6y07e2vta.why: Do not kill the soul God has made sacred except by right: in the list of commandments, in the rules of retaliation, and in the description of the servants of the Merciful. A memorizer set on one prohibition.
cmp:1dsly6y07e2vta.relation: Same ruling: the sanctity of life, in commandments and in character.

cmp:0xusxa70xo6lzh.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same prohibition (with 25:68).

cmp:1b7hedw0da0f9g.why: What your Lord has forbidden: indecencies open and hidden, and associating partners. Two lists of prohibitions that overlap and differ, worth reading together.
cmp:1b7hedw0da0f9g.relation: Same theme: the core prohibitions, listed twice.

cmp:0xwkg26107yb4e.why: Do not approach the orphan's wealth except in the best way until he reaches maturity, then fulfil: the measure and the covenant, or the covenant alone. The same commandment in two lists, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0xwkg26107yb4e.relation: Same commandment: guarding the orphan's wealth, joined to keeping one's word.

cmp:0t9v4vg0phaixu.why: Are they waiting for nothing but the angels to come to them, or your Lord, or His command? Two threats with the same opening and different continuations.
cmp:0t9v4vg0phaixu.relation: Same theme: the deniers wait until it is too late for faith to help.

cmp:0ozoq3c0en5s8e.why: Whoever brings a good deed will have: ten like it, or better than it. Three places with different completions, and the evil deed is treated differently in each. A key memorizer set.
cmp:0ozoq3c0en5s8e.relation: Same theme: the generosity of the reward against the justice of the penalty.

cmp:0i6ea1f0euadzr.why: No bearer of burdens bears another's burden, then to your Lord is your return and He will inform you of what you...: differed about, or did. A long shared run with a different tail.
cmp:0i6ea1f0euadzr.relation: Same theme: individual responsibility and the final reckoning.

cmp:1pxet5i09ovf8y.why: Each soul earns or strays only against itself, and no bearer of burdens bears another's burden: in 6:164 and 17:15, followed by the return to God or by no punishment until a messenger is sent.
cmp:1pxet5i09ovf8y.relation: Same theme: personal responsibility, and God's justice in warning before punishing.

cmp:1kpbreg10yeaqm.why: Whoever's scales are heavy, those are the successful: word for word in two surahs, each followed by the light scales. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1kpbreg10yeaqm.relation: Same scene: the weighing of deeds.

cmp:0vjiyd30rc7v0z.why: Whoever's scales are light, those are the ones who lost themselves: then because they wronged Our signs, or abiding in Hell. A memorizer pair whose tails differ.
cmp:0vjiyd30rc7v0z.relation: Same scene: the loss of those whose scales are light.

cmp:0m5txbv1lqkrld.why: I am better than him: You created me from fire and him from clay. Iblis's answer in two tellings of the story, with different lead-ins and replies. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0m5txbv1lqkrld.relation: Same story: the pride of Iblis.

cmp:09hkg8q1szxnjq.why: Get out of it: disgraced and expelled, or for you are accursed, in three tellings of Iblis's story. The last two are identical, the next ayat differ (the curse or My curse). A memorizer set.
cmp:09hkg8q1szxnjq.relation: Same story: the expulsion of Iblis.

cmp:126fyq10kp2mgd.why: Their nakedness became visible to them and they began to cover themselves with leaves of the Garden: in two tellings of Adam's slip, with different lead-ins and endings. A memorizer pair.
cmp:126fyq10kp2mgd.relation: Same story: Adam and his wife after eating from the tree.

cmp:1od2b490r60mad.why: Do you say about God what you do not know? Once against those who claim God ordered indecency, once against those who say He took a son. The same rebuke to two false attributions.
cmp:1od2b490r60mad.relation: Same theme: speaking about God without knowledge.

cmp:1oh1p4a1e05fv2.why: When their term comes they cannot delay it an hour nor advance it: for every nation, and for all people despite their wrong. A memorizer pair, with a spelling difference in the verb.
cmp:1oh1p4a1e05fv2.relation: Same theme: the fixed term of nations and people.

cmp:09keia20bbtbbs.why: Where are those you used to call on besides God? They say: they have left us, then they testify against themselves, or they claim they called on nothing. A memorizer pair on one scene.
cmp:09keia20bbtbbs.relation: Same scene: the idolaters abandoned by their idols.

cmp:00qfnr20xzfo7i.why: Those who bar from God's way and seek to make it crooked: twice with the same tail differing by one pronoun, once with a different lead-in and tail. A memorizer set.
cmp:00qfnr20xzfo7i.relation: Same theme: those who block God's way and deny the Hereafter.

cmp:1hyz49p08s51hb.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same closing (with 6:24).

cmp:0exqjdv07qm29b.why: Created the heavens and the earth in six days, then rose over the Throne: five places with different lead-ins (your Lord is God, God, He) and different continuations. A classic memorizer tree.
cmp:0exqjdv07qm29b.relation: Same theme: creation and God's rule over it, each place adding an attribute.

cmp:0jjhjgf0w5dt03.why: A repeat: these three ayat are in the five-row card of the same phrase.

cmp:14zhjgh1d264bl.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the five-row card of the same phrase, where their different continuations are shown.

cmp:0519wj21rd8tmy.why: A near repeat of the five-row card of creation in six days and rising over the Throne; only 11:7 is new, and there the phrase goes on differently (His Throne was on the water).

check.why: Three rows are in the kept five-row card on the same phrase, and 11:7 appears in kept tree cards on creation in six days. Truly adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:0ac0xm60c21goy.why: Do not cause corruption in the land after it has been set right: God's own command and Shuaib's call to his people, in one surah. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0ac0xm60c21goy.relation: Same command: from God directly and through a prophet.

cmp:16to6fb0mwgrlx.why: He sends the winds as good news before His mercy: once leading to rain and the image of resurrection, once in the questions of who else does this. A memorizer pair.
cmp:16to6fb0mwgrlx.relation: Same sign: the winds that herald rain, as proof of resurrection and of oneness.

cmp:1v0guxz1wi7obr.why: My people, worship God, you have no god but Him: the call of Noah, Hud, Salih and Shuaib in two surahs, each with a different continuation. The most important memorizer set of the prophets' stories.
cmp:1v0guxz1wi7obr.relation: Same message: every prophet called his people to the same oneness.

cmp:0u9b31x0oc6rn1.why: A near copy of the eight-row card of the prophets' call to worship God alone; it only adds 23:32, the unnamed messenger, where the call is given without the vocative. If 23:32 is wanted, this card could replace the other rather than stand beside it.

check.why: The only row it adds over the kept eight-row card is 23:32, and 23:32 is already shown with this call in kept tree cards. So it truly adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:1djpzus1a9nt84.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the card of the prophets' call to worship God alone and in the card of the sending of Noah, which show this pair's differences.

cmp:0xht4480e15pro.why: I fear for you the punishment of a great day: Noah's warning and Hud's warning in two surahs, each followed by the people's mocking reply. A memorizer set with one theme.
cmp:0xht4480e15pro.relation: Same theme: the prophets' compassionate warning, and the same refusal.

cmp:03ytlfn1mz2809.why: We sent Noah to his people: five openings with and without the conjunction, then his call, his warning, his long stay of 950 years, and Noah with Abraham. A memorizer set.
cmp:03ytlfn1mz2809.relation: Same story: the sending of Noah, each place picking up a different part.

cmp:1dehev116dmhtj.why: The chiefs of the people said: to Noah you are in clear error, of Moses he is a skilled sorcerer, to Pharaoh will you leave Moses, of the messenger he is only a man like you. The chiefs' words across stories, a memorizer set.
cmp:1dehev116dmhtj.relation: Same theme: the ruling elite as the first to oppose every prophet.

cmp:1j861tl1bzmobt.why: There is no error in me, or no foolishness, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds: Noah's and Hud's answers six ayat apart, followed by different promises. A sharp memorizer pair.
cmp:1j861tl1bzmobt.relation: Same answer: two prophets reply to insult with the same calm.

cmp:0351rkq1qvvw3q.why: I know from God what you do not know: Noah to his people, and Jacob twice to his sons, once with and once without the emphasis. A memorizer set and a lesson in the prophets' hope from God.
cmp:0351rkq1qvvw3q.relation: Similarity: the prophets' certainty from God, against their people's doubt.

cmp:0hyyhxq13ubls2.why: Do you wonder that a reminder has come to you from your Lord through a man among you to warn you: Noah's and Hud's words six ayat apart with different tails. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0hyyhxq13ubls2.relation: Same answer: the wonder that a human messenger came.

cmp:1akpyer1jmnaet.why: A repeat branch: these three ayat are in the card of the prophets' call to worship God alone, which shows the will you not fear Him branch among the others.

check.why: The branch on will you not fear Him, with 23:32, is kept in a tree card holding these same three calls. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:1qjqt81036vx2z.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the card of the prophets' call, which shows this branch.

cmp:0imrpu50xtz3rt.why: A repeat: these three ayat are in the five-row card of the chiefs' sayings (with 7:75 and 7:88).

cmp:0e8628a04udvia.why: The chiefs who disbelieved, or who were arrogant, among his people said: five scenes from Hud, Salih, Shuaib and Noah. The two descriptions of the chiefs and their words are the memorizer's work.
cmp:0e8628a04udvia.relation: Same theme: the chiefs' arrogance and threats against every prophet and his followers.

check.why: The chiefs of each prophet's people, two descriptions. Keep.

cmp:196i67502a0dt9.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the five-row card of the chiefs' sayings.

cmp:1djpvtd0dv6k3n.why: Remember when He made you successors after...: the people of Noah (to Ad) and Ad (to Thamud), then remember God's favours. Two prophets remind of the same favour and the chain of peoples.
cmp:1djpvtd0dv6k3n.relation: Same theme: each people inherits the land from one destroyed before it.

cmp:0t32qjn1bqokud.why: Bring us what you threaten us with, if you are truthful: the challenge thrown at Hud and at Noah, each with the prophet's different reply. A memorizer set.
cmp:0t32qjn1bqokud.relation: Same theme: the deniers hasten the punishment they deny.

cmp:126ynij0ody4tn.why: Names that you and your fathers have named, for which God sent down no authority: said by Hud, by Joseph in prison, and in an-Najm (53:23), now split into two pairs. One card shows all three.
cmp:126ynij0ody4tn.changes: Added 53:23, which has the same clause and is now in a separate pair with 7:71.
cmp:126ynij0ody4tn.relation: Same argument: idols are only names, with no proof from God.

check.why: Adding 53:23 puts the three uses of the clause on names you have named in one card. Keep with the change.

cmp:1kgs4fh13ep53f.why: A partial card of the names-you-named clause; both ayat belong in the three-row card proposed under the 7:71 and 12:40 pair.

check.why: Fully shown in the three-row card. Drop.

cmp:1cedyxq07v5jie.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the card of the prophets' call to worship God alone, where the clear proof branch is shown.

cmp:1jihauw0pbvn2c.why: Those who were arrogant said: to the believers of Salih, we disbelieve; in the Fire to the weak, did we bar you; and, we are all in it. The arrogant speak in this world and in the next.
cmp:1jihauw0pbvn2c.relation: Contrast: their pride in this life and their excuses in the Fire.

check.why: The arrogant speaking in this world and in the Fire. Keep.

cmp:1s1ehgl1afutct.why: The earthquake seized them and they lay fallen in their homes: Thamud, Midian, and Midian again in al-Ankabut, word for word. A memorizer set.
cmp:1s1ehgl1afutct.relation: Same end: the punishment that struck the peoples of Salih and Shuaib.

cmp:1ut7dni0deleve.why: He turned away from them and said, my people, I conveyed to you the message: Salih and Shuaib after their peoples were destroyed, differing in message or messages and in the closing. 12:84 is Jacob turning from his sons in grief, a different subject.
cmp:1ut7dni0deleve.changes: Removed 12:84, which shares only the opening verb and is about Jacob's grief, not a prophet leaving a destroyed people.
cmp:1ut7dni0deleve.relation: Same scene: the prophet's farewell over his destroyed people.

check.why:
I would keep 12:84. The opening is the same verb and structure, so the rules do not call for removing it, and a reciter can slip from one place to the other. It also carries a real link for pondering: Shuaib asks how he should grieve over a disbelieving people, and Yaqub turns away crying out in grief for Yusuf. Two fathers of their people, turning away in sorrow.
فكيف ءاسى
ياأسفى

cmp:0ygkj160fmd12u.why: Lot to his people: you commit an indecency no one in the worlds did before you, with and without the emphasis, followed by different charges. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0ygkj160fmd12u.relation: Same story: Lot's rebuke of his people.

cmp:0epm4d01ygt6t0.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of Lot's address to his people (with 29:28).

cmp:17odmq01dawskm.why: And Lot, when he said to his people: three tellings of his rebuke, with a question or an emphatic statement and different tails (no one did it before you, while you see). A key memorizer set.
cmp:17odmq01dawskm.relation: Same story: Lot's rebuke of his people's indecency.

cmp:1tqzob60qhbt40.why: The only answer of his people was that they said: expel them, they keep pure; expel Lot's family; kill or burn him (Abraham); bring God's punishment. Different conjunctions and replies, a memorizer set.
cmp:1tqzob60qhbt40.relation: Same theme: when argument fails, the people answer with threats.

cmp:0xgq4jt1e33vx5.why: Him and his family, except his wife, she was of those who remained behind: once as narration, once as the angels' promise to Abraham. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0xgq4jt1e33vx5.relation: Same story: Lot saved, his wife lost.

cmp:01s3a7a0j87msy.why: We sent no prophet or warner to a town but...: We seized its people with hardship, or its affluent said we reject it. Two outcomes of the same sending.
cmp:01s3a7a0j87msy.relation: Same theme: the testing of towns and the refusal of their wealthy.

cmp:0f6injg1itp8n4.why: Do the people of the towns feel safe that Our punishment will come to them: at night while they sleep, in the morning while they play. Consecutive ayat that differ by the conjunction and the time.
cmp:0f6injg1itp8n4.relation: Same warning: punishment can come at any hour, in sleep or in play.

cmp:03md5rh04jq9nt.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of then after them We sent (with 10:74).

cmp:19etm031m2cjut.why: Then after them We sent: Moses with Our signs, messengers to their peoples, Moses and Aaron. Word order differs between 7:103 and 10:75, a memorizer trap.
cmp:19etm031m2cjut.relation: Same theme: the succession of messengers and the refusal of their peoples.

cmp:13wbkxy1mmm6ss.why: To say nothing about God but the truth: Moses declares it his duty, and the later generation broke the covenant that bound them to it. The same words, kept and broken, in one surah.
cmp:13wbkxy1mmm6ss.relation: Contrast: Moses holds to the truth about God; the heirs of the Book trade it for gain.

cmp:0x5sr9t06483xd.why: The magicians' declaration, the Lord of Moses and Aaron, word for word in two tellings, followed by Pharaoh's threat in different words. A memorizer pair in the same story.
cmp:0x5sr9t06483xd.relation: Same story: the magicians' faith and Pharaoh's reply.

cmp:0ux6dmp1bwjlrv.why: Call on your Lord for us by the covenant He made with you: Pharaoh's people ask Moses twice, once by name with a promise to believe, once calling him sorcerer. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0ux6dmp1bwjlrv.relation: Same story: Pharaoh's people beg Moses for relief, then break their word.

cmp:0kgl0u309d6ucb.why: Because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them: the cause of Pharaoh's drowning and of the arrogant being turned from the signs, ten ayat apart. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0kgl0u309d6ucb.relation: Same cause: denial and heedlessness lead to ruin.

cmp:0kfq3uc0fdzjhq.why: We took the Children of Israel across the sea: then they came to idol worshippers and asked for a god, or Pharaoh pursued them and drowned. Two continuations of the crossing.
cmp:0kfq3uc0fdzjhq.relation: Same event: the crossing, followed by Israel's lapse and Pharaoh's late faith.

cmp:1f67uwb1162pdh.why: Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do? Closing the voiding of the deniers' deeds and the chains on the deniers in the Fire. A rare exact clause on one theme.

cmp:0po84zy079alzi.why: Moses returned to his people angry and grieved, he said: two tellings of the golden calf, with different conjunctions and different words of rebuke. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0po84zy079alzi.relation: Same story: Moses' return to find the calf.

cmp:16kb1we1xnw1k4.why: He said, my Lord, forgive me: Moses then asks mercy for his brother, Solomon then asks for a kingdom. Two prophets open their request with forgiveness.
cmp:16kb1we1xnw1k4.relation: Similarity: prophets ask forgiveness before they ask for anything.

cmp:1vdppud1kbhmh3.why: Your Lord after that is Forgiving and Merciful: closing three ayat about those who repent after evil or after being persecuted. A memorizer set with one promise.
cmp:1vdppud1kbhmh3.relation: Same theme: repentance after sin is met with forgiveness.

cmp:0ugxt751k2mwjf.why: Say, O mankind: four declarations of the Prophet to all people (I am God's messenger to you all, if you doubt my religion, the truth has come, I am only a warner). A memorizer set.
cmp:0ugxt751k2mwjf.relation: Same theme: the Prophet's universal address.

cmp:1qpcmoc1tww7cg.why: There is no god but He, He gives life and causes death: then believe in God and His Messenger, or your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1qpcmoc1tww7cg.relation: Same theme: the giver of life and death is the only God.

cmp:1r3vly600k8gli.why: Then after them came a later generation who...: inherited the Book and took cheap gains, or neglected prayer and followed desires. The same decline in two descriptions.
cmp:1r3vly600k8gli.relation: Same theme: later generations who lose what their fathers held.

cmp:169os8v03cmoel.why: I give them respite; My plan is firm: the same ayah word for word in two surahs. A memorizer pair.
cmp:169os8v03cmoel.relation: Same theme: God's respite to the deniers is part of His plan.

cmp:14m70ln1y3nv6n.why: There is no madness in your companion, he is only a warner: once in the third person with clear, once in the second person with before a severe punishment. A memorizer pair.
cmp:14m70ln1y3nv6n.relation: Same theme: the Prophet defended as sane, a warner.

cmp:1abev6i0lnzj5u.why: Whom God sends astray: then no guide for him, or no protector after Him. A memorizer pair, but the phrase occurs in more places (for example 13:33, 39:23, 40:33) that this card does not hold.
cmp:1abev6i0lnzj5u.relation: Same theme: no one can guide whom God leaves to stray.

check.why: Whom God sends astray, with two continuations. Keep.

cmp:0egyo291j640vz.why: They ask you about the Hour, when will it arrive: once with a long answer that only God knows it, once followed by the question what have you to do with mentioning it. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0egyo291j640vz.relation: Same question about the Hour, answered by deferring to God.

cmp:1lxno7y0i9th5w.why: If you call them to guidance: they will not follow you, they will not hear. Two descriptions of the idols five ayat apart. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1lxno7y0i9th5w.relation: Same theme: the idols cannot respond to anything.

cmp:0t1jvdh09cwdmb.why: Those you call upon besides God: are servants like you, and could not create a fly even together. Two arguments against the idols with the same subject.
cmp:0t1jvdh09cwdmb.relation: Same theme: the helplessness of what is worshipped besides God.

cmp:0h210sr1owtrjj.why: Those whose hearts tremble when God is mentioned: then faith grows when His signs are recited, or patience, prayer and spending. Two descriptions of the believers with the same opening.
cmp:0h210sr1owtrjj.relation: Same theme: the marks of true believers.

cmp:1naosgn06gts2v.why: The believers are only those who: tremble at God's mention, do not leave the Prophet without permission, believe without doubt and strive. Three definitions of the true believer.
cmp:1naosgn06gts2v.relation: Same theme: what makes a believer, from the heart to conduct.

cmp:1qbalg61kov140.why: Those are the believers in truth; for them...: ranks with their Lord, forgiveness and noble provision, or forgiveness and noble provision. A memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp:1qbalg61kov140.relation: Same verdict: true believers, defined by worship and by emigration and striving.

cmp:05sae3l04i186h.why: O you who believe, when you meet: the deniers in battle, do not turn your backs; a force, stand firm and remember God. Two battle commands in one surah.
cmp:05sae3l04i186h.relation: Same theme: conduct when facing the enemy.

cmp:1ufpxm903mwumn.why: The worst of creatures in God's sight: the deaf and dumb who do not reason, those who disbelieve and will not believe. A memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp:1ufpxm903mwumn.relation: Same verdict on those who refuse to hear and believe.

cmp:1qo72320xbebds.why: When Our clear signs are recited to them: six replies of the deniers (we could say the like, which party is better, rage, he only wants to bar you, bring back our fathers, it is magic). A classic memorizer set.
cmp:1qo72320xbebds.relation: Same theme: the deniers' excuses for rejecting the recited signs.

cmp:04t1jgc058e0hw.why: For the Messenger, the near relatives, the orphans, the needy and the traveller: the shares of the spoils of war and of the spoils taken without fighting. A memorizer pair with one ruling.
cmp:04t1jgc058e0hw.relation: Same ruling: the shares of public wealth.

cmp:02k66sg0l6ly8i.why: When the hypocrites and those with sickness in their hearts said: at Badr, their religion deluded them; at the trench, God's promise was a delusion. Two battles, one slander.
cmp:02k66sg0l6ly8i.relation: Same theme: the hypocrites call faith a delusion in times of danger.

cmp:1nq4hhu16qimcs.why: If there are among you...: twenty who overcome two hundred, then lightened to a hundred who overcome two hundred. Consecutive ayat with the numbers to keep apart.
cmp:1nq4hhu16qimcs.relation: Same ruling: the ratio in battle, then its easing.

cmp:1r5k0q305599i3.why: O Prophet, say to your wives: twice in al-Ahzab, the choice between the world and God and the command to draw their cloaks. 8:70, say to the captives, shares only the call and has a different subject.
cmp:1r5k0q305599i3.changes: Removed 8:70, which is about captives; the card keeps the two commands about the Prophet's wives.
cmp:1r5k0q305599i3.relation: Same subject: instructions to the Prophet's household.

cmp:03w9pbj18kkwgd.why: Those who believed, emigrated and strove, and those who sheltered and helped: their bond with each other, and they are the true believers. Two ayat of one passage with different tails.
cmp:03w9pbj18kkwgd.relation: Same subject: the Emigrants and the Helpers.

cmp:1uazzar19n91eb.why: Strove with their wealth and their selves in the way of God: in the description of the Emigrants and in the definition of the true believers. A shared clause naming the same act.
cmp:1uazzar19n91eb.relation: Same theme: striving with wealth and self as the proof of faith.

cmp:0v74gez1q1apz5.why: Those who believed, emigrated and strove in the way of God: then the true believers, or greater in rank, the winners. A memorizer pair across two adjacent surahs.
cmp:0v74gez1q1apz5.relation: Same subject: the reward of the Emigrants who strove.

cmp:1bkead70moodv3.why: Blood relatives are closer to one another in the Book of God: the same ruling on inheritance in two surahs, with different surroundings.
cmp:1bkead70moodv3.relation: Same ruling: kinship takes precedence over the brotherhood bond in inheritance.

cmp:0i6xq5b0rmyns7.why: Only the stock closing that God does not guide the wrongdoing people is shared. One compares serving the pilgrims with faith and striving, the other is the parable of the donkey carrying books; different subjects.

cmp:1es6l3h0om8x05.why: Abiding therein forever: two short ayat that open alike, one about the great reward with God, one about the deniers who find no protector. The same words describe opposite eternities.
cmp:1es6l3h0om8x05.relation: Contrast: eternity in reward and eternity in punishment, in the same words.

check.why: The same words for eternal reward and eternal punishment; a clear contrast. Keep.

cmp:157fzma00lcsli.why: Only the short opening, say if there is, is shared. One weighs family and wealth against God, the other refutes that the Merciful has a son; different subjects.

cmp:05hwyi31swz2dp.why: God sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and the believers: at Hunayn after the rout, and at al-Hudaybiyah against the deniers' zealotry. A memorizer pair on one gift.
cmp:05hwyi31swz2dp.relation: Same theme: tranquillity sent in two moments of crisis.

cmp:1uzd3lm1osqcoy.why: He sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to make it prevail over all religion: three times, twice closing with though the polytheists dislike it and once with God suffices as witness. A key memorizer set.
cmp:1uzd3lm1osqcoy.relation: Same promise: the victory of the religion of truth.

cmp:1h4ztkg0lbe348.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the three-row card of the same sentence (with 48:28), which also shows the one different ending.

cmp:1hynoep1lnmrkl.why: Only the call to the believers and an emphatic particle are shared. One is about rabbis and monks devouring wealth, the other about spouses and children who are enemies; unrelated subjects.

cmp:039kwgq0825w5m.why: The life of this world compared with the Hereafter is only...: a little enjoyment, or an enjoyment. A memorizer pair that differs in the ending and in the lead-in.
cmp:039kwgq0825w5m.relation: Same theme: the worldly life weighed against the Hereafter.

cmp:0e04njf0v5m3x3.why: Striving with your wealth and selves in the way of God, that is better for you if you knew: 9:41 and 61:11 share the whole clause. 29:16 (Abraham's call) and 62:9 (the Friday prayer) share only the closing, that is better for you if you knew, a stock phrase with other subjects.
cmp:0e04njf0v5m3x3.changes: Kept only 9:41 and 61:11, which share the command to strive with wealth and selves; removed 29:16 and 62:9, which share only the closing.
cmp:0e04njf0v5m3x3.relation: Same theme: striving with wealth and self as the better trade.

check.why: I would keep all four rows. The shared words form an exact five-word closing refrain, and the question for a memorizer is which commands end with it. The same agent kept refrain cards with varied subjects (cmp:1pqhnmz1ygfrhx, cmp:0tk6j321jy006g), so cutting 29:16 and 62:9 here is inconsistent. Removal is also not called for, since the words and structure are the same.

cmp:1b3bqnn16skglz.why: Whoever opposes, or disobeys, God and His Messenger, for him is the fire of Hell abiding: alone with the great disgrace, or forever in plural. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1b3bqnn16skglz.relation: Same theme: opposing God and His Messenger ends in Hell.

cmp:0fhb9da04yfvsq.why: God would not wrong them, but they wronged themselves: closing three accounts of destroyed peoples with different lead-ins. A memorizer set with one lesson.
cmp:0fhb9da04yfvsq.relation: Same theme: the destroyed peoples were not wronged by God.

cmp:1hxit0f16mqqa1.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same closing (with 29:40).

cmp:1rs1a121rzztwo.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the large gardens card, where their tails are shown with the others.

check.why: Both rows are in the kept 19-row gardens card. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:16yvqmn0yeetwr.why: O Prophet, strive against the deniers and the hypocrites and be firm with them: the same ayah word for word in two surahs, each followed by a different passage. A memorizer pair.
cmp:16yvqmn0yeetwr.relation: Same command in two contexts: the hypocrites' oath and the wives of Noah and Lot.

check.why: An identical ayah in two surahs. Keep.

cmp:1ggr69w14s84cy.why: Do they not know that God...: knows their secrets and private talk, and accepts repentance and takes charities. Two places in one surah, one a warning to the hypocrites, one hope for the repentant.
cmp:1ggr69w14s84cy.relation: Contrast: God's knowledge exposes the hypocrites and His mercy receives the repentant.

cmp:0zjj0n11mht4y7.why: Their hearts were sealed, so they do not understand: said of those content to stay behind and of the hypocrites who believed then disbelieved. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0zjj0n11mht4y7.relation: Same theme: hypocrisy seals the heart.

cmp:0frsor11puh2zx.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the large gardens card and in the great-triumph card, which show their tails.

cmp:1mq446208ak8i6.why: A repeat: only the gardens formula is shared, and both ayat are in the large gardens card.

cmp:0kgtci81fnjpm8.why: The blame is only on those who...: the rich who ask leave to stay behind, and those who oppress people. In both passages the ayah before says there is no blame on others (the doers of good, those who defend themselves).
cmp:0kgtci81fnjpm8.relation: Same theme: where blame truly falls, after naming who is free of it.

cmp:05eju8606bv6wy.why: You will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the seen and He will inform you of what you did: closing three ayat with different lead-ins (then you will be returned, and you will be returned). A memorizer set.
cmp:05eju8606bv6wy.relation: Same theme: the return to God who knows all.

cmp:0obaiwf0i9pbvb.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same closing (with 9:105).

cmp:0l7coje19cxpw0.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the great-triumph card of the gardens promise, which shows 9:100 without the preposition.

check.why: Both rows are in the kept 19-row gardens card. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:0pbdq0e0th3hlo.why: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth, He gives life and causes death: then you have no protector besides God, or He is able over all things. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0pbdq0e0th3hlo.relation: Same theme: the master of life and death is the only protector.

cmp:12r7bim0o7pfya.why: God does not let the reward of the doers of good be lost: for the strivers, for the patient Prophet, and in Joseph's words to his brothers. Different lead-ins, a memorizer set.
cmp:12r7bim0o7pfya.relation: Same theme: patience and piety are never wasted.

cmp:0mw2us60qnhgp2.why: Whenever a sura is sent down: some ask whose faith it increased, others look at each other and slip away. Two reactions three ayat apart.
cmp:0mw2us60qnhgp2.relation: Contrast: revelation increases the believers in faith and the hypocrites in flight.

cmp:1rnxt1c1v468ke.why: There is no god but He, in Him I trust: then He is Lord of the great Throne, or to Him is my return. A memorizer pair at the close of two passages.
cmp:1rnxt1c1v468ke.relation: Same stance: the Prophet's reliance on God when people turn away.

cmp:135w81b1fn6hmd.why: God, there is no god but He, Lord of the great Throne: once inside the Prophet's words of reliance, once as the hoopoe's declaration to Solomon. A memorizer pair.
cmp:135w81b1fn6hmd.relation: Same declaration of oneness, from the Prophet and from a bird.

cmp:177yfqd13fpivl.why: If they turn away, say: God suffices me, or I have warned you all equally. Two answers of the Prophet to people turning away, near the end of two surahs.
cmp:177yfqd13fpivl.relation: Same situation: the Prophet's last word to those who turn away, reliance and fair warning.

check.why: The Prophet's two answers to those who turn away. Keep.

cmp:132y1rg1mijdxu.why: It is He who made: the sun a light and the moon a radiance, the night for rest, the earth subservient. Three signs of God's design, without the conjunction (the set with it is a separate card).
cmp:132y1rg1mijdxu.relation: Same theme: the heavens, time and the earth made for people.

cmp:18rha7s0tswvhs.why: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter, or do not hope to meet Us: they are content with this life, deviate from the path, see their deeds made fair, name the angels female. 16:104 is about those who do not believe in God's signs, a different object.
cmp:18rha7s0tswvhs.changes: Removed 16:104, whose object is God's signs, not the Hereafter; the card keeps the deniers of the meeting and the Hereafter.
cmp:18rha7s0tswvhs.relation: Same theme: what denying the Hereafter does to a person.

check.why: I would keep 16:104. The frame those who do not believe in is the same words and structure; only the object changes, from the Hereafter to God's signs. A reciter can slip on exactly that word. The theme is still the fate of the deniers, so this is not two different groups, and removal is not clearly called for.

cmp:03se41y12f5chi.why: When harm touches man he calls on Us, then when We relieve him or grant him a favour he forgets or claims credit. Three tellings with different conjunctions and endings, a classic memorizer set.
cmp:03se41y12f5chi.relation: Same theme: man's prayer in hardship and ingratitude in ease.

cmp:1ct1xww1yazm92.why: They worship besides God what...: neither harms nor benefits them, owns no provision for them, has no authority from God, neither benefits nor harms them. The order of harm and benefit is the memorizer's trap.
cmp:1ct1xww1yazm92.relation: Same argument: what is worshipped besides God is powerless.

cmp:198ftlf0p09cxl.why: A repeat: these three ayat are in the four-row card of the same phrase (with 22:71).

cmp:12ay4cu16wfmak.why: Had it not been for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them: three times, twice word for word about Moses' Book, once about mankind's first division. A memorizer set.
cmp:12ay4cu16wfmak.relation: Same theme: God's decree delays judgment on human differences.

cmp:0df9cta1ofw6p0.why: Why has not a sign been sent down to him from his Lord: the deniers' demand three times with different answers (the unseen is God's, you are only a warner, God guides who turns to Him). The same family also includes 6:37 and 29:50, proposed together under the 6:37 and 13:27 pair.
cmp:0df9cta1ofw6p0.relation: Same theme: the demand for a miracle and the answers to it.

cmp:100x2go10xz4uq.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the demand for a sign (with 13:7).

check.why: Fully shown in the merged card of the demand for a sign. Drop.

cmp:17lug2m12tvcmg.why: A partial copy of the demand-for-a-sign family; its ayat are in the three-row card of the same demand and the proposed five-row card.

check.why: A partial copy of the demand-for-a-sign family, all inside the merged card. Drop.

cmp:0ilzepk0r56biy.why: A partial copy of the demand-for-a-sign family; its ayat are in the three-row card of the same demand and the proposed five-row card.

check.why: A partial copy of the demand-for-a-sign family, all inside the merged card. Drop.

cmp:0kobasl02uxcnj.why: When We let people taste mercy: they plot against Our signs, or they rejoice and then despair when harm comes. Two reactions to mercy, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0kobasl02uxcnj.relation: Same theme: people's fickleness between mercy and hardship.

cmp:1y2e5bi1rtdbk2.why: The parable of worldly life is like water We sent down from the sky, mixed with the earth's plants: once long with the adorned earth, once short with chaff scattered by the winds. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1y2e5bi1rtdbk2.relation: Same parable: the brief bloom of worldly life.

cmp:1o9738b1uskb1j.why: He brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living: once as a question to the deniers, once as a statement leading to resurrection. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1o9738b1uskb1j.relation: Same sign: life from death, as proof of God and of resurrection.

cmp:17wdwi715t95yb.why: Say, is there any of your partners who...: begins creation then repeats it, guides to the truth. Consecutive questions with the answer that God alone does it.
cmp:17wdwi715t95yb.relation: Same argument: creation and guidance belong only to God.

cmp:05dvacw0gghldw.why: Conjecture avails nothing against the truth: after most of them follow only conjecture, and after they have no knowledge of the angels. A memorizer pair.
cmp:05dvacw0gghldw.relation: Same theme: guessing cannot replace knowledge of the truth.

cmp:1fap4qu11swl3o.why: The Book, no doubt in it, from the Lord of the worlds: after the detailing of the Book and after the sending down of the Book, each followed by or do they say he invented it. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1fap4qu11swl3o.relation: Same claim: the Quran is from the Lord of the worlds, against the charge of forgery.

cmp:1yuk0cr0d33nvn.why: Not invented, but a confirmation of what came before and a detailing of...: the Book, or everything. Said of the Quran and of the stories of the prophets. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1yuk0cr0d33nvn.relation: Same theme: revelation confirms the past and explains all things.

cmp:189q68q09824na.why: Or do they say he invented it? Five places, each with a different reply: bring one sura like it, bring ten suras, if I invented it my crime is on me, it is the truth from your Lord, you cannot help me against God. A classic memorizer set.
cmp:189q68q09824na.relation: Same charge of forgery, with the challenge and the Prophet's answers.

cmp:01cgngv0876s5z.why: Whether We show you some of what We promise them or take you to Us, to Us is their return: two endings (God is witness, they will be returned). A memorizer pair.
cmp:01cgngv0876s5z.relation: Same theme: the outcome is God's, whether the Prophet sees it or not.

cmp:1hf4voz0k219pb.why: It will be judged between them with justice and they will not be wronged: closing two ayat of one surah, after the messenger comes to a nation and after the wrongdoers wish to ransom themselves. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1hf4voz0k219pb.relation: Same theme: judgment with justice, in this world and the next.

cmp:15zqjlw0m17uzu.why: They say, when is this promise, if you are truthful: the same ayah in six surahs, each followed by a different answer. The memorizer must know what comes after each.
cmp:15zqjlw0m17uzu.relation: Same mockery of the promised Day, answered six ways.

cmp:0kc7wik1ilteqq.why: When their term comes they cannot delay it an hour nor bring it forward: with and without the conjunction, after different lead-ins. Together with 7:34 it is a three-place memorizer family.
cmp:0kc7wik1ilteqq.relation: Same theme: the fixed term that no one can move.

cmp:1rz0c4s096i7l6.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same opening (with 10:66) and in the card with 4:170.

cmp:0txiyea0gir41y.why: God's promise is true, but most of them do not know: as a general statement and in the return of Moses to his mother, where the promise was seen fulfilled. A memorizer pair with a lesson.
cmp:0txiyea0gir41y.relation: Similarity: the promise to Moses' mother is a small proof of God's promise in general.

check.why: The general promise and its small proof in Moses' return to his mother. Keep.

cmp:1q724g51va29zb.why: Indeed to God belongs what, or who, is in the heavens and the earth: three places in which the relative and the continuation differ. A memorizer set.
cmp:1q724g51va29zb.relation: Same theme: God owns all things and all beings, so His promise and knowledge are sure.

cmp:1pvpwjp0hpaufx.why: Only the short opening, say have you considered what, is shared. One is about making lawful and unlawful from provision, the other about what the idols created; different subjects.

cmp:1lf1jay1doqtyq.why: He is full of favour to people, but most of them do not give thanks: once after those who lie about God, once about your Lord. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1lf1jay1doqtyq.relation: Same theme: God's generosity and people's ingratitude.

cmp:0ilbzg11bc8995.why: Not an atom's weight escapes Him in the earth or the heaven, nor anything smaller or bigger, but it is in a clear Book: the order of earth and heaven is reversed in 34:3. A known memorizer pair.
cmp:0ilbzg11bc8995.relation: Same theme: God's complete knowledge, recorded.

cmp:17g22li0da0fsm.why: When the trumpet is blown, whoever is in the heavens and the earth is terrified (27:87) or falls dead (39:68), except whom God wills: a strong memorizer pair. 10:66 (ownership) and 22:18 (prostration) share only the phrase for everyone in heaven and earth.
cmp:17g22li0da0fsm.changes: Kept only the two trumpet ayat; removed 10:66 and 22:18, where the shared words are a common phrase with other subjects.
cmp:17g22li0da0fsm.relation: Same scene: the blowing of the trumpet.

check.why: Everyone in the heavens and the earth is a common noun phrase. The real card is the trumpet pair, so the group really is two different things. Agree with keeping only 27:87 and 39:68.

cmp:03k5oky12dd3e4.why: He made the night for you to rest in and the day for seeing: then signs for people who hear, or God is full of favour to people. A memorizer pair.
cmp:03k5oky12dd3e4.relation: Same sign: night and day, for reflection and for gratitude.

cmp:14i11sr1v630ed.why: The night to rest in and the day for seeing, signs for a people who hear, or who believe. A memorizer pair that differs in its opening and its last word.
cmp:14i11sr1v630ed.relation: Same sign: night and day as proof for those who listen and believe.

cmp:0sd7t6r0miwynx.why: Those who invent lies against God will not succeed: the same sentence twice, followed by brief enjoyment then punishment. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0sd7t6r0miwynx.relation: Same theme: lying about God brings only short gain.

cmp:0dr6e801womazq.why: I ask no reward from you, my reward is only from God, or from the Lord of the worlds: Noah in Yunus and five prophets in ash-Shuara. A memorizer set.
cmp:0dr6e801womazq.relation: Same stance: every prophet served without payment.

cmp:1w269wh01h68mh.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of when the truth came to them (with 43:30).

cmp:1px0hk705ak8ql.why: When the truth came to them they said: this is clear magic, why was he not given what Moses was given, this is magic and we reject it. A memorizer set with different conjunctions.
cmp:1px0hk705ak8ql.relation: Same theme: truth met with the charge of magic.

cmp:1fkee0c0qf38fk.why: Moses said to them, throw what you will throw: in two tellings of the contest, each followed by a different next ayah. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1fkee0c0qf38fk.relation: Same story: Moses and the sorcerers.

check.why: Moses to the sorcerers in two tellings. Keep.

cmp:10zcxuv0f9kgud.why: When the sorcerers came: Moses tells them to throw, or they ask Pharaoh for a reward. Two tellings of the same moment.
cmp:10zcxuv0f9kgud.relation: Same story: the arrival of the sorcerers, seen from Moses and from Pharaoh.

cmp:1mykh871rbexzn.why: Had your Lord willed: all on earth would have believed, or He would have made mankind one community. Two statements on why people differ.
cmp:1mykh871rbexzn.relation: Same theme: faith cannot be forced, and difference is part of God's plan.

cmp:1d8kxab1ufv3a3.why: Calling on, or worshipping, besides God what neither benefits nor harms you: a command to the Prophet and Abraham's question to his people. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1d8kxab1ufv3a3.relation: Same argument against idols, in a command and in a question.

cmp:1l8g4gs1670e3y.why: Whoever is guided is guided for himself, and whoever strays...: three places, and 39:41 has the same sentence in a shorter form and sits in a separate card with two of them. One card shows all four.
cmp:1l8g4gs1670e3y.changes: Added 39:41, which carries the same sentence and is now in a separate partial card.
cmp:1l8g4gs1670e3y.relation: Same theme: guidance and error fall on the one who chooses them.

check.why: Adding 39:41 completes the guided-for-himself family. Keep with the change.

cmp:11beqlj1k07uid.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the card of whoever is guided is guided for himself.

cmp:0eurgyg1h7xkck.why: A partial copy of the guided-for-himself family; its ayat belong in the four-row card proposed with 27:92.

check.why: A partial copy of the same family, fully shown in the four-row card. Drop.

cmp:00xw7oj0gnfpt3.why: Follow what is revealed to you: then be patient until God judges, or from your Lord, God is aware of what you do. A memorizer pair, the closing command of Yunus and an opening command of al-Ahzab.
cmp:00xw7oj0gnfpt3.relation: Same command: hold to revelation and leave the outcome to God.

cmp:0c9jzwl0m536tr.why: He knows what they conceal and what they declare: then He knows what is in the breasts, or He does not love the arrogant. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0c9jzwl0m536tr.relation: Same theme: nothing is hidden from God, neither secret thoughts nor arrogance.

cmp:1vzcn4y19y8uby.why: He created the heavens and the earth in six days, with and without the conjunction: then His Throne was on the water to test you, or He rose over the Throne and knows all. 11:7 is not in the five-row card of the rising over the Throne, so this pair shows its difference.
cmp:1vzcn4y19y8uby.relation: Same theme: creation in six days, as a test for people and as a sign of God's knowledge.

cmp:1yigxpf1joc7rn.why: What they used to mock surrounded them: closing six ayat with different lead-ins (the evil of what they did, or earned, appeared to them). A memorizer set.
cmp:1yigxpf1joc7rn.relation: Same theme: mockery turns into the very punishment that was mocked.

cmp:0x5t0710gn57lz.why: Is the one who stands on clear proof from his Lord...: followed by a witness from Him and Moses' Book, or like the one whose evil deeds are made fair to him. Same question, two answers.
cmp:0x5t0710gn57lz.relation: Contrast: the one on clear proof and the one deceived by his own desires.

cmp:0vi7r691hxactv.why: Before it was the Book of Moses, a guide and a mercy: in 11:17 inside a long question and in 46:12 opening an ayah that presents the Quran as confirming it. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0vi7r691hxactv.relation: Same theme: the Quran stands in line with the Book of Moses.

cmp:0fusrd80xon0da.why: They had no protector, or defender, against God: said of the deniers who cannot escape on earth and of the earlier strong peoples seized for their sins. A short clause with one meaning.
cmp:0fusrd80xon0da.relation: Same theme: no one shields the wrongdoers from God.

check.why: No protector against God for the deniers, the same meaning in both. Thin but real. Keep.

cmp:10nmh301dqyh88.why: Worship none but God, I fear for you the punishment of a day: painful in Noah's words, great in Hud's. A memorizer pair with one call.
cmp:10nmh301dqyh88.relation: Same message from two prophets, differing in one word.

cmp:0ml56yz0pon6x9.why: The chiefs who disbelieved among his people said: we see you only as a man like us, or this is only a man like you. Noah's people in two surahs, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0ml56yz0pon6x9.relation: Same objection: a human cannot be a messenger.

cmp:0pxht0n0vv255f.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the five-row card of or do they say he invented it, which shows all the replies.

cmp:1pp5e6d1ggemxp.why: Build the ark under Our eyes and Our revelation, and do not address Me about the wrongdoers, they will be drowned: in two tellings of Noah's story with different surroundings. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1pp5e6d1ggemxp.relation: Same story: the command to build the ark.

cmp:031gqts1s0s3gy.why: Who will get a disgracing punishment and on whom a lasting punishment will fall: Noah's words to his people and the Prophet's to his. A memorizer pair.
cmp:031gqts1s0s3gy.relation: Same threat from Noah and from the Prophet.

cmp:0nkrd2a193nzmk.why: You will know who gets a disgracing punishment: Noah and Shuaib in one surah, with and without the particle, then different tails (a lasting punishment, and who is a liar). A memorizer pair.
cmp:0nkrd2a193nzmk.relation: Same threat from two prophets in one surah.

cmp:10er07y0fc31iu.why: Only the common opening, until when there came, is shared. One is the flood, the other the death of a wrongdoer; unrelated subjects.

cmp:1j5umyc0j1mw4i.why: When Our command came We saved Hud, Salih, Shuaib and those who believed with him by mercy from Us: three times in one surah, with different conjunctions and endings. A classic memorizer set.
cmp:1j5umyc0j1mw4i.relation: Same pattern: the prophet and the believers saved, the wrongdoers destroyed.

cmp:07p7kv51e7uv39.why: A curse followed them in this world and on the Day of Resurrection: Ad and Pharaoh's people, with different tails. A memorizer pair.
cmp:07p7kv51e7uv39.relation: Same fate for two arrogant peoples.

check.why: A curse in this world and on the Day for two arrogant peoples. Keep.

cmp:1bhecsb0owwb1r.why: As if they had never lived there, away with...: Thamud and Midian, the second compared to the first. A memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp:1bhecsb0owwb1r.relation: Same end of two peoples, one likened to the other.

cmp:11qx25f0a7p911.why: He felt fear of them; they said, do not fear: then we are sent to Lot's people, or they gave him news of a knowing son. A memorizer pair.

cmp:14ga9h60po49cw.why: When Our messengers came: to Lot, who was distressed, and to Abraham with good news and the news of the town's destruction. One mission seen from two houses.
cmp:14ga9h60po49cw.relation: Same story: the angels' visit to Abraham and to Lot.

cmp:0gdn8350sfwfd7.why: Marked by your Lord: the stones on Lot's people, for the wrongdoers or for the transgressors. A short memorizer pair.
cmp:0gdn8350sfwfd7.relation: Same punishment, with two names for those it struck.

cmp:165ho6d1gmtkmd.why: Do not deprive people of their things and do not spread corruption in the land: Shuaib's words in two surahs, one longer. A memorizer pair.
cmp:165ho6d1gmtkmd.relation: Same message of Shuaib about honest trade.

cmp:1ork6vj1dtnvid.why: My people, work according to your position, I am working: Shuaib with the conjunction and the Prophet with say, then different tails. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1ork6vj1dtnvid.relation: Same challenge from Shuaib and from the Prophet.

cmp:1r16dc01x0rxgw.why: We sent Moses with Our signs: four places, two word for word with a clear authority and two with different continuations (bring your people out of darkness, to Pharaoh and his chiefs). A memorizer set.
cmp:1r16dc01x0rxgw.relation: Same story: the sending of Moses with signs.

cmp:0trp1tt1kuoiud.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the four-row card of the sending of Moses with Our signs.

cmp:1msjvxg1vzf5mc.why: To Pharaoh and his chiefs: then they followed Pharaoh's command, or they were arrogant. Two openings alike with different outcomes, a memorizer pair.
cmp:1msjvxg1vzf5mc.relation: Same story: Pharaoh's chiefs reject Moses.

cmp:08bo2l61luqjc0.why: Abiding there as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills: said of the wretched in the Fire and of the happy in the Garden, consecutive ayat with different endings.
cmp:08bo2l61luqjc0.relation: Contrast: the same words describe the eternity of the Fire and of the Garden; the Garden's gift is never cut off.

cmp:0pt0dmh0xujq4b.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the three-row card of the word that preceded from your Lord (with 10:19).

check.why: The identical pair is in the kept three-row card and several kept tree cards. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:16yn4bz1peudvx.why: But for a word that preceded from your Lord it would have been judged between them, and they are in disquieting doubt about it: 42:14 adds to a set term and changes who is in doubt. Not in the three-row card, and a sharp memorizer pair.
cmp:16yn4bz1peudvx.relation: Same theme: division over the Book, and God's decree delaying judgment.

cmp:0uh1efm1wu855a.why: I will fill Hell with jinn and men all together: the word of your Lord fulfilled, and the word from Me came true. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0uh1efm1wu855a.relation: Same decree, after God's choice to leave people free.

cmp:0q1ag0e1b8b1kc.why: Except whom your Lord, or God, has mercy on: the exception from those who differ, and from those whom no ally can help on the Day. A short memorizer pair.
cmp:0q1ag0e1b8b1kc.relation: Same theme: only God's mercy exempts.

check.why: The short exception of God's mercy. Keep. 11:43 has the same exception and could be added later, but that is not needed for this verdict.

cmp:0wzqpaf0ey9mhj.why: To God belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth: then all matters return to Him, or the Hour is like the blink of an eye. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0wzqpaf0ey9mhj.relation: Same theme: God's knowledge of the unseen, of all affairs and of the Hour.

cmp:0w3915v1h68sib.why: We narrate to you: the best of stories (Joseph), and their story in truth (the youths of the cave). Two story openings with the same words.
cmp:0w3915v1h68sib.relation: Same theme: stories told by God as true lessons.

cmp:0qkvesq0c9vz7e.why: My son, or my sons, do not...: Jacob warns Joseph not to tell his dream to his brothers, then his sons not to enter by one gate. Two cautions of one father in one surah.
cmp:0qkvesq0c9vz7e.relation: Same person: Jacob's caution for his children, with trust in God.

cmp:1shbwbl0uta8hr.why: There were in...: Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask, and in their stories a lesson for people of understanding. The opening and the closing of the same surah.
cmp:1shbwbl0uta8hr.relation: Same theme: the story of Joseph as signs and lesson, at its start and its end.

cmp:0cedess0ekwrcs.why: Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will take him as a son: the Egyptian about Joseph, Pharaoh's wife about Moses. Two prophets taken into a foreign house with the same words.
cmp:0cedess0ekwrcs.relation: Similarity: two prophets adopted in the house of power, by God's plan.

cmp:04wzdd70qghka3.why: Both ayat are in the three-row card proposed under the 7:71 and 12:40 pair, which also holds Hud's use of the same clause.

check.why: Fully shown in the three-row card with 7:71. Drop.

cmp:17h7adi0dipeq2.why: That is the right religion, but most people do not know: Joseph's words in prison and the command to turn to the natural religion. A memorizer pair.
cmp:17h7adi0dipeq2.relation: Same theme: pure monotheism is the upright religion.

cmp:0olyfl81siguko.why: Seven fat cows eaten by seven lean, seven green ears and others dry: the king's dream, then the cupbearer repeating it to Joseph. A memorizer pair in one passage.
cmp:0olyfl81siguko.relation: Same story: the king's dream told and retold.

cmp:018h2d81tod9ey.why: Then after that will come: seven hard years, then a year of relief. Consecutive ayat in Joseph's interpretation.
cmp:018h2d81tod9ey.relation: Same story: Joseph's reading of the dream.

cmp:01tgqv61uh54i6.why: The king said, bring him to me: first Joseph refuses until his innocence is shown, then the king takes him for himself. Same words, two stages.
cmp:01tgqv61uh54i6.relation: Same story: Joseph's rise, his honour cleared first.

cmp:02ouhlo1fsnp5y.why: When he had furnished them with their provisions: on the first trip he asks for their brother, on the second he hides the cup. Different conjunctions, a memorizer pair.
cmp:02ouhlo1fsnp5y.relation: Same story: Joseph's two dealings with his brothers.

cmp:0by77ox0nsqxox.why: Of no avail against God: Jacob says his advice cannot help them, and then it did not help them except to fulfil a wish of Jacob. Consecutive ayat.
cmp:0by77ox0nsqxox.relation: Same story: human caution and God's decree.

cmp:0bkybc60rriuiq.why: When they entered upon Joseph he took to himself: his brother, then later his parents. Same words at two reunions.
cmp:0bkybc60rriuiq.relation: Same story: Joseph's two embraces, of his brother and of his parents.

cmp:0et0j490wc4hcp.why: They said, by God, ...: we did not come to cause corruption, and God has preferred you over us. The brothers' oaths at two moments of the story.
cmp:0et0j490wc4hcp.relation: Same speakers: the brothers protesting innocence, then admitting their fault.

cmp:0usjeoq09szu78.why: You ask no reward for it: in Yusuf the Prophet, and then it is only a reminder for the worlds; in ash-Shuara Noah, and then my reward is only from the Lord of the worlds. 12:104 is not in the card of the prophets' refusal of payment, so this pair shows its branch.
cmp:0usjeoq09szu78.relation: Same stance: the message is given freely, as a reminder to all.

cmp:1r3axta1qksm3s.why: A duplicate of the 12:104 and 26:109 pair: 26:127 is word for word the same as 26:109, so this pair adds no new branch.

cmp:16rqqq214t9ycs.why: A duplicate of the 12:104 and 26:109 pair: 26:145 is word for word the same as 26:109, so this pair adds no new branch.

cmp:0pgvzu91w0klhr.why: A duplicate of the 12:104 and 26:109 pair: 26:164 is word for word the same as 26:109, so this pair adds no new branch.

cmp:0i6eqcr00kftxh.why: A duplicate of the 12:104 and 26:109 pair: 26:180 is word for word the same as 26:109, so this pair adds no new branch.

cmp:1bfb2t30r23aaj.why: A repeat: these five ayat are all in the six-row card of the same question, which also holds 40:21.

cmp:06v275a0o0p11m.why: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the end of those before them: six places with two openings (or with the conjunction or with the particle) and different tails (stronger than them, more numerous, God destroyed them). A classic memorizer tree.
cmp:06v275a0o0p11m.relation: Same theme: the ruins of stronger peoples as a warning.

cmp:1ds5zx4128tv0k.why: A repeat branch: these three ayat are in the six-row card of the same question.

cmp:1g1mz4q1ohnvbo.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of We sent before you only men (with 21:7).

cmp:15rogeb0bfew39.why: We sent before you only men to whom We revealed: three places, 21:7 without the preposition before before you, two with the same tail ask the people of the reminder. A classic memorizer set.
cmp:15rogeb0bfew39.relation: Same theme: the messengers were human men.

cmp:1c362zu0mx4k92.why: He subjected the sun and the moon, each running for a set term: three places, each in a different frame (raising the heavens, merging night and day, wrapping night and day). A memorizer set.
cmp:1c362zu0mx4k92.relation: Same sign: the ordered course of the sun and moon.

cmp:17qw3v705bmku1.why: Surely in that are signs for a people who reflect: closing four signs (the spread earth, spouses and love, sleep as a small death, all things subjected). The memorizer must match each sign to the faculty named; reflection is asked of these.
cmp:17qw3v705bmku1.relation: Similarity: the signs that call for reflection.

check.why: A refrain closing four signs; a memorizer set. Keep.

cmp:04j92sw033fnzs.why: Surely in that are signs for a people who reason: closing three signs (gardens watered by one water but different, night, day and stars subjected, lightning and rain). The memorizer must tie each sign to its closing.
cmp:04j92sw033fnzs.relation: Similarity: the signs that call for reasoning.

check.why: A refrain closing three signs. Keep.

cmp:12iz1wk1gtdszg.why: Those who disbelieve say, three times in one surah: why has no sign been sent down (twice), and you are not a messenger. A memorizer set with the answers to each.
cmp:12iz1wk1gtdszg.relation: Same subject: the deniers' objections in ar-Rad, and God's replies.

cmp:03q0s5206580dk.why: Only the short opening, God knows what, is shared. One is about what every womb carries, the other about what you hide and show; a common phrase with different subjects.

cmp:1nhm37t196mdu7.why: Knower of the unseen and the seen, then: the Great, the Exalted; exalted above what they associate; the Mighty, the Wise. Three ayat that open alike and close with different names.
cmp:1nhm37t196mdu7.relation: Same attribute of God, joined each time to another of His names.

cmp:1xppzdq0id6f2s.why: It is He who shows you: lightning in fear and hope, and His signs with provision from the sky. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1xppzdq0id6f2s.relation: Same theme: signs from the sky that bring both fear and provision.

cmp:0cb5kvf1pl3qfd.why: The prayer of the disbelievers is only in error: after the parable of one stretching his hands to water, and in the reply of Hell's keepers. The only two places of this sentence.
cmp:0cb5kvf1pl3qfd.relation: Same theme: prayer to other than God, and prayer too late, are both lost.

cmp:1lf01nc123yqik.why: Say, who is Lord of the heavens...: and the earth, then God; and of the seven heavens and the great Throne. Two forms of the same question.
cmp:1lf01nc123yqik.relation: Same argument: the Lord of the heavens deserves sole worship.

cmp:0gpx2521neqpji.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the ransom of all that is on earth (with 5:36).

cmp:079yfoq182231c.why: Established prayer and spent of what We provided them, secretly and openly: in the description of the people of understanding and of those who recite God's Book. A memorizer pair.
cmp:079yfoq182231c.relation: Same description of the righteous: prayer and spending.

cmp:1iapco41ynxxmw.why: Gardens of Eden with the righteous among their fathers, spouses and offspring: as a description, and in the angels' prayer for the believers. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1iapco41ynxxmw.relation: Same promise: families reunited in the Garden, promised and prayed for.

cmp:129v4510w36iht.why: Gardens of Eden which they will enter: with the righteous of their families, with rivers and all they wish, adorned with gold, pearls and silk. Three openings alike with different descriptions.
cmp:129v4510w36iht.relation: Same promise: three pictures of the gardens of Eden.

cmp:1hpiez70x9h62h.why: God extends provision to whom He wills and restricts it: once with their delight in this world, twice with signs for those who believe, with two different questions (do they not see, do they not know). A memorizer set.
cmp:1hpiez70x9h62h.relation: Same theme: provision is measured by God, a sign for believers.

cmp:1chdxjh05mz5ph.why: God sends astray whom He wills and guides: whoever turns to Him, or whom He wills. A memorizer pair whose last words differ.
cmp:1chdxjh05mz5ph.relation: Same theme: guidance is God's, and turning to Him is the way to it.

cmp:14zn7p715qiqqj.why: Whom God sends astray has no...: guide (four times), protector after Him, or way. A classic memorizer tree with one subject.
cmp:14zn7p715qiqqj.relation: Same theme: no one can rescue whom God leaves to stray.

cmp:0rld9g80r6old2.why: A repeat: these four ayat are in the six-row card of the same phrase, which also shows the other two tails.

cmp:1ufp1sw0ftuwzo.why: The likeness of the Garden promised to the God-fearing: once briefly with rivers, lasting fruit and shade, once with four kinds of rivers. Each ends by setting it against the Fire.
cmp:1ufp1sw0ftuwzo.relation: Contrast: the Garden of the God-fearing set beside the Fire of the deniers.

cmp:1y6nair0kuuuub.why: Have they not seen that We...: reduce the land from its edges, made a safe sanctuary, drive water to dry land, created cattle for them. Four signs with the same opening.
cmp:1y6nair0kuuuub.relation: Same theme: visible signs of God's power and favour.

cmp:0x06rw90eykk1z.why: We come to the land, reducing it from its edges: with have they not seen and the judgment of God, or do they not see and are they the victors. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0x06rw90eykk1z.relation: Same sign: the shrinking of the deniers' land.

cmp:02jj58g0m2phr6.why: Those before them plotted: then all plotting belongs to God, or God came at their building from its foundations. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:02jj58g0m2phr6.relation: Same theme: the plots of the past failed against God.

cmp:0t4a7x0052jr1s.why: Say, God suffices as witness between me and you: answering you are not a messenger, then he who has knowledge of the Book; or He is aware and seeing of His servants. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0t4a7x0052jr1s.relation: Same answer: God as witness for His messenger.

cmp:1vjb5zk1dj6nkq.why: To whom belongs what is in the heavens and the earth: after God, after praise be to God, after the path of God, with different continuations. A memorizer set.
cmp:1vjb5zk1dj6nkq.relation: Same attribute: God's ownership as ground of praise, warning and the return of all matters.

cmp:0ejkjoh19q8g69.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same clause (with 34:1).

cmp:0rb4sup1gut3l5.why: God sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills: after the messenger speaking his people's tongue, and after the number of Hell's keepers as a test. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0rb4sup1gut3l5.relation: Same theme: clear messages and tests both lead some to guidance and some to error.

cmp:01horwm06kan1o.why: Surely in that are signs for every patient, grateful one: closing four signs (God's days with Moses' people, ships at sea, Saba torn apart, the still wind). A rare closing whose places the memorizer must know.
cmp:01horwm06kan1o.relation: Similarity: patience in hardship and gratitude in ease are what these signs teach.

cmp:029n14b004213r.why: The people of Noah, Ad and Thamud and those after them: in the messengers' address and in the believer of Pharaoh's people. Two tails, a memorizer pair.
cmp:029n14b004213r.relation: Same theme: the succession of destroyed peoples as a warning.

cmp:1uu07321styhky.why: Has not the news reached you of those before you: then the named peoples, or those who disbelieved and tasted the result of their deeds. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1uu07321styhky.relation: Same theme: the news of earlier peoples as a lesson.

cmp:0p3ws911t2p707.why: To forgive you of your sins and defer you to a set term: in the messengers' reply to their peoples, and in Noah's call. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0p3ws911t2p707.relation: Same promise: forgiveness and respite for those who answer the call.

cmp:0zm35ue1g8u8b8.why: To bar us, or you, from what our, or your, fathers worshipped: the deniers' charge against the messengers and against the Prophet. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0zm35ue1g8u8b8.relation: Same accusation against all prophets: they turn people from their fathers' ways.

cmp:0itccew0quuiwa.why: Except by God's permission, and upon God let the believers rely: the messengers' reply that they bring no proof except by God's leave, and the secret talk that cannot harm except by His leave. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0itccew0quuiwa.relation: Same theme: nothing happens without God's permission, so trust Him.

cmp:09r7uee0uu1amw.why: If He wills He will remove you and bring a new creation, and that is not hard for God: two ayat repeated together in two surahs, after the creation of the heavens and earth in truth and after man's need of God.
cmp:09r7uee0uu1amw.relation: Same theme: mankind replaceable at God's will.

cmp:0aetti41imhefc.why: A repeat: this short identical ayah is already inside the rows of the 14:19 and 35:16 pair, which shows it with what comes before it.

check.why: This identical short ayah is in kept tree cards together with what precedes it. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:0ozsr1k1meyhos.why: The weak say to the arrogant, we were your followers, can you avail us: in the open gathering before God and in the arguing inside the Fire. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0ozsr1k1meyhos.relation: Same scene: followers blaming their leaders when it is too late.

cmp:11ln1if1vniwz3.why: God admits those who believe and do good into gardens with rivers flowing beneath: three times in the form indeed God admits, once as were admitted, each with a different tail (God does what He wills, bracelets of gold, the deniers eat like cattle). A branch that the large gardens card mostly lacks.
cmp:11ln1if1vniwz3.relation: Same promise, set once against the deniers' animal-like enjoyment.

cmp:11zlvw11i3k91j.why: Only the common gardens phrase is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp:039jbxl1kswrcn.why: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with...: Ad, the people of the elephant. Two short openings that a memorizer must keep apart. 14:24, have you not seen how God set forth a parable, has a different verb and subject.
cmp:039jbxl1kswrcn.changes: Removed 14:24, which is about a parable, not about how your Lord dealt with a people.
cmp:039jbxl1kswrcn.relation: Same theme: what God did to the arrogant of the past.

check.why: 89:6 and 105:1 share the longer opening about what your Lord did to a people. 14:24 shares only three common words before turning to a parable, so it is really a different thing. Agree with the change and the shortOpening flag.

cmp:10ginbd1lwapk9.why: Hell, they will burn in it, and wretched is: the settlement, or the resting place. Two short ayat that differ in one word, a memorizer pair.
cmp:10ginbd1lwapk9.relation: Same end of the arrogant leaders and of the transgressors.

cmp:1l07gl81ya3o5u.why: They set up rivals to God to lead others from His way; say, enjoy yourselves: in plural to the deniers, and in singular to the ungrateful man who forgets his prayer in hardship. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1l07gl81ya3o5u.relation: Same rebuke: brief enjoyment, then the Fire, for those who set up rivals to God.

cmp:1apsun10z5yeud.why: Prayer and spending from what We provided, secretly and openly: a command to God's servants before a day with no trade, and the praise of those who recite the Book. A memorizer pair (13:22 has the same clause).
cmp:1apsun10z5yeud.relation: Same deeds: prayer and spending, commanded and praised.

cmp:179j4fi02483x0.why: God is the One who created: the heavens and earth and sends rain, the heavens and earth in six days, seven heavens and as many earths. Three openings alike, each going on to a different lesson.
cmp:179j4fi02483x0.relation: Same theme: creation as the ground of provision, rule and knowledge.

cmp:06ukg8y00azd0o.why: Never think God...: unaware of what the wrongdoers do, or failing His promise to His messengers. Two warnings in one passage with different conjunctions.
cmp:06ukg8y00azd0o.relation: Same theme: the delay of punishment is not neglect or a broken promise.

cmp:08uq9se03xf2ry.why: We destroyed no town but that it had: a known term, or warners. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:08uq9se03xf2ry.relation: Same theme: no town is destroyed without a term and a warning.

cmp:1im8d8m07ax95k.why: No nation can advance its term, nor delay it: the same ayah word for word in two surahs. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1im8d8m07ax95k.relation: Same theme: the appointed term of nations.

cmp:1kvovc31r4ks5v.why: It is We who sent down: the Reminder, and We are its guardians; the Quran to you in stages. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1kvovc31r4ks5v.relation: Same theme: God sent down the Quran and protects it.

cmp:0utovm41g077ec.why: We sent before you: among the sects of the ancients, and messengers to their peoples who brought clear proofs. A memorizer pair that consoles the Prophet.
cmp:0utovm41g077ec.relation: Same theme: earlier messengers, denied then vindicated.

cmp:1gucjp91vjww5x.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the seven-row card of no messenger or sign comes to them but they mock or turn away.

cmp:078ux8w1ryeuou.why: They will not believe in it: and the way of the ancients has passed, or until they see the painful punishment. Both follow the same sentence, thus We insert it into the hearts of the criminals. A strong short memorizer pair.
cmp:078ux8w1ryeuou.relation: Same theme: the criminals' hearts reject the Quran.

cmp:1no572v1jamqcx.why: We spread the earth, cast mountains in it and made grow in it of every...: well-measured thing, or delightful pair. A memorizer pair whose last words differ.
cmp:1no572v1jamqcx.relation: Same sign: the spread earth and what grows on it.

cmp:13h36gt1x2f3nz.why: We created man: from dry clay, from an extract of clay, knowing what his soul whispers, in toil, in the best form. Five places, three with the conjunction and two without. A memorizer set.
cmp:13h36gt1x2f3nz.relation: Same theme: the creation of man and his condition.

cmp:1908cpw1tyrioc.why: You are of those given respite until the day of the known time: identical in two tellings of Iblis's story, then his oath differs (because You misled me, by Your might). A memorizer pair.
cmp:1908cpw1tyrioc.relation: Same story: Iblis granted respite and his oath to mislead.

cmp:0qdupgf1q5bz91.why: He said, my Lord, because You...: misled me, I will make things fair to them (Iblis); blessed me, I will never support the criminals (Moses). The same words open a vow of evil and a vow of good.
cmp:0qdupgf1q5bz91.relation: Contrast: Iblis blames God and vows to mislead; Moses thanks God and vows to stay clear of wrong.
