cmp:10t96cl0rexmfl.why: Over My servants you have no authority: except those who follow you, or your Lord suffices as guardian. A memorizer pair.
cmp:10t96cl0rexmfl.relation: Same promise: Satan has no power over God's true servants.

cmp:1v3lokk0r5pxm2.why: The God-fearing will be among gardens and springs: the same ayah word for word, then different next ayat. A memorizer pair.

cmp:1p3a0vb1tdl3e7.why: When they entered upon him and said peace, he said: we are afraid of you, or peace, strangers. Two tellings of Abraham's guests, a memorizer pair.

cmp:0vdas930fey7ov.why: What is your business, O messengers? They said, we have been sent to a criminal people: identical in two surahs, then the third ayah differs (except Lot's family, to send stones). A memorizer pair.
cmp:0vdas930fey7ov.relation: Same story: the angels' mission to Lot's people.

cmp:0fdyxbb1in07mr.why: A repeat: these two ayat are already inside the rows of the 15:57 and 51:31 pair, which shows them with the question before and the different ayah after.

cmp:1ce6lht0nlj86h.why: Two short ayat that share only the stock opening, surely in that are signs; one closes the ruin of Lot's people, the other the flood, with different endings. Nothing beyond the common formula.

cmp:17e2ung0bmuwti.why: What they used to earn did not avail them: closing the end of the people of al-Hijr, of those before who made the same claim, and of the stronger earlier peoples. A memorizer set with one lesson.
cmp:17e2ung0bmuwti.relation: Same theme: wealth and power do not protect from God's punishment.

cmp:0w95f8e0kxziwm.why: Did not avail them what they used to...: earn, or enjoy. Two short ayat, with and without the conjunction, that differ in the last word. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0w95f8e0kxziwm.relation: Same theme: earnings and pleasures are useless when punishment comes.

cmp:0nrfchm0pdybra.why: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them...: except in truth (twice) or in play. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer set.
cmp:0nrfchm0pdybra.relation: Same theme: creation has a purpose, not play.

check.why: Creation not in play, with and without the conjunction. Keep.

cmp:1r1c5wd02imko5.why: Created the heavens and the earth and what is between them only in truth: twice in the first person and once in the third (God created), with and for a set term. A memorizer set.
cmp:1r1c5wd02imko5.relation: Same theme: creation in truth and for a term, so the Hour will come.

cmp:1kohibl0comb3r.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the two three-row cards of the same sentence.

cmp:0zysckb0sdbpg7.why: Do not extend your eyes to what We have given some of them to enjoy: then do not grieve over them and lower your wing to the believers, or the flower of worldly life. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0zysckb0sdbpg7.relation: Same command: do not envy the deniers' worldly enjoyment.

cmp:1uiz9jl1hhs1dn.why: He sends the Spirit of His command on whom He wills of His servants: to warn that there is no god but Him, or to warn of the Day of Meeting. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1uiz9jl1hhs1dn.relation: Same theme: revelation chosen by God, for warning.

cmp:0yktg1m0gndagm.why: He created the heavens and the earth in truth: then exalted above what they associate, He wraps night over day, He shaped you well. Three openings alike, a memorizer set.
cmp:0yktg1m0gndagm.relation: Same theme: creation in truth, then oneness, cosmic order and the shaping of man.

cmp:0av2j2q1yudjeq.why: He created man from: a sperm-drop, haste, clay like pottery, a clinging clot. Four short openings, a memorizer set and a lesson on man's origin and nature.
cmp:0av2j2q1yudjeq.relation: Same theme: man's humble origin and his hasty, quarrelsome nature.

cmp:1u5241a1vkiz9i.why: From a sperm-drop, and then he is an open adversary: once as a statement, once inside the question does man not see. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1u5241a1vkiz9i.relation: Same irony: made from a drop, he argues against his Maker.

cmp:0j3ic7b08m2qbt.why: Surely in that is a sign for a people who reflect, with sign in the singular: closing the crops from rain and the bee's honey, in one surah. The memorizer must separate singular from plural closings.
cmp:0j3ic7b08m2qbt.relation: Similarity: rain and the bee, two signs that call for reflection.

check.why: The singular sign closing, twice in one surah. Keep.

cmp:06be37j0p69y5t.why: So that you may seek of His bounty and that you may be grateful: after the subjected sea and after the night and day made a mercy. A memorizer pair.
cmp:06be37j0p69y5t.relation: Same theme: God's signs are means of livelihood and reasons for thanks.

cmp:1m7a3wy1ytzoxq.why: He cast firm mountains on the earth lest it shift with you: then rivers and paths, or animals and rain. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1m7a3wy1ytzoxq.relation: Same sign: the mountains that steady the earth.

cmp:0cds5hb00skv2r.why: The punishment came to them from where they did not perceive: after the plotters whose building fell on them, and after the deniers before them. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0cds5hb00skv2r.relation: Same theme: sudden punishment of earlier deniers.

cmp:00la6xb0b6spbj.why: Those whom the angels take in death: wronging themselves, or good. Two ayat of one passage with opposite ends.
cmp:00la6xb0b6spbj.relation: Contrast: the death of the wrongdoers and the death of the good, in the same words.

cmp:1pu1s7416pcnpk.why: For those who do good in this world there is good: in the God-fearing's answer about revelation, and in the call to the believers to fear God. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1pu1s7416pcnpk.relation: Same promise: good for the doers of good, here and in the Hereafter.

check.why: The same promise of good for those who do good. Keep.

cmp:15b640014k63ls.why: Those who emigrated for God, or in God's way: a good abode in this world and a greater reward, or a good provision if killed or dead. A memorizer pair.
cmp:15b640014k63ls.relation: Same subject: the reward of the emigrants.

cmp:1pm9w9n1dyop1l.why: Those who were patient and rely on their Lord: the same short ayah word for word in two surahs, then different next ayat. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1pm9w9n1dyop1l.relation: Same description of the emigrants and the believers.

cmp:1rboc9n0wy3uor.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of We sent before you only men (with 12:109).

cmp:11eqk741c25ca8.why: Have they not looked at: what God created whose shadows bow, the earth and what grows in it, the birds above them. Three signs, a memorizer set.
cmp:11eqk741c25ca8.relation: Same theme: signs within sight that point to God.

cmp:1n4vxsi19tefe4.why: So that they deny what We gave them; enjoy then, you will come to know: the same ayah word for word in two surahs, each after people who call on God in distress and then associate. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1n4vxsi19tefe4.relation: Same theme: ingratitude after rescue, met with a threat.

cmp:0wtgc370unkejn.why: So that they deny what We gave them, then enjoy, you will come to know: a command in the second person in 16:55, a third-person form in 29:66. A fine memorizer distinction.
cmp:0wtgc370unkejn.relation: Same theme: the ungrateful are left to enjoy for a while.

cmp:13zcl4m0yba6a2.why: We did not send down to you the Book, or the Quran: except to make clear what they differed about, or to make you miserable. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair on the purpose of revelation.
cmp:13zcl4m0yba6a2.relation: Same theme: why the Quran was revealed, to clarify and not to burden.

cmp:11bmw0j0pvzl3n.why: Water from the sky by which He revives the earth after its death, then signs for people who hear, or who reason: one past tense with a singular sign, one present with plural signs. A memorizer pair.
cmp:11bmw0j0pvzl3n.relation: Same sign: rain reviving dead land.

cmp:09sq9vq1cmhfwa.why: Sent down water from the sky and revived the earth after its death: a statement in an-Nahl and a question to the deniers in al-Ankabut, who answer God. A memorizer pair.
cmp:09sq9vq1cmhfwa.relation: Same sign used as a statement and as an argument against the idolaters.

cmp:195flm60eaav2s.why: God made for you: spouses from yourselves, homes and tents, shade and garments, the earth as a carpet. Four lists of favours with the same opening, three in one passage.
cmp:195flm60eaav2s.relation: Same theme: God's favours in family, shelter and the earth.

cmp:0k12agv1uf8der.why: Praise be to God, but most of them do not know: closing two parables (the slave and the free, the man with quarrelling partners) and the deniers' admission that God created all. A memorizer set.
cmp:0k12agv1uf8der.relation: Same theme: the plain truth that most people ignore.

cmp:17lu6os14yuch2.why: Surely in that are signs for a people who believe: closing five signs (the birds held in the sky, night and day, Abraham saved from the fire, provision extended and restricted twice). The memorizer must match each sign to its closing.
cmp:17lu6os14yuch2.relation: Similarity: the signs that speak to those who believe.

check.why: A refrain closing five signs, with the twin pair on provision. Keep.

cmp:17lknqe18q2wv8.why: When those who wronged see the punishment, and when those who associated see their partners: consecutive ayat with the same opening and two scenes of the Day.
cmp:17lknqe18q2wv8.relation: Same scene: the wrongdoers face the punishment and their false gods.

cmp:1auh3sj03ty91h.relation: Same command: rights of kin and the needy.

cmp:0bh9s6u1mk9or4.relation: Same theme: provision measured by knowledge.

cmp:0g1d0bi14gwiu8.relation: Same theme: the variety of the Quran's examples and people's resistance.

cmp:0nva1om06olc7w.why: We know best what they...: listen to, say (twice). Three places with the same opening and different continuations.

cmp:1xtx7e511vmdvv.why: The truth has come: and falsehood has vanished, or falsehood neither begins nor repeats. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:1xtx7e511vmdvv.relation: Same declaration: falsehood has no power before the truth.

cmp:19a115403klm76.why: Say, God suffices between me and you as witness: the word witness comes before between me and you in one and after it in the other. A memorizer pair (13:43 has a third form).
cmp:19a115403klm76.relation: Same answer to the deniers: God is witness.

check.why: The word order of witness swapped. Keep.

cmp:0yg38b01ct9jp4.why: Whom God guides is rightly guided, and whom He sends astray, you will find for them no protectors, or for him no guiding ally. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0yg38b01ct9jp4.relation: Same theme: guidance and error in God's hand.

cmp:1ppb5jm1co8he6.why: Do they not see that God who created the heavens and the earth is able: to create their like, or to give life to the dead. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1ppb5jm1co8he6.relation: Same argument: the Creator of the heavens can raise the dead.

cmp:0ez0lgt11wfdb9.why: The strong part of this card is the 17:99 and 46:33 pair, which has its own card; 30:37 shares only the opening do they not see that God, with a different subject (provision).

cmp:0wy24ap0x7cyrv.why: He has not taken a son and has no partner in dominion: in the praise that closes al-Isra and in the description that opens al-Furqan, with different surroundings. A memorizer pair.

cmp:0gn39vb1ksd7kv.why: They have no knowledge of it: nor did their fathers, or they follow only conjecture. Said of those who claim God has a son and of those who name the angels female. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0gn39vb1ksd7kv.relation: Same theme: false claims about God made without knowledge.

cmp:1beuo071gz8pv5.why: Perhaps you will destroy yourself with grief: over their traces if they do not believe, or that they will not be believers. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:1beuo071gz8pv5.relation: Same consolation to the Prophet over his people's rejection.

cmp:1gejk890dxha87.why: They said, we stayed a day or part of a day: the youths of the cave after three centuries, and the deniers on the Day about their life on earth. A memorizer pair with a strong lesson.
cmp:1gejk890dxha87.relation: Similarity: long time felt as a day, in the cave and in the grave.

cmp:0chmn6w1tky166.why: Recite what is revealed to you of the Book: then none can change His words, or establish prayer. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0chmn6w1tky166.relation: Same command: recite the revelation, joined to its steadfastness and to prayer.

cmp:0101h9a0txw70i.why: Adorned there with bracelets of gold: then green garments of silk, or pearls and silk clothing (22:23 and 35:33 alike). A memorizer set.
cmp:0101h9a0txw70i.relation: Same description of the dwellers of the Garden.

cmp:0u77teq0oir2ss.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the bracelets of gold (with 35:33).

cmp:1tjsw8n1mb0rqn.why: From dust, then from a sperm-drop, then...: four places, each continuing differently (He shaped you a man, a clot, made you pairs, brings you out as a child). A memorizer set.

cmp:11yq82d0rva7b7.why: He had no party to help him besides God, nor could he help himself: the owner of the two gardens and Qarun. Two rich men undone in the same words.

cmp:1plvixu0lqeafe.why: So they set out until, when...: they boarded the ship, met a boy, came to a town. The three journeys of Moses with al-Khidr. A memorizer set.
cmp:1plvixu0lqeafe.relation: Same story: the three trials of Moses' patience.

cmp:1y8t94h1n8wts7.why: Until, when he reached: the setting of the sun, its rising, between the two barriers. The three stages of Dhul-Qarnayn. A memorizer set.

cmp:0oqv9ef0zt1idh.relation: Same story: the transitions in Dhul-Qarnayn's journeys.

cmp:1dfa62d094a46d.why: Say, I am only a man like you, revealed to me that your god is one God: then whoever hopes to meet his Lord, or go straight to Him. A long identical run with different tails.
cmp:1dfa62d094a46d.relation: Same declaration of the Prophet's humanity and of oneness.

cmp:0xz1s0r02yxseh.why: It is revealed to me that your god is one God: twice after I am only a man like you, once in a shorter form (21:108) with the question will you submit. A memorizer set.

cmp:12ovri40nm4ojk.why: Say, I am only...: a man like you (twice), or a warner (38:65); each then declares one God. A memorizer set on how the Prophet describes himself.
cmp:12ovri40nm4ojk.relation: Same theme: the Prophet is human and a warner, and God is one.

cmp:1htvttu0tnqnv8.why: He said, so it will be, your Lord says it is easy for Me: to Zakariya about John and to Mary about Jesus, in one surah, with different tails. A memorizer pair.

cmp:1v642wj1n9rvcx.why: He came out to his people: Zakariya from the prayer niche, signing to them to glorify God, and Qarun in his finery, making people envy him. Same words, opposite figures.

cmp:14ly49n1nt9s4v.why: Mention in the Book: Mary, Abraham, Moses, Ishmael, Idris, each with his quality (truthful prophet, sincere, true to his promise). The structure of Maryam; a memorizer set.

cmp:0vvq56r0ttq2fd.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the five-row card of mention in the Book, which shows that Abraham and Idris share the same description.

cmp:05bcdh00lnagie.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the six-row card of when Our clear signs are recited to them.

cmp:11ekfi704mmrid.why: They said, woe to us, we were: wrongdoers, transgressors. Two short ayat that differ in one word, the destroyed town and the owners of the garden.

cmp:19ebeij1v280fp.why: We did not create the heaven and the earth and what is between them: in play, or in vain. A memorizer pair whose last word differs.

cmp:1xnyxww1azn9hy.why: Or have they taken besides Him...: gods, intercessors, protectors. Three challenges with different answers.
cmp:1xnyxww1azn9hy.relation: Same argument against taking any helper besides God.

cmp:1n27els0xnqqj0.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the six-row card of We sent no messenger before you except.

cmp:01dog2102ti1lx.relation: Same story: Job's prayer in affliction.

cmp:1xl8y5i0a3vngu.relation: Same theme: the breaking of one community into sects.

cmp:18xpb3y1pghn58.why: You and what you worship: fuel of Hell, or cannot tempt anyone away from God. With and without the conjunction, two addresses to the idolaters.
cmp:18xpb3y1pghn58.relation: Same address to idolaters and their idols.

cmp:0fpb0481dskyd8.relation: Same theme: the scope and purpose of the Prophet's mission.

cmp:1ytf1kl08ssteh.why: Among people is he who disputes about God without knowledge: then follows every devil, or without guidance or an enlightening Book (twice). A memorizer set.
cmp:1ytf1kl08ssteh.relation: Same type: arguing about God without knowledge.

cmp:03nui350zy26tj.relation: Same sign: the reviving earth as proof of resurrection.

cmp:0gq1xbd1iauyur.why: That is because God is the Truth: then He gives life to the dead, or what they call on besides Him is falsehood (twice, with and without a pronoun). A memorizer set.
cmp:0gq1xbd1iauyur.relation: Same theme: God is the Truth and idols are falsehood.

cmp:0y1hl5o0451cqs.why: He gives life to the dead and He is able over all things: once with that and once with He, after God is the Truth and after God is the Protector. A memorizer pair.

cmp:1hhduzv0rqqni9.why: A repeat: these three ayat are in the four-row card of God admits those who believe into gardens (with 14:23).

cmp:1b3ve4w0benx96.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the bracelets of gold (with 18:31).

cmp:03bbakn0ta933f.why: Only the common phrase about those who believe and do good is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp:0g60td91j4ojlv.why: To mention God's name over the livestock He provided them: in the rites of pilgrimage and in the rite given to every nation. A memorizer pair in one passage.
cmp:0g60td91j4ojlv.relation: Same theme: sacrifice as remembrance of God, common to all nations.

cmp:035002m0dwc0he.why: That, and whoever honours...: the sacred things of God, it is better for him; the symbols of God, it is from the piety of hearts. Two ayat of one passage, a memorizer pair.
cmp:035002m0dwc0he.relation: Same theme: reverence for what God made sacred.

cmp:0x8k0zj0re29u5.why: For every nation We appointed a rite: to mention God's name over livestock, or which they perform, so let them not dispute with you. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.

cmp:1c9t4fp0halfdp.why: How many a town: We destroyed while it did wrong, I gave respite then seized, stronger than your town, rebelled against its Lord. Different conjunctions and tails, a memorizer set.
cmp:1c9t4fp0halfdp.relation: Same theme: the end of wrongdoing towns.

cmp:0xuiz7z1n2069h.why: He merges night into day and day into night: four places with different lead-ins and tails (hearing and seeing, subjected sun and moon twice, knowing what is in the breasts). A memorizer set.

cmp:14rwzi91w6hhvn.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the four-row card of the merging of night and day.

cmp:13gzllc1dkz0ru.why: Have you not seen that God sent down water from the sky: then the earth becomes green, We brought out fruits of varied colours, He made it springs then crops. A memorizer set.
cmp:13gzllc1dkz0ru.relation: Same sign: rain and the variety it brings, a reminder for people of understanding.

cmp:0iuf0b90ux0jxd.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same question (with 35:27).

cmp:1l86c170i0cl4f.why: That God has subjected to you what is: on the earth, or in the heavens and on the earth. Have you not seen, singular and plural. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1l86c170i0cl4f.relation: Same theme: all creation put at mankind's service.

cmp:08ndupr15v4upx.why: In a Book; that is easy for God: after God's knowledge of heaven and earth, and after the term of every life. A memorizer pair.
cmp:08ndupr15v4upx.relation: Same theme: everything recorded, and its recording easy for God.

check.why: The same opening with three different rewards; the exact memorizer point. Keep.

cmp:1yi80161kpqy6w.why: A repeat: both ayat are in cmp:0uvyc4t0tvlrql, which also shows 41:8.

cmp:1ow50c21tj7uu4.why: God does not love every arrogant boaster, said in two settings about conduct: Luqman's advice on walking among people, and not exulting over what one is given. The shared clause is rare and the theme the same.
cmp:1ow50c21tj7uu4.relation: Pride in manner and pride in wealth, both disliked by God.

cmp:16a8tcn1yufm1f.why: God made all that is in the heavens and the earth serve you, said twice with different continuations (blessings outward and inward; all from Him, signs for those who reflect).
cmp:16a8tcn1yufm1f.relation: The universe subjected to man as grace and as a sign.

cmp:0ag0ke20ia23ta.why: A repeat: all three rows are in cmp:1ld0z8j1guibwl, which shows the full family of these questions.

cmp:1a4hqu70ii1bu3.why: A repeat: both rows are in cmp:1ld0z8j1guibwl.

cmp:16f2wky1xoksw2.why: Night merged into day and the sun and moon each running for a term, word for word apart from one preposition, with different endings. A precise memorizer's trap.
cmp:16f2wky1xoksw2.relation: The ordered cycle of night and day as proof of God's sole lordship.

cmp:1yf8ig70nijobn.why: The same warning not to be deceived by this life or by the Deceiver, after two different openings. The next ayat differ too (the five keys of the unseen, Satan as enemy).

cmp:04cd9aj0de7n0z.why: A repeat: cmp:0gd2fhz0hywp77 sets both these ayat together with 23:78, which ends in the same words.

cmp:0rw65080mxei44.why: The same rare challenge, who can protect you from God if He wills harm or good for you, said to the hypocrites at the Trench and to the Bedouins who stayed behind. Same theme of excuses for not fighting.
cmp:0rw65080mxei44.relation: No excuse shields anyone from what God wills.

cmp:1wc7rko0kuuroa.why: An excellent example for whoever hopes in God and the Last Day: the Prophet in 33:21, Abraham and those with him in 60:6. Nearly identical wording with different endings.
cmp:1wc7rko0kuuroa.relation: Two models to follow, the Prophet and Abraham, for the same kind of believer.

cmp:1iqm8wb11j6u8r.why: Two addresses to the Prophet in the same surah that share only the call and the word for We. One describes his mission, the other the women lawful to him. Different subjects.

check.why: Only the call to the Prophet is shared, with different subjects. Drop.

cmp:0s4o2by0mmhnpm.why: Two surah openings that join God's ownership of all in the heavens and the earth with His praise, one as praise and one as glorification, each closing with different names. Easy to confuse and worth pondering together.
cmp:0s4o2by0mmhnpm.relation: Praise belongs to the Owner of everything, in this world and the next.

check.why: Two surah openings joining ownership and praise, with different names at the close. Keep.

cmp:1qqc7tk1ngrcgi.why: The same full description of God's knowledge of what enters and leaves the earth and what comes down and goes up to the sky, closing differently (merciful and forgiving; with you wherever you are).
cmp:1qqc7tk1ngrcgi.relation: God's complete knowledge, joined once to mercy and once to His nearness.

cmp:1e1rjmv1vsr8tr.why: Contrast in the same surah: not even an atom's weight in the heavens or the earth escapes God, while the false gods do not own even an atom's weight of them.
cmp:1e1rjmv1vsr8tr.relation: Contrast: God's knowledge misses nothing; the idols own nothing.

cmp:1r5ry4v1ykonrv.why: Only the common opening, the disbelievers said, followed by a negation, is shared. One denies the Hour, the other urges people not to listen to the Quran. Different subjects.

cmp:1vh5qry1crfis0.why: In one surah the Prophet twice says his Lord widens and narrows provision, the second time adding of His servants and the promise to replace what is spent. A sharp memorizer's trap. The third row shares only the opening.
cmp:1vh5qry1crfis0.changes: Removed 34:48: it shares only the opening and is about God casting the truth, not provision.
cmp:1vh5qry1crfis0.relation: Provision is God's: the first answers pride in wealth, the second urges spending.

cmp:198b0nq1rtjlyk.why: When the clear verses are recited, the disbelievers call the truth plain magic. The same scene in nearly the same words, with 34:43 adding two more charges first.
cmp:198b0nq1rtjlyk.relation: The same reaction of the disbelievers to the truth.

cmp:1adpq4m1e7jiso.why: Both prove God alone is the Creator and Provider, then ask how they are turned away, in the same words. A memorizer's trap, and the run-on shows the different continuations.
cmp:1adpq4m1e7jiso.relation: The argument from creation to worshipping God alone.

cmp:0987sxs0w7o6qe.why: Only the phrase that the disbelievers will have something is shared; it is a common pattern and the two ayat say different things. Little to learn from the pair.

check.why: I would keep. Both ayat are in the same surah and say the same thing, that the disbelievers have punishment, once as severe punishment and once as the fire of Hell. The one difference is the conjunction. That is a classic memorizer trap and the subject is the same, not different.

cmp:09yk9t71ccz4hb.why: A rare clause, no female conceives or gives birth except with His knowledge, in two passages on God's knowledge (of each lifespan, of the Hour and of fruits).
cmp:09yk9t71ccz4hb.relation: God's knowledge of what is hidden in wombs, lifespans and the Hour.

cmp:114cwbo1jdg0z2.why: Creation from dust, then from a drop, continued in two ways: made into pairs, or from a clinging clot to old age. Useful for memorizers and for pondering the stages of creation.
cmp:114cwbo1jdg0z2.relation: The stages of human life from dust to the end of the appointed term.

cmp:0uu834l0oj36z3.why: The sun and moon subjected, each running for an appointed term, after two different verbs for night and day (merging, wrapping). A precise trap for memorizers.
cmp:0uu834l0oj36z3.relation: The ordered cosmos as proof of God's lordship and might.

cmp:0ouod121tvhgu6.why: The blind and the seeing are not equal, said in two surahs and continued differently (darkness and light; believers and evildoers). Good for memorizers and for pondering.
cmp:0ouod121tvhgu6.relation: Faith as sight and light, disbelief as blindness and darkness.

cmp:0z10qoo016hzhw.why: The same challenge to the idolaters, show me what they created of the earth or do they have a share in the heavens, each asking for a different proof after it.
cmp:0z10qoo016hzhw.relation: No creation, no share, no scripture: the idols have no claim.

cmp:1wdrzea1cvzcbc.why: God declares that He gives life, continued differently (records deeds and traces; causes death and to Him is the return). A memorizer's point on the resurrection theme.
cmp:1wdrzea1cvzcbc.relation: The One who gives life and death also records and judges.

cmp:0d521y3099k44r.why: Two short announcements of Hell to its people, differing in what they denied. A small memorizer's trap.

cmp:0phvbze0q17taa.why: The deniers' mocking question about their forefathers is identical in two surahs, and so is the ayah before it about being raised after becoming dust and bones. The answers differ. Adding the ayah before shows what the question continues.
cmp:0phvbze0q17taa.changes: Added the ayah before each (37:16 and 56:47), which repeats the same question and gives the match its sense.
cmp:0phvbze0q17taa.relation: The same denial of resurrection, answered in two ways.

check.why: Adding the ayah before each row (37:16, 56:47) is right. But the proposed rows also drop the run-on ayat 37:18 and 56:49, which carry the two different answers that the why itself points to. The brief says not to remove run-ons yourself. I would make the rows 37:16 to 37:18 and 56:47 to 56:49, keep the card, and keep the runOn flag.

cmp:1274v280vm4h8s.why: It will be only a single cry, then they look on (37:19) or they are on the open plain (79:14). Same scene of resurrection, a memorizer's trap.
cmp:1274v280vm4h8s.relation: The resurrection happens with one cry.

cmp:1fz7u390166an5.why: This is the Day of Decision, said in two surahs and continued differently (which you used to deny; We have gathered you and the former peoples).
cmp:1fz7u390166an5.relation: The Day the deniers rejected is now present.

cmp:1q0tml01cypfvm.why: They turn to one another questioning: the people of Hell blaming, the people of Paradise recalling, and the owners of the garden blaming each other. A strong memorizer's set and a striking contrast.
cmp:1q0tml01cypfvm.relation: Contrast: the same gesture among the damned, the blessed and the punished garden owners.

cmp:1onheu60udh338.why: The refrain of as-Saffat excepting God's sincere servants, four times with different continuations. Shows where each sits in the surah.
cmp:1onheu60udh338.relation: The sincere servants are excepted from every evil fate.

check.why: The refrain of as-Saffat, four times. Keep.

cmp:1jiiztx04a1vjz.why: The refrain that God left a good remembrance for the prophet among later generations, each followed by peace upon a different prophet. Exactly what a memorizer needs to order the stories.
cmp:1jiiztx04a1vjz.relation: Each prophet is honored in later generations.

cmp:0do32xj061a04b.why: The refrain that he was one of Our believing servants, closing the stories of Noah, Abraham and Elias, each followed by something different.
cmp:0do32xj061a04b.relation: Faith is the quality praised in each prophet.

check.why: The refrain of as-Saffat, three times. Keep.

cmp:1s1vrqc0fh7nd0.why: Short ayat that open the same way, two of them in neighbouring surahs (84:22 and 85:19) with nearly the same ending. A real memorizer's trap.

cmp:19ia1a60lvmapq.why: Do they have the treasures of your Lord: asked twice, with different continuations. Same argument against those who reject the Prophet.
cmp:19ia1a60lvmapq.relation: They own nothing of God's treasures, so they cannot decide who receives revelation.

cmp:0s5him80a06t4w.why: The same promise of nearness and a good return, said of David and of Solomon in one surah. Father and son end in the same words.
cmp:0s5him80a06t4w.relation: Father and son, each tested and forgiven, receive the same honor.

cmp:1n13ce10kkn82t.why: This is what you were promised, said to the people of Paradise in two surahs with different continuations. A memorizer's trap.

cmp:06af37x1l54dsx.why: Four Ha-Mim surahs open with the revelation of the Book from God the Mighty; one ends with the Knowing, three with the Wise, and the next ayah differs each time. A key memorizer's set.
cmp:06af37x1l54dsx.relation: The same declaration of the Book's source opens a family of surahs.

cmp:1uoj1st0oqonxp.why: A repeat: these three rows are inside cmp:06af37x1l54dsx, which also shows 40:2 with its different ending.

cmp:0a4zduv12yzaqj.why: A rare closing, God does not guide one who is a liar, with two different pairs of descriptions: the idolaters' false excuse, and the believer of Pharaoh's family warning about Pharaoh.
cmp:0a4zduv12yzaqj.relation: Lying shuts the door to guidance.

cmp:13hiyxp04itj15.why: In one surah, man calls on God in harm and forgets Him in blessing, twice, with different endings (setting up rivals; claiming his own knowledge earned it). A memorizer's trap and a lesson on ingratitude.
cmp:13hiyxp04itj15.relation: Two ways of forgetting God after relief: idolatry and self-credit.

cmp:04mmjfq0ed3a9i.why: The true losers are those who lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection: said by the Prophet in 39:15 and by the believers in 42:45, with different endings.
cmp:04mmjfq0ed3a9i.relation: The real meaning of loss, said in this world and confirmed on that Day.

cmp:1hi16we1u7zwb8.why: Disgrace in this world and a worse punishment in the next, said of earlier peoples in general and of Aad. Two comparatives (greater, more disgracing) that a memorizer must keep apart.
cmp:1hi16we1u7zwb8.relation: Worldly punishment is a foretaste of a greater one.

cmp:0y1keog0a9sr8w.why: The same closing, the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they only knew, after two different stories (earlier deniers; the owners of the garden).
cmp:0y1keog0a9sr8w.relation: Every worldly punishment points to a greater one.

cmp:0t1v6r51rnyrs5.why: They will have whatever they wish with their Lord, closing as the reward of the good-doers or as the great favor. A memorizer's trap in a shared theme.
cmp:0t1v6r51rnyrs5.relation: The reward of the righteous is whatever they wish, a favor from their Lord.

cmp:11onsmt031sxhr.why: They will have whatever they wish, continued with their Lord in 39:34 and therein, with more from Us in 50:35. Same reward, a fine memorizer's point.
cmp:11onsmt031sxhr.relation: Whatever they wish, and more beyond it.

cmp:1ns4fpo03ihpn0.why: Two consecutive commands that end before the punishment comes to you, the second adding suddenly, while you do not perceive. Worth seeing together so the two endings are not swapped.
cmp:1ns4fpo03ihpn0.relation: Turn back and follow the best before it is too late.

cmp:1y8kldt00fnlqf.why: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth, continued as a warning to the deniers or as His control of provision. A rare phrase, good for memorizers.
cmp:1y8kldt00fnlqf.relation: The One who holds the keys decides loss and provision.

cmp:1ri9x5f0zxfeth.why: The same sentence to the arrogant at the gates of Hell, in two surahs next to each other. The next ayah is very different (the righteous led to Paradise; a call to patience).

cmp:1b780li00na84g.why: The seven Ha-Mim openings and what follows each. This is exactly what a memorizer must master to move between these surahs.
cmp:1b780li00na84g.relation: A family of surahs opened by the same letters, each continuing with the Book.

check.why: The Ha Mim openings and what follows each. Keep.

cmp:0ty3my20goz4ce.why: The believer of Pharaoh's people addresses them twice in the same words, first warning, then inviting. Worth knowing which comes first in his speech.
cmp:0ty3my20goz4ce.relation: One man's sincere advice to his people, in stages.

cmp:13n2p6y0dia68a.why: Those who dispute about God's signs without any authority come to them, described twice in one surah with different continuations (sealed hearts; pride they will never satisfy).
cmp:13n2p6y0dia68a.relation: Arguing against revelation comes from pride.

cmp:1sb7wji0d1jvpw.why: Three blessings in one surah, each opened by God who made for you: night and day, earth and sky, livestock. Shows the order in Ghafir and invites gratitude.
cmp:1sb7wji0d1jvpw.relation: A list of daily blessings, each a sign of His care.

cmp:01x69if194sgkb.why: The punishment explained by what they did on earth without right, rejoicing and exulting in one, arrogance and sin in the other. A memorizer's trap with the same reproach.
cmp:01x69if194sgkb.relation: Arrogance on earth without right is the cause of the punishment.

cmp:0xb7w0g14vokwm.why: A reward never cut off for believers who do good, in three places (one with a connective letter). The words around it differ slightly, a real memorizer's point.
cmp:0xb7w0g14vokwm.relation: An unending reward for faith and good deeds.

cmp:0kah4jf05rg0c9.why: A repeat: both ayat are in cmp:0xb7w0g14vokwm, which also shows 95:6.

cmp:02glna104fx6pv.why: Ownership and glorification of all in the heavens and the earth, closing with two different pairs of names (the High, the Great; the Mighty, the Wise). 59:1 and 61:1 are identical openings, a memorizer's trap.
cmp:02glna104fx6pv.relation: Everything belongs to Him and glorifies Him.

check.why: This is inconsistent with the same agent's split of cmp:0bg07hf1kbmkz5. There, ownership (42:4) and glorification (59:1, 61:1) were judged a different phrase structure. By that ruling 42:4 does not belong here, and what remains is exactly the pair 59:1|61:1. I would drop this card, or remove 42:4, and keep the 59:1|61:1 card for the identical openings.

cmp:1q1ma6o1py32ze.why: Thus We revealed to you, twice in ash-Shura: an Arabic Quran to warn, and a spirit by Our command as light. Good for memorizers and for pondering what revelation is.
cmp:1q1ma6o1py32ze.relation: Revelation described as a warning and as a living light.

cmp:0tkocyx09lzs4t.why: Only the opening that God is He is shared; one ayah is about worship as the straight path, the other about God as Provider. Different subjects.

cmp:0hv76u41mqnoh6.why: The criminals are in, followed by two descriptions (abiding in Hell; error and blazing fire). Same subject, a small memorizer's point.

check.why: The criminals with two descriptions. Keep.

cmp:1c6lht81rrfuz6.why: Contrast in the same opening words: the people of Paradise taste no death there beyond the first, and the people of Hell taste there no coolness and no drink.
cmp:1c6lht81rrfuz6.relation: Contrast: what each group will never taste.

cmp:152ek7s1vvcyjq.why: The day the disbelievers are exposed to the Fire, twice in al-Ahqaf, with two different reproaches. Worth knowing which comes where.
cmp:152ek7s1vvcyjq.relation: The disbelievers' exposure to the Fire and the reasons given.

cmp:1pihpq60xjhusg.why: The same description of the evil man, hinderer of good, transgressor, ending differently (doubter; sinner). A precise memorizer's trap.
cmp:1pihpq60xjhusg.relation: Portraits of the one who blocks good.

cmp:09efnj41he5ts4.why: The same command to glorify Him in the night, ending differently (after the prostrations; at the setting of the stars). A precise memorizer's trap.
cmp:09efnj41he5ts4.relation: Glorifying God at night, tied to prayer and to the stars.

cmp:0o1yo1r0k0vlop.why: The people of Noah before, they were, followed by two descriptions (defiantly disobedient; more unjust and more tyrannical). Same subject, a memorizer's trap.

cmp:0elhyy30tqokql.why: Two very short ayat that share only a negation of having something; one is about the punishment that none can avert, the other about man with no strength on the Day. Too thin to teach anything.

check.why: Only a negation of having something; too thin. Drop.

cmp:1kjsq180vv8cii.why: Eat and drink with good cheer for what you did, said to the people of Paradise three times, once with a different reason (for what you sent ahead in days gone by). Good for memorizers.
cmp:1kjsq180vv8cii.relation: The joy of Paradise as the fruit of past deeds.

cmp:1scu0m10hm6hg1.why: The refrain of al-Qamar, how was My punishment and My warnings, after each people's story, with what follows each. Helps the memorizer order the surah.
cmp:1scu0m10hm6hg1.relation: Each people's end is followed by the same question to the listener.

cmp:030m57r09gh1uf.why: In al-Qamar the same words introduce three punishments: a wind, a single cry, a storm of stones. Good for memorizers and for pondering how each people was destroyed.
cmp:030m57r09gh1uf.relation: Different punishments for Aad, Thamud and Lot's people.

cmp:0kty0170n1z3z7.why: The same description of the companions of Paradise in two gardens of ar-Rahman, followed by the refrain and two different images. A memorizer must know which garden each belongs to.

cmp:1sxhs1p0ytirgn.why: A crowd of the earlier generations, said of the foremost and of the people of the right, with different followings (a few of the later; a crowd of the later). A real memorizer's trap and a meaningful contrast.
cmp:1sxhs1p0ytirgn.relation: The foremost are mostly early; the people of the right are many in both eras.

cmp:1whengu1ik6oi6.why: Eternal youths go round among them, the same picture of Paradise in two surahs, continued with cups or with scattered pearls.

cmp:10d5azk0223jbc.why: God is able to replace them, with the likes of you or with better than them. A rare phrase on the same theme of God's power over the deniers.
cmp:10d5azk0223jbc.relation: God can replace any people; they cannot escape Him.

cmp:1tcebt70v5cphv.why: The command to glorify the name of your Lord the Most Great closes passages in al-Waqia (twice) and al-Haqqa. The memorizer needs what comes next in each.

cmp:1ahq4lx1soh7xz.why: The three groups at death in al-Waqia, each introduced the same way: those brought near, the people of the right, the deniers who went astray. Shows the surah's structure.
cmp:1ahq4lx1soh7xz.relation: The three destinies at the moment of death.

cmp:02wxmea1omfs8q.why: A repeat: both ayat are in cmp:0icu61z139ts8p, which shows the same closing with 30:27 and 45:37.

check.why: Both rows are in the kept card on the same closing. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp:0qzfhqc11qy8ak.why: That is the bounty of God, He gives it to whom He wills, and God is of great bounty: said of Paradise, of God's grace to the believers, and of the Prophet's mission. A memorizer's trap in neighbouring surahs.
cmp:0qzfhqc11qy8ak.relation: Every grace, from forgiveness to prophethood, is God's bounty.

cmp:1h1yd6c17uogiu.why: Whoever turns away, God is free of need and Praiseworthy: closing the rebuke of the misers and the call to follow Abraham. A rare clause on the same theme.

cmp:1fdra270ecjv61.why: Those who oppose God and His Messenger, twice in al-Mujadala: humbled as those before, and among the most abased. A memorizer's trap and one theme.
cmp:1fdra270ecjv61.relation: The fate of those who oppose God and His Messenger.

cmp:0wijmye13u6gqa.why: The Day God raises them all, twice in one surah: He informs them of their deeds, and they swear to Him as they swore to you. Good for memorizers and for pondering.
cmp:0wijmye13u6gqa.relation: On that Day deeds are shown and the hypocrites still lie.

cmp:1do0iv61autbc4.why: A repeat: both ayat are in cmp:02glna104fx6pv, which shows these identical openings with 42:4.

check.why: I would keep this pair: two identical surah openings, a real memorizer trap. The drop relies on cmp:02glna104fx6pv, but that card mixes in 42:4, which by the agent's own structure ruling does not belong. The clean pair should be the card that stays.

cmp:0kntksy0b1nqxw.why: Two consecutive ayat at the end of al-Hashr opening with the same declaration of God's oneness, each followed by different names. Seeing them together fixes the order of the names.
cmp:0kntksy0b1nqxw.relation: The names of God listed after the declaration of His oneness.

cmp:0nye2j01mxodos.why: Consecutive ayat in contrast: God does not forbid kindness to those who did not fight you, and forbids alliance with those who did. Same words, opposite rulings.
cmp:0nye2j01mxodos.relation: Contrast: justice toward peaceful non-Muslims, no alliance with aggressors.

cmp:0ekhpmy1n3eree.why: Two addresses to the Prophet that share only the call and the word when. One is about the women's pledge, the other about divorce. Different subjects.

check.why: Only the call to the Prophet and the word when are shared, with different subjects. Drop.

cmp:1kkvb6i0d0h726.why: Only the reward formula of forgiven sins and gardens beneath which rivers flow is shared. Different settings; per the owner's rulings this generic formula leans drop.

cmp:02yycpe1cq4z70.why: Two surah openings that glorify God in the same words, followed by different names and attributes. A classic trap for memorizers between neighbouring surahs.
cmp:02yycpe1cq4z70.relation: All things glorify the King, who owns all and is praised.

cmp:0optz371px8mtl.why: Two consecutive challenges in al-Mulk: who is this that can help you, who is this that can provide for you. Same opening, worth fixing the order.
cmp:0optz371px8mtl.relation: No one but God can protect or provide.

cmp:1eklml11fi16lv.why: Two consecutive ayat in al-Mulk opening with the same command: He who brought you into being, He who spread you over the earth. Good for the order and for pondering.
cmp:1eklml11fi16lv.relation: From creation to being gathered back to Him.

cmp:18kt1li0hvh5lk.why: The same picture of the deniers on the Day, eyes downcast, covered with humiliation, closing differently (they were called to prostrate; this is the promised Day).
cmp:18kt1li0hvh5lk.relation: The humiliation of those who refused to bow.

cmp:123kwjh1kcnqjx.why: Receiving the record in the right hand, the left hand, or behind the back, in two surahs with the same opening. Good for memorizers and a vivid contrast of fates.
cmp:123kwjh1kcnqjx.relation: Contrast: how each person receives his record shows his end.

cmp:0d9rfdz01m6qm9.why: In a lofty garden, the same short ayah in two surahs, followed by different descriptions (low-hanging fruit; no idle talk heard). A memorizer's trap.

cmp:1ulbaoy1hoflxe.why: The identical ayah, not urging the feeding of the poor, describes the doomed man in al-Haqqa and the denier of the Religion in al-Maun. The next ayah differs.
cmp:1ulbaoy1hoflxe.relation: Neglecting the poor marks the one who denies the Last Day.

cmp:11g3t6z0vvj3np.why: The identical oath-answer, it is the word of a noble messenger, followed by different descriptions (not a poet's word; possessed of power with the Lord of the Throne).
cmp:11g3t6z0vvj3np.relation: The Quran's messenger described from two sides.

cmp:062xhap1p1tk15.why: It is not the word of a poet, it is not the word of an accursed devil: two denials of false sources of the Quran, in two surahs with the same opening.
cmp:062xhap1p1tk15.relation: The Quran is neither poetry nor the devil's speech.

cmp:0opyu5b1qe2f9v.why: The mountains become like wool, and in al-Qaria carded wool. The same picture of the Last Day, with one word added.

cmp:094wjy01hm0114.why: The jinn say twice that they had thought something: that no one would lie about God, and that they could not escape God. Same opening, worth fixing the order.
cmp:094wjy01hm0114.relation: The jinn's two realizations, about lies and about God's power.

cmp:1axg8x30j9z5e1.why: For whoever among you wills to, continued to advance or lag behind, and to go straight. A clear memorizer's trap on the theme of human choice.

cmp:05y59u1122a6r1.why: Two short ayat that share only the opening particles of rebuke; one is about not fearing the Hereafter, the other about not honoring the orphan. Different subjects.

check.why: Only rebuke particles are shared, with different subjects. Drop.

cmp:0qjei9v0mxj78v.why: Two short ayat in al-Qiyama, to your Lord that Day is the settlement, and the driving. A memorizer must know which comes first.
cmp:0qjei9v0mxj78v.relation: Every soul is driven to its Lord and settled there.

cmp:0alwpjf1v3vfy9.why: Short ayat that share only the opening; one promises to explain the Quran, the other the reckoning of the deniers. Different subjects.

cmp:1ase1kq05f3uka.why: A spring from which drink God's servants, or those brought near: the same image of Paradise in two surahs, a memorizer's trap.
cmp:1ase1kq05f3uka.relation: The special spring for the closest servants.

cmp:19wss751l9a1dj.why: You cannot will unless God wills, closing two surahs with different names (Knowing, Wise; Lord of the worlds). A clear memorizer's trap and a point to ponder.
cmp:19wss751l9a1dj.relation: Human will is real but under God's will.

cmp:06vdej8022ys86.why: What will make you know what is the Day, of Decision or of Judgment. Short, but a real trap between the short surahs.

cmp:035qvz006tg0eg.why: The identical ayah, provision for you and your cattle, in two neighbouring surahs, each followed by a different name for the Last Day. A classic memorizer's trap.
cmp:035qvz006tg0eg.relation: After the blessings comes the Day that ends them.

cmp:0dz3znw0idbowc.why: The identical ayah, the righteous are in bliss, in neighbouring surahs, followed by the wicked in Hell in one and the couches in the other.

cmp:1unodoh0lpnez5.why: Contrast in one surah, in the same words: the record of the wicked is in Sijjin, the record of the righteous in Illiyyin.
cmp:1unodoh0lpnez5.relation: Contrast: the records of the wicked and of the righteous.

cmp:137vzlo09m1z7s.why: On couches, looking, twice in al-Mutaffifin, followed by different things (the glow of bliss; are the disbelievers repaid). Worth knowing where each sits.
cmp:137vzlo09m1z7s.relation: The righteous look on bliss and on the justice done.

cmp:07ce0d816qdeb8.why: Successful is the one who purifies himself, or who purifies it, the soul. Two short ayat with the same promise, a memorizer's trap.

cmp:0x9igrs05qtphg.why: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book and the idolaters, at the start and the middle of al-Bayyina: their state before the clear proof and their end after rejecting it.
cmp:0x9igrs05qtphg.relation: The same group, before and after the clear proof.

cmp:19f6g7j1o6ke6h.why: The repeated line of al-Kafirun, nor are you worshippers of what I worship, each followed by a different ayah. Exactly what a memorizer needs to keep the surah in order.

cmp:0i1dev40slkrew.why: The two refuge surahs open in the same words and differ in the last word (the daybreak; mankind). A natural pair to learn together.
cmp:0i1dev40slkrew.relation: Seeking refuge from outer and inner evils.

cmp-card:1:6|4:68.why: The prayer for the straight path, and the promise that those who obey would be guided to it: the request and its answer.
cmp-card:1:6|4:68.relation: Request and answer: the worshipper asks for the straight path, and 4:68 says obedience is how it is given.

cmp-card:1:2|6:45.why: Only the praise formula is shared; one is the opening praise, the other closes the account of the wrongdoers being cut off. Different subjects, and the phrase is too common to teach a memorizer anything.

cmp-card:1:6|6:87.why: The prayer for the straight path beside the prophets and their families whom Allah chose and guided to it: the reader asks for the path the prophets walked.
cmp-card:1:6|6:87.relation: The worshipper asks for the path; 6:87 shows who was already guided to it.

cmp-card:1:2|10:10.why: The phrase that opens the Quran is the last call of the people of Paradise. A known point for pondering: praise is the first and the last word.
cmp-card:1:2|10:10.relation: The opening praise of the Book is also the final call of the dwellers of Paradise.

cmp-card:1:6|10:25.why: Only the stock phrase about guiding whom He wills to a straight path; a personal prayer against a general statement about the call to the abode of peace. Too common to add anything.

cmp-card:1:2|14:39.why: Only the opening words of praise are shared; 14:39 is Ibrahim thanking Allah for his sons in old age. Different subjects, nothing to learn from the pairing.

cmp-card:1:6|16:121.why: The prayer for the straight path beside Ibrahim, who was chosen and guided to it because he was grateful: a model of the answered prayer.
cmp-card:1:6|16:121.relation: The path asked for in 1:6 is the path Ibrahim was guided to, and gratitude is named as the way.

cmp-card:1:6|24:46.why: Only the stock phrase about guiding whom He wills to a straight path; 24:46 is about the clear signs sent down. Different subjects.

cmp-card:1:2|35:34.why: Only the opening words of praise; 35:34 is the people of Paradise thanking Allah for removing grief. The shared words are too common to make a card.

cmp-card:1:2|37:182.why: Only the praise formula, here as the closing line of a surah. A memorizer will not confuse the opening of the Fatiha with this, and the subjects differ.

cmp-card:1:2|40:65.why: Only the praise formula closing a call to sincere worship. Stock phrase, different subjects.

cmp-card:1:6|67:22.why: Only the words straight path; 67:22 is a parable comparing the one walking prone with the one walking upright. The link to the prayer is thin.

check.why: Only the straight path is shared; the prayer and the parable are thin together. Drop.

cmp-card:2:23|2:94.why: Only the challenge formula is shared; one challenges the doubters to bring a surah, the other challenges the claim to the hereafter by wishing for death. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:37|2:160.why: Adam's repentance accepted and the promise to accept those who hid the truth then repented: both end with the same divine name of accepting repentance.
cmp-card:2:37|2:160.relation: The first repentance in human history and the door left open for later sinners, closed with the same name.

cmp-card:2:39|2:81.why: Two descriptions of the people of the Fire, one by disbelief and denial, one by sin that surrounds a person, ending in the same verdict. Useful for memorizers and for pondering who earns it.
cmp-card:2:39|2:81.relation: Two routes, disbelief and being engulfed by one's sins, end in the same eternal Fire.

cmp-card:2:40|2:47.why: The same call to the Children of Israel to remember the favour, continuing two ways. A classic place for a memorizer to slip.

cmp-card:2:40|2:122.why: 2:122 repeats 2:47 word for word, and 2:40 with 2:47 is already a card. This pairing adds nothing that card does not show.

check.why: 2:122 is word for word 2:47, and 2:40 with 2:47 is already a card. Truly adds nothing. Drop.

cmp-card:2:62|2:112,2:62|2:262,2:62|2:27.why: Four groups in one surah promised the same reward and freedom from fear and grief: the believers of all communities, the one who submits, the one who spends without reproach, the one who prays and gives zakat. Strong for memorizers and for pondering who earns it.
cmp-card:2:62|2:112,2:62|2:262,2:62|2:27.relation: Different deeds, one promised reward: no fear and no grief.

cmp-card:2:68|2:69.why: Consecutive questions about the cow, each asking again for a detail: same opening, different question. The story shows the people making it harder for themselves.
cmp-card:2:68|2:69.relation: Same story: repeated questions that only add restrictions.

cmp-card:2:94|2:111.why: Two claims of the People of the Book to own the hereafter or Paradise, each met with a challenge to prove it if they are truthful.
cmp-card:2:94|2:111.relation: Same theme: the claim to exclusive Paradise, answered by a demand for proof.

cmp-card:2:97|2:170.why: Only scattered common words; Jibril bringing the revelation versus following the fathers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:103|2:239.why: Only common words like believing and knowing; a reward the Jews missed versus prayer in fear. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:103|2:278.why: Only the common words believe and fear Allah; different subjects (the reward missed by the sorcerers' followers, and leaving usury).

cmp-card:2:103|2:280.why: Only the ending about what is better if you knew; different subjects (the missed reward, and giving debtors time).

cmp-card:2:106|2:148.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things; abrogation versus each having a direction. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:110|2:277,2:112|2:277.why: Prayer and zakat with the promise that good is found with Allah, then the same promise phrased as reward with their Lord and no fear or grief. Shows how one surah repeats the same reward for the same deeds.
cmp-card:2:110|2:277,2:112|2:277.relation: The deeds of 2:110 and the reward of 2:112 meet in 2:277.

cmp-card:2:111|2:135.why: Two claims of the Jews and Christians in the same passage, each opened with the same words and each answered by the Prophet: one asks for their proof, the other points to the way of Ibrahim.
cmp-card:2:111|2:135.relation: Same theme: exclusive claims to salvation and guidance, answered two ways.

cmp-card:2:112|2:262,2:112|2:274.why: Submitting to Allah and spending in His way, by day and night, earn the same reward with the same closing words. Good for a memorizer to see where each ending sits.
cmp-card:2:112|2:262,2:112|2:274.relation: Different deeds, one reward: no fear and no grief.

cmp-card:2:129|2:151.why: Ibrahim's prayer for a messenger and its fulfilment, in nearly the same words; in the answer, purification comes before teaching. A well-known point for pondering and a place memorizers mix up.
cmp-card:2:129|2:151.relation: Prayer and answer: Ibrahim asked for a messenger, and 2:151 says he was sent.

cmp-card:2:144|2:149,2:144|2:150.why: The command to face the Sacred Mosque repeated three times with different continuations. A classic spot for memorizers.
cmp-card:2:144|2:149,2:144|2:150.relation: Same command, repeated for emphasis with a new reason each time.

cmp-card:2:154|2:190.why: Only the phrase in the way of Allah is shared; the martyrs being alive versus the command to fight without transgressing. The phrase is stock.

cmp-card:2:154|2:244.why: Only the phrase in the way of Allah is shared; the martyrs being alive versus the command to fight. The phrase is stock.

cmp-card:2:168|2:208.why: The same warning not to follow Satan's footsteps, said first to all people about food and then to the believers about entering Islam fully. Same ending, different openings: useful for memorizers.
cmp-card:2:168|2:208.relation: Satan's steps are a danger in what we eat and in how fully we submit.

cmp-card:2:190|2:195,2:190|2:244.why: Fight in the way of Allah but do not transgress, for He does not love transgressors; spend in His way and do good, for He loves those who do good. A clear contrast, plus the repeated command to fight.
cmp-card:2:190|2:195,2:190|2:244.relation: Contrast in one passage: what Allah does not love and what He loves.

cmp-card:2:262|2:274.why: Two descriptions of those who spend, one by the absence of reproach, one by spending day and night, secretly and openly, with the same reward. Memorizers need to know which wording goes where.
cmp-card:2:262|2:274.relation: Two qualities of spending, one promised reward.

cmp-card:2:262|2:277,2:274|2:277.why: The spenders and the believers who pray and give zakat share the same reward line. Useful for memorizers and for seeing that spending stands beside prayer.
cmp-card:2:262|2:277,2:274|2:277.relation: Different deeds, one reward: no fear and no grief.

cmp-card:2:51|23:41.why: Only the word wrongdoers is shared; the calf worship versus the blast that destroyed a people. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:53|23:49.why: The same statement that Musa was given the Book so people would be guided; one adds the criterion and addresses the Israelites, the other speaks of them. A memorizer's trap.
cmp-card:2:53|23:49.relation: Same purpose of the Book given to Musa: guidance.

cmp-card:2:92|23:41.why: Only the word wrongdoers is shared; the calf worship versus the blast that destroyed a people. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:11|26:152.why: Corruption in the land claimed as reform: the hypocrites and the transgressors of Thamud.
cmp-card:2:11|26:152.relation: Those who corrupt and call it reform.

cmp-card:2:117|26:24.why: Only the words heavens and earth; creation by the word Be versus Musa answering Pharaoh about the Lord. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:204|35:5.why: Only the words the life of this world are shared; the man whose speech impresses versus the warning not to be deceived. The link is thin.

check.why: Only the life of this world is shared. Drop.

cmp-card:2:284|35:1.why: Only heavens and earth and the stock closing about Allah's power; reckoning of hidden thoughts versus the angels as messengers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:66|36:9.why: Only the words before and behind; a punishment made an example versus a barrier set before the deniers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:66|36:45.why: Only the words before and behind; a punishment made an example versus a call to fear what is ahead. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:77|36:76.why: The same statement that Allah knows what they hide and what they show, once as a rebuke to the Jews, once as comfort to the Prophet. Same words, two uses.
cmp-card:2:77|36:76.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden as a warning to some and a comfort to the Messenger.

cmp-card:2:131|36:58.why: Only the word Lord and a shared root; Ibrahim's submission versus the greeting of peace in Paradise. Different scenes.

cmp-card:2:154|37:36.why: Only the verb of saying; martyrs alive versus the idolaters calling the Prophet a mad poet. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:66|41:42.why: Only the words before and behind; a punishment made an example versus falsehood not reaching the Quran. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:82|41:8.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good, followed by different rewards. A stock phrase; nothing specific to ponder.

cmp-card:2:86|41:31.why: Only the pair this world and the Hereafter; those who sold the Hereafter versus the angels' promise to the steadfast. The shared wording is stock.

check.why: Only this world and the Hereafter, a stock pair. Drop.

cmp-card:2:70|43:49.why: Call on your Lord for us, then we will be guided: the Israelites and Pharaoh's people say the same words to Musa.
cmp-card:2:70|43:49.relation: Two peoples address Musa in the same words, both insincere.

cmp-card:2:92|43:38.why: Only scattered words; the calf after Musa versus the regret of the one with an evil companion. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:117|43:9.why: Only the words heavens and earth; creation by command versus the idolaters admitting who created them. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:131|43:89.why: Only a shared root of peace and submission; Ibrahim's submission versus the Prophet told to turn away. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:97|46:30.why: The Quran described as confirming what came before it and guiding, once about Jibril bringing it, once by the jinn who heard it. A rare shared description.
cmp-card:2:97|46:30.relation: The revelation confirms earlier scripture and guides, said by Allah and repeated by the jinn.

cmp-card:2:98|46:6.why: Only the roots of enmity and disbelief; enmity to Allah's angels versus idols disowning their worshippers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:107|46:32.why: Only the common idea of no protector besides Allah, in a stock wording; the dominion of Allah versus the jinn warning those who ignore the caller. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:176|46:2.why: Only the Book sent down from Allah; disputes about the Book versus a surah opening formula. Too common.

cmp-card:2:209|46:2.why: Only the names Mighty and Wise, a stock pair. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|46:33.why: Only heavens and earth and the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:106|48:21.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things; abrogation versus spoils not yet won. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:107|48:14.why: Only the dominion of the heavens and earth, a stock phrase; no protector versus forgiving whom He wills. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:117|48:7.why: Only the words heavens and earth; creation by command versus Allah's hosts. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:119|48:8.why: We sent you as a bearer of good news and a warner.

check.why: Sent as bearer of good news and warner, in two wordings. Keep.

cmp-card:2:148|48:21.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things; racing to good deeds versus spoils not yet won. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:209|48:7.why: Only the names Mighty and Wise, a stock closing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:209|48:19.why: Only the names Mighty and Wise, a stock closing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|48:14.why: His is what is in the heavens and the earth; He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills.

cmp-card:2:95|49:1.why: Only the words for what hands put forward and the name Knowing; the Jews not wishing for death versus manners before the Prophet. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:103|49:1.why: Only the common words believe and fear Allah. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:107|49:16.why: Only heavens and earth and a verb of knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:116|49:16.why: Only the stock phrase of what is in the heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:137|49:1.why: Only the names Hearing and Knowing, a stock closing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:160|49:10.why: Only the roots of setting right and mercy; repentance versus brotherhood among believers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:182|49:10.why: Both command making peace between people: between heirs after an unjust bequest, and between believers who fight. Same act of reconciliation, closed with mercy.
cmp-card:2:182|49:10.relation: Reconciling people is praised in family disputes and in disputes among believers.

check.why: Making peace between people, in a family dispute and among believers. Keep.

cmp-card:2:192|49:5.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:224|49:1.why: Only fearing Allah and the names Hearing and Knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:224|49:13.why: Only the root of fearing Allah and the name Knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|49:16.why: Only the stock phrase of what is in the heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:32|51:30.why: Angels speaking close with the names Knowing and Wise, in reverse order: to Allah, and to Ibrahim's wife. A memorizer trap.

check.why: The same two names in reverse order; a memorizer trap. Keep.

cmp-card:2:55|51:44.why: The thunderbolt seized them while they looked: the Israelites and Thamud.

cmp-card:2:86|59:3,2:201|59:3.why: This world and the Hereafter set side by side three ways: those who sold the Hereafter, the believers asking for good in both and protection from the Fire, and a people spared punishment in this world but left with the Fire.
cmp-card:2:86|59:3,2:201|59:3.relation: Contrast: the believers ask good in both worlds and safety from the Fire; the deniers face punishment in both.

cmp-card:2:116|59:24.why: Only the stock phrase of what is in the heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:148|59:6.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:190|60:8.why: Two rules for dealing with others: fight those who fight you and do not transgress; be kind and just to those who did not fight you. One says whom Allah does not love, the other whom He loves.
cmp-card:2:190|60:8.relation: Contrast in the rules of war and peace.

cmp-card:2:218|60:7.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:101|63:1.why: Only the words a messenger of Allah came; the People of the Book casting the Book aside versus the hypocrites' false testimony. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:29|65:12.why: Both speak of the creation of seven heavens and of Allah's knowledge of all things. A real shared subject.
cmp-card:2:29|65:12.relation: The seven heavens as a sign of Allah's knowledge and power.

cmp-card:2:148|65:3.why: Only the words all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:261|65:12.why: Only the number seven. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|65:3.why: Only the words all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|65:12.why: Only heavens and earth and the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:173|66:1.why: Only the root of forbidding and the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful; the food laws versus the Prophet forbidding himself something. A possible point that only Allah sets what is lawful, but the wording is too thin.

check.why: Only one root and a stock closing. Drop.

cmp-card:2:199|66:1.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:207|66:1.why: A rare phrase, seeking the pleasure of, used once for Allah and once for wives. The contrast itself is the lesson.
cmp-card:2:207|66:1.relation: Contrast: one sells himself seeking Allah's pleasure; the Prophet is gently asked why he sought his wives' pleasure.

cmp-card:2:218|66:1.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:104|67:28.why: Only painful punishment for the disbelievers, a stock phrase. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:88|69:41.why: The rare rebuke little do they believe, said of the Jews who claimed sealed hearts and of the Makkans who called the Quran poetry. Both refuse the revelation.
cmp-card:2:88|69:41.relation: Two excuses for rejecting revelation, met by the same rebuke.

cmp-card:2:66|72:27.why: Only the words before and behind. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:48|82:19,2:123|82:19.why: The Day when no soul can help another: twice in al-Baqara with intercession and ransom swapped, and once in 82:19 with all command belonging to Allah. A strong memorizer pair plus a theme.
cmp-card:2:48|82:19,2:123|82:19.relation: Same Day, described as one where no soul avails another.

cmp-card:2:82|84:25.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good; different rewards follow. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:2:25|85:11,2:82|85:11.why: Only the generic reward formula for those who believe and do good, with gardens beneath which rivers flow. It recurs across the Quran; this grouping gives nothing particular.

check.why: Only the generic reward formula. Drop.

cmp-card:2:107|85:9.why: Only the dominion of the heavens and earth, a stock phrase. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:116|85:9.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:39|90:19.why: The same verdict on those who reject Our signs: they are the people of the Fire, called in 90:19 the people of the left. Same subject, two wordings.
cmp-card:2:39|90:19.relation: Rejecting the signs and its end, named two ways.

cmp-card:2:82|95:6.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase; nothing particular to learn.

cmp-card:2:82|98:7.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase; nothing particular to learn.

cmp-card:2:209|98:4.why: Only the common phrase after the clear proofs came; slipping versus the People of the Book dividing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:82|103:3.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase; nothing particular to learn.

cmp-card:3:4|3:11.why: Those who deny Allah's signs and their severe punishment, stated generally in 3:4 and shown in Pharaoh's people in 3:11.
cmp-card:3:4|3:11.relation: A rule and its example: denial of the signs brings severe punishment.

cmp-card:3:6|3:62.why: Within Al Imran, both close on the declaration that there is no god but Him, then the names Mighty and Wise, as 3:18 does. A memorizer must place each closing.
cmp-card:3:6|3:62.relation: The surah keeps returning to the oneness of Allah closed with His might and wisdom.

check.why: The same closing on oneness with Mighty and Wise, in one surah. Keep.

cmp-card:3:15|3:198,3:136|3:198.why: Three places in one surah describing gardens with rivers flowing beneath, abiding, each with a different addition (spouses and good pleasure, forgiveness, hospitality from Allah). Useful for a memorizer to keep the endings apart.
cmp-card:3:15|3:198,3:136|3:198.relation: The same Garden, offered to the God-fearing and the repentant, described with different gifts.

cmp-card:3:18|3:62.why: Two declarations of oneness in the same surah, both closing on the names Mighty and Wise. A memorizer's point and a repeated theme.
cmp-card:3:18|3:62.relation: Allah's own witness to His oneness, and the true story that proves it.

cmp-card:3:19|3:199.why: Two kinds of People of the Book: those who differed out of envy, and those who believe humbly. Both close on Allah being swift in reckoning.
cmp-card:3:19|3:199.relation: Contrast within the People of the Book, both told reckoning is swift.

cmp-card:3:21|3:181.why: The crime of killing prophets without right, named twice, each followed by a promised punishment.
cmp-card:3:21|3:181.relation: Same crime of the People of the Book, recorded and answered.

cmp-card:3:25|3:161.why: The same line, every soul paid in full for what it earned and none wronged, about the gathering Day and about whoever cheats. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:3:25|3:161.relation: Full repayment on the Day, applied to a general and a specific sin.

cmp-card:3:29|3:165.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:31|3:129.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:33|3:42.why: Allah chose Al Imran over the worlds, and then Maryam from that family over the women of the worlds. The same verb of choosing ties them.
cmp-card:3:33|3:42.relation: The choice of the family, then of Maryam within it.

cmp-card:3:40|3:165.why: Only the question word how; Zakariya's wonder at a son versus the believers asking why defeat came. One word is too little.

cmp-card:3:52|3:160.why: Only the root of helping; Isa's disciples versus Allah's help in battle. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:57|3:76.why: Only the closing about whom Allah loves or does not love, a stock pattern, and a shared root of paying in full. Different subjects.

check.why: A stock closing on whom God loves. Drop.

cmp-card:3:62|3:126.why: Only the names Mighty and Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:67|3:95,3:70|3:98.why: Two different pairs: Ibrahim described as upright and not of the polytheists (3:67, 3:95), and the rebuke to the People of the Book for disbelieving in the signs (3:70, 3:98). Each pair is good, but they are two things.
cmp-card:3:67|3:95,3:70|3:98.changes: Split into the Ibrahim pair and the rebuke pair, since the card joins two unrelated matches.
cmp-card:3:67|3:95,3:70|3:98.relation: Ibrahim's true way, and the People of the Book rebuked for denying what they witness.

cmp-card:3:83|3:109.why: All in the heavens and earth belong to Allah and return to Him: in 3:83 they submit willingly or not, in 3:109 all matters go back to Him.
cmp-card:3:83|3:109.relation: Everything in creation submits to Allah and returns to Him.

cmp-card:3:86|3:101.why: Two questions of how: how would Allah guide those who disbelieved after belief, and how can you disbelieve while the signs are recited and the Messenger is among you.
cmp-card:3:86|3:101.relation: Disbelief after the proof has come, warned against in the same passage.

cmp-card:3:104|3:114.why: Enjoining good and forbidding evil: commanded of this nation in 3:104, praised in the upright among the People of the Book in 3:114. A memorizer pair with different endings.
cmp-card:3:104|3:114.relation: The same duty, as a command and as praise.

cmp-card:3:122|3:160.why: Both close with the call for the believers to rely on Allah: when two groups almost lost heart, and when victory is His alone.
cmp-card:3:122|3:160.relation: Reliance on Allah as the lesson of the battle.

cmp-card:3:130|3:200.why: Two commands to the believers, leaving usury and holding firm in patience, both closing with fear Allah so that you may succeed.
cmp-card:3:130|3:200.relation: Success tied to fearing Allah in wealth and in steadfastness.

cmp-card:3:157|3:169.why: Those killed in the way of Allah: forgiveness better than what people gather, and they are alive with their Lord.

It is the same question of whom God favours, mocked and then shown true.
