cmp-card:21:52|43:26.why: The same opening of Ibrahim's speech to his father and his people, in two surahs: once questioning the idols, once declaring himself free of them.
cmp-card:21:52|43:26.relation: One story: Ibrahim confronting his father and people, questioning and then disowning.

cmp-card:21:53|43:22,21:53|43:24.why: The same excuse of following the fathers, given to Ibrahim and to every messenger, and the messenger's answer.
cmp-card:21:53|43:22,21:53|43:24.relation: Blind following of forefathers as the deniers' excuse, and the call to something better guided.

cmp-card:21:53|43:26.why: Same story, but the rows do not match: one is the people's reply, the other Ibrahim's disowning. The pairs 21:52 with 43:26 and 21:53 with 43:22 already show the parallel.

cmp-card:21:54|43:40.why: Only the stock phrase clear error is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:55|43:30.why: Only the word truth and a reply are shared; the two answers to the messenger differ in meaning and wording.

cmp-card:21:56|43:82.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:103|43:83.why: The same phrase, the Day they are promised, closes both: the believers are met by angels on it, the deniers are left to play until they meet it.
cmp-card:21:103|43:83.relation: Contrast: one promised Day, met in peace by the believers and in dread by the deniers.

cmp-card:21:112|43:82.why: Only the stock ending about what they describe; a plea for judgment and a glorification are different.

cmp-card:21:4|44:6.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Knowing; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:4|44:7.why: Only the stock words Lord, heaven and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:16|44:7.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; different points.

cmp-card:21:56|44:7.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:4|45:36.why: Only the stock words Lord, heaven and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:41|45:33.why: The same closing clause: what they mocked closed in on them. The deeds wording here (what they did) differs from 39:48 (what they earned), a point for memorizers.
cmp-card:21:41|45:33.relation: Mockery of the warning returns on the mockers.

cmp-card:21:56|45:36.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:16|46:3.why: The same statement about creation in near-identical wording: not in play (21:16), but in truth and for a fixed term (46:3).
cmp-card:21:16|46:3.relation: Creation has a purpose and an end.

cmp-card:21:30|46:33.why: Both open with the same rebuke to the deniers and point to the creation of the heavens and earth as proof of His power over life.
cmp-card:21:30|46:33.relation: Have they not seen: creation as the proof of giving life and raising the dead.

cmp-card:21:38|46:22.why: The same defiant demand by deniers in two ages: bring what you promise us, if you are truthful.
cmp-card:21:38|46:22.relation: Deniers of every age challenge the messenger to bring the threatened punishment.

cmp-card:21:78|48:19.why: Only words from the same root as judgment and wisdom; Dawud and Sulayman's ruling and the spoils of war are unrelated.

cmp-card:21:4|49:16.why: Only the stock statement that Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:4|49:18.why: Only the stock statement of Allah's knowledge of the heavens and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:16|50:38.why: The same creation of the heavens, earth and what is between them, with two denials: not in play, and with no fatigue.
cmp-card:21:16|50:38.relation: Creation done with purpose and without weariness.

cmp-card:21:4|51:23.why: Only the words Lord, heaven and earth; Allah hearing speech and an oath on the truth of provision are different.

cmp-card:21:56|51:23.why: Only the common title Lord of the heaven and earth; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:16|52:36.why: Only the creation of the heavens and earth is shared; creation not in play and the question whether they created them are different points.

cmp-card:21:4|64:4.why: Both say Allah knows all speech, secret and open, in heaven and earth; 21:4 answers the deniers' secret talk in 21:3.
cmp-card:21:4|64:4.relation: Nothing said in secret is hidden from Allah.

check.why: God knows all that is said and kept secret in heaven and earth. Keep.

cmp-card:21:16|64:3.why: Two sides of one point about creation: the heavens and earth were not made in play, they were made in truth.
cmp-card:21:16|64:3.relation: Creation has a purpose: not play, but truth.

cmp-card:21:36|67:28.why: Only the word disbelievers and seeing are shared; the deniers mocking the Prophet and the question who will protect them are different points.

cmp-card:21:38|67:25.why: The same ayah word for word in two surahs; a memorizer must know where it recurs and what follows each time.
cmp-card:21:38|67:25.relation: The deniers' recurring taunt about the promised Hour.

cmp-card:21:49|67:12.why: The same description of the believers, those who fear their Lord unseen, with two endings: their dread of the Hour, and their forgiveness and reward.
cmp-card:21:49|67:12.relation: Fearing Allah unseen: its sign and its reward.

cmp-card:21:54|67:29.why: Only the stock phrase clear error is shared; Ibrahim's charge to his people and the Prophet's declaration of trust are different points.

cmp-card:21:61|67:30.why: Only the verb bring is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:60|68:51.why: Only hearing and mention are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:103|70:42,21:103|70:44.why: The promised Day closes all three: the believers are met by angels on it; the deniers are left to play until they meet it, then come humbled.
cmp-card:21:103|70:42,21:103|70:44.relation: Contrast: one promised Day, met in peace by the believers and in humiliation by the deniers.

cmp-card:21:42|71:5.why: Only night and day are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:4|78:37.why: Only the words Lord, heaven and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:16|78:37.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; different points.

cmp-card:21:56|78:37.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:56|85:9.why: Only the heavens, earth and the word witness are shared; different points.

cmp-card:21:73|98:5.why: The prophets of Ibrahim's line were inspired to pray, give zakat and worship Allah, and the People of the Book were commanded nothing other than this; the upright religion is the same.
cmp-card:21:73|98:5.relation: The religion of the prophets is the one the People of the Book were commanded.

check.why: The prophets' religion and what the People of the Book were commanded are the same. Keep.

cmp-card:22:3|22:8.why: The same opening in one surah, a few ayat apart, with different continuations; a clear trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:22:3|22:8.relation: Two kinds of disputers about Allah without knowledge: the follower of every devil, and the proud leader without guidance or book.

cmp-card:22:6|22:74.why: Only words from the same roots are shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:8|22:68.why: In one surah: there are those who dispute about Allah without knowledge, and the Prophet is told how to answer them.
cmp-card:22:8|22:68.relation: Disputing about Allah, and the answer: Allah knows best what you do.

check.why: Disputing about God, and how to answer it, in one surah. Keep. The link is two forms of one root, so a rootLink flag would fit.

cmp-card:22:12|22:62.why: What they call on besides Allah is described twice in one surah: it neither harms nor benefits, it is falsehood.
cmp-card:22:12|22:62.relation: The emptiness of what is worshipped besides Allah, against Allah who is the Truth.

cmp-card:22:14|22:23,22:14|22:56.why: 22:14 and 22:23 open identically and differ in their endings, a real trap for memorizers; 22:56 gives the same promise on the Day Allah judges.
cmp-card:22:14|22:23,22:14|22:56.relation: The believers' reward, promised in one surah three times.

cmp-card:22:61|22:75.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Seeing is shared; the alternation of night and day and the choosing of messengers are different subjects.

cmp-card:22:63|23:18.why: The same sign of water sent down from the sky to the earth, shown from two sides: it makes the earth green, and He could take it away.
cmp-card:22:63|23:18.relation: Rain as a sign of His kindness and His power.

cmp-card:22:66|23:37.why: Life, death and life again stated by Allah, and denied by the disbelievers in the same words.
cmp-card:22:66|23:37.relation: Contrast: He gives life, causes death and gives life again; they say we die and live and will not be raised.

cmp-card:22:16|24:1,22:16|24:34,22:16|24.why: The same statement, We sent down clear signs, with different endings; 22:16 and 24:46 both close with Allah guiding whom He wills.
cmp-card:22:16|24:1,22:16|24:34,22:16|24.relation: Clear signs are sent down, and guidance is from Allah.

cmp-card:22:61|24:44.why: The same sign of Allah alternating night and day, with a call to reflect on it.
cmp-card:22:61|24:44.relation: The turning of night and day as a sign of His power.

cmp-card:22:63|24:41.why: Only the opening do you not see that Allah is shared; rain and the glorification of all creatures are different signs.

cmp-card:22:69|24:48.why: Only judging between them is shared; Allah's judgment on the Day and the hypocrites refusing the Messenger's judgment are different.

cmp-card:22:70|24:64.why: Both close a passage with Allah's knowledge of all in the heavens and earth, and of what people do.
cmp-card:22:70|24:64.relation: Allah knows all, and all is recorded and will be told.

cmp-card:22:14|25:70.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; gardens and sins turned to good deeds are different points.

cmp-card:22:66|25:49.why: Only life and death words are shared; human life and death and rain reviving land are different subjects.

cmp-card:22:67|25:31.why: Only the words every and We made, and Lord with guidance; rites for each nation and enemies for each prophet are different points.

cmp-card:22:70|27:25,22:70|27:65,22:70|2.why: Allah's knowledge of what is hidden in the heavens and the earth; 22:70 and 27:75 both add that it is recorded in a book.
cmp-card:22:70|27:25,22:70|27:65,22:70|2.relation: Nothing hidden in heaven or earth escapes His knowledge or His record.

cmp-card:22:50|28:67.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:12|29:42.why: Only what they call on besides Allah is shared; the point of each ayah differs (no harm or benefit; Allah knows them).

cmp-card:22:14|29:58,22:23|29:58,22:56|2.why: Across the surahs only the general reward formula is shared: those who believe and do good, gardens with rivers. Nothing specific links al-Ankabut to al-Hajj here; the strong match of 22:14 with 22:23 is already its own card.

check.why: Across the two surahs only the generic reward formula is shared. The real pair 22:14 and 22:23 has its own card. Drop.

cmp-card:22:50|29:9.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:57|29:23.why: Only the general statement that deniers of the signs have punishment; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:22:62|29:42.why: The same clause about what they call on besides Him, and the same verdict: it is falsehood (22:62), it is nothing (29:42).
cmp-card:22:62|29:42.relation: What is worshipped besides Allah is nothing at all.

check.why: What they call on besides Him is nothing; the same clause and verdict. Keep.

cmp-card:22:70|29:52.why: Only the stock statement that Allah knows what is in the heavens and the earth; the surrounding points differ.

cmp-card:22:6|30:50.why: Nearly the same closing: He gives life to the dead and is able over all things. In 30:50 it follows rain reviving the land, the proof of resurrection.
cmp-card:22:6|30:50.relation: Reviving the dead earth as proof of reviving the dead.

cmp-card:22:8|30:29.why: Only the phrase without knowledge is shared; disputing about Allah and following desires are different points.

cmp-card:22:38|30:45.why: Only the stock statement that Allah does not love the disbelievers; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:50|30:15.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:50|30:45.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:57|30:16.why: The same wording for the deniers' end, and in both surahs it follows straight after the believers' reward; a memorizer must keep the endings apart.
cmp-card:22:57|30:16.relation: Contrast: the believers in gardens, the deniers of the signs in punishment.

cmp-card:22:12|31:11.why: Only besides Allah and error are shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:12|31:30.why: What they call on besides Allah: it neither harms nor benefits (22:12), it is falsehood (31:30).
cmp-card:22:12|31:30.relation: The emptiness of what is worshipped besides Allah.

cmp-card:22:41|31:17.why: The same duties: establish prayer, enjoin good and forbid evil. Once as the mark of those given power, once in Luqman's advice to his son.
cmp-card:22:41|31:17.relation: The same duties, for the ruler and for the young believer, each closed with a word about affairs.

cmp-card:22:50|31:8.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:56|31:8.why: The same promise in close wording: those who believe and do good are in the Gardens of Bliss. Close enough to confuse a memorizer.
cmp-card:22:56|31:8.relation: The believers' reward, the Gardens of Bliss.

cmp-card:22:61|31:29,22:62|31:30.why: Two consecutive ayat repeated almost word for word in two surahs, with different endings; a key passage for memorizers.
cmp-card:22:61|31:29,22:62|31:30.relation: The alternation of night and day, and Allah as the Truth against the falsehood of other gods.

cmp-card:22:64|31:25.why: Only the heavens, earth and praise are shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:74|31:9.why: Only the words Allah, truth and Mighty; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:75|31:28.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Seeing is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:50|32:19.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:56|32:19.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds with gardens; the names of the gardens and the contexts differ.

cmp-card:22:69|32:25.why: The same statement in close wording: on the Day of Resurrection Allah judges between them in what they differed. A memorizer must tell the openings apart.
cmp-card:22:69|32:25.relation: All disputes are settled by Allah on the Day of Resurrection.

cmp-card:22:6|33:27.why: Only the stock closing able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:50|33:31.why: Only noble provision and good deeds are shared; the reward of believers and of the Prophet's wives are different contexts.

cmp-card:22:63|33:34.why: Only the stock closing Subtle, Aware; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:44|34:45.why: Both close with the same question after earlier nations denied: then how was My rejection.
cmp-card:22:44|34:45.relation: The end of those who denied the messengers before.

cmp-card:22:50|34:4,22:51|34:5,22:54|34:.why: Three matching ayat in the same order: the believers' forgiveness and noble provision, those who strive against the signs, and those given knowledge seeing it is the truth. A strong parallel for memorizers and for pondering.
cmp-card:22:50|34:4,22:51|34:5,22:54|34:.relation: One sequence in two surahs: the believers' reward, the opponents' end, and the knowers' recognition of the truth.

cmp-card:22:51|34:38.why: The same description of those who strive to defeat Our signs, with two endings a memorizer must keep apart.
cmp-card:22:51|34:38.relation: The end of those who strive against the signs.

cmp-card:22:63|34:1.why: Only heaven, earth and Aware; different points.

cmp-card:22:64|34:1.why: The same statement that all in the heavens and the earth is His, joined to praise.
cmp-card:22:64|34:1.relation: Owner of all, and so the Praised.

cmp-card:22:44|35:26.why: The same words: then I seized them, and how was My rejection.
cmp-card:22:44|35:26.relation: The end of those who denied the messengers.

cmp-card:22:50|35:7.why: Close wording a memorizer can confuse: forgiveness and noble provision (22:50), forgiveness and a great reward (35:7). Both set the believers against the deniers.
cmp-card:22:50|35:7.relation: The believers' forgiveness and reward, beside the deniers' punishment.

cmp-card:22:61|35:13.why: The same words for the alternation of night and day; 35:13 also matches 31:29 with the sun and moon.
cmp-card:22:61|35:13.relation: The turning of night and day as a sign of His power.

cmp-card:22:64|35:15.why: Only the stock closing the Rich, the Praised is shared; His ownership and people's need of Him are different points.

cmp-card:22:70|35:38.why: Only the stock statement of Allah's knowledge of the heavens and earth; nothing specific shared.

cmp-card:22:76|35:4.why: Only the stock closing that matters return to Allah is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:6|36:12.why: Both declare that Allah gives life to the dead, and close with His power or His record of all things.
cmp-card:22:6|36:12.relation: Giving life to the dead, and all things counted.

cmp-card:22:76|36:9.why: Before them and behind them means different things: Allah's knowledge and a barrier set on the deniers.

cmp-card:22:76|36:45.why: Only the phrase before and behind is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:14|39:20.why: Only the general phrase about rivers flowing beneath is shared; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:22:69|39:46.why: Both say Allah judges between people in what they differed; once as a statement, once in the Prophet's prayer.
cmp-card:22:69|39:46.relation: Every dispute is left to Allah's judgment.

cmp-card:22:7|40:59.why: The same declaration that the Hour is coming, no doubt in it, with two different continuations; a point for memorizers.
cmp-card:22:7|40:59.relation: The certainty of the Hour, and those who still do not believe.

cmp-card:22:61|40:20.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Seeing is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:62|40:12,22:62|40:20.why: Allah is the Truth and what they call on besides Him is nothing; 22:62 and 40:12 both close with the Most High, the Great, and 40:20 says their gods judge nothing.
cmp-card:22:62|40:12,22:62|40:20.relation: Allah alone is the Truth and the Judge; the gods they call on have no power.

cmp-card:22:69|40:48.why: The promise that Allah will judge between people, and the proud in Hell admitting He has judged.

check.why: Judgment promised and then confessed as done. Keep.

cmp-card:22:75|40:20.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Seeing is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:6|41:39.why: Nearly the same closing: He gives life to the dead and is able over all things. In 41:39 it follows rain reviving the land.
cmp-card:22:6|41:39.relation: Reviving the dead earth as proof of reviving the dead.

cmp-card:22:50|41:8.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:60|41:6.why: Only incidental words are shared; retaliation and the message of one God are unrelated.

cmp-card:22:76|41:42.why: Before and behind means different things: Allah's knowledge, and the Book guarded from falsehood.

cmp-card:22:35|42:38.why: Two portraits of the believers ending the same way: they establish prayer and spend from what We provided.
cmp-card:22:35|42:38.relation: The marks of true believers: prayer and spending.

cmp-card:22:74|42:19.why: Only the stock closing the Strong, the Mighty is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:69|43:63.why: Only the word differ is shared; Allah's judgment on the Day and Isa explaining their differences are different points.

cmp-card:22:6|44:8.why: Only giving life is shared; the resurrection argument and the declaration of oneness are different points.

cmp-card:22:19|44:48.why: The same punishment in close words: scalding water poured over the head of the denier.
cmp-card:22:19|44:48.relation: The punishment of those who disputed about their Lord.

cmp-card:22:50|45:30.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

check.why: Only the stock formula with different rewards. Drop.

cmp-card:22:57|45:9,22:57|45:11.why: Those who deny or mock Our signs, and their punishment: humiliating in 22:57 and 45:9, painful in 45:11. A memorizer must keep the endings apart.
cmp-card:22:57|45:9,22:57|45:11.relation: Denying or mocking the signs brings a humiliating punishment.

cmp-card:22:6|46:33.why: Nearly the same closing: able to give life to the dead, and able over all things.
cmp-card:22:6|46:33.relation: His power over creation proves His power to raise the dead.

cmp-card:22:12|46:32.why: Only besides Him and error are shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:67|46:25.why: Only incidental words are shared; rites for each nation and the wind that destroyed Ad are unrelated.

cmp-card:22:14|47:12,22:23|47:12,22:56|4.why: 47:12 opens with exactly the same words as 22:14 and 22:23, then each goes its own way; a real trap for memorizers. 47:12 adds the contrast with the deniers who eat like cattle.
cmp-card:22:14|47:12,22:23|47:12,22:56|4.relation: Contrast in 47:12: gardens for the believers, the Fire for those who only enjoy and eat.

cmp-card:22:68|47:30.why: Only Allah's knowledge of deeds is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:6|48:21.why: Only the stock closing able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:14|48:5,22:23|48:5.why: 48:5 shares only the general reward of gardens with rivers; the specific opening that links 22:14 and 22:23 is not there.

check.why: 48:5 shares only the generic reward. Drop.

cmp-card:22:70|49:16,22:70|49:18.why: Only the stock statement that Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth; the points differ (it is written in a book; you cannot teach Allah your religion).

cmp-card:22:75|49:1.why: Only messengers and a closing name are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:42|50:12.why: The same list of earlier nations who denied, with differences in the names; useful for memorizers and as consolation.
cmp-card:22:42|50:12.relation: The Prophet consoled: nations before denied their messengers too.

cmp-card:22:70|50:4.why: Both join Allah's knowledge to a book that records it.
cmp-card:22:70|50:4.relation: Allah's knowledge is complete and recorded.

check.why: God's knowledge joined to a recording book. Thin but real. Keep.

cmp-card:22:6|54:49.why: Only all things and a word of the same root as power are shared; different statements.

cmp-card:22:22|54:37.why: Only taste the punishment is shared; different scenes.

cmp-card:22:42|54:9.why: The same opening about earlier nations who denied before them.
cmp-card:22:42|54:9.relation: Nations before denied their messengers too.

cmp-card:22:44|54:18.why: The same question after the destruction of a denying people, worded differently: how was My rejection, how was My punishment and warnings.
cmp-card:22:44|54:18.relation: The end of those who denied the messengers.

cmp-card:22:6|57:2.why: Both join giving life to His power over all things.
cmp-card:22:6|57:2.relation: He gives life and death, and nothing is beyond Him.

cmp-card:22:16|57:9.why: Both speak of clear signs sent down, and what they lead to: guidance (22:16), out of darkness into light (57:9).
cmp-card:22:16|57:9.relation: Clear signs sent down for guidance.

cmp-card:22:61|57:6.why: The same words for the alternation of night and day, with different closings.
cmp-card:22:61|57:6.relation: The turning of night and day as a sign of His power and knowledge.

cmp-card:22:64|57:24.why: Only the stock closing the Rich, the Praised is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:70|57:22.why: Both say all is in a book and close with the same words: that is easy for Allah.
cmp-card:22:70|57:22.relation: All things, even every misfortune, are recorded beforehand, and this is easy for Allah.

cmp-card:22:76|57:5.why: Only the stock closing that matters return to Allah is shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:74|58:21.why: Only the stock closing Strong, Mighty is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:69|60:3.why: Both say that on the Day of Resurrection Allah will judge between you; in 60:3 even kin and children will not help then.
cmp-card:22:69|60:3.relation: On the Day of Resurrection only Allah's judgment counts.

cmp-card:22:14|61:12.why: Only the general phrase about gardens with rivers is shared; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:22:10|62:7.why: Only the common phrase about what their hands sent ahead is shared; the disputer's punishment and the Jews not wishing for death are different points.

check.why: Only a common phrase, with different points. Drop.

cmp-card:22:6|64:1.why: Only the stock closing able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:57|64:10.why: The same opening about those who disbelieve and deny Our signs, with different endings; a trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:22:57|64:10.relation: The end of those who deny the signs.

cmp-card:22:63|64:8.why: Only sent down and the closing Aware are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:70|64:4.why: Only the stock statement of Allah's knowledge of the heavens and earth; the points differ.

cmp-card:22:14|65:11.why: Only the general reward formula is shared; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:22:6|67:1.why: Only the stock closing able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:44|67:18.why: Both close the same way after earlier nations denied: how was My rejection.
cmp-card:22:44|67:18.relation: The end of those who denied before.

cmp-card:22:49|67:26.why: The same command to the Prophet to declare he is only a clear warner, in different settings.
cmp-card:22:49|67:26.relation: The Prophet's role: only a warner, the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah.

cmp-card:22:49|71:2.why: The same words of warning from Muhammad to mankind and from Nuh to his people.
cmp-card:22:49|71:2.relation: Every messenger is a clear warner to his people.

cmp-card:22:76|72:27.why: Only before and behind is shared; different subjects.

tree:095kk3k09zmibw.why: The inheritance law repeats the same condition in both ayat: every share is paid only after a bequest or debt is settled. A memorizer must track the varying verb form in each place.
tree:095kk3k09zmibw.relation: The same condition runs through all the shares of the inheritance law.

tree:0oou5g30oaqhyn.why: Same scene told twice: Pharaoh threatens the magicians who believed. The wording is near identical, with differences to note: an added warning in 26:49, and a different end to the threat in each.
tree:0oou5g30oaqhyn.relation: One event in two surahs: the believing magicians facing Pharaoh's threat.

tree:07qgkrr1sv87e3.why: Same declaration of Allah's dominion opening three ayat, each continuing differently; 2:107 and 9:116 both end with no protector or helper besides Allah, while 5:40 speaks of punishing and forgiving. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:093abcj0r9hgxx.why: The deniers' same question about being raised after becoming dust and bones, in four places; 37:53 alone ends with being judged instead of raised. Classic memorizer trap, and one theme: denial of resurrection.
tree:093abcj0r9hgxx.relation: The same disbelief in resurrection, answered differently in each surah.

tree:0gujjom0e2n2nu.why: A stock closing formula on Allah's power, shared by unrelated ayat on many subjects. Nothing to learn from seeing these together; it is a search, not a card.

tree:1ql64tj1p4g0vl.why: The same list of patriarchs in two nearby ayat of al-Baqara: in 2:136 the believers declare faith in what was revealed to them, in 2:140 Jews and Christians are refuted for claiming them as their own.
tree:1ql64tj1p4g0vl.changes: Add 3:84 and 4:163, which carry the same list; 3:84 is the classic twin of 2:136. They sit in another card only because the name is spelled differently in the script.
tree:1ql64tj1p4g0vl.relation: Contrast: the list as an object of faith versus the list as a disputed claim.

check.why: The same list of patriarchs, split into two cards only by a spelling difference. Merging 2:136, 2:140, 3:84 and 4:163 is right; 2:136 and 3:84 are classic twins. Keep with the change.

tree:1b2fybp1y0ncvd.why: The same list of patriarchs: 3:84 is the declaration of faith in all revelation, 4:163 lists those to whom Allah revealed as He revealed to the Prophet.
tree:1b2fybp1y0ncvd.changes: Add 2:136 and 2:140, which carry the same list; 2:136 is the classic twin of 3:84. They sit in another card only because the name is spelled differently in the script.
tree:1b2fybp1y0ncvd.relation: One chain of revelation, stated as faith in 3:84 and as Allah's act in 4:163.

check.why: The same merge as tree:1ql64tj1p4g0vl, proposed from the other side. Right, though the two now propose one identical card, so one of them should give way when applied.

tree:0oejs4v1tp2e57.why: Same statement that Allah varied the reminders for people and most refused all but disbelief. Two wordings of the first half to keep apart.
tree:0oejs4v1tp2e57.relation: The same complaint about people's refusal despite varied reminders.

tree:1gyr70d19kyrfp.why: Both ayat show the worthlessness of protectors taken besides Allah: in 29:41 as a spider's flimsy house, in 45:10 as nothing that will avail them before Hell.
tree:1gyr70d19kyrfp.relation: The weakness of false protectors, shown by a parable and by the Hereafter.

tree:0b3giaq1prpnwq.why: A rare full clause, fear Allah to whom you will be gathered, closing a command in only these two places (hunting in ihram, and secret counsel). Useful for a memorizer even though the subjects differ.

tree:1u6tjut1ekdgdv.why: The same exhortation, fear Allah if you are believers, in only these two places, both in al-Ma'ida: once to the believers, once from Jesus to the disciples asking for the table. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:1sbr54s1yiu9mo.why: Two neighbouring ayat end with the same promise of being rewarded by the best of what they did, the first for the patient, the second for every believer who does good. A memorizer needs to see them together.
tree:1sbr54s1yiu9mo.relation: The same reward promised to the patient and to every believing doer of good.

tree:0x4e00q15gyoh4.why: Same scene: Abraham questions his father and people about their worship. The question is worded fully in 21:52 and briefly in 26:70.
tree:0x4e00q15gyoh4.relation: One event told in two surahs.

tree:17jpnea0iw7goy.why: The same command to remember Allah much that you may succeed, once in the face of the enemy and once in the market after Friday prayer.
tree:17jpnea0iw7goy.relation: Remembrance asked for both in battle and in daily trade.

tree:0izljco02tepd2.why: Both call the believers to remember Allah's favour, then name a specific event: hearts joined after enmity in 3:103, enemies' hands held back in 5:11.
tree:0izljco02tepd2.relation: Allah's favour remembered through concrete events of protection and unity.

tree:1d5ybh81twbivm.why: The two sides of the same oath procedure between spouses: the husband swears he is truthful, the wife swears he is lying.
tree:1d5ybh81twbivm.relation: Mirror oaths in one law: truthful against lying.

tree:0h4czjg07akbr8.why: The same command to seek refuge in Allah with two different closing names: the Hearing, the Seeing in 40:56 and the Hearing, the Knowing in 41:36. A classic memorizer pair in neighbouring surahs.

tree:068mgkx12p78ln.why: The same scene of the wrongdoers hiding regret when they see the punishment, continued differently: judgment with justice in 10:54, chains on necks in 34:33.
tree:068mgkx12p78ln.relation: The same moment of regret on seeing the punishment.

tree:182re8v0bcjt1h.why: The same description of whoever submits his face to Allah while doing good: in 2:112 he has his reward, in 4:125 he follows the way of Abraham.
tree:182re8v0bcjt1h.relation: Two consequences of the same submission: reward, and the best of religion.

tree:1fdbl3d06ouh2h.why: Same command to obey Allah and the Messenger, then if they turn away, his duty is only clear delivery. Wording differs in the middle, which a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1fdbl3d06ouh2h.relation: The same rule on the Messenger's duty in two surahs.

tree:1c06d9q1niftyc.why: Within one surah: Allah commands the Prophet to worship Him with sincere religion, then the Prophet declares he was commanded exactly that.
tree:1c06d9q1niftyc.relation: A command and the Prophet's own declaration of it.

tree:140nofm07sv7xg.why: The same threat of severe punishment prepared by Allah, opening an ayah in two neighbouring surahs, with different continuations. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:1bn93d503lg897.why: The same prayer for forgiveness and mercy ending differently: best of forgivers in 7:155 (Moses), best of the merciful in 23:109 (the believers).
tree:1bn93d503lg897.relation: One prayer in the mouth of Moses and of the believers.

tree:1d26o6l0egsjoh.why: The same command to pray, give alms and obey, then the object differs: the Messenger in 24:56, Allah and His Messenger in 58:13. A memorizer pair.

tree:1f0yl620xhepn2.why: Two consecutive ayat on the same people and their eating of the unlawful, ending with what they used to do and what they used to work, a classic memorizer difference.
tree:1f0yl620xhepn2.relation: Blame on the sinners, then on the scholars who did not forbid them.

tree:0cl2p6a1vk0fs4.why: Both protect wives from being pressured or put out of their homes, with the same single exception of open immorality. Same subject in two laws.
tree:0cl2p6a1vk0fs4.relation: The one exception that lifts a wife's protection, in marriage and in divorce.

tree:1h9pavb1je4zwd.why: The same exception on the Day: none speaks or intercedes except whom the Most Merciful permits, ending with being pleased with his word in 20:109 and speaking what is right in 78:38.
tree:1h9pavb1je4zwd.relation: Permission to speak on the Day of Judgment, described from two sides.

tree:0ayjze714u3fud.why: Both address all mankind and ground the oneness of Allah in His dominion over heavens and earth, then draw a different conclusion: believe in the Messenger, or how are you turned away. The shared part beyond the stock phrase is thin.
tree:0ayjze714u3fud.relation: Two calls to mankind arguing from creation to the oneness of Allah.

check.why: Two calls to mankind arguing from God's dominion to His oneness. Keep.

tree:0t8fdyr1p0grf1.why: What was revealed to the Prophet from his Lord is the truth: most people do not believe it (13:1), while those given knowledge see it (34:6).
tree:0t8fdyr1p0grf1.relation: Contrast: most people reject the revelation, the knowledgeable recognise it.

tree:10t511x0lxgep9.why: The creation of mankind from a single soul and its mate, told with two different verbs for making the mate. A classic memorizer pair, and one theme.
tree:10t511x0lxgep9.relation: The same origin of mankind, told as a call to piety and as a story of the first couple.

tree:1qc2l8u154x9b0.why: Only the stock formula of those who believe and do good with their reward; the contexts are unrelated and nothing is learned from the pair.

tree:1qxo81v1cpfuup.why: Both picture the Day of Judgment sorting people, with the believers placed in gardens named differently in each. The formula is common but the setting is shared.
tree:1qxo81v1cpfuup.relation: The believers' place in the judgment scene, named two ways.

check.why: The believers' place in the judgment scene, named two ways. Keep.

tree:0tt11ka0oghls2.why: The shared word after the formula is a different word in each: from His bounty in 30:45, out of darkness in 65:11. Beyond that only the stock formula is shared.

tree:1nlm1a91h3cmel.why: Both show the gods taken besides Allah failing those who took them: a spider's flimsy house in 29:41, gods who abandoned their worshippers in 46:28.
tree:1nlm1a91h3cmel.relation: The helplessness of false gods, by parable and by history.

tree:0gu476k1fzzn1i.why: The same opening about those who took protectors besides Him, continued differently: their excuse that the idols bring them near in 39:3, Allah watching over them in 42:6. A memorizer pair.
tree:0gu476k1fzzn1i.relation: The idolaters' claim and Allah's watch over them.

tree:1pj1ndd0il2p7x.why: The same phrase about those worshipped besides Allah: the Prophet refuses to worship them (10:104), and Abraham shows they cannot provide (29:17).
tree:1pj1ndd0il2p7x.relation: Refusing false worship, and the reason: they own nothing.

tree:0h65de403m4axy.why: The same rare clause about those who split their religion into sects, with different conclusions: the Prophet has nothing to do with them, and each faction rejoices in its own.
tree:0h65de403m4axy.relation: The danger of sectarian division, stated twice.

tree:05904vz1rqdxo1.why: Both speak of those killed in Allah's cause and promise them a gain: they are alive with their Lord (3:169), their deeds are not lost (47:4).

tree:1fl9u4n1byb169.why: Same story: Noah saved and the people who denied Our signs drowned, with a different description of the people in each surah.
tree:1fl9u4n1byb169.relation: One event, Noah's people drowned, in two surahs.

tree:1oqqi7g0j5k6em.why: Close neighbours in al-A'raf with the same subject, those who deny Our signs and are arrogant, and two consequences: the Fire, and the gates of heaven closed to them.
tree:1oqqi7g0j5k6em.relation: Two fates of the arrogant deniers.

tree:15tkk440wl09v2.why: The same threat of painful punishment for the disbelievers among them, introduced by two different verbs. A memorizer pair.

tree:1wss4dm0vmt39m.why: Two neighbouring ayat on those who do not believe in Allah's signs: Allah does not guide them, and they are the ones who invent lies.
tree:1wss4dm0vmt39m.relation: The deniers described twice in a row: unguided, and the true liars.

tree:1rexad208e12qk.why: Both end with the aim of becoming God-fearing and mention those before you: worship of the Creator in 2:21, fasting in 2:183.
tree:1rexad208e12qk.relation: Piety as the aim of both worship and fasting.

tree:1r7wmu802esyb2.why: Those they call on besides Him answer nothing (13:14) and judge nothing (40:20), each set against Allah's true call or true judgment.
tree:1r7wmu802esyb2.relation: The false gods' helplessness against Allah's truth.

tree:1yn06290fg6tpv.why: A rare clause: opposing the Messenger after guidance has become clear, with the consequence in each. Same subject.
tree:1yn06290fg6tpv.relation: The fate of those who oppose the Messenger knowingly.

tree:1iezmus11979tg.why: The sun, moon and stars subjected by His command, as part of creation in 7:54 and as a sign for those who reason in 16:12.
tree:1iezmus11979tg.relation: The same cosmic order seen as Allah's creation and as a sign.

tree:1wyq6g01bpu00i.why: Only the stock closing that there are signs in that is shared; the word before it belongs to different phrases, and the subjects (Moses' mission, birds in the sky) are unrelated.

tree:0h3bjpp1ux09wt.why: Allah is the creator of all things, closing with two different attributes: the One, the Subduer in 13:16, and Guardian over all things in 39:62. A memorizer pair.
tree:0h3bjpp1ux09wt.relation: From creation of all things to two attributes of Allah.

tree:1xzr1910kze2br.why: Two agreements sealed by making Allah the guarantor of what is said: Jacob with his sons, and Moses with the old man of Madyan.
tree:1xzr1910kze2br.relation: Covenants witnessed by Allah in two prophets' lives.

tree:1u9sjv20gfwnyi.why: Allah begins creation then repeats it, closed differently: how are you deluded in 10:34, then to Him you return in 30:11.
tree:1u9sjv20gfwnyi.relation: Resurrection argued from the first creation.

tree:0m80mmy1rmsqao.why: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection: between the believers and the hypocrites in 4:141, over what you differed in at 22:69. Two continuations to keep apart.
tree:0m80mmy1rmsqao.relation: Disputes left to Allah's judgment on the Last Day.

tree:1x3yozo0v96jy8.why: The same list of the oppressed men, women and children in one surah: in 4:75 the believers must fight for them, in 4:98 they are excused from emigrating.
tree:1x3yozo0v96jy8.relation: The weak among the believers: a duty to defend them and an excuse granted to them.

tree:0h9kqaq1lpe8rk.why: The same rebuke said to the deniers in Hell: the Fire you used to deny, introduced differently in each place. Same scene and a memorizer pair.
tree:0h9kqaq1lpe8rk.relation: The deniers faced with the very Fire they denied.

tree:0mxu35c1olq4n8.why: The blessed land appears twice in al-Anbiya': Abraham and Lot saved to it, and the wind carrying Solomon's command to it. Same surah, different endings.
tree:0mxu35c1olq4n8.relation: One blessed land in two prophets' stories.

tree:0zik2ph0ev2egj.why: Revelation came to the Prophet and to those before him: in 39:65 with the warning against associating partners, in 42:3 as Allah's way of revealing. Neighbouring surahs.
tree:0zik2ph0ev2egj.relation: One revelation shared by all prophets.

tree:1jel2fy13nqdk4.why: Noah (10:72) and the Prophet (27:91) each declare they were commanded to be among those who submit, after different lead-ins.
tree:1jel2fy13nqdk4.relation: Two prophets with the same declaration of submission.

tree:0tliifk1xvzxz8.why: Same rare description of a community that guides by the truth and does justice by it: among the people of Moses, and among those We created.
tree:0tliifk1xvzxz8.relation: The righteous community, first among Moses' people and then in general.

tree:10m8th30ahtqw3.why: The same closing threat to the wrongdoers ends two ayat about false partners: Satan disowning those who associated him with Allah, and partners who legislated religion without Allah's leave.
tree:10m8th30ahtqw3.relation: Association of partners and its punishment.

tree:1nst4dy1tzpi08.why: A closing found only in these two places: Allah is kind and merciful to people, after the change of qibla in 2:143 and after the subjection of earth and sea in 22:65. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:07ga1531uemb5x.why: Allah does not love every one of a kind: the treacherous ingrate (22:38) and the arrogant boaster (31:18). A memorizer pair with two different types named.
tree:07ga1531uemb5x.relation: Two kinds of people Allah does not love.

tree:1re3oht1h7hmzd.why: Allah does not break His promise, said by the believers about the Day of gathering in 3:9 and by Allah about His promise coming upon the deniers in 13:31.
tree:1re3oht1h7hmzd.relation: Allah's promise, trusted by the believers and awaiting the deniers.

tree:0ttmw3o0mzjymq.why: The same sentence to the punished: that is for what your hands sent ahead, and Allah is never unjust to His servants. A memorizer pair, with a singular and plural for hands.
tree:0ttmw3o0mzjymq.changes: Add 3:182, which carries the same sentence word for word as 8:51.
tree:0ttmw3o0mzjymq.relation: Punishment as the fruit of one's own deeds.

check.why: The same sentence to the punished. Adding 3:182, its word-for-word twin, is right. Keep with the change.

tree:0udsezd1b784qr.why: Two places in at-Tawba close with Allah being the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful: about accepting repentance and charity, and about the three who stayed behind.
tree:0udsezd1b784qr.relation: Allah's acceptance of repentance in the same surah of repentance.

tree:0b2ab5e124qt0c.why: Deniers tell the believers or the warners that they are only in error, with different adjectives: clear in 36:47, great in 67:9.
tree:0b2ab5e124qt0c.relation: The deniers accusing the guided of error.

tree:0bc3rhs0xpgkuy.why: If they turn away, the Prophet's duty is only to deliver: closing with Allah seeing His servants in 3:20 and with clear delivery in 16:82.
tree:0bc3rhs0xpgkuy.relation: The Prophet's duty limited to delivering the message.

tree:0q1k9ym06e0d0s.why: Patience is called a matter of firm resolve both to the believers under trial (3:186) and in Luqman's advice to his son (31:17).
tree:0q1k9ym06e0d0s.relation: Patience under hardship as true resolve.

tree:0n1nlzn0ghaofl.why: The rare singular form, a sign for the believers, closes only these two ayat (the ruins of Lot's people, and creation of the heavens). Useful for a memorizer against the common plural.

tree:0vzhnc91h760gl.why: Two adjacent ayat set out the witness's test in Joseph's story: the shirt torn from the front or from the back, with the verdict reversed.
tree:0vzhnc91h760gl.relation: A test by evidence with two mirror outcomes.

tree:1jc0l4k0v35yze.why: Two adjacent offers to bring the Queen's throne to Solomon: the jinn before he rises, the one with knowledge of the Book before the glance returns.
tree:1jc0l4k0v35yze.relation: Contrast: the power of the jinn against the power of knowledge.

tree:0m5wknk0fu58k2.why: In one surah, what was revealed to the Prophet is the truth: most people do not believe (13:1), and the one who knows it is not like the blind (13:19).
tree:0m5wknk0fu58k2.relation: Knowing the revelation is truth, and the blindness of those who do not.

tree:1dl7zej13i2jbh.why: After destroying past nations Allah raised up another generation; the same phrase in 6:6 and 23:31 with a different linking word.
tree:1dl7zej13i2jbh.relation: The succession of nations after destruction.

tree:0yfz2kp1n851gz.why: The warning to see the end of the wrongdoers follows denial of the Quran in 10:39 and Pharaoh's drowning in 28:40.
tree:0yfz2kp1n851gz.relation: The end of wrongdoers as a lesson.

tree:1wzxfs312oa9p7.why: Both close a passage on Moses and Pharaoh with the same call to see the end of the corrupters. Same story.
tree:1wzxfs312oa9p7.relation: Pharaoh's end as the lesson on corruption.

tree:0gbq89i10cqjre.why: The same call to see the end of those warned, after Noah's people were drowned in 10:73 and after past warned nations in 37:73.
tree:0gbq89i10cqjre.relation: The end of the warned nations who denied.

tree:06hqkaq1k3ly0q.why: The same sentence said to the disbelievers in the Fire: you are only repaid for what you did, after telling them patience or excuses are useless.
tree:06hqkaq1k3ly0q.relation: No excuse helps on the Day: only deeds are repaid.

tree:0oh1oc50156yjl.why: The same closing on Allah being aware and seeing of His servants, twice in al-Isra': after His giving of provision, and after Him being witness between the Prophet and the deniers. A memorizer pair in one surah.

tree:112h1db05ts0ap.why: The core message given to every messenger, there is no god but Me, closing with fear Me in 16:2 and worship Me in 21:25.
tree:112h1db05ts0ap.relation: One message of all prophets, with two demands that follow from it.

tree:1huxyj90rtiqhl.why: The same words, I fear Allah the Lord of the worlds, in the mouth of Adam's righteous son refusing to kill, and in Satan's mouth disowning the man he misled.
tree:1huxyj90rtiqhl.relation: Contrast: a sincere fear of Allah, and the same words used by Satan as betrayal.

tree:12n8p950y8dfzv.why: The same description of those who bought error for guidance: the hypocrites, and those who hide the Book. 2:175 adds punishment for forgiveness. A memorizer pair in one surah.
tree:12n8p950y8dfzv.relation: The losing trade of choosing error over guidance.

tree:1azvfud1wpkxu9.why: The same promise that the doers of good enter Paradise and are not wronged, ending with not a speck in 4:124 and not at all in 19:60.
tree:1azvfud1wpkxu9.relation: Paradise for faith with deeds, and the repentant included.

tree:04p9p7h1h7n797.why: Both say a small patient band defeats a larger one by Allah's leave, and Allah is with the patient: Talut's army, and the believers at war.
tree:04p9p7h1h7n797.relation: The few who are patient overcome the many by Allah's leave.

tree:04r43bm1mrhxhe.why: Both list signs in creation, including spreading every kind of creature on the earth, then continue differently. Same theme.
tree:04r43bm1mrhxhe.relation: Living creatures as one of the signs of creation.

check.why: Keep is right: two lists of signs in creation, each with the spreading of every creature.

tree:06hy8ak0dxwspq.why: Whoever turns away or disbelieves after that are the defiant: after the covenant of the prophets in 3:82, after the promise of succession in 24:55. A memorizer pair.
tree:06hy8ak0dxwspq.relation: Turning away after a covenant or a promise as defiance.

tree:1uqhnjl1jt64yx.why: Both argue that the Creator is able to give life to the dead, from the creation of heavens and earth in 46:33 and from man's creation from a drop in 75:40.

tree:11v0m0n1kjjqb5.why: The same verdict on some People of the Book, cursed or sealed for their disbelief so they believe only a little, twice in an-Nisa'. A memorizer pair.
tree:11v0m0n1kjjqb5.relation: Disbelief leading to a sealed heart.

tree:1vrisi00b090jk.why: What Allah gave of His bounty appears in neighbouring ayat: martyrs rejoicing in it (3:170), the miserly withholding it (3:180).
tree:1vrisi00b090jk.relation: Contrast: rejoicing in Allah's bounty against hoarding it.

tree:05992i21btfmlc.why: Faced with clear signs, deniers say this is nothing but magic (Pharaoh's people) or nothing but a man who wants to turn you from your fathers' gods (the Prophet's people).
tree:05992i21btfmlc.relation: The same denial of clear signs, against Moses and against the Prophet.

tree:1hwy1xb0ypv0j3.why: The same sign of clouds gathered and rain coming from within them, falling on whom He wills. Same theme in two surahs.
tree:1hwy1xb0ypv0j3.relation: Rain from clouds as a sign of Allah's power.

tree:0ds48ve0p2tkto.why: The same command not to associate partners and to be good to parents, followed by different duties in 4:36 and 6:151. Classic memorizer pair and one theme.
tree:0ds48ve0p2tkto.relation: Tawhid and kindness to parents opening two lists of duties.

tree:19zxc251eaewmd.why: Salih and Shu'ayb in the same surah both call their people to seek forgiveness and repent, closing with different names of Allah.
tree:19zxc251eaewmd.relation: Two prophets with the same call to repentance.

tree:0c4zugr1vv4o21.why: Same story: Our messengers came to Abraham with good news, then the greeting in 11:69 and the announcement of Lot's town's destruction in 29:31.
tree:0c4zugr1vv4o21.relation: One visit of the angels to Abraham told in two surahs.

tree:0j0vopp00doob3.why: Allah made mates for you from yourselves, continued with children and grandchildren in 16:72 and with mates among cattle in 42:11.
tree:0j0vopp00doob3.relation: Pairs in creation as a sign and blessing.

tree:1rr6azp0dka8f1.why: Until they see what they are promised, then they will know who is weaker: a near-identical warning to the deniers in 19:75 and 72:24.
tree:1rr6azp0dka8f1.relation: The deniers learning the truth only when the promise comes.

tree:1utrc2k0ptbsa2.why: The same instruction not to sit with those who mock Allah's signs until they enter another talk, given to the believers in 4:140 and the Prophet in 6:68.
tree:1utrc2k0ptbsa2.relation: Leaving gatherings where the signs are mocked.

tree:0ow0vml0pstgqj.why: Shu'ayb tells his people it is better for them if they are believers, in both of his tellings (7:85, 11:86). Same story.

tree:1hq5oei15nzp1e.why: The same verdict, that is because they are a people who do not reason, closing two ayat on mockers of prayer and on divided enemies. Rare exact closing, useful for a memorizer.

check.why: A rare exact closing. Keep.

tree:0fbfs2j1hszizb.why: After signs of creation, That is Allah your Lord, His is the dominion: continued with the helplessness of false gods in 35:13 and with no god but He in 39:6.
tree:0fbfs2j1hszizb.relation: From creation to the Lord who owns all dominion.

tree:0g1vxg91mzkx0z.why: The same rare clause: they are returned to Allah, their true Master, after death in 6:62 and on the Day of reckoning in 10:30.
tree:0g1vxg91mzkx0z.relation: The return to the true Master, and the false gods lost.

tree:0aferrl1dojdg5.why: The same command to spend from what We provided before something comes: a Day without trade or friendship (2:254), or death (63:10).
tree:0aferrl1dojdg5.relation: Spend before it is too late: the Day and death.

tree:06m23ze1pwoow6.why: Allah provided good things and preferred them: the children of Adam over much of creation, the children of Israel over the worlds.
tree:06m23ze1pwoow6.relation: Two honourings with the same wording: mankind and Israel.

tree:1nbl8xi1oczbi2.why: Messengers from among you reciting My signs: in 6:130 the jinn and men confess on the Day they came, in 7:35 the children of Adam are told they will come.
tree:1nbl8xi1oczbi2.relation: The same messengers promised in 7:35 and confessed to in 6:130.

tree:09ehn8v0mpvx8t.why: Messengers sent to their peoples came with clear proofs, then two endings: hearts sealed (10:74), the criminals punished and the believers helped (30:47).
tree:09ehn8v0mpvx8t.relation: The pattern of messengers and the fate of those who reject them.

check.why: Keep is right: messengers come to their peoples with clear proofs, then two endings a memorizer must hold.

tree:0w4o7v61ozlt4i.why: The same rare warning in two surahs, followed in both by the same next ayah: We will lead the deniers on step by step, and I give them respite, My plan is firm.
tree:0w4o7v61ozlt4i.relation: Allah's gradual respite for the deniers.

tree:1bu9r8h0lh8vh1.why: Divorce before consummation in two rulings: half the dowry if one was fixed (2:237), no waiting period and a gift (33:49).
tree:1bu9r8h0lh8vh1.relation: Two rulings on the same case.

tree:0lqbnfg0emp1h8.why: The punishment of disgrace in this world: lifted from the people of Jonah when they believed (10:98), tasted by 'Ad (41:16).
tree:0lqbnfg0emp1h8.relation: Contrast: the disgrace removed by faith, and the disgrace inflicted for denial.

check.why: Keep is right: the punishment of disgrace lifted from one people and inflicted on another, a real contrast.

tree:00xv49c1884cos.why: The same promise of forgiveness to those who do good, closing with a great reward in 11:11 and a noble provision in 34:4. A memorizer pair, though the formula is common.

check.why: Forgiveness then a different reward; a closing trap. Keep.

tree:02igv9x1ukxzcj.why: Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth and what you hide and declare: in the hoopoe's words in 27:25, and as a statement in 64:4.
tree:02igv9x1ukxzcj.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden and the open.

tree:1r2a0tm0gfdb1o.why: Two ayat open the same way with a different verb: those who emigrated for Allah after being wronged, and those who argue about Allah after He was answered. The shared words carry different senses, so the link is thin.
tree:1r2a0tm0gfdb1o.relation: Contrast: reward for those who leave for Allah, wrath for those who dispute about Him.

check.why: Those who leave for God and those who dispute about Him, opened alike. Keep.

tree:03i2fcv00vhcql.why: Striving in Allah's cause with wealth and lives earns a higher rank: over those who sit back (4:95), and greater in degree with Allah (9:20).
tree:03i2fcv00vhcql.relation: The rank of those who strive with wealth and life.

tree:16fzb9s1xpfbpu.why: Allah casts terror into the hearts of the disbelievers, after Uhud in 3:151 and at Badr in 8:12, said with We and with I.
tree:16fzb9s1xpfbpu.relation: Terror in the enemy's hearts as Allah's help in battle.

check.why: Keep is right: God casts terror into the disbelievers' hearts in two battles, once said with 'We' and once with 'I'.

tree:0epzbsk0qg0u5q.why: Those who do not hope to meet Us make demands: a different Quran (10:15), angels or seeing their Lord (25:21).
tree:0epzbsk0qg0u5q.relation: The deniers' demands as a cover for not expecting the meeting.

tree:0dr2u9f1q6zkkj.why: Pharaoh's chiefs speak twice in al-A'raf: calling Moses a learned magician, then urging Pharaoh against Moses and his people.
tree:0dr2u9f1q6zkkj.relation: Pharaoh's chiefs before and after the magicians' contest.

tree:1ggrwl31363f0t.why: I was given it only because of knowledge: Qarun's claim in 28:78, and man's claim after a favour in 39:49, both answered.
tree:1ggrwl31363f0t.relation: Ingratitude: crediting one's own knowledge for Allah's gift.

tree:136c81b1th1tav.why: The same list of destroyed peoples before them, Noah, 'Ad and Thamud, then Abraham's people and others in both places. Same theme.
tree:136c81b1th1tav.relation: The past nations as a warning and consolation.

tree:0uj6f991nvynm3.why: If they believe they are guided, if they turn away: they are only in schism (2:137), your duty is only to deliver (3:20). A memorizer pair.
tree:0uj6f991nvynm3.relation: The People of the Book's choice: guidance or turning away.

tree:0295wjo0u8u4xk.why: The deniers demand signs and the answer is the same: signs are only with Allah, continued differently.
tree:0295wjo0u8u4xk.relation: The reply to demands for miracles.

tree:0w77r9u10uzone.why: Asked about the Hour, the answer is the same: its knowledge is only with Allah, then most people do not know (7:187), and perhaps it is near (33:63).
tree:0w77r9u10uzone.relation: The Hour's time known only to Allah.

tree:08gszxm0uqf274.why: The Prophet asks no wage for the message, then it is only a reminder (6:90), except love for kin (42:23). Classic memorizer pair.

tree:1byipdc1dc1d80.why: Are the blind and the seeing equal, then continued with will you not reflect (6:50) and are darkness and light equal (13:16).
tree:1byipdc1dc1d80.relation: The blind and the seeing as faith and disbelief.

tree:1h7tbl214jymow.why: On the Day the idolaters are asked where are those you used to worship (26:92), associate (40:73). A memorizer pair.
tree:1h7tbl214jymow.relation: The false gods missing when called for.

tree:0g0xaa31auop3h.why: Only the common closing on Allah's knowledge of all things; the subjects (the seal of prophets, the treaty at Hudaybiya) are unrelated, and the closing occurs in other places too.

tree:1emczip1jcihsl.why: Both recall Allah holding back the enemy from the believers, at the Trench (33:9) and near Mecca (48:24), and close with Allah seeing what they do.
tree:1emczip1jcihsl.relation: Allah's protection of the believers from their enemies.

tree:01joio013x9ygk.why: A rare closing found only twice: that is written in the Book, after the end of towns in 17:58 and after inheritance among kin in 33:6. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:1gfu03d19crbwv.why: Consolation to the Prophet: before them the people of Noah and 'Ad denied, continued with Thamud in 22:42 and Pharaoh in 38:12.
tree:1gfu03d19crbwv.relation: The Prophet consoled by past nations' denial.

tree:1m59ilh0i0dthn.why: Two close ayat in an-Nahl: so did those before them, after the deniers wait for the angels (16:33) and blame Allah's will for their shirk (16:35).
tree:1m59ilh0i0dthn.relation: The deniers repeating the excuses of earlier nations.

tree:18si3e60tx81fi.why: So did those before them deny: until they tasted Our might (6:148), so see the end of the wrongdoers (10:39). A memorizer pair.
tree:18si3e60tx81fi.relation: Today's deniers repeating the past nations' denial.

tree:1xzkfon1jy6obr.why: Thus We established Joseph in the land, said twice in his story: as a boy in the minister's house, and as ruler over Egypt's stores.
tree:1xzkfon1jy6obr.relation: Two stages of Joseph's establishment, from slave to ruler.

check.why: Keep is right: 'thus We established Joseph in the land' marks two stages of his story.

tree:0fqlr620t5u12c.why: Thus Allah seals the hearts of the disbelievers (7:101), of those who do not know (30:59). A memorizer pair.
tree:0fqlr620t5u12c.relation: The sealing of hearts as the end of persistent denial.

tree:14s86yf1rg54c1.why: Each faction rejoicing in what it has, after people split their religion into sects. Same theme in both places.
tree:14s86yf1rg54c1.relation: Sectarian division and each sect's self-satisfaction.

tree:1hp1xkp1k0jvpt.why: How many generations We destroyed before them: they walk in their dwellings (20:128), they will not return to them (36:31).
tree:1hp1xkp1k0jvpt.relation: The ruins of past nations as a lesson.

check.why: Keep is right: the generations destroyed before them, as a lesson, in both.

tree:0maxwmd0fmrbnr.why: I ask you no wage for it: the Prophet (6:90) and Hud (11:51), with different continuations.
tree:0maxwmd0fmrbnr.relation: Prophets asking no reward for their message.

tree:1brjnmn0d2g23b.why: Do not consume your wealth among you unjustly, continued with bribing judges (2:188) and the exception of trade by consent (4:29).
tree:1brjnmn0d2g23b.relation: The ban on unjust wealth and its lawful alternative.

tree:03adj5z1lzppj5.why: Do not sell My signs for a small price: to the Children of Israel (2:41), and to the rabbis judging by the Torah (5:44).

tree:1i8c54k0kkl626.why: Do not walk on earth arrogantly, with two reasons: you cannot tear the earth (17:37), Allah does not love the boaster (31:18).
tree:1i8c54k0kkl626.relation: Humility in walking, argued two ways.

tree:1fuyoqh17yyt8n.why: The false gods create nothing and are themselves created, the same argument in two surahs.

check.why: Keep is right: the same argument that the false gods create nothing and are themselves created.

tree:0l0759b05fe21n.why: Allah burdens no soul beyond its capacity (2:286), beyond what He gave it (65:7). Classic memorizer pair.
tree:0l0759b05fe21n.relation: Duty measured by ability and by means.

tree:1ygqpje0hxa9oe.why: In Hell the criminal neither dies nor lives, in 20:74 and 87:13, each followed by the success of the purified believer.
tree:1ygqpje0hxa9oe.relation: The state of the damned, set against the saved.

tree:1ubiv5q0ouq99o.why: That you magnify Allah for guiding you, after completing the fast (2:185) and after the sacrifice (22:37).
tree:1ubiv5q0ouq99o.relation: Takbir closing two acts of worship.

tree:1dd65zp1iallpp.why: Revelation sent to warn the Mother of Towns and those around it, said of the Book in 6:92 and of the Arabic Quran in 42:7.
tree:1dd65zp1iallpp.relation: Mecca and its surroundings as the first audience.

tree:1p9dpjf1oxxlif.why: The Prophet cannot guide people himself, but Allah guides whom He wills, in 2:272 and 28:56.
tree:1p9dpjf1oxxlif.relation: Guidance is Allah's alone, not the Prophet's.

tree:06r6b9p17yie6b.why: On the Day they feel they stayed only an hour of a day, in 10:45 and 46:35. Same scene.
tree:06r6b9p17yie6b.relation: The shortness of worldly life seen from the Day.

tree:12jgws30k484zt.why: The word after the dominion phrase is a different word in each: and you have no protector in 2:107, and what is between them in 43:85. This is the owner's own example of a different structure.

tree:1ceiggf1cjkk51.why: Theirs is the curse and the evil home: for those who break Allah's covenant (13:25) and for the wrongdoers on the Day (40:52).
tree:1ceiggf1cjkk51.relation: The curse and evil abode for covenant breakers and wrongdoers.

tree:0ukok1a13u8hcs.why: A rare punishment phrase, a painful torment of foul kind, for those who oppose or deny Our signs. Same subject.
tree:0ukok1a13u8hcs.relation: The punishment for fighting the signs.

tree:0l9mm7d02kiz9x.why: They have no protector from Allah: said of the deniers in 13:34 and of destroyed past nations in 40:21. Rare clause, same theme.

tree:0q5djkp0i4bfub.why: He is the One who brings you out of darkness into light, through His blessings in 33:43 and His clear signs in 57:9, each closing with His mercy.
tree:0q5djkp0i4bfub.relation: Allah's mercy taking believers from darkness to light.

tree:13fkg7y03jshck.why: A rare clause: none besides Allah for it, about a soul with no protector in 6:70, and the Hour none can disclose in 53:58. Useful for a memorizer though the subjects differ.

check.why: A rare clause, kept on the owner's shared-rare-clause precedent. Keep.

tree:153atp41gnsv2g.why: Two ayat in the Badr passage repeat that Allah brought the armies together to settle a matter already decreed.
tree:153atp41gnsv2g.relation: Badr as Allah's decree, from the meeting to the perception of numbers.

tree:00daek61vzai2u.why: What Allah gave them of His bounty: hidden by the misers (4:37) and envied by others (4:54).
tree:00daek61vzai2u.relation: Two vices toward Allah's bounty: hiding it and envying it.

tree:0sxqvfe0uj4c6g.why: We sent no messenger except to be obeyed (4:64), except in his people's tongue (14:4). A memorizer pair on the purpose of messengers.

tree:06gvuo10brssb5.why: We sent you only as a bearer of good news and a warner, the same sentence about the Prophet's role in two surahs.
tree:06gvuo10brssb5.relation: The Prophet's role defined in the same words.

tree:1rhsjgf06pa8xt.why: Your Lord is not unaware of what you do: this closing ends both Hud and an-Naml, the last ayah of each surah. A memorizer pair.
tree:1rhsjgf06pa8xt.relation: Two surahs closing on Allah's watch over deeds.

tree:13c9hu81k6gyi6.why: They have no defender against Allah, with two different nouns at the end: no protector in 10:27, no shield in 13:34. A memorizer pair.

check.why: Keep is right: 'no defender against God' ends with two different nouns, a memorizer pair.

tree:0ltf3ab0wk5e7j.why: They have none besides Him, ending with two related nouns for a guardian in 13:11 and 18:26. A memorizer pair.

tree:1jgvama0eqslhe.why: That of which I have no knowledge: Noah asking forgiveness for asking it (11:47), and Pharaoh's believer refusing to associate it with Allah (40:42).
tree:1jgvama0eqslhe.relation: Refusing to go beyond knowledge, in prayer and in creed.

tree:01rja460ga615c.why: There is no god but Allah, followed by two pairs of names: the Mighty, the Wise (3:62) and the One, the Subduer (38:65). A memorizer pair.

tree:1k9azhi0io1jac.why: None take heed but people of understanding, closing an ayah on wisdom (2:269) and one on the clear and ambiguous verses (3:7).
tree:1k9azhi0io1jac.relation: Understanding as the condition for benefiting from wisdom and revelation.

tree:0b0qjrp1w68zd7.why: Only the phrase about what they worship besides Allah is shared; Abraham leaving his people and the gathering of idols with their worshippers are different subjects with no point drawn between them.

check.why: Drop is right: only 'what they worship besides God' is shared, in different subjects.

tree:109pmhi15gtokk.why: Satan promises them nothing but delusion: the same sentence in 4:120 and 17:64, each in a passage on Satan's plan to mislead.

tree:11jor6016wu248.why: The deniers ask what Allah meant by this parable, about the gnat in 2:26 and the number of the guardians of Hell in 74:31; both then say He leads astray and guides by it.
tree:11jor6016wu248.relation: The same test: one example misleads some and guides others.

tree:1wcvpb60f4r770.why: The same promise of gardens and good dwellings in gardens of Eden, closing with the great success; 9:72 adds Allah's pleasure. Same reward for believers.
tree:1wcvpb60f4r770.relation: The highest reward described in the same words.

check.why: Good dwellings in gardens of Eden, the same reward. Keep.

tree:1gg601f0p2a1zh.why: Confirming what came before it: Jesus confirming the Torah (5:46) and the Quran confirming the Book (5:48), in neighbouring ayat.
tree:1gg601f0p2a1zh.relation: Each revelation confirming the one before.

tree:0foj7u510budwz.why: Do not call another god with Allah: a warning that whoever does has no proof (23:117), and a command to the Prophet (28:88).
tree:0foj7u510budwz.relation: The prohibition of calling on other gods.

tree:0iaru980uzjyig.why: His is the dominion of heavens and earth, and to Allah is the return, ending with the destination in 24:42 and all matters in 57:5. A memorizer pair.

tree:0bloisq0njclus.why: Two adjacent ayat on eating what Allah's name was mentioned over: a command, then why would you not.
tree:0bloisq0njclus.relation: The command and its reason, side by side.

tree:13g8k0w1dkpase.why: From before them and behind them: Satan's attack from every side (7:17), and messengers coming to 'Ad and Thamud from every side (41:14).
tree:13g8k0w1dkpase.relation: Contrast: Satan's approach and the messengers' approach from all directions.

check.why: Satan's approach and the messengers' approach from every side. Keep.

tree:1pzqjmg0akk1t6.why: Whoever repents, believes and does good: they enter Paradise (19:60), they may be successful (28:67).
tree:1pzqjmg0akk1t6.relation: Repentance opening the way to success.

tree:0a8gj510puss7j.why: Those worshipped besides Allah own nothing: no provision (29:17), not an atom's weight (34:22). Same argument against false gods.

tree:1iyh9w80uf0oym.why: No protectors besides Allah, in two places of Hud: for the deniers (11:20), and for whoever leans to the wrongdoers (11:113).

tree:0y232qx1vy5w8r.why: No protector besides Him, then nor does He share His rule (18:26) and nor intercessor (32:4). A memorizer pair.

tree:0l73tcv0f73ej1.why: Deniers deny that anything was revealed and accuse the messengers: you only lie (36:15), you are in great error (67:9).
tree:0l73tcv0f73ej1.relation: The deniers rejecting revelation and accusing its bearers.

tree:0e9f62l1e9osrl.why: Only the stock phrase from Allah, indeed Allah is shared; Mary's provision and victory at Badr are unrelated subjects.

tree:0o0230b0td7bud.why: From above them and from beneath their feet: provision that would have poured on the People of the Book had they kept the Torah (5:66), and punishment covering the deniers (29:55).
tree:0o0230b0td7bud.relation: Contrast: blessing from every side, or punishment from every side.

tree:1lub0f904nnr5v.why: The last shared word is a different word in each: all are obedient to Him in 30:26, every day He is at work in 55:29. Beyond that only the common phrase of those in the heavens and earth is shared.

tree:1v2hioh04fn6tn.why: Same story: Lot's people answer only by saying expel them, they keep themselves pure. Near identical in both surahs, with the object named differently.
tree:1v2hioh04fn6tn.relation: One reply of Lot's people told twice.

tree:0mhco4v0xi8tql.why: The chiefs answer Noah and Hud with the same words, we see you in error, then in foolishness. A memorizer pair in one surah.
tree:0mhco4v0xi8tql.relation: Successive prophets met with the same accusation.

tree:1p0u1o00r69j44.why: Whoever of you is ill or: on a journey, for fasting (2:184); with an ailment of the head, for pilgrimage (2:196). The same concession in two acts of worship.
tree:1p0u1o00r69j44.relation: Allah's concessions for the sick in fasting and in Hajj.

tree:0m7bfik09727by.why: Whoever disbelieves, Allah is free of need: of the worlds after the duty of Hajj (3:97), and praiseworthy after Luqman's gratitude (31:12).
tree:0m7bfik09727by.relation: Allah needs no one's worship or thanks.

tree:08j2wq00nyjwte.why: Only the phrase of those your right hands possess is shared; a marriage ruling and a parable against shirk have nothing to learn from each other.

tree:14f0c8a1aumv4o.why: People in danger at sea or land vow to be grateful if saved, and both passages go on to show them break the vow once rescued.
tree:14f0c8a1aumv4o.relation: The vow made in danger and broken in safety.

tree:0uj4pup18vdnyt.why: The Prophet answers the deniers that Allah knows, or they will know, who is in clear error. Same reply in two surahs.
tree:0uj4pup18vdnyt.relation: Leaving the verdict on who is misguided to Allah.

tree:0cpxctf0x1mikp.why: Whoever fears Allah, He makes for him a way out (65:2) and ease in his affair (65:4), two promises in the same divorce passage.
tree:0cpxctf0x1mikp.relation: Two rewards of piety amid the hardships of divorce.

tree:0y4rsf61pxh4ew.why: Who provides for you from the sky and earth: a question the idolaters answer with Allah (10:31), and a challenge is there a god with Allah (27:64).
tree:0y4rsf61pxh4ew.relation: Provision as proof of Allah's oneness.

tree:13058n41fltsb0.why: Allah guides to Himself whoever turns to Him, past tense in 13:27 and present in 42:13. A memorizer pair.
tree:13058n41fltsb0.relation: Guidance given to those who turn to Allah.

tree:08kjd1x068asej.why: Who would help me against Allah if: Noah if he drove away the believers (11:30), Salih if he disobeyed (11:63). Two prophets in one surah.
tree:08kjd1x068asej.relation: Prophets fearing Allah more than their people.

tree:0yf8ioy0bw2dr4.why: Whoever of you does this has strayed from the straight way: disbelief after the covenant (5:12), secret friendship with enemies (60:1). A memorizer pair.
tree:0yf8ioy0bw2dr4.relation: Two betrayals that lead astray: of the covenant and of loyalty.

tree:1ft5wx517jtnpn.why: Moses sent with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, in 7:103 and 43:46. Same story.
tree:1ft5wx517jtnpn.relation: Moses' mission told in two surahs.

tree:13r6rdf1leequx.why: Same event word for word: We saved Noah and his family from the great distress.

check.why: Keep is right: the same rescue of Noah, word for word, in two surahs.

tree:1wm7lfd08xz437.why: Both speak of the Prophet as a warner against the objections of others, ending differently: Allah is able over all things (5:19), Guardian over all things (11:12). Thin beyond the stock endings.

check.why: The Prophet as warner, with two endings. Thin, but a closing trap. Keep.

tree:1tuvobg0xm4jku.why: Those who take Allah's signs in mockery have a humiliating punishment, said twice with different verb forms. A memorizer pair.
tree:1tuvobg0xm4jku.relation: Mocking the signs and its punishment.

tree:08x5dlb1vbr163.why: He made the night for you: for rest (10:67), as a covering (25:47), and the day for sight or rising.
tree:08x5dlb1vbr163.relation: Night and day as a sign and a mercy.

tree:16dflgt11r6uh3.why: In the Hereafter among the losers: whoever seeks a religion other than Islam (3:85), whoever rejects faith (5:5).
tree:16dflgt11r6uh3.relation: Loss in the Hereafter for rejecting the faith.

tree:1vs0lso0kdnq8i.why: The promise of Allah, Allah does not break His promise, said of Rome's victory (30:6) and of Paradise's rooms (39:20).
tree:1vs0lso0kdnq8i.relation: Allah's promise kept in this world and the next.

tree:17egefy0tncmf6.why: O believers, if you obey a group of the People of the Book (3:100) or the disbelievers (3:149), they will turn you back. Same warning in one surah.
tree:17egefy0tncmf6.relation: The danger of obeying the enemies of faith.

tree:0j9xx8805mayjy.why: O people, if you are in doubt: of my religion (10:104), of the resurrection (22:5). A memorizer pair, each followed by its answer.

tree:011pz211y0jjk3.why: Seeking bounty from Allah and His pleasure: the companions in prayer (48:29), and the poor emigrants (59:8).
tree:011pz211y0jjk3.relation: The companions described by what they seek.

tree:1qmngqe0fvw8r8.why: Those who transgress on earth without right: the rescued who rebel (10:23), and the oppressors held accountable (42:42).
tree:1qmngqe0fvw8r8.relation: Transgression on earth and its punishment.

tree:154f53k0qo92fc.why: He brings them out of darkness into light: Allah as protector of the believers (2:257), and through the Book (5:16).
tree:154f53k0qo92fc.relation: Allah leading from darkness to light.

check.why: Keep is right: God brings the believers out of darkness into light in both.

tree:09nxeq301qu0zp.why: He knows what you hide and what you declare, in 16:19 and 64:4. A memorizer pair for the closing words.

tree:0ibmecl07xqys9.why: Only the common phrase that He knows what is in the heavens and earth is shared; a call to Allah as witness and a statement of His knowledge continue in unrelated ways.

tree:0bjpc761wxtnzm.why: Both promise that Allah will give something better and forgive: the captives at Badr if there is good in their hearts, and the believers a double share of mercy. The parallel is more than the closing formula, but thin.
tree:0bjpc761wxtnzm.relation: Allah's compensation and forgiveness offered for faith.

check.why: God's better gift and forgiveness offered for faith. Keep.

tree:0eu7i5p1yj8emf.why: Same description of Thamud's ringleaders, who spread corruption in the land and do not set right, in two tellings of Salih's story.
tree:0eu7i5p1yj8emf.relation: One people's corrupters in two surahs.

tree:0mouw2a10s9ic8.why: To Allah is your return, and He will inform you of what you differed in, said with two lead-ins in 5:48 and 6:164.
tree:0mouw2a10s9ic8.relation: Differences settled by Allah on the return.

tree:1nji4e51xw0yhh.why: Whatever you spend will be repaid in full and you will not be wronged: spending in charity (2:272) and in preparing for war (8:60).
tree:1nji4e51xw0yhh.relation: Spending in Allah's cause is never lost.

tree:16mulr50v6sow7.why: Moses calls his people three times with the same opening: to repent from the calf, to remember Allah's favour, and to stop hurting him.
tree:16mulr50v6sow7.relation: Moses' patience with his people through three calls.

tree:1ek719e04u9bdo.why: Remember Allah's favour upon you when: Moses reminding his people twice (5:20, 14:6), and the believers reminded of the Trench (33:9).
tree:1ek719e04u9bdo.relation: Allah's favours remembered through specific rescues.

check.why: Keep is right: 'remember God's favour upon you when' is followed by specific rescues each time.

tree:0xblzi80h8rj2k.why: Ask forgiveness of your Lord then repent to Him, three times in Hud: the Prophet, Hud and Shu'ayb, each with a different promise.
tree:0xblzi80h8rj2k.relation: The same call to repentance by three messengers.

tree:0u1bqik1ombv52.why: Know that Allah is severe in punishment, in three places; 5:98 alone pairs it with His forgiveness and mercy. A memorizer set.
tree:0u1bqik1ombv52.relation: Allah's severity, balanced once by His mercy.

tree:1l2kgae09f689a.why: Know that Allah is with the God-fearing closes three commands about fighting: retaliation in the sacred month, fighting the idolaters together, and fighting those near you.
tree:1l2kgae09f689a.relation: Allah's company promised to the pious in warfare.

tree:166cqc40hxm0wm.why: They turn to one another questioning: the people of Hell blaming each other (37:27), and the people of Paradise recalling the past (37:50, 52:25).
tree:166cqc40hxm0wm.relation: Contrast: the same mutual questioning in Hell and in Paradise.

tree:1jhzmwp0s6gamx.why: They swore by Allah their strongest oaths that if: a sign came, the Prophet commanded, a warner came, they would comply; and they did not.
tree:1jhzmwp0s6gamx.relation: Strong oaths of the insincere, broken each time.

tree:0c3fin91b6h10l.why: That of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew: the reward of emigrants (16:41) and the punishment of deniers (39:26, 68:33).
tree:0c3fin91b6h10l.relation: Contrast: the Hereafter's reward and punishment both greater than this world's.

tree:1421nto0ku0nx2.why: The dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is over all things: able in 3:29 and 3:189, witness in 85:9. The memorizer value is that ending; the rest is a common formula.

check.why: The same ending with able and witness. Keep.

tree:08xxowo1fhk7t8.why: Only the common formula of those who believe and do good, those are, followed by unrelated rewards; generic reward wording with nothing to learn from the set.

tree:0slt9f81v70w1g.why: Three times in Ghafir: those who dispute about Allah's signs, twice without authority given to them and once asked how they are turned away.
tree:0slt9f81v70w1g.relation: The disputers' arrogance as the surah's theme.
