tree:1d8spq50zky16n.why: When he said to his father and his people: Ibrahim's question in three surahs, what are these statues (21:52), what do you worship (26:70), and what is it you worship (37:85). Same story, a classic memorizer trap.
tree:1d8spq50zky16n.relation: Ibrahim's opening question to his people, told three ways.

tree:04xj9ji1gl4ats.why: We sent before you no messenger: the shared message of oneness (21:25), Satan casting into a prophet's wish (22:52), and ask the messengers whether gods besides the Merciful were made (43:45). Same theme of earlier messengers, a memorizer set.
tree:04xj9ji1gl4ats.relation: All earlier messengers carried the same message that there is no god but God.

tree:1rvy8o40kpzo82.why: Except those who repent: after that and reform (3:89, 24:5, identical) or before you overpower them (5:34). The exception of repentance from three severe rulings, a strong memorizer set.
tree:1rvy8o40kpzo82.relation: Even after the gravest sins, repentance opens the way to God's forgiveness.

tree:10l868d0n37cbx.why: They deceive, mislead or destroy only themselves, and they do not perceive: hypocrites (2:9), some of the People of the Book (3:69), and deniers who keep others from the Quran (6:26). Three different verbs before the same ending.
tree:10l868d0n37cbx.relation: Every scheme against the truth harms only its plotters, without their knowing.

tree:0nvzovp0yhhek7.why: Except in the best way: approaching the orphan's wealth (6:152, 17:34, which run identical and then branch) and debating the People of the Book (29:46). Strong memorizer set, and a shared lesson of dealing in the best manner.
tree:0nvzovp0yhhek7.relation: The best manner governs both handling the weak's property and arguing with others.

tree:1n56o671alnmj7.why: That you worship none but God: the Prophet's warning (11:2), messengers to Aad and Thamud refused (41:14), and Hud's warning (46:21). Same call of prophets to their people, with different continuations.
tree:1n56o671alnmj7.relation: Every prophet's call opens with the same demand to worship God alone.

tree:1uf0xhg0qrxguu.why: No messenger or prophet came to them but they mocked him, said three times (15:11, 36:30, 43:7) with small differences in the lead-in and the noun. Same theme, a classic memorizer set.
tree:1uf0xhg0qrxguu.relation: Mockery of messengers is the constant pattern of the deniers.

tree:1usyfge1rqtiqs.why: Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do: identical in 7:147 and 34:33, with a variant in 28:84 about those who did evil. Same law of recompense, a memorizer set.

tree:080b43z0qj9vut.why: The confession that there is no god but Him, Lord of the mighty Throne, closes the Prophet's word of trust (9:129) and the hoopoe's report against sun-worship (27:26). Rare exact clause, good memorizer pair. The 9:129 row reads on across the surah boundary into 10:1, which should be checked.
tree:080b43z0qj9vut.relation: The Lord of the mighty Throne: enough for the Prophet when people turn away, and the only one worthy of worship, not the queen's sun.

tree:1yfcs3a03rs7xu.why: The earth revived after its death, a sign for those who hear (16:65) and who reason (30:24), and proof that He will revive the dead (30:50). Same sign, with endings a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1yfcs3a03rs7xu.relation: Rain reviving dead land is both a sign of God and a picture of the resurrection.

tree:1d6hqos18poudk.why: The truth is from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters: twice with the emphatic form (2:147, 10:94) and once without (3:60). A classic memorizer trap.
tree:1d6hqos18poudk.relation: The Prophet is told three times to hold firmly to the truth from his Lord.

tree:0ltej5k0e4ujnw.why: The punishment of disgrace in this worldly life: lifted from the people of Yunus when they believed (10:98), and tasted by earlier deniers and by Aad, with the Hereafter's punishment greater still (39:26, 41:16). Same theme, worth pondering.
tree:0ltej5k0e4ujnw.relation: Contrast: the one people spared worldly disgrace through faith, and those who tasted it with worse to come.

tree:13373360aklf7a.why: He made the night for you to rest in: identical opening in 10:67 and 40:61 with different endings, and the night as a garment in 25:47. Same sign of night and day, a memorizer set.
tree:13373360aklf7a.relation: Night for rest and day for sight, a mercy that calls for listening and thanks.

tree:0r3g5ln0nznecf.why: That which you used to deny, said to the deniers when they meet it: the Fire (32:20), the Day of sorting (37:21), and the scene of 83:17. Same reproach with different lead-ins.
tree:0r3g5ln0nznecf.relation: On the Day the deniers are shown exactly what they denied.

tree:0gqv9m00vacj0c.why: Those who believed and were God-fearing: the friends of God (10:63), and those saved from the destruction of Thamud (27:53, 41:18) with two forms of the verb. A memorizer set, and a clear lesson that faith with fear of God saves.
tree:0gqv9m00vacj0c.relation: Faith joined with God-consciousness is what saves, in this world and the next.

tree:1i90qiu1oekt0s.why: Those who believed, emigrated and strove: the order of wealth, lives and the way of God changes between 8:72, 8:74 and 9:20. A classic memorizer set on one theme.
tree:1i90qiu1oekt0s.relation: The rank of the early emigrants who gave their wealth and lives.

tree:1konsxp09zci7z.why: Those who disbelieve in the signs of God: they have a severe punishment (3:4), they despair of His mercy (29:23), and they are the losers (39:63). Same subject, three outcomes to keep apart.
tree:1konsxp09zci7z.relation: Rejecting God's signs leads to punishment, despair and loss.

tree:1xcdflm1j1petw.why: Those who fear their Lord unseen, with three continuations: they dread the Hour (21:49), they keep up the prayer (35:18), and they have forgiveness and a great reward (67:12). Same description of the believers, a memorizer set.
tree:1xcdflm1j1petw.relation: Fear of God unseen shows in dread of the Hour and in prayer, and is rewarded.

tree:07mh94z1426md9.why: Those they call on besides Him do not answer (13:14), do not judge anything (40:20), and hold no intercession (43:86). Same argument on the powerlessness of false gods.
tree:07mh94z1426md9.relation: The false gods can neither answer, nor judge, nor intercede.

tree:1vcbsgi0neqy98.why: Responding to the Messenger after being wounded (3:172) set beside opposing the Messenger after guidance became clear (4:115, 47:32, near identical). The pair 4:115 and 47:32 is a strong memorizer link; 3:172 adds a contrast.
tree:1vcbsgi0neqy98.relation: Contrast: some obey the Messenger even after injury, others oppose him even after clear guidance.

check.why: Keep is right: 4:115 and 47:32 are a near-identical pair about opposing the Messenger, and 3:172 adds a contrast.

tree:1yety1k0zj02d8.why: To God belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, ending knowing and wise (48:4) and then mighty and wise (48:7), twins in one surah; 4:170 has the same closing after what is in the heavens and the earth. A memorizer trap on which name comes where.

tree:1mqcq8106no14j.why: They keep up the prayer and spend from what We provided them: describing the God-fearing (2:3), the true believers (8:3), and the humble (22:35), each with a different form of the verb. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1mqcq8106no14j.relation: Prayer and spending together are named as the mark of the believers again and again.

tree:0rh3rz71vou2qv.why: The Book, no doubt in it: a guidance for the God-fearing (2:2), and from the Lord of the worlds (10:37, 32:2), the latter two followed by the charge that he invented it. A strong memorizer set.
tree:0rh3rz71vou2qv.relation: The Quran's certainty is stated against those who claim it was invented.

tree:19v2i5w0altdui.why: The disbelievers' prayer or plotting is only in error: their call to idols (13:14), Pharaoh's plot against the believers (40:25), and their cry in the Fire (40:50). A rare ending that ties together worldly and otherworldly futility.
tree:19v2i5w0altdui.relation: Whatever the disbelievers call on or plot comes to nothing.

tree:1e0qz8i0f1vfgw.why: Only the opening of three unrelated stock statements is shared: God does not change a people's state (13:11), does not break His promise (13:31), does not guide the wrongdoers (28:50). Different subjects, and the shared words stop before the meaning starts.

tree:10ekofm0xj3fum.why: Only the stock closing that God sees what they do is shared, after unrelated subjects: those who wish for long life (2:96), the ranks of people with God (3:163), and the Children of Israel's blindness (5:71).

tree:10v0d290nqymwn.why: The shared closing names God as Mighty, Owner of retribution, after different subjects: those who deny His signs (3:4), the one who hunts in the sacred state again (5:95), and His promise to His messengers (14:47). A closing pair of names with nothing particular to learn.

check.why: Drop is acceptable: only a closing pair of divine names is shared, after unrelated subjects. This is a generic formula, which the brief leans to drop.

tree:19do41z0w5g13d.why: Your wealth and your children are a trial, and with God is a great reward: nearly identical in 8:28 and 64:15, a strong memorizer pair. 9:22 shares only the reward clause, closing the description of the emigrants' gardens, a different subject.
tree:19do41z0w5g13d.changes: Removed 9:22: it shares only the closing reward clause, not the theme of wealth and children as a trial.
tree:19do41z0w5g13d.relation: Wealth and children test a person, while the greater reward is with God.

check.why:
I would keep 9:22. It has the same words and structure as the others:
إن الله عنده أجر عظيم
Per the Clarifications, a different subject is not a reason to remove a row. Keep all three rows, or split the 8:28 and 64:15 pair from 9:22.

tree:0vmqvfw1ar52k4.why: Whom God curses or leaves astray, you will never find a helper (4:52) or a way (4:88, 4:143) for him, all in one surah. A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:0vmqvfw1ar52k4.relation: No one can save the person God has abandoned.

tree:0sotlu80yumdqq.why: The shared words mean only 'after' in three unrelated settings: exchanging God's favour (2:211), emigrating after being wronged (16:41), and arguing about God after His call was answered (42:16). Different subjects.

tree:1kx1agp08ficm9.why: The full name, the Messiah Jesus son of Mary: in the good news to Mary (3:45), in the claim that they killed him (4:157), and in the warning against excess (4:171). Same subject, worth pondering what is said of him in each.
tree:1kx1agp08ficm9.relation: Who Jesus is: honoured and near to God, a messenger and His word, not killed and not divine.

tree:0nr1ygq0pmbxiu.why: Then wish for death, if you are truthful: the challenge to those claiming the Hereafter is theirs alone (2:94, 62:6, followed by they will never wish it), and avert death from yourselves (3:168) to the hypocrites. A memorizer set on one challenge.
tree:0nr1ygq0pmbxiu.relation: Those who claim special favour with God, or blame others' deaths, are challenged by death itself.

tree:0q0h0hp0hj0euz.why: Your shelter is the Fire and you have no helpers: identical in 29:25 and 45:34, with a variant in 11:113 warning not to incline toward the wrongdoers. A memorizer set on the abandonment of the people of the Fire.

tree:17lnyn30ibsy07.why: And to Thamud their brother Salih: identical openings in 7:73 and 11:61, and a different form in 27:45. Same story, a classic memorizer set.
tree:17lnyn30ibsy07.relation: Salih's call to Thamud, the same in every telling.

tree:0rxfxpq17j3z5q.why: Go to Pharaoh, he has transgressed: said to Musa alone (20:24, 79:17) and to Musa and Harun together (20:43). Same story, a classic memorizer trap.
tree:0rxfxpq17j3z5q.relation: The same command to confront Pharaoh, given first to Musa and then to both brothers.

tree:050ooit1k23z2t.why: Twin ayat in one surah: if God made the night (28:71) or the day (28:72) perpetual until the Day of Resurrection, what god besides Him could bring light or rest? A strong memorizer pair and a sign to ponder. In 7:167 the shared word is a relative pronoun (someone who will afflict them), not the question 'what god', so it does not belong.
tree:050ooit1k23z2t.changes: Removed 7:167: its shared word is a relative pronoun, not the interrogative of 28:71 and 28:72.
tree:050ooit1k23z2t.relation: Night and day each a mercy no one but God could restore if He withheld it.

check.why: Removing 7:167 is right: its shared word is a relative pronoun, a different word from the interrogative in 28:71 and 28:72.

tree:0jv4b0m1nqec96.why: Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers (29:68, 39:32, both after who is more unjust than one who lies about God) or for the arrogant (39:60). Same theme of lying about God, a memorizer set.
tree:0jv4b0m1nqec96.relation: Lying against God and denying the truth leads to the same end.

tree:0ygpqc30uesfrn.why: The night and the day, the sun and the moon: made subservient (16:12), created each in an orbit (21:33), and signs not to be worshipped (41:37). Same sign, three lessons drawn from it.
tree:0ygpqc30uesfrn.relation: The heavenly bodies are servants and signs of God, not objects of worship.

tree:1twnbf11r9301r.why: I have been commanded to be among the Muslims (Nuh, 10:72) and among the believers (the Prophet, 10:104), in one surah. One word changes, a memorizer trap, and the same stance of two messengers.
tree:1twnbf11r9301r.relation: Nuh and Muhammad declare the same commanded submission before their people.

tree:0zoow5z1ib1jtv.why: Judgement belongs only to God, said by the Prophet (6:57), by Yusuf in prison (12:40), and by Yaqub to his sons (12:67), with three different continuations. Classic memorizer set on one creed.
tree:0zoow5z1ib1jtv.relation: Prophets in very different settings affirm that decision rests with God alone.

tree:1trqza70kfroqp.why: Whatever good you spend, God knows it: after who should receive it (2:215), the poor who do not beg (2:273), and spending what you love (3:92). Same theme of spending, a memorizer set.
tree:1trqza70kfroqp.relation: No act of giving is lost; God knows each one.

tree:1mlnk6m01qqg06.why: Only the stock closing that God knows what they do is shared, after unrelated subjects: following conjecture (10:36), and wrongdoers denying their deeds at death (16:28).

tree:1h8hbwk0b80mr2.why: God loves the God-fearing, closing three ayat on keeping covenants: whoever fulfils his pledge (3:76), and honouring treaties with polytheists who kept theirs (9:4, 9:7). Same theme, worth pondering.
tree:1h8hbwk0b80mr2.relation: Faithfulness to one's word, even with enemies, is part of fearing God.

tree:0omm0pq02pas4s.why: God loves those who act justly, closing three ayat on fairness: judging between the People of the Book (5:42), reconciling fighting believers (49:9), and dealing justly with peaceful non-Muslims (60:8). Same theme in three settings.
tree:0omm0pq02pas4s.relation: Justice is owed to everyone: to other faiths, to quarrelling believers, and to non-hostile neighbours.

tree:0skn5lp18tqsfr.why: Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection in what they differed: identical in 10:93 and 45:17, both after the Children of Israel differed once knowledge came, and with His judgement in 27:78. A strong memorizer set.
tree:0skn5lp18tqsfr.relation: Division after knowledge came is left to God's judgement.

tree:0f3elwq19qeinc.why: Indeed in that is a lesson, for those with insight (3:13 the victory at Badr, 24:44 night and day) and for whoever fears (79:26 Pharaoh's end). A rare word for lesson, and two different endings that a memorizer must hold.

check.why: Keep is right: the rare word for lesson comes with two different endings a memorizer must hold.

tree:1gmsyie0kjv3a8.why: Though before they were in clear error: the gift of a messenger who teaches the Book and wisdom (3:164, 62:2, near identical); 30:49 uses the same lead-in for despair before the rain. A strong memorizer set.
tree:1gmsyie0kjv3a8.relation: God's mercy, in a messenger or in rain, comes to those who were lost or despairing.

check.why: Keep is right: 3:164 and 62:2 are nearly identical, and keeping 30:49 with the same lead-in follows the Clarifications.

tree:000bv711uu3mrj.why: Many of the people are defiantly disobedient (5:49), heedless of Our signs (10:92), and deniers of meeting their Lord (30:8). A memorizer set with three endings, and one picture of most people's failure toward revelation.

check.why: Keep is right: 'many of the people' has three different endings, all about people failing toward revelation.

tree:1jpargy05vy3is.why: If it is Him you worship: eat the good things and give thanks (2:172, 16:114, both followed by the same list of forbidden foods), and prostrate to God, not to the sun and moon (41:37). A memorizer set on worship as gratitude.
tree:1jpargy05vy3is.relation: Worship shown both by thanks for provision and by prostration to the Creator alone.

tree:1847ifp168truj.why: They follow only conjecture and they only guess: said of most people (6:116), of the polytheists (10:66), and of those who blame God's will for their idolatry (43:20). A memorizer set on the polytheists' lack of knowledge.
tree:1847ifp168truj.relation: Shirk rests on guessing, never on knowledge.

tree:1byf3nm15eb9by.why: The angels to Ibrahim: we have been sent to the people of Lut (11:70) and to a criminal people (15:58, 51:32). Same story, a memorizer set.

tree:1njui4q1xcy0i8.why: We sent down to you the Book in truth: to judge between people (4:105), confirming and guarding earlier scripture (5:48), so worship God sincerely (39:2). Same statement with three purposes.
tree:1njui4q1xcy0i8.relation: Why the Book came down in truth: to judge, to confirm, and to lead to sincere worship.

check.why: Keep is right: the same statement, 'We sent down to you the Book in truth', with three different purposes.

tree:16lb3tp06s6cm5.why: Give us victory over the disbelieving people closes three prayers: Talut's army before Jalut (2:250), the end of al-Baqara (2:286), and the companions of the prophets (3:147). Same prayer, a memorizer set. The 2:286 row reads on across the surah boundary into 3:1, which should be checked.
tree:16lb3tp06s6cm5.relation: Believers of every age ask for steadfastness and victory in the same words.

tree:1g630sb1g7cet5.why: Striving with wealth and lives in God's way: the emigrants (8:72), the hypocrites who hated it (9:81), and the true believers (49:15). Same phrase, with a clear contrast.
tree:1g630sb1g7cet5.relation: Contrast: striving with wealth and self defines the true believers, and hating it exposes the hypocrites.

tree:1fatt0k11ipp5u.why: He is the Forgiving, the Merciful, each time after real forgiveness: Yaqub promising to seek it for his sons (12:98), Musa forgiven after killing (28:16), and the call not to despair of God's mercy (39:53). The closing is common, but here the theme is shared.
tree:1fatt0k11ipp5u.relation: Even grave sins are forgiven: the brothers of Yusuf, Musa, and all who have wronged themselves.

check.why: Keep is right: each place follows real forgiveness, so the theme is shared, not only the closing.

tree:19fomeg11y8wl8.why: How can I have a son: Zakariyya twice (3:40, 19:8, the order of age and barren wife reversed) and Maryam (19:20). Same question of a miraculous birth, a classic memorizer set.
tree:19fomeg11y8wl8.relation: Two miraculous births, each met with the same astonished question.

tree:0pvjx2v0ny1wox.why: The forbidden foods, including what was dedicated to other than God, in 5:3, 6:145 and 16:115, with different word orders and continuations. Same ruling, a memorizer set.

tree:0lpsy4f0iyyr3j.why: Those are the ones who lost themselves: those whose scales are light (7:9, 23:103) and those who lied about God (11:21), with three endings. A memorizer set on the same loss.
tree:0lpsy4f0iyyr3j.relation: The true loss is losing one's own self.

tree:0grfd990jwb4xj.why: Only the stock clause promising a painful punishment is shared, after different subjects: disbelievers dying in disbelief (3:91), deniers of the meeting with God (29:23), and oppressors (42:42).

tree:0bpummu1nugix6.why: For them is a humiliating punishment, after taking God's signs in mockery (31:6, 45:9, near identical) and denying them (22:57). The humiliation matches the mockery; a good memorizer set.
tree:0bpummu1nugix6.relation: Those who make a mockery of God's signs are themselves humiliated.

tree:01odaai1sr4mak.why: Whoever turns away, lies against God, or disbelieves after that: after the prophets' covenant (3:82), after the ruling on food (3:94), and after the promise of succession (24:55). Two endings, the defiantly disobedient and the wrongdoers, to keep apart.
tree:01odaai1sr4mak.relation: Turning away after God's covenant or promise is named as the worst disobedience.

tree:19k6jeo1t2wfz2.why: Rather they are in doubt: about the Hereafter (27:66), about My reminder (38:8), and playing (44:9). Rare clause, a memorizer set on the deniers' doubt.
tree:19k6jeo1t2wfz2.relation: The deniers' doubt about revelation and the Hereafter is the root of their play.

tree:0te1p1i0qkhttm.why: Whoever repents, believes and does good: they will enter Paradise (19:60), I am forgiving to him if he then stays guided (20:82), and he may be among the successful (28:67). Three endings to the same condition.
tree:0te1p1i0qkhttm.relation: Repentance joined with faith and deeds opens Paradise, forgiveness and success.

tree:0r3r4er14ylmdh.why: Rivers flowing beneath them, the rarer form of the Paradise phrase, in 7:43, 10:9 and 18:31, each continuing differently. The reward is a common theme, but the rare pronoun is a real memorizer trap.

check.why: Keep is right: the rarer pronoun form 'beneath them' is a memorizer trap.

tree:05w0lzf0rnigo7.why: You are recompensed only for what you used to do: said to every nation kneeling before its record (45:28), to the people of the Fire (52:16), and to the disbelievers told not to make excuses (66:7). Same scene of the Day, a memorizer set.
tree:05w0lzf0rnigo7.relation: On the Day, recompense matches deeds and no excuse helps.

tree:0a54qgv0voqpm3.why: These are the verses of the clear Book opening three surahs (12:1, 26:2, 28:2), each followed by a different sentence. Classic memorizer set.

tree:1wvq6dz0fuqi19.why: Every soul will be paid in full for what it earned (2:281, 3:161) or did (16:111), and they will not be wronged. A memorizer set on just recompense.
tree:1wvq6dz0fuqi19.relation: No soul is wronged on the Day; each receives what it earned.

tree:1w70wi51koa3d7.why: He gave you life, then will cause you to die, then give you life: against disbelief (2:28), against ingratitude (22:66), and against shirk (30:40). Same argument for God's power over life and death.
tree:1w70wi51koa3d7.relation: The stages of life and death answer disbelief, ingratitude and shirk alike.

tree:1i4k1hp0dkeyp1.why: As a reward for what they used to do, closing three descriptions of Paradise: the hidden delight (32:17), the people of Paradise who were steadfast (46:14), and the foremost (56:24). Same theme, a memorizer set.

tree:11o9sdc1yssu80.why: Gardens of Eden with rivers beneath them (18:31) or beneath it (20:76, 98:8). A reward formula, but with the rare pronoun change and the endings that name who earns it: the one who purified himself, and the one who feared his Lord.

check.why: Keep is right: the pronoun changes and the endings name who earns the reward, so the set teaches something.

tree:0qx1yuc1pmpmem.why: Until they see the painful punishment: Musa's prayer against Pharaoh's chiefs (10:88), those on whom the word is due (10:97), and the criminals who will not believe the Quran (26:201). Same theme, faith that comes only when it is too late.
tree:0qx1yuc1pmpmem.relation: Some will not believe until punishment is before their eyes, when belief no longer helps.

tree:0xrb5jo1636myk.why: Leave them until they meet their Day which they are promised: identical in 43:83 and 70:42, and the Day in which they will be struck down in 52:45. A strong memorizer set.

tree:0uq9wkk1m5uhfc.why: The mountain raised over the Children of Israel: take what We gave you with strength and remember (2:63, 7:171), and listen (2:93) with their reply that they heard and disobeyed. Same story, a classic memorizer set.
tree:0uq9wkk1m5uhfc.relation: The covenant under the raised mountain, and the people's disobedience to it.

tree:09hnnu70atq6c7.why: Abiding therein, and that is the reward of the good-doers (5:85), of the one who purified himself (20:76), and of the wrongdoers in the Fire (59:17). Same clause for both destinations.
tree:09hnnu70atq6c7.relation: Contrast: the same words describe eternal reward and eternal punishment.

tree:1e12qqw0tw4gta.why: The creation of the heavens and earth and the alternation of night and day (2:164, 3:190), and the variety of your tongues and colours (30:22). Same signs, a memorizer set.
tree:1e12qqw0tw4gta.relation: Creation and human diversity are signs for those who reflect.

tree:16bxhw21ey584g.why: God created the heavens and the earth in truth: a sign for the believers (29:44), with an appointed term (30:8), and so that every soul is recompensed (45:22). Same truth drawn to three lessons.
tree:16bxhw21ey584g.relation: Creation has a purpose: it points to God and to the coming reckoning.

tree:1bzsbz70domyoj.why: He created you from dust, then: you are humans spreading out (30:20), then from a drop (35:11, 40:67). Same sign of human creation, a memorizer set.
tree:1bzsbz70domyoj.relation: The stages of human creation from dust as a sign of God's power.

tree:17hau5v064k0zd.why: That is the decree of the Mighty, the Knowing, closing three passages on the ordering of the cosmos: dawn, night and the sun and moon (6:96), the sun running its course (36:38), and the seven heavens (41:12). Same theme each time.
tree:17hau5v064k0zd.relation: The precise order of the heavens is the measured decree of God.

tree:1k6i26q1jfkpi8.why: My Lord, how can I have a son: Zakariyya twice (3:40, 19:8) and Maryam once (3:47, a different word for child), each answered with God doing or creating what He wills. Classic memorizer set.
tree:1k6i26q1jfkpi8.relation: Two miraculous births, met with the same question and the same answer.

tree:1us0mmv0gi2z7x.why: Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers: said by Musa to Pharaoh (26:26), by Ilyas to his people (37:126), and in 44:8. Same claim of the one Lord against ancestral worship.
tree:1us0mmv0gi2z7x.relation: Prophets answer ancestral idolatry by naming the one Lord of the forefathers too.

tree:08v84il0rkvhbv.why: I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds: Nuh denies error (7:61), Hud denies foolishness (7:67), and Musa addresses Pharaoh (7:104), in one surah. Same theme of prophets and their people, a memorizer set.
tree:08v84il0rkvhbv.relation: Each messenger rejects the people's insult with the same claim of being sent by the Lord of the worlds.

tree:1f6latj0axnj61.why: You will find me, God willing: patient (Musa to al-Khidr, 18:69), among the righteous (Musa's father-in-law, 28:27), and among the patient (Ibrahim's son, 37:102). Rare clause and a beautiful pondering set.
tree:1f6latj0axnj61.relation: Three promises made humbly, each tied to God's will; one of them is broken, the others kept.

tree:00q0fdv1n40lbl.why: He made subservient to you what is on the earth (22:65), and what is in the heavens and the earth (31:20, 45:13). Same blessing, a memorizer set.
tree:00q0fdv1n40lbl.relation: Everything in creation is made to serve people, calling for gratitude and reflection.

tree:05gbdsr0pjtk8h.why: God has sealed their hearts: those who stayed behind though able (9:93), those who chose disbelief (16:108), and those who follow their desires (47:16). Same consequence, three endings to keep apart.
tree:05gbdsr0pjtk8h.relation: The seal on the heart follows the person's own choices.

tree:0qg91p20m3hccu.why: A painful punishment for what they used to deny (2:10, the hypocrites) or disbelieve (6:70, 10:4, both with the boiling drink). A memorizer set with one word changing.

tree:1w0zx43095dmlr.why: Say nothing about God but the truth: the warning to the People of the Book about Jesus (4:171), Musa before Pharaoh (7:105), and the covenant of the Book (7:169). Same principle, worth pondering together.
tree:1w0zx43095dmlr.relation: Speaking only truth about God is the duty of prophets and of the people of scripture.

tree:1jdcawt1huvwc7.why: He is over all things a guardian: after creator of all things in 6:102 and 39:62 (near identical), and in 11:12 comforting the Prophet that he is only a warner. A memorizer set.
tree:1jdcawt1huvwc7.relation: God is the creator and keeper of all; the Prophet only warns.

tree:12ywdfu101r5ca.why: God turns in mercy to whom He wills, twice in one surah after fighting (9:15, 9:27), with different closing names. In 59:6 the shared words belong to a different verb, giving His messengers power over whom He wills, about the spoils: a different subject.
tree:12ywdfu101r5ca.changes: Removed 59:6: its shared words follow a different verb and subject (power over the enemy, not turning in mercy).
tree:12ywdfu101r5ca.relation: Even after war, God's door of repentance stays open to whom He wills.

check.why: Removing 59:6 is right: there 'over whom He wills' belongs to a different verb (giving power), not turning in mercy. That is a structural difference.

tree:1cqjskr0jeiuex.why: The shared words are the common phrase 'with God' or 'from God' followed by a closing about God, across unrelated subjects: good deeds stored with God (2:110), Maryam's provision (3:37), and victory at Badr (8:10). A stock phrase with different subjects.

check.why: Drop is right: only the stock 'from God' plus a closing is shared, across unrelated subjects.

tree:0hok10314p5hyn.why: Those who strive against Our signs to defeat them: companions of Hellfire (22:51), a painful punishment (34:5), and brought into punishment (34:38). Same subject, three endings to keep apart.
tree:0hok10314p5hyn.relation: Fighting God's signs leads to punishment, told three ways.

tree:05gds5010drsrm.why: Everything in the heavens and earth is devoutly obedient to Him: in answer to the claim of a son (2:116) and as a sign (30:26). A strong memorizer pair. In 55:29 the shared word is part of 'every day', a different structure.
tree:05gds5010drsrm.changes: Removed 55:29: its shared word begins 'every day', not 'all are obedient to Him'.
tree:05gds5010drsrm.relation: All creation obeys God, so He needs no son.

check.why: Removing 55:29 is right: its shared word begins 'every day', a different structure from 'all are obedient to Him'.

tree:0os9vs8043x8oa.why: In the creation of the heavens and the earth: the signs listed (2:164, 3:190) and the people of understanding who reflect on them and pray (3:191). Same theme, and 3:190 to 3:191 shows what reflection leads to.
tree:0os9vs8043x8oa.relation: The signs of creation, and the believers who reflect on them and turn to God.

tree:10ecyz41evwe8q.why: Only the common phrase 'in the way of God' followed by a negation is shared, in unrelated settings: the poor who cannot travel (2:273), fight even if alone (4:84), and those not equal with God (9:19).

tree:0n2z7fb1n14rdr.why: Those who believed, emigrated and strove, and those who sheltered and helped: 8:72 and 8:74 in one surah, a strong memorizer pair. In 4:76 the words after 'in the way of God' start a different clause about the disbelievers, so it does not belong.
tree:0n2z7fb1n14rdr.changes: Removed 4:76: after the shared phrase it begins a different clause about disbelievers fighting for false gods.
tree:0n2z7fb1n14rdr.relation: The emigrants and the helpers of Medina, one community bound to each other.

check.why: Removing 4:76 is right: after 'in the way of God' it starts a new clause about the disbelievers, so the structure differs.

tree:1wwm8jv184yxfp.why: Only the common phrase 'in the way of God' followed by a conjunction is shared, in unrelated settings: spending without ruin (2:195), striving without fear of blame (5:54), and hardships of the campaign (9:120).

tree:0vvym6008p51hg.why: Good in this world: Musa asks for it with the Hereafter (7:156), and it is promised to those who do good (16:30, 39:10, nearly identical lead-ins with different endings). Same theme, a memorizer set.
tree:0vvym6008p51hg.relation: Good in this world is granted to those who do good, with the Hereafter better still.

tree:15gnnru0aduuwc.why: He made the night for rest and the day for sight: a sign for those who hear (10:67) and believe (27:86), and a favour most do not thank (40:61). Same sign with three endings, a memorizer set.

tree:0yrm82b10pjfxt.why: Those given knowledge speak: on the disgrace of the disbelievers on the Day (16:27), to Qarun's admirers that God's reward is better (28:80), and on the time spent until resurrection (30:56). Same speakers each time, worth pondering.
tree:0yrm82b10pjfxt.relation: The people of knowledge speak the truth when others are deceived, in this world and on the Day.

tree:0onhaw018lws7q.why: Jesus son of Mary said: asking for the table from heaven (5:114), announcing Ahmad to the Children of Israel (61:6), and calling for helpers (61:14). Same speaker, three memorable sayings.
tree:0onhaw018lws7q.relation: Three words of Jesus: a prayer, a message, and a call for helpers.

tree:0zt74a90xxe48z.why: They said God has taken a son: answered with glory be to Him (2:116, 10:68, different continuations) and a warning (18:4). Same claim, a memorizer set.
tree:0zt74a90xxe48z.relation: The claim of a son refuted: He owns all and needs nothing.

tree:0b14don1b11t67.why: Praise be to God who guided us (7:43), removed grief from us (35:34), and fulfilled His promise (39:74): the words of the people of Paradise. Same scene, a memorizer set.
tree:0b14don1b11t67.relation: The thanks of the people of Paradise for guidance, relief and fulfilment.

tree:0kd8zdx1890fkx.why: The people of Nuh, Aad and Thamud before them: listed in 9:70, 22:42 and 38:12 with differences in the list. A memorizer set on the destroyed nations.
tree:0kd8zdx1890fkx.relation: The same line of past nations recalled as a warning.

tree:1qvp1531qlbu6l.why: Fight in the way of God: against those who fight you (2:190), and know God hears (2:244), and the hypocrites asked to fight who refused (3:167). Same command, a memorizer set with a contrast.
tree:1qvp1531qlbu6l.relation: The command to fight, obeyed by the believers and refused by the hypocrites.

check.why: Keep is right: the same command to fight in God's way, with a contrast in the hypocrites.

tree:0wzyiwt1ioa3a5.why: He has strayed from the right way: whoever exchanges faith for disbelief (2:108), disbelieves after the covenant (5:12), or secretly befriends the enemy (60:1). A rare clause; each case is a betrayal of faith once given.
tree:0wzyiwt1ioa3a5.relation: Every betrayal of faith after it was given is called straying from the right way.

tree:07bxld00n7pp3g.why: We have detailed the signs for people who know, understand and remember, closing 6:97, 6:98 and 6:126 in one surah. A classic memorizer set on which ending goes where.

tree:13t7l3c0kqw1c0.why: A people with whom you have a treaty: exempt from fighting (4:90), owed blood money (4:92), and not to be fought even to help believers (8:72). Same ruling theme, worth pondering.
tree:13t7l3c0kqw1c0.relation: A treaty binds the believers even in war and in blood money.

tree:0jql5kq1remjtc.why: Only the stock closing that God knows or encompasses all things is shared, after unrelated subjects: ownership of creation (4:126), the seal of the prophets (33:40), and the believers' calm at Hudaybiya (48:26).

tree:1oqf4yw1pzpnfq.why: God sees what you do, after God turned back the confederates (33:9) and held back hands at Mecca (48:24); 48:11 has the variant 'aware'. The closing is common, but 33:9 and 48:24 share the theme of God holding off the enemy.
tree:1oqf4yw1pzpnfq.relation: God protects the believers from their enemies and sees all they do.

check.why: Keep is right: 33:9 and 48:24 share God holding off the enemy, and the 'aware' variant in 48:11 is a useful trap.

tree:1sfulsz1ilpynf.why: As if they had never lived there: the people of Shuayb (7:92, 11:95) and Thamud (11:68). Same theme of destroyed nations, a memorizer set.
tree:1sfulsz1ilpynf.relation: Destroyed nations vanish as if they had never been.

tree:144ifny1j7a006.why: Thus We detail the signs for people who know, reflect and reason: after lawful adornment (7:32), the parable of worldly life (10:24), and the parable of slaves as partners (30:28). A memorizer set on which ending goes where.

tree:07v3dw20cdzefo.why: Thus God seals the hearts: of the disbelievers (7:101), of those who do not know (30:59), and of every arrogant tyrant (40:35). Same consequence, a memorizer set.
tree:07v3dw20cdzefo.relation: Arrogance and rejection end in sealed hearts.

tree:13t95x81ex9wra.why: Every soul will find what it did (3:30) and be paid in full for what it did (39:70). Same scene of the Day, a memorizer pair.
tree:13t95x81ex9wra.relation: On the Day each soul meets its own deeds.

tree:07spfyy1j90hpy.why: Eat of what God has provided you: lawful and good, and fear God (5:88), do not follow Satan (6:142), and give thanks (16:114). Same command, a memorizer set.
tree:07spfyy1j90hpy.relation: Eating God's provision comes with fear of God, avoiding Satan, and gratitude.

tree:0sx98820d6j388.why: See how was the end of the corrupters: Shuayb to Madyan (7:86) and the end of Pharaoh (7:103, 27:14). Same warning, a memorizer set.
tree:0sx98820d6j388.relation: The end of the corrupters as a lesson for the living.

tree:0sc9n28151mmig.why: I ask you no reward for it: it is only a reminder (6:90), my reward is with my Creator (11:51), and except love of kin (42:23). Same stance of the messengers, a memorizer set.
tree:0sc9n28151mmig.relation: Messengers seek no pay from their people.

tree:1gzvgft1rw7ixt.why: There is no god but Me, so fear Me (16:2), worship Me and keep the prayer (20:14), and worship Me (21:25, the message of every messenger). Same divine declaration, a memorizer set on the endings.
tree:1gzvgft1rw7ixt.relation: God's own word of oneness, given to the angels, to Musa and to every messenger.

tree:0muvrtb0s6v7tv.why: Do not cause corruption in the land: the hypocrites claim they are reformers (2:11), and after its reform (7:56 general, 7:85 Shuayb to Madyan). Same command, a memorizer set with a contrast.
tree:0muvrtb0s6v7tv.relation: Corruption after the land was set right, and those who call corruption reform.

check.why: Keep is right: the same command not to cause corruption in the land, with a contrast in 2:11.

tree:1z0csp21ossn4s.why: And do not be among the polytheists, said to the Prophet three times (6:14, 10:105, 28:87), each after a different command. A memorizer set on the same warning.

tree:0si2fs71s563p5.why: So do not be among the doubters, after the truth from your Lord (2:147, 10:94) and after the Book sent down in truth (6:114). A memorizer set; overlaps another card but adds 6:114.

tree:1nv0pjt0n91je5.why: No blame on you in what: widows do for themselves after their waiting period (2:234), hinting at a proposal (2:235), and agreeing after the dower (4:24). Same family-law theme, a memorizer set.
tree:1nv0pjt0n91je5.relation: Rulings that lift blame in marriage matters, each with its limit.

tree:04ik98r0pg3zfv.why: We make no distinction between any of them (2:136, 3:84) or of His messengers (2:285). The believers' creed of faith in all prophets, a strong memorizer set.
tree:04ik98r0pg3zfv.relation: Faith in all God's messengers without distinction.

tree:0mtcfq50sstaf7.why: They are in disquieting doubt about it: identical passages on the Book of Musa (11:110, 41:45) and the inheritors of the Book (42:14). A strong memorizer set.
tree:0mtcfq50sstaf7.relation: Difference over the scripture, and judgement delayed by a prior word from God.

tree:0c7yl4k11obyio.why: If you follow their desires after the knowledge came to you, you will have no protector from God: 2:120 and 13:37, ending helper and defender. A strong memorizer pair. In 60:4 the shared words belong to Ibrahim's 'I have no power for you against God', a different structure.
tree:0c7yl4k11obyio.changes: Removed 60:4: its shared words are part of a different sentence (Ibrahim cannot avail his father anything against God).
tree:0c7yl4k11obyio.relation: Following others' desires after revelation leaves one without God's protection.

check.why: Removing 60:4 is right: its shared words belong to a different sentence (I have no power for you against God).

tree:125svat06av0i9.why: He made for you mates from among yourselves: with children and grandchildren (16:72), with love and mercy (30:21), and as part of His creation in pairs (42:11). Same blessing, a memorizer set.
tree:125svat06av0i9.relation: Marriage as a sign and a blessing of God.

tree:1eww6071noh08h.why: When Our command came, We saved Hud (11:58), Salih (11:66) and Shuayb (11:94) and those who believed with them, by mercy from Us, in one surah. Same story pattern, a classic memorizer set.
tree:1eww6071noh08h.relation: The same rescue of each prophet and his followers, by God's mercy.

tree:1j9dqgd1su2fif.why: They will never harm God at all: those hastening into disbelief (3:176), those buying disbelief with faith (3:177), and those opposing the Messenger (47:32). Same assurance, a memorizer set.
tree:1j9dqgd1su2fif.relation: Disbelief and opposition harm only the disbelievers, never God.

tree:1fxn5re1boe7im.why: God will never forgive them: the hypocrites, even with seventy requests for forgiveness (9:80, 63:6), and those who die as disbelievers (47:34). Same theme of those beyond forgiveness.
tree:1fxn5re1boe7im.relation: No intercession helps those who die in disbelief or hypocrisy.

tree:0kl3jnu1bt9n92.why: For us our deeds and for you your deeds: said to the People of the Book (2:139, 42:15) and by believers to those speaking idly (28:55). A memorizer set on how believers end a dispute.
tree:0kl3jnu1bt9n92.relation: Each answers for his own deeds; argument gives way to peace.

tree:0rbzsai0gp79hi.why: They have no knowledge of it: about the crucifixion (4:157), the claim of a son (18:5), and naming angels as females (53:28). Same rebuke, false beliefs resting on conjecture.
tree:0rbzsai0gp79hi.relation: False beliefs about God and His messengers rest on no knowledge.

tree:1c2dbo60qs6ajk.why: For them is forgiveness and a great reward, a rarer form of the reward, after the patient (11:11), believers set against the disbelievers (35:7), and those who fear their Lord unseen (67:12). A reward formula, but its rare wording is a memorizer trap.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: it is a reward formula, but this rarer wording occurs in only these three places.

tree:14k09up0oevrnb.why: They will have no protector against God: those who earned evil (10:27), and the punished in this world and the next (13:34, 40:21). The ending noun changes; a classic memorizer set.
tree:14k09up0oevrnb.relation: No one can shield the wrongdoers from God.

tree:0wc0kal09rlbh1.why: Even if he is a relative: in testimony (5:106), in just speech (6:152), and in bearing another's burden (35:18). Rare clause, and one lesson: kinship does not bend justice or accountability.
tree:0wc0kal09rlbh1.relation: Kinship does not change justice in this world or responsibility in the next.

tree:0eufuv20gy38d8.why: What will make you know what the Day is: the Day of sorting (77:14) and the Day of judgement (82:17, repeated in 82:18). A good memorizer set, but the 82:17 row reads on into 82:18, which is also its own row, so one ayah appears twice; the run-on should be checked.

check.why: Keep with the runOn flag is right: the 82:17 row reads into 82:18, which is also its own row.

tree:1maslkm0p53mku.why: The life of this world is only enjoyment of delusion (3:185, 57:20) or play and amusement (6:32). Same truth about worldly life, a memorizer set.
tree:1maslkm0p53mku.relation: Worldly life is fleeting and deceptive beside the Hereafter.

tree:1f0hov409pvoqo.why: You are not their guardian, said to the Prophet three times (6:107, 39:41, 42:6), each after a different lead-in. A memorizer set.
tree:1f0hov409pvoqo.relation: The Prophet conveys; he is not responsible for people's choices.

tree:1d4zs0u16n1kq0.why: What God sends down from the sky, of water (2:164) or of provision (45:5), reviving the earth after its death. A strong memorizer pair in two lists of signs. In 2:174 the shared words refer to the Book that is concealed, a different meaning and structure.
tree:1d4zs0u16n1kq0.changes: Removed 2:174: there what God sent down is the Book, followed by a different structure.
tree:1d4zs0u16n1kq0.relation: Rain sent down as life for the earth, a sign in both lists.

check.why: Removing 2:174 is right: there 'of' names the Book that was sent down, while in 2:164 and 45:5 it begins 'from the sky'. That is a different use of the word, not only a different subject.

tree:0nth9fu09p6lx2.why: Follow or recite what was revealed to you: from your Lord (6:106), from the Book of your Lord (18:27), and from the Book with prayer (29:45). Same command to the Prophet, a memorizer set.
tree:0nth9fu09p6lx2.relation: The Prophet's task: hold to and recite the revelation.

tree:1e0qtuq0hxxob2.why: Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, if you are certain (26:24, 44:7), and Lord of the east and the west, if you reason (26:28). A classic memorizer set.
tree:1e0qtuq0hxxob2.relation: Musa's answer to Pharaoh about who the Lord is, echoed in 44:7.

tree:0a3tccy18cc3em.why: Whatever good you do, God knows it: during the pilgrimage (2:197), in spending (2:215), and in dealing justly with orphans (4:127). A memorizer set on the endings.
tree:0a3tccy18cc3em.relation: No good deed goes unseen by God.

tree:0skcruy1qrhuu0.why: After the knowledge that came to you: if you follow their desires (2:145, 13:37), and if anyone disputes with you (3:61). Same theme of holding firm after revelation, a memorizer set.
tree:0skcruy1qrhuu0.relation: After revelation, neither following desires nor yielding in dispute.

check.why: Keep is right: 'after the knowledge came to you' carries the same theme in all three, holding firm after revelation.

tree:1qgvr1e0qdu0mc.why: Your Lord is not unaware of what they do (6:132) or you do (11:123, 27:93). A rare form of the closing, and two of them end their surahs. The rows for 11:123 and 27:93 read on across the surah boundary, which should be checked.

check.why: Keep with the runOn flag is right: the closing form is rare, and two of the rows cross a surah boundary.

tree:10324vx1jhm9kz.why: We never heard of this among our forefathers: the chiefs of Nuh's people (23:24) and Pharaoh's people (28:36), and in the latest religion (38:7) from Quraysh. Same objection of every people, a memorizer set.
tree:10324vx1jhm9kz.relation: Every people rejects its messenger by appeal to what their ancestors did not know.

tree:0y93td80st1jqw.why: They had no protector: besides God (11:20), from God (40:21), and to help them besides God (42:46). Same theme, word order changes a memorizer must hold.
tree:0y93td80st1jqw.relation: The wrongdoers find no protector against God.

tree:0knhkzt0n4s5dz.why: What is wrong with you, how do you judge: on following one who cannot guide (10:35), claiming God has daughters (37:154), and equating believers with criminals (68:36). Same rebuke, a memorizer set.
tree:0knhkzt0n4s5dz.relation: The deniers' judgements about God are rebuked with the same question.

tree:18i520f1hysl85.why: The wrongdoers have no helpers: after spending and vows (2:270), in the prayer of the people of understanding (3:192), and after shirk (5:72). A rare clause found only in these three places, a memorizer set.

tree:1xnueds1sn69vo.why: There is no god but God (3:62, 38:65) or but one God (5:73, against the Trinity). Same declaration of oneness, a memorizer set.
tree:1xnueds1sn69vo.relation: The oneness of God stated against the claims about Jesus.

tree:0bnlze91jp1tyd.why: None rejects Our signs except the disbelievers (29:47), the wrongdoers (29:49), and every treacherous ingrate (31:32). A classic memorizer set on the ending.
tree:0bnlze91jp1tyd.relation: Rejecting clear signs reveals disbelief, wrongdoing and ingratitude.

tree:0byqrlt0bg9p1b.why: What they call on besides Him is falsehood (22:62, 31:30, near identical), and God knows whatever they call on (29:42). A strong memorizer set on false gods.
tree:0byqrlt0bg9p1b.relation: God is the truth; what is called on besides Him is falsehood.

tree:0bn48vz0ysfoj9.why: Spend of what We provided them secretly and openly: the patient (13:22), the command to believers (14:31), and those who recite the Book (35:29). Same description, a memorizer set.
tree:0bn48vz0ysfoj9.relation: Prayer and spending in secret and in public mark the believers.

tree:07kne9y1hg0ooc.why: I cannot avail you anything against God: Yaqub to his sons (12:67, 12:68) and Ibrahim to his father (60:4). Each is followed by reliance on God. A pondering set on the limits of a prophet's power.
tree:07kne9y1hg0ooc.relation: Two prophets admit they cannot shield their own family from God's decree, and both turn to trust in Him.

tree:1pe7fz71n2n8oh.why: Among people is he who says: we believe, but they are not believers (2:8); we believe, then fails when harmed (29:10); and our Lord give us in this world only (2:200). Same opening for those whose faith falls short.
tree:1pe7fz71n2n8oh.relation: Words of faith exposed by hypocrisy, weakness or worldliness.

tree:1c05uoy1p89g02.why: Whoever is given his book in his right hand: reads it (17:71), calls others to read it (69:19), and has an easy account (84:7). Same scene, a memorizer set.
tree:1c05uoy1p89g02.relation: The joy of the one given his record in his right hand.

tree:107q7rk0m9zs6s.why: Except whoever repents, believes and does good: they enter Paradise (19:60), their bad deeds are turned to good (25:70), and he may succeed (28:67). A memorizer set; 25:70 adds the change of misdeeds into good deeds.
tree:107q7rk0m9zs6s.relation: Repentance can even turn past misdeeds into good deeds.

tree:0y9gi270t90cq7.why: Whatever good you spend (2:273) or do (4:127), God knows it: two forms of the ending to keep apart. A memorizer pair.
tree:0y9gi270t90cq7.relation: Good done for the poor or the orphan is known to God.

tree:0p46smx0eq0uuh.why: Those they call on besides God create nothing (16:20) and own not an atom's weight (34:22). The shared words are short, but the theme is the same: the powerlessness of false gods.
tree:0p46smx0eq0uuh.relation: False gods neither create nor own anything.

check.why: Keep is right: both are about the powerlessness of the false gods people call on.

tree:168vvrx1c0dqs5.why: Not besides God, but: a prophet does not ask to be worshipped but tells people to be devoted to the Lord (3:79), the Quran is not invented but confirms (10:37), and I do not worship your gods but God (10:104). One pattern of rejecting the false and stating the true, though the subjects differ.

check.why: Keep is right: each place rejects the false and states the true, in one pattern.

tree:0or8n2o1329lwu.why: From your Lord, so do not be: among the doubters (2:147, 10:94) or a supporter of the disbelievers (28:86). A memorizer set on the ending.

tree:0xdl12t1bwlhy5.why: All who are on the earth: God could destroy them all (5:17), their disbelief does not harm God (14:8), and the criminal would give them all as ransom (70:14). A rare phrase and one point: the whole of mankind counts for nothing against God.
tree:0xdl12t1bwlhy5.relation: All the people of the earth cannot affect God, nor ransom one soul.

tree:07j7uyp1dbywgb.why: And the people of Nuh before: they were a defiant people (51:46), and they were more unjust and transgressing (53:52). A strong memorizer pair. In 34:54 the shared words follow a different clause (as was done to their kind before), about doubt, not Nuh's people.
tree:07j7uyp1dbywgb.changes: Removed 34:54: its shared words follow a different clause and subject.
tree:07j7uyp1dbywgb.relation: Nuh's people as the first example of destroyed wrongdoers.

check.why:
I would keep 34:54. It has the same words and structure as the other rows:
من قبل إنهم كانوا
The only difference is the subject. The three different endings (in doubt, defiant, more unjust) are exactly the trap a memorizer needs, and the Clarifications say a different subject is not a reason to remove a row.

tree:0okjpi61gjfqbq.why: You will know who will get a disgracing punishment: Nuh to his people (11:39), Shuayb to his (11:93), and the Prophet (39:40, identical to 11:39). Same threat from three prophets.
tree:0okjpi61gjfqbq.relation: Prophets leave their people to see who will be disgraced.

tree:1m0uoqt0z3x1u9.why: Whoever associates partners with God: has invented a great sin (4:48), has strayed far (4:116), and God has forbidden him Paradise (5:72). A classic memorizer set.
tree:1m0uoqt0z3x1u9.relation: Shirk as the one sin God does not forgive.

tree:0yec6b40sbnege.why: Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger: enters the Fire (4:14, 72:23) or has clearly strayed (33:36). A memorizer set on one warning.
tree:0yec6b40sbnege.relation: Disobedience to God and His Messenger leads astray and into the Fire.

tree:0346gz20vg24su.why: The fire of Hell, abiding therein: the hypocrites (9:68), the disobedient (72:23), and the disbelievers of the People of the Book and the polytheists (98:6). A memorizer set with three continuations.

tree:070ik5z1rf93qf.why: Is this not but a man like you: the Quraysh (21:3), and the chiefs of two earlier peoples (23:24, 23:33). Same objection to a human messenger.
tree:070ik5z1rf93qf.relation: Every people rejects a messenger for being human.

tree:1mrdh9c1ogj482.why: This is what you used to hasten (51:14), call for (67:27), and deny (83:17). Same reproach on the Day, a classic memorizer set.
tree:1mrdh9c1ogj482.relation: The deniers finally see what they mocked.

tree:1kyzcus0s05mvg.why: Is there any of your partners who: begins creation (10:34), guides to the truth (10:35), or does any of this (30:40). Same challenge to the polytheists.
tree:1kyzcus0s05mvg.relation: The partners can neither create, guide, nor give life.

tree:026qnrr1v8qq3f.why: Do they wait for anything but that God (2:210) or the angels (6:158, 16:33) come to them? Same warning, a classic memorizer set.
tree:026qnrr1v8qq3f.relation: The deniers wait only for the coming of the end.

tree:1u9j5nz1bchwmp.why: And they are disbelievers in the Hereafter: those who bar from God's way (11:19), Yusuf on the faith he left (12:37), and those who do not pay zakat (41:7). A memorizer set on the lead-ins.
tree:1u9j5nz1bchwmp.relation: Denial of the Hereafter goes with barring from God's way and withholding zakat.

tree:07eke4r0m71cpj.why: He is the one who created you from clay (6:2), a single soul (7:189), and dust (40:67). Same opening, three origins, a memorizer set.
tree:07eke4r0m71cpj.relation: Human creation described from three angles.

tree:12mcbpt104sdu9.why: Only the stock closing that He knows all things is shared, one of the most frequent endings, after different passages (2:29, 6:101, 57:3). Nothing particular to learn from the grouping.

tree:0clueup1s1r1u9.why: Fallen on its roofs, a rare image of ruin: the town that made a man ask how God could revive it (2:259), the ruined garden of the arrogant owner (18:42), and the destroyed towns of the wrongdoers (22:45). A strong pondering set.
tree:0clueup1s1r1u9.relation: Ruins as a lesson: on resurrection, on the end of arrogance, and on the fate of wrongdoers.

tree:1fgpiy60qn31ss.why: God has promised those who believe and do good: forgiveness and a great reward (5:9, 48:29) and succession in the land (24:55). The reward wording is common, but the three promises side by side show what God pledges to the believers, and 48:29 adds 'of them'.

check.why: Keep is right: three promises of God to the believers, with the variant 'of them' in 48:29.

tree:1cu1v5f0yacvjl.why: Woe to those who disbelieve: from the witnessing of a great Day (19:37), from the Fire (38:27), and from their promised Day (51:60). Same warning with three endings, a memorizer set.
tree:1cu1v5f0yacvjl.relation: The disbelievers' woe on the Day they denied.

tree:1bfk7b11364ar1.why: O people, there has come to you: the Messenger with the truth (4:170), a proof and a clear light (4:174), and the truth (10:108). Same address to mankind, a memorizer set.
tree:1bfk7b11364ar1.relation: What has come to mankind: the Messenger, a proof, a light and the truth.

tree:0u1o3xs0x7wd1u.why: He revives the earth after its death: so you will be brought out (30:19), He will revive the dead (30:50), and We have made the signs clear (57:17). Same sign tied to resurrection, a memorizer set.
tree:0u1o3xs0x7wd1u.relation: The revival of dead land as a picture of the resurrection and of reviving hearts.

tree:0ddi9bn11o3rt9.why: He brings the living from the dead and the dead from the living: with a noun (6:95) or a verb (10:31, 30:19) in the second half. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0ddi9bn11o3rt9.relation: Life from death and death from life as proof of God's power.

tree:13d0ato0zc2z2g.why: Who provides for you from the sky and the earth: three challenges to the polytheists (10:31, 27:64, 35:3) with different continuations. A memorizer set on one argument.
tree:13d0ato0zc2z2g.relation: God alone provides, so He alone deserves worship.

tree:1j8xu551fsvm8f.why: He leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back (13:27) or whom He wills (16:93, 35:8). A memorizer set; 13:27 shows guidance follows turning to God.
tree:1j8xu551fsvm8f.relation: Guidance is God's to give, and it comes to those who turn to Him.

tree:19csefm0rboaq6.why: They fight in the way of God: the believers against the friends of Satan (4:76), those whose lives God bought for Paradise (9:111), and some among the night-worshippers (73:20). Same phrase, the theme of fighting for God.
tree:19csefm0rboaq6.relation: Fighting in God's way as the believers' bargain with God.

tree:0ffppza0erpg5i.why: The shared words straddle two sentences: one clause ends with the Day of Resurrection and a new closing about God begins. The subjects differ: those who lie about God (10:60), the religions judged (22:17), and God's knowledge of secret talk (58:7).

tree:0krybwz0vzmdwr.why: We stayed a day or part of a day: the man raised after a hundred years (2:259), the people of the cave (18:19), and the dead on the Day (23:113). A rare clause and a beautiful pondering set.
tree:0krybwz0vzmdwr.relation: Time shrinks for the dead and the sleeping; a century feels like a day.

tree:1mrkcgv0bli3yl.why: What God gave them of His bounty: the martyrs rejoice in it (3:170), the misers hold it back (3:180, 4:37), and the envious resent it in others (4:54). A rich pondering set on how people treat God's favour.
tree:1mrkcgv0bli3yl.relation: Contrast: rejoicing in God's bounty, hoarding it, and envying it.

tree:11pu3mz05lt2zb.why: Remember God's favour upon you: the Book and wisdom (2:231), brotherhood after enmity (3:103), enemies held back (5:11), and provision from the One Creator (35:3). A memorizer set on the favours named.
tree:11pu3mz05lt2zb.relation: The favours God names: revelation, unity, protection and provision.

tree:0srzg4616uy53k.why: Remember God's favour upon you when: the covenant (5:7), prophets and kings among you (5:20), rescue from Pharaoh (14:6), and the confederates repelled (33:9). A memorizer set; two are Musa's words to his people.
tree:0srzg4616uy53k.relation: Favours recalled to Musa's people and to the believers alike.

tree:0qwz5jx0pj7uc5.why: Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub and the tribes, the same list in 2:136, 2:140, 3:84 and 4:163, with different contexts. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0qwz5jx0pj7uc5.relation: The line of prophets after Ibrahim, all believed in without distinction.

tree:0lukisk03r7gbe.why: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the end of those before them (12:109, 40:82, 47:10), and have hearts to understand (22:46)? A classic memorizer set.
tree:0lukisk03r7gbe.relation: History as a lesson for those whose hearts are not blind.

tree:1ybvjmb1pzgizb.why: Kept up the prayer and gave zakat: the believers' reward (2:277), repentant polytheists set free (9:5) or made brothers (9:11), and those given power on earth (22:41). A memorizer set with clear endings.
tree:1ybvjmb1pzgizb.relation: Prayer and zakat as the sign that marks the believers and the repentant.

tree:0ao494m034b1km.why: Except in a clear record: closing God's knowledge of every leaf and seed (6:59), every atom (10:61, 34:3, near identical), and every hidden thing (27:75). A strong memorizer set.
tree:0ao494m034b1km.relation: Nothing escapes God's knowledge; all is written.

tree:148prxi0fkstzw.why: I have no power to benefit or harm myself except what God wills: 7:188 and 10:49, with the two nouns reversed, a strong memorizer pair. The exception in 6:128 (the Fire) and 87:7 (forgetting the Quran) is a common phrase with different subjects.
tree:148prxi0fkstzw.changes: Kept only 7:188 and 10:49; removed 6:128 and 87:7, which share only the exception phrase.
tree:148prxi0fkstzw.relation: The Prophet owns no power over his own fate; all rests on God's will.

check.why: The result is right: keep the pair 7:188 and 10:49. The exception phrase in 6:128 and 87:7 has the same structure, so this is really a split, but that leftover part is a stock phrase with different subjects and would be dropped anyway.

tree:1kf45pb14x5bbh.why: They differed only after knowledge came to them, out of rivalry (3:19, 42:14, 45:17), and after clear proof came (98:4). A strong memorizer set on one theme.
tree:1kf45pb14x5bbh.relation: Division among the people of scripture came from rivalry, not ignorance.

tree:17mn7p01djf5s4.why: The chiefs who disbelieved among his people: against Hud (7:66), Shuayb (7:90), Nuh (11:27), and another messenger (23:24). Same theme of prophets and their people, a memorizer set.
tree:17mn7p01djf5s4.relation: The same chiefs' response to every prophet.

tree:1i05cnr0ww3wj9.why: Those who do not expect to meet Us: content with this life (10:7), left wandering (10:11), asking for another Quran (10:15), and demanding angels (25:21). A memorizer set on one group.
tree:1i05cnr0ww3wj9.relation: Not expecting to meet God shows in worldliness and in demands on revelation.

tree:1a3lsfh186szm7.why: The people who denied Our signs: the parable of the dog (7:176, 7:177), Nuh's people (21:77), and Pharaoh's (25:36). A memorizer set.
tree:1a3lsfh186szm7.relation: Denial of signs, pictured in a parable and in destroyed nations.

tree:0il0kxg1iz2wgu.why: Only stock closings with pairs of divine names are shared (Knowing and Wise, Forgiving and Merciful, Witness over all things), after unrelated subjects: inheritance (4:11), seeking forgiveness (4:106), the Prophet's wives (33:55), and God's will (76:30).

tree:086b76m0vu79x6.why: God does not love every sinful ingrate (2:276), treacherous ingrate (22:38), and boastful braggart (31:18, 57:23, identical). A memorizer set on the endings, and a list of traits God dislikes.
tree:086b76m0vu79x6.relation: The traits God does not love: ingratitude, treachery and arrogance.

tree:12637mo1by2fns.why: God is the Free of need, the Praised: He owns all (31:26), you are the needy ones (35:15), and whoever turns away harms only himself (57:24, 60:6, identical). Same point each time, a memorizer set.
tree:12637mo1by2fns.relation: People need God; He needs nothing from those who turn away.

tree:1vpuhj10aug0q5.why: God guides whom He wills to a straight path (2:213, 24:46), and but God guides whom He wills, to the Prophet (2:272, 28:56). A memorizer set on two lead-ins.
tree:1vpuhj10aug0q5.relation: Guidance is God's alone; the Prophet cannot give it to whom he loves.

tree:0m7s5sa0zyvrbs.why: Do you not know that God: has power over all things (2:106), owns the heavens and earth (2:107, 5:40), and knows all in them (22:70). A memorizer set; 2:106 and 2:107 come in sequence.
tree:0m7s5sa0zyvrbs.relation: God's power, dominion and knowledge, recalled by the same question.

tree:1vhsuwi0rxqj9m.why: Orphans, the needy and the traveller: in true righteousness (2:177), in spending (2:215), in the spoils (8:41), and in the gains without fighting (59:7). Same recipients, a memorizer set.
tree:1vhsuwi0rxqj9m.relation: The same weak groups are named in every kind of giving.

tree:0bw0n9x1i58a4b.why: Or do they say he invented it: answered with the challenge of one surah (10:38) or ten (11:13), and with if I invented it, the burden is mine (11:35, 46:8). A classic memorizer set.
tree:0bw0n9x1i58a4b.relation: The charge of invention met with a challenge and with the messenger's accountability.

tree:06xmofj1700x71.why: Only the stock closing that God sees what you do is shared, after unrelated rulings and signs (2:110, 2:233, 2:237, 31:29). Nothing particular to learn from the grouping.

tree:1crc4my01xyf42.why: Only the stock closing that God is aware of what you do is shared, after unrelated commands: justice (5:8), lowering the gaze (24:30), obedience (24:53), and preparing for tomorrow (59:18).

tree:0megv3410n6wk6.why: Only the stock closing that God hears and sees is shared, after unrelated subjects: night and day (22:61), choosing messengers (22:75), creation and resurrection (31:28), and the woman who pleaded (58:1).

tree:1yctlzn0la4ktn.why: The God-fearing are in gardens and springs (15:45, 51:15), bliss (52:17), and a river (54:54). Short ayat with one word changing, a classic memorizer set.

tree:1h4a0l01ei8abk.why: It is only a reminder for the worlds (12:104, 38:87, 81:27) or a reminder and a clear Quran (36:69). A memorizer set on what the Quran is.
tree:1h4a0l01ei8abk.relation: The Quran is a reminder for all, not poetry and not for pay.

tree:0zvealo0p7dhos.why: They follow only conjecture: and only guess (6:116, 10:66), and what their souls desire (53:23), and conjecture avails nothing against truth (53:28). A memorizer set.
tree:0zvealo0p7dhos.relation: Shirk rests on guesswork and desire, not knowledge.

tree:0uxzqld0uu0p5t.why: We caused to grow in it every kind: of balanced thing (15:19), of noble pair (26:7, 31:10), and of delightful pair (50:7). A memorizer set on the endings.
tree:0uxzqld0uu0p5t.relation: The variety of plants as a sign of the Creator.

tree:0tq0mn80g5vs54.why: We sent down water from the sky: to give you drink (15:22), in measure (23:18), pure (25:48), and to grow every pair (31:10). Same sign, a memorizer set.
tree:0tq0mn80g5vs54.relation: Rain as provision, measure, purity and growth.

tree:13ditjl1fikzop.why: You are the Mighty, the Wise, closing four prayers: Ibrahim for a messenger (2:129), Isa for his people (5:118), the angels for the believers (40:8), and Ibrahim's followers (60:5). A closing pair of names, but each time it ends a prayer, which gives the set its point.

check.why: Keep is right: the closing ends a prayer every time, so the set has a theme.

tree:087bxrq0uxskmy.why: The wrongdoers will not succeed: after lying against God (6:21), in the prophet's challenge to his people (6:135, 28:37, near identical), and in Yusuf's refusal (12:23). A rare clause with strong memorizer value.
tree:087bxrq0uxskmy.relation: Wrongdoing never prospers, whether lying about God or betraying trust.

tree:1ndvp6g0ldmici.why: They were a defiantly disobedient people: Pharaoh's people (27:12, 28:32, 43:54) and Nuh's (51:46). A memorizer set on the signs of Musa.
tree:1ndvp6g0ldmici.relation: Defiance as the cause of the destruction of Pharaoh's and Nuh's people.

tree:1vvs54t142bd3j.why: We inspired Musa: throw your staff (7:117), travel by night with My servants (20:77, 26:52), and strike the sea (26:63). Same story, a memorizer set.
tree:1vvs54t142bd3j.relation: The stages of Musa's struggle, each opened by revelation.

tree:01fzqv30fkyocp.why: Do they not see that God: who created the heavens can create their like (17:99) or revive the dead (46:33), extends provision (30:37), and is stronger than Aad (41:15). A memorizer set.
tree:01fzqv30fkyocp.relation: God's creation shows His power over resurrection, provision and the proud.

tree:00xa3hi0psmu42.why: That is because they are a people who do not reason (5:58, 59:14), know (9:6), or understand (59:13). A memorizer set on which verb closes which ayah.

tree:0nw99j01h53iae.why: Satan made their deeds seem good to them: the Quraysh at Badr (8:48), earlier nations (16:63), the queen of Sheba's people (27:24), and Aad and Thamud (29:38, near identical to 27:24). A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:0nw99j01h53iae.relation: Satan's adornment of evil deeds leads every people away from the path.

tree:0sztfq40q36df4.why: Glory be to Him, exalted above what they associate: each time closing a refutation of shirk (10:18, 16:1, 30:40, 39:67). A memorizer set whose closing fits the theme every time.
tree:0sztfq40q36df4.relation: Every argument against partners ends by declaring God above them.

tree:1rcek1s1vhn1q4.why: If I stand on clear proof from my Lord: the Prophet (6:57), Nuh (11:28), Salih (11:63), and Shuayb (11:88), each with a different continuation. Same theme of prophets and their people, a memorizer set.
tree:1rcek1s1vhn1q4.relation: Every prophet stands on the same clear proof from his Lord.

tree:07xyqre1aew03e.why: Their hearts are sealed so they do not hear (7:100), understand (9:87, 63:3), or know (9:93). A memorizer set on which verb closes which ayah.
tree:07xyqre1aew03e.relation: Hypocrisy and staying behind end in sealed hearts.

tree:0pha0280fdhzws.why: Why has no sign been sent down to him from his Lord: answered four ways (6:37, 10:20, 13:7, 13:27). Same demand of the deniers, a classic memorizer set.
tree:0pha0280fdhzws.relation: The demand for a miracle answered: God can send it, but guidance is His.

tree:1mudsof13glw3t.why: The people of Nuh, Aad and Thamud, followed by different names (9:70, 14:9, 22:42, 40:31). A memorizer set on the destroyed nations.
tree:1mudsof13glw3t.relation: The same line of past nations recalled as a warning.

tree:05oiky4138asf2.why: Only the closing pair of divine names, Mighty and Wise, is shared, after unrelated subjects: Jesus raised (4:158), messengers sent (4:165), the soldiers of the heavens (48:7), and the spoils (48:19).

tree:04tup0m1jj74iw.why: Every soul paid for what it earned, and they will not be wronged: 2:281, 3:25 and 3:161, with 45:22 in a different structure. A memorizer set on just recompense.

tree:0i6fr6e16e4gb2.why: Every soul for what it earned: God stands over it (13:33), it is recompensed today (40:17, 45:22), and it is held in pledge (74:38). A memorizer set on accountability.
tree:0i6fr6e16e4gb2.relation: Each soul is bound to and paid for its own deeds.

tree:1v4c9wy1x0hasy.why: Every soul paid what it earned: three times with they will not be wronged (2:281, 3:25, 3:161) and once with God is swift in account (14:51). A memorizer set; it overlaps another card but adds 14:51.

tree:1el9r231ht6v09.why: See how was the end of the deniers: travel and see (3:137, 16:36), travel then see (6:11), and see (43:25). A classic memorizer set on the particles.
tree:1el9r231ht6v09.relation: The fate of past deniers as a lesson.

tree:0gorw7i0jmb91i.why: Do not follow the footsteps of Satan, he is a clear enemy to you (2:168, 2:208, 6:142), and its longer form in 24:21. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0gorw7i0jmb91i.relation: Satan's steps lead gradually to evil, in food, in faith, and in slander.

tree:1h75q8b19bohmd.why: He gave you hearing, sight and hearts: that you may give thanks (16:78), and little do you thank (23:78, 32:9, 67:23). A classic memorizer set.
tree:1h75q8b19bohmd.relation: The senses are a gift met with little gratitude.

tree:11woy7z0z46f45.why: Two different pairs ending with if you are believers: a sign for you (2:248 the ark of Talut, 3:49 the miracles of Isa), and better for you (7:85 and 11:86, both Shuayb to Madyan). Each pair is a real memorizer link, but they are two different things.
tree:11woy7z0z46f45.changes: Split into two cards: the signs in 2:248 and 3:49, and Shuayb's appeal in 7:85 and 11:86.

check.why: The split is right: 'a sign for you' and 'better for you' are two different pairs, and each is a real link.

tree:1ehbaqc1atlc5g.why: Only the stock closing that God is Forgiving and Merciful is shared, after unrelated subjects: marrying slave women (4:25), captives (8:70), pardoning a relative (24:22), and the double share of mercy (57:28).

tree:069e7z516i20tl.why: To Him belongs, prostrates and glorifies whoever is in the heavens and the earth (21:19, 22:18, 24:41, 30:26). A memorizer set on all creation's submission.
tree:069e7z516i20tl.relation: All creation belongs to God and worships Him.

tree:1vtgcfj04v7heb.why: For them is forgiveness and a noble provision: the emigrants and helpers (8:74), the believers (22:50, 34:4), and the innocent slandered (24:26). A reward formula, but a rarer one, and 22:50 and 34:4 are both followed by those who strive against Our signs.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: it is a reward formula, but a rarer one, and 22:50 and 34:4 run in parallel.

tree:1lxb6rp1u3dzmh.why: They will find no protector or helper besides God: the arrogant (4:173), the deniers (11:20), the hypocrites (33:17), and Nuh's people (71:25). A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:1lxb6rp1u3dzmh.relation: No one besides God can protect the wrongdoers.

tree:0akn0eu0r3f07i.why: There is no blame on you to: trade during pilgrimage (2:198), shorten the prayer in fear (4:101), enter uninhabited houses (24:29), and eat together or apart (24:61). Same formula of permissions, a memorizer set.
tree:0akn0eu0r3f07i.relation: God's ease in worship and daily life.

tree:1728uz81gw0q3u.why: What is with God is better: for the righteous (3:198), and more lasting (28:60, 42:36), and better than amusement and trade (62:11). Same theme, a memorizer set.
tree:1728uz81gw0q3u.relation: What God keeps for His servants outweighs any worldly gain.

tree:0nr6tk504d3xu3.why: What He has sent down no authority for: shirk punished with terror (3:151), Ibrahim's argument (6:81, with 'upon you'), the forbidden things (7:33), and worship besides God (22:71). A memorizer set on one argument.
tree:0nr6tk504d3xu3.relation: Shirk rests on no authority from God.

tree:1ozgmfo13n6so2.why: He knows what they conceal and what they reveal: 2:77, 11:5, 16:23 and 36:76, each with a different context and ending. A memorizer set on God's knowledge of the hidden.
tree:1ozgmfo13n6so2.relation: Nothing people hide escapes God, which comforts the Prophet and warns the arrogant.

tree:1kcd3430yybt7z.why: I know from God what you do not know: Nuh (7:62) and Yaqub twice (12:86, 12:96); and you hope from God what they do not hope (4:104). A memorizer set with a pondering link on the believer's hope.
tree:1kcd3430yybt7z.relation: Knowledge and hope from God set the believer apart from others.

tree:0zs00bg1ia5c62.why: After clear proofs had come to them: differing (2:213, 2:253), the calf (4:153), and division (98:4). A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:0zs00bg1ia5c62.relation: Division and idolatry came after clear proof, not for lack of it.

tree:0hebper0jjw57j.why: After knowledge came to them, out of rivalry (3:19, 42:14, 45:17), and after clear proofs (3:105). A strong memorizer set; overlaps another card but adds 3:105.
tree:0hebper0jjw57j.relation: Division among the people of scripture came from rivalry, not ignorance.

tree:094nlft0y6vc5x.why: Call whoever you can besides God, if you are truthful: the challenge to produce one surah (2:23, 10:38) or ten (11:13). A classic memorizer set. In 39:38 the shared words end one sentence and a new conditional begins, a different structure.
tree:094nlft0y6vc5x.changes: Removed 39:38: its shared words belong to a different structure (what you call on besides God, then if God intended me harm).
tree:094nlft0y6vc5x.relation: The challenge to bring anything like the Quran.

check.why: Removing 39:38 is right: there the shared words end one sentence and a new conditional begins, so the structure differs.

tree:0dz6bs81waox2s.why: Male or female: no worker's deed is lost (3:195), whoever does good while a believer enters Paradise (4:124, 40:40) or is given a good life (16:97). A memorizer set and a clear teaching.
tree:0dz6bs81waox2s.relation: Men and women are rewarded equally for faith and good deeds.

tree:0qxecqp05bofx9.why: Whoever cannot find, then fasting: three days (2:196, 5:89) or two consecutive months (4:92, 58:4). The expiations side by side, a strong memorizer set.
tree:0qxecqp05bofx9.relation: Fasting as the fallback in every expiation, with its length set by the case.

tree:0gjonla109lgig.why: Whoever obeys God and His Messenger: enters gardens (4:13, 48:17), they are the successful (24:52), and has achieved a great success (33:71). A memorizer set.
tree:0gjonla109lgig.relation: Obedience to God and His Messenger is the way to success.

tree:13i142v1dz6tml.why: Guidance and mercy for a people who believe, closing four descriptions of the revelation (7:52, 7:203, 12:111, 16:64). A memorizer set on the lead-ins. The 12:111 row reads on across the surah boundary into 13:1, which should be checked.
tree:13i142v1dz6tml.relation: The revelation is guidance and mercy, but only those who believe benefit.

tree:0qrfknv1gmjkmj.why: It is only a reminder for the worlds (12:104, 38:87, 81:27), and with a different opening in 68:52. A memorizer set. The 68:52 row reads on across the surah boundary into 69:1, which should be checked.

tree:0bi0rq41a61dw6.why: He is the one who made for you the stars (6:97), the night (10:67, 25:47), and the earth (67:15). A memorizer set on God's gifts.
tree:0bi0rq41a61dw6.relation: Stars, night and earth made for people's guidance, rest and livelihood.

tree:0jq6auq06bmwb8.why: We granted him Ishaq and Yaqub, with four continuations (6:84, 19:49, 21:72, 29:27). Same story of Ibrahim, a classic memorizer set.
tree:0jq6auq06bmwb8.relation: Ibrahim's reward for leaving his people: a line of prophets.

tree:1jeq00g1cswg78.why: Who believe in God and the Last Day: the righteous of the People of the Book (3:114), those who do not ask leave from jihad (9:44) set against those who do (9:45), and those who do not love God's enemies (58:22). A memorizer set with a contrast.
tree:1jeq00g1cswg78.relation: Faith in God and the Last Day shows in deeds, loyalties and readiness to strive.

tree:1ys6kba0eo2gr8.why: Those they call on besides God: do not insult them (6:108), they follow conjecture (10:66), they availed nothing (11:101), and they create nothing (16:20). A memorizer set on false gods.
tree:1ys6kba0eo2gr8.relation: The false gods are powerless, yet even they are not to be insulted.

tree:18zoevi149zzbi.why: God gives whom He wills, and God is All-Encompassing, Knowing: kingship (2:247), multiplied reward (2:261), and bounty (3:73, 5:54). The closing fits each case: God's wide giving.
tree:18zoevi149zzbi.relation: Kingship, reward and favour are God's to give as He wills.

tree:1n5c86n0uigl8p.why: Who keep up the prayer and give zakat: while bowing (5:55), and obey God (9:71), and are certain of the Hereafter (27:3, 31:4, identical). A memorizer set.
tree:1n5c86n0uigl8p.relation: Prayer and zakat as the mark of the believers and their allies.
