tree:0o95x7c1e3xxag.why: The day the Horn is blown: His is the dominion (6:73), the criminals gathered (20:102), all terrified (27:87), and you come in crowds (78:18). Same scene, a memorizer set.
tree:0o95x7c1e3xxag.relation: The blowing of the Horn and what follows it.

tree:0i48nyf12zz9rf.why: When we have died and become dust: the deniers' question in five places (23:82, 37:16, 37:53, 50:3, 56:47), with different endings. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0i48nyf12zz9rf.relation: The deniers' doubt about resurrection, repeated and answered.

tree:1no6ba90ripwab.why: Whoever believes in God and the Last Day: the classic pair 2:62 and 5:69, true righteousness (2:177), and those who maintain the mosques (9:18, 9:19). A strong memorizer set.
tree:1no6ba90ripwab.relation: Faith in God and the Last Day as the basis of reward, righteousness and service of the mosques.

tree:184v2wc1cf5xmc.why: We sent Nuh to his people, opening five tellings of his story (7:59, 11:25, 23:23, 29:14, 71:1), with 7:59 and 23:23 identical until the ending. A classic memorizer set.
tree:184v2wc1cf5xmc.relation: The story of Nuh opened the same way, then told from different angles.

tree:0c95koo02817v6.why: Obey God and obey the Messenger: with those in authority (4:59), beware (5:92), if they turn away his duty is only to convey (24:54, 64:12), and do not void your deeds (47:33). A classic memorizer set.
tree:0c95koo02817v6.relation: Obedience to God and the Messenger, and the Messenger's duty only to convey.

tree:1j3urdq1dmi1xq.why: They swore by God their strongest oaths: the hypocrites (5:53), the deniers demanding a sign (6:109), denying resurrection (16:38), promising to go out (24:53), and promising to follow a warner (35:42). A memorizer set on broken oaths.
tree:1j3urdq1dmi1xq.relation: Strong oaths that hide disbelief or are broken when tested.

tree:0ckvuwc1ebvmqq.why: He made the earth for you a bed (2:22), a cradle (20:53, 43:10), a dwelling (40:64), and subservient (67:15). A memorizer set on the noun that follows.
tree:0ckvuwc1ebvmqq.relation: The earth made ready for people, a sign calling to worship God alone.

tree:0sr7ftd1mpbhut.why: Those who said God is: poor (3:181), made a covenant with us (3:183), the Messiah (5:17, 5:72), and the third of three (5:73). False sayings about God, a memorizer set with a strong pair in 5:17 and 5:72.
tree:0sr7ftd1mpbhut.relation: False claims about God, each refuted.

tree:0vxtrjz0fb12bl.why: Only the stock closing that God knows what is in the breasts is shared, after unrelated subjects (3:119, 3:154, 5:7, 31:23, 64:4). Nothing particular to learn from the grouping.

tree:0l9na4s0c1y7cw.why: They call on God, sincere in religion: at sea in danger (10:22, 29:65, 31:32), and the command to worship Him sincerely (40:14, 98:5). A classic memorizer set with a contrast.
tree:0l9na4s0c1y7cw.relation: Sincerity forced by danger and forgotten in safety, against the sincerity God commands always.

tree:0hp06ic1h1hu2c.why: Fear God and know that God: is with the God-fearing (2:194), severe in punishment (2:196), knows all (2:231), sees what you do (2:233), hears and knows (2:244). Five places in al-Baqara where the ending must be placed; the subjects differ, so the value is for memorizers only.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: five places in al-Baqara where the ending after 'know that God' must be placed.

tree:1le0f9k1njf1tg.why: Those who do not believe in God's signs (16:104) or the Hereafter (17:10, 23:74, 27:4, 53:27): five consequences. A memorizer set.
tree:1le0f9k1njf1tg.relation: Denial of the Hereafter leads astray in deeds, path and belief.

tree:0l46n04024n340.why: Only the closing that God is swift in account is shared, after mostly unrelated subjects: disbelief in signs (3:19), the faithful of the People of the Book (3:199), and hunting animals (5:4); only 14:51 and 40:17 share the recompense theme.

check.why: Drop is right: only the stock closing is shared. The one strong pair, 14:51 with 40:17, is already held by kept cards (the C2 compare card and tree:1oww3fm1ympjm2).

tree:1ndmxv50w8y9v1.why: Only the stock closing with divine names (Knowing and Wise, or Knowing and Aware) is shared, after unrelated subjects: inheritance (4:11), marriage (4:24), arbitration (4:35), the Prophet's obedience (33:1), and God's will (76:30).

tree:1f5ny1k16jautu.why: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is guided: 6:117, 16:125, 53:30 and 68:7 with small differences, and 6:119 with the transgressors. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1f5ny1k16jautu.relation: Only God knows who is truly guided.

tree:1knzm2q04acvwq.why: Thus do We reward the good-doers, the refrain of the prophets in as-Saffat (37:80, 37:105, 37:121, 37:131) and in 77:44. A memorizer set: which prophet each one closes.
tree:1knzm2q04acvwq.relation: Each prophet in as-Saffat is praised with the same refrain.

tree:1m99c181v37jfm.why: That there is no god but: He (3:18), the one the Children of Israel believe in (Pharaoh drowning, 10:90), I (16:2, 21:25), and God (47:19). A memorizer set and a strong pondering link.
tree:1m99c181v37jfm.relation: The testimony of oneness from God, His messengers, and even from Pharaoh too late.

tree:068n2qz1rgn41d.why: Only the stock closing that He is the Hearing, the Knowing is shared, after unrelated subjects: peace (8:61), Yusuf's prayer (12:34), the Prophet's trust (26:220), seeking refuge (41:36), and mercy (44:6).

tree:06n315x04rohfn.why: Suddenly while they do not perceive: punishment comes to the heedless in 7:95, 12:107, 26:202, 29:53 and 43:66. Same warning, a memorizer set.
tree:06n315x04rohfn.relation: Punishment and the Hour come suddenly on those who feel safe.

tree:166siw40ooq1xy.why: Gives life to the earth after its death, by rain: 2:164, 16:65, 30:24, 35:9 and 45:5, with different endings. Same sign, a memorizer set.
tree:166siw40ooq1xy.relation: Rain reviving dead land, a sign of God and of the resurrection.

tree:1yjq8po1nfwl46.why: No bearer of burdens bears the burden of another: 6:164, 17:15, 35:18, 39:7 and 53:38, each with a different continuation. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1yjq8po1nfwl46.relation: Each soul carries only its own burden.

tree:1ce0lf40ht8utu.why: What you worship besides God: the Prophet's refusal (10:104), Ibrahim's rebuke (21:67, 29:17), fuel for Hell (21:98), and Ibrahim's people disowning theirs (60:4). A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:1ce0lf40ht8utu.relation: Prophets disown what their people worship besides God.

tree:0aj1ft604xluz4.why: He created the heavens and the earth in truth, with five continuations (6:73, 14:19, 16:3, 39:5, 64:3). A memorizer set.
tree:0aj1ft604xluz4.relation: Creation in truth points to God's sovereignty and the return to Him.

tree:1y60m34191he4c.why: That is easy for God: His recorded knowledge (22:70), repeating creation (29:19), every lifespan (35:11), every calamity written beforehand (57:22), and resurrection (64:7). Same point, what seems vast to people is easy for God.
tree:1y60m34191he4c.relation: Knowledge, decree and resurrection are all easy for God.

tree:1ka1uee1s5mdns.why: Taste the punishment for what you used to disbelieve (3:106, 6:30, 8:35, 46:34) or earn (7:39). Same verdict on the deniers, a memorizer set; 6:30 and 46:34 are near identical.
tree:1ka1uee1s5mdns.relation: The deniers are made to taste what their disbelief earned.

tree:0v5kimw0fpleom.why: In the earth nor in the sky: nothing hidden from God (3:5, 10:61, 14:38), you cannot escape Him (29:22), and every calamity is written (57:22, with 'in yourselves'). A memorizer set on God's encompassing knowledge and power.
tree:0v5kimw0fpleom.relation: Nothing in earth or heaven escapes God's knowledge or power.

tree:1ruqljs077q63a.why: Before them the people of Nuh denied, followed by different names (22:42, 38:12, 40:5, 50:12, 54:9). A classic memorizer set.
tree:1ruqljs077q63a.relation: Denial of messengers is an old pattern that began with Nuh's people.

tree:0o1enkj0fcetql.why: How many generations We destroyed before them: better in goods (19:74), not a sound left (19:98), whose dwellings they walk in (20:128), who never return (36:31), and stronger (50:36). A memorizer set.
tree:0o1enkj0fcetql.relation: The vanished generations as a lesson for the living.

tree:1pb6n7t02wwv4h.why: Their reward is with their Lord: the believers of every community (2:62), those who spend without reproach (2:262) or secretly and openly (2:274), the doers of good (2:277), and the faithful of the People of the Book (3:199, different ending). A memorizer set, mostly on spending.
tree:1pb6n7t02wwv4h.relation: The reward kept with God for faith and generous spending.

tree:1vmeitb0uiz59r.why: We sent before you only men to whom We revealed (12:109, 16:43), no messenger but We revealed to him (21:25), no messenger or prophet (22:52), and no warner to a town (43:23). A classic memorizer set.
tree:1vmeitb0uiz59r.relation: Every messenger before was a man given revelation.

tree:0fs33i801aqex0.why: Ibrahim was upright and not of the polytheists, said five times (2:135, 3:67, 3:95, 6:161, 16:123). A classic memorizer set.
tree:0fs33i801aqex0.relation: The religion of Ibrahim, pure monotheism, claimed by the Prophet's followers.

tree:0byob5c1nqh1zc.why: And they will have no helpers: three times in Al Imran (3:22, 3:56, 3:91) and after those God leaves astray (16:37, 30:29). A memorizer set on one ending.
tree:0byob5c1nqh1zc.relation: Those God abandons have no helper.

tree:05x5wpx1c8hx21.why: After it became clear to them: opposing the Messenger (4:115, 47:32), turning back (47:25), and asking forgiveness for polytheists (9:113). A memorizer set.
tree:05x5wpx1c8hx21.relation: Acting against what has become clear is the gravest error.

tree:15fbs6c1yrq8ii.why: Before a day comes with no trade and no friendship (2:254, 14:31), with no turning back (30:43, 42:47), or before death comes (63:10). A memorizer set on the urgency to act.
tree:15fbs6c1yrq8ii.relation: Spend and respond to God now, before the Day or death closes the door.

tree:1q5vqio1hant7i.why: This is nothing but tales of the ancients, said by deniers in 6:25, 8:31, 23:83, 27:68 and 46:17; the pair 23:83 and 27:68 differ only in word order. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1q5vqio1hant7i.relation: The deniers dismiss revelation as old legends.

tree:12r5zsk1memlbs.why: Most rows share only the common phrase of believing in God and the Last Day, used in unrelated rulings. The real twins, 2:232 and 65:2 (this is an admonition for whoever believes), are already kept in another card (cmp:18439pa00xx94u).

tree:15qs44p1qsw7gj.why: He begins creation then repeats it: 10:4, 10:34, 27:64, 30:11 and 30:27, each with a different continuation. A memorizer set on the argument for resurrection.
tree:15qs44p1qsw7gj.relation: The One who began creation can repeat it.

tree:1xqojap0879ks3.why: Thus God makes clear the signs to you: that you may reflect (2:219, 2:266), and God is Knowing and Wise (24:18, 24:58), that you may reason (24:61). A memorizer set on the endings.

tree:1e0iiym04tjkb4.why: They invent lies against God: on purity claims (4:50), invented cattle rules (5:103), their expectation on the Day (10:60), and they will not succeed (10:69, 16:116, near identical). A memorizer set.
tree:1e0iiym04tjkb4.relation: Inventing lies about God, especially in making things lawful or forbidden, never succeeds.

tree:0q0m0jr1awy5ej.why: He only says to it 'Be' and it is: after decreeing a matter (2:117, 3:47, 19:35, 40:68) or willing a thing (36:82). A classic memorizer set; two are about the birth of Jesus.
tree:0q0m0jr1awy5ej.relation: God's creative command, shown in the birth of Jesus and in all creation.

tree:0ee6pov0gbi2ar.why: They took besides God gods, protectors or intercessors: for honour (19:81), like a spider's house (29:41), for help (36:74), as intercessors (39:43), useless (45:10), and abandoning them (46:28). A memorizer set.
tree:0ee6pov0gbi2ar.relation: Every protector taken besides God fails those who rely on it.

tree:0x5b27e1n6a69i.why: The six rows share only the closing about the heavens and the earth and God the Mighty, the Wise. The real group, the surah openers 57:1, 59:1 and 61:1, is already compared by the books, and 30:27 and 45:37 do not belong. Two rows (45:37, 59:24) read on across surah boundaries.

tree:01r4yab0wbd3z7.why: Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds: opening al-Fatiha (1:2), after the wrongdoers are cut off (6:45), the last call of the people of Paradise (10:10), and closing judgements (37:182, 39:75, 40:65). A memorizer set. Two rows (37:182, 39:75) read on across surah boundaries, which should be checked.
tree:01r4yab0wbd3z7.relation: Praise of God opens the Book and closes every judgement.

tree:1d4b2tg13melzg.why: God is the possessor of great bounty, each time after His bounty given to whom He wills: 2:105 and 3:74 (He chooses for His mercy), 57:21, 57:29 and 62:4 (God's favour He gives whom He wills), and 8:29. The closing fits the theme every time. The 57:29 row reads on across the surah boundary into 58:1.
tree:1d4b2tg13melzg.relation: God's favour is His to give, and no one can withhold it.

tree:090b6g51g5vibj.why: You have no protector or helper besides God: after His dominion (2:107, 9:116), after following desires (2:120, 13:37), and you cannot escape (29:22, 42:31). A strong memorizer set with three pairs.
tree:090b6g51g5vibj.relation: Only God protects; dominion is His and no one escapes Him.

tree:1x5pppp1trvrkx.why: God knows what is in: yourselves (2:235), your hearts (33:51), and the heavens and the earth (5:97, 22:70, 49:16, 58:7). A memorizer set on God's knowledge.
tree:1x5pppp1trvrkx.relation: God knows the inner thoughts as He knows all of creation.

tree:1411tvw1bch20a.why: And to God all matters return, closing six ayat (2:210, 3:109, 8:44, 22:76, 35:4, 57:5). A rare refrain, a memorizer set; each closes a statement of God's control.
tree:1411tvw1bch20a.relation: Every affair returns to God in the end.

tree:0izl9on127msfx.why: Only the stock closing that God hears and knows is shared, after six unrelated rulings and events (2:181, 2:227, 2:244, 8:17, 8:53, 49:1).

tree:1wi90r0109ykhk.why: This is nothing but clear magic: said of Jesus' signs (5:110), a book on parchment (6:7), resurrection (11:7), the truth (34:43), and in 37:15, with 'magic handed down' in 74:24. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1wi90r0109ykhk.relation: Every sign of truth is dismissed by deniers as magic.

tree:0dn9b8c1sexpzm.why: What was sent down to you from your Lord: increases many in transgression (5:64, 5:68, near identical), must be conveyed (5:67), and is the truth (13:1, 13:19, 34:6). A memorizer set.
tree:0dn9b8c1sexpzm.relation: The same revelation is truth to the knowing and increases the deniers in rebellion.

tree:05o6s6f0l1yznh.why: Travel and see how was the end of the deniers, corrupters, criminals, or those before (3:137, 6:11, 7:86, 16:36, 27:69, 30:42). A memorizer set on which ending goes where.
tree:05o6s6f0l1yznh.relation: The fate of past nations as a lesson.

tree:13vz8d004ex1ey.why: Only the closing that He knows what is in the breasts is shared, after mostly unrelated subjects: the dream at Badr (8:43), the unseen (35:38), recompense (39:7), and the charge of invention (42:24); only 11:5 and 67:13 share the theme of hiding.

check.why: Drop is right: only the closing is shared, after unrelated subjects, and a kept W2 card (tree:174llzx0d7pxy5) already covers this closing as a memorizer set.

tree:1yeo29l05demd3.why: I am to you a trustworthy messenger: the refrain of Nuh, Hud, Salih, Lut and Shuayb in ash-Shuara (26:107 to 26:178), each followed by the same lines and then each prophet's particular charge, and Musa in 44:18. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1yeo29l05demd3.relation: Every prophet brings the same message; only the sin of each people differs.

check.why: Keep is right: the 'trustworthy messenger' refrain in ash-Shuara is a classic memorizer set.

tree:01qirmf0bht3tr.why: Rather, most of them do not know: after praise be to God in three parables and questions (16:75, 31:25, 39:29), and after the charge of invention (16:101), the demand for proof (21:24), and a god with God (27:61). A memorizer set.
tree:01qirmf0bht3tr.relation: Most people fail to see what the signs and parables make plain.

tree:0jvvmlr0pncb8f.why: Then He rose over the Throne, after creating the heavens and the earth in six days, in 7:54, 10:3, 13:2, 25:59, 32:4 and 57:4, each continuing differently. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0jvvmlr0pncb8f.relation: The Creator who rose over the Throne governs all affairs.

tree:0zfv9660usvb10.why: That is the great success, closing six descriptions of the believers' reward (9:72, 9:111, 10:64, 40:9, 44:57, 57:12), with and without the conjunction. A memorizer set; each names what the success is.
tree:0zfv9660usvb10.relation: What counts as the great success: Paradise, God's pleasure, protection from evil.

tree:1jpmmf51m90gbh.why: God is witness over all things: Isa's words (5:117), the religions judged (22:17), the messenger's reward (34:47), the signs in the horizons (41:53), the Day (58:6), and the persecutors of the believers (85:9). A rarer closing, each time on God witnessing deeds.

check.why: I would drop it. Only the closing 'God is witness over all things' is shared, after six unrelated subjects. The same agent dropped the sibling closings 'knows what is in the breasts' and 'swift in account' for exactly that reason, and the brief leans to drop such formulas.

tree:13enea90nm96o7.why: Only the stock closing that God is Knowing and Wise is shared, after unrelated subjects in an-Nisa and al-Fath (4:17, 4:92, 4:104, 4:111, 4:170, 48:4).

tree:0j09p1b1u40rlt.why: Have they not travelled and seen the end of those before them: 12:109, 30:9, 30:42, 35:44, 40:82 and 47:10, each with a different description. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0j09p1b1u40rlt.relation: The stronger nations before were destroyed; their ruins are the lesson.

tree:0m1ztt51cj1jmt.why: Those before them also denied: 6:148, 10:39, 34:45, 35:25, 39:25 and 67:18, with different endings. A memorizer set.
tree:0m1ztt51cj1jmt.relation: Denial repeats through history, and so does its end.

tree:01u2q3c156lbs2.why: Had God willed, they would not have: fought (2:253), associated (6:107), done it (6:137), and the polytheists' excuse (6:148, 16:35); and I would not have recited it (10:16). A classic memorizer set and a pondering point on divine will.
tree:01u2q3c156lbs2.relation: God's will allows human choice; the polytheists misuse it as an excuse.

tree:1mtj9xr1uze6j7.why: Only the stock closing that God is not unaware of what you do is shared, after unrelated subjects in al-Baqara and Al Imran (2:74, 2:85, 2:140, 2:144, 2:149, 3:99). Kept consistent with other cards built on this closing.

check.why: Drop is right: only the stock closing is shared. The 2:144 with 2:149 qibla pair is held by a kept compare card, and a kept W4 card holds the closing as a set.

tree:1fdb6231v8qktn.why: All that is on the earth: offered as ransom on the Day (5:36, 13:18, 39:47, near identical), and spent without uniting hearts (8:63). Same point, the whole earth cannot buy what only God gives. In 2:29 the phrase is about creation for people, a different subject.
tree:1fdb6231v8qktn.changes: Removed 2:29: it uses the phrase for what God created for people, not for what cannot be bought.
tree:1fdb6231v8qktn.relation: Not all the earth's wealth can ransom a soul or unite hearts.

check.why:
I would keep 2:29. It has the same words and grammatical role as the other rows:
ما في الأرض جميعا
Only the subject differs (what God created for you), and per the Clarifications a different subject is not a reason to remove a row. Keep all five rows.

tree:12up6vl0x8foar.why: Confirming what was before it: the Quran (2:97, 3:3, 5:48, 35:31), Jesus and the Gospel (5:46), and the jinn on the book after Musa (46:30). A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:12up6vl0x8foar.relation: Each revelation confirms the one before it.

tree:0atgdyv1gw269b.why: Only the common phrase 'those given the Book' is shared, across unrelated subjects: casting the Book away (2:101), obeying them (3:100), hearing harm (3:186), marriage (5:5), mockers (5:57), and the jizya (9:29). No single point to learn.

check.why: Drop is right: 'those given the Book' is a common phrase, used here across six unrelated subjects.

tree:1ooyppc0obzrrm.why: Who bar from the way of God: 7:45 and 11:19 (with the repeated pronoun), 14:3 (seeking it crooked), 8:47, 9:34 and 22:25. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1ooyppc0obzrrm.relation: Barring others from God's way goes with love of this world and denial of the Hereafter.

tree:0194z0300p188x.why: They worship besides God what neither harms nor benefits them (10:18, 25:55, the two verbs reversed), what owns no provision (16:73), and what has no authority (22:71); and what they worship, left by Ibrahim (19:49) and gathered on the Day (25:17). A memorizer set.
tree:0194z0300p188x.relation: Worship of the powerless, abandoned by Ibrahim and exposed on the Day.

tree:0d9ff6s0yp64tm.why: He knows what is in the heavens and the earth, with and without the repeated 'what is in' (3:29, 5:97, 29:52, 49:16, 58:7, 64:4). A memorizer set on God's knowledge.

tree:1yejqh20h8vmi0.why: Then He will inform you of what you used to do, after your return to Him (5:105, 6:60, 39:7) or to the Knower of the unseen (9:94, 9:105, 62:8). A memorizer set on the lead-ins.
tree:1yejqh20h8vmi0.relation: Every deed will be shown to its doer when all return to God.

tree:0zg597p0x0hdgp.why: Except that God wills: they would not believe (6:111), we would not return to your religion (7:89), Yusuf could not take his brother (12:76), saying God willing (18:24), and you will only as God wills (74:56, 76:30, 81:29). A rich memorizer set on God's will.
tree:0zg597p0x0hdgp.relation: Every human will is subject to God's will.

tree:0wq4gil03apm3x.why: Those who disbelieve and deny Our signs: companions of the Fire (2:39, 64:10), of Hellfire (5:10, 5:86, 57:19), a humiliating punishment (22:57), and brought to punishment (30:16). A classic memorizer set.
tree:0wq4gil03apm3x.relation: Disbelief and denial of signs lead to the Fire.

tree:08aveq80wy3ev0.why: Only the stock closing that God is aware of what you do is shared, after unrelated subjects (3:153, 5:8, 9:16, 24:53, 58:13, 59:18, 63:11). The 63:11 row also reads on across the surah boundary into 64:1.

tree:1b2pak409bpqpk.why: Only the stock closing that God is Mighty and Wise is shared, after seven unrelated subjects (2:209, 2:220, 2:260, 8:10, 8:49, 9:71, 31:27).

tree:02c256d06aixmn.why: They disbelieved and barred from God's way: strayed far (4:167), punishment upon punishment (16:88), deeds lost (47:1, 47:32), never forgiven (47:34); and they used their oaths as a shield (58:16, 63:2). A memorizer set with clear pairs.
tree:02c256d06aixmn.relation: Barring others from God's way multiplies one's own loss.

tree:1dm3gb804q4zbq.why: And what they used to invent has left them, said in six places (6:24, 7:53, 10:30, 11:21, 16:87, 28:75), and what they used to call on in 41:48. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1dm3gb804q4zbq.relation: On the Day all the false gods and lies abandon those who relied on them.

tree:00u45ni0ztrc0a.why: And upon God let the believers rely, closing seven ayat (3:122, 3:160, 5:11, 9:51, 14:11, 58:10, 64:13). A memorizer set; each is a moment of fear or threat answered with trust.
tree:00u45ni0ztrc0a.relation: In every danger the believers are told to rely on God.

tree:1izwaya02wfhby.why: In the land without right: being arrogant (7:146, 28:39, 41:15, 46:20), transgressing (10:23, 42:42), and exulting (40:75). A memorizer set on which verb goes where.
tree:1izwaya02wfhby.relation: Arrogance and transgression on earth without right lead to ruin.

tree:1918hys1j6e0hg.why: Then see how was the end of those before them: 12:109, 30:9, 30:42, 35:44, 40:21, 40:82 and 47:10. Overlaps another card but adds 40:21; a classic memorizer set.

tree:0nmpr620agujtk.why: We gave Musa the Book, with seven continuations (2:87, 11:110, 23:49, 25:35, 28:43, 32:23, 41:45), 11:110 and 41:45 identical. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0nmpr620agujtk.relation: The Book of Musa, its purpose, and the differences over it.

tree:1eczx3p1nvsxxb.why: But they used to wrong themselves: after the manna and quails (2:57, 7:160), after the destroyed nations (9:70, 16:33, 29:40, 30:9), and after the foods forbidden to the Jews (16:118). The lead-ins differ (they did not wrong Us; God would not wrong them; We did not wrong them), a classic memorizer set.
tree:1eczx3p1nvsxxb.relation: God wrongs no one; people bring ruin on themselves.

tree:0pfyf2h18ahu4n.why: From darkness into light: by God (2:257, 5:16), by the Book (14:1, 57:9, 65:11), by Musa (14:5), and by God's blessing and the angels (33:43). A classic memorizer set.
tree:0pfyf2h18ahu4n.relation: God, His books and His messengers bring people out of darkness into light.

tree:1k7gz2k0sfb52w.why: You have no protector or helper besides God: 2:107, 9:116, 29:22, 42:31, and with protectors in 11:20 and 11:113. A memorizer set. In 11:101 the shared words belong to a different structure (their gods availed them nothing besides God).
tree:1k7gz2k0sfb52w.changes: Removed 11:101: there the words after 'besides God' are the object of 'availed', a different structure.
tree:1k7gz2k0sfb52w.relation: No one besides God can protect.

check.why: Removing 11:101 is right: there the words after 'besides God' are the object of 'availed', a different structure. Keeping the 'no protector or helper' set follows the owner's precedent.

tree:14xnqvj196ndbx.why: No protector and no helper, closing seven ayat (2:107, 2:120, 9:74, 9:116, 29:22, 42:8, 42:31) with different lead-ins. A classic memorizer set; overlaps other cards on the same closing.
tree:14xnqvj196ndbx.relation: Without God there is no protector or helper.

tree:1fmpfq41tw34g0.why: Keep up the prayer and give zakat, then eight different continuations (2:43, 2:83, 2:110, 4:77, 22:78, 24:56, 58:13, 73:20). A classic memorizer set.
tree:1fmpfq41tw34g0.relation: Prayer and zakat are commanded together, each time joined to another duty.

tree:0etbwan0izio05.why: Those in whose hearts is a disease: eight places (5:52, 8:49, 9:125, 33:12, 33:60, 47:20, 47:29, 74:31), often beside the hypocrites. A memorizer set, and a portrait of the sick heart.
tree:0etbwan0izio05.relation: What the diseased heart says and does in times of trial.

tree:0kuiqsk0xk96d0.why: Only the stock closing that God is aware of what you do is shared, after eight unrelated subjects (2:234, 2:271, 3:180, 31:29, 57:10, 58:3, 58:11, 64:8).

tree:17l1khf1falshb.why: Whom God leaves astray has no guide (13:33, 39:23, 39:36, 40:33), no protector (42:44), no way (42:46), and whom God humiliates has no honourer (22:18). A memorizer set.
tree:17l1khf1falshb.relation: No one can guide or honour whom God abandons.

tree:1m5922a0jn3tso.why: Two structures meet: saying about God what you do not know (2:80, 2:169, 7:28, 7:33, 10:68), and I know from God what you do not know (Nuh 7:62, Yaqub 12:86, 12:96). A memorizer set with a contrast worth pondering.
tree:1m5922a0jn3tso.relation: Contrast: the deniers speak about God without knowledge, while prophets know from God what others do not.

check.why: Keep is right: two structures (saying about God without knowledge, and knowing from God) form a real contrast.

tree:0ptz80j1mxe45h.why: Whoever opposes God and His Messenger, God is severe in punishment: 8:13 and 59:4 are near identical, a strong memorizer pair. The other six share only the common closing after unrelated commands.
tree:0ptz80j1mxe45h.changes: Kept only 8:13 and 59:4; removed the six rows that share only the closing formula.
tree:0ptz80j1mxe45h.relation: Opposing God and His Messenger brings severe punishment, at Badr and on Banu an-Nadir.

check.why: The result is right: keep 8:13 with 59:4. The other six share the same closing, so strictly this is a split rather than a structural removal, but that leftover part is a stock closing and would be dropped anyway.

tree:1f8nc051ihgv6l.why: That God knows what: they conceal and reveal (2:77, 16:23), is in yourselves (2:235), in the heavens and earth (5:97, 22:70, 58:7), you do (16:91), and they call on (29:42). A memorizer set on God's knowledge; overlaps other cards with the same theme.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: these are places on God's knowledge, each with a different object.

tree:02j9de912v48xf.why: Thus God makes clear to you the signs or His signs, closing rulings with different endings: reflect (2:219, 2:266), reason (2:242, 24:61), be guided (3:103), give thanks (5:89), and Knowing and Wise (24:58, 24:59). A classic memorizer set.

tree:0ht8g6s0rihggc.why: To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, then eight continuations (3:189, 5:17, 5:18, 5:120, 24:42, 42:49, 45:27, 48:14). A classic memorizer set.
tree:0ht8g6s0rihggc.relation: God's dominion over all: He creates, forgives, punishes, and all return to Him.

tree:0bxj24v19nzt9x.why: Whoever is in the heavens and the earth: submits (3:83), prostrates (13:15), comes as a servant (19:93), belongs to Him (21:19, 30:26), glorifies (24:41), does not know the unseen (27:65), and asks of Him (55:29). A memorizer set.
tree:0bxj24v19nzt9x.relation: All creation submits to God and depends on Him.

tree:0tbufzn191woxh.why: Upon whom He wills of His servants: revelation (2:90, 16:2, 40:15), guidance (6:88), the land (7:128), good (10:107), favour (14:11), and rain (30:48). A memorizer set on God's choosing.
tree:0tbufzn191woxh.relation: God chooses whom He wills for revelation, guidance and blessing.

tree:1p1ieuk15q5n1e.why: Fear God, indeed God is: severe in punishment (5:2, 59:7), swift in account (5:4), knowing the breasts (5:7), aware (5:8), forgiving (8:69), hearing (49:1), accepting repentance (49:12). The subjects differ; its value is for memorizers who must place each closing.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: a memorizer set for placing the closing after 'fear God', consistent with the kept al-Baqara 'know that God' set.

tree:0pw6jsx0fnwms1.why: Only the stock closing that God sees what you do is shared, after nine unrelated subjects (2:110, 2:233, 2:237, 2:265, 3:156, 8:72, 57:4, 60:3, 64:2).

tree:0mowl3315c7059.why: God, there is no god but He: the Living, the Sustainer (2:255, 3:2), He will gather you (4:87), Lord of the Throne (9:129, 27:26), His are the best names (20:8), and more (20:14, 28:70, 64:13). A classic memorizer set.
tree:0mowl3315c7059.relation: The declaration of oneness, each time joined to a different attribute.

tree:0gb2fw60lc24n6.why: My reward is only from God or the Lord of the worlds: Nuh (10:72, 11:29), Hud (11:51), the five prophets of ash-Shuara (26:109 to 26:180), and the Prophet (34:47). A classic memorizer set.
tree:0gb2fw60lc24n6.relation: Every messenger seeks his reward only from God.

tree:0ky8rsm1dezbzu.why: If you are of the truthful: the challenge thrown at Hud (7:70, 46:22), Musa (7:106, 26:31), Nuh (11:32), the Prophet (15:7), Salih (26:154), Shuayb (26:187), and Lut (29:29). A classic memorizer set on prophets and their people. The rows for 7:106 and 26:31 read on across three more ayat each, which should be checked.
tree:0ky8rsm1dezbzu.relation: Every people dares its prophet to bring the punishment or a sign.

tree:0a3fzw80v2oxxu.why: Those you call on besides God: I am forbidden to worship them (6:56, 40:66), where are they (7:37), servants like you (7:194), I leave them (19:48), cannot create a fly (22:73), show me what they created (35:40, 46:4), and can they remove harm (39:38). A memorizer set.
tree:0a3fzw80v2oxxu.relation: The powerlessness of what is called on besides God.

tree:1pgyx8l1clg3ur.why: That is better for you, if you know (fasting, charity to a debtor, striving, God's reward, Ibrahim's call, Friday prayer) or if you are believers (Shuayb, 7:85, 11:86). A classic memorizer set.
tree:1pgyx8l1clg3ur.relation: What God asks is better for people than what they hold on to.

tree:19e92bb1ax1oev.why: O my people, worship God, you have no god but Him: Nuh, Hud, Salih and Shuayb in al-Araf and Hud, Nuh in al-Muminun, and Shuayb in 29:36 with a different continuation. A classic memorizer set on prophets and their people.
tree:19e92bb1ax1oev.relation: Every prophet opens with the same call to worship God alone.

tree:01wt7jx1wknb2x.why: Only the stock closing that God is Forgiving and Merciful is shared, after nine unrelated subjects in an-Nisa, al-Furqan, al-Ahzab and al-Fath. The 33:73 row also reads on across the surah boundary into 34:1.

tree:00s4aqc1x6wjt0.why: Only the stock closing that most of them do not know is shared, after nine unrelated subjects (6:37, 7:131, 8:34, 10:55, 28:13, 28:57, 39:49, 44:39, 52:47). Kept consistent with other cards built on this closing.

check.why: Drop is right: only the stock closing 'most of them do not know' is shared, after nine unrelated subjects.

tree:1p5cntl1cakpfv.why: Another god with God: the warning and its outcomes in nine places (15:96, 17:22, 17:39, 23:117, 25:68, 26:213, 28:88, 50:26, 51:51). A classic memorizer set on which consequence follows each.
tree:1p5cntl1cakpfv.relation: Setting up another god with God leads to blame, the Fire and failure.

tree:0nba8w31w8juix.why: Worshipping besides God what neither benefits nor harms: in nine places (5:76, 6:71, 10:18, 10:106, 16:73, 21:66, 22:12, 22:71, 25:55), the order of the two verbs changing. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0nba8w31w8juix.relation: False gods have no power to benefit or harm.

tree:0udo04w1lu3f7w.why: He extends provision to whom He wills and restricts it, with or without 'of His servants' and 'for him', in nine places. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0udo04w1lu3f7w.relation: Provision is in God's hand; wealth is not a sign of His favour.

tree:08cmw5s11t3tf4.why: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter, with ten different descriptions (6:113 to 53:27). A memorizer set and a full portrait of this group.
tree:08cmw5s11t3tf4.relation: Denial of the Hereafter shapes the heart, the path and the beliefs.

tree:1g1nwks0mvcca6.why: Worship God, you have no god but Him: the prophets' call in al-Araf, Hud and al-Muminun, including 23:32. A classic memorizer set. In 42:47 the shared words belong to a different sentence (no turning back from God, you have no refuge), not the call.
tree:1g1nwks0mvcca6.changes: Removed 42:47: its shared words are a different structure about the Day, not the prophets' call.
tree:1g1nwks0mvcca6.relation: Every prophet's call opens with the same words.

check.why: Removing 42:47 is right: its shared words belong to a different sentence about the Day, not the prophets' call.

tree:1o8p8js1y1in9y.why: Do you not see that God: ten signs of creation (14:19, 22:18, 22:63, 22:65, 24:41, 24:43, 31:29, 35:27, 39:21, 58:7). A memorizer set; three are about rain sent down.
tree:1o8p8js1y1in9y.relation: The signs of creation invite the reader to look and reflect.

tree:0k45e481v2kaps.why: God does not love: the transgressors (2:190, 5:87), the disbelievers (3:32), the arrogant boaster (4:36, 31:18), the treacherous (4:107, 8:58), the exultant (28:76), and the corrupters (28:77). A memorizer set and a list of traits to avoid.
tree:0k45e481v2kaps.relation: The traits God does not love, from aggression to arrogance.

tree:1vgp00c02dhqno.why: God's promise is true, in ten places with different continuations: be patient (30:60, 40:55, 40:77), do not be deceived by this life (31:33, 35:5), and the deniers' reply (45:32, 46:17). A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:1vgp00c02dhqno.relation: Certainty of God's promise calls for patience and guards against worldly deception.

tree:1y7rczf03mpxpx.why: He sent down water from the sky, then ten continuations (2:22, 6:99, 13:17, 14:32, 16:10, 16:65, 20:53, 22:63, 35:27, 39:21). A classic memorizer set on what the rain brings out.
tree:1y7rczf03mpxpx.relation: Rain as provision, life and a parable.

tree:18r6stl11qcp8v.why: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, then ten continuations (2:107, 5:40, 7:158, 9:116, 25:2, 39:44, 43:85, 57:2, 57:5, 85:9). A memorizer set.
tree:18r6stl11qcp8v.relation: God's dominion is the ground of His power, His oneness and the return to Him.

tree:07g32wf1qvwty7.why: What they used to mock: its news will come (6:5, 26:6), it encompassed them (6:10, 21:41, identical, and 11:8, 16:34, 39:48, 40:83, 45:33, 46:26). A classic memorizer set.
tree:07g32wf1qvwty7.relation: The mockers are overtaken by what they mocked.

tree:1a1u3uu0pxkrlm.why: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against God, in eleven places, and the charge thrown at prophets (23:38, 34:8, 42:24). A classic memorizer set.
tree:1a1u3uu0pxkrlm.relation: Lying about God is the worst injustice, and the deniers accuse the prophets of it.

tree:0ghqmjg0i5p86m.why: Mostly the stock closing that God does not guide the wrongdoing, disbelieving or defiant people, after unrelated subjects (5:51, 5:67, 6:144, 16:107, 28:50, 46:10, 63:6). A few rows (12:52, 40:28) have rarer endings, but the set as a whole has no single point.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing about whom God does not guide, after unrelated subjects.

tree:1a4b60y00p63g6.why: Only the stock closing that He has power over all things (or is guardian, or witness) is shared, after eleven unrelated subjects. The 5:120 row also reads on across the surah boundary into 6:1.

tree:1gtt4b41ym1p50.why: Only the common address to the believers followed by 'when' is shared, opening eleven unrelated rulings: debts, travel, ablution, battle, divorce, private talk, assemblies, emigrant women, and Friday prayer. No single point links them.

check.why: Drop is right: only the common address to the believers is shared, opening unrelated rulings.

tree:01pjhhl1a479bd.why: Who created the heavens and the earth: in six days then rose over the Throne (7:54, 10:3, 25:59, 32:4, 57:4), in truth (6:73), with the Throne on water (11:7), and able to create their like or revive the dead (17:99, 36:81, 46:33). A classic memorizer set.
tree:01pjhhl1a479bd.relation: The Creator of the heavens can surely raise the dead.

tree:1k67x921aoduvw.why: Only the stock closing that God knows all things is shared, after twelve unrelated subjects. Three rows (4:176, 8:75, 24:64) also read on across surah boundaries.

tree:1fo46oq08ik3mc.why: Have you not seen those who: the rhetorical opening of twelve portraits, among them the People of the Book given a portion (3:23, 4:44, 4:51, near identical openings), the hypocrites (4:60, 58:14, 59:11), and those who exchanged God's favour (14:28). A memorizer set; the subjects vary but all are warnings about a group's conduct.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: the near-identical openings in 3:23, 4:44 and 4:51 carry the set, and all the rows warn about a group's conduct.

tree:1ifi8ij07i2spj.why: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, with and without the repeated 'what is in', in eleven places, often answering the claim of a son (2:116, 4:171, 10:68). A memorizer set. In 59:24 the shared words follow 'glorifies Him', a different structure.
tree:1ifi8ij07i2spj.changes: Removed 59:24: there the words are the subject of 'glorifies Him', not a statement of ownership.
tree:1ifi8ij07i2spj.relation: Everything belongs to God, so He needs no son or partner.

check.why: Removing 59:24 is right: glorification is a different structure from ownership.

tree:1uo8xyq0au36u0.why: To God belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, with and without the repeated 'what is in', in eleven places with different continuations. A memorizer set. The five surah openers (57:1, 59:1, 61:1, 62:1, 64:1) use the words after 'glorifies God', a different structure, and the books already compare them.
tree:1uo8xyq0au36u0.changes: Removed the five glorification openers 57:1, 59:1, 61:1, 62:1 and 64:1: their shared words follow a different verb and structure.
tree:1uo8xyq0au36u0.relation: God owns all, so to Him all return and He judges as He wills.

check.why: Removing the five glorification openers is right: that structure differs from ownership, and the books already compare those openers.

tree:1j3826h1kv0syt.why: The heavens and the earth and what is between them: created in truth (15:85, 30:8, 46:3), in six days (25:59, 32:4, 50:38), not in play (44:38), their Lord (19:65, 26:24, 37:5, 38:66, 44:7, 78:37), and their dominion (5:17, 5:18, 38:10, 43:85). A memorizer set on the formula.
tree:1j3826h1kv0syt.relation: All between heaven and earth is God's creation, made with purpose.

tree:0uplbi61o04tty.why: Only the stock closing that most people do not know, thank or believe is shared, after seventeen unrelated subjects. Kept consistent with other cards built on this closing.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing after seventeen unrelated subjects.

tree:061elyk071u7ic.why: Only the stock closing that God does not guide the wrongdoing, disbelieving or defiant people is shared, after eighteen unrelated subjects. Kept consistent with other cards built on this closing.

tree:0f2b6sq0esfmti.why: Only the phrase 'our fathers before' is shared, in two different arguments: the excuse that the forefathers associated partners (7:173), and the claim that resurrection was promised to the forefathers too (27:68). Different subjects and structures.

check.why: Drop is right: only 'our fathers before' is shared, in two different arguments.

tree:1jv6qdb0iav0p5.why: And We gave Dawud the Psalms, closing two passages on the prophets: the list of those given revelation (4:163) and the preference of some prophets over others (17:55). Rare exact clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:1jv6qdb0iav0p5.relation: Dawud's Psalms named among God's gifts to His prophets.

tree:1eq0ku903pode9.why: God gave him kingship: Dawud, given kingship and wisdom after killing Jalut (2:251), and the tyrant who argued with Ibrahim because God had given him kingship (2:258). Same surah, a rare phrase and a sharp contrast.
tree:1eq0ku903pode9.relation: Contrast: the same gift of kingship used with wisdom by one and with arrogance by the other.

tree:1mgllpw13gql2w.why: When we are dust, will we be: in a new creation (13:5), and brought out, we and our fathers (27:67). Same denial of resurrection, a memorizer pair.

tree:11t2d511wvs1cb.why: Ears with which they hear: the idols have none (7:195), and the deniers have them but their hearts are blind (22:46). A rare phrase and a strong pondering pair.
tree:11t2d511wvs1cb.relation: Contrast: idols without senses, and people with senses whose hearts are blind.

tree:0hafz1v06q5pf5.why: Reinforcement by angels at Badr: three thousand (3:124), then five thousand if you are patient and fear God (3:125). Consecutive ayat with the number to remember.
tree:0hafz1v06q5pf5.relation: God's help grows with patience and God-consciousness.

tree:01yewzv1pg9edz.why: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us: the prayer of the God-fearing (3:16) and of a group of God's servants mocked by the deniers (23:109). Same prayer, different endings, a memorizer pair.
tree:01yewzv1pg9edz.relation: The believers' prayer for forgiveness, answered with protection and mercy.

tree:1x2fxkv0dt7s4v.why: The shared words are a different structure in each: a command to believe in what God sent down (2:91), and the hypocrites who claim they believed (4:60). Different subjects, nothing to learn together.

tree:1p126hs1qun988.why: They believed then disbelieved: the repeated cycle with no forgiveness (4:137), and the hypocrites whose hearts were sealed (63:3). Same theme, worth pondering.
tree:1p126hs1qun988.relation: Wavering between faith and disbelief ends in a sealed heart.

tree:1vuyrvq0eudmz4.why: Only short connecting words are shared: mercy for those of you who believe (9:61) and God raises those of you who believe (58:11), each followed by a different group. Different subjects.

tree:0k7j3vn06cxfpp.why: We made them leaders guiding by Our command: Ibrahim's line (21:73) and the leaders of the Children of Israel because they were patient (32:24). Rare exact clause, a memorizer and pondering pair.
tree:0k7j3vn06cxfpp.relation: Leadership in religion is given for worship, patience and certainty.

tree:1a6f1681h381t6.why: Taking God's signs in mockery: forbidden to the believers in rulings on divorce (2:231), and the cause of the deniers' end in the Fire (45:35). A rare phrase with a clear contrast.
tree:1a6f1681h381t6.relation: A warning to the believers in the same words that condemn the people of the Fire.

tree:1v3ega415trn9g.why: His signs, that you may reason, in al-Baqara twice: after the cow brings the dead man to life (2:73) and after the divorce rulings (2:242). The subjects differ; the pair is useful mainly for memorizers.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: the same 'His signs, that you may reason' appears twice in al-Baqara, a memorizer pair.

tree:062xbf41k8f7ns.why: God makes His signs clear to people that they may: be God-fearing (2:187, after fasting), or remember (2:221, after marriage to polytheists). Same surah and formula, a memorizer pair.

tree:1w372tx0septgt.why: Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqub: Yusuf follows their religion (12:38), and they are praised as men of strength and vision (38:45). Same patriarchs, a memorizer and pondering pair.
tree:1w372tx0septgt.relation: The patriarchs as a model followed by Yusuf and praised by God.

tree:1jalbyl06e8vuv.why: Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa and Isa named together: in the solemn covenant taken from the prophets (33:7), and in the one religion prescribed to them all (42:13). A rich pondering pair.
tree:1jalbyl06e8vuv.relation: The great messengers share one covenant and one religion.

tree:025peth1b1x9dj.why: Lists of those owed kindness, ending with the traveller: in spending (2:215) and in the command of good treatment (4:36). Same theme, a memorizer pair.
tree:025peth1b1x9dj.relation: The weak who are owed spending and kindness.

tree:1wx3a2c0sgdqgo.why: The son of Mary and his mother: God could destroy them if He willed (5:17), and He made them a sign and sheltered them (23:50). A rare phrase on one subject, with a pondering point about their human nature.

check.why: Keep is right: a rare phrase about the same two people.

tree:1svnc921hmwsvy.why: Those who did wrong followed: their luxury (11:116) and their desires (30:29). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:1svnc921hmwsvy.relation: Wrongdoers follow comfort and desire instead of guidance.

tree:01ma7431xbvt9r.why: Whoever follows you of the believers: God is sufficient for you and for them (8:64), and lower your wing to them (26:215). Rare exact clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:01ma7431xbvt9r.relation: The Prophet's followers, protected by God and treated gently by him.

tree:0vmqmbj09eegxp.why: His reward is due from God: the emigrant who dies on the way (4:100), and the one who pardons and makes peace (42:40). A rare phrase and a pondering pair.
tree:0vmqmbj09eegxp.relation: Sacrifice and forgiveness both earn a reward God Himself guarantees.

tree:0sgozwl1otzapf.why: Anyone among the worlds, in one surah: given what no one else among the worlds was given (5:20), and punished as no one else among the worlds (5:115). A rare phrase with a sharp contrast.
tree:0sgozwl1otzapf.relation: Contrast: unique favour for Musa's people, and unique punishment for those who disbelieve after the table.

tree:0c652v20pdm2ha.why: When death comes to one of them he says: I repent now (4:18), and my Lord, send me back (23:99). Same scene, a memorizer and pondering pair.
tree:0c652v20pdm2ha.relation: Repentance at death comes too late.

tree:19unnif0awuexv.why: The best of what they did: God rewards it and adds from His favour (24:38), and accepts it and overlooks their misdeeds (46:16). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:19unnif0awuexv.relation: God rewards the best of deeds and overlooks the worst.

tree:0h5onzg1tn48ry.why: Good things are made lawful for you, in consecutive ayat: hunting with trained animals (5:4) and the food of the People of the Book (5:5). A memorizer pair.

tree:0n6dolm1p9ejke.why: Musa fears they will kill him, in two tellings: for the crime they hold against him (26:14) and because he killed one of them (28:33). Same story, a memorizer pair.
tree:0n6dolm1p9ejke.relation: Musa's fear before his mission, met with God's reassurance.

tree:1k62xh91gnfl5b.why: Your brothers in religion: repentant enemies (9:11) and adopted sons of unknown fathers (33:5). Rare exact phrase, a pondering pair.
tree:1k62xh91gnfl5b.relation: Faith makes brothers of former enemies and of those without known lineage.

tree:06nt3zk015ymk0.why: And call to your Lord: you are on straight guidance (22:67), and do not be of the polytheists (28:87). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:06nt3zk015ymk0.relation: The Prophet's call continues whatever others dispute or block.

tree:1bhizhs1bc1ri0.why: When Our punishment came to them: why did they not humble themselves (6:43), and their only cry was that they had been wrongdoers (7:5). Same theme, a memorizer pair.
tree:1bhizhs1bc1ri0.relation: Punishment should bring humility; it brought only a late confession.

tree:08jqpk4059hrm4.why: Only the short words 'when ... said to him' are shared: his Lord to Ibrahim (2:131) and his people to Qarun (28:76). Different speakers and subjects.

tree:1e3ubyl10f8nqh.why: Only the short words 'when it was said to them' are shared: the Children of Israel told to enter the town (7:161) and Thamud told to enjoy for a while (51:43). Different subjects.

tree:1pnbjjy1n43nri.why: When you have given them their dowers: marrying women of the People of the Book (5:5) and believing emigrant women (60:10). Rare clause on the same ruling, a memorizer pair.
tree:1pnbjjy1n43nri.relation: The dower is the condition of a lawful marriage.

tree:160m8oh0k3dim7.why: When a calamity strikes them: the patient say we belong to God and to Him we return (2:156), and the hypocrites come swearing excuses (4:62). Rare clause with a clear contrast.
tree:160m8oh0k3dim7.relation: Contrast: the patient turn to God in calamity, the hypocrites turn to excuses.

tree:18qcfll0gcu2s5.why: When a surah is sent down: about striving, the wealthy ask leave (9:86), and the sick-hearted look as if fainting from death (47:20). Same theme, a memorizer pair.
tree:18qcfll0gcu2s5.relation: Revelations calling to jihad expose the hypocrites.

check.why: Keep is right: when a surah calling to fight is sent down, the hypocrites are exposed, the same theme in both.

tree:1moaq951vuj655.why: When they reach their term: widows are free to act (2:234), and divorced women are kept or released honourably (65:2). Rare clause on the waiting periods, a memorizer pair.
tree:1moaq951vuj655.relation: The end of the waiting period in widowhood and divorce.

tree:0dwd57k167c7g4.why: When you travel, in the way of God (4:94) or in the land (4:101), in one surah: verify before calling anyone a disbeliever, and shortening the prayer. A memorizer pair.

tree:0m7gpf4000ge5w.why: Only the short words 'when it is said to you' are shared, with unrelated commands: march out to fight (9:38) and make room in gatherings (58:11).

tree:1nsdqmf0gzywxt.why: Then we would be in error: the believer of the town refusing other gods (36:24), and Thamud refusing to follow one man (54:24). Rare clause with opposite uses.
tree:1nsdqmf0gzywxt.relation: Contrast: one calls shirk error, the others call following a prophet error.

tree:10go8vo0jkn2po.why: When harm touches you: you cry to Him (16:53), and at sea all else is forgotten but Him (17:67). Same theme, a memorizer pair.
tree:10go8vo0jkn2po.relation: In distress people turn to God alone, then forget Him in ease.

tree:09xz3jb1s4bvzf.why: Then they from it: flee (21:12) and laugh (43:47). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:09xz3jb1s4bvzf.relation: Fleeing punishment and laughing at signs, two faces of the deniers.

tree:1k43nxd17709mz.why: Then they rejoice: at rain reaching them (30:48), and at the mention of false gods (39:45). Identical closing with a pondering contrast.
tree:1k43nxd17709mz.relation: Contrast: rejoicing at God's mercy, and rejoicing at what is not God.

tree:09t0rzi1tazm2e.why: When We removed the punishment, they broke their word: Pharaoh's people in 7:135 and 43:50. Same story, a memorizer pair.
tree:09t0rzi1tazm2e.relation: Pharaoh's people promised faith under punishment and broke it in relief.

tree:04yio3j196usif.why: When it is recited to them: those given knowledge before fall in prostration (17:107), and the People of the Book say we believe, it is the truth (28:53). Same scene, a memorizer and pondering pair.
tree:04yio3j196usif.relation: The faithful of earlier scripture recognise the Quran.

tree:1evyi3m0cjicm8.why: Remember when He made you successors and remember the favours of God: Hud to Aad (7:69) and Salih to Thamud (7:74), in one surah. A classic memorizer pair.
tree:1evyi3m0cjicm8.relation: Two prophets remind their peoples of God's favours in the same words.

tree:13gl9ws09y2vn8.why: Mention God's name over it: game caught by trained animals (5:4), and sacrificial camels lined up (22:36). Same ruling, a memorizer pair.
tree:13gl9ws09y2vn8.relation: God's name makes the food lawful.

tree:143bygm1k5bsmq.why: Their limbs testify against them on the Day: tongues, hands and feet (24:24), and mouths sealed while hands speak and feet testify (36:65). Same scene, a memorizer pair.
tree:143bygm1k5bsmq.relation: On the Day the body itself bears witness.

check.why: Keep is right: the body testifying on the Day, the same scene in two forms.

tree:1th357218guw2w.why: We sent before you of the messengers: God's way with them does not change (17:77), and they ate food and walked in markets (25:20). Same theme, a memorizer pair.
tree:1th357218guw2w.relation: Earlier messengers were human, and God's way with them stays the same.

tree:1mdyvlg0er9cnq.why: God's earth is spacious: a rebuke to those who stayed oppressed instead of emigrating (4:97), and a comfort to believers (39:10). Rare phrase, a pondering pair.
tree:1mdyvlg0er9cnq.relation: The wide earth leaves no excuse to stay in oppression.

tree:1c5redn1ixzn8b.why: Stand firm as you were commanded: with those who repented with you (11:112), and do not follow their desires (42:15). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:1c5redn1ixzn8b.relation: Steadfastness on the command, without excess or following desires.

tree:1b7melf1899bqf.why: They were arrogant in the land: Qarun, Pharaoh and Haman (29:39), and Aad (41:15). Same theme, a memorizer pair.
tree:1b7melf1899bqf.relation: Arrogance in the land brought down the strongest.

tree:0ghu9ay1iamh56.why: God's name over them: cattle over which they do not mention it, as an invented rule (6:138), and the sacrificial camels over which it must be mentioned (22:36). Rare phrase with a contrast.
tree:0ghu9ay1iamh56.relation: Contrast: invented rules that drop God's name, and true rites that require it.

tree:1vxaoxy1h7sd6q.why: Are they harder to create, or: those We created (37:11), or the heaven (79:27). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:1vxaoxy1h7sd6q.relation: Creating humans again is small beside creating the heavens.

tree:0rfq3b21yduusg.why: In the story of the two gardens: the believer says I associate none with my Lord (18:38), and the owner later wishes he had not (18:42). Same story, a beautiful pondering pair.
tree:0rfq3b21yduusg.relation: The believer's creed becomes the regret of the one who denied it.

tree:0cr9ujv1229hip.why: They put their fingers in their ears: the hypocrites from thunder (2:19), and Nuh's people from his call (71:7). Rare phrase, a pondering pair.
tree:0cr9ujv1229hip.relation: Blocking the ears against the truth, from fear or from arrogance.

tree:0f7h07o0im1es6.why: The companions of Paradise and of the Fire: the one calls to the other (7:44), and they are not equal (59:20). Same theme, a pondering pair.
tree:0f7h07o0im1es6.relation: The people of Paradise and of the Fire, set against each other.

tree:162kbsd1h0itdj.why: Calls to the companions of Paradise: from the people of the heights, peace be on you (7:46), and from the people of the Fire, pour water on us (7:50). Same scene, a memorizer pair.
tree:162kbsd1h0itdj.relation: Greeting and pleading addressed to the people of Paradise.

tree:0etjcr21eeeofy.why: Obey God and the Messenger: if they turn away God does not love the disbelievers (3:32), and that you may receive mercy (3:132). Same command in one surah, a memorizer pair.
tree:0etjcr21eeeofy.relation: Obedience brings mercy; turning away brings God's displeasure.

tree:0g45ply11m0gmu.why: Worship God and fear Him: Ibrahim (29:16) and Nuh (71:3) to their peoples. Same call of different prophets, a memorizer pair.
tree:0g45ply11m0gmu.relation: Two prophets call their peoples in the same words.

tree:0f0kn1r0ah0ipl.why: He has prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating (4:102) or painful (33:8) punishment. Rare clause, the adjective is the memorizer trap.

tree:0kunzw60bkf2te.why: He has prepared for them a humiliating punishment, for those who harm God and His Messenger (33:57), and a painful one for the wrongdoers (76:31). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.

tree:1ibqjc501amr8h.why: And turn away from the polytheists, closing two commands: follow what is revealed to you (6:106), and proclaim what you are commanded (15:94). Identical closing, a memorizer pair.
tree:1ibqjc501amr8h.relation: Proclaim the message and leave the polytheists to God.

tree:1746av40cqtaxy.why: Turn away from this: to Ibrahim pleading for Lut's people (11:76), and to Yusuf about the minister's wife (12:29). Rare phrase, a memorizer pair.

tree:1hdjv410f7vc4l.why: Know that God: has power over all (2:259, the man raised after a century) and is Mighty and Wise (2:260, Ibrahim and the birds). Consecutive ayat, both about seeing resurrection, a strong pondering pair.
tree:1hdjv410f7vc4l.relation: Two lessons in resurrection, each ending with what the witness learned of God.

tree:0hg0f9y085g6a8.why: God (22:68) or my Lord (26:188) knows best what you do: the Prophet's and Shuayb's answer to those who dispute. Rare closing, a memorizer pair.
tree:0hg0f9y085g6a8.relation: Messengers leave the deniers to God's knowledge.

check.why: Keep is right: 'God' versus 'my Lord' knows best what you do, a messenger's answer both times.

tree:1i04jvo0mhucw8.why: God knows best what is in their souls (11:31, Nuh) or your souls (17:25). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:1i04jvo0mhucw8.relation: Only God knows what is in the hearts.

tree:0y9qicf12ms5s9.why: We drowned Pharaoh's people: while you watched (2:50) and they were all wrongdoers (8:54). Same story, a memorizer pair.
tree:0y9qicf12ms5s9.relation: Pharaoh's drowning, seen by the saved and named as a warning.

tree:071fwmv03upco3.why: Forgive me and my parents and the believers: Ibrahim (14:41) and Nuh (71:28). Same prayer of two prophets, a memorizer pair.
tree:071fwmv03upco3.relation: The prayer of two prophets for themselves, their parents and all believers.

tree:0k0qofj0w78vl7.why: Can you make the deaf hear: those who listen without understanding (10:42), and can you guide the blind (43:40). Same comfort to the Prophet, a memorizer pair.
tree:0k0qofj0w78vl7.relation: Guidance is God's; the Prophet cannot force hearing on the heart-deaf.

tree:103roeh0tqih41.why: He invented it, rather he is: a poet, say the deniers (21:5), and rather it is the truth from your Lord (32:3). Same words, opposite answers.
tree:103roeh0tqih41.relation: Contrast: the deniers' confused charges and God's reply that it is the truth.

tree:0m7yulo0pxupx8.why: Kill them wherever you find them: those who fight you at the Sanctuary (2:191), and hypocrites who keep fighting (4:91). Rare clause with its conditions, a memorizer pair.
tree:0m7yulo0pxupx8.relation: The command to fight is tied to the enemy's aggression.

tree:0swa8gf02w4yj7.why: More just in the sight of God: writing down debts (2:282) and calling adopted sons by their fathers (33:5). Rare phrase, a memorizer pair.
tree:0swa8gf02w4yj7.relation: Justice in records and in lineage.

tree:1h4nl8h02a0p9l.why: More in wealth and children: past nations who enjoyed their share (9:69), and the rich who think they will not be punished (34:35). Rare phrase, a pondering pair.
tree:1h4nl8h02a0p9l.relation: Wealth and children deceive their owners into feeling safe.

tree:17f0x2c0zglyei.why: Most of them, so they do not believe (36:7) or do not hear (41:4). Rare clause, the final verb is the memorizer trap.

tree:0y5f0jv1hswvi9.why: Except the family of Lut: We will save them all (15:59), We saved them before dawn (54:34). Same story, a memorizer pair.
tree:0y5f0jv1hswvi9.relation: Lut's family alone saved from the destruction.

tree:1mr1rod08rbmir.why: Only seeking the face of God (2:272) or of his Lord Most High (92:20): the intention behind spending. Rare clause, a pondering pair.
tree:1mr1rod08rbmir.relation: True giving seeks only God's face.

tree:0iai5qk0jamcco.why: Except those who are patient: who do good deeds and earn forgiveness (11:11), and only they are granted to repel evil with good (41:35). Rare clause, a pondering pair.
tree:0iai5qk0jamcco.relation: Patience is the key to reward and to returning good for evil.

tree:1c5o6vz0d4jtlj.why: Except those with whom you made a treaty, twice in at-Tawba (9:4, 9:7), both ending God loves the God-fearing. A memorizer pair on keeping treaties.
tree:1c5o6vz0d4jtlj.relation: Treaties are honoured as long as the other side honours them.

tree:04w85d20qvdcws.why: Truly the party of Satan are the losers (58:19), and truly the party of God are the successful (58:22), in one surah. A sharp contrast in the same words.
tree:04w85d20qvdcws.relation: Contrast: the two parties and their ends.

tree:0huv4hq0xqkcrk.why: Except a little of what you eat (12:47) and of what you store (12:48): Yusuf's interpretation of the dream, consecutive ayat. A memorizer pair.
tree:0huv4hq0xqkcrk.relation: Yusuf's plan: save in the years of plenty for the years of famine.

tree:1n640s80pdy08a.why: Only that We might know who: follows the Messenger, in the change of qibla (2:143), and believes in the Hereafter, in Satan's influence (34:21). Rare clause, a pondering pair.
tree:1n640s80pdy08a.relation: Trials are set to show who is true.

tree:1geoics1pfebdq.why: Except what your right hands possess (4:24) or your right hand possesses (33:52): rulings on marriage, a memorizer pair.

tree:1pw30371pubipb.why: The shared word is different in each: the one who was wronged (4:148, passive) and the one who did wrong (27:11, active). Different words and subjects, so the pair does not hold.

tree:1paqdza10xfhmu.why: They would turn their backs and then not be helped: the disbelievers at Hudaybiya (48:22), and the hypocrites' allies (59:12). Same description, a memorizer pair.
tree:1paqdza10xfhmu.relation: Enemies of the believers flee and find no help.

tree:1wywtpp076y0wl.why: The shared words straddle two clauses: the earth ends one statement and a new exclamation begins, on different subjects (God's promise in 10:55, God's forgiveness in 42:5).

tree:14ldaot0lbn5z7.why: The shared words straddle two clauses about unrelated subjects: Qarun told not to spread corruption (28:77), and God's ownership of all (31:26).

tree:12k3hd41kyldv8.why: Only the end of a clause about the earth and a stock pair of divine names are shared; 25:6 (the revealer of the Quran) and 35:44 (nothing escapes God) are otherwise unrelated.

tree:10qmjeu1hfx6jw.why: The earth, vast as it is, became narrow: for the believers at Hunayn (9:25) and for the three who stayed behind (9:118), in one surah. Rare clause, a pondering pair.

check.why: Keep is right: 'the earth, vast as it is, became narrow' is a rare clause, twice in one surah, both times about distress after a fault.

tree:1v6d9i311ngao5.why: Who is Lord of the heavens and the earth (13:16), who provides from them (34:24): say, God. Same argument, a memorizer pair.
tree:1v6d9i311ngao5.relation: The polytheists' own answer refutes their shirk.

tree:075y1fc1kp4qt0.why: In the heavens and the earth are signs for people who reason (2:164) or are God-fearing (10:6). A memorizer pair on the ending.
tree:075y1fc1kp4qt0.relation: The signs of creation for those who reason and fear God.

tree:0f3q5zs0zg5iws.why: Only 'the earth after' is shared, with different words following: inheriting the land after its people (7:100), and reviving it after its death (29:63). Different subjects.

tree:10xb1d11rbkh57.why: The land after them: you were made successors to see how you act (10:14), and the messengers settled there after the deniers (14:14). Rare phrase, a pondering pair.
tree:10xb1d11rbkh57.relation: Inheriting the land after others is a test, and a promise for those who fear God.

tree:1gpf92o0ysk9ge.why: Both ayat are about Pharaoh and his people: they were arrogant in the land and could not escape (29:39), and neither heaven nor earth wept for them and they were given no respite (44:29). The shared words are short, but the subject and the closing pattern match.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: both rows are about Pharaoh's people being destroyed, each closing with 'and they were not' plus a different word.

tree:1rukv440t029gi.why: The heavens and the earth and whoever is in them: glorify Him (17:44), and would be ruined if the truth followed their desires (23:71). Rare phrase with a pondering contrast.
tree:1rukv440t029gi.relation: Creation stands by glorifying God; it would collapse if ruled by human desire.

tree:0oywqil1wouk4d.why: Mankind and jinn: could not produce the like of the Quran together (17:88), and the jinn once thought neither would lie about God (72:5). Rare phrase, a pondering pair.
tree:0oywqil1wouk4d.relation: Mankind and jinn before the Quran: unable to match it, misled about God.

tree:0rdnl1k05o8cdq.why: Man created from dry clay: from altered mud (15:26) and like pottery (55:14). Same point, a memorizer pair.

tree:0bpexs51xlx3rf.why: Man created from a drop: then he becomes an open adversary (16:4), and mixed, to test him (76:2). Same point, a memorizer pair.
tree:0bpexs51xlx3rf.relation: From a drop to a disputer: the purpose of creation is a test.

tree:1xicoiu03xboui.why: Rivers flowing beneath: the destroyed nations who had them (6:6), and Pharaoh boasting of the Nile beneath him (43:51). Rare phrase in the worldly sense, a pondering pair.
tree:1xicoiu03xboui.relation: Worldly rivers did not save those who boasted of them.

tree:04sbwdn0t2erk1.why: Which you were promised: Hell for the deniers (36:63), and Paradise for those who stood firm (41:30). Rare clause with a contrast.
tree:04sbwdn0t2erk1.relation: Contrast: the same promise fulfilled as Hell for some and Paradise for others.

tree:0vs9uix0yl2mad.why: In Paradise abiding: as long as the heavens and earth endure, a gift unending (11:108), and as reward for what they did (46:14). A reward phrase, but with distinct endings a memorizer must keep apart.

tree:12vuonv0ryjvrh.why: Speech said aloud: remember your Lord without it (7:205), and He knows it as He knows what you hide (21:110). Rare phrase, a pondering pair.
tree:12vuonv0ryjvrh.relation: God hears the quiet remembrance as He knows all speech.

tree:0x0b5hv1pukra3.why: Worldly life deceived them, so today: We forget them (7:51), and they will not be brought out (45:35). Same scene, a memorizer pair.
tree:0x0b5hv1pukra3.relation: Those deceived by this life are abandoned on the Day.

tree:1qz0uth1mlv11f.why: Worldly life, while they: think they do well though their effort is lost (18:104), and know only its outward side, heedless of the Hereafter (30:7). Short shared words, but one theme worth pondering.
tree:1qz0uth1mlv11f.relation: Busy with this world, blind to the Hereafter.

check.why: Keep is right: both describe people absorbed in this world and blind to the Hereafter.

tree:0crvodh0enfpul.why: To separate the bad from the good: by trials among the believers (3:179), and by gathering the bad into Hell (8:37). Rare clause, a pondering pair.
tree:0crvodh0enfpul.relation: God sifts the bad from the good, in this world and the next.

tree:1g8dzux1r98rtt.why: Enjoyment of this world, then to Us is the return: then We inform you (10:23), then We make them taste punishment (10:70), in one surah. A memorizer pair.
tree:1g8dzux1r98rtt.relation: Worldly enjoyment is brief; the return to God decides.

tree:1utwfza05gj5qs.why: Worldly gain, but with God is more: many spoils (4:94) and the reward of this world and the next (4:134), in one surah. A memorizer pair.
tree:1utwfza05gj5qs.relation: Seek from God, who holds more than any worldly gain.

tree:0h6moh80f56szs.why: Whoever wants the world, We give him of it: and the Hereafter too (3:145), but no share in the Hereafter (42:20). A memorizer pair with a contrast.
tree:0h6moh80f56szs.relation: What one seeks decides what one is given.

tree:09gukvz0zap9y3.why: He who sends the winds: as good news before His mercy (25:48), and to raise clouds that revive dead land (35:9). Same sign, a memorizer pair.
tree:09gukvz0zap9y3.relation: Winds bring rain, mercy and a picture of resurrection.

tree:1x3gqbr19tneun.why: Which they were promised: the true promise of Paradise (46:16), and the Day of humiliation (70:44). Identical closing with a contrast. The 70:44 row reads on across the surah boundary into 71:1, which should be checked.
tree:1x3gqbr19tneun.relation: Contrast: the same promise is Paradise for some and a day of disgrace for others.

tree:063ntny0qlq4to.why: That over which they differ (27:76) or are differing (78:3). Rare clause, verb against participle, a memorizer pair.
tree:063ntny0qlq4to.relation: The great news over which people dispute, settled by revelation.

tree:1ldze8t1jkuu1h.why: He who sends the winds: as good news before His mercy (7:57), and to stir up clouds (30:48). Same sign, a memorizer pair.
tree:1ldze8t1jkuu1h.relation: Winds bringing rain as a sign of mercy and resurrection.

tree:1x5o5b905nbnwj.why: Only 'those who believe' followed by a particle is shared, in unrelated contexts: not seeking forgiveness for polytheists (9:113), and despairing that God could guide all (13:31).

tree:1wk7u4u0s29i66.why: Only 'those who believe' and 'thus' are shared, across a sentence boundary, in unrelated contexts: the rescue of messengers (10:103) and the sealing of arrogant hearts (40:35).

tree:1phl7hb0rilr21.why: Only 'those who believe' and a preposition are shared, in unrelated contexts: later emigrants (8:75) and believers laughing at disbelievers (83:34).

tree:0gmcsal0k1jd2h.why: Only 'those who believe and did not' is shared, with unrelated continuations: faith not mixed with wrong (6:82), and believers who did not emigrate (8:72).

tree:1xsy14d1bdio6l.why: Those who took their religion as play and amusement (6:70) or amusement and play (7:51): the order swaps, a classic memorizer trap, both followed by worldly life deceived them.
tree:1xsy14d1bdio6l.relation: Treating religion as a game, deceived by worldly life.

tree:1dnpsje18shslw.why: Those who differed over it: over Jesus' crucifixion (4:157) and over the Sabbath (16:124). Different subjects joined only by the phrase.

tree:1ywyzqn00r3sul.why: Those who, when reminded of the signs of their Lord: do not fall upon them deaf and blind (25:73), and fall down in prostration (32:15). Rare clause, a pondering pair.
tree:1ywyzqn00r3sul.relation: How true believers receive the signs: attentive, humble and prostrating.

tree:1e5s8sd15fci33.why: Only the common phrase 'those who did evil deeds' is shared, in different rulings: forgiveness after repentance (7:153) and recompense of evil (28:84).

tree:0chxdws1hhhsry.why: Those who lied against their Lord (11:18) or against God (39:60), on the Day of Judgement. Rare clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:0chxdws1hhhsry.relation: Liars against God exposed on the Day.

tree:1g9m4ca1tromcg.why: Only 'those who disbelieve' and a particle are shared, in unrelated contexts: taking God's servants as protectors (18:102) and denying resurrection (64:7).

tree:1598nun0fzxh6h.why: Only the common phrase 'those who disbelieve in Our signs' is shared, in unrelated scenes: skins renewed in the Fire (4:56) and the people of the left (90:19).

tree:1smartk1mhrgqc.why: Only the short ending 'those who do not reason' is shared, in different contexts: the worst creatures (8:22) and faith only by God's leave (10:100).

tree:0vjrlbi0d7n6ku.why: Only 'those besides Him' is shared, in unrelated contexts: what they created (31:11) and their joy at the mention of others (39:45).

tree:00skv0k0xvv15i.why: Only 'those whom God guided' is shared, in unrelated contexts: the change of qibla (2:143) and the prophets to follow (6:90).

tree:1crspww04zsbhq.why: Those who are fearful: out of awe of their Lord (23:57), and of the punishment of their Lord (70:27). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.

tree:14gmab81k6lhdc.why: Those who believe in God: do not ask leave from striving (9:44), and ask leave properly from the Prophet (24:62). Rare clause on asking leave, a pondering pair.

tree:1iiu0tw1kd5owq.relation: Slander of chaste women is punished in both worlds.

tree:1485t1c17ghtpm.why: Those who deviate concerning His names (7:180) or Our signs (41:40). Rare clause, a memorizer pair.

tree:1sos9hl0394kzj.why: Only the end of a clause about the heavens and the earth and a closing with divine names are shared; 25:6 and 35:38 have different endings and subjects.

tree:02al65k1wdili6.why: Only the closing with a pair of divine names is shared, after unrelated subjects: making peace (8:61) and mercy on the Day (44:42).

tree:17syjqw1m30mt4.relation: Similarity: rain revives the land, revelation revives hearts; both are His mercy.

tree:0a9sa050iy56ax.why: Both are declarations of God's oneness closing on the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. 2:163 states it plainly; 59:22 adds knowledge of the unseen and the seen.

tree:1jvx1030c77uov.why: Both close a mention of God's help or mercy with the same pair of names, after 'and He is' (30:5) and 'indeed He is' (44:42). The phrase is common, but here the lead-in fits the closing in both.
tree:1jvx1030c77uov.relation: God's help for whom He wills and His mercy on whom He has mercy, both from the Mighty, the Merciful.

tree:1j98weh0qg5zsd.why: The closing 'and He is the Most High, the Most Great' occurs only here, and in both it follows 'to Him belongs what is in the heavens and the earth'. A clear mutashabih between the Throne Verse and 42:4.

tree:1mtup5v1b2z5wj.why: Same pair of names closing two ayat, after 'your Lord is' in 11:66 (saving Salih) and 'and He is' in 42:19 (provision). The lead-in is what a memorizer must keep apart.

tree:01qoaxj1hdkwir.why: The only two ayat ending 'and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware', both about God's knowledge: He perceives all sight (6:103), He knows what He created (67:14).
tree:01qoaxj1hdkwir.relation: The names fit the point: nothing escapes the One who is subtle and aware.

tree:0d6m2vz1mkak25.why: Both end 'and He is the best of providers' in a talk about wealth: the Prophet asks no payment, his Lord's reward is better (23:72); what you spend He replaces (34:39).
tree:0d6m2vz1mkak25.relation: Provision from God is better than what people give or keep.

tree:1xcascl05yqg93.why: Only the stock phrase 'it is better for him' is shared. Voluntary extra fasting (2:184) and honouring God's sanctities on the pilgrimage (22:30) are different subjects, and nothing more links them.

tree:0e8ca551x5w3dx.why: Both are about speech: debate in the best way (16:125) and say what is best (17:53). The same words are followed by a different reason (your Lord knows / Satan sows discord).
tree:0e8ca551x5w3dx.relation: The best words: in calling others to God and among believers, against Satan's discord.

tree:1tkzglh066esxn.why: The faces of the disbelievers in two moments: now they show rejection when the ayat are recited (22:72); on the Day they darken when they see what they denied (67:27).
tree:1tkzglh066esxn.relation: Contrast: the face shows hostility in this world and grief in the next.

tree:1xcvsap0x3am13.why: Both describe the wrongdoers' faces in the Fire: thrown face-first (27:90), turned over while they wish they had obeyed (33:66). Same scene from two sides.

tree:0duhivo09wkfzi.why: The only two places with 'they wish you would disbelieve', both warning against taking enemies as allies. Same theme, different position in the ayah (opening vs ending).
tree:0duhivo09wkfzi.relation: The enemy's true wish is your disbelief, so do not take them as protectors.

tree:1b8t4wg1kw60mo.why: God's mercy embraces everything: God says it (7:156), and the angels pray with it (40:7), adding knowledge. A beautiful pair to ponder.
tree:1b8t4wg1kw60mo.relation: God's word about His mercy and the angels' prayer that answers it.

tree:09mftyq0tgjjda.why: Two ayat of one passage on the end of time in an-Naml: when the word falls due, the Beast comes out (27:82); the word falls due and they cannot speak (27:85). A pair a memorizer must keep in order.
tree:09mftyq0tgjjda.relation: The same decree, first as a sign before the Hour, then as the silencing of the wrongdoers.

tree:0yfxc8r0lxndcz.why: The only two descriptions of the Fire whose fuel is people and stones: prepared for the disbelievers (2:24), and a warning to believers to guard themselves and their families (66:6).
tree:0yfxc8r0lxndcz.relation: The same Fire threatens the deniers and is a reason for believers to protect their homes.

tree:149uwip15lgln3.why: Unlawful gain is fire in the belly, said twice: of those who hide the Book for a small price (2:174) and of those who eat the orphan's wealth (4:10). Rare image, close wording.
tree:149uwip15lgln3.relation: Similarity: both sell a trust for money, and both eat fire.

tree:0iwzxsq1lh1cna.why: Both address the people of understanding and then end differently: 'that you may be mindful' (2:179) and 'that you may succeed' (5:100). A clean memorizer's trap.

tree:07xrutt0kuywyh.why: Only the common call 'O people, only ...' is shared. One ayah is about people who rebel after being saved at sea (10:23), the other the Prophet stating he is a warner (22:49). Different subjects, nothing to learn.

tree:1ww1eiq15nqdmu.why: Both are about enemies stretching out their hands against the believers: God held them back (5:11), and they would do it if they could (60:2).
tree:1ww1eiq15nqdmu.relation: God's past protection (5:11) and the standing danger from enemies (60:2).

tree:1b6h7j30q26o71.why: Two neighbouring ayat about desert Arabs, one counts what he spends as a loss, the other as a way to draw near to God. Same words, opposite intention.
tree:1b6h7j30q26o71.relation: Contrast: the same spending is a burden to one and a means of nearness to another.

tree:0stegkx1v44z03.why: God completing His favour on a chosen servant: Joseph and Jacob's family (12:6) and the Prophet Muhammad (48:2). Same promise to two prophets.
tree:0stegkx1v44z03.relation: Similarity: the favour completed on Joseph and on Muhammad, both after hardship.

tree:06hjuw80kp436m.why: Only the common phrase 'and God turns in mercy to' is shared. 9:15 is about fighting the oath-breakers, 33:73 about the trust carried by man. The lead-ins and closings differ, so a reciter is unlikely to mix them.

tree:19elbjw0gs059a.why: The only two places with 'and they think they are rightly guided', both about people who take devils as allies or companions (7:30, 43:36-37).
