tree:0bs4xvh0odkut3.why: Those who pray and give zakat, followed by bowing (5:55) or certainty in the hereafter (27:3, 31:4), and the opposite in 41:7: those who do not give zakat and deny the hereafter.
tree:0bs4xvh0odkut3.relation: Contrast: the believers who give and are certain of the hereafter, and the polytheists who withhold and deny it.

tree:1vwj8121ej90b4.why: O people, there has come to you: the Messenger, a proof, an exhortation, the truth. Four calls to all mankind naming what has come from their Lord.
tree:1vwj8121ej90b4.relation: What God has sent to all people, named four ways.

tree:1gcwyv402yuv5s.why: God provides for whom He wills without measure, closing three different scenes (the mockers, Mary's food, the men of the mosques), and with another ending in 42:19.
tree:1gcwyv402yuv5s.relation: Provision without account, for the God-fearing over the mockers, for Mary, and for those who remember God.

tree:1nb9dmu05avgty.why: All four rows stay. 'God wants to ...' is the same words and structure in all four: to lighten for you (4:28), to establish the truth (8:7), to strike them for some of their sins (5:49), to punish them through their wealth (9:85). Different subject, same phrase.
tree:1nb9dmu05avgty.relation: What God wills: ease for the believers, truth established, punishment for those who turn away.

tree:0pt4wn71i7319x.why: And He increases them from His bounty: full reward plus more, four times with different closings. Often contrasted with the deniers' punishment in the same ayah.
tree:0pt4wn71i7319x.relation: The believers' reward goes beyond their deeds, from God's bounty.

tree:0kz524q1ef93x4.why: The blind and the seeing are not equal, asked as a question (6:50, 13:16) and stated (35:19, 40:58), each followed by a different pair. A strong memorizer and pondering set.
tree:0kz524q1ef93x4.relation: Faith as sight and denial as blindness, set side by side four times.

tree:150etdo1a0q1eq.why: Promises that end and He forgives you, then a different closing name each time: great bounty, forgiving merciful, appreciative forbearing. 8:29 and 57:28 also share the shape of the promise.
tree:150etdo1a0q1eq.relation: Forgiveness promised for piety, sincere captives, faith and generous loans.

tree:1mg4uq20ncb2mm.why: Corruption in the land: two nearly identical ayat (2:27, 13:25) with different fates, and two that pair corruption with not setting right (26:152, 27:48). Memorizer pairs inside one theme.
tree:1mg4uq20ncb2mm.relation: Breaking God's covenant and cutting what should be joined is named corruption, as was the deeds of Thamud's leaders.

tree:05ik0un0g38g5l.why: And the deniers say, three times in Ar-Ra'd (13:7 and 13:27 share their whole request), plus their charge of old tales in 6:25. Different answers to the same objection.
tree:05ik0un0g38g5l.relation: The deniers ask for a sign, and the answer differs each time: you are a warner, God guides whom He wills.

tree:0psyntb0qysot7.why: Or do they say he invented it, with four answers: bring one surah, bring ten surahs, my crime is on me (Noah), you cannot protect me from God. A classic set.
tree:0psyntb0qysot7.relation: The charge of invention answered by the challenge and by the messenger's own accountability.

tree:0j8zjea19zh26o.why: All four rows stay. 'On the Day of Resurrection; indeed ...' is the same words and structure in all four. Three continue 'indeed God' with different closings (bounty, witness, knowing); 68:39 continues 'indeed you have'. Different subject, same words: exactly where a reciter could slip.
tree:0j8zjea19zh26o.relation: What the Day of Resurrection reveals: God's bounty, His witness and knowledge, and the emptiness of the deniers' claims.

tree:0zk69xu1bm07oc.why: He will surely gather you to the Day of Resurrection, there is no doubt in it: three times with different openings and closings. In 28:41 'no' negates a verb ('they will not be helped'), not 'no doubt', and the day is not 'to the Day': a different structure.
tree:0zk69xu1bm07oc.relation: The certainty of the gathering, affirmed three times.

tree:00qiiyv1g4i9vt.why: Fear God, whom..., with three different relative clauses, two of them occurring twice (in whom you believe: 5:88, 60:11; to whom you will be gathered: 5:96, 58:9). A good memorizer set.
tree:00qiiyv1g4i9vt.relation: Each command is anchored in a reason to fear God: kinship, faith, the gathering.

tree:1apht451u3m00f.why: Fear God so that you may succeed, be grateful, or receive mercy, after different commands. The memorizer must match the ending to each.
tree:1apht451u3m00f.relation: Piety tied to its fruit: success, gratitude and mercy.

tree:00smh3o1ggeo9m.why: The alternation of night and day as a sign, in five settings with different companions and audiences (people who reason, people of understanding, the pious). Classic memorizer set.
tree:00smh3o1ggeo9m.relation: One sign named to different audiences who are meant to reflect on it.

tree:1lw4sms0225rp4.why: All five rows stay. 'Be patient over what ...' is the same words and the same relative in all five. Four tell the Prophet to be patient over what they say, each with a different remedy; 31:17 is Luqman's 'be patient over what befalls you'. Different subject, same phrase.
tree:1lw4sms0225rp4.relation: Patience with people's words and with what befalls you, and what goes with it: glorifying, remembering, leaving gracefully.

tree:1hx0mq80ln7wha.why: Those are the companions of paradise, they abide in it eternally, after four different descriptions of the believers; 59:20 ends instead with they are the winners. A strong memorizer set.
tree:1hx0mq80ln7wha.relation: Who the people of paradise are: faith and good deeds, excellence, humility before their Lord.

tree:1x3wxew165czgy.why: Worship none but God, in the message of the messengers (11:2, 41:14, 46:21), and worship none but Him as a decree (12:40, 17:23). The noun and pronoun forms are a real memorizer trap.
tree:1x3wxew165czgy.relation: The one message of every messenger, given as a call and as a decree.

tree:1n5uzf415hclk2.why: The deniers' prayer is only in vain (13:14, 40:50, the same words), their plot is only in vain (40:25), and the deniers tell the believers you are only in clear or great error (36:47, 67:9).
tree:1n5uzf415hclk2.relation: Contrast: the deniers' calls and plots are lost, while they accuse the believers of being lost.

tree:1g4vkdz0pi17u9.why: To God belongs what is in the heavens and the earth, and God is ever... with four different closing names. 48:4 and 48:7 repeat the armies of the heavens with a changed ending, a classic trap.
tree:1g4vkdz0pi17u9.relation: God's ownership of all, sealed by His knowledge, wisdom, sufficiency and might.

tree:1k57jea0dboxhs.why: He who created you from one soul, from clay, from weakness, from dust. One opening with different origins, each leading to a different lesson.
tree:1k57jea0dboxhs.relation: Human origins recalled to teach piety, the appointed term, and the stages of life.

tree:0pixdje0fwpkni.why: This is what you used to deny, said to the deniers in the hereafter, with changed endings: deny, hasten, call for. A tight memorizer set.
tree:0pixdje0fwpkni.relation: What the deniers rejected or mocked in this life is shown to them on the Day.

tree:0y996tn0hyg9v9.why: Those who believe in God and His messengers or His Messenger: 24:62 and 49:15 define the true believers with the same opening, 4:152 and 57:19 promise their reward. Singular and plural Messenger is a trap.
tree:0y996tn0hyg9v9.relation: What true faith includes: not dividing the messengers, steadfastness, striving, and staying with the Prophet.

tree:0okt7pf0woizi5.why: 'Indeed those who believe and those who ...' opens 2:62, 5:69 and 22:17 (Jews, Christians, Sabians, in changed order and case) and 2:218 (the emigrants). In 2:212 'and those who feared' begins a new sentence ('are above them'), a different structure.
tree:0okt7pf0woizi5.changes: Removed 2:212: its 'and those' starts a new sentence.
tree:0okt7pf0woizi5.relation: Believers listed beside other communities, and beside the emigrants who strive.

tree:00oqu571bt6dmx.why: Those who passed away before you or before them: their trials (2:214), their days (10:102), their example (24:34), God's way with them (33:38, 33:62). The pronoun changes are the trap.
tree:00oqu571bt6dmx.relation: God's way with past nations as a lesson for the present one.

tree:0azbbqy0b62zl8.why: Those who disbelieve are in doubt (22:55), in pride and dissension (38:2), in denial (85:19): the deniers' states in one frame. In 3:196 and 48:26 'in' belongs to another word (their moving about in the land, placed in their hearts), a different structure.
tree:0azbbqy0b62zl8.changes: Removed 3:196 and 48:26: there the preposition depends on another word, a different structure.
tree:0azbbqy0b62zl8.relation: The inner state of the deniers: doubt, pride, denial.

tree:0up8okv03s4z9d.why: Those before you as a reference point: created like you (2:21), fasting prescribed as for them (2:183), their ways shown to you (4:26), enjoying their share (9:69), their news (14:9). 2:21 and 2:183 end the same way, a memorizer pair.
tree:0up8okv03s4z9d.relation: The present community measured against the nations before it, in worship, law and warning.

tree:08furqr1gcqmod.why: Those who spend their wealth: in God's cause, without reminders of favours, seeking God's pleasure, night and day, and to be seen by people. Five continuations to keep apart, ending with the contrast of showing off.
tree:08furqr1gcqmod.relation: Contrast: spending for God and spending to be seen.

tree:123m2o60obyhn4.why: The heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise, closing four ayat with different openings; 6:14 shares the start and then turns to He feeds and is not fed. A memorizer set.
tree:123m2o60obyhn4.relation: Glorification of God by all in the heavens and earth, sealed by His might and wisdom.

tree:08y79hd1kgs6kv.why: He subjected the sun and the moon, each running for or to an appointed term, or swimming in an orbit. Classic preposition differences in five places.
tree:08y79hd1kgs6kv.relation: The ordered course of the sun and moon as a sign of the Creator.

tree:0ztilos0g56rb8.why: The people who denied Our signs: as a parable (7:176, 7:177), in Noah's rescue (21:77), Moses' mission (25:36), and the parable of the donkey with God's signs (62:5). Close wording with different roles.
tree:0ztilos0g56rb8.relation: The deniers of signs as an evil example and as a people destroyed.

tree:01nj2t51rcumud.why: God is my Lord and your Lord, said by Jesus (3:51, 19:36 nearly identical, 5:72, 5:117) and by Hud (11:56). Jesus' own words refute the claim of his divinity.
tree:01nj2t51rcumud.relation: Jesus' repeated statement that God is his Lord too, set against those who deified him.

tree:1xgc9sp0ncptqb.why: Remember God's favour upon you when..., five times with five different events. The memorizer must link each favour to its ayah.
tree:1xgc9sp0ncptqb.relation: The habit of remembering specific favours: brotherhood, protection, prophets, rescue, victory.

tree:18jju7c0yp278i.why: God knows what they do is a stock closing here after five unrelated scenes (conjecture, Joseph's sale, the deniers' death, glorification by birds, the one pleased with his evil). The verb changes alone do not make a useful card.

tree:1xzk4860g02akq.why: The Ma'ida trio on not judging by what God revealed (deniers, wrongdoers, defiant), plus 2:229 with the same wrongdoers ending for transgressing God's limits and 30:39 with a positive ending. A famous memorizer set.
tree:1xzk4860g02akq.relation: Ruling by God's revelation and keeping His limits, with the names given to those who do not.

tree:0vac6lz1xvv7xn.why: And sufficient is God as..., with three closings: Knower, Guardian, Accountant. 4:81, 33:3 and 33:48 share the whole phrase on relying on God.
tree:0vac6lz1xvv7xn.relation: Trust in God, and God as enough for the one who relies on Him.

tree:0pqkyua17s0leo.why: God loves the doers of good, closing five ayat on spending, forgiving, steadfastness, pardon and piety. Indeed God or and God is the trap.
tree:0pqkyua17s0leo.relation: The many deeds that God names excellence.

tree:0uzyuhw1gnsl4k.why: God guides whom He wills, with three openings (and God, but God, and that God) and one changed verb in 22:16. A real memorizer set.
tree:0uzyuhw1gnsl4k.relation: Guidance belongs to God, not to the Prophet.

tree:1abxhwq1x08s2c.why: He merges the night into the day and the day into the night, five times, each followed by something different. A classic set.
tree:1abxhwq1x08s2c.relation: The turning of night and day as proof of God's power and knowledge.

tree:1vsldpx0awam9z.why: Until the day they are raised: Iblis asks for respite until then (7:14, 15:36, 38:79 with small differences), the dead wait behind a barrier until then (23:100), Jonah would have stayed in the fish until then (37:144).
tree:1vsldpx0awam9z.relation: One horizon, the Day of Resurrection: respite for Iblis, waiting for the dead, and the prison Jonah was saved from.

tree:11kt17i1nvtmz4.why: The same five ayat on merging night into day already form card tree:1abxhwq1x08s2c. One copy is enough.

tree:02yoltc179lmes.why: Worship God, the core of the messengers' call, each time followed by something different: my Lord and your Lord (Jesus), avoid false gods, you have no god but Him, they split into two parties (Salih), fear Him and obey me (Noah).
tree:02yoltc179lmes.relation: One call carried by every messenger, and the different responses it met.

tree:1u3p9b00tkc18k.why: Indeed many of the people are..., with three endings (defiant, heedless of Our signs, deniers of the meeting with their Lord), and the same opening for the rabbis and monks and for partners in business. A real memorizer set.
tree:1u3p9b00tkc18k.relation: Most people stray, in law, in heeding signs, and in belief in the meeting with God.

tree:1tm8gas1133c2m.why: Indeed this is truly..., five times with five different predicates: the true story, the clear favour, the great triumph, the clear trial, the certain truth. Short and easy to mix.
tree:1tm8gas1133c2m.relation: Different realities each sealed with emphatic certainty.

check.why: Keep is right: 'indeed this is truly' closes five places with five different predicates, a real memorizer trap.

tree:0rr162j0ytaxql.why: All five rows stay. 'It is nothing but ...' is the same words and structure in all five: only our worldly life (6:29, 23:37), only our first death (44:35), only Your trial (7:155), only names you have named (53:23). Different subject, same phrase, and a reciter must know which ending goes where.
tree:0rr162j0ytaxql.relation: What things really are: the deniers reduce life to this world, Moses calls it God's trial, and idols are only names.

tree:0r29btv0ngt9tt.why: You are the Mighty, the Wise, closing prayers of Abraham, Jesus, the angels and Abraham's followers; and in 44:49 the denier is mocked: taste, you are the mighty, the noble.
tree:0r29btv0ngt9tt.relation: Contrast: the believers call God mighty and wise in prayer; the arrogant denier is told in scorn that he was the mighty one.

tree:1pqtptx09faq5p.why: They were a people blind (Noah's people) or defiant (Pharaoh's people, three times, and Noah's people in 51:46). The memorizer must know which nation gets which word.
tree:1pqtptx09faq5p.relation: The verdict on destroyed nations, named in one sentence.

tree:1qmff9o0e6x3pu.why: Those given the Scripture before you: their harm to the believers, the same command to them and you, their mockery, and the warning not to be like them in hardness of heart (with before, without you, in 57:16).
tree:1qmff9o0e6x3pu.relation: The People of the Book as a mirror: same command, and a warning not to repeat their hardness.

tree:1r9elcv1a3eacb.why: Four of its five ayat (2:82, 7:42, 10:26, 11:23) are already card tree:1hx0mq80ln7wha on the same closing. Only 46:14 is new, which does not need its own card.

check.why: Drop is right: four rows are in the kept tree:1hx0mq80ln7wha, and 46:14 is kept with 11:108 in W1 (tree:0vs9uix0yl2mad).

tree:0rrzmm20vde0u6.why: All five rows stay. 'Those are the defiantly disobedient' is the same closing in all five. 3:82 and 24:55 are the close pair (whoever turns away or disbelieves after that); 5:47 closes the judging ruling, 24:4 the slanderers, 59:19 those who forgot God. Same words and structure, different subjects. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0rrzmm20vde0u6.relation: Who is called defiantly disobedient: those who turn away after a covenant, who do not judge by revelation, who slander, who forget God.

tree:0tfmlr20cj35qs.why: Some of them are allies of others, said of the Jews and Christians, the emigrants and helpers, the deniers, the believing men and women, and the wrongdoers. The same phrase for both camps.
tree:0tfmlr20cj35qs.relation: Contrast: alliance among believers built on faith and good deeds, and alliance among deniers and wrongdoers.

tree:0gdveen1udgcf7.why: Rather, you are a people..., in the stories of Lot (excessive, transgressing, ignorant), Salih (being tested) and the town's messengers (excessive). The ending changes with each story.
tree:0gdveen1udgcf7.relation: Each people's sin named in one word by its prophet.

tree:1ffv1xy14fg6yu.why: In what was revealed to you and what was revealed before you: the believers (2:4, 4:162), the false claim of the hypocrites (4:60). 4:166 and 13:36 use the same words for God's testimony and the rejoicing of the People of the Book.
tree:1ffv1xy14fg6yu.relation: Contrast: true faith in all revelation, a false claim of it, and God's own testimony to it.

tree:1r2cxf400n4yjm.why: All five rows stay. 'God is ever, of what you do, Aware' is the same closing in all five, and four are in the past-tense form a memorizer must tell from 'Aware of what you do'. 4:128 and 4:135 are the close pair in one surah. Same words and structure, different subjects. The rows that read on stay as they are.

tree:1w4d6gy1ubiq3s.why: Punishment because they were defiant: a plague from the sky on the Israelites (2:59) and on Lot's town (29:34) in the same words, the Sabbath-breakers tested and seized (7:163, 7:165), and the deniers touched by punishment (6:49).
tree:1w4d6gy1ubiq3s.relation: Defiance as the stated cause of punishment in several stories.

tree:0swkvkx1ee7y7v.why: Taste the punishment for what you used to deny, said on the Day to the black-faced (3:106), to those stood before their Lord (6:30, 46:34 nearly identical), to Quraysh at the House (8:35), and burn in it today (36:64).
tree:0swkvkx1ee7y7v.relation: The deniers' own denial named as the cause of their punishment.

tree:1c3xnaf0nvob91.why: That is God's guidance, He guides with it whom He wills (6:88, 39:23), and He strikes with rain or good whom He wills (10:107, 24:43, 30:48). Two sub-pairs with the same frame.
tree:1c3xnaf0nvob91.relation: Guidance and rain both fall on whom God wills, a parallel worth pondering.

tree:0o8867f06vdzct.why: Their refuge is Hell, and evil is the destination: 9:73 and 66:9 are identical, 3:162 and 8:16 share returning with God's wrath, 67:6 a shorter form. Classic set.
tree:0o8867f06vdzct.relation: The end of hypocrites, deserters and deniers, in one closing.

tree:1q5rkoe1gmyole.why: Satan made their deeds seem good to them, with what follows changing: hardened hearts, the betrayal at Badr, past nations, Sheba, Ad and Thamud. 27:24 and 29:38 share a longer tail.
tree:1q5rkoe1gmyole.relation: Satan's adornment of deeds as the common root of many nations' ruin.

tree:0kt30yp1ay958v.why: Four of its five ayat (13:2, 31:29, 35:13, 39:5) already make card tree:08y79hd1kgs6kv on the sun and moon. 29:61 alone does not justify a second card.

check.why: Drop is right: I checked that the four sun-and-moon rows are kept in tree:08y79hd1kgs6kv, and 29:61 is kept in several 'who created ... they say God' cards. Nothing is lost.

tree:10ydlux1askjwn.why: Except God's chosen servants, the refrain in As-Saffat, and once in the deniers' mouth: we would have been God's chosen servants (37:169).
tree:10ydlux1askjwn.relation: Contrast: God's sincere servants are excepted from punishment; the deniers claim they would have been among them.

tree:1gcs4c30qk5zv1.why: And upon their Lord they rely, closing descriptions of the believers after different traits (faith increased, patience, faith). 16:42 and 29:59 are identical.
tree:1gcs4c30qk5zv1.relation: Reliance on God paired with patience and faith.

tree:0kksuvi1s4d694.why: What is with God is better: than magic (2:103), than this world (28:60, 42:36 with different endings), than trade and amusement (62:11).
tree:0kksuvi1s4d694.relation: Every worldly gain set against what is with God.

tree:0kus4620tcuqy0.why: Say: the signs are only with God, and what will make you perceive (6:109); say: its knowledge is only with God, and what will make you know (33:63). A tight pair. In 3:78, 3:198 and 30:39 the 'and what' after 'with God' is another 'what' (a negation, a relative, a condition), not the question.
tree:0kus4620tcuqy0.changes: Removed 3:78, 3:198 and 30:39: their 'what' is a different word.
tree:0kus4620tcuqy0.relation: Signs and the Hour are with God alone; people cannot know when or whether they will believe.

check.why: In the removed rows, the ma after 'with God' is relative or a different clause. In 6:109 and 33:63 it is the question 'what will make you know'. A different particle function, so removing them is right.

tree:08gxjph0zf6vad.why: All five rows stay. 'In the Hereafter a punishment' is the same words and structure in all five: disgrace here and a great punishment there (2:114, 5:33, 5:41), the punishment of the Fire (59:3), and a severe punishment (57:20). Different subject, same phrase. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:08gxjph0zf6vad.relation: This world and the next: disgrace now, punishment then.

tree:0j6jp6x0lsv07l.why: Two different phrases share the words: 'he has no share in the Hereafter' (2:102, 2:200, 42:20, with a negation and an extra 'from') and 'in the Hereafter he is among the losers' (3:85, 5:5, where 'from' means 'among'). Different structures, so two memorizer cards.
tree:0j6jp6x0lsv07l.changes: Split: no share in the Hereafter (2:102, 2:200, 42:20) and among the losers (3:85, 5:5). The rows that read on (2:201, 3:86, 5:6) are kept as they are.
tree:0j6jp6x0lsv07l.relation: No share in the Hereafter for those who want only this world; loss for those who reject faith.

tree:06qp4yw0ashn1m.why: Wandering blindly in their transgression, after four different verbs (He extends them, We leave them, He leaves them, they would persist). A classic memorizer set.
tree:06qp4yw0ashn1m.relation: The deniers left in their transgression as a result of their own refusal.

tree:1l9ojfp1ie2a47.why: Except in a clear record, closing descriptions of God's complete knowledge: the falling leaf, the atom's weight (10:61, 34:3 nearly identical), every creature's dwelling, every hidden thing.
tree:1l9ojfp1ie2a47.relation: Nothing in creation escapes God's knowledge and record.

tree:1hzz8uq067ny3c.why: Four of its five ayat (17:89, 18:54, 30:58, 39:27) already make card tree:12x0g85057k2qp on every kind of example. Only 17:41 is new; it could be added to that card instead.

tree:1asmb2k199qe9a.why: In this world: good for those who do good (7:156, 16:30, 39:10) and a curse that follows Ad and Pharaoh's people (11:60, 28:42, also into the Day of Resurrection).
tree:1asmb2k199qe9a.relation: Contrast: the doers of good receive good in this world, the deniers are pursued by a curse in this world and the next.

tree:0ze045n0rdq417.why: How many generations We destroyed before them, five times with five lessons: they were stronger, richer, now silent, cried out too late, searched for escape.
tree:0ze045n0rdq417.relation: The fate of past generations as a warning to Quraysh.

tree:0fh0w990455qkb.why: The people of Noah, Ad and Thamud, listed as nations that denied, with the list changing (38:12 puts Pharaoh in place of Thamud). A memorizer trap.
tree:0fh0w990455qkb.relation: The chain of destroyed nations recalled to the Prophet and to Quraysh.

tree:0sbn0jp00m85d9.why: Indeed God is ever Forgiving, Merciful is a stock closing here after unrelated subjects: marriage law, asking forgiveness, fairness among wives, the Quran's revelation, the hypocrites. The particle differences alone do not make a useful card.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing after unrelated subjects.

tree:0k6548e1db82hg.why: Thus We detail the signs, followed by a people who know, reflect, reason, or by a purpose clause (that the way of the criminals be clear, that they may return). The two short purpose forms (6:55, 7:174) are the trap.
tree:0k6548e1db82hg.relation: Why the signs are detailed: to expose the criminals, to bring people back, and for those who think.

tree:0zq98f300jqph5.why: And sufficient is God as Guardian, after two lead-ins: rely on God (4:81, 33:3, 33:48) and to Him belongs all in the heavens and earth (4:132, 4:171). A memorizer set on which lead-in comes where.
tree:0zq98f300jqph5.relation: God is enough as guardian because all things are His.

tree:0t4pehb070vixn.why: Every thing, and He..., after creating, owning or giving speech to every thing: He knows all, He is the One, He protects, He is Guardian, He created you. Similar frames with different endings.
tree:0t4pehb070vixn.relation: God's sovereignty over everything, sealed with a different attribute each time.

tree:0s3pqbi0fpu06y.why: Every soul for what it earned or strives: God watches over it, it will be repaid, it is held in pledge. Changed verbs and frames in five places.
tree:0s3pqbi0fpu06y.relation: Each soul answers for its own deeds.

tree:0owfycn10bf297.why: How many We destroyed: generations before them, generations after Noah, a town ungrateful for its living. The noun after the verb changes in each place.
tree:0owfycn10bf297.relation: Destroyed nations whose homes still stand as a lesson.

tree:0omr7bt0ptd3cr.why: Concerning what you used to differ in, after God judges or informs on the Day: five places with judge, inform, make clear. A clear memorizer set.
tree:0omr7bt0ptd3cr.relation: Human disagreement will be settled by God on the Day of Resurrection.

tree:07wvm1i180f052.why: Nor will they be reprieved: 2:162 and 3:88 are identical, 16:85 is close, and 21:40 and 32:29 use it for the sudden Hour and the day of victory.
tree:07wvm1i180f052.relation: No delay once the punishment or the Hour arrives.

tree:1un3deg0n0s5ii.why: The punishment will not be lightened for them, ending with nor helped (2:86) or nor reprieved (2:162, 3:88, 16:85), and in 35:36 nor will it be lightened from its punishment. The endings are the trap.
tree:1un3deg0n0s5ii.relation: The unchanging punishment of the deniers.

tree:1w0zsl3012qmzj.why: In clear error: before the Messenger came (3:164, 62:2 nearly identical), Joseph's brothers about their father, the idolaters' confession in Hell, the man of the town. A good memorizer set.
tree:1w0zsl3012qmzj.relation: Clear error before guidance, confessed by the lost in the hereafter.

tree:161sjrs00hfb08.why: It would have been better for them, after five conditions (if the People of the Book believed, said we hear and obey, did what they were told, were true to God, waited patiently), with different continuations.
tree:161sjrs00hfb08.relation: The good that people miss when they do not obey.

tree:0dnbwq31b7xkd3.why: A humiliating punishment for those who mock God's signs (31:6, 45:9 with the same phrase), deny, swear false oaths, or are given respite. The humiliation matches arrogance and mockery.
tree:0dnbwq31b7xkd3.relation: A punishment of humiliation for those who held God's signs in contempt.

tree:0gj2prf11rkrzj.why: For them is forgiveness and a reward great or large: which ayah has which word is a known trap, after five descriptions of the believers.
tree:0gj2prf11rkrzj.relation: Who earns forgiveness and great reward: good deeds, patience, reverence, fear of God unseen.

tree:1c4ci960kge5jk.why: The useful slips (no protector from God, in two words) are in the smaller card. Here they are mixed with God's great bounty for believers (33:47) and what appears to the wrongdoers (39:47), which share only the words from God.

tree:1fjz0r007wg4x2.why: What they used to earn or enjoy did not avail them: 15:84, 39:50 and 40:82 end the same, 26:207 and 46:26 change the subject. A good memorizer set.
tree:1fjz0r007wg4x2.relation: Wealth, strength and senses are no help against God's punishment.

tree:1wkrgkk1k6ty9a.why: You cannot escape, ending the ayah (6:134, 10:53, 11:33) or followed by in the earth (29:22, 42:31 nearly identical). Clear memorizer set.
tree:1wkrgkk1k6ty9a.relation: No escape from God's promise, in earth or heaven.

tree:12w6pue0pvw43q.why: 'Except what God wills': the Prophet has no power to benefit or harm himself (7:188, 10:49, word order swapped), he will not forget (87:7), and the people of the Fire abide in it (6:128). Same exception, same words in all four. In 18:39 there is no exception: 'what God willed' is the believer's exclamation, a different structure.
tree:12w6pue0pvw43q.changes: Removed only 18:39: no exception there, a different structure. 6:128 stays: same exception, only a different subject.
tree:12w6pue0pvw43q.relation: Everything stands under God's will: the Prophet's power, his memory, and the abode of the Fire.

tree:16hx3xm0ni6vpw.why: What is with God is better or lasting: for the righteous, against what you have, which runs out, against worldly enjoyment, against trade. 16:96 adds the clear contrast of lasting and running out.
tree:16hx3xm0ni6vpw.relation: Contrast: what people hold runs out, what is with God remains.

tree:0u8kpmi12i2mka.why: It was not for them joins unrelated sentences: entering mosques only in fear, no protectors, no choice in creation, no defender from God. The useful slip (no protector, in two words) is in a smaller card.

tree:1wq1djy1hzuyxg.why: Those your right hands possess, across the marriage rulings (4:3, 4:24, 4:25), the command of kindness (4:36), and the parable against partners to God (30:28). Same term, shown in law and in argument.
tree:1wq1djy1hzuyxg.relation: The parable in 30:28 uses a social reality the listeners know to show the absurdity of giving God partners.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: three marriage rulings share the term, and 30:28 uses it in argument.

tree:1nfax6s1p8wpgw.why: This is nothing but..., the deniers' dismissals of their messengers: a man like you (23:24, 23:33), invented magic, a man who turns you away, a lie, old tales. A clear memorizer set.
tree:1nfax6s1p8wpgw.relation: The same few charges thrown at every messenger and at the Quran.

tree:19itybi1lwxd0k.why: No messenger, reminder or prophet comes to them but they mock it, play, or turn away. 15:11 and 36:30 share the tail, 21:2 and 26:5 share the new reminder.
tree:19itybi1lwxd0k.relation: The deniers' habit of mocking every new reminder.

tree:0ituqhh0fwhptn.why: Forgiveness and generous provision, promised to the true believers (8:4, 8:74), to those who believe and do good (22:50, 34:4), and to the innocent women (24:26). Lead-ins differ.
tree:0ituqhh0fwhptn.relation: The same reward for faith, emigration, good deeds and purity.

tree:0loqhin0l1ol9n.why: Eat of what God has provided you: lawful and good, then fear God (5:88) or be grateful (16:114), and do not follow Satan (6:142). In 7:50 and 36:47 the words follow other verbs (pour on us, spend), a different governing verb.
tree:0loqhin0l1ol9n.changes: Removed 7:50 and 36:47: a different governing verb.
tree:0loqhin0l1ol9n.relation: Eating God's provision is tied to fearing Him, thanking Him and refusing Satan's steps.

tree:1wpx73w13ha3je.why: Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth, asked three times with different follow-ups (10:31, 27:64, 35:3), and blessings from heaven and earth that faith would open (7:96). In 34:9 'from' only says what surrounds them (of sky and earth), a different sense.
tree:1wpx73w13ha3je.changes: Removed 34:9: a different sense of the particle.
tree:1wpx73w13ha3je.relation: Provision from heaven and earth: asked as a proof of God, and promised to towns that believe.

check.why: In 34:9, 'of the sky and the earth' explains what is before and behind them; it is not the source of provision or blessing. A different construction, so removing it is right.

tree:1hkx1ab1cwwcx3.why: Whoever is given his record in his right hand, left hand, or behind his back, with different responses. A clear memorizer and pondering set.
tree:1hkx1ab1cwwcx3.relation: Contrast: the joy of the right hand and the regret of the left on the Day of Judgment.

tree:1p8kvko04k1u5s.why: Besides Him, any..., with protector (13:11, a rare form), ally (18:26, 32:4) or anything (16:35, 29:42). The noun after the phrase is the trap.
tree:1p8kvko04k1u5s.relation: Nothing and no one besides God can protect or be worshipped.

tree:070ifbn1qeh1d3.why: Who is it that...: lends to God (2:245, 57:11 with different endings), intercedes, helps you after Him, protects you from God. One rhetorical opening for God's power and generosity.
tree:070ifbn1qeh1d3.relation: Questions that leave only God as the answer.

tree:1hssaid1rn0zuf.why: Eat of the good things We provided you: to the Israelites (2:57, 7:160, 20:81) and the believers (2:172), and spend of the good things you earned (2:267). Different endings make it a real trap.
tree:1hssaid1rn0zuf.relation: Eating good provision, gratefully and without transgression; spending only the good.

tree:1osdiil0vj545j.why: Whoever does good does it for himself: 41:46 and 45:15 differ only in their final clause, 30:44 and 16:97 are close.
tree:1osdiil0vj545j.relation: Each person's deeds return to themselves.

tree:06slkff01d7ltx.why: Four of its five ayat (13:33, 40:17, 45:22, 74:38) are already card tree:0s3pqbi0fpu06y on every soul for what it earned. 6:70 alone is new.

tree:1v61d4b1j225yp.why: We sent Noah to his people, five times with different continuations: his call (7:59, 23:23 differing in the ending), I am a warner, he stayed a thousand years, warn your people.
tree:1v61d4b1j225yp.relation: Noah's mission in summary, told from different angles.

tree:0gfjs4n0fe7guz.why: Guidance and mercy for a people who believe, closing four descriptions of the Book, and for a people who are certain in 45:20.
tree:0gfjs4n0fe7guz.relation: The Book as guidance and mercy for those who believe.

tree:0djd9no1ifnho0.why: This is a straight path, after Jesus' words (3:51, 19:36, 43:64, with small differences), worship Me (36:61), and follow me (43:61).
tree:0djd9no1ifnho0.relation: Worship of the one Lord as the straight path, said by Jesus and by God.

tree:1sagx0c19scz7o.why: And they, in the hereafter, are deniers (11:19, 12:37, 41:7) or are certain (27:3, 31:4). One word flips the meaning.
tree:1sagx0c19scz7o.relation: Contrast: denial and certainty of the hereafter, in the same words.

tree:0lblukp1xhdc3j.why: So they do not believe: those who lost themselves (6:12, 6:20 identical), the worst creatures (8:55), the heedless (19:39), those on whom the word came true (36:7).
tree:0lblukp1xhdc3j.relation: Different causes named for the same refusal to believe.

tree:0eaiibk1e4yeh8.why: It is only a reminder for the worlds, four times with the opening particle changing, and once a reminder and a clear Quran (36:69).
tree:0eaiibk1e4yeh8.relation: The Quran as a reminder for all.

tree:00sa6pl1ekg7un.why: It is He who sent down: the Book (3:7, 6:114), rain (6:99, 16:10), tranquility (48:4). Two sub-pairs with the same opening.
tree:00sa6pl1ekg7un.relation: The Book, rain and tranquility, all sent down by God, bring life.

tree:0p7akzh0sicwbl.why: O People of the Book, why do you...: argue, deny (3:70, 3:98 with different endings), mix truth with falsehood, turn others away. All in Al Imran, a tight set.
tree:0p7akzh0sicwbl.relation: God's questions to the People of the Book, each naming a fault.

tree:0tutb871e6d12x.why: On the Day the Hour arrives, five times with five different scenes: the criminals despair, they divide, they swear, Pharaoh's people enter, the falsifiers lose. Short and easy to mix.
tree:0tutb871e6d12x.relation: Scenes of the Last Hour, one after another.

tree:05r36uh0v829at.why: Who believes and does good, sometimes with repents before it, and six different rewards after. A strong memorizer set.
tree:05r36uh0v829at.relation: Repentance, faith and good deeds as the condition of every reward.

tree:0vkhohr00no2bl.why: They took besides Him gods (18:15, 21:24, 25:3) or allies (39:3, 42:6, 42:9), with the noun and continuation changing. A useful memorizer set.
tree:0vkhohr00no2bl.relation: Taking gods or allies besides God, answered each time.

tree:1p7x5l70a4isjh.why: Whoever obeys God and His Messenger (or and the Messenger, 4:69), with five rewards: gardens (4:13, 48:17 share the words), company of the prophets, the winners, a great triumph.
tree:1p7x5l70a4isjh.relation: Obedience to God and the Messenger and its many rewards.

tree:1vjttut1wmlxyr.why: Fear God and know that..., six times in Al-Baqara, each with a different ending fitted to the ruling before it. A classic set.
tree:1vjttut1wmlxyr.relation: Each ruling sealed by a truth about God or the meeting with Him.

tree:03l1ara1o5n8ky.why: Call upon your Lord for us: three times in the cow story with small changes, for food in 2:61, and twice by Pharaoh's people with by the covenant He made with you (7:134, 43:49).
tree:03l1ara1o5n8ky.relation: The Israelites and Pharaoh's people asking Moses to pray for them, out of reluctance or fear.

tree:08pkvi11omk0j1.why: When he said to his people: Lot three times in different wordings (7:80, 27:54, 29:28), plus Noah, Abraham and Ilyas. The three Lot ayat are a classic trap.
tree:08pkvi11omk0j1.relation: Each prophet's opening words to his people.

tree:0igkoa91u3uvv9.why: Except in a record: a clear record (6:59, 10:61, 27:75, 34:3) and a record, that is easy for God (35:11, 57:22). Two endings to keep apart.
tree:0igkoa91u3uvv9.relation: Everything, including lifespans and calamities, is written beforehand.

tree:04f5g6v180s8wv.why: All six rows stay. 'Except what God / your Lord wills' is the same exception in all six: abiding in the Fire (6:128, 11:107) and the Garden (11:108), the Prophet's power over benefit and harm (7:188, 10:49), and his memory (87:7). Same words and structure; a different subject is not a reason to remove.
tree:04f5g6v180s8wv.relation: God's will is the exception over eternity, over the Prophet's power, and over what he remembers.

tree:05zfkbr1f952en.why: 'Except after' leads two different things here: the People of the Book differed only after knowledge came to them (3:19, 42:14, 45:17, 98:4), and no intercession except after His permission (10:3, 53:26). The two subjects do not meet, so a split gives two clean cards.
tree:05zfkbr1f952en.changes: Split: differing after knowledge came (3:19, 42:14, 45:17, 98:4) and intercession after permission (10:3, 53:26).
tree:05zfkbr1f952en.relation: Division comes after knowledge, out of envy; intercession comes only after permission.

check.why: Right split: differing only after knowledge came, and intercession only after His permission, are two different sentences that share 'except after'.

tree:1cbd5wx1pznt6r.why: The truth from your Lord, followed by do not be a doubter (2:147, 3:60, 10:94) or by its effect on others: most do not believe, the learned humble themselves, so that you warn. A memorizer set.
tree:1cbd5wx1pznt6r.relation: The revelation as truth from the Lord, and how people respond to it.

tree:1csfb901pdpu26.why: He begins creation then repeats it, six times with six continuations, two in surah Yunus and two in Ar-Rum. A model memorizer card.
tree:1csfb901pdpu26.relation: The first creation as proof of resurrection.

tree:174ogtb0o1l2bp.why: The words those who believe, followed by indeed, join six unrelated sentences: rabbis eating wealth, glad tidings, God's defence, a wide earth, the losers, enemies in the family. Nothing to compare.

tree:1242if41vrbatc.why: All six rows stay. Those who disbelieve answer with 'nothing but': this is nothing but plain magic (6:7, 11:7), old tales (6:25), a lie (25:4), you are nothing but falsifiers (30:58). 21:36 has the same negation and exception ('they take you nothing but in mockery'), same words and structure, only another verb. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1242if41vrbatc.relation: The deniers' labels for revelation and for the Prophet.

tree:0c1r8r1144cdxn.why: All six rows stay as one card. 'Those who do not know' is the same words and structure in all six: what they said (2:113, 2:118), do not follow their way or desires (10:89, 45:18), God seals their hearts (30:59), are they equal to those who know (39:9). Same phrase, different subjects; splitting it into pairs would hide the reciter's trap. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0c1r8r1144cdxn.relation: What is said of those without knowledge: their words, their way, their sealed hearts, and that they are not equal to those who know.

tree:10galdw1xar1sc.why: Those they call on besides God or besides Him, with different negations: they create nothing, answer nothing, judge nothing, own no intercession. A memorizer set.
tree:10galdw1xar1sc.relation: The helplessness of false gods, shown six ways.

tree:15aj0vd1crrbzn.why: Kin, orphans and the poor, in six lists of who deserves kindness or a share, each continuing differently. A classic memorizer set.
tree:15aj0vd1crrbzn.relation: The same weak groups named in worship, charity, inheritance and spoils.

tree:1prb038090ej6e.why: 'God, for / over what' carries two senses. Magnify or mention God for what He guided or gave you (2:185, 22:34, 22:37). God is witness or guardian over what is said or hidden (2:204, 12:66, 28:28). 2:204 is the same sense as the second group, so it moves there instead of being removed.
tree:1prb038090ej6e.changes: Split by the two senses: magnifying God for what He gave (2:185, 22:34, 22:37) and God as witness over what is said (2:204, 12:66, 28:28). 2:204 joins the second group. The rows that read on (12:67, 28:29) are kept as they are.
tree:1prb038090ej6e.relation: Thanking God for His gifts; calling God to witness over words and hearts.

tree:1tjgm720xoqde8.why: A goodly loan to God, six times with different rewards: multiplied, sins removed, generous reward, forgiveness, found with God. 2:245 and 57:11 share the opening.
tree:1tjgm720xoqde8.relation: Spending for God described as a loan He repays many times.

tree:0ww6yug0e16qcu.why: The poor and the traveller, in lists of who receives: 17:26 and 30:38 are nearly identical, the others vary their lists and endings.
tree:0ww6yug0e16qcu.relation: The right of the needy in charity, spoils and spending.

tree:1d7u6ot04aujo1.why: Your God is one God, six times with different continuations; 18:110 and 41:6 share the long opening.
tree:1d7u6ot04aujo1.relation: The oneness of God as the centre of the message.

tree:0eq0klp1j0dncz.why: To Pharaoh and his chiefs, with six different continuations: they did wrong, were arrogant (10:75, 23:46), followed Pharaoh, were defiant, and Moses said.
tree:0eq0klp1j0dncz.relation: The mission of Moses to Pharaoh's court and its refusal.

tree:07wi606168x5wc.why: The useful set, those who do not believe in the hereafter, is already its own card; this one repeats it with 10:7, 16:104 and 17:10 added, which share only the opening.

tree:027xd320jwao10.why: God sees what you do is a stock closing here after unrelated rulings (prayer, nursing, divorce, enemies, fighting). The small changes in verb and name are not enough to make a card.

tree:1tv513h0btivo5.why: If God wills: you will find me, if God wills, patient or righteous (18:69, 28:27, 37:102), and enter safe, if God wills (12:99, 48:27). Good memorizer pairs.
tree:1tv513h0btivo5.relation: Promises made with God's will: Moses to Khidr, the old man to Moses, Ishmael to Abraham.

tree:1rp11p51hvqzyp.why: They only guess or assume, or they are only like cattle: the ending changes across six descriptions of those who follow conjecture.
tree:1rp11p51hvqzyp.relation: Following conjecture instead of knowledge leads astray.

tree:1vap7y40q4rzyq.why: He does not love the wasteful (6:141, 7:31), the transgressors, the arrogant, the deniers, the wrongdoers. Each fits the command before it, a good memorizer set.
tree:1vap7y40q4rzyq.relation: Who God does not love, each matched to a command.

tree:1ju0mal0nqketr.why: The wrongdoers or the criminals or the deniers will not succeed: 6:21 and 10:17 differ only in the last word, a classic trap; Joseph and Moses also say it.
tree:1ju0mal0nqketr.relation: Failure of the wrongdoers, said by God, by Joseph and by Moses.

tree:0wahobf0hh0t1d.why: And We inspired Moses: throw your staff, strike the rock, settle your people, travel by night with My servants (20:77, 26:52), strike the sea. Each command marks a stage of his story.
tree:0wahobf0hh0t1d.relation: The story of Moses told through God's commands to him.

tree:0ws05nd0n239b9.why: In the best way: approaching the orphan's wealth (6:152, 17:34, nearly identical), arguing with people (16:125, 29:46), and repelling evil (23:96, 41:34). Three pairs under one phrase.
tree:0ws05nd0n239b9.relation: The same standard of excellence in wealth, debate and dealing with harm.

tree:03k502j1qdt9xd.why: That is because they are a people who do not reason, understand or know, closing five descriptions of deniers and hypocrites. The last verb is the trap.
tree:03k502j1qdt9xd.relation: Lack of understanding named as the cause of the enemies' behaviour.

tree:0nlnzlo1mfofv6.why: All five rows stay. 'After it had become clear to them' is the same words and structure in all five: the truth (2:109), the guidance (4:115, 47:25, 47:32), and that they are of Hell (9:113). Different subject, same phrase.
tree:0nlnzlo1mfofv6.relation: Clear knowledge removes excuses: whoever turns from guidance after it is clear is held to account.

tree:061cxlo19wog98.why: Because of what their hands have sent ahead: they will never wish for death (2:95, 62:7, differing in the particle), a calamity strikes them (4:62, 28:47), an evil touches them (30:36, 42:48).
tree:061cxlo19wog98.relation: Suffering and fear of death as the fruit of their own deeds.

tree:04uvxda1xbhh04.why: God or your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection in what they differed: with judge, decide or separate, six places with small changes. A classic set.
tree:04uvxda1xbhh04.relation: Final judgment on the disputes of the religions.

tree:0krksvy1r4pp2u.why: These are the limits of God, then do not approach them, do not transgress them, He makes them clear, and whoever obeys or transgresses. Six places with different follow-ups.
tree:0krksvy1r4pp2u.relation: God's limits in fasting, divorce, inheritance and expiation.

tree:1mgbinc0ijpyhi.why: Rely upon God, then God loves those who rely, He is the Hearing the Knowing, you are on clear truth, and sufficient is God as Guardian (three times). A memorizer set.
tree:1mgbinc0ijpyhi.relation: Reliance on God after consultation, peace and the deniers' plots.

tree:034cp691s1prf5.why: Their messengers came to them with clear proofs, six times with six reactions: they would not believe (7:101, 10:13), returned their hands to their mouths, wronged themselves, rejoiced in their own knowledge.
tree:034cp691s1prf5.relation: Every nation rejected clear proofs in its own way.

tree:02idchl1ndac8z.why: A recompense for what they used to earn, do, or deny, for the hypocrites, the believers in hidden joy, the enemies of God and the people of paradise. The verb changes with the subject.
tree:02idchl1ndac8z.relation: Contrast: the same words for reward and for punishment, each earned by deeds.

tree:10vlrqk1fciac2.why: He made the earth for you a bed, a cradle (20:53, 43:10), a dwelling, tame, a carpet. Six descriptions to keep apart.
tree:10vlrqk1fciac2.relation: The earth prepared for mankind, as a sign of God's care.

tree:1s6l60p08ay0dz.why: He made for you from: yourselves mates (16:72, 42:11), your homes rest, green trees fire, ships and cattle. A memorizer set on God's provisions.
tree:1s6l60p08ay0dz.relation: Everyday blessings drawn from ordinary things.

tree:1n19xy91g9q1ox.why: All six rows stay. 'The creation of the heavens and the earth' is the same noun phrase in all six: a sign with night and day (2:164, 3:190), reflected on (3:191), with languages and colours (30:22), with creatures (42:29), and not witnessed by the idols (18:51). Same words, different subject.
tree:1n19xy91g9q1ox.relation: Creation as a sign to reflect on, and the idols who had no part in it.

tree:0b0mmho1ymkod2.why: That is the great triumph, with and without and, after gardens beneath which rivers flow in six places. The detail of each promise varies.
tree:0b0mmho1ymkod2.relation: The great triumph promised to the obedient, the truthful, the forerunners and the believers.

tree:19gwds80ccuo6s.why: Whoever after that ..., those are the defiant, wrongdoers, transgressors or losers. 23:7 and 70:31 are identical, 3:82 and 24:55 share their ending.
tree:19gwds80ccuo6s.relation: Each boundary God sets, and what those who cross it are called.

tree:1w26p8k01w6oxw.why: A mercy from your Lord, six times with different roles: hoped for, kept the revelation, the treasure for orphans, the mission of the Prophet, the Book.
tree:1w26p8k01w6oxw.relation: Revelation and care for the weak, both named mercy from the Lord.

tree:0t813yk0fp2yaq.why: Glorify with the praise of your Lord, six times with different companions: be of the prostrating, before sunrise, evening and morning, when you rise, ask forgiveness.
tree:0t813yk0fp2yaq.relation: Glorification as the Prophet's support in patience.

tree:02vxsvs1w0jtaq.why: Glory be to Him, exalted above what they describe, associate or say. Six places with three endings.
tree:02vxsvs1w0jtaq.relation: God declared above every false claim about Him.

tree:1uijdwj02ja3cl.why: Travel through the land and see the end of the deniers, criminals, those before, or how He began creation. The verb after travel (then see) and the ending vary.
tree:1uijdwj02ja3cl.relation: History and creation as lessons for whoever travels and looks.

tree:0x3574q1qx1xk0.why: Perhaps God will: restrain the deniers, pardon the weak (4:99), bring victory, accept repentance (9:102), bring back Jacob's sons, create affection. Six hopes.
tree:0x3574q1qx1xk0.relation: God's mercy left open as a hope in different situations.

tree:0xxhdgw0v5mzoe.why: If I am upon clear proof from my Lord, said by Noah, Salih and Shu'ayb in Hud with different follow-ups, and by the Prophet; and is one upon clear proof like... (11:17, 47:14).
tree:0xxhdgw0v5mzoe.relation: The prophets' certainty of their message, set against their people's doubt.

check.why: Keep is right: 'upon clear proof from my Lord' is repeated by three prophets in Hud, with the question form in 11:17 and 47:14.

tree:0jzlfml1hz046r.why: On a straight path, said of the Prophet (36:4, 43:43), of God (11:56), of the one God guides, of the just man, and of the one walking upright. Different lead-ins to one ending.
tree:0jzlfml1hz046r.relation: The straight path as the way of God, His Prophet, and the guided.

tree:1i9ta9m1n4g5b8.why: The unseen of the heavens and the earth: God knows it (2:33, 35:38, 49:18), it belongs to Him (11:123, 16:77 sharing the opening), it is His (18:26). Different follow-ups.

tree:0ltp8jx1cjekwb.why: Originator of the heavens and the earth, in six prayers and arguments, each continuing differently. A memorizer set.
tree:0ltp8jx1cjekwb.relation: The Creator as the only one fit to be protector, judge and god.

tree:1gimour0rdygs5.why: When Moses said to his people, with and without O my people, in six scenes: the calf, the cow, the favours, patience, rescue from Pharaoh, why do you hurt me.
tree:1gimour0rdygs5.relation: Moses' words to his people across their history.

tree:0mi9b93088562x.why: All six rows stay. 'They said: indeed God ...' is the same words and structure in all six. Five are false claims about God, each refuted (poor, made a covenant, the Messiah, third of three); in 7:50 the people of the Garden say 'God has forbidden both to the deniers'. Different subject, same words.
tree:0mi9b93088562x.relation: Contrast: false sayings about God, and one true saying from the people of the Garden.

tree:07n03o60glbw7k.why: Before them the people of Noah denied, followed by different lists: Ad and Thamud, Ad and Pharaoh, the parties after them, the people of the well, or straight into the story (54:9). A memorizer set.
tree:07n03o60glbw7k.relation: The denial of Noah's people at the head of every list of deniers.

tree:0xy3vba1hpvn7i.why: Say: praise be to God, six times with six continuations; 29:63 and 31:25 differ only in the last word (reason, know).
tree:0xy3vba1hpvn7i.relation: Praise as the Prophet's answer to every sign and argument.

tree:12bwgv00tjuft0.why: And God is ever over all things..., is a stock closing here after unrelated subjects (intercession, replacing people, the parable of this life, spoils, the Prophet's wives). The changed name alone is not enough for a card.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing after unrelated subjects.

tree:0ijvp3w0kfyqto.why: Five of its six ayat (2:113, 10:93, 16:124, 32:25, 45:17) are already card tree:04uvxda1xbhh04 on God judging what they differed in. Only 39:46 is new.

tree:0rd7uso1kebzzw.why: Sufficient is God as witness: closing an ayah (4:79, 4:166, 48:28) or followed by between me and you (13:43, 17:96) or between us and you (10:29). The forms are the trap.
tree:0rd7uso1kebzzw.relation: God as witness to the Messenger's truth when people deny it.

tree:0jfkjky0brayyq.why: Do not be like those who: split, disbelieved, said we hear, marched out in pride, hurt Moses, forgot God. Six warnings, each naming a past example.
tree:0jfkjky0brayyq.relation: Past failures held up as warnings to the believers.

tree:12o9rx104o664b.why: Nor will they be helped, closing scenes of the Day: 2:48 and 2:123 swap intercession and ransom, a classic trap; the others vary.
tree:12o9rx104o664b.relation: No help for the deniers on the Last Day.

tree:0i8y1t10kjcerb.why: In that are signs for a people who believe, closing six signs: plants, birds, night and day, Abraham's rescue, and provision (30:37, 39:52 nearly identical).
tree:0i8y1t10kjcerb.relation: Signs that faith lets one see.

tree:10qm0kw1te2ee2.why: That you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful, after the sea, ships, night and day and winds. 17:66 ends instead with He is Merciful to you. A strong memorizer set.
tree:10qm0kw1te2ee2.relation: Every means of livelihood framed as a call to gratitude.

tree:10okcmo0koau4s.why: Gardens beneath which rivers flow, with differences that trap memorizers: 9:100 without from, 85:11 the great triumph, different tails after abiding. Useful mainly for memorizers.
tree:10okcmo0koau4s.relation: The promise of gardens to the believers, worded six ways.

tree:1qhuhpr1sjn3d1.why: For them is a severe punishment is a stock phrase after unrelated groups (deniers of signs, plotters, those who stray, disputers). Nothing is gained by setting them side by side.

tree:0a21y9p0dvm4p3.why: And for them is a great punishment closes six unrelated passages (sealed hearts, division, apostasy, slander). A stock closing with different subjects.

tree:0gq5mbf09w30ud.why: What they have in the hereafter: no share (3:77), great punishment (5:33), only the fire (11:16), the punishment of fire (59:3). One frame, four ends for those who traded faith for this world.
tree:0gq5mbf09w30ud.relation: Those who choose this world have nothing in the hereafter but punishment.

tree:0kf7zdf1lvtkhp.why: Why has not a sign, angel or treasure been sent down to him: 13:7 and 13:27 share the whole request, 10:20 and 29:50 change the answer. A classic set.
tree:0kf7zdf1lvtkhp.relation: The deniers' demands for a sign, answered: the unseen and the signs belong to God.

tree:1n0qkcr071jqlx.why: There is no blame on you, with and without the prefixes so or and, granting six permissions (trade on Hajj, not writing small trades, shortening prayer, entering houses, eating together, mistakes in names).
tree:1n0qkcr071jqlx.relation: Ease granted in worship, trade and family life.

tree:0y5lz1t0wlb0pd.why: Two different words share 'what God created'. In 10:5 and 30:8 'what' is a negation (God did not create it except in truth). In the others it is a relative, what God created: signs in the heavens and earth (7:185, 10:6, 16:48) and what God created in the wombs (2:228). 2:228 has the relative, so it belongs with that group.
tree:0y5lz1t0wlb0pd.changes: Split by the two words: the negation (10:5, 30:8) and the relative (2:228, 7:185, 10:6, 16:48). 2:228 stays, in the relative group.
tree:0y5lz1t0wlb0pd.relation: Creation is in truth, and all He created is a sign, even what is hidden in the womb.

tree:1s2g60r0b8x35l.why: All six rows stay. 'And he was not of the ...' is the same negation and words in all six. Five close ayat on the religion of Abraham ('of the polytheists'); 28:81 says Qarun was not of those who could defend themselves. Same words and structure, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1s2g60r0b8x35l.relation: Abraham's pure religion, five times; and Qarun who could not save himself.

tree:17pa8if1egcg7z.why: The wrongdoers have no helpers, no helper, no friend: three endings across six places, a clear memorizer set.

tree:1r14dm20nkzyba.why: And from what We provided them, they spend, closing six descriptions of the believers with different traits before it. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1r14dm20nkzyba.relation: Spending as a constant trait of the believers.

tree:1pudes101r48px.why: All six rows stay. 'Of the jinn and mankind' is the same words and sense in all six. 7:38, 41:25 and 46:18 are the close set (nations of jinn and men that passed); 7:179, 27:17 and 41:29 have the same phrase for Hell's many, Solomon's armies, and the misleaders. Same words, different subjects. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1pudes101r48px.relation: Jinn and men together: in judgment, in Hell, in Solomon's host, and as misleaders.

tree:000kwh61hs5ax6.why: I know from God what you do not know: Noah (7:62) and twice Jacob (12:86, 12:96); you hope from God what they do not (4:104); there appeared from God what they had not expected (39:47). In 42:47 'what' after 'from God' is a negation ('you will have no refuge'), a different word.
tree:000kwh61hs5ax6.changes: Removed 42:47: its 'what' is a negation. The rows that read on (7:63, 12:87, 12:97) are kept as they are.
tree:000kwh61hs5ax6.relation: What only God gives: knowledge to His prophets, hope to the believers, and the unexpected to the wrongdoers.

tree:0y8t6og1hfr2fc.why: From dust, then: then He said Be (Adam), then from a drop (four times with different stages), then you are humans spreading. A strong memorizer and pondering set.
tree:0y8t6og1hfr2fc.relation: Human origin from dust as proof of resurrection.

tree:0zehg8b1qx77dj.why: Allies besides Him: do not follow (7:3), have you taken (13:16), those who took (39:3, 42:6), have they taken (42:9), he has none (46:32). One phrase, six forms.
tree:0zehg8b1qx77dj.relation: Only God is a true protector.

tree:1i8oy9t0hsd085.why: No messenger, except: to be obeyed, in his people's tongue, they mocked him (15:11, 36:30), We revealed to him, they said a magician. Six continuations.
tree:1i8oy9t0hsd085.relation: Why messengers are sent and how they were received.

tree:0c1febb1twv1kb.why: Two different phrases are mixed only through before them: how many generations We destroyed (6:6, 32:26, 38:3) and among nations of jinn and men that passed (41:25, 46:18). Both groups already have their own cards (tree:0owfycn10bf297 and tree:1pudes101r48px).

tree:0sdjnzl11t4whn.why: Of all fruits: in the parable of the burnt garden, rain reviving the dead land, the spread earth, crops, the bee, and paradise. Different sentences around one image.
tree:0sdjnzl11t4whn.relation: Fruits as a sign of revival and of God's gifts, here and in paradise.

tree:0iahjwe1b12nny.why: All six rows stay. 'Of every thing' is the same words and sense in all six. 18:84, 27:16 and 27:23 are the close set (three rulers given of everything); 7:145 (written of everything), 15:19 (grown of everything) and 51:49 (of everything We created pairs) are the same phrase in other subjects.
tree:0iahjwe1b12nny.relation: Rulers given of everything: one thanks God (Solomon), one worships the sun (the Queen).

tree:0eotv5a1qmo21g.why: God leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills (14:4, 16:93, 35:8, 74:31) or guides to Himself who turns back (13:27, 42:13). The second half is the trap.
tree:0eotv5a1qmo21g.relation: Guidance given to those who turn to God.

tree:1bvm0t40jxxjhw.why: And the trumpet is blown, six times with six scenes after it: gathering, no ties, rising from graves, swooning and standing, the day of the threat, a single blast.
tree:1bvm0t40jxxjhw.relation: The blowing of the trumpet and what follows.

tree:14ciehl0ruajoh.why: It is He who made for you: the stars, sun and moon, night for rest (10:67, 25:47 differ), night and day in succession, the earth tame. With and without and.
tree:14ciehl0ruajoh.relation: Signs of the sky and time made for human benefit.

tree:0j271ps18yezwg.why: It is He who created: what is on earth, the heavens and earth in truth or in six days (11:7, 57:4), night and day, man from water. A memorizer set.
tree:0j271ps18yezwg.relation: Creation as proof of His knowledge, power and purpose.

tree:1uhjhan0h37mtz.why: He is the Forgiving, the Merciful, with three lead-ins (and He, indeed He, indeed God is He), mostly after asking forgiveness: Jacob for his sons, Moses for himself, the call not to despair, the angels' prayer.
tree:1uhjhan0h37mtz.relation: Forgiveness asked for, and God's name answering it.

tree:1aanthj112zr21.why: It is better for you, with and, so, rather: fighting you dislike, secret charity, stopping, repenting, what is with God, and the slander that was good for you (24:11).
tree:1aanthj112zr21.relation: What seems hard or harmful can be good, as in fighting (2:216) and the slander (24:11).

tree:0n68asa04gnd48.why: No protector and no helper, after besides God (4:123, 4:173, 33:17) or without it (33:65, 48:22, which the owner kept as a pair). A memorizer set.
tree:0n68asa04gnd48.relation: The deniers find no protector, here or in the hereafter.

tree:0xife0p182h9ih.why: He creates what He wills, followed by six different statements: when He decrees, His power, His choice, the stages of life, no son, daughters and sons.
tree:0xife0p182h9ih.relation: God's free will in creation, against claims of sons and partners.

tree:0bif2fb0667foj.why: He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills, with the order swapped in 5:40 and mercy in place of forgiveness in 29:21, and different closings. A classic set.
tree:0bif2fb0667foj.relation: Forgiveness and punishment both in God's hand.

tree:11cwqax044rlbz.why: Five of its six ayat are already card tree:04uvxda1xbhh04 on God judging what they differed in. Only 22:69 is new.

check.why: Drop is right: the five rows are in the kept tree:04uvxda1xbhh04, and I checked that 22:69 is kept in tree:16bpoqk10th5w2 and tree:0omr7bt0ptd3cr. Nothing is lost.

tree:0oadsbk1mwyj4q.why: Five of its seven ayat are already card tree:1gimour0rdygs5 on Moses speaking to his people. The two new ones (18:60 to his boy, 27:7 to his family) could be added there.

tree:1f3onk90mbmgd1.why: Those you call on besides God: I am forbidden to worship them (6:56, 40:66), they are servants like you, they cannot help, cannot create a fly, own nothing. Six answers.
tree:1f3onk90mbmgd1.relation: The weakness of false gods shown from every side.

tree:1uigtt50m0j0i3.why: Those who lost themselves: they do not believe (6:12, 6:20), their scales are light (7:9, 23:103), they lost themselves and their families (39:15, 42:45). Three pairs.
tree:1uigtt50m0j0i3.relation: The real loss is losing oneself in the hereafter.

tree:0ger9eg0ypy63e.why: He created the heavens and the earth in truth, seven times with seven different continuations. A model memorizer set.
tree:0ger9eg0ypy63e.relation: Creation with purpose, leading to judgment.

tree:0d0b8941613glc.why: God who created the heavens and the earth: in six days (7:54, 10:3, 32:4), sent down rain, is able to create their like, gives life to the dead, seven heavens. A memorizer set.
tree:0d0b8941613glc.relation: The Creator of the heavens is able to raise the dead.

tree:02ka3j90i5t7ah.why: God, the Mighty, the Wise: closing the revelation of the Book (39:1, 45:2, 46:2 identical), victory, Moses' call, and revelation to all prophets.
tree:02ka3j90i5t7ah.relation: The Book and victory come from the Mighty, the Wise.

tree:1pjkevx1olgc97.why: All seven rows stay as one card. 'God, if you are ...' is the same words and structure in all seven, and the ending is the trap: truthful (the challenge, 2:23, 10:38, 11:13), believers (5:57, 5:112), worshipping Him alone (16:114), believing in God and the Last Day (24:2). Same phrase, different subjects. The rows that read on stay as they are.

tree:0lvyces0kquce8.why: God, Lord of the worlds: I fear God, said by Adam's son (5:28) and by Satan (59:16); blessed is God (7:54, 40:64); Moses' call (27:8, 28:30). Pairs worth comparing.
tree:0lvyces0kquce8.relation: Contrast: the same words of fear said truly by Adam's righteous son and falsely by Satan.

tree:0e4ur3l0wair4t.why: God is swift in account is a stock closing after unrelated passages (pilgrims, the People of the Book, hunting, the deniers' deeds). The changed particle alone does not make a card.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing. The 14:51 with 40:17 pair is kept elsewhere.

tree:0asymji11rmgqu.why: The real pair here (2:27, 13:25, breaking God's covenant after its pledge) is already in card tree:1mg4uq20ncb2mm. The rest share only of God, after.

check.why: Drop is right: I checked that 2:27 with 13:25 is kept in tree:1mg4uq20ncb2mm and in other cards. The rest is glue.

tree:0wfoqjr0snd0j3.why: And God is All-Encompassing, Knowing, mostly after His bounty given to whom He wills: kingship to Talut, multiplied reward, forgiveness and bounty, a people He loves, wealth for the poor who marry. The name fits the giving.
tree:0wfoqjr0snd0j3.relation: God's vast bounty, given by knowledge to whom He wills.

check.why:
I would drop it. 'And God is All-Encompassing, Knowing' is a generic closing formula, and the brief says those lean drop. The link to giving is the agent's reading over unrelated rulings, not a shared clause.
والله واسع عليم

tree:0jz50611fmbydj.why: God is with the patient (2:153, 8:46), the God-fearing (2:194, 9:36, 9:123), the believers (8:19), and those who fear and do good (16:128). Which is which is the trap.
tree:0jz50611fmbydj.relation: God's closeness to the patient, the pious and the doers of good.

tree:0pb49xq0hok1zi.why: You are nothing but...: the messengers tell the deniers you only guess, only invent (6:148, 11:50), and the deniers tell the messengers and believers you are only human, only falsifiers, only liars, only in error (14:10, 30:58, 36:15, 36:47, 67:9).
tree:0pb49xq0hok1zi.relation: Contrast: the same words of dismissal used by the prophets and by their opponents.

tree:0egip9o1uu5kiq.why: Indeed He is the Hearing, the Knowing or the Seeing. 40:56 and 41:36 both say seek refuge in God and end differently (Seeing, Knowing), a well-known trap.
tree:0egip9o1uu5kiq.relation: Seeking refuge and relying on God, who hears and knows.

tree:1i324m718hm6wx.why: All seven rows stay. 'Those are the wrongdoers' is the same closing in all seven. 9:23 and 60:9 are the close pair (whoever takes them as allies); the others close rulings on God's limits, lying about God, judging by revelation, refusing judgment, and not repenting. Same words and structure, different subjects. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1i324m718hm6wx.relation: Who is called wrongdoer: the one who crosses God's limits, lies about Him, does not judge by revelation, or takes the enemy as ally.

tree:0nvns0n1rdnns3.why: God is not unaware of what you do is a stock closing after unrelated passages (hard hearts, killing your own, hiding testimony, the qibla, blocking God's way). The God or your Lord change alone does not make a useful card.

tree:16i6ztb1ie3yhf.why: Exalted is He above what they associate, with Glory be to Him, so, or nothing before it, in seven places. The lead-in forms are the trap.
tree:16i6ztb1ie3yhf.relation: God declared above every partner people give Him.

tree:1w6ppif0f74ep7.why: These are the verses of the Book: wise, clear, and a clear Quran, opening seven surahs. Which adjective goes with which surah is a classic memorizer question.
tree:1w6ppif0f74ep7.relation: The Book described by its wisdom and clarity at the start of surahs.

tree:1qm78ft1iisnkb.why: Hell, abiding in it: forever, it is enough for them, and the arrogant's evil abode (16:29, 39:72, 40:76 with so or then indeed). Classic traps.
tree:1qm78ft1iisnkb.relation: The eternal abode of the arrogant and the deniers.

tree:18j2qo80zw2avu.why: That is because God...: 22:62 and 31:30 are almost identical (one pronoun differs); 22:6 shares God is the Truth; the others vary. A classic set.
tree:18j2qo80zw2avu.relation: God is the Truth and what they call besides Him is falsehood.

tree:1edgac50a6z8kz.why: That is the great triumph, with and without and, and once the clear triumph (45:30). Useful for memorizers who must place each form.
tree:1edgac50a6z8kz.relation: Triumph named for paradise, God's pleasure and the bargain of the soul.

tree:1uhwgju16c6lss.why: That is God your Lord, followed by no god but He, so worship Him, the Truth, His is the dominion, Creator of all, blessed is God. Seven continuations.
tree:1uhwgju16c6lss.relation: God named as Lord after each of His acts, and worship demanded.

tree:0xowxoj0gczjlx.why: That is better for you, followed by if you are believers, if you know, that you may remember, or with your Creator. Seven commands and their endings.
tree:0xowxoj0gczjlx.relation: What God commands is better for people, if they knew.

check.why: Keep is right: 'that is better for you' followed by different endings (if you know, that you may remember, with your Creator, if you are believers) is a real memorizer trap.

tree:0anc7xr0igmxer.why: God sets forth a parable: the good word, the slave and the free, the dumb man, the town, the man with partners, the wives of Noah and Lot, Pharaoh's wife. Paired parables for comparison.
tree:0anc7xr0igmxer.relation: Contrast: paired parables of believers and deniers, especially the women in 66:10 and 66:11.

tree:11nwf9c1jytkm2.why: All seven rows stay as one card. 'Upon whom He wills' follows a different act of God each time: sending down His bounty or the Spirit (2:90, 16:2, 40:15), conferring favour (14:11), turning in mercy (9:15, 9:27), giving His messengers power (59:6). Same words and structure. The memorizer's point is which verb leads in, and that only the revelation ayat add 'of His servants'.
tree:11nwf9c1jytkm2.relation: God's choice: whom He sends revelation to, whom He forgives, whom He gives victory.

tree:189ehka057s70w.why: In six days, then He rose over the Throne (five times), and His Throne was on water (11:7), and no fatigue touched Us (50:38). Classic set.
tree:189ehka057s70w.relation: Creation in six days, without fatigue, and the Lord's rule over it.

tree:0bmw6ea01ukft6.why: And God is ever Knowing, Wise is a stock closing after unrelated subjects (repentance, accidental killing, fighting, sin, the Messenger). The one-word change in 33:51 is not enough for a card.

tree:117wlxe0jl0gqa.why: He says to it Be and it is, after seven different lead-ins (when He decrees, when We will, His command when He wills). A classic set.
tree:117wlxe0jl0gqa.relation: God's creative command, shown in the births of Adam and Jesus and the raising of the dead.

check.why: Keep is right: 'He says to it Be, and it is' after different lead-ins is a classic memorizer set.

tree:1hb0n5b1024641.why: If you could see when..., seven judgment and death scenes: before the fire, before their Lord, at death, heads hung low, arguing, in terror. Strong pondering set.
tree:1hb0n5b1024641.relation: Scenes of the deniers' regret, shown to the reader before they happen.

tree:05xxlc70f9ypaz.why: Were it not for God's favour and mercy upon you, with seven different consequences; 24:10 and 24:20 differ only in the closing names. Classic set.
tree:05xxlc70f9ypaz.relation: God's favour as what keeps people from loss, error and punishment.

tree:1y0nvg81gyp0aw.why: We did not send before you except...: men (12:109, 16:43), a messenger to be obeyed, in his people's tongue, with the oneness, and Satan's insertion. Classic memorizer set.
tree:1y0nvg81gyp0aw.relation: What every messenger had in common.

tree:0yf533h1cx80rx.why: The enjoyment of this worldly life, in seven settings; 28:60 and 42:36 share their opening. Each time set against what is with God.
tree:0yf533h1cx80rx.relation: Contrast: worldly enjoyment and the lasting hereafter.

tree:0z6ne7316bgmdp.why: Sincere to Him in religion: the call to pray sincerely, and the sailors who pray sincerely in danger and then turn back (10:22, 29:65, 31:32). Strong pondering set.
tree:0z6ne7316bgmdp.relation: Contrast: sincere prayer in danger, forgotten once safe.

tree:0rex7111hhlmoh.why: I ask you no reward, my reward is only from the Lord of the worlds: the refrain of five prophets in Ash-Shu'ara, Noah's form in 10:72, and the Prophet's in 12:104.
tree:0rex7111hhlmoh.relation: Every prophet asked nothing of his people.

tree:01lrls40rnfbg8.why: From where they do not perceive, know or expect: punishment comes unseen (16:26, 16:45, 39:25), the deniers are led on gradually (7:182, 68:44 identical), Satan sees you unseen, and provision comes unexpected (65:3).
tree:01lrls40rnfbg8.relation: Contrast: unseen punishment for deniers and unexpected provision for those who rely on God.

tree:19tdk6a1fup1l6.why: From the Lord of the worlds: a messenger (Noah, Hud, Moses), the Book without doubt (10:37, 32:2), and a revelation (56:80, 69:43 identical). Pairs worth comparing.
tree:19tdk6a1fup1l6.relation: The messengers and the Quran both from the Lord of the worlds.

tree:0mw7ozb0vpnbaf.why: And whoever does that, followed by its consequence: disgrace, wronging himself, nothing to do with God, fire, great reward, meeting sin, loss. The memorizer must tie each to its ruling.
tree:0mw7ozb0vpnbaf.relation: Each act named with the outcome it brings.

tree:1k2od5t16wmcmz.why: This is nothing but magic: clear magic (5:110, 6:7, 11:7, 37:15), invented magic (28:36), magic handed down (74:24). Said of Jesus' miracles, the Book, resurrection and Moses' signs.
tree:1k2od5t16wmcmz.relation: Every clear sign was dismissed with the same word.

tree:04mef5704t38rr.why: Are they waiting for anything but: God and the angels, the angels or your Lord (6:158, 16:33), its fulfilment, the way of the ancients, the Hour suddenly (43:66, 47:18). Classic memorizer set.
tree:04mef5704t38rr.relation: The deniers wait for what will come too late to help them.

tree:1ap49zk0uq86qe.why: What they call on besides Him: 22:62 and 31:30 differ by one pronoun, and five other places describe these false gods: females, no answer, no judging, no intercession.
tree:1ap49zk0uq86qe.relation: Everything worshipped besides God is falsehood.

tree:1yldvfp1hz61a7.why: And they say, when is this promise, if you are truthful: six times the same, once with the victory (32:28). Each answer that follows differs.
tree:1yldvfp1hz61a7.relation: The deniers' mocking question about the Day, answered six ways.

tree:1mgc5k117lj2z3.why: When Our verses are recited to them: the deniers call them old tales, ask for another Quran, boast, rage, call it magic; the prophets fall prostrate weeping (19:58).
tree:1mgc5k117lj2z3.relation: Contrast: the prophets' tears and the deniers' scorn at the same recitation.

tree:0refkly00si8j6.why: We sent before you: only men (12:109, 16:43), no messenger except (21:25, 22:52), among the sects, messengers to their people, a warner to a town, ask those We sent. Classic memorizer set.
tree:0refkly00si8j6.relation: The Prophet placed in the line of earlier messengers.

tree:1knl86l1j529gt.why: Except that God or my Lord wills: Abraham and Shu'ayb (6:80, 7:89 both followed by my Lord encompasses all in knowledge), Joseph, the Prophet, and you do not will unless God wills (76:30, 81:29).
tree:1knl86l1j529gt.relation: Every human intention under God's will.

tree:13980q10bkbmdx.why: Except by God's permission: no messenger brings a sign (13:38, 40:78), no proof from us (14:11) and no harm from whispering (58:10) both ending with let the believers rely, no soul dies or believes (3:145, 10:100), no calamity (64:11).
tree:13980q10bkbmdx.relation: Death, faith, signs and harm all happen only by God's leave.

tree:1cspopa0to71de.why: He gives life to the earth after its death, eight times with eight endings, several drawing the lesson of resurrection. A classic set.
tree:1cspopa0to71de.relation: The revived earth as a sign of the resurrection.

tree:1b2sfdn1id8sa3.why: Those to whom We gave the Book: they recite it, recognize it as their sons (2:146, 6:20), know it is true, rejoice, believe in it. Eight continuations.
tree:1b2sfdn1id8sa3.relation: How the People of the Book received the Quran: some believed, some hid the truth.

tree:0ev53481ipxzyu.why: O you who believe, fear God, and then eight different commands. A memorizer set on what follows piety.
tree:0ev53481ipxzyu.relation: Piety joined to concrete acts: leaving usury, truthfulness, right speech, looking to tomorrow.

tree:13tx0rb0syw4xd.why: And those who believed with him: rescued with Hud, Salih and Shu'ayb (11:58, 11:66, 11:94, near identical), with the Messenger in hardship and striving, with Talut, and Pharaoh's order to kill their sons.
tree:13tx0rb0syw4xd.relation: The believers who stood with each prophet, tested and saved.

tree:0dmkx2o0x3zksk.why: Those given knowledge: their words on the Day, their prostration, their certainty, their warning to Qarun's admirers, their rank. Eight scenes.
tree:0dmkx2o0x3zksk.relation: What true knowledge produces: humility, faith and clear sight.

tree:0c5exao1n61gr6.why: All eight rows stay. Those who disbelieve and deny: seven times 'Our signs' with endings that differ by one word (the Fire, Hellfire, a humiliating punishment, brought to punishment), a classic memorizer set. 23:33 has the same words with 'the meeting of the Hereafter' in a description of a people's chiefs. Same words and structure, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0c5exao1n61gr6.relation: The fate of those who reject God's signs, and of a people who denied the meeting with Him.

tree:1vf1ko103b8w5f.why: God is Aware of what you do is a stock closing here after unrelated passages (Uhud, justice, jihad, lowering the gaze, oaths, charity). The particle and verb change alone do not make a card.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing after unrelated passages.

tree:0ceht4s0l0ea8c.why: What was sent down to you from your Lord: increases many in transgression (5:64, 5:68, same words), convey it, follow it (6:106, 33:2), it is the truth (13:1, 13:19, 34:6).
