tree:0ceht4s0l0ea8c.relation: One revelation that guides some and hardens others.

tree:18ak04s0mgcbf0.why: As for those who believe: they know it is the truth, He pays them their reward (3:57, 4:173), enters them into mercy, faith increases, they are in a garden. Each often followed by as for those who disbelieve.
tree:18ak04s0mgcbf0.relation: Contrast: the believers' response and reward, set against the deniers.

tree:0mwp2w403ygvoa.why: All eight rows stay. 'If he is of ...' is the same condition in the same words in all eight. It holds three clear groups (the cursing oaths 24:7 and 24:9; 'have you considered if it is from God' 41:52 and 46:10; the three ends in 56:88, 56:90, 56:92) and the killing ruling 4:92, which has the same words with another subject. A split into the three groups would leave 4:92 alone, so the card is judged whole; a split is possible.
tree:0mwp2w403ygvoa.relation: If he is truthful or lying, if it is from God, if he is of those brought near: the condition decides the end.

tree:0fom4fh1gbfz9b.why: I fear for you the punishment of a day: great, big, painful, all-encompassing, the day of the parties, the day of calling. Said by Noah, Hud, Shu'ayb and the believer of Pharaoh's family.
tree:0fom4fh1gbfz9b.relation: The prophets' concern for their people, each naming the day differently.

tree:0lowbyc11krdlq.why: Those, for them is a punishment closes eight unrelated passages; the adjectives change but the subjects are different. The good pair (31:6, 45:9) already has its own card.

tree:1hiwr340qye1eq.why: Those are the losers is a stock closing after eight unrelated deeds (breaking covenants, misguidance, distraction by wealth). The prefix changes alone do not make a card.

tree:09h2k6x0ip96k7.why: But most of them do not know, believe or reason: after praise be to God in three parables and questions (16:75, 31:25, 39:29) and do not reason in 29:63. A known trap.
tree:09h2k6x0ip96k7.relation: Most people do not draw the conclusion the signs point to.

tree:0ty3mio0b5cg7q.why: By what God revealed: the Ma'ida trio (5:44, 5:45, 5:47), judge by it and do not follow their desires (5:48, 5:49), the Israelites' refusal (2:90, 2:91), and I believe in it (42:15).
tree:0ty3mio0b5cg7q.relation: Ruling by and believing in all God revealed.

tree:113x7p0013a7y0.why: For what they used to earn is a stock closing after eight unrelated scenes. The useful pair (9:82, 9:95) is already in card tree:02idchl1ndac8z.

tree:0h4aqe11gp9zd3.why: Punishment of a great day: I fear, if I disobey my Lord (6:15, 10:15, 39:13, said by the Prophet), and I fear for you (Noah, Hud, Salih), and it seized them (26:189).
tree:0h4aqe11gp9zd3.relation: Contrast: the Prophet fears for himself if he disobeys; the prophets fear for their people.

tree:0x7jhna14wjmbi.why: And upon God let the believers rely, closing seven ayat, with the one change in 14:12 (let those who rely, rely). Each follows a different trial.
tree:0x7jhna14wjmbi.relation: Reliance on God after defeat, danger, whispering and the deniers' threats.

tree:0v07rcp03t7kuj.why: I ask you no reward for it: the refrain of five prophets in Ash-Shu'ara, and the Prophet's own forms with different endings (12:104, 25:57, 38:86).
tree:0v07rcp03t7kuj.relation: No messenger asked a wage; the Prophet adds only that people take a way to their Lord.

tree:1udvupt0g5leoh.why: He said, my Lord, indeed I...: Moses four times (fear, wronged myself, in need, killed a man), Noah twice, Zakariya. Each prayer opens the same way.
tree:1udvupt0g5leoh.relation: Prophets' confessions of weakness and need before their Lord.

tree:05lyn9a11f9cic.why: Say, have you considered if...: pairs inside (28:71 and 28:72 night and day, 41:52 and 46:10, 67:28 and 67:30). Strong memorizer and pondering set.
tree:05lyn9a11f9cic.relation: Thought experiments that leave only God as the answer.

tree:0r994d408pbako.why: Have they not travelled and seen the end of those before them, then different follow-ups: stronger, more numerous, destroyed. Classic memorizer set.
tree:0r994d408pbako.relation: The ruins of stronger nations as a warning.

tree:10qhexl0ocjqwj.why: Every soul paid what it earned (2:281, 3:161 identical endings, 3:25), what it did, what it sent ahead. The verb is the trap.
tree:10qhexl0ocjqwj.relation: Full and just repayment for every soul.

check.why: Keep is right: every soul is paid what it earned or did, with the verb changing (paid, finds, tests, recompense), a memorizer trap.

tree:1kl42ap0vaxrr3.why: Do not be among: the doubters (2:147, 6:114, 10:94), the polytheists (6:14, 10:105, 28:87), the ignorant (6:35). With so or and before it.
tree:1kl42ap0vaxrr3.relation: Warnings to the Prophet, meant for his community.

tree:0otjrjn044vjhf.why: To God, Lord of the worlds: in the Fatiha, after the destruction of wrongdoers, my prayer and sacrifice, the last call of the people of paradise, the Queen of Sheba's submission, the angels at the Throne.
tree:0otjrjn044vjhf.relation: Praise to the Lord of the worlds as the first and last word.

tree:0kfyn3w0nhxcy0.why: If only they knew, closing seven ayat on what the deniers miss: the hereafter is greater, the spider's house is weakest, the real life is the hereafter. 34:14 uses the words in another structure (if they had known the unseen) and could be removed.
tree:0kfyn3w0nhxcy0.relation: What people would choose if they truly knew.

check.why: Keep is right: 'if only they knew' closes a memorizer set. As the agent notes, 34:14 ('if they had known the unseen') is a different structure and should be removed; the agent noted it but proposed no change.

tree:1hd9s1v1bn8387.why: God would not...: wrong them, but they wronged themselves (9:70, 29:40, 30:9 identical endings), waste your faith, punish while you are among them, mislead after guidance. Classic set.
tree:1hd9s1v1bn8387.relation: God's justice: destruction came only from their own wrongdoing.

tree:06z6e680sikaj6.why: And what they used to invent has left them, eight times with different openings. A classic memorizer set.
tree:06z6e680sikaj6.relation: False gods and claims vanish when they are most needed.

tree:1fs22ao1wjl3x2.why: You are repaid only for what you used to do: with will you be, taste, and only, in eight places. The particles are the trap.
tree:1fs22ao1wjl3x2.relation: The hereafter as the exact return of deeds.

tree:1n686vc0wj1wxw.why: Confirming what came before it: the Quran, the Torah and Gospel, Jesus (3:50, 61:6 with before me), the jinn's words. A classic set.
tree:1n686vc0wj1wxw.relation: Each revelation confirms the one before.

tree:192wx4l0dby2in.why: Then He will inform you of what you used to do or differ in, after to God is your return, in eight places. The ending is the trap.
tree:192wx4l0dby2in.relation: Every deed and dispute will be told back on the Day.

tree:0rpk5621ckag8i.why: Nothing but that they said: the answer of Lot's people (7:82, 27:56), Abraham's people, the prayer of the faithful, the deniers' excuse. A strong memorizer set.
tree:0rpk5621ckag8i.relation: Contrast: the believers' prayer and the deniers' answer, framed the same way.

tree:1m9sjyt096dzlr.why: Those in whose hearts is disease (and deviation in 3:7), with nine scenes; 8:49 and 33:12 share the hypocrites and the diseased speaking.
tree:1m9sjyt096dzlr.relation: The diseased heart's behaviour shown across many situations.

tree:0sbjf1t151az8p.why: God knows best what...: she delivered, they conceal (3:167, 5:61), you describe, He sends down, they kept. A good memorizer set.
tree:0sbjf1t151az8p.relation: God's knowledge of what people hide or claim.

tree:1gwzxz60o3wfv8.why: All nine rows stay as one card. 'God ... those who believe' is the same structure in all nine, with God's act on the believers changing: He promised them (5:9, 24:55, 48:29), makes them known and purifies them (3:140, 3:141, 29:11), guides them (2:213), makes them firm (14:27), raises them (58:11). Same words, different verbs; the verb is the memorizer's point and the card shows what God does for the believers.
tree:1gwzxz60o3wfv8.relation: All that God does for the believers: guides, tests, purifies, makes firm, raises, and promises.

tree:1ahoe400q1c0xs.why: Nothing avails against God, and nothing is hidden from Him: Jacob's two sayings (12:67, 12:68), Abraham to his father (60:4), the false gods (11:101), the followers in Hell (14:21), nothing hidden from God (14:38), God sent down nothing, the deniers say (67:9). All have a negation with 'anything'. In 7:185 and 16:48 'what' is a relative ('what God created of things'), a different word.
tree:1ahoe400q1c0xs.changes: Removed only 7:185 and 16:48: their 'what' is a relative. 14:38 and 67:9 stay: same negation and structure, a different subject.
tree:1ahoe400q1c0xs.relation: No power avails against God, and nothing escapes His knowledge.

tree:0pxailt12et8tz.why: All nine rows stay. 'God is severe in penalty' is the same closing in all nine, and the memorizer's trap is in the small words around it: 'know that', 'indeed', 'then indeed', and 'punishment' instead of 'penalty' (2:165). 8:13 and 59:4 are the closest pair (whoever opposes God and His Messenger). Same words and structure, different subjects. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0pxailt12et8tz.relation: God's severity named after warnings: on opposing Him, on changing His favour, on transgression.

tree:02m9hmj1lmgla1.why: That God is Mighty, Wise is a stock closing here after nine unrelated subjects; the variants (owner of retribution, forgiving) do not make a card on their own.

tree:0toeewz1w6n60p.why: Indeed your Lord, He...: knows best who strays (6:117, 16:125, 53:30, 68:7), the transgressors, is the Strong, will gather them, is the Creator, will judge. A memorizer set.
tree:0toeewz1w6n60p.relation: God's knowledge and judgment of who is guided and who strays.

tree:08q27l51z0ekov.why: Two senses of 'some of them over / to others'. Over: favouring some over others (2:253, 4:34, 17:21), gods rising over one another (23:91), partners wronging one another (38:24). To: turning to one another, asking (37:27, 37:50, 52:25) or blaming (68:30). The preposition has a different sense, so the split follows it and no row is lost.
tree:08q27l51z0ekov.changes: Split by the two senses: 'over' (2:253, 4:34, 17:21, 23:91, 38:24) and 'turning to' (37:27, 37:50, 52:25, 68:30). 23:91 and 38:24 stay, in the 'over' group. The rows that read on are kept as they are.
tree:08q27l51z0ekov.relation: Rank between people is God's gift; on the Day, people turn to one another to ask or to blame.

tree:03e7va602m534s.why: They tell lies about God: knowingly (3:75, 3:78 same ending), will not succeed (10:69, 16:116), who is more wrong (61:7), and others. A memorizer set.
tree:03e7va602m534s.relation: Lying about God, the gravest lie, and its end.

tree:0mc12081p2qguk.why: Two different words: 'what is in the earth, all of it' and 'whoever is in the earth, all of them'. What is on earth: created and subjected for you (2:29, 45:13), offered as ransom (5:36, 13:18, 39:47), spent without uniting hearts (8:63). Whoever is on earth: if God destroyed the Messiah and all on earth (5:17), if you and all on earth disbelieve (14:8), all on earth to save the criminal (70:14). The split follows the word, so no row is lost.
tree:0mc12081p2qguk.relation: All the earth's wealth cannot ransom a soul or unite hearts; all its people cannot harm God.

tree:0z3go0910g0kvd.why: Three groups share 'in it of every': the ark, carry in it of every kind two (11:40, 23:27); the earth, We caused to grow / spread in it of every (15:19, 26:7, 31:10, 50:7); gardens with all fruits (2:266, 47:15). 2:164 'He spread in it every creature' is the same words as 31:10, so it belongs in the earth group.
tree:0z3go0910g0kvd.changes: Split into the ark (11:40, 23:27), the earth (2:164, 15:19, 26:7, 31:10, 50:7) and gardens (2:266, 47:15). 2:164 stays, in the earth group beside its twin 31:10.
tree:0z3go0910g0kvd.relation: The ark, the earth and the gardens, each holding 'of every kind'.

tree:15bfylp1rho1hn.why: 'Have passed away before' is said of three things: messengers before Muhammad and before the Messiah (3:144, 5:75), past ways and examples (3:137, 13:6, 48:23), and nations before (7:38, 13:30, 41:25, 46:18). Three different subjects, so three cards, and no row is lost.
tree:15bfylp1rho1hn.changes: Split into messengers (3:144, 5:75), precedents (3:137, 13:6, 48:23), and nations (7:38, 13:30, 41:25, 46:18). The nations stay as their own card. The rows that read on (41:26, 46:19) are kept.
tree:15bfylp1rho1hn.relation: Messengers die, God's ways remain, nations pass and are judged.

tree:1nd7kfz1tku1lr.why: Thus do We reward the doers of good: the closing of the prophets in as-Saffat (37:80 to 37:131), with 'inna' and without, and Joseph and Moses at maturity (12:22, 28:14). The opening particle is the trap.
tree:1nd7kfz1tku1lr.relation: Reward of ihsan for the prophets.

tree:031rre102zsjrj.why: Thus God makes clear His signs to you, with a different closing in each place (that you may be guided, reflect, understand, be grateful). A memorizer set.
tree:031rre102zsjrj.relation: God makes His law clear so people may reflect and obey.

tree:0rx3dnf1neh0p1.why: 'No blame on you' in the laws of widows and marriage (2:234, 2:235, 2:236, 2:240, 4:23, 4:24, 60:10) and shortened prayer in fear (4:102). 2:234 and 2:240 is a strong pair. The continuation (fima, in, an) is the trap.
tree:0rx3dnf1neh0p1.relation: Allowances within the laws of family and worship.

tree:1p0b9ho0pwlzs6.why: Wealth and children will avail nothing against God (3:10, 3:116, 58:17), they will not avail you anything (45:19, 66:10), who owns anything against God (5:17, 5:41, 46:8, 48:11). One theme with variant wording.
tree:1p0b9ho0pwlzs6.relation: Nothing protects from God: not wealth, children, allies or kin.

tree:0a4thdj0xs6hmt.why: Two structures share 'from God, of'. 'They have from God no ...' (protector, defender, guardian): 2:120, 10:27, 13:34, 13:37, 40:21, 40:33. 'Avail / own against God nothing', with another governing verb: 12:67, 12:68, 60:4. The split follows the structure, so 2:120 stays beside its twin 13:37 and the three 'nothing' ayat keep their own card.
tree:0a4thdj0xs6hmt.changes: Split by structure: 'no protector from God' (2:120, 10:27, 13:34, 13:37, 40:21, 40:33) and 'avail nothing against God' (12:67, 12:68, 60:4). The rows that read on are kept.
tree:0a4thdj0xs6hmt.relation: No protector from God, and no one can avail anything against Him: not Jacob, not Abraham.

tree:1qgw0ue099wcwo.why: 'Whoever is on the earth' in five unrelated settings: destroying the Messiah and all on earth (5:17), obeying most on earth (6:116), all would believe (10:99), you and all on earth disbelieve (14:8), ransom (70:14). Only a stock phrase is shared.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock phrase in five unrelated settings.

tree:0xjjctz1kgfz6v.why: Whom God sends astray: no way for him (4:88, 4:143, 42:46), no guide (7:186, 13:33, 39:23, 39:36, 40:33), no protector after Him (42:44). The ending is the trap.
tree:0xjjctz1kgfz6v.relation: Guidance and straying are in God's hand.

tree:1wcivls10v7sg0.why: We gave Moses the Scripture, continued ten ways; 11:110 and 41:45 are identical. A real mutashabih set.
tree:1wcivls10v7sg0.relation: The Torah given to Moses and how his people received it.

tree:1a9u4ha03d8u46.why: So fear God and obey me: the refrain of the messengers in ash-Shu'ara (26:108 to 26:179), and Jesus (3:50, 43:63). Identical wording; the next ayah is the trap. The rows run on into the next ayah, so 26:108 and 26:110 repeat each other.
tree:1a9u4ha03d8u46.relation: Every messenger calls to taqwa and obedience.

tree:0ca1ev50ds6qd7.why: Praise be to God who...: the openings of al-An'am, al-Kahf, Saba and the praise of the people of Paradise (7:43, 35:34, 39:74), Noah (23:28), Abraham (14:39), David and Solomon (27:15). The continuation is the trap.
tree:0ca1ev50ds6qd7.relation: Praise for creation, revelation and salvation.

tree:1b3zyed0m9vmst.why: Stock closing 'God is severe in penalty' over unrelated subjects (hajj, Israel, Pharaoh, hunting, the Prophet's spoils). The true pair 8:13 and 59:4 is already its own card from 0pxailt12et8tz.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing over unrelated subjects. The true pair, 8:13 with 59:4, has its own card.

tree:09pwk8n10fhjd5.why: Stock closing 'God is Forgiving, Merciful' over unrelated subjects (hijra, wronging oneself, repentance, names of adopted sons, wives of the Prophet, the hijab, the trust). Only the closing is shared.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing over unrelated subjects.

tree:1bm6jwr1b7rt97.why: 'What God gave them of His bounty': the misers (3:180, 4:37), the envied (4:54), the martyrs rejoice (3:170), the hypocrites' wish (9:59), and God will enrich them of His bounty (9:28, 24:32, 24:33). 2:90 and 4:32 fit the bounty theme. Many real pairs.
tree:1bm6jwr1b7rt97.relation: God's bounty: rejoiced in, envied, withheld, hoped for.

tree:15e21gr0a0ejnp.why: Stock closing 'God is Hearing, Knowing/Seeing' over unrelated subjects (wills, divorce, fighting, Badr, the Day, the Prophet's presence, the woman who pleaded). Only the closing is shared.

tree:1xussq51jdpzcr.why: 'If you only knew' closes ten ayat: 'that is better for you' (2:184, 2:280, 9:41, 16:95, 29:16, 61:11, 62:9) is a memorizer set, and 23:84 and 23:88 are a close pair. 6:81 is the odd one.
tree:1xussq51jdpzcr.relation: What God commands is better, if you only knew.

check.why: Keep is right: 'that is better for you, if you only knew' is a real memorizer set, and 23:84 with 23:88 is a close pair. 6:81 is the odd one and could be removed.

tree:0gf36w41k78b44.why: All ten rows stay. 'For what they used to do' is a frequent closing, and here the same relative and words in every row. It holds two strong groups: limbs that testify (24:24, 41:20) and reward 'for what they used to do' (32:17, 32:19, 46:14, 56:24). 6:108, 6:127, 12:69 and 26:112 have the same words with other subjects. Cutting to the groups would remove rows for their subject only. The card is judged whole: worth keeping for the two groups, though the shared closing is common.
tree:0gf36w41k78b44.relation: Deeds come back: the limbs testify to them, and the Garden is their reward.

tree:10hx37t1uf9bkb.why: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, with a different closing each time (the Wise, the Aware; He will inform you of what you did, 9:94, 9:105, 62:8). A real mutashabih set.
tree:10hx37t1uf9bkb.relation: God's complete knowledge and the reckoning that follows.

tree:0uic8f405z5x3g.why: Two structures. 'In the earth nor in the heaven' (two places joined): nothing hidden (3:5, 14:38), not an atom's weight (10:61, 34:3, order reversed), you cannot escape (29:22), no misfortune on earth or in yourselves (57:22). And corruption on earth: those who corrupt and do not reform (26:152, 27:48, identical) against those who want no exaltation or corruption on earth (28:83). In 6:38 'nor' joins 'creature' and 'bird', a different structure.
tree:0uic8f405z5x3g.changes: Split: heaven and earth (3:5, 10:61, 14:38, 29:22, 34:3, 57:22) and corruption on earth (26:152, 27:48, 28:83). 29:22, 57:22, 26:152, 27:48 and 28:83 stay. Removed only 6:38: its 'nor' joins two creatures. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:0uic8f405z5x3g.relation: Nothing in heaven or earth escapes God; corruption on earth is the opposite of the people of the Hereafter.

tree:18k9y1o1bhscsc.why: Near-duplicate of tree:1m9sjyt096dzlr, which already holds 7 of these 10 ayat on those with sickness in their hearts.

tree:1fsq4ce0smameg.why: 'No doubt in it': of the Book (2:2, 10:37, 32:2) and of the Day (3:9, 3:25, 4:87, 6:12, 42:7, 45:26), with 17:99 the appointed term. What follows is the trap.
tree:1fsq4ce0smameg.relation: Certainty of the Book and of the Day of Gathering.

tree:18dtky70hbd725.why: Near-duplicate of tree:1wcivls10v7sg0, which holds 7 of these 10 ayat (We gave Moses the Scripture). Only 17:101, 21:48 and 40:53 are new.

tree:0873pph1xdmcnl.why: 'You have no god other than Him': the call of Noah, Hud, Salih and Shu'ayb (7:59 to 7:85, 11:50 to 11:84, 23:23, 23:32), with what follows as the trap. Pharaoh's 'I know of no god for you other than me' (28:38) is kept as the contrast.
tree:0873pph1xdmcnl.relation: Contrast: every messenger calls to God alone; Pharaoh claims godhood.

tree:0w847rn10obxh1.why: 'No protector and no helper' in one structure (a negation, 'of a protector', then 'nor' and a second noun), with variations a memorizer must keep apart: besides God (2:107, 9:116, 29:22, 42:31), from God (2:120, 13:37 with 'guardian'), besides Him (32:4 with 'intercessor'), on earth (9:74), the wrongdoers have (42:8). In 18:26 'nor' starts a verb ('nor does He share His rule'), a different structure.
tree:0w847rn10obxh1.changes: Removed only 18:26: its 'nor' starts a verb. 9:74, 32:4 and 42:8 stay: same structure, other subjects. Kept as one card, not split. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:0w847rn10obxh1.relation: Who has no protector: those who leave God, follow desires, or wrong.

tree:0icv3so1ljgtwa.why: 'Suddenly while they do not perceive' of the Hour or punishment (7:95, 12:107, 26:202, 29:53, 43:66), and 'while they do not perceive' in the stories of Joseph, Moses, the ant and Salih's plotters. The lead-in is the trap.
tree:0icv3so1ljgtwa.relation: What comes upon people unawares: the Hour, punishment, and God's hidden plan.

tree:1o7pd4y0sjf9f6.why: Near-duplicate of tree:031rre102zsjrj, which holds 7 of these 9 ayat (thus God makes clear His signs to you). Only 4:176 and 24:18 are new.

tree:1mhqd8p0k6u6g9.why: He guides whom He wills: to a straight path (2:142, 2:213, 10:25, 24:46), He sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills (14:4, 16:93, 35:8, 74:31), but God guides whom He wills (2:272, 28:56). Three clear variant groups.

tree:1i70ls21464l4q.why: He who made for you: the earth a cradle (20:53, 43:10), the night to rest in (10:67, 40:61), the earth a bed or a resting place and the sky a canopy (2:22, 40:64), and the stars, cattle, fire. Several close pairs.
tree:1i70ls21464l4q.relation: God's provisions in creation as signs.

tree:1xvos1e1va3l60.why: 'Do you not see that God': sent down water from the sky with three continuations (22:63, 35:27, 39:21), all glorify or prostrate to Him (22:18, 24:41), and other signs. A memorizer set.
tree:1xvos1e1va3l60.relation: Signs in creation that all submit to God.

tree:0s9kjh11szworh.why: 'To an appointed term': He delays them (16:61, 35:45 nearly identical), He forgives and delays you (14:10, 71:4), sun and moon run (31:29), and others. Real pairs.
tree:0s9kjh11szworh.relation: Every respite has a set term with God.

tree:1ake5rt17cm2vx.why: All nine rows stay. 'Indeed God is Knowing ...' is the same closing in all nine, and the memorizer's trap is the word after it: of what is in the breasts (3:119, 5:7, 31:23), Wise (9:28), of what they do (10:36), of what you used to do (16:28), Able (16:70), Aware (49:13), of the corrupters (3:63). Same words and structure; cutting to one ending would remove rows for their subject only. The shared closing is common, so the value is mainly for memorizers. The rows that read on stay as they are.

tree:0cop2lz0x3qmlb.why: 'God loves': the doers of good (2:195, 5:13), the god-fearing (3:76, 9:4, 9:7), the just (5:42, 49:9, 60:8), those who rely (3:159), who repent (2:222), who fight in ranks (61:4). The ending is the trap.

tree:0eoqvrt12j6ia9.why: God knows what they conceal and what they declare (2:77, 16:23), what is in the heavens and the earth (5:97, 22:70, 58:7), their secrets (9:78), and others. Real pairs inside one theme.
tree:0eoqvrt12j6ia9.relation: God's knowledge of the hidden and the open.

tree:1o7oeer0yn9gu9.why: The peoples' challenge to their prophets: 'bring us what you threaten us with, if you are of the truthful' (7:70, 11:32, 46:22; 'of the messengers' in 7:77), and 'if you are of the truthful' after other demands (15:7, 26:31, 26:154, 26:187, 29:29). In 12:3 'if' is the lightened 'indeed' with 'surely of the heedless', a different word and structure.
tree:1o7oeer0yn9gu9.changes: Removed 12:3: its particle is not the condition. The rows that read on are kept as they are.
tree:1o7oeer0yn9gu9.relation: Every people challenged its prophet in the same words, and each was answered.

tree:17ehftz0zwv4yv.why: 'It is only a reminder to the worlds' (6:90, 12:104, 38:87, 81:27), 'only a clear warner' (7:184, 34:46), 'only a man' (23:25, 23:38), and others. Several identical or near-identical places.
tree:17ehftz0zwv4yv.relation: What the message and the messenger truly are, against what the deniers say.

check.why: Keep is right: 'it is only' followed by a reminder to the worlds, a clear warner, or a man, holds several identical groups.

tree:146cp4o1bdyvty.why: 'Those are the companions of the Fire, they abide therein' in many places, with 'abiding therein, and wretched is the destination' in 64:10; 3:116 and 58:17 are a close pair. A memorizer set.
tree:146cp4o1bdyvty.relation: The end of disbelief and sin.

tree:0mfzwob0kudzrn.why: 'Those are the successful': 2:5 and 31:5 identical, 7:8 and 23:102 on heavy scales, and wa / fa openings elsewhere. A real mutashabih set.
tree:0mfzwob0kudzrn.relation: The qualities of those who succeed.

tree:12cmlwn19ovjd5.why: All eleven rows stay as one card. 'Abiding therein forever' is said in the same words of the Garden (8 places, mostly after 'rivers flowing beneath') and of Hell (4:169, 33:65, 72:23). Seeing both together is the point: the same eternity for opposite ends. Splitting would hide that contrast, and the phrase is the same in all. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:12cmlwn19ovjd5.relation: Contrast: the same 'forever' for the Garden and for Hell.

tree:1pkyn0302z2vg1.why: 'That is easy for God' (kana ... yasira, inna ... yasir) and 'that is not difficult for God' (14:20, 35:17 identical). The closing form is the trap.
tree:1pkyn0302z2vg1.relation: Nothing is hard for God: punishment, creation, resurrection.

tree:1x0qd6x1mql7bj.why: 'Lord of the heavens and the earth (and what is between them)': 26:24 and 44:7 identical, 19:65, 37:5, 38:66, 78:37 differ in what follows. A real set.

tree:09e7wuy1sglor8.why: Jesus son of Mary: given clear proofs (2:87, 2:253), the Messiah, messenger of God (4:157, 4:171), Jesus said (5:114, 61:6, 61:14). Real pairs.
tree:09e7wuy1sglor8.relation: Who Jesus is in the Quran.

tree:16l0d3b1jy51nb.why: 'In the earth, and what' holds two different words. As a relative: what is in the earth and what is between (20:6), He knows what enters the earth and what comes out (34:2, 57:4). As a negation: you cannot escape in the earth and have no protector (11:20, 42:31), and others where a denial follows 'in the earth' (10:66, 10:78, 12:73, 28:19, 29:39, 34:22). The split follows the word, so no row is lost.
tree:16l0d3b1jy51nb.changes: Split by the word: the relative (20:6, 34:2, 57:4) and the negation (10:66, 10:78, 11:20, 12:73, 28:19, 29:39, 34:22, 42:31). 20:6 and the negation rows stay.
tree:16l0d3b1jy51nb.relation: God knows all that is in the earth; no one escapes Him there.

tree:0t5ins11t4bij3.why: 'Those who do not believe in the Hereafter', with eleven different follow-ons describing them. One theme; the continuation is the trap.
tree:0t5ins11t4bij3.relation: Disbelief in the Hereafter and what it does to a person.

tree:1065d6m0di0b5m.why: 'But most of them do not know' and 'do not give thanks': 10:60 and 27:73 a close pair, 10:55 and 28:13 'God's promise is true'. The ending is the trap.
tree:1065d6m0di0b5m.relation: Most people neither know nor give thanks.

tree:18hay4r0xstpb7.why: 'What they used to mock' engulfs them: 6:10 and 21:41 identical, 6:5 and 26:6, 39:48 and 45:33. 26:199 'they would not have believed in it' is the contrasting ending.

tree:0854ijv0xjehwx.why: 'I know from God what you do not know' (7:62, 12:86, 12:96) and 'you say about God what you do not know' (2:80, 2:169, 7:28, 7:33, 10:68), with creation of what you do not know (16:8, 56:61) and 2:30. Clear groups.
tree:0854ijv0xjehwx.relation: Contrast: true knowledge from God against speaking about God without knowledge.

tree:1j93izn0c6fb9d.why: 'Among the people is he who': says we believe (2:8, 29:10), disputes about God without knowledge (22:3, 22:8, 31:20), and other types. A real mutashabih set.
tree:1j93izn0c6fb9d.relation: Types of people and their stance toward God.

tree:1tao65c056umv0.why: 'And they will not be wronged': every soul paid in full for what it earned (2:281, 3:25, 3:161, 16:111), judged between them in justice (10:47, 10:54, 39:69). The lead-in is the trap.

tree:064se070pyctcj.why: 'Whom He wills of His servants': sends the spirit of His command (16:2, 40:15), extends provision (28:82, 29:62, 34:39), bestows favour (2:90, 10:107, 14:11). Real pairs.
tree:064se070pyctcj.relation: God's free choice in revelation and provision.

tree:17mqpxc1iezpbi.why: 'He knows what is in': the heavens and earth (3:29, 5:97, 22:70, 29:52, 49:16, 58:7, 64:4), land and sea (6:59), the wombs (31:34), yourselves and hearts (2:235, 33:51). The object is the trap.
tree:17mqpxc1iezpbi.relation: Nothing is hidden from God's knowledge.

tree:0ceea5b0nevwcz.why: 'Establish prayer and give zakat', then a different clause in each place; 9:5 and 9:11 are a pair, as are 2:43, 2:110 and 24:56. A real mutashabih set.
tree:0ceea5b0nevwcz.relation: Prayer and zakat as the pair of the believer's duties.

tree:12thl9g1a075i2.why: Stock closing 'God is Mighty, Wise' over unrelated subjects (orphans, divorce, widows, Abraham's birds, theft, Badr, the cave). Only the closing is shared.

tree:1a5oqys008apjq.why: 'To a straight path': He guides whom He wills (2:142, 2:213, 10:25, 24:46), We chose and guided them or him (6:87, 16:121), my Lord guided me (6:161), you invite them (23:73), and others. Real groups.
tree:1a5oqys008apjq.relation: The straight path, and that God alone guides to it.

tree:0ds2nkj1c0tnvj.why: 'Until the Day of Resurrection': He will gather you (4:87, 6:12, 45:26), enmity and hatred (5:14, 5:64), perpetual night or day (28:71, 28:72). Clear pairs.
tree:0ds2nkj1c0tnvj.relation: What lasts until the Day, and the Day that gathers all.

tree:1xc36yu0xoqkne.why: Stock closing 'God sees what you do' over unrelated subjects (prayer, nursing, divorce, spending, Uhud, hijra, David's armour). Only the closing is shared.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing over unrelated subjects.

tree:174llzx0d7pxy5.why: 'Knowing of what is in the breasts' closes twelve ayat with different lead-ins (inna Allah, innahu, wa huwa, wallahu); 3:119, 5:7 and 31:23 share 'inna Allah'. A memorizer set on one meaning. This card covers my proposed change of tree:1ake5rt17cm2vx.
tree:174llzx0d7pxy5.relation: God knows the secrets of hearts.

tree:1m20zve1hu982o.why: 'What they used to invent strayed from them' (6:24, 10:30, 11:21, 16:87, 28:75), 'what they earned availed them nothing' (15:84, 39:50, 40:82), and 26:207, 41:48, 6:88. Clear groups.
tree:1m20zve1hu982o.relation: On the Day their false gods and gains forsake them.

tree:12p8ho80zuvn1w.why: Near-duplicate of tree:1xussq51jdpzcr, which holds 7 of these 12 ayat ('that is better for you, if you only knew').

tree:16f6uia1u1ljbo.why: Near-duplicate of tree:0xjjctz1kgfz6v (whom God sends astray has no guide), which holds 6 of these 11; the rest (22:18, 24:40, 38:54, 52:8, 86:10) share only 'he has no'.

check.why: Drop is right: I checked that the six 'whom God sends astray' rows are kept in tree:0xjjctz1kgfz6v and other cards, and the other five share only 'he has no'.

tree:1u8xah20d33b9i.why: 'They have no helpers' (3:22, 3:56, 3:91, 16:37, 30:29), 'no escape' (41:48, 42:35), 'no defender or protector from God' (10:27, 13:34), and 'no protector' (18:26, 42:8). The ending is the trap.
tree:1u8xah20d33b9i.relation: The wrongdoers stand alone before God.

tree:04n78ll1h2se6j.why: 'After that': 3:89 and 24:5 identical (except those who repent after that), 12:48 and 12:49 adjacent, 5:43 and 24:47 turning away. Real pairs.
tree:04n78ll1h2se6j.relation: What came after: forgiveness, turning away, repentance.

tree:1tids9b0maja3f.why: 'Whoever is in the heavens': prostrates (13:15, 22:18), glorifies (24:41), submits (3:83, 30:26, 21:19), is terrified or struck at the Trumpet (27:87, 39:68). Several pairs.
tree:1tids9b0maja3f.relation: All in the heavens and earth belong to God and submit.

tree:0mdp22i0qubukq.why: 'Woe that Day to the deniers', the refrain of al-Mursalat, with 52:11 (fa-) and 83:10. The ayah after each is the trap.
tree:0mdp22i0qubukq.relation: Woe to those who deny the Day.

tree:0fp7tpc06pt4s8.why: 'Who does more wrong than one who invents a lie against God': 6:21, 7:37 and 10:17 add 'or denies His signs', with different closings; the deniers' 'he has invented a lie' (23:38, 34:8, 42:24). A real set.
tree:0fp7tpc06pt4s8.relation: Lying about God is the greatest wrong.

tree:0mv08eg0lobtm8.why: 'Those who disbelieved, of ...' holds three things. The chiefs who disbelieved of his people, answering Hud, Shu'ayb and Noah (7:66, 7:90, 11:27, 23:24), a classic set. Those who disbelieved of the People of the Book or the Children of Israel (2:105, 5:78, 59:2, 59:11, 98:1, 98:6). And those who disbelieved before (9:30, 64:5), where 'of' means 'before'. In 5:3 'of' belongs to 'despaired of your religion', a different structure.
tree:0mv08eg0lobtm8.changes: Split into the chiefs (7:66, 7:90, 11:27, 23:24), the People of the Book (2:105, 5:78, 59:2, 59:11, 98:1, 98:6), and 'those who disbelieved before' (9:30, 64:5). Removed only 5:3: there the particle belongs to 'despaired of'.
tree:0mv08eg0lobtm8.relation: The same rejection from the chiefs of every people and from the People of the Book.

tree:0obuoeu0r5jpla.why: Stock closing 'God has power over all things' over unrelated subjects (lightning, abrogation, the qibla, the ruined town, Uhud, creation). 22:39 is a different structure.

tree:0dp9jka0s871ck.why: 'In this world and the Hereafter': deeds made worthless (2:217, 3:22, 9:69), punished with no helpers (3:56), cursed (24:23, 33:57), painful punishment (24:19). Others (2:220, 3:45, 12:101) are looser.
tree:0dp9jka0s871ck.relation: Loss and blessing in both worlds.

tree:0qggm7s0mfi2t4.why: 'In clear error': we see you (7:60, 12:30), I see you (6:74), you and your fathers (21:54), the wrongdoers (19:38, 31:11), who is in it (28:85, 67:29). The lead-in is the trap.
tree:0qggm7s0mfi2t4.relation: Who is truly in clear error.

tree:071zn6l0h2pfij.why: Two structures share 'they used to mock it'. With the relative: what they used to mock encompassed them, or news of it will come (6:5, 6:10, 11:8, 16:34, 21:41, 26:6, 39:48, 40:83, 45:33, 46:26). Without it: no messenger came to them but they mocked him (15:11, 36:30, 43:7). The split follows the structure, so no row is lost because another card also holds it.
tree:071zn6l0h2pfij.changes: Split by structure: 'what they used to mock' (10 rows) and 'but they used to mock him' (15:11, 36:30, 43:7). The rows that read on are kept as they are.
tree:071zn6l0h2pfij.relation: Every messenger was mocked, and the mockery came back on the mockers.

tree:0w7dkhz0q6maw7.why: 'No fear upon them nor will they grieve' with fa-la, wa-la and ala lead-ins; 2:62 and 5:69 a close pair; 2:262, 2:274, 2:277 their reward with their Lord. A real set.
tree:0w7dkhz0q6maw7.relation: Those freed from fear and grief.

tree:0nvt2qw0bo9kq6.why: 'And what can make you know what...' the refrain of the late surahs; the noun is the trap. 82:17 runs on into 82:18, which is also its own row.
tree:0nvt2qw0bo9kq6.relation: The terror and greatness of the unseen.

tree:0efow8z0gdwief.why: 'From the People of the Book': a group wished or said (3:69, 3:72), many wish (2:109), some are trustworthy and believe (3:75, 3:113, 3:199), and those who disbelieved among them (59:2, 59:11, 98:1, 98:6). Real pairs.
tree:0efow8z0gdwief.relation: The People of the Book are not all alike.

check.why: Keep is right: 'of the People of the Book' in the same structure, holding several real groups (wished, a party said, those who disbelieved among them).

tree:139rywx1pf5hjb.why: Stock closing 'He is the Hearing, the Knowing' over unrelated subjects. Only the closing and its lead-in are shared.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing over unrelated subjects, and its real lead-in pairs are kept in W4 cards.

tree:1blfwa519qg3fd.why: 'When it is said to them': follow what God sent down (2:170, 31:21), come to what God sent down (4:61, 5:104), believe (2:13, 2:91), and others. Same opening, many replies.
tree:1blfwa519qg3fd.relation: The deniers' replies when called to the truth.

tree:013nx29038ec27.why: 'Those who were given the Scripture' in many settings; the 'before you' trio (3:186, 4:131, 5:57) and the 'did not differ until after knowledge came' pair (3:19, 98:4) are real slips. One theme: the People of the Book and their stance.
tree:013nx29038ec27.relation: Those given the Book before: their division and their envy.

tree:0f516ql1o9h3sj.why: 'Those who denied Our signs': and were arrogant (7:36, 7:40), drowned with Noah's people (7:64, 10:73), the dog's likeness (7:176, 7:177), and others. Real pairs.
tree:0f516ql1o9h3sj.relation: The fate of those who deny God's signs.

tree:0w8sbdo17hizvy.why: Stock closing 'God is Hearing, Knowing' over unrelated subjects (wills, oaths, divorce, fighting, Imran's family, alms). Only the closing is shared; see also tree:15e21gr0a0ejnp.

tree:03vguwe0u6o5o2.why: Stock closing 'God is Knowing, Wise' over unrelated subjects (alms, Bedouins, the mosque of harm, asking permission, the believing women). Only the closing is shared.

check.why: Drop is right: a stock closing over unrelated subjects.

tree:06qe4d21dvrhse.why: Near-duplicate of tree:0fp7tpc06pt4s8, which holds 11 of these 14 ayat on inventing a lie against God.

tree:0c7ygk50hkyw37.why: 'Had God willed': the polytheists' excuse (6:148, 16:35), He would have made you one nation (5:48, 16:93, 42:8), they would not have associated (6:107, 6:137), and others. Several real pairs.
tree:0c7ygk50hkyw37.relation: God's will and the excuses people make of it.

tree:10z2p1f10t5kdx.why: 'Whom He wills, and God...': He singles out for His mercy whom He wills (2:105, 3:74), that is God's bounty He gives whom He wills (57:21, 57:29, 62:4), He turns to whom He wills (9:15, 9:27). The closing name is the trap.
tree:10z2p1f10t5kdx.relation: God's bounty and mercy are His to give.

tree:0qkv4n30267tdx.why: 'Most of them do not know' comes after two different particles, and that is the memorizer's trap: 'but most of them' (6:37, 7:131, 8:34, 10:55, 28:13, 28:57, 39:49, 44:39, 52:47) and 'nay, most of them' (16:75, 16:101, 21:24, 27:61, 31:25, 39:29, three after 'praise be to God'). The split follows the particle, so no row is lost.
tree:0qkv4n30267tdx.changes: Split by the particle: 'but' (9 rows) and 'nay' (6 rows). The rows that read on are kept as they are.
tree:0qkv4n30267tdx.relation: The truth is plain, yet most do not know it.

tree:1lf60621gtzeia.why: Stock closing 'God knows all things' over unrelated subjects (divorce, debts, inheritance, the Ka'ba, the light, provision). Only the closing is shared.

tree:05lyrse063egge.why: All fifteen rows stay. 'God knows what ...' is the same words and structure in all, and a memorizer has to keep apart what follows: what you reveal and what you conceal (5:99, 24:29), what they hide and what they declare (2:77, 16:19, 16:23), what is in the heavens and the earth (5:97, 22:70, 49:16, 58:7), what is in your souls or hearts (2:235, 33:51), what every female carries (13:8), what you do or craft (16:91, 29:45), what they call on (29:42). Other cards also holding some of these rows is no reason to remove them here. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:05lyrse063egge.relation: Nothing is hidden from God: the open and the secret, the heavens and the womb.

tree:0en9zid0cmm8sj.why: All fifteen rows stay. 'Have you not seen ...' opens all fifteen in the same words and structure, a well-known memorizer list. Inside it are tight sets: 'those given a portion of the Book' three times (3:23, 4:44, 4:51), the call to fight (2:246, 4:77), and the hypocrites' allies (58:14, 59:11). Cutting to two sets would remove rows only for their subject. The opening alone is common, so the card is mainly an index for memorizers.
tree:0en9zid0cmm8sj.relation: Each 'have you not seen' points to an example to learn from: the arrogant, the hypocrites, the half-believers.

tree:0h7vs0e1u8zsvc.why: 'God is He': the claim that God is the Messiah (5:17, 5:72), He is the Truth, the High (22:62, 31:30), the Rich, the Praised (31:26, 57:24, 60:6), the Acceptor of repentance (9:104, 9:118). Real pairs.
tree:0h7vs0e1u8zsvc.relation: Who God truly is, against what people claim.

tree:1a1fmbl0qhtos3.why: 'This is nothing but': tales of the ancients (23:83, 27:68), clear magic (5:110, 6:7, 37:15, 74:24), the deniers' words about revelation. Real pairs.

tree:1e8820r1kl6efh.why: 'What God sent down': follow it (2:170, 31:21), come to it (4:61, 5:104), names with no authority sent down (12:40, 53:23), rain sent from the sky (2:164, 45:5). Real pairs.
tree:1e8820r1kl6efh.relation: Following what God sent down against following the fathers.

tree:1sx41fs00q6hjy.why: 'Who does more wrong than one who': invents a lie (6:21, 7:37, 10:17 and others), was reminded of his Lord's signs and turned away (18:57, 32:22), bars the mosques (2:114), lies about God (39:32). The parent set for the 'invented a lie' card tree:0fp7tpc06pt4s8.

tree:1hwnapi04arg0a.why: 'From God': a Book or messenger confirming (2:89, 2:101), victory is only from God (3:126, 8:10), if it is from God and you disbelieve (41:52, 46:10). Real pairs.

tree:1vdjls31hgkv5b.why: All fifteen rows stay. 'He is the Mighty, the Wise' closes all fifteen in the same words, and the trap is what leads into it: 'and He is' (most), 'indeed He is' (29:26), 'no god but He' (3:6, 3:18). The surah openings 'whatever is in the heavens and earth glorifies God' (57:1, 59:1, 61:1, with 59:24) are the strongest set inside it. Cutting to the sets would remove rows only for their subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1vdjls31hgkv5b.relation: His might and wisdom close praise, creation, guidance and sending.

tree:040nwzc1yi4kao.why: 'Know that God...' with sixteen endings and wa / fa lead-ins; 5:98 and 8:25 'severe in penalty', 2:194 and 9:36 and 9:123 'with the god-fearing'. A formula set on one meaning.
tree:040nwzc1yi4kao.relation: Reminders of God's attributes in the laws.

tree:0r1cjun0cju4zt.why: 'God does not love': the transgressors (2:190, 5:87), the wrongdoers (3:57, 3:140), every arrogant boaster (31:18, 57:23, 4:36), the treacherous (4:107, 8:58, 22:38), the corrupters (2:205, 5:64, 28:77). The ending is the trap.
tree:0r1cjun0cju4zt.relation: The qualities God does not love.

tree:1k3du350y0ja9j.why: All sixteen rows stay. 'If you are believers' closes every row in the same words and structure, after a command or a reminder: fear God (5:57, 5:112), leave what remains of usury (2:278), fear Me (3:175), rely on God (5:23), obey God and His Messenger (8:1), a sign for you (2:248, 3:49, identical). The closing is common and the subjects differ, so its value is mainly for memorizers, who must know which commands it follows. Cutting to one pair would remove rows for their subject only. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1k3du350y0ja9j.relation: Faith is the condition laid on fear of God, trust, obedience and leaving usury.

tree:03cnigr1v75fyz.why: All sixteen rows stay. 'Of all things Knowing' closes all sixteen in the same words, and the trap is the lead-in: 'and He is' (2:29, 6:101, 57:3), 'and God is' (2:282, 4:176, 24:35, 24:64, 49:16, 64:11), 'indeed God / indeed He is' (8:75, 9:115, 29:62, 42:12, 58:7), 'that God is' (2:231, 5:97). The tree shows those branches; cutting to two sets would remove rows only for their subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:03cnigr1v75fyz.relation: God's complete knowledge closes creation, provision, law and judgment.

tree:0k3ench1j65eqh.why: 'For what you used to do': eat and drink with satisfaction (52:19, 77:43), the Garden you inherited (7:43, 43:72), I will inform you (29:8, 31:15), returned to the Knower of the unseen (9:94, 9:105, 62:8). Real pairs.
tree:0k3ench1j65eqh.relation: Deeds are told back and rewarded.

tree:18djqsz0oikepb.why: 'Those who disbelieved said': to those who believed (19:73, 29:12, 36:47, 46:11), this is magic or a man (34:43, 46:7), about the Quran (25:32, 34:31, 41:26). The saying is the trap.
tree:18djqsz0oikepb.relation: The deniers' sayings against revelation and believers.

tree:0p0cpqv03b078n.why: All seventeen rows stay. 'Those who do not believe' is the same words and structure in all, and the branch after it is the memorizer's point: in the Hereafter (10 rows), in God and the Last Day (9:29, 9:45), in God's signs (16:104, 16:105), in it (42:18), or nothing (6:125, 41:44). Another card also holding the Hereafter rows is no reason to remove them here. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0p0cpqv03b078n.relation: What unbelief in the Hereafter does: a veil, deeds made fair, hearts that shrink at God's mention.

tree:0m7q56q07m9za0.why: Two branches of 'God, what does not'. Besides God, what neither benefits nor harms: worshipped or called on (5:76, 6:71, 10:18, 10:106, 16:73, 21:66, 22:12, 25:55), with the order of benefit and harm switching, a classic trap. About God or from God, what you do not know: saying about God what you do not know (2:80, 2:169, 7:28, 7:33, 10:68), knowing from God what you do not (7:62, 12:86, 12:96), hoping from God what they do not (4:104). The split follows the preposition before God's name, so no row is lost because another card also holds it.
tree:0m7q56q07m9za0.changes: Split by the preposition: 'besides God' (8 rows) and 'about / from God' (9 rows). The rows that read on are kept as they are.
tree:0m7q56q07m9za0.relation: False gods that neither help nor harm, and false speech about God without knowledge.

tree:1e7knv314mem9x.why: 'Those who believed': and the Jews and Christians (2:62, 5:69, 22:17), and emigrated and strove (2:218, 8:72), and did righteous deeds, with many different rewards. Real pairs and a memorizer set.

tree:0vp1dwu0tbvrog.why: All seventeen rows stay as one card. 'They will abide therein' closes the people of the Fire and the people of the Garden in the same words, often side by side (2:81 and 2:82, 10:26 and 10:27). Seeing both together is the point for pondering and for memorizers ('companions of the Fire' / 'of the Garden'). Another card also holding the Fire rows is no reason to remove them. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0vp1dwu0tbvrog.relation: Contrast: the same eternity in the same words, for the Garden and for the Fire.

tree:0eq86ne0ooaufo.why: 'Those who disbelieved': wealth and children will not avail (3:10, 3:116), died as disbelievers (2:161, 3:91, 47:34), and barred from God's way (4:167, 22:25, 47:32). Real pairs.

tree:17rjgmf1l90xzn.why: 'What they used to do': evil is what they used to do (9:9, 58:15, 63:2, 5:62), vain is what they used to do (7:118, 7:139, 11:16), rewarded by the best of what they did (9:121, 16:96, 16:97). The lead-in is the trap.
tree:17rjgmf1l90xzn.relation: Deeds come to nothing or are rewarded at their best.

tree:0rfk5dw10v2pcm.why: All nineteen rows stay. 'In God and the Last Day' is the same phrase in all, and the memorizer must know which verb leads in: who believes (2:62, 5:69, 2:177, 9:18, 9:19), if you believe (4:59, 24:2), those who believe / do not believe (9:44, 9:45), whoever of you believes (2:232, 65:2). Inside it are real sets (asking leave, the divorce rulings, the mosques), but cutting to them would remove rows only for their subject. The phrase is common, so the card is mainly a memorizer's index.
tree:0rfk5dw10v2pcm.relation: Belief in God and the Last Day as the test behind worship, law, spending and loyalty.

tree:0kbwenf04a3tgb.why: All nineteen rows stay. 'In the life of this world' is the same phrase in all, and it holds real sets: support and good news 'in the life of this world and in the Hereafter' (10:64, 14:27, 40:51, 41:31), and disgrace in this life with a greater punishment after (13:34, 39:26, 41:16, and 2:85). The other rows have the same words with other subjects; cutting to the sets would remove them only for that. The phrase is common, so the card is weak as a whole; kept for the sets inside it.
tree:0kbwenf04a3tgb.relation: This life and the next set side by side: support or disgrace now, and more to come.

tree:1xbfu2d0ejy5fv.why: 'God does not guide the people who are': wrongdoers, disbelievers or defiantly disobedient. Which ending closes which ayah is the classic trap.
tree:1xbfu2d0ejy5fv.relation: Guidance withheld from those who choose wrong.

tree:0lumgzj0ph12rt.why: All nineteen rows stay. 'For them a painful punishment' closes all nineteen, and real pairs sit inside: 59:15 and 64:5 (they tasted the evil result of their affair), 2:174 and 3:77 (He will not purify them), 14:22 and 42:21 (the wrongdoers). The memorizer's trap is the lead-in ('and for them', 'those, for them', 'the wrongdoers, for them'). Cutting to one pair would remove rows only for their subject. The closing is common, so the card is mainly for memorizers. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0lumgzj0ph12rt.relation: Who is promised a painful punishment: hypocrites, concealers of the Book, mockers, wrongdoers.

tree:1enr60o0auj1qc.why: 'His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth', with many continuations: 2:107 and 9:116 (no protector), 5:40 and 48:14 (forgives and punishes), 57:2 and 57:5. Real pairs.

tree:0bqlmy6079dl5w.why: Near-duplicate of tree:0mc12081p2qguk, which already holds 2:29, 5:36, 13:18 and 39:47 in its split; 8:63 was removed there. Only 10:54 and 22:65 are new.

tree:1x0z4l417eldeq.why: 'Your fathers or' is glue in two unrelated ayat: remembrance after hajj (2:200) and eating in relatives' houses (24:61).

tree:1j8pjgc0hhnudc.why: 'Your fathers and your sons' opens a list in the inheritance law (4:11) and in the warning against loving kin more than God (9:24). Different subjects.

tree:1rnksvk0vib6c6.why: The deniers' challenge 'bring us a punishment': Quraysh (8:32) and Lot's people (29:29). Same mockery in two nations.

tree:1xm4i640tmyxqy.why: 'We gave him of': Dhul-Qarnayn given means to everything (18:84) and Qarun given treasures (28:76). Both were given power; one used it for good, the other grew arrogant.
tree:1xm4i640tmyxqy.relation: Contrast: power used with thanks and with pride.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: 'We gave him of', power used with thanks and with pride.

tree:1x9mgzi0tsvcaq.why: 'What their Lord gave them' in adjacent Paradise scenes (51:16, 52:18), continuing differently. A real trap.

tree:040wtod0a068hf.why: 'Another god' with God: whoever calls on another god has no proof (23:117), do not call on another god (28:88). Same prohibition, near-identical words, at surah ends.

tree:18q9fc10z4eup5.why: The family of Abraham chosen over the worlds (3:33) and given the Book and wisdom (4:54). One theme: God's favour on that family.

tree:0p4spxs1f672m8.why: 'Family of Jacob' in Joseph's favour (12:6) and Zakariyya's prayer for an heir (19:6). Different settings.

check.why: Drop is right: 'the family of Jacob' appears in different settings.

tree:1quqzrn0kmyfcf.why: 'Now? And indeed...' twice in Yunus: to the deniers who believe when punishment falls (10:51) and to Pharaoh drowning (10:91). Belief too late.
tree:1quqzrn0kmyfcf.relation: Belief that comes too late is refused.

tree:0pxygi8199t0rm.why: 'Believed among them' in Abraham's prayer for Mecca (2:126) and Salih's chiefs (7:75). Unrelated.

tree:1czj0yo0sxelvw.why: The words cross a phrase boundary: 'to those who believed: follow our way' (29:12) against 'those who believed followed the truth' (47:3). Different structures.

tree:1cugmgd1dqc5r5.why: Glue across a boundary: 'those who believe, who establish prayer' (5:55) and 'to those who believe, the Jews' (5:82). Unrelated.
