tree:0acdru60eghwyc.relation: Only God makes lawful and unlawful: people may not forbid what He allowed nor allow what He forbade.

tree:12xpm7q10jwxme.why: His brother Harun: a prophet (19:53), sent with signs (23:45), a minister (25:35).

tree:0ys7su51inre4n.why: The Book was differed over: Musa's Book in identical words (11:110, 41:45), and all Books (2:213).

tree:14dk7xy0pxychm.why: The blast seized them: at sunrise (15:73), in the morning (15:83), in truth (23:41).
tree:14dk7xy0pxychm.relation: The blast as punishment of Lut's people, Thamud and others.

tree:1w901nr1wb8dxp.why: Enter Paradise: no fear for you (7:49), for what you did (16:32), you and your wives (43:70).

tree:1p8aj3p03wzfwf.why: Call to your Lord's way with wisdom (16:125), call to your Lord (22:67, 28:87).
tree:1p8aj3p03wzfwf.relation: The Prophet's mission of calling to God.

tree:0qv7uxd0zbwu79.why: When God or your Lord took a covenant: from the prophets (3:81), from the People of the Book (3:187), from Adam's descendants (7:172).
tree:0qv7uxd0zbwu79.relation: God's covenants with prophets, scripture holders and all mankind.

tree:1l89z7g0gpz7tm.why: When they entered upon him: Ibrahim's guests (15:52, 51:25) and Dawud's litigants (38:22). Each prophet is startled.

tree:0hk42pr0z7ezsf.why: When you said: O Musa, we will not believe (2:55), we will not endure (2:61); and we hear and obey (5:7).
tree:0hk42pr0z7ezsf.relation: Contrast: the Israelites' refusals and the believers' obedience.

tree:1xmfgqp0qvl6db.why: When We let people taste mercy: they scheme (10:21), rejoice then despair (30:36, 42:48).
tree:1xmfgqp0qvl6db.relation: Human ingratitude in ease and hardship.

tree:0digzs50fbzql9.why: Then behold you: spreading as humans (30:20), coming out (30:25), kindling fire (36:80).

tree:16ypwp00xjzrrm.why: All three rows stay. 'When there comes' is the same words and structure: the great catastrophe (79:34) and the deafening blast (80:33) in neighbouring surahs, and the sign that comes to deniers who still will not believe (6:109). Same words, different subject.
tree:16ypwp00xjzrrm.relation: What comes at last: the overwhelming Day, and signs that do not move those who refuse.

tree:1yndutl1ajf8oj.why: When they come to you: the believers (6:54), believing women to pledge (60:12), the hypocrites (63:1).
tree:1yndutl1ajf8oj.relation: How the Prophet receives each group.

tree:1m4bij11ki6mhd.why: When reminded: they do not fall deaf and blind (25:73), they fall prostrate (32:15), they do not take heed (37:13).
tree:1m4bij11ki6mhd.relation: Contrast: believers respond to reminders, deniers ignore them.

tree:1cbf7c313a2hf3.why: All three rows stay. 'Then they would not' is the same particle and negation before a verb in all three: they would not remain after you but a little (17:76), you would not enjoy but a little (33:16), they would not give people a speck (4:53). Same words and structure; different subject is no reason to remove 4:53.
tree:1cbf7c313a2hf3.relation: Fleeing or expelling buys only a little time; the greedy would give nothing.

tree:1haj90d1hii8g3.why: Then we or you would be losers: the chiefs of Madyan (7:90), Yusuf's brothers (12:14), the deniers in al-Muminun (23:34).

tree:1q6ytbz0wj4i03.why: When you meet: the deniers in battle, do not flee (8:15), strike their necks (47:4); a force, be firm (8:45).

tree:1h27u1j1x0aex9.why: All three rows stay. 'Then behold, he/it is' is the same words and structure: man created from a drop, then he is an open adversary (16:4, 36:77), and falsehood struck by truth, then it vanishes (21:18). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1h27u1j1x0aex9.relation: Sudden reversals: a drop becomes a disputer, falsehood vanishes before truth.

tree:0j0b1au0cla52g.why: Remember your Lord: much, said to Zakariyya (3:41); within yourself (7:205); when you forget (18:24).
tree:0j0b1au0cla52g.relation: Three ways of remembering God: much, humbly, and on recalling.

tree:08tikxs1swwd4o.why: Sad's refrain, remember Our servant: Dawud (38:17), Ayyub (38:41), Ibrahim with his sons (38:45).
tree:08tikxs1swwd4o.relation: Models of patience and turning to God set before the Prophet.

tree:1kryiq40623uz6.why: Except whom He permits: no intercession (20:109, 34:23), no speech on the Day (78:38).
tree:1kryiq40623uz6.relation: On the Day, speech and intercession only by God's leave.

tree:1don9u11r8w9g1.why: Four months: the oath of abstention (2:226), the widow's waiting (2:234), and the respite for idolaters (9:2). A memorizer must keep the three apart.

tree:166wg5x1lgflp1.why: When We intend to destroy a town (17:16), We wished their Lord would replace him (18:81), had We wanted a pastime (21:17): a common verb, three unrelated points.

tree:1jfs8zv1ehwsrz.why: Send with us: Yusuf's brothers ask for Binyamin (12:63), Musa and Harun ask Pharaoh for the Israelites (20:47, 26:17).
tree:1jfs8zv1ehwsrz.relation: A request to release someone held, by brothers and by prophets.

tree:0cxqxga0sqneso.why: What I was sent with: Shuayb (7:87) and Hud (11:57, 46:23) say they have delivered it.
tree:0cxqxga0sqneso.relation: The prophets' task is to deliver what they were sent with.

tree:1cszevg198fljc.why: We sent messengers to the Israelites (5:70), no warner to Quraysh (34:44), two to the town (36:14): a common verb, unrelated contexts.

tree:1g8cluk1wlar36.why: We sent before you: our way with messengers (17:77), only men inspired (21:7), messengers who ate and walked in markets (25:20).
tree:1g8cluk1wlar36.relation: The messengers before were human, and God's way with them does not change.

tree:057a7jo14ln62c.why: Show me what they created: almost identical in 35:40 and 46:4, and in 31:11 after this is God's creation.
tree:057a7jo14ln62c.relation: The challenge to idolaters: their gods created nothing.

tree:03auoe81aznorm.why: Purified spouses in Paradise, each ayah ending differently: abiding (2:25), God's pleasure (3:15), deep shade (4:57). A memorizer card.
tree:03auoe81aznorm.relation: The same reward, completed three ways.

tree:1ds5i6s0wayhtk.why: The challenge: bring one surah or ten like it and call whomever you can besides God (10:38, 11:13), a classic memorizer pair. In 8:60 the relative is 'what' (prepare what you can of strength) and 'of' introduces the thing, not 'besides God': a different word and structure.
tree:1ds5i6s0wayhtk.changes: Removed 8:60: a different relative and structure. The rows that read on (10:39, 11:14) are kept.
tree:1ds5i6s0wayhtk.relation: The challenge of the Quran, given twice with a different measure.

tree:09z5ijc03ybgiy.why: Ask God's forgiveness, God is forgiving and merciful: after the hajj (2:199), at the end of al-Muzzammil (73:20), and with the messenger's prayer (4:64). The row for 73:20 reads on into a new surah.
tree:09z5ijc03ybgiy.relation: Seeking forgiveness after worship and after wrong.

tree:12ptq751jnrizd.why: They were arrogant in: themselves (25:21), the land, Qarun, Pharaoh and Haman (29:39), and Ad (41:15).
tree:12ptq751jnrizd.relation: Arrogance in the land leads to destruction.

tree:0q3024j1ltl4oh.why: Travel by night with My servants: strike a dry path (20:77), you will be pursued (26:52), by night (44:23).
tree:0q3024j1ltl4oh.relation: The exodus told in three surahs.

tree:04pkkdg06kxlym.why: Israil forbade to himself (3:93), cursed by the tongue of Dawud (5:78), a witness from the Israelites (46:10): a name and preposition only.

tree:0r3t7zw093nnnc.why: A good example: in God's Messenger (33:21), in Ibrahim and those with him (60:4, 60:6), for whoever hopes in God and the Last Day.
tree:0r3t7zw093nnnc.relation: The Prophet and Ibrahim as models.

tree:1jrewoo1mcxy1q.why: Associating with Him: I do not (13:36, 72:20), and you call me to (40:42).
tree:1jrewoo1mcxy1q.relation: The refusal of shirk by the Prophet and by the believer of Pharaoh's people.

tree:181406r1wumgv7.why: All three rows stay. 'A calamity befell you' is the same verb and structure: at Uhud, it is from yourselves (3:165), the laggard glad he was absent (4:72), and the calamity of death on a journey (5:106). Same words; the different subject is no reason to remove 5:106.
tree:181406r1wumgv7.relation: How people meet calamity: blaming others, rejoicing to have escaped, or ordering their affairs before death.

tree:19clvb80ri8vpc.why: Strike with your staff: the rock, twelve springs (2:60, 7:160), the sea, split (26:63).
tree:19clvb80ri8vpc.relation: Musa's staff brings water and splits the sea.

tree:04cbj4s1uycoc0.why: Who is more astray than one who: follows desire (28:50), is in far dissension (41:52), calls on what will not answer (46:5).
tree:04cbj4s1uycoc0.relation: Three faces of the worst error.

tree:0t38h0o13f3xpw.why: I am forbidden to worship those you call besides God (6:56, 40:66), and I do not worship those you worship (10:104).
tree:0t38h0o13f3xpw.relation: The Prophet's refusal of idol worship.

tree:0jh105a0f67hyc.why: We have prepared for them a painful punishment (4:18, 17:10) or the punishment of the Blaze (67:5). Rows read on.

tree:098v3s5084s40l.why: I do not know the unseen: the Prophet (6:50) and Nuh (11:31) in almost the same words, and had I known it (7:188).
tree:098v3s5084s40l.relation: Prophets disclaim knowledge of the unseen.

tree:05m1nzl18gm3wx.why: I know what: you do not know (2:30), you reveal and conceal (2:33), and Isa says I do not know what is in You (5:116).
tree:05m1nzl18gm3wx.relation: God's knowledge and the limits of others' knowledge.

tree:0pu1quy09kcvwi.why: That I may do good: Sulayman (27:19) and the grown man (46:15) in the same prayer, and the dead man's too-late plea (23:100).
tree:0pu1quy09kcvwi.relation: Contrast: the prayer for good deeds in life and the wish for them after death.

tree:1u0irvx18wa3fh.why: I seek refuge in You: Noah from asking what he has no knowledge of (11:47), and the Prophet from the devils' whispers and their presence (23:97-98). 23:97 and 23:98 are one continuous prayer, so they read as one row.
tree:1u0irvx18wa3fh.changes: Merged 23:97 and 23:98 into one row: one prayer.
tree:1u0irvx18wa3fh.relation: Seeking refuge from one's own ignorance and from the devils.

tree:19fvcz1150kxn5.why: What God gave to His messenger as spoils without fighting: captives (33:50), from them (59:6), from the towns (59:7).
tree:19fvcz1150kxn5.relation: The Prophet's share of fay and its distribution.

tree:1atunfu1nkfhi8.why: Other than God: shall I seek a judge (6:114), will you fear (16:52), do you order me to worship (39:64).
tree:1atunfu1nkfhi8.relation: No judge, object of fear or worship but God.

tree:00no6k90o1eo8n.why: Will you not see: the night as mercy (28:72), Pharaoh's boast of his rivers (43:51), signs in yourselves (51:21). A memorizer ending.

tree:0g22s4f1habcl5.why: Three rhetorical questions of the same form: is one who stands on clear proof, or who believes, like one who does not? 11:17 and 47:14 open identically, and 32:18 gives the plainest version of the comparison.
tree:0g22s4f1habcl5.relation: The same question asked three ways: guidance and faith cannot equal misguidance and defiance.

tree:02y6wr20e3w37i.why: The command to fight is worded nearly the same in 2:191, 4:89 and 4:91, differing only in the verb for finding the enemy. A real trap for memorizers.

tree:0fi6iw313gozm1.why: All three rows stay. 'I say to you' is the same verb and words in all three: the Prophet and Noah disclaim treasures, the unseen and being angels (6:50, 11:31, close parallels), and the believer of Pharaoh's people says 'you will remember what I say to you' (40:44). Same words, different subject.
tree:0fi6iw313gozm1.relation: Messengers claim nothing beyond their message, and the believer leaves his words to be remembered.

tree:0m74esa12k1gb4.why: Three prayers that each end with the speaker fearing or hoping which group he will be among: Nuh (11:47) and Yusuf (12:33) fear loss and ignorance, the dying man (63:10) wishes he could be among the righteous.
tree:0m74esa12k1gb4.relation: Prophets ask for help before the fall; the negligent man asks only when it is too late.

check.why: Keep is right: three prayers that each end by naming which group the speaker will be among.

tree:0v3fnck0nxf4f2.why: Spending only to seek the face of God appears in 2:272 and 92:20; 57:27 uses the same construction for monasticism invented to seek God's pleasure but not kept up. A useful lesson about sincere intention.
tree:0v3fnck0nxf4f2.relation: Seeking God's face through charity, set beside a self-made devotion that was not kept.

check.why: Keep is right: 'only seeking the face or pleasure of God' has the same construction in all three rows, with a lesson about intention.

tree:0z3w9031ij2jwp.why: All three rows stay. 'Except Him' is the same exception in all three: worship none but Him, then the upright religion (12:40) or kindness to parents (17:23); and at sea all you call on vanish except Him (17:67). Same words and structure; 17:67 shows the same truth in a moment of danger.
tree:0z3w9031ij2jwp.relation: Only Him: in the decree to worship, and in the storm where every other god vanishes.

tree:1xmacum0by3nwm.why: All three rows stay. 'Except by His leave' is the same exception in all three: no intercession (2:255) and no speech on the Day (11:105) except by His leave, and the sky does not fall on the earth except by His leave (22:65). Same words and structure, different subject.
tree:1xmacum0by3nwm.relation: Everything waits on His leave: intercession, speech, and the sky itself.

tree:0cxddj00vtn6b2.why: Success (11:88), patience (16:127) and strength (18:39) are each said to come only through God. A clear lesson that every ability is from Him.
tree:0cxddj00vtn6b2.relation: Success, patience and power: none of them is had except through God.

tree:0qm1r1g0k2by7e.why: The refrain of surah Hud closing the stories of Ad, Thamud and Madyan, with small differences each time. Memorizers mix these up; the pattern ties the destroyed nations together.
tree:0qm1r1g0k2by7e.relation: One curse closes three stories of nations that rejected their prophets.

tree:0egetau05tlm8a.why: Only a two-word particle phrase is shared; God's knowledge, the punishment of wrongdoers and the brothers' testimony have nothing in common.

tree:1nv6bge06yhnm8.why: Three things that only increase loss: the Quran for wrongdoers (17:82), disbelief for disbelievers (35:39), wealth and children for those who follow it (71:21). Same closing, worth pondering.
tree:1nv6bge06yhnm8.relation: What should benefit only adds loss to those who turn away.

tree:1pi7iq01uidp2e.why: The same dismissal of a messenger as just a man: twice in surah al-Muminun by Nuh's and another people, and by Quraysh in 34:43. Same theme of peoples refusing their prophets.
tree:1pi7iq01uidp2e.relation: Every people belittled its messenger in the same words: he is only a man.

tree:072ogpa1mt4k6y.why: Refusing everything but disbelief, in nearly identical closings: most people in 17:89 and 25:50, the wrongdoers in 17:99. A real memorizer trap.

tree:1susvyt066hxap.why: Only a comparison particle is shared; usury, the idolaters' worship and Yaqub's distrust are unrelated.

tree:1dqbe1e023zg8m.why: All three rows stay. 'Except for whom' is the same exception in all three: intercession only for whom He approves (21:28) or permits (34:23), and 'do not trust except whoever follows your religion' (3:73). Same words and structure, different subject.
tree:1dqbe1e023zg8m.relation: Who is accepted: God admits intercession for whom He wills, while some trust only their own.

tree:00cfy5k0l14r04.why: The worldly life as mere enjoyment, said in 3:185 and 57:20 with the same words and in 13:26 compared with the Hereafter. Same theme, small differences worth learning.
tree:00cfy5k0l14r04.relation: The worldly life is little enjoyment beside the Hereafter.

tree:0p1qmna1lm4dhw.why: The righteous in bliss, said identically in 82:13 and 83:22, and in 83:18 their record in the highest place. Useful for memorizers, and the run-on in 82:14 shows the contrast with the wicked.
tree:0p1qmna1lm4dhw.relation: Contrast: the righteous in bliss, the wicked in fire.

tree:12cb5vo1chzea0.why: 19:37 and 43:65 are near-identical: the sects differed among themselves about Jesus, then woe to those who disbelieved / did wrong. In 40:5 'the factions' are followed by 'after them', not 'among them', a different structure.
tree:12cb5vo1chzea0.changes: Removed 40:5: a different structure (the factions after them).
tree:12cb5vo1chzea0.relation: Division over Jesus, and the woe that follows, told twice.

check.why: Removing 40:5 is right: there 'the factions' is followed by 'after them', a different phrase from 'from among them', so it is more than a subject difference.

tree:1hj746f162v02z.why: Only a stock phrase about belief in the Last Day is shared, followed by different sentences on charity for show, a good example and divorce.

tree:0rqtyz21vphhm0.why: The shared words are the common pairing of this world and the Hereafter; reward for the righteous, captives at Badr and spreading indecency are different subjects.

tree:0lk20wu0k1nw28.why: Only the end of a stock phrase about the heavens and the earth followed by an opening particle is shared; the statements after it differ in subject.

check.why: Drop is right: the shared words straddle the end of a stock phrase and the start of a new exclamation.

tree:1m33fhf0btkeip.why: Only the word for the earth followed by a particle is shared; God's knowledge, Qarun's corruption and God's wealth are unrelated.

tree:0nhe044042wncw.why: The same question and answer pattern in 6:12, 13:16 and 34:24: ask who owns, rules or provides from the heavens and earth, and answer God. A clear memorizer group with a single argument.
tree:0nhe044042wncw.relation: The idolaters are made to answer their own question: it is God.

tree:1hshy791pp0peh.why: 2:116 and 30:26 say all in the heavens and earth are devoutly obedient to Him, in nearly the same words. In 55:29 'every' starts 'every day He is about a matter', a different phrase.
tree:1hshy791pp0peh.changes: Removed 55:29: 'every' is part of a different phrase. The rows that read on (2:117, 30:27) are kept.
tree:1hshy791pp0peh.relation: All creation obeys Him, so He has no need of a son.

tree:1hs8tcg151qd4s.why: Signs in the creation of heavens and earth, each for a different people: those who reason, those who fear God, the believers. Good for memorizers and for pondering who benefits from signs.
tree:1hs8tcg151qd4s.relation: The same signs, and three kinds of people who see them.

tree:1fbvafp0n7xfwx.why: Only the word for the earth followed by a particle is shared, in three different sentences on destroyed nations, the evil tree and God's knowledge.

tree:0pdy6ff1npidaz.why: All three rows stay. 'The earth and the mountains' is the same pair in all three: lifted and crushed (69:14), quaking (73:14), and refusing the Trust (33:72). Same words; the different subject is no reason to remove 33:72.
tree:0pdy6ff1npidaz.relation: The mountains that will be crushed on the Day are the ones that refused the Trust man carried.

tree:1d1pte50dk90a5.why: All three rows stay. 23:79 and 67:24 are almost identical: He spread you through the earth and to Him you will be gathered. 11:123 has the same words and structure, 'the earth, and to Him returns the whole matter'. Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1d1pte50dk90a5.relation: All returns to Him: people and every matter.

tree:0luft1h0hkj9p9.why: Only the earth followed by a common verb is shared; creation of light, rivers on earth and Pharaoh's tyranny are different subjects.

tree:0nqlncd05c2fez.why: The shackles on the necks of disbelievers in three scenes: deniers of resurrection, followers and leaders blaming each other, and those dragged into fire. One image of punishment repeated.
tree:0nqlncd05c2fez.relation: The same punishment for those who denied, shown three times.

tree:1k1f8150pexsk1.why: The shared words are a common noun and preposition in three different sentences: the hypocrites' complaint at Uhud, the Romans' defeat and victory, and God directing affairs from the sky. No shared wording to learn.

tree:0svh2mn136ghez.why: Men and jinn named together about speech: their devils whisper false words (6:112), together they cannot produce the Quran (17:88), and the jinn thought none of them would lie about God (72:5).
tree:0svh2mn136ghez.relation: Men and jinn can deceive and be deceived, but cannot match God's word.

check.why: Keep is right: men and jinn named together about speech, the same theme in all three.

tree:13y0oxi0sliqsk.why: 22:62 and 31:30 are near identical (God is the truth, what they call on is falsehood), differing by one pronoun. 47:3 applies the same truth and falsehood split to the people who follow each.
tree:13y0oxi0sliqsk.relation: God is the truth and their idols are falsehood; so people divide into followers of each.

tree:1medzm40m9up5e.why: Only a relative pronoun and a verb are shared; the burdens lifted by the Prophet, the Sabbath town and Lut's town are separate subjects.

tree:1f2z422162xqac.why: God establishes the truth by His words in three places: at Badr (8:7), against Pharaoh's magicians (10:82) and against those who accuse the Prophet (42:24). Same promise with different endings.
tree:1f2z422162xqac.relation: Whatever the battle, God makes the truth prevail by His words.

tree:1eef3cy0dokrl8.why: Only the word for truth followed by a negation is shared; extremism in religion, haste with revelation and hardened hearts are unrelated sentences.

tree:1p51pv310toq53.why: God speaks the truth, then one attribute follows: He is the best of judges (6:57), He guides to the way (33:4), He is the High, the Great (34:23). A tidy memorizer group with the same meaning.
tree:1p51pv310toq53.relation: God's word is the truth, said three times with a different attribute after it.

check.why: Keep is right: 'God speaks the truth, and He is' followed by three different attributes.

tree:0hl2uvv0t86rfr.why: Wine and gambling across the stages of their ruling: harm greater than benefit (2:219), then a filth to avoid (5:90), then Satan's aim to divide and distract from prayer (5:91).
tree:0hl2uvv0t86rfr.relation: The gradual prohibition of wine and gambling, read in order.

tree:1ysey6515t5zer.why: 18:104 and 30:7 describe people absorbed in the worldly life while deluded about their deeds or heedless of the Hereafter. In 8:42 the same word means 'the nearer' bank of the valley at Badr, a different sense.
tree:1ysey6515t5zer.changes: Removed 8:42: a different sense of the word.
tree:1ysey6515t5zer.relation: Busy with this world, blind to the next.

check.why: Removing 8:42 is right: there the word means the near bank of the valley, a different word sense and structure.

tree:0hq81f418ahgbm.why: The creation of male and female in three late surahs: as a sign (53:45), as proof of resurrection (75:39), and as an oath (92:3). Short ayat a memorizer can confuse.
tree:0hq81f418ahgbm.relation: The pairing of male and female as a sign of God's power to create and to resurrect.

tree:0yr523g18udr8i.why: All three rows stay. 'The one in whose hand is' is the same words and structure: the dominion of all things (36:83, 67:1), and the marriage tie (2:237). Same words, different subject: the husband who can forgo the dowry is named with the phrase used of God's dominion.
tree:0yr523g18udr8i.relation: In His hand is all dominion; in the husband's hand is only the marriage tie, and forgoing is nearer to piety.

tree:14dh5s01tysenk.why: God subjected the sea (16:14, 45:12) and the riding animals and ships (43:13) for people to travel and seek His bounty, with a call to thank Him. Same favour, close wording.
tree:14dh5s01tysenk.relation: The means of travel are subjected to us so that we give thanks.

check.why: Keep is right: 'He who subjected' the sea and mounts, the same favour in close wording.

tree:0mik5xd0ib5jcd.why: Hud (11:51), the man in surah Ya-Sin (36:22) and Ibrahim (43:27) each speak of God as the one who created me. Callers to God use the same personal argument.
tree:0mik5xd0ib5jcd.relation: Each caller points to the One who created him as the reason to worship Him.

tree:1e72c6s0riip9a.why: Only a relative clause frame is shared; Yusuf's dream interpretation, the dispute about Isa and the Day the deniers meet are different subjects.

tree:1hvykyv15dvc6x.why: Only the term for the criminals is shared, in three different scenes: punishment for demanding signs, vengeance on past nations, and mocking believers.

tree:1ns177i0tyt2g4.why: People of the Book who differed: about the Book (2:176), about Isa (4:157) and about the Sabbath (16:124). Same phrase, three disputes, each judged.
tree:1ns177i0tyt2g4.relation: Every dispute over what God revealed ends in doubt, division or God's judgement.

tree:0fkn1va1uwriuk.why: Two outcomes for the oppressed: God makes the oppressed believers leaders and heirs (28:5), while the weak who followed the arrogant blame them in the fire (34:31, 34:33).
tree:0fkn1va1uwriuk.relation: Contrast: the oppressed who held to faith inherit the land; the weak who followed their masters share their punishment.

check.why: Keep is right: two outcomes for the oppressed form a real contrast.

tree:10owfsc0shgyuw.why: 3:142 and 9:16 are a close pair: did you think you would be left before God knows who strives among you? 29:69 gives the striver's reward: God guides them to His ways.
tree:10owfsc0shgyuw.relation: Striving is the test, and guidance is its reward.

tree:07sri2x007wa1b.why: 9:43 and 29:3 both speak of God making clear who is truthful and who lies; 2:177 describes who the truthful are. Worth reading together.
tree:07sri2x007wa1b.relation: Trials separate the truthful from the liars, and 2:177 says what truthfulness looks like.

tree:1ob4bzp03tc7kx.why: Three treaty rulings at the start of at-Tawba with almost the same words: the release from treaties, the exception for those who kept them, and those at the Sacred Mosque. A real memorizer trap.

check.why: Keep is right: three treaty rulings in almost the same words, a real trap.

tree:0ljobu609csuaw.why: 3:169 and 47:4 speak of those killed in God's cause: they are alive, and their deeds are not lost. In 6:140 the verb is active (those who killed their children), a different word.
tree:0ljobu609csuaw.changes: Removed 6:140: the verb is active, a different word.
tree:0ljobu609csuaw.relation: Those killed for God are alive with their Lord.

check.why: Removing 6:140 is right: there the verb is active (those who killed), a different word from 'those who were killed'.

tree:1vuw3ic0hfjhta.why: Only a relative pronoun and a helper verb are shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:0d6c58y19a1zvw.why: 11:18 and 39:60 show those who lied against God on the Day: named by the witnesses, faces darkened. In 9:90 the verb takes a direct object ('lied to God and His Messenger') instead of 'against', a different construction.
tree:0d6c58y19a1zvw.changes: Removed 9:90: a different construction of the verb.
tree:0d6c58y19a1zvw.relation: Lying against God is exposed on the Day.

check.why: Removing 9:90 is right: there the verb takes a direct object (they lied to God), a different construction from 'lied about God'.

tree:1kszmpj18nxgeh.why: Those who harm the Prophet (9:61), God and His Messenger (33:57), and the believers (33:58), each with its punishment. A clear set for pondering the weight of harming others.
tree:1kszmpj18nxgeh.relation: Harm to the Prophet, to God and to believers, each with its own sentence.

tree:0ju2ye50172mbv.why: 4:37 and 57:24 open identically on the misers who command miserliness, then diverge; 3:180 says what the misers will carry on the Day. A memorizer trap and one theme.
tree:0ju2ye50172mbv.relation: The miser thinks he gains but will be collared with what he withheld.

tree:1hh8tiq022xck4.why: Three rulings in surah an-Nur on accusing chaste women and wives, with small changes in wording. Same subject, clear memorizer value.
tree:1hh8tiq022xck4.relation: Accusing the chaste: the legal penalty, the oath between spouses, and the curse in both worlds.

tree:1m5hsbs0fvejn2.why: All three rows stay. 'Those who do ...' is the same words and structure: good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds (17:9, 18:2, nearly identical), and those who do evil deeds thinking they will escape (29:4). Same words, opposite deeds.
tree:1m5hsbs0fvejn2.relation: Contrast: those who do good are given good news; those who do evil will not outrun God.

tree:0pch9nl1jixevf.why: The Hour coming suddenly on the deniers, in three places with three different results: regret, unawareness, and the punishment of a barren day.
tree:0pch9nl1jixevf.relation: Those who doubt the Hour will be overtaken by it without warning.

tree:1rhjamm09u5b1o.why: 2:215 and 4:36 share a stock list of relatives, orphans, the poor and wayfarers that recurs often; 40:37 is Pharaoh barred from the way, unrelated.

tree:0mtu6d70yhbdw7.why: 67:16 and 67:17 are two parallel warnings that open alike ('do you feel secure from Him who is in heaven that He ...'), easy to swap. In 22:65 'the sky' is the object of 'holds back', a different structure.
tree:0mtu6d70yhbdw7.relation: Two threats from above: the earth swallowing, a storm of stones.

check.why: Removing 22:65 is right: there the sky is the object of a different verb, a different structure from 'He who is in the sky'.

tree:07qbeh61pe5lvy.why: 29:4 and 45:21 are a close pair (do the doers of evil think...? how bad is their judgement), and 16:45 asks the same of the plotters: do they feel safe? All three expose the evildoer's false security.
tree:07qbeh61pe5lvy.relation: Evildoers wrongly think they will escape or be treated like the believers.

tree:1dfnk3p0bmowz1.why: 4:120 and 17:64 end with the same sentence: Satan promises them nothing but delusion. In 4:83 the exception follows an affirmative ('you would have followed Satan, except a few'), a different structure.
tree:1dfnk3p0bmowz1.changes: Removed 4:83: a different structure. The rows that read on (4:121, 17:65) are kept.
tree:1dfnk3p0bmowz1.relation: Satan's promises are only delusion, said twice.

tree:0iydzzg01a1jiq.why: Satan wants to lead them far astray (4:60) and to sow enmity through wine and gambling (5:91): his aims named in the same words. In 18:63 'Satan, that I mention it' is an exception with an appositive clause, a different structure.
tree:0iydzzg01a1jiq.relation: What Satan wants: to mislead and to divide.

tree:0kabdzk0uyw7wg.why: Three statements of what Satan is: his plot is weak (4:76), he is an open enemy to man (17:53), he is disobedient to the Most Merciful (19:44). Same frame, different description each time.
tree:0kabdzk0uyw7wg.relation: Satan is weak, hostile and rebellious, so he deserves neither fear nor obedience.

tree:0x1ycsj0yuzobb.why: Only the stock phrase for good deeds followed by a preposition is shared; the sentences go to different places (gender equality, reward, leaving darkness).

tree:0iahtsw0n0llww.why: Prayer followed by a reason: seek help through patience and prayer, God is with the patient (2:153); prayer is a timed duty (4:103); prayer forbids indecency (29:45). Worth reading together.
tree:0iahtsw0n0llww.relation: What prayer is: a help, a fixed duty, and a guard against evil.

tree:1w0rfil01piu5h.why: The far straying closes three descriptions of the disbelievers: deeds like ash (14:18), calling on what neither harms nor helps (22:12), and denying the Hereafter (34:8). Memorizers must place each version.
tree:1w0rfil01piu5h.relation: Different paths of disbelief, all named the same far straying.

tree:0ywfutz17gw9dh.why: The wrongdoers given nothing but more of their own end: loss from the Quran (17:82), and Nuh's two prayers for more straying and ruin (71:24, 71:28). Close wording, one theme.
tree:0ywfutz17gw9dh.relation: For the wrongdoer, even what is sent as mercy only adds to his ruin.

tree:1eaxbzh1o7ewrh.why: The calf worship told three times: 2:51 and 2:92 end identically, 4:153 adds that it came after clear proofs. Same story, a real memorizer trap.
tree:1eaxbzh1o7ewrh.relation: Taking the calf after Musa and after clear signs, and God still forgave.

tree:1k7m0b20ivbdn2.why: Enmity and hatred from three sources: cast among the Jews as punishment (5:64), sown by Satan through wine (5:91), declared by Ibrahim against idol worship (60:4). Same pair of words, worth pondering.
tree:1k7m0b20ivbdn2.relation: Enmity can be a punishment, Satan's work, or a stand for faith.

tree:18wr2a316exob1.why: The path of the Mighty, the Praised in 14:1 and 34:6, and belief in the Mighty, the Praised in 85:8. In 14:2 and 85:9 the next ayah continues with Him who owns the heavens and earth.
tree:18wr2a316exob1.relation: The way people are guided to and the faith people are punished for belong to the same Mighty and Praised Lord.

tree:1q0po1p00pm0hv.why: Three ayat ending with the Mighty, the Forgiving, after lordship of creation (38:66, 39:5) and the believer's call (40:42). Same closing, different lead-ins: a memorizer set.
tree:1q0po1p00pm0hv.relation: The Lord of all creation is both mighty and forgiving.

tree:1pjyspt1ohn2xl.why: The end belongs to the God-fearing: Musa to his people (7:128), after Nuh's story (11:49), and the abode of the Hereafter (28:83). Same promise, small differences in wording.
tree:1pjyspt1ohn2xl.relation: Whatever the trial, the outcome is for those who fear God.

tree:1i0qg9l06gap5p.why: Only the word for knowledge followed by a particle is shared; three different sentences.

tree:0m1q9d217mj4ua.why: Corruption in the land is a common phrase; past nations without reformers, Qarun's warning and corruption on land and sea do not show a closer link.

check.why: Drop is acceptable: the common phrase spans three different subjects, and the closer pair 11:116 with 28:77 is already kept in W1 (tree:0r1zrfa0zn1i7u).

tree:1a3m9kv1ud2rp1.why: The laden ship closes three short ayat: Nuh saved (26:119), the offspring carried (36:41), Yunus fleeing (37:140). Memorizers mix them up, and the image ties the stories together.
tree:1a3m9kv1ud2rp1.relation: The same ship image for rescue, for favour, and for a prophet's flight.

tree:0sohnq519hk6fx.why: Musa told to throw his staff three times: before the magicians (7:117) and at the first call (27:10, 28:31), which differ only in their endings. A real memorizer trap.

tree:1sax5au1lvh5ji.why: The sun, moon and stars subjected by His command (7:54, 16:12) and prostrating to Him (22:18). Same list, one meaning: they obey their Lord.
tree:1sax5au1lvh5ji.relation: The heavenly bodies are subjected and they prostrate: all creation submits.

tree:0m1y9lz0uyzypb.why: 41:25 and 46:18 share a whole clause: the word came true against them among nations of jinn and men before them; they were losers. In 21:4 'the word' means speech (He knows what is said in heaven and earth), a different sense.
tree:0m1y9lz0uyzypb.changes: Removed 21:4: a different sense. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:0m1y9lz0uyzypb.relation: The decree that fell on past nations falls on the deniers too.

tree:15p8gh01hcdbfq.why: The People of the Book and a verb of belief appear, but as a plot to deceive (3:72), a warning (4:47) and a promise (5:65). Too loose a link to learn from.

tree:1ed0ows1xmp9i2.why: Only the word Book followed by a particle is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:1o5pksu1pffr8g.why: 38:4 and 50:2 are a close pair: they wondered a warner came from among them, and the disbelievers said this is... 54:8 has the same words when the Day comes: this is a hard day.
tree:1o5pksu1pffr8g.relation: The disbelievers who called the warner a liar or strange will say on the Day: this is a hard day.

tree:1dvwm8c1ljuqto.why: 19:81 and 36:74 are near-identical: they took gods besides God to gain honour / to be helped. In 6:19 it is 'with God other gods', a different preposition and structure.
tree:1dvwm8c1ljuqto.changes: Removed 6:19: a different preposition and structure.
tree:1dvwm8c1ljuqto.relation: Seeking honour and help from false gods, which give neither.

tree:1h77xvu0dzs326.why: 9:121 and 24:38: that God may reward them for the best of what they did. In 23:14 'best' describes God (the best of creators), a different structure.
tree:1h77xvu0dzs326.relation: God rewards by the best of deeds.

check.why: Removing 23:14 is right: 'God, the best of creators' is a different phrase. The resulting pair, 9:121 with 24:38, is already kept as tree:0kclx650myvtpl in W1, so it should be de-duplicated when the shards are merged.

tree:0gm920f1fh9d9n.why: Three things of God called greater: His pleasure greater than the gardens (9:72), His remembrance greater (29:45), His hatred of the disbelievers greater than their hatred of themselves (40:10).
tree:0gm920f1fh9d9n.relation: Contrast: God's pleasure for believers and His hatred for deniers, each greater than what they see.

check.why: Keep is right: three things of God called 'greater' form a real contrast.

tree:138fnav0qvsdtd.why: Three assurances that each open with the same particle: God's help is near (2:214), hearts find rest in remembering God (13:28), God's party succeeds (58:22).
tree:138fnav0qvsdtd.relation: Help, rest and success: three promises to the believers.

tree:1c2rhb01a45b12.why: God and the believers appear together in three different sentences (reward for the repentant, the promise of gardens, sparing them battle); no shared phrase to learn.

tree:0asho25144p3kl.why: Only the name of God followed by a preposition is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:0f7dioq1eyfy6s.why: 9:30 and 63:4 end alike: may God fight them, how they are deluded; 40:69 asks how those who dispute God's signs are turned away. Same astonishment at misguidance.
tree:0f7dioq1eyfy6s.relation: Astonishment at people turned from the truth after it is clear.

tree:1ixn6qp14k0v5n.why: 6:17 and 10:107 open identically on harm that only God removes, then diverge; 39:38 asks whether the idols could remove harm He sends. Strong memorizer set with one meaning.
tree:1ixn6qp14k0v5n.relation: Only God removes harm or withholds mercy; idols can do neither.

tree:06kip3g0rbfhqg.why: Only the name of God followed by the word after is shared; reviving a dead town, not being turned from revelation and ease after hardship are different sentences.

tree:1vvd2mf195vg2r.why: 14:20 and 35:17 are the same short ayah: replacing you with a new creation is not hard for God. In 39:37 the word means 'Mighty' (is not God Mighty, Owner of retribution?), a different sense.
tree:1vvd2mf195vg2r.changes: Removed 39:37: a different sense of the word. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:1vvd2mf195vg2r.relation: Replacing a people is easy for God.

tree:1iotmad00cgv8l.why: All three rows stay. 'God; nay, ...' is the same words and structure in all three, all in an-Naml: is there a god with God? nay, they are a people who deviate (27:60) / nay, most of them do not know (27:61); and Salih's 'your omen is with God; nay, you are a people being tested' (27:47). 27:47 even has 'a people' after 'nay' like 27:60: a real slip for a reciter.
tree:1iotmad00cgv8l.relation: In one surah, the same turn ('nay') exposes the deniers: they deviate, they do not know, they are being tested.

tree:151y46j1vqdagx.why: 2:26 and 74:31 share the deniers' mocking question, 'what did God intend by this as a parable?', answered by 'He leads astray by it many and guides many'. In 6:144 'God, with this' follows a different verb ('did God enjoin you with this?'), a different structure and sense.
tree:151y46j1vqdagx.relation: A parable divides people: it guides some and misleads others.

tree:11wmwz21t0b4wg.why: You will find no change in the way of God, in 33:62, 35:43 and 48:23; 35:43 adds no alteration either. A clear memorizer set on one law.
tree:11wmwz21t0b4wg.relation: God's way with past nations does not change.

tree:09r9m901nvrubg.why: Three ayat opening with God created you: then He takes you in death (16:70), from dust then a drop (35:11), and what you make (37:96). Same opening with different continuations.
tree:09r9m901nvrubg.relation: God made you, your life span and even your work.

tree:1ox2o6504jzlld.why: 2:207 and 3:30 end with the same words, God is kind to His servants, and 24:20 ends with God kind and merciful. A memorizer set on God's kindness after a warning or a sacrifice.
tree:1ox2o6504jzlld.relation: Even when He warns, God is kind to His servants.

tree:1vmccis1fou5b2.why: 3:98 and 10:46 share God as witness over what they do, but 6:19 is a different sentence (God is witness between me and you). The pair is better shown on its own than in this mixed tree.

check.why: Drop is right: I checked that the pair 3:98 with 10:46 is kept in W1 (tree:0hc4at21imcshe), and 6:19 is a different sentence.

tree:1yo6bzn0qr0o1d.why: 60:8 and 60:9 are a matched pair: God does not forbid you regarding those who did not fight you; He only forbids you regarding those who did. In 48:18 'God ... with' follows another verb ('God was pleased with the believers'), a different structure.
tree:1yo6bzn0qr0o1d.relation: Kindness to the peaceful, no alliance with aggressors.

check.why: Removing 48:18 is right: a different verb (God was pleased).

tree:0pwn40r0y1jb1r.why: 29:61 and 43:87 end with they would say God, so how are they turned away; 6:95 ends with that is God, so how are you turned away. Close endings, one argument.
tree:0pwn40r0y1jb1r.relation: They admit God is the creator, yet turn away from Him.

tree:13psohf0ut0ng9.why: Only the name of God followed by a common particle is shared; Satan's promises, divorce limits and the two wives' repentance are unrelated.

tree:0mn1zoa1lpg9y4.why: God acts on hearts according to what people do: they turned away so He turned their hearts (9:127), they swerved so He made them swerve (61:5), while He tested the hearts of the reverent for piety (49:3).
tree:0mn1zoa1lpg9y4.relation: Contrast: hearts turned or made to swerve as recompense, hearts tested for piety as an honour.

check.why: Keep is right: God acting on hearts according to deeds is the same theme, with a contrast.

tree:1yto53r0hvq23f.why: God is subtle and aware ends 22:63 and 31:16, and 42:19 opens God is subtle with His servants. A memorizer set on one attribute with different contexts.
tree:1yto53r0hvq23f.relation: His subtlety reaches the rain, the smallest seed, and His servants' provision.

tree:18izm1m1ykx5ic.why: Every nation has a term (10:49), every term a decree (13:38), everything a measure (65:3). Same idea of a fixed appointment, two of them after an exception by God's will.
tree:18izm1m1ykx5ic.relation: Nothing comes early or late: God has set a term and measure for all.

tree:0x1ksju1h81rmc.why: Only God and the word for people are shared; hastening evil, opening mercy and striking parables are different subjects.

tree:17kk2ak1mf6ohg.why: God is your protector, said three times with three different endings: best of helpers (3:150), excellent protector and helper (8:40), the Knowing, the Wise (66:2). A clear memorizer set.
tree:17kk2ak1mf6ohg.relation: Rely on God as protector in battle, in doubt and in law.

tree:10uhn2a0sohcpa.why: 2:286 and 65:7: God does not burden a soul except with its capacity / with what He gave it. In 63:11 the verb is different ('God will not delay a soul').
tree:10uhn2a0sohcpa.relation: Duty is measured by capacity and by what God gave.

tree:1ogu8ql0efyv3z.why: Only the name of God followed by a particle is shared, in three unrelated sentences.

tree:044asrh0u13nd3.why: Only the name of God followed by a conjunction is shared, in three unrelated sentences.

tree:0o7btlp1e4qka5.why: Worshipping God alone and the deniers' reaction: Ad object to it (7:70), hearts recoil when He is mentioned alone (39:45), they disbelieved when He alone was called on (40:12).
tree:0o7btlp1e4qka5.relation: The disbelievers' aversion to God alone, across past and present peoples.

tree:1pnif941f5vspy.why: God keeps His promise: He fulfilled it at Uhud (3:152), He will not break it (22:47, 30:6). Close wording in three places.
tree:1pnif941f5vspy.relation: God's promise is always fulfilled, in victory and in punishment.

tree:1abpgr61gach4u.why: 7:131 and 7:187 both say it is with God, but most do not know (most of them or most people), and 6:111 ends most of them are ignorant. Small differences a memorizer must get right.

check.why: Keep is right: 7:131 and 7:187 differ only in 'most of them' versus 'most people', a real memorizer trap, and 6:111 adds the 'ignorant' variant.

tree:0s2x79v0v56ctt.why: Only the name of God followed by a particle is shared, in three unrelated sentences.

tree:0vxebzd0pclgjn.why: Denying God's signs (6:33, 40:63) and denying God's favour (16:71), with the same verb at the end. The run-on in 16:72 and 40:64 lists God's favours denied.
tree:0vxebzd0pclgjn.relation: They deny both God's signs and His favours.

tree:0a4ccgo015p4r0.why: Fear God and He will make for you a criterion (8:29), a way out (65:2), ease (65:4). Same promise in close wording, a memorizer set.
tree:0a4ccgo015p4r0.relation: Piety brings discernment, a way out and ease.

tree:0wih76a0p6n2ym.why: Did We not make...? The earth a container (77:25), a cradle (78:6), and two eyes for man (90:8). Short ayat a memorizer can swap.
tree:0wih76a0p6n2ym.relation: God's favours listed as questions that demand gratitude.

tree:1xmsbrx1bo6gl3.why: Three questions in at-Tawba: do they not know that...? Hellfire for opposing God (9:63), God knows their secrets (9:78), God accepts repentance (9:104). A memorizer set with a clear turn from threat to mercy.
tree:1xmsbrx1bo6gl3.relation: Warning and hope: God punishes opposition, knows secrets and accepts repentance.

tree:1jqsqks1qya6o4.why: 6:48 and 18:56 are near identical on messengers sent only as bearers of good news and warners; 25:20 says the messengers before were only men who ate food. Same frame about the messengers' nature.
tree:1jqsqks1qya6o4.relation: Messengers are human bearers of news, not angels or wonder workers.

tree:1qlah3003gxxzy.why: The weak among men, women and children in 4:75 and 4:98, and among children in 4:127: three rulings in an-Nisa on protecting the weak.
tree:1qlah3003gxxzy.relation: The weak have a claim on the believers' fighting, mercy and justice.

tree:0fsmi6z16siy3n.why: 6:158 and 16:33 are a classic pair: are they waiting for the angels to come, or your Lord, or His command? 25:21 has the deniers demanding angels or to see their Lord.
tree:0fsmi6z16siy3n.relation: They demand angels and God; when these come, it will be too late.

check.why: Keep is right: a classic pair, with a related demand for angels.

tree:0ebdn2j0m908dr.why: Manna and quails sent to the Children of Israel, told three times with small changes (on you or on them, sent down or brought down). A real memorizer trap in one story.
tree:0ebdn2j0m908dr.relation: The same favour recalled in three surahs, each followed by a different command.

tree:130sr2o0fvnem0.why: The hypocrite men and women named with the disbelievers or the idolaters for punishment, in three places with small differences. 33:73 also sets the believers' forgiveness beside them.
tree:130sr2o0fvnem0.relation: Hypocrites share the fate of open disbelievers.

tree:18u4l4p1g0kcjj.why: 2:80 and 3:24 quote the same claim, 'the Fire will not touch us except for numbered days', differing in one letter at the end, a classic memorizer pair. In 74:31 'the Fire' is part of 'the keepers of the Fire', object of 'We made', a different structure.
tree:18u4l4p1g0kcjj.relation: The false hope of a short punishment, and how it deceived them.

tree:1a2nckr13jfed9.why: Three ayat that end with the fire and how bad it is, each with a different noun: destination (2:126), abode of the wrongdoers (3:151), the watering place (11:98). A memorizer must place each.
tree:1a2nckr13jfed9.relation: The fire as destination, dwelling and drinking place of those who reject.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: the Fire and how evil it is, with three different nouns a memorizer must place.

tree:1emvk7r15c7f1x.why: 17:89 and 25:50 end identically: most people refused all but disbelief. In 10:19 the verb is 'were' ('people were not but one nation'), a different structure.
tree:1emvk7r15c7f1x.changes: Removed 10:19: a different verb and structure. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:1emvk7r15c7f1x.relation: Every example given, yet most refuse.

tree:04bf21i0jinhuw.why: Only the word for people and a preposition are shared; greed for life, envy and reciting the Quran slowly are unrelated.

tree:1wc741r0nxxc7h.why: Only the word for people followed by the name of God is shared; oaths, forgiving people and fearing people over God are different subjects.

tree:109ewqw1pkn3ew.why: 3:126 and 8:10 are a classic pair (Uhud and Badr): victory is only from God, with two different endings. In 8:72 the exception follows a duty ('you must help them, except against a people with a treaty'), a different structure and sense.
tree:109ewqw1pkn3ew.relation: Victory is only from God, whatever the angels or numbers.

check.why: Removing 8:72 is right: 'help, except' there is an obligation with an exception, not 'victory is only from God'.

tree:07yu8vd0suq7hl.why: Pharaoh asks for a tower to look for the god of Musa (28:38, 40:37), and the Samiri's people call the calf the god of Musa (20:88). Two mockeries of Musa's Lord.
tree:07yu8vd0suq7hl.relation: Pharaoh mocks the god of Musa; the calf worshippers replace Him with a calf.

check.why: Keep is right: 'the god of Musa' is mocked in each row, by Pharaoh and by the calf worshippers.

tree:1fnu5il0taymk7.why: One God: Yaqub's sons pledge to worship one God (2:133), the People of the Book were commanded to (9:31), and Quraysh mock that the gods became one (38:5).
tree:1fnu5il0taymk7.relation: One God, pledged by the prophets' sons, commanded to the scholars, mocked by the idolaters.

check.why: Keep is right: 'one God' is pledged, commanded and mocked, one theme.

tree:0atemjy14slz7y.why: The humiliating punishment for what they did: at death (6:93), Thamud's thunderbolt (41:17), and before the fire (46:20). Same phrase, different endings.
tree:0atemjy14slz7y.relation: Arrogance and lies are repaid with humiliation.

tree:0qmdbzb12b0o3d.why: Sailors pray sincerely at sea, then when He brings them safe to land: you turned away (17:67), they associate (29:65), some are moderate (31:32). A classic memorizer set.
tree:0qmdbzb12b0o3d.relation: Gratitude in danger, forgetting on safe land.

tree:0l2ernq0a78iuu.why: Three attitudes to the call to prayer: hypocrites stand up lazily (4:142), believers stand up and purify (5:6), disbelievers mock the call (5:58).
tree:0l2ernq0a78iuu.relation: How each group meets the prayer shows its faith.

check.why: Keep is right: three attitudes to the prayer, a real contrast.

tree:05vs8630ngkn2z.why: The phrase about returning to their families is shared, but Yusuf's brothers, the people struck by the Blast and the mockers have nothing in common beyond it.

check.why: Drop is right: only the phrase about returning to their families is shared.

tree:02svtj20k1atfe.why: 10:74 and 30:47 share a long clause: We sent messengers to their peoples and they came with clear proofs, then diverge. In 46:29 the words follow another verb (the jinn turned back to their people), a different structure.
tree:02svtj20k1atfe.relation: Messengers came with proofs; some peoples refused, and God helped the believers.

check.why: Removing 46:29 is right: there 'to their people' follows a different verb (they turned back), not 'We sent messengers'.

tree:0l4dxs914m9ltj.why: To Me is your return: and I will judge (3:55), and I will inform you (29:8, 31:15). 29:8 and 31:15 are both about not obeying parents in shirk. A memorizer set.
tree:0l4dxs914m9ltj.relation: Every dispute and every family conflict returns to God's judgement.

tree:05jbh3z1k43fkr.why: To Us is their return, said to console the Prophet in three places with three different continuations. A memorizer set with one meaning.
tree:05jbh3z1k43fkr.relation: Do not grieve over the deniers; their return is to God.

tree:00bpc851lt6uox.why: 30:33 and 39:8 are a close pair: when harm touches man he calls on his Lord, turning to Him; then when given favour he forgets. In 9:118 the words are 'no refuge from God except in Him; then He turned to them', a different structure.
tree:00bpc851lt6uox.relation: Turning to God in hardship and forgetting Him in ease.

tree:1i553et19casxz.why: 3:83 and 6:36 both close with all being returned to God. In 21:58 the verb is active ('that they might return to it', the idol), a different word and reference.
tree:1i553et19casxz.changes: Removed 21:58: an active verb about the idol. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:1i553et19casxz.relation: All are returned to God, willing or not.

tree:097oetf1eejv3t.why: Today you are repaid: with the humiliating punishment (6:93, 46:20), or for what you did (45:28). Close wording on the Day of reckoning.
tree:097oetf1eejv3t.relation: The day of repayment, with the cause named each time.

tree:05ubnvz0n3m3y5.why: 13:39 and 43:4 speak of the Mother of the Book with God. In 3:7 the phrase names the clear ayat that are the foundation of the Book, a different sense.
tree:05ubnvz0n3m3y5.changes: Removed 3:7: a different sense of the phrase. The row that reads on (13:40) is kept.
tree:05ubnvz0n3m3y5.relation: The source of all revelation is with God.

tree:1d1psj61o26lmi.why: Do you ask them for a payment? 23:72 tribute, 52:40 and 68:46 a wage, and the next ayah in both 52 and 68 is identical. A classic memorizer trap.
tree:1d1psj61o26lmi.relation: The Messenger asks nothing; they have no excuse.

tree:0j2jmo40753mwa.why: All three rows stay. 'Either ... or' is the same words and structure: the magicians' offer to Moses (7:115, 20:65, differing only at the end) and the choice given to Dhul-Qarnayn (18:86, either punish or treat well). Same words, different story.
tree:0j2jmo40753mwa.relation: Choices offered: the magicians to Moses, God to Dhul-Qarnayn.

tree:0dvtbv70ogr7c3.why: If guidance or messengers come to you, whoever follows will not fear or stray: 2:38 and 20:123 to Adam, 7:35 to his children. Classic memorizer set with one promise.
tree:0dvtbv70ogr7c3.relation: From the first descent, guidance is promised and following it is safety.

tree:0xmbjnv08omvnd.why: Your Lord's command (His punishment) has come: to Lut's people (11:76), to the destroyed nations (11:101), and the deniers wait for it (16:33). Same phrase and theme.
tree:0xmbjnv08omvnd.relation: When God's command comes, neither pleading nor idols avail.

tree:0lw03p303ao1vd.why: They disputed or split their affair among themselves: the magicians (20:62) and the nations who split the one religion (21:93, 23:53). A memorizer set; the splits differ in what follows.
tree:0lw03p303ao1vd.relation: Division over the truth, among Pharaoh's magicians and among nations after their prophets.

tree:1thcqj91wuiw53.why: 7:183 and 68:45 are the same short ayah: I give them respite, My plan is firm. 47:25 uses the same verb for the apostates given false hope.
tree:1thcqj91wuiw53.relation: God's respite is a firm plan, not a sign of His approval.

check.why: Keep is right: 7:183 and 68:45 are the same ayah, and the runOn flag is right.

tree:1rb56qv1adqfgl.why: We sent to nations before you, then: We seized them with hardship (6:42), Satan made their deeds seem fair (16:63); 29:18 says nations before denied too. Same theme on past nations.
tree:1rb56qv1adqfgl.relation: The Prophet is not the first to be denied; past nations did the same.

tree:00gkmg01ax0pgi.why: The call to believe and three answers: the wise answered and believed (3:193), the disciples said we believe (5:111), the wealthy hypocrites asked to stay behind (9:86).
tree:00gkmg01ax0pgi.relation: Contrast: the same call accepted by believers and dodged by hypocrites.

check.why: Keep is right: the same call to believe meets three answers.

tree:14w1f870a0btr7.why: Praise of Ibrahim in three places: tender and forbearing (9:114), forbearing, tender, turning to God (11:75), a nation in himself (16:120). The word order changes between 9:114 and 11:75, a known trap.
tree:14w1f870a0btr7.relation: The qualities that made Ibrahim a model.

tree:16e9uk21y1jkom.why: Tell me, if His punishment came to you: 6:40 and 6:47 open identically, 10:50 is close. Each then asks a different question. A memorizer set on one warning.
tree:16e9uk21y1jkom.relation: If punishment came suddenly, whom would you call on, and who would perish?

tree:0a2kl2s0y0aouu.why: I do not know whether what you are promised is near or far (21:109, 72:25), and I do not know, perhaps it is a trial (21:111). The Messenger's admission of not knowing the hour, worded close in each.
tree:0a2kl2s0y0aouu.relation: The Messenger does not know the time of the promise; only God does.

tree:0prablv10d4tdp.why: 27:19 and 46:15 share the same prayer: inspire me to thank Your favour on me and my parents and to do good that pleases You; then Solomon asks to join the righteous, the man of forty asks for good offspring. In 34:11 the verb is a command ('do'), a different word from 'that I do'.
tree:0prablv10d4tdp.changes: Removed 34:11: its verb is an imperative, a different word.
tree:0prablv10d4tdp.relation: Gratitude for parents' blessings and righteous work, prayed by a prophet and by any man at forty.

tree:05qxh681basgbq.why: The righteous: they drink from a cup mixed with camphor (76:5), they are in bliss (82:13, 83:22). Short ayat a memorizer can mix up, and 82:14 sets the wicked beside them.
tree:05qxh681basgbq.relation: Contrast: the righteous in bliss, the wicked in fire.

tree:0n09tho04lhz8i.why: If they stop: God is forgiving (2:192), no hostility except against wrongdoers (2:193), God sees what they do (8:39). 2:193 and 8:39 share a long command and differ at the end.
tree:0n09tho04lhz8i.relation: Fighting ends when persecution ends: the aim is not vengeance.

tree:1q9o5gp0k9vd7d.why: All three rows stay. 'That you enter' is the same words and structure: did you think you would enter Paradise before being tested (2:214, 3:142, a classic pair), and no blame that you enter uninhabited houses (24:29). Same words, different subject.
tree:1q9o5gp0k9vd7d.relation: Entering the Garden takes trials; entering houses has its manners.

tree:1nbxixx0r3jgpl.why: If you call them to guidance they do not follow (7:193) or do not hear (7:198), and 35:14 says the idols do not hear your call. Same words, the helplessness of false gods.
tree:1nbxixx0r3jgpl.relation: False gods neither hear nor answer.

tree:1msjk880ch198s.why: Only a verb of saying is shared; Harun's excuse, the Samiri's punishment and the regret of a soul on the Day are different sentences.

tree:0md7igv18sd801.why: Only a verb of standing is shared, in three senses: praying in the mosque, rising from a seat, the heavens standing firm.

tree:18szaky0sa5lhs.why: All three rows stay. 'That ... be sent down' is the same words in all three: the People of the Book ask that a book be sent down on them (4:153), the hypocrites fear a surah sent down on them (9:64), and food was lawful before the Torah was sent down (3:93). Same words, different subject.
tree:18szaky0sa5lhs.relation: What is sent down from God: demanded by some, dreaded by others, and the Torah that came after Israel's own rulings.

tree:0x2wzin0tyjesv.why: God's party will prevail (5:56) and succeed (58:22), Satan's party will lose (58:19). Same phrase, a clear contrast.
tree:0x2wzin0tyjesv.relation: Contrast: the party of God wins, the party of Satan loses.

tree:1isutiq097tkh8.why: Your Lord's punishment is to be feared (17:57), will surely come (52:7), is not safe from (70:28). Short closings a memorizer can mix up, one warning.
tree:1isutiq097tkh8.relation: No one is safe from God's punishment, not even the pious who fear it.

tree:1x4b1zp0dy6xx7.why: Pharaoh was arrogant in the land (10:83, 28:4), and he, Haman and their soldiers were sinners (28:8). Same story, the character of the tyrant.
tree:1x4b1zp0dy6xx7.relation: Pharaoh's arrogance and sin, which led to his fall.

tree:1n7051m0n35kic.why: Only a particle pair is shared; the disciples' table, the call between Paradise and Fire and the messengers' delivery are unrelated.

tree:1f2qw9r17t1wgv.why: If they deny you: messengers before you were denied (3:184), say your Lord's mercy is vast (6:147), say I have my deeds and you yours (10:41). Three answers to the same rejection.
tree:1f2qw9r17t1wgv.relation: How to answer denial: patience, a reminder of mercy and warning, and leaving them to their deeds.

tree:1svihav149ue69.why: Only a verb form about women is shared; the waiting period, inheritance shares and housing are separate rulings with no shared phrase.

tree:1a4r14t0n46m0n.why: For the God-fearing is a good return (38:49), gardens of bliss (68:34), success (78:31). Short ayat a memorizer can confuse, one promise.
tree:1a4r14t0n46m0n.relation: What is prepared for the God-fearing, described three ways.

tree:0xuua280ojicva.why: Only a conditional particle pair is shared; punishing the heirs of the land, the believers' hope and the jinn not knowing of Sulayman's death are different sentences.

tree:0tqfpfv15a3bj3.why: Lut's wish for strength (11:80) and the sinner's wish to return (39:58) share only two words, and 41:50 is a boast; the subjects differ.

check.why: Drop is right: only 'if only I had' is shared, with different subjects.

tree:1si9xgm11mjwlw.why: All three rows stay. 'Indeed what ...' is the same particle with the same relative in all three: what they call on besides Him is falsehood (22:62, 31:30, near-identical, differing by one pronoun), and what you are promised is coming (6:134). Same words and structure, different subject.
tree:1si9xgm11mjwlw.relation: What is false and what is sure: the idols are falsehood, God's promise will come.

tree:0pebcvq0h90woc.why: 94:5 and 94:6 repeat the promise 'with hardship comes ease', one with a linking letter and one without, a known point for memorizers. 6:19 has the same particle and preposition ('that with God there are other gods'), the same structure with another subject, so it stays. 94:6 appeared in two rows, which the rule of one place per ayah does not allow.
tree:0pebcvq0h90woc.changes: 94:6 now appears once: its own row, which still reads on into 94:7; the 94:5 row ends at 94:5. 6:19 stays.
tree:0pebcvq0h90woc.relation: With hardship, ease: said twice for certainty.

tree:1kpipdz0p5psvx.why: If We willed: a sign to humble them (26:4), the earth to swallow them (34:9), to drown them (36:43). Same opening, three displays of God's power.
tree:1kpipdz0p5psvx.relation: God could compel or destroy them at once, but gives respite.

tree:0ra84a31arwvvr.why: All three rows stay. 'That ... comes to you' is the same words and structure: before the punishment comes to you, in two parallel commands (39:54, 39:55), and the sign of his kingship is that the Ark comes to you (2:248). Same words, different subject.
tree:0ra84a31arwvvr.relation: What comes to people: a sign of tranquillity, or a sudden punishment if they delay turning back.

tree:0xsaugf07hwyux.why: Do you feel safe that He will not make the earth swallow you? 16:45, 17:68 and 67:16 with small changes. One warning, a memorizer set.
tree:0xsaugf07hwyux.relation: No one is safe from God's punishment on land or anywhere.

tree:1727wvg1wl0yb4.why: Hope that God forgives: the magicians (26:51), Ibrahim (26:82), and the believers asked if they do not love that God forgive them (24:22).
tree:1727wvg1wl0yb4.relation: Everyone hopes for forgiveness; 24:22 asks you to forgive others for it.

tree:1t9z5xr0eu1wtj.why: God's call to Musa told three times: I am God, there is no god but Me (20:14), the Mighty, the Wise (27:9), Lord of the worlds (28:30). A classic memorizer set.
tree:1t9z5xr0eu1wtj.relation: The same moment of revelation told with three names of God.

tree:0phag2o0ottymk.why: We sent it down: as an Arabic Quran (12:2), in a blessed night (44:3), in the Night of Decree (97:1). Short openings a memorizer can mix.
tree:0phag2o0ottymk.relation: The Quran's language and the night of its revelation.

tree:10u87890htxtap.why: I am the first of the Muslims (6:163), of the believers (7:143), of the worshippers (43:81). Same phrase, three speakers and contexts, a memorizer set.
tree:10u87890htxtap.relation: Being first in submission and faith.

tree:06jsrd51o57njr.why: 21:92 and 23:52 are near identical (I am your Lord, so worship Me or fear Me), and Pharaoh claims I am your Lord most high (79:24).
tree:06jsrd51o57njr.relation: Contrast: the true Lord calling to worship, and Pharaoh's false claim.

tree:1hwlwle1xmgzhu.why: I am not a guardian over you (6:104, 11:86) or a keeper (10:108): the messenger's duty is to deliver, not compel. A memorizer set with one ending changed.
tree:1hwlwle1xmgzhu.relation: Each person is responsible for their own guidance.

tree:13yatzf0kwnbtr.why: The chiefs insult three prophets with the same opening: we see you in clear error (Nuh, 7:60), in folly (Hud, 7:66), weak among us (Shuayb, 11:91).
tree:13yatzf0kwnbtr.relation: Every people sneered at its prophet in the same words.

tree:0owxrur1r7gu0h.why: We are with you, said by the hypocrites to their devils (2:14), by the believers waiting with the hypocrites (9:52), and by God to Musa and Harun (26:15).
tree:0owxrur1r7gu0h.relation: Contrast: the hypocrites' secret loyalty to devils, and God's company with His messengers.

check.why: Keep is right: 'we are with you' gives a real contrast between the hypocrites' loyalty and God's company.

tree:1o1f384144e2zu.why: All three rows stay. 'News of what' is the same word with the same relative: the news of what they mocked will reach them (6:5, 26:6, one word different), and We relate to you news of what has passed (20:99). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1o1f384144e2zu.relation: News of the past is told as a lesson; news of what they mocked will reach the mockers.

tree:0v4iqwk04j153q.why: All three rows stay. 'I will inform you of what' is the same verb and structure: to Me is your return and I will inform you of what you used to do (29:8, 31:15), and Jesus informs them of what they eat and store (3:49). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0v4iqwk04j153q.relation: Knowledge of what people hide: God's of their deeds, and Jesus' by God's leave.

tree:1r1mu7r1xu9kzd.why: Thamud (26:154) and the people of the Thicket (26:186) tell their prophets: you are only a man like us. In 35:23 God tells the Prophet: you are only a warner.
tree:1r1mu7r1xu9kzd.relation: Contrast: the deniers reduce the messenger to a man; God defines him as a warner.

check.why: Keep is right: 'you are only' gives a contrast between the deniers' view of the messenger and God's.

tree:1wyjz8w1vnnh0u.why: While you were looking on, ending three ayat: the sea parted (2:50), the thunderbolt (2:55), death at Uhud (3:143). A memorizer closing with one point: they saw it themselves.

tree:0xq09pm0405hic.why: Only a short relative phrase is shared; the testing of believers, God's knowledge and the idolaters unable to tempt are unrelated.

tree:04oumxp0547g7l.why: All three rows stay. 'You are to it ...' is the same words and structure: devoted to the idols (21:52), coming down into Hell (21:98), averse to it (11:28). Same words, different subject.
tree:04oumxp0547g7l.relation: Devoted to idols, averse to mercy, and arriving at Hell.

tree:0usa7ql0kdtqo7.why: Who sent down the Book is shared in three different arguments (the Torah of Musa, the excuse of the Arabs, the Book and the balance); the link is only a common phrase.

tree:0c8els11cikbwn.why: We believe in God and what was sent down to us, said to or about the People of the Book in 2:136, 5:59 and 29:46. Same creed, different followings, a memorizer set.
tree:0c8els11cikbwn.relation: The believers' creed: faith in all revelation, offered to the People of the Book.

tree:1wvtioy1vigxso.why: Belief in what was sent down to him is a common phrase; the Messenger's faith (2:285), the People of the Book's alliances (5:81) and the demand for an angel (25:7) are different subjects.

tree:16aed0013lhnw8.why: We sent down to you: a clear light (4:174), a Book with your remembrance (21:10), clear signs (24:34). Same opening, three descriptions of revelation.
tree:16aed0013lhnw8.relation: What God sent down: light, honour and clear signs.

tree:1t6qs9u0t88em6.why: Gratitude for the favour You bestowed on me: Sulayman (27:19) and the man of forty (46:15) in the same prayer, and Musa vowing never to help criminals (28:17).
tree:1t6qs9u0t88em6.relation: Thanks for God's favour shown in deeds: righteous work, and refusing to support wrong.

tree:0xbs0a20b4yeiu.why: Only a pronoun and a particle are shared; God's reckoning of hidden thoughts, killing yourselves and just testimony are unrelated.

tree:0qk1j6h1v0uzqr.why: He has only forbidden you carrion, blood and pork in 2:173 and 16:115 with tiny differences, and 7:33 lists what my Lord has truly forbidden: indecency, sin, shirk. A memorizer set and a lesson.
tree:0qk1j6h1v0uzqr.relation: The food prohibitions, and the greater prohibitions of the heart and tongue.

tree:1bytpst1gpceox.why: The hypocrites say we are only reformers (2:11) and we are only mocking (2:14); the two angels in Babylon say we are only a trial (2:102).
tree:1bytpst1gpceox.relation: Contrast: the hypocrites' excuses, and the angels' honest warning.

check.why: Keep is right: 'we are only' gives a contrast between the hypocrites' excuses and the angels' warning.

tree:0mt8lfe0ijdc4g.why: He was one who often turned to God, said of Dawud, Sulayman and Ayyub in surah Sad. One praise for three prophets, a memorizer refrain.
tree:0mt8lfe0ijdc4g.relation: What the three prophets share: turning back to God in every state.

tree:1jun73g0lp437k.why: He is aware of what they do (11:111), He sees what you do (11:112, 41:40). Neighbouring closings that a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1jun73g0lp437k.relation: God sees and repays every deed.

tree:06cnpz90vc1e01.why: Only a pronoun and a helper verb are shared; Yunus's glorification and two statements of the jinn are unrelated.

tree:0wjuroo1v5rmsw.why: It is the truth, sworn by my Lord (10:53), by the Lord of heaven and earth (51:23), and called certain truth (69:51). Same assurance in three places.
tree:0wjuroo1v5rmsw.relation: The promise and the Quran are sworn to be true.

tree:0rzryi1108q27r.why: It is the word of a noble messenger, identical in 69:40 and 81:19, and a decisive word in 86:13. The run-ons show how each surah continues differently.
tree:0rzryi1108q27r.relation: The Quran is not a poet's or a soothsayer's word but a decisive message.

tree:0627ohv18gcu07.why: Three rules of recompense opening the same way: whoever associates others with God, Paradise is forbidden (5:72); whoever fears and is patient, his reward is kept (12:90); whoever comes as a criminal, Hell (20:74).
tree:0627ohv18gcu07.relation: God's fixed rules: shirk and crime lead to the fire, patience and piety are rewarded.

check.why: Keep is right: three rules of recompense open the same way.

tree:0prz19v07iphkb.why: He knows the secret and what is hidden (20:7), the spoken and what you conceal (21:110, 87:7). Close wording, one attribute.
tree:0prz19v07iphkb.relation: Nothing said or hidden escapes God.

tree:16ezgdu0gk84ww.why: Musa's three answers about the cow, each opening He says it is a cow, then its age, its colour, its use. Consecutive ayat in one story, a classic memorizer progression.
tree:16ezgdu0gk84ww.relation: Every question they asked made the task stricter.

tree:03wu0sz1jym5sr.why: All three rows stay. 'That they are in ...' is the same words and structure: in the Hereafter they are the (greatest) losers (11:22, 16:109, one word different), and the poets wander in every valley (26:225). Same words, different subject.
tree:03wu0sz1jym5sr.relation: Losers in the Hereafter, and poets lost in every valley.

tree:05xoc341o9hwy0.why: Only a negation particle is shared; Christians not being arrogant, the defiant not believing and destroyed towns not returning are unrelated.

tree:1ddlg510fwszoh.why: Only a negation particle is shared; three different statements about deniers and treaty breakers.

tree:0rke7u80993d50.why: All three rows stay. 11:110 and 41:45 are the same ayah on Moses' Book and the dispute over it; 15:72 has the same words and structure ('indeed they are in their intoxication'). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0rke7u80993d50.relation: Doubt about the Book and the stupor of Lot's people: both lost.

tree:19qpwqw1xetefy.why: Only I see is shared: Satan seeing the angels, the king's dream and Ibrahim's dream have no closer link.

tree:135jy7w0k88fj2.why: God tells the angels I know what you do not (2:30), then reminds them (2:33); Yaqub echoes the same words when Yusuf's shirt arrives (12:96).
tree:135jy7w0k88fj2.relation: Knowledge from God answers doubts, for the angels and for Yaqub.

tree:13aorqj1mmej9h.why: All three rows stay. 'Indeed I do not ...' is the same words and structure: Moses has power only over himself and his brother (5:25), the Prophet has no power to harm or guide (72:21), and 'in My presence the messengers do not fear' (27:10). Same words, different subject.
tree:13aorqj1mmej9h.relation: The limits of the messengers: no power over others, and no fear before God.

tree:0yoxut70jktnb1.why: How can they have it now? Reaching faith from far away (34:52), remembrance when a messenger already came (44:13), remembrance when the Hour has come (47:18).
tree:0yoxut70jktnb1.relation: Remembrance and faith come too late once the punishment or the Hour arrives.

tree:0k0p7e709i4ejf.why: Nuh told to carry his family except the one already sentenced (11:40, 23:27), and Lut's family saved except his wife (29:33). Same exception in two rescue stories.
tree:0k0p7e709i4ejf.relation: Family ties do not save the one who rejects: Nuh's son and Lut's wife.

tree:0mkzcp31hlxmcx.why: 21:76 and 37:76 are nearly identical: Noah and his family saved from the great distress, with different continuations. In 2:126 'its people, of' follows 'provide' and 'of' means 'of the fruits', a different verb and sense.
tree:0mkzcp31hlxmcx.changes: Removed 2:126: a different governing verb and sense. The rows that read on are kept.

tree:0yvk20a18zsnbo.why: All three rows stay. 'Or intends' is the same words and structure in all three: if He intends harm or intends mercy for you (33:17), harm or benefit (48:11), and for whoever intends to remember or intends gratitude (25:62). Same words, different subject.
tree:0yvk20a18zsnbo.relation: God's intention decides harm and mercy; man's intention decides whether he remembers and thanks.

tree:160xqw90hxg3gn.why: Like this, or even more: hearts as hard as stone or harder (2:74), remember God as your fathers or more (2:200), fear people as God or more (4:77). The same comparison of degree, each a lesson.
tree:160xqw90hxg3gn.relation: Hardness, remembrance and fear: the measure says where the heart is.

tree:06sx26o0hby1ta.why: All three rows stay. 'Or that' is the same words and structure: Moses and Aaron fear Pharaoh will act hastily or transgress (20:45), Pharaoh fears Moses will change their religion or spread corruption (40:26), and Shu'ayb's people ask whether his prayer commands them to leave their gods or not do as they wish with their wealth (11:87). Same words, different subject.
tree:06sx26o0hby1ta.relation: Each side fears the other: the prophets fear tyranny, the tyrants fear change.

tree:10ilsqu1no4g40.why: Whether you reveal or hide it: God will account for it (2:284), forgive it (4:149), know it (33:54). Same opening with three endings, one meaning.
tree:10ilsqu1no4g40.relation: What is hidden and what is shown are the same to God.

tree:1m7f4rn02vpmut.why: The deniers' demand that the Prophet have a garden: 17:91 and 25:8, with 'for you' and 'for him'. In 12:85 the verb is second person ('or you become of those who perish'), not 'a garden be': a different word.
tree:1m7f4rn02vpmut.changes: Removed 12:85: the verb is second person, a different word.
tree:1m7f4rn02vpmut.relation: The demand for a garden as proof, asked twice.

check.why: Removing 12:85 is right: there 'or you become' takes a predicate (among the perishing), a different structure from 'or you have a garden'.

tree:0zzjmw41te8uk8.why: Only a short particle pair is shared; punishment from above or below, revelation from behind a veil and fighting behind walls are unrelated.

tree:1nf0z0b07rb4jp.why: Or the punishment comes on them: from where they do not perceive (16:45), face to face (18:55), of a barren day (22:55). One warning with three endings.
tree:1nf0z0b07rb4jp.relation: The punishment can come in any form, at any time.

tree:15y2a2o0bfltx0.why: Only a demonstrative and a negation are shared; barring mosques, hiding the Book and self-defence are unrelated.

tree:1eqt68c007zb3k.why: Their refuge is Hell: with an evil end (4:97), no escape (4:121), for what they earned (10:8). Close wording with three endings, a memorizer set.
tree:1eqt68c007zb3k.relation: The end of those who wrong themselves, follow Satan or are content with this world.

tree:00fv6gr0ykmrx7.why: They swore by God with their strongest oaths: if a sign came (6:109), if you commanded them (24:53), if a warner came (35:42). Classic memorizer set, one lesson.
tree:00fv6gr0ykmrx7.relation: Strong oaths that were never kept.

tree:1n4hhv40vrkbve.why: They incurred wrath from God, said of the Children of Israel in 2:61 and 3:112 with near identical clauses, and wrath upon wrath in 2:90. A memorizer set in one theme.
tree:1n4hhv40vrkbve.relation: Rejecting signs and killing prophets brought wrath upon wrath.

tree:1x889c71mpyr4v.why: By their Lord's permission is a common phrase; bringing people to light, entering gardens and the angels descending are different subjects.

check.why: Drop is right: 'by their Lord's permission' is a common phrase across different subjects.

tree:13qmgjx0dtj90d.why: Evil is the abode of the wrongdoers (3:151) and of the arrogant (39:72, 40:76). 39:72 and 40:76 are near identical, and the run-on in 39:73 sets the righteous entering Paradise beside them.
tree:13qmgjx0dtj90d.relation: Contrast: the arrogant led to Hell's gates, the God-fearing to Paradise.

check.why: Keep is right: 39:72 and 40:76 are near identical, and 3:151 varies the ending.

tree:1a05ctv0lxew4j.why: In sin and aggression: the Israelites helping against their own (2:85), and secret talk in sin and aggression in 58:8 and 58:9, where believers are told to talk in righteousness instead.
tree:1a05ctv0lxew4j.relation: Cooperation in sin, against cooperation in righteousness and piety.

tree:12vf58a1562fh8.why: They denied the truth when it came to them, in 6:5, 29:68 and 50:5, each with a different consequence. A memorizer set on one charge.
tree:12vf58a1562fh8.relation: Denying the truth when it arrives leads to confusion, punishment and Hell.

tree:1qre2wb1et226z.why: Only with the truth followed by a particle is shared; the Book, leaving for Badr and the creation of the heavens are different subjects.
