tree:0frft9l0miwm4r.why: In David's story the disputants ask him to judge with truth and not be unjust (38:22), then God tells him to judge with truth and not follow desire (38:26). In 25:68 'except by right, and they do not commit adultery' is a statement with a different sense of 'by right'.
tree:0frft9l0miwm4r.changes: Removed 25:68: a different structure and sense.
tree:0frft9l0miwm4r.relation: The disputants' plea and God's command to David in the same words: judge with truth.

tree:0bqi98t0hoizib.why: All three rows stay. 'With the truth, while they ...' is the same words and structure: a Book that speaks with truth and they are not wronged (23:62), judged with truth and not wronged (39:69), and whoever bore witness to the truth while they know (43:86). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0bqi98t0hoizib.relation: Truth on the Day: the Book speaks it, judgment follows it, and only those who witnessed it can intercede.

tree:14nbzyl0s0sa7z.why: Being pleased with the worldly life: the believers who were reluctant to march (9:38), those who do not hope to meet God (10:7), and those who rejoiced in it (13:26). One danger, three groups.
tree:14nbzyl0s0sa7z.relation: Contentment with this world, a warning even to believers.

check.why: Keep is right: contentment with the worldly life, one danger shown in three groups.

tree:0gjq1w70epcywb.why: In the mornings and evenings: remember your Lord (7:205), their shadows prostrate (13:15), men glorify Him in the mosques (24:36). Same closing for the remembrance of all creation.
tree:0gjq1w70epcywb.relation: All creation, shadows and men, glorify God morning and evening.

tree:1c8z8v60tdn4ww.why: With justice, and do not...: in testimony (5:8), in the measure (11:85), in the weighing (55:9). Same structure, one command to be just.
tree:1c8z8v60tdn4ww.relation: Justice in speech, in trade, and in the balance of the universe.

tree:17hiafh14xax0h.why: 31:33 and 35:5 end alike: do not let the worldly life deceive you, nor the deceiver about God. 57:14 shows the hypocrites who were deceived by him.
tree:17hiafh14xax0h.relation: The warning, then those who ignored it and were deceived.

tree:0b9gr8k0ic43b8.why: By God followed by a conditional particle is shared by chance; oaths of hypocrites, witnesses to a will and the owner of the garden are unrelated.

tree:0fhrysf1mg4i5n.why: By God followed by a preposition is shared; Yusuf's creed, seeking refuge and apostasy are unrelated.

tree:1g2lj1b02ko8mb.why: 4:38 and 9:29 share the stock phrase about not believing in God and the Last Day, but the subjects differ (show-off spenders and the People of the Book). 16:127 is unrelated.

tree:0tyuqjy0o23gbo.why: Kindness to parents follows the command to worship God alone in 4:36, 6:151 and 17:23, then each goes its own way. A classic memorizer set and a lesson in priorities.
tree:0tyuqjy0o23gbo.relation: Right after God's right comes the parents' right.

tree:1rs66so0pbaxiw.why: Give the hypocrites news that theirs is a painful punishment (4:138), give the believers news that theirs is great bounty (33:47), and the believers' bargain: theirs is Paradise (9:111).
tree:1rs66so0pbaxiw.relation: Contrast: the same words of news bring punishment to hypocrites and bounty to believers.

check.why: Keep is right: 'that theirs is' brings punishment in one row and bounty in the others, a clear contrast.

tree:10gwaio0chh9dk.why: All three rows stay. 2:61 and 3:112 share a long clause: that is because they used to disbelieve in God's signs and kill the prophets. 9:66 has the same words and structure, 'because they were criminals'. Same words, different subject.
tree:10gwaio0chh9dk.relation: The cause behind the punishment: disbelief, killing prophets, crime.

tree:0f9dugh0fcox65.why: In what statement after this will they believe? 7:185 and 77:50 identical, 45:6 adds after God and His signs. A memorizer set; the run-on from 77:50 into 78:1 crosses into a new surah and adds nothing.
tree:0f9dugh0fcox65.relation: If they reject the Quran, nothing else will convince them.

tree:1pxbi8v1m49bwh.why: Who is more unjust than one reminded of his Lord's signs who turns away (18:57, 32:22), and the punishment for one who did not believe in his Lord's signs (20:127). Same theme with a known memorizer difference.
tree:1pxbi8v1m49bwh.relation: Turning away from the signs of one's Lord is the worst injustice.

tree:1wvnk8j134fm4t.why: All three rows stay. 27:81 and 30:53 are the same ayah: you make hear only those who believe in Our signs, so they submit. 27:83, two ayat later in the same surah, has the same words and structure: 'those who deny Our signs, so they are driven'. Same words, opposite subject: a real slip for a reciter. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1wvnk8j134fm4t.relation: Contrast: believers in Our signs submit; deniers of Our signs are driven in ranks.

tree:1o5fcl81vmfmj6.why: 7:136 and 7:146 share a whole clause, but that pair is already kept as its own compare card; 43:69 shares only two words and is about believers.

tree:0glema718a0tgj.why: Doing evil in ignorance, then repenting: accepted (4:17), forgiven (6:54, 16:119). Close wording in three places, one promise of mercy.
tree:0glema718a0tgj.relation: Repentance after sin done in ignorance is always open.

tree:0ndhlbk0p9psbm.why: Isa supported with the Holy Spirit, in 2:87 and 2:253 with the same clause, and God reminding him of it in 5:110. Same favour, different continuations.
tree:0ndhlbk0p9psbm.relation: Isa's support from God, met with rejection and division.

tree:0matej40cgv00m.why: In the name of God: opening the Fatiha (1:1), Sulayman's letter (27:30), and Nuh's ship setting sail (11:41). One phrase that begins a book, a letter and a voyage.
tree:0matej40cgv00m.relation: Every important start is made in God's name.

tree:0sz76ix0zt2ahd.why: Give news to those who believe (2:25, 10:2), and give news of a painful punishment to those who disbelieve (9:3). Same command, a sharp contrast.
tree:0sz76ix0zt2ahd.relation: Contrast: good news for believers, and the same word used for the deniers' punishment.

tree:1b5cdsi1aau0ga.why: God will test you with something of fear and hunger (2:155), or of the game while in ihram (5:94). In 2:255 'anything of His knowledge' follows 'they do not encompass', a different governing verb and sense.
tree:1b5cdsi1aau0ga.relation: Tests come in small portions: fear, hunger, game within reach.

tree:19f0i1805wgcha.why: The wombs of your mothers: you came out knowing nothing (16:78), created stage after stage (39:6), He knew you then, so do not claim purity (53:32). One reminder of our origin.
tree:19f0i1805wgcha.relation: Remember where you came from: gratitude and humility.

check.why: Keep is right: 'the wombs of your mothers' is one reminder of our origin.

tree:0w32am51x8r6zh.why: Only the verb for God sending is shared; prophets, a crow and the mockers' question are unrelated.

tree:1a65jei0i7mree.why: When mercy follows hardship, people plot (10:21), boast (11:10) or claim it is theirs (41:50). Close wording in three places, one lesson about ingratitude.

tree:0r4ocq70vtywjt.why: Were it not for God repelling people by one another, the earth would be corrupted (2:251) and places of worship destroyed (22:40). In 6:53 the words follow another verb ('We tried some by others'), a different sense.
tree:0r4ocq70vtywjt.relation: God's checking of people by people protects the earth and places of worship.

tree:1qd7soz15wb5g3.why: Only a reciprocal pronoun pair is shared; nations destroyed one after another, deceivers and social ranks are unrelated.

tree:0not0rl1szeumt.why: Unless they commit a clear indecency, in three rulings on women: inheritance (4:19), the Prophet's wives (33:30), and divorce (65:1). Same phrase, a memorizer set.
tree:0not0rl1szeumt.relation: Clear indecency changes the ruling in each case.

tree:1r0a1cc0omjw5k.why: Rather they said: muddled dreams, a forgery, a poet (21:5); what the earlier peoples said (23:81); we found our fathers on a way (43:22). The deniers' excuses side by side.
tree:1r0a1cc0omjw5k.relation: Every excuse of the deniers is borrowed from those before them.

check.why: Keep is right: 'rather they said' sets the deniers' excuses side by side.

tree:0nsm8ws06zmzn8.why: Only a short connective phrase is shared; not hoping for resurrection, worshipping the jinn and not understanding are different charges in different scenes.

tree:0rnp2v50d3ax65.why: Rather they denied: what they could not grasp (10:39), the Hour (25:11), the truth when it came (50:5). Same opening, three things denied.
tree:0rnp2v50d3ax65.relation: The deniers rejected the Quran, the Hour and the truth.

tree:1b8l9wy0hq5cuw.why: Rather we are deprived, identical in 56:67 and 68:27 (crops and the garden lost), and rather we are bewitched in 15:15. Short sentences a memorizer can mix.
tree:1b8l9wy0hq5cuw.relation: Those who lose their crops admit loss; those shown signs claim magic.

tree:04x1kan16isakl.why: Belief in the meeting with their Lord: the purpose of Musa's Book (6:154), denied by many (30:8, 32:10). Same phrase, a clear contrast.
tree:04x1kan16isakl.relation: The Book was given so people would believe in meeting God; many still deny it.

tree:1k9gzac0vv2naw.why: Yes indeed, whoever earns evil (2:81), whoever submits to God (2:112), whoever keeps his promise (3:76). Same reply to the People of the Book's claims, three rules of reward.
tree:1k9gzac0vv2naw.relation: Salvation depends on deeds, not lineage.

tree:1yutn8m0ybxyhc.why: The martyrs rejoice in what God gave them of His bounty (3:170), the misers withhold what God gave them (3:180), and the righteous enjoy what their Lord gave (52:18).
tree:1yutn8m0ybxyhc.relation: Contrast: what God gives brings joy to the grateful and a collar to the miser.

tree:1thafne084q8v4.why: 23:53 and 30:32 end the same: each faction rejoices in what it has. In 72:28 the words follow 'He encompasses', a different governing verb.
tree:1thafne084q8v4.changes: Removed 72:28: a different governing verb. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:1thafne084q8v4.relation: Sects each rejoicing in their own share.

tree:0nck8861h7oyri.why: God knows what they do, closing 10:36, 24:41 and 39:70 with small changes (God is knowing, He knows best). A memorizer closing set.
tree:0nck8861h7oyri.relation: God knows every deed: of the doubters, the glorifiers and all souls.

tree:0dg6sxy1cvtdpk.why: God comforts the Prophet about what they say: your chest tightens (15:97), We know best what they say (20:104, 50:45).
tree:0dg6sxy1cvtdpk.relation: God knows what the deniers say, so the Prophet need not grieve.

tree:1a14gtv1flo6pt.why: Retain them honourably or release them: 2:229, 2:231 and 65:2, with a different verb each time. A memorizer set in the divorce rulings.
tree:1a14gtv1flo6pt.relation: Whether staying together or parting, it must be with kindness.

tree:0tkx3ti1kphkgw.why: 15:88 and 20:131 both say: do not extend your eyes to what We gave some of them to enjoy, then differ. In 20:53 the word means pairs of plants, a different sense.
tree:0tkx3ti1kphkgw.changes: Removed 20:53: a different sense of the word.
tree:0tkx3ti1kphkgw.relation: Do not envy what others enjoy.

check.why: Removing 20:53 is right: there the word means kinds of plants, a different word sense from groups of people.

tree:0uhc89e1aygwci.why: 3:91 and 13:18: even if they had the earth's worth to ransom themselves, theirs is a painful punishment / an evil reckoning. In 39:33 the two words only meet across a clause boundary after another verb ('believed in it; those are the righteous').
tree:0uhc89e1aygwci.changes: Removed 39:33: a different governing verb, the words only touch.

tree:0js9iye1501tai.why: The accusation that the messenger is possessed: by Nuh's people (23:25), and by Quraysh in 23:70 and 34:8, each answered with rather. Same charge, one theme.
tree:0js9iye1501tai.relation: Calling the messenger mad is the old answer to a truth people dislike.

tree:0h1xnkx0dyfbwv.why: Only a pronoun and the word until are shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:0tog03l0j1u3hl.why: Do not associate anything with Him: the call to the People of the Book (3:64), and the commandments in 4:36 and 6:151, both followed by kindness to parents.
tree:0tog03l0j1u3hl.relation: Tawhid comes first in every call and every list of commands.

tree:19b66g70q65ksp.why: 6:145 and 16:115 list the same forbidden foods and the same exception for one forced by need, ending 'your Lord' / 'God is forgiving'. In 72:13 the words follow another verb ('we believed in it; whoever believes'), a different structure.
tree:19b66g70q65ksp.relation: Mercy built into the law: necessity lifts the ban.

check.why: Removing 72:13 is right: a different verb follows 'whoever'.

tree:1o89gjh08vyd7t.why: Only a pronoun and a relative particle are shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:1d2hnru095bhku.why: All three rows stay. 'In Him / in it, believers' is the same words and structure: fear God in whom you believe (5:88, 60:11), and Salih's followers: we believe in what he was sent with (7:75). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1d2hnru095bhku.relation: Belief named as the ground of fearing God, and belief declared against the arrogant.

tree:0fdmmpv05ppicf.why: Rain bringing out plants: as a sign of God's bounty (6:99), and as a parable of the brief worldly life (10:24, 18:45), which are near identical.
tree:0fdmmpv05ppicf.relation: The same rain is a sign of life and a parable of how quickly life ends.

tree:1i2ng6h0078o3n.why: 4:48 and 4:116 are identical until the last words (has invented a great sin / has gone far astray), a classic memorizer pair. In 57:28 the words only meet across a clause after another verb ('a light you walk by, and He forgives you').
tree:1i2ng6h0078o3n.changes: Removed 57:28: a different governing verb, the words only touch.
tree:1i2ng6h0078o3n.relation: Shirk is the one sin not forgiven; all else is at His will.

check.why: Removing 57:28 is right: it shares only a common verb, in a different sentence.

tree:1bwwot70ea5mjv.why: All three rows stay. 'By it, or' is the same structure in all three: a noun with a clause ending 'by it', then 'or' and a second noun. After a bequest made or a debt (4:11, 4:12, with changing pronouns), and hearts to reason with or ears to hear with (22:46). Same words and structure, different subject.
tree:1bwwot70ea5mjv.relation: The inheritance formula repeated with each heir; and the faculties given to understand.

tree:0p5vtbm0l7hyp4.why: All three rows stay. 9:55 and 9:85 are near twins (God means to punish them by it in this life), a known trap. 6:97 has the same words and structure, 'to be guided by them in the darkness'. Same words, different subject.
tree:0p5vtbm0l7hyp4.relation: The same things can be a means of guidance (the stars) or of punishment (wealth and children).

tree:099ipqj1fl7rb5.why: Only a pronoun followed by say is shared; three unrelated arguments.

tree:0wjmklw1mozdos.why: Do they feel safe from God making the earth swallow them (16:45, 34:9)? On the Day the disbelievers will wish the earth were levelled over them (4:42).
tree:0wjmklw1mozdos.relation: They fear no swallowing now, but will wish for it on the Day.

check.why: Keep is right: the earth swallowing or being levelled over them, the same theme.

tree:1w3mga21wk2gi8.why: Livestock as God's provision: permitted (5:1), and named in sacrifice in 22:28 and 22:34, which share a long clause and then differ. A memorizer set.
tree:1w3mga21wk2gi8.relation: Livestock are a gift to be eaten and offered in God's name.

tree:0yzo9170ovxmsj.why: Only between you followed by the name of God is shared; three unrelated sentences.

check.why: Drop is right: only 'between you' and a divine name are shared.

tree:06hcf9i0964j6o.why: All three rows stay. 'Between them with justice' is the same words in all three: judgment between them in justice, and they are not wronged (10:47, 10:54), and the command 'judge between them with justice' (5:42). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:06hcf9i0964j6o.relation: Justice between people: commanded of the Prophet, done by God on the Day.

tree:1mf1qkl05bvw3f.why: Between me and you is a common phrase; the parting of Khidr and Musa, Musa's contract and the regretful companion are unrelated.

tree:0drbszg0noolrw.why: Belief and denial of the Day of Judgement in three short ayat: those who affirm it (70:26), we used to deny it (74:46), those who deny it (83:11).
tree:0drbszg0noolrw.relation: Contrast: those who believe in the Day and those who deny it.

tree:0j42etp05agn2n.why: God turning to them in mercy appears in three different stories with nothing more shared: the Israelites' blindness, the Tabuk expedition and charity before private talks.

tree:0ctf45t1nzggkl.why: All three rows stay. 'So He turned to you' is the same words in all three: God knew you could not keep it, so He turned to you and eased the rule (2:187, 73:20, a rare shared structure), and the repentance for the calf (2:54). Same words, different subject.
tree:0ctf45t1nzggkl.relation: God turns to people both by accepting repentance and by easing what they cannot bear.

tree:1mb6ti919xteuz.why: The Hour coming suddenly: it will stun them (21:40), while they are unaware (43:66), and its signs have already come (47:18). Close wording, one warning.
tree:1mb6ti919xteuz.relation: The Hour comes suddenly, and its signs are already here.

tree:0643qip0muejcv.why: All three rows stay. 'By God, certainly' is the same oath in all three: Joseph's brothers swear twice (12:73, 12:91), and God swears that He sent messengers to nations before (16:63). Same words, different speaker.
tree:0643qip0muejcv.relation: Oaths by God: the brothers' denial, their confession, and God's own word about past nations.

tree:07qr7yq1v3h0cu.why: Blessed is God: Lord of the worlds (7:54, 40:64) and best of creators (23:14), each after describing creation. A memorizer set.
tree:07qr7yq1v3h0cu.relation: Every account of creation ends in praise of the Creator.

tree:0u71q160lzi4ci.why: God's answer to Iblis about those who follow him, told three times with different wording (7:18, 17:63, 38:85). Same story, a memorizer trap.
tree:0u71q160lzi4ci.relation: Whoever follows Satan shares his fate.

tree:0vh5w550xfkxsh.why: When it became clear to him: the man raised after a hundred years confessed God's power (2:259), Ibrahim disowned his father (9:114), while another opposes the Messenger after guidance is clear (4:115).
tree:0vh5w550xfkxsh.relation: What a person does once the truth is clear decides his end.

check.why: Keep is right: what a person does once the truth becomes clear, the same theme in all three.

tree:0boudpn0sbh7ul.why: If you are patient and fear God (3:186), do good and fear Him (4:128), make peace and fear Him (4:129): each ends with a reassurance. 4:128 and 4:129 are adjacent, a memorizer set.
tree:0boudpn0sbh7ul.relation: Piety with patience, kindness or reconciliation is never lost.

tree:17qao3x1lz09fj.why: Freeing a slave as expiation: for accidental killing (4:92), broken oaths (5:89), and zihar (58:3). Same ruling across three sins.
tree:17qao3x1lz09fj.relation: Freeing a slave is the first expiation in several sins.

tree:1f51y3t18vp9v7.why: Only a verb of coming out and a preposition are shared; words from mouths, the olive tree and fruits from sheaths are unrelated.

tree:04ymlm10ycltmf.why: Humiliation covering them: 68:43 and 70:44 share a whole clause (eyes downcast, humiliation covering them), and 10:27 says the same of evildoers. A memorizer set.
tree:04ymlm10ycltmf.relation: The humiliation of the deniers on the Day.

tree:1lo8et508whkm9.why: You see the earth lifeless then quivering with life when rain falls (22:5, 41:39), both as proof of resurrection; 18:47 shows the earth laid bare on the Day itself.
tree:1lo8et508whkm9.relation: The earth revived by rain is a picture of the resurrection to come.

tree:0tn3xg11qx9flj.why: Come to: a common word with the People of the Book (3:64), and to what God revealed and to the Messenger (4:61, 5:104), which share a clause and differ in the refusal.
tree:0tn3xg11qx9flj.relation: The invitation to revelation, refused by hypocrites and by those who follow their fathers.

tree:1q36d8l1w2bc5n.why: The two Zakariyya ayat (3:41, 19:10) are already kept as their own compare card; 5:110 is Isa speaking in the cradle, another story, so this tree adds nothing.

tree:1232fux08z9lil.why: Only a verb of being and a preposition are shared; distress at plots, a mustard seed in a rock and doubt about meeting Musa are unrelated.

tree:153rp491azogkd.why: 2:193 and 8:39 are a close pair: fight them until there is no persecution and religion is (all) for God, differing by one word. In 5:71 the word means a trial that would follow their sin ('they thought there would be no trial'), a different sense.
tree:153rp491azogkd.changes: Removed 5:71: a different sense of the word.
tree:153rp491azogkd.relation: Fighting has an end: when persecution stops and religion is God's.

check.why: Removing 5:71 is right: there the particle differs ('that there would be no trial' rather than 'until there is no persecution'), and so does the sense.

tree:1fog68z1mj6x8l.why: Do not be among X is a common pattern; fair measure (26:181) and avoiding shirk (30:31) are different subjects, and 12:9 is a different construction.

tree:1f0e10a1ucyqf6.why: The staff swallows what they faked (7:117, 26:45) or what they made (20:69). Same moment told three times, with the run-ons showing the outcome.
tree:1f0e10a1ucyqf6.relation: The truth swallows the magicians' falsehood.

tree:11b35im1t8omyi.why: Turn in repentance: to your Maker after the calf (2:54), to God all of you believers (24:31), with sincere repentance (66:8). Same command to sinners and to believers.
tree:11b35im1t8omyi.relation: Repentance is asked of everyone, not only the worst sinners.

tree:1pyio6h0r124wf.why: Turning away from a messenger: the believers told not to (8:20), Ibrahim's people did (37:90), and Quraysh did, calling him a taught madman (44:14).
tree:1pyio6h0r124wf.relation: The believers are warned not to do what past peoples did to their messengers.

check.why: Keep is right: turning away from a messenger, the same theme in all three.

tree:02eiaou0ryrz3y.why: A large group from the earlier generations, then a few from the later (56:13-14, the foremost) and a large group from the later (56:39-40, those on the right). The run-on is the point.
tree:02eiaou0ryrz3y.relation: The foremost are mostly from the early generations; those on the right come from both.

tree:1jzl66q0vs3sa4.why: Then We drowned the others (26:66, 37:82) and the rest after (26:120). Short endings to the stories of Musa and Nuh, a memorizer trap.
tree:1jzl66q0vs3sa4.relation: The deniers drowned in the stories of Musa and Nuh.

tree:0lwqjs30tuzopf.why: Then to Us is your or their return, after the brief enjoyment of this world (10:23, 10:70) and after death (29:57). A memorizer set on one truth.
tree:0lwqjs30tuzopf.relation: Every soul returns to God after a short life.

tree:1bc6jdu0cp0dki.why: All three rows stay. 'Then you ...' is the same words and structure in all three: God's favours end with 'yet you doubt' (6:2) and 'yet you associate' (6:64), and 'then you are those who kill one another' (2:85). Same words, different subject.
tree:1bc6jdu0cp0dki.relation: After every favour, the people turn: doubt, shirk, killing their own.

tree:1kp3pw60mocmmi.why: Then He made: strength after weakness and weakness after strength (30:54), offspring from a fluid (32:8), a mate from one soul (39:6). All describe the stages of human creation.
tree:1kp3pw60mocmmi.relation: Man is made in stages, each by God's design.

check.why: Keep is right: 'then He made' describes the stages of human creation in all three.

tree:1ksfgvr1ny7h9x.why: Only then he or it was is shared; the end of evildoers, a clot of blood and joining the believers are unrelated.

tree:0vayomm1nn32tm.why: The reward of this world: given to whoever wants it (3:145), given with the better reward of the next (3:148), both are with God (4:134). Close wording on one theme.
tree:0vayomm1nn32tm.relation: Seek the Hereafter and this world comes with it.

tree:17rpj0q0a2zmye.why: Better in reward and better in outcome, hope, or return (18:44, 18:46, 19:76). 18:46 and 19:76 share the lasting good deeds. A memorizer set.
tree:17rpj0q0a2zmye.relation: Lasting good deeds are better than wealth and children.

tree:1yr546c0riuobe.why: The truth came: and God's command prevailed though they hated it (9:48), and falsehood vanished (17:81), and falsehood can neither begin nor repeat (34:49).
tree:1yr546c0riuobe.relation: When the truth comes, falsehood cannot stand.

tree:07890ex0e20hjx.why: The magicians arrive before Pharaoh, told three times: 7:113 and 26:41 ask for a reward, 10:80 has Musa tell them to throw. A memorizer set in one story.
tree:07890ex0e20hjx.relation: The magicians came for wages and ended up believers.

check.why: Keep is right: the magicians' arrival, told three times in one story.

tree:0plkfjy0nhpm8o.why: A messenger came to you: the Israelites rejected or killed messengers (2:87), the prophets pledged to believe in the coming messenger (3:81), and he came from among you, caring for you (9:128).
tree:0plkfjy0nhpm8o.relation: How messengers were received, and the Messenger who came with mercy.

check.why: Keep is right: 'a messenger came to you' and how messengers were received.

tree:0k7zwo50f77ymp.why: Only came to them followed by a relative is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:03qxika1vj99mu.why: The side of the Mount in Musa's story: where he was called (19:52), the meeting place promised to the Israelites (20:80), where he saw the fire (28:29). Same place, three moments.
tree:03qxika1vj99mu.relation: The Mount as the place of calling, of promise and of the fire.

tree:0sj8rsd1g6bzdp.why: The recompense of whoever is shared in three unrelated sentences: the Israelites, the minister's wife and the purified.

tree:0njztzb1o6d7fr.why: He placed in it firm mountains (13:3, 41:10), and in the sky a lamp and a moon (25:61). Same verb for features of earth and sky, a memorizer set.
tree:0njztzb1o6d7fr.relation: Earth and sky are furnished by the same Creator.

tree:1nu30g71kbiyut.why: We made the night: a sign (17:12), for rest (27:86), a covering (78:10). Three purposes of the night in close wording.
tree:1nu30g71kbiyut.relation: The night as a sign, a rest and a covering.

tree:093r0bb017l8pn.why: We placed in it: paths (21:31), gardens (36:34), lofty mountains (77:27). Same opening for the features of the earth.
tree:093r0bb017l8pn.relation: The earth's paths, gardens and mountains as favours.

tree:0ckl4lb1y2u6ep.why: All three rows stay. 'We made for you' is the same verb and words: means of living on earth (7:10, 15:20), and clear authority against those who fight you (4:91). Same words, different subject.
tree:0ckl4lb1y2u6ep.relation: What God made for people: livelihood on earth, and authority against aggressors.

tree:11an35p0h7t4qn.why: We made for them is a common phrase; spouses for messengers, a good name for prophets and senses for a destroyed people are unrelated.

tree:0i7pay40a0ygbm.why: Hell, which they will burn in, followed by a different noun each time: resting place (14:29), bed (38:56), destination (58:8). A memorizer set.
tree:0i7pay40a0ygbm.relation: Hell as resting place, bed and destination.

tree:0owzgb00heby9w.why: Until God brings His command (2:109, 9:24) or His promise comes (13:31). Close wording; wait for God's decision.
tree:0owzgb00heby9w.relation: Patience until God's command or promise arrives.

tree:1a4kn7s0zi3yys.why: Until it becomes clear is shared in three unrelated sentences: dawn in fasting, the truthful among the hypocrites, the signs in the horizons.

tree:0uzx1xt1pjrz3v.why: Nearness to Us and a good return, said of Dawud (38:25) and Sulayman (38:40) in identical words, and a good return for believers (13:29). A memorizer set.
tree:0uzx1xt1pjrz3v.relation: The prophets' and the believers' good return.

tree:0vyy28k0xw2q5i.why: Three closings in surah al-Isra: your Lord is aware and seeing of His servants, after the destroyed nations (17:17), provision (17:30) and testimony (17:96). A memorizer refrain.
tree:0vyy28k0xw2q5i.relation: God sees His servants in their sins, their provision and their disputes.

tree:0nu0wut0oxsqox.why: All three rows stay. 'Went out from' is the same verb and sense in all three: from their homes in thousands fearing death (2:243), from their homes in arrogance and show (8:47), and from the Prophet's presence asking 'what did he say?' (47:16). Same words, different subject.
tree:0nu0wut0oxsqox.relation: How people go out: fleeing death, showing off, or leaving the Prophet unheeding.

tree:1g4ehz51ozr6j9.why: Abiding in it forever, the punishment for disobeying God (4:14), killing a believer deliberately (4:93) and opposing God and His Messenger (9:63). Same sentence of eternity for three crimes.
tree:1g4ehz51ozr6j9.relation: Three sins that bring eternal fire.

tree:1mk9e090vvu291.why: He created everything: 6:101 and 25:2 both deny Him a son, then say He created all things; 24:45 says He created every creature from water. A memorizer set with one argument.
tree:1mk9e090vvu291.relation: The Creator of all things needs no son.

tree:1szgv1p1mn21i1.why: All three rows stay. 'He created for you' is the same verb and words: spouses (26:166, 30:21) and all that is on earth (2:29). Same words, different subject.
tree:1szgv1p1mn21i1.relation: What God created for people: the whole earth, and spouses for rest and love.

tree:0uq94b50b93pjb.why: Iblis's argument: You created me from fire and him from clay (7:12, 38:76, identical), or from sounding clay (15:33). Same story, a memorizer trap.
tree:0uq94b50b93pjb.relation: Pride in origin was Iblis's first sin.

tree:062jeeu1qwc864.why: All three rows stay. 'We created him from' is the same words and structure, and 15:27 ('the jinn We created before, from scorching fire') even shares 'from before' with 19:67. Man from nothing (19:67), from a drop (36:77), the jinn from fire (15:27): same words, different subject.
tree:062jeeu1qwc864.relation: Origins: man from nothing and from a drop, the jinn from fire.

tree:0wnwxp9125ybpb.why: 35:40 and 46:4 share the challenge: show me what they created of the earth, or do they have a share in the heavens? 52:35 asks were they created from nothing, the same argument.
tree:0wnwxp9125ybpb.relation: The idols created nothing, and their worshippers did not create themselves.

tree:0u575r80dhgpeu.why: Dawud and Sulayman named together: among Ibrahim's guided offspring (6:84), judging the field (21:78), given knowledge (27:15). Same pair, three favours.
tree:0u575r80dhgpeu.relation: Father and son prophets given judgement and knowledge.

tree:11hst7h05uw8yd.why: All three rows stay. 'They entered upon' is the same words and structure: Joseph's brothers entering upon him twice (12:69, 12:99), and the disputants entering upon David (38:22). Same words, different story.
tree:11hst7h05uw8yd.relation: Entering upon a prophet: Joseph receives his family, David is startled by the disputants.

tree:0vbrt7x0x4vgub.why: All three rows stay. 'He called on his Lord' is the same verb and words: Moses against the criminals (44:22), Noah, overcome, asking for help (54:10), and man in distress who calls on his Lord then forgets (39:8). Same words, different subject.
tree:0vbrt7x0x4vgub.relation: Contrast: prophets call on their Lord and keep faith; man calls in distress and forgets in ease.

tree:0qetu8z14wryhn.why: The religion of God is shared, but seeking another religion, the penalty for adultery and people entering Islam in crowds are different subjects.

tree:02sol5910hc45b.why: 6:118 and 6:119 are adjacent rulings: eat of what God's name was mentioned over, and why would you not eat of it? In 87:15 the verb is active ('he remembered the name of his Lord and prayed'), a different word.
tree:02sol5910hc45b.changes: Removed 87:15: an active verb, a different word.
tree:02sol5910hc45b.relation: Mentioning God's name over food makes it lawful.

tree:1lxc6f61vxsx9y.why: That Day: the deniers' humiliation on the Day they were promised (70:44), the righteous saved from its evil (76:11), and the Day of truth (78:39).
tree:1lxc6f61vxsx9y.relation: Contrast: the same Day brings humiliation to deniers and safety to the righteous.

check.why: Keep is right: 'that Day' brings humiliation to some and safety to others, a real contrast.

tree:0znx2p80eqv6o8.why: All three rows stay. 'That; and not' is the same words and structure: then they turn away after that, and those are not believers (5:43, 24:47), and 'what is between that; and your Lord is not forgetful' (19:64). Same negation after 'that', different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0znx2p80eqv6o8.relation: Turning away after the judgment comes; God forgets nothing.

tree:15th1zn0pgvqb9.why: In surah al-Hajj: that, and whoever honours God's sacred things (22:30) or His symbols (22:32), and whoever retaliates (22:60). A memorizer set in one surah.
tree:15th1zn0pgvqb9.relation: Honouring God's rites comes from piety of the heart.

tree:1apuirr0yoyjfj.why: Kindness to relatives in the covenant of the Israelites (2:83), the commands of 4:36, and the great command of justice in 16:90. A memorizer set on one duty.
tree:1apuirr0yoyjfj.relation: Giving to relatives is part of every covenant.

tree:1kbdxhx1n90v7j.why: Showing off to people: in charity (2:264, 4:38) and in going out to war (8:47). Same phrase, the same vice.
tree:1kbdxhx1n90v7j.relation: Acts done for show are worthless before God.

tree:0giznfv1vnecur.why: Lord of the east and the west: Musa to Pharaoh (26:28), the Lord of the easts (37:5), and the command to rely on Him (73:9). A memorizer set.
tree:0giznfv1vnecur.relation: The Lord of every horizon is the one to rely on.

tree:188nycj19c3a1v.why: Only your Lord followed by a particle is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:10jivxe0msqede.why: Your Lord's provision, tribute and mercy are better: than worldly splendour (20:131), than any payment (23:72), than what they amass (43:32).
tree:10jivxe0msqede.relation: What God gives is better than what people collect.

tree:13lftj80zedfxm.why: 10:33 and 40:6 share the clause: thus the word of your Lord came true against those who defied / disbelieved. In 34:21 'your Lord' is the subject ('your Lord is Guardian over all things'), a different structure.
tree:13lftj80zedfxm.relation: God's word comes true against those who persist in denial.

tree:1f0jz4p1pf5m6p.why: All three rows stay. 'Your Lord, and do not' is the same structure in all three: a command ending 'your Lord', then a prohibition. Be patient for your Lord's decision and do not be like the man of the fish (68:48) / do not obey a sinner (76:24); call to your Lord and do not be of the polytheists (28:87). Same words, different subject.
tree:1f0jz4p1pf5m6p.relation: Patience and calling to God, each paired with a warning.

tree:1levedx0xegblv.why: Your Lord who created you: worship Him (2:21), fear Him (4:1); and your Lord who drives the ships for you (17:66). Same frame, God's favours as reasons for worship.
tree:1levedx0xegblv.relation: The Lord who created and provides deserves worship.

tree:0xpk43l0z61jlj.why: Noah (7:63) and Hud (7:69) ask: do you wonder that a reminder came from your Lord through a man among you? Then they differ. In 6:54 'your Lord' is the subject of 'has written mercy upon Himself', a different structure.
tree:0xpk43l0z61jlj.relation: Every people wondered that a messenger was one of them.

tree:11hs70g1d55126.why: What did your Lord send down? The deniers say tales of the ancients (16:24), the God-fearing say good (16:30), and on the Day the angels answer the truth (34:23).
tree:11hs70g1d55126.relation: Contrast: the same question answered by deniers, believers and angels.

tree:1lpxuiq1rx7swg.why: Our Lord, give us: in this world only (2:200), good in both worlds (2:201), mercy from You (18:10, the youths of the cave). The adjacent pair is a classic contrast.
tree:1lpxuiq1rx7swg.relation: Contrast: those who ask only for this world and those who ask for both.

tree:18p2r311qy5z9f.why: Our Lord, we believe: the disciples (3:53), Christians moved by the Quran (5:83), a party of God's servants (23:109). 3:53 and 5:83 end alike, a memorizer set.
tree:18p2r311qy5z9f.relation: The prayer of those who believe on hearing the truth.

tree:0daczou1np0b92.why: Our Lord, take us out: the oppressed from the unjust town (4:75), and the damned from the fire (23:107, 35:37).
tree:0daczou1np0b92.relation: Contrast: a prayer answered in this world, and the same prayer refused in the fire.

tree:1sdm5dj1jp3035.why: Our Lord, forgive: the companions of the prophets (3:147), Ibrahim for himself and his parents (14:41), later believers for those before them (59:10).
tree:1sdm5dj1jp3035.relation: Prayers for forgiveness for oneself, family and brothers in faith.

tree:0adqsdk085yqo8.why: Our Lord is God: the believers expelled only for saying it (22:40), and those who said it and stood firm (41:30, 46:13, which differ in their reward).
tree:0adqsdk085yqo8.relation: Saying our Lord is God costs the believers their homes, and earns them the angels' good news.

tree:1g0vlla1o7hikq.why: All three rows stay. 'Our Lord, indeed we ...' is the same opening in all three: we have believed, so forgive us (3:16), we heard a caller to faith (3:193), and Moses and Aaron: we fear he will hasten against us (20:45). Same words, different prayer.
tree:1g0vlla1o7hikq.relation: Prayers opening the same way: faith asking forgiveness, and fear asking protection.

tree:09r5vub1ci5b3f.why: Our Lord, these are the ones...: followers blame leaders (7:38), idolaters point to their partners (16:86), leaders disown followers (28:63). The blame game in Hell.
tree:09r5vub1ci5b3f.relation: On the Day, followers and leaders turn against each other.

tree:0fxnrej0xasyhf.why: He called his Lord: Ayyub, harm has touched me (21:83) or Satan has touched me (38:41), and Nuh, I am overcome (54:10). Prophets' prayers in distress, a memorizer set.
tree:0fxnrej0xasyhf.relation: In distress the prophets tell their Lord their state and ask for help.

tree:0cdrr1k1u8kwsy.why: 2:282 and 2:283 are adjacent debt rulings, each with 'let him fear God his Lord, and do not ...'. In 2:112 'his Lord' follows 'with', and 'and no' opens 'no fear upon them', a different structure.
tree:0cdrr1k1u8kwsy.relation: Fear of God as the guard of debts and trusts.

tree:0oels4w0uvb8dm.why: 18:38 and 72:20 are close: my Lord, and I associate none with Him. In 20:52 'my Lord' is the subject and 'nor' joins a second negated verb ('my Lord neither errs nor forgets'), a different structure.
tree:0oels4w0uvb8dm.relation: Declaring pure monotheism: the believer in the garden parable and the Prophet.

tree:086hx0k0ct37iy.why: Only mercy followed by a conditional is shared; retaliation, the Book's arrival and Salih's question are unrelated.

tree:1iq1s9108hz9tj.why: The Quran as guidance and mercy for the believers (10:57, 27:77) and as healing and mercy for them (17:82). Same closing phrase, a memorizer set.
tree:1iq1s9108hz9tj.relation: The Quran heals and guides believers, and only adds loss to wrongdoers.

tree:1fqyro80fcrg6i.why: All three rows stay. 'They are returned to' is the same verb and sense in all three: returned to God, their true Master (6:62, 10:30), and whenever returned to temptation they fall into it (4:91). Same words, different subject.
tree:1fqyro80fcrg6i.relation: Where people are returned: to temptation in this life, to God their true Master in the end.

tree:1p05scc0bqz2tg.why: Did messengers from among you not come to you? Asked of jinn and men (6:130), promised to Adam's children (7:35), asked by Hell's keepers (39:71). A memorizer set.
tree:1p05scc0bqz2tg.relation: No one will have the excuse that no messenger came.

tree:0gl2b6q1psnqkq.why: I convey my Lord's messages: Nuh (7:62), Hud (7:68), Shuayb (7:93). Same mission statement with small differences, in one surah.
tree:0gl2b6q1psnqkq.relation: Every prophet's task: deliver the message and give sincere advice.

tree:005otp70m2n3n5.why: A noble messenger: Musa sent to Pharaoh's people (44:17), and the Quran as the word of a noble messenger (69:40, 81:19, identical).
tree:005otp70m2n3n5.relation: Noble messengers carried the message to Pharaoh and to us.

tree:1vqgkh10gj51ov.why: Ibrahim prays for a messenger from among them who recites, teaches and purifies (2:129), and 62:2 says God sent him, with the order changed. 23:32 is the same sending to a past nation.
tree:1vqgkh10gj51ov.relation: Ibrahim's prayer answered in the Prophet.

tree:073qdvx1mxswvd.why: Only His Messenger followed by then is shared; emigration, the hypocrites' excuses and true believers are different sentences.

tree:0qxgqyz0yaurmj.why: Only His Messenger and a preposition are shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:1qyvhc01evxv7g.why: Only His Messenger followed by the name of God is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:0gh5l3n0sdvd2j.why: 8:13 and 59:4 are near-identical: they opposed God and His Messenger, and whoever opposes God, God is severe in penalty; one drops 'His Messenger'. In 3:101 the two words only meet at a clause boundary after another verb ('His Messenger is among you; whoever holds fast to God').
tree:0gh5l3n0sdvd2j.changes: Removed 3:101: a different structure, the words only touch.
tree:0gh5l3n0sdvd2j.relation: Opposing God and His Messenger: Badr and Banu Nadir.

check.why: Removing 3:101 is right: it shares only a conjunction and a word, in a different sentence.

tree:1ky1a7g075jdim.why: Following God's pleasure in 3:162 and 3:174, and monks seeking God's pleasure through an invented monasticism in 57:27.
tree:1ky1a7g075jdim.relation: Seeking God's pleasure: truly followed by the believers, poorly kept by the monks.

tree:0bf46pe1smm23s.why: All three rows stay. 'Two mates' is the same words and sense in all three: carry in the ark two of every kind (11:40, 23:27), and of every fruit He made two mates (13:3). Same words, different subject.
tree:0bf46pe1smm23s.relation: Pairs in creation: kept alive in the ark, set in every fruit.

tree:16fpo1q0fng85a.why: Satan has no authority over them except...: except that I called you (14:22), except those who follow you (15:42), except so We may know (34:21). A memorizer set on one truth.
tree:16fpo1q0fng85a.relation: Satan only invites; those who follow him chose it.

tree:0tufktx1q46pjf.why: A clear authority, ending three ayat of an-Nisa (4:91, 4:144, 4:153), each with a different subject. A memorizer closing set.
tree:0tufktx1q46pjf.relation: God gives clear authority to believers against the treacherous and to Musa.

tree:19co0k8012x2si.why: All three rows stay. 'Hearing, Seeing' is the same pair in all three: God is ever Hearing, Seeing (4:58, 4:134), and We made man hearing, seeing (76:2). Same words, said of God and of man. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:19co0k8012x2si.relation: God hears and sees all; He gave man hearing and sight to be tested.

tree:1yor8sf0olbphv.why: God's way with those who passed before: in 33:38, 33:62 and 48:23 with small differences. A memorizer set on one law.

tree:0bkwyhc1pyqyoi.why: Whose evil deed is made to seem good to him: 35:8, 47:14 and Pharaoh in 40:37. Same phrase, one lesson.
tree:0bkwyhc1pyqyoi.relation: Self-deception about evil deeds, from the deniers to Pharaoh.

tree:1ezy2q813o9546.why: It is the same to them: whether you warn them or not (2:6, 36:10), whether you ask forgiveness for them or not (63:6). A memorizer set.
tree:1ezy2q813o9546.relation: Warnings and prayers do not help those who have closed their hearts.

tree:09q6mg60xxiy46.why: The rites of God: do not violate them (5:2), honouring them is piety (22:32), the sacrificial camels are among them (22:36).
tree:09q6mg60xxiy46.relation: God's rites are to be honoured with piety.

tree:1wjngz71v8bn4j.why: In far dissension, closing 2:176, 22:53 and 41:52: those who differed about the Book, the wrongdoers, and the deniers. A memorizer closing set.
tree:1wjngz71v8bn4j.relation: Rejecting the truth leaves people in deep division.

tree:1jb2p620j8inmk.why: All three rows stay. 'Anything; thus' is the same structure in all three: a negation with 'anything', then a new sentence with 'thus'. Had God willed we would not have associated (6:148, 16:35), and 'we were not calling on anything before; thus God leaves the deniers astray' (40:74). Same words, different subject.
tree:1jb2p620j8inmk.relation: The idolaters' excuse in this life, and their denial in Hell.

tree:1vyy7xu0kfq2sy.why: Only something of is shared; Saba's gardens, God's bounty and lost dowries are unrelated.

tree:00hzrip0niy239.why: Only a noun followed by and whoever is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:1sbfg7h1acblc7.why: God has spoken the truth: so follow Ibrahim (3:95), the believers say it on seeing the confederates (33:22), and God fulfilled His Messenger's vision (48:27).
tree:1sbfg7h1acblc7.relation: God's promises come true, and the believers' faith grows when they do.

check.why: Keep is right: 'God has spoken the truth', with His promises fulfilled, in all three.

tree:1fmzrj80uiee0k.why: Except whoever repents, believes and does good, those...: enter Paradise (19:60), have their evil turned to good (25:70); and in 34:37 those who believe and do good get a double reward.
tree:1fmzrj80uiee0k.relation: Repentance and good deeds change the sinner's fate.

tree:1bcu4v01oltppq.why: When you travel: in God's cause, verify (4:94); in the land, shorten prayer (4:101); and witnesses to a will when travelling (5:106). A memorizer set of travel rulings.
tree:1bcu4v01oltppq.relation: Rulings that ease and guide the traveller.

check.why: Keep is right: three rulings about travel.

tree:1po48xx1dts75f.why: In far error, closing 14:3, 42:18 and 50:27: those who prefer this world, who dispute about the Hour, and the man whose companion disowns him. A memorizer closing set.
tree:1po48xx1dts75f.relation: Loving this world and doubting the Hour lead far astray.

tree:0afip8x0zmafw7.why: A group of you and another group is shared, but Uhud, Shuayb's people and the hypocrites' mockery are different scenes with nothing more to learn together.

check.why: Drop is right: 'a group of you' appears in unrelated scenes.

tree:1xv34k50ximmf7.why: All three rows stay. 'Transgression and disbelief' is the same pair of words in all three: what was sent to you increases many of them in transgression and disbelief (5:64, 5:68), and the boy who would have burdened his believing parents with transgression and disbelief (18:80). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1xv34k50ximmf7.relation: Transgression and disbelief: what revelation exposes in some, and what God spared two believing parents.

tree:03mmk2h0znvt5p.why: Wronging himself: the garden owner (18:35), some of those who inherit the Book (35:32), some of Ibrahim and Ishaq's descendants (37:113).
tree:03mmk2h0znvt5p.relation: Even among the chosen and their offspring, some wrong themselves.

tree:1orawuq01iqmlu.why: You thought...: the Bedouins thought the Prophet would never return (48:12), the believers did not think the Jews would leave (59:2), the jinn say men thought God would raise no one (72:7).
tree:1orawuq01iqmlu.relation: Human assumptions about God's decree proved wrong.

tree:14el76q1464di8.why: They defied their Lord's command: Thamud (7:77, 51:44), and the Sabbath breakers defied what they were forbidden (7:166). A memorizer set.
tree:14el76q1464di8.relation: Defiance of God's command and its punishment.

tree:1e7hqv3168jk4f.why: Two just men among you: judging the game penalty (5:95), witnessing a will (5:106), witnessing divorce (65:2). Same requirement in three rulings.
tree:1e7hqv3168jk4f.relation: Justice of witnesses is required in every ruling.

tree:1s4ll481dkgq7s.why: Protected from the punishment of Hellfire: the angels' prayer (40:7), and the righteous in 44:56 and 52:18. A memorizer closing set.
tree:1s4ll481dkgq7s.relation: The angels' prayer for the believers, answered.

tree:0ti7hbu1j09wro.why: Your Lord's punishment: to be feared (17:57), a breath of it brings confession (21:46), it will surely come (52:7).
tree:0ti7hbu1j09wro.relation: The certainty and weight of God's punishment.

tree:0e3h0dv0h4u4rv.why: 34:5 and 45:11 end the same: for them is a punishment of painful foulness. In 19:45 'a punishment from the Most Merciful' has 'from' as its source, not 'of' a kind, a different sense.
tree:0e3h0dv0h4u4rv.changes: Removed 19:45: a different sense of the particle. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:0e3h0dv0h4u4rv.relation: The same punishment for those who fight God's signs and those who deny them.

tree:1nqt55f0dv8tg3.why: The final home in surah ar-Rad: for the patient (13:22), excellent is the final home (13:24), and the disbelievers will know whose it is (13:42). The run-on in 13:25 shows the evil home.
tree:1nqt55f0dv8tg3.relation: The good end for the patient, and the evil end for those who break God's covenant.

tree:0zrsqst0l08wxv.why: Knowledge of the Hour is with God: in 31:34, 41:47 and 43:85, each followed by other things only He knows or owns.
tree:0zrsqst0l08wxv.relation: Only God knows when the Hour comes.

tree:1x86yck0olrpeq.why: All three rows stay. 'God knew' is the same verb and subject: God knew you were deceiving yourselves (2:187), that you would think of them (2:235), and had God known any good in them He would have made them hear (8:23). Same words, different subject.
tree:1x86yck0olrpeq.relation: God's knowledge of hearts: it eases rulings for the believers and judges the deniers.

tree:0lklsrk0ly1rwy.why: All three rows stay. 'Knowledge; indeed' is the same structure: 'without knowledge', then a new sentence with 'indeed' (6:119 your Lord, 6:144 God, a real slip), and 'what you have no knowledge of; indeed hearing, sight and heart' (17:36). Same words, different subject.
tree:0lklsrk0ly1rwy.relation: Speaking without knowledge: misleading others, and what each faculty will answer for.

tree:1ilxk1h0d2whzt.why: 22:8 and 31:20 share: disputing about God without knowledge, guidance or illuminating Book; 18:5 says they have no knowledge, nor did their fathers.

tree:0d5xivs1hq9h1g.why: All three rows stay. 'Its knowledge is with' is the same words in all three, and 20:52 even matches 7:187 exactly ('with my Lord'): the Hour's knowledge is with God (7:187, 33:63), and Moses says the knowledge of past generations is with my Lord in a record (20:52). Same words, different subject: a real slip.
tree:0d5xivs1hq9h1g.relation: What only God knows: the Hour and the fate of past generations.

tree:0xfcuq30vw6p8l.why: Peace upon Abraham: the fire made cool and peaceful (21:69), and the greeting of peace (37:109). In 3:84 'upon Abraham' follows 'what was sent down', a different governing word.
tree:0xfcuq30vw6p8l.changes: Removed 3:84: a different governing word. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:0xfcuq30vw6p8l.relation: Peace on Abraham, from the fire and in God's greeting.

tree:0rztage0txnbwq.why: On your heels: turning back if the Prophet died (3:144), being turned back by obeying disbelievers (3:149), turning away from the signs (23:66).
tree:0rztage0txnbwq.relation: Turning back on one's heels is the image of apostasy.

tree:1greckh1leismh.why: 17:83 and 41:51 are identical until the end: when touched by evil he despairs / prays at length. In 76:1 'upon man' follows 'there came', a different governing verb.
tree:1greckh1leismh.relation: Man turns from God in ease and despairs or pleads in hardship.

tree:0w67i7o000hzvq.why: Only a preposition and relative pronoun are shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:10dkyne1l37xxq.why: The curse of God is upon the wrongdoers in 7:44 and 11:18, and the next ayah in both is near-identical. In 2:193 'upon the wrongdoers' follows 'no hostility except', a different governing word.
tree:10dkyne1l37xxq.changes: Removed 2:193: a different governing word. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:10dkyne1l37xxq.relation: The curse on the wrongdoers, proclaimed in the Garden and before the witnesses.

tree:17qa9pg08zvqj0.why: On them and on ships you are carried, identical in 23:22 and 40:80, and Nuh on the ship in 23:28. A memorizer set.
tree:17qa9pg08zvqj0.relation: Ships and animals as God's favour of transport.

tree:036b0kz1hg6snr.why: The Prophet is named with the same preposition in three different sentences: God's forgiveness, no blame on him, and blessings on him.

tree:0gvqdal143albh.why: On guidance is a short phrase; uniting them on guidance, Thamud preferring blindness and a rhetorical question are different sentences.

tree:05bm0e508bkn3r.why: On yourselves is a common phrase; testimony, transgression and eating in houses are unrelated.

tree:1uf56q013jjkgm.why: 19:71 and 25:16 end alike: it is upon your Lord a decree fulfilled / a promise asked of. In 18:48 'before your Lord' follows 'they were presented', a different governing verb and sense.
tree:1uf56q013jjkgm.relation: What God has bound Himself to: the passing over Hell and the promise of the Garden.

tree:142d0040cswrls.why: He sent down to His servant: the Book (18:1), the Criterion (25:1), clear signs (57:9). Same frame of praise for revelation.
tree:142d0040cswrls.relation: The Quran sent down on God's servant, as Book, Criterion and clear signs.

tree:1t9wksd12d67wj.why: Turning back on his heels: who would abandon the Messenger over the qibla (2:143) or his death (3:144), and Satan himself turning on his heels at Badr (8:48).
tree:1t9wksd12d67wj.relation: Those who turn back follow Satan, who was first to flee.

tree:16k51af1dfriex.why: Revelation sent down on your heart: by God's leave (2:97), so you may be a warner (26:194); and God could seal your heart if He willed (42:24).
tree:16k51af1dfriex.relation: The Prophet's heart receives revelation only by God's will.

check.why: Keep is right: the Prophet's heart and revelation, one theme.

tree:14edkd60tzgel0.why: On his face is shared in three images: Yusuf's shirt on his father's face, the wavering worshipper turning back, the one who walks fallen on his face. Too loose to learn from together.

check.why: Drop is right: 'on his face' is too loose a link.

tree:14rv80s06x9nek.why: Dragged or gathered on their faces: blind, dumb and deaf (17:97), to Hell (25:34), into the fire (54:48). Same image of the deniers on the Day.
tree:14rv80s06x9nek.relation: Those who turned their faces from the truth are dragged on them.

tree:1t45d2k1v4jfhe.why: We sent down the Quran to you: not to make you miserable (20:2), He who ordained it will return you (28:85), We sent it down gradually (76:23).
tree:1t45d2k1v4jfhe.relation: The Quran is a mercy to the Prophet, not a burden.

tree:06y43vb0vhchxd.why: Upon you and upon...: God's favour on Isa and his mother (5:110), blessings on Nuh and those with him (11:48), favour on Yusuf and Yaqub's family (12:6).
tree:06y43vb0vhchxd.relation: God's favour on a prophet extends to his family and followers.

tree:1pae05s0bhsy0g.why: God's signs recited to you: how can you disbelieve (3:101), did messengers not recite them (39:71), a messenger reciting them clearly (65:11).
tree:1pae05s0bhsy0g.relation: The recitation of God's signs leaves no excuse for disbelief.

tree:0yla0a41vja1t6.why: Only upon you followed by a negation is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:1tpil1z1jux50f.why: 7:39 and 11:27 share a real clause about having no advantage over us, but that pair has its own tree; 7:50 shares only two words.

check.why: Drop is right: I checked that the 7:39 with 11:27 pair is kept in W1 (tree:0w5jw490wugi7n), and 7:50 shares only two words.

tree:12lfjeb1klu773.why: Only upon him followed by if is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:05fujvu1mv956a.why: 3:164 and 62:2 share the clause: a messenger reciting His signs, purifying and teaching them. 8:2 says when His signs are recited faith increases.
tree:05fujvu1mv956a.relation: The recitation of signs purifies and increases faith.

tree:0uihnez0dzi71n.why: We did not send you as a guardian over them (4:80, 42:48), We did not make you one (6:107). A memorizer set on the Prophet's role.
tree:0uihnez0dzi71n.relation: The Messenger delivers; he is not their keeper.

check.why: Keep is right: 'not a guardian over them', a memorizer set on the Prophet's role.

tree:16zqb4u0125ez8.why: Only upon them followed by a relative is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:07isybu0xp7m32.why: Righteous deeds: mixed with bad (9:102), the condition for meeting God (18:110), and with repentance turning evil to good (25:70).
tree:07isybu0xp7m32.relation: Good deeds bring hope to those who mixed them with sin.

tree:0yru7rh07o0wp3.why: Turning from or heedless of Our signs: 6:157, 10:7 and 10:92 (heedless vs truly heedless). A memorizer set.
tree:0yru7rh07o0wp3.relation: Most people are heedless of God's signs, even Pharaoh's preserved body.

tree:150z2j715gptm9.why: They ask you about the Hour: when will it arrive (7:187, 79:42), people ask you (33:63). A memorizer set with one answer.
tree:150z2j715gptm9.relation: The Hour's time is with God alone.

tree:1j0693t09r6q7d.why: 3:97 and 29:6 end with God is free of need of the worlds, with and without emphasis. In 15:70 'from the worlds' follows 'forbid you', a different governing verb and sense.
tree:1j0693t09r6q7d.changes: Removed 15:70: a different governing verb. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:1j0693t09r6q7d.relation: God needs no one's worship or striving.

tree:0t2pfhc12wbygs.why: 6:147 and 12:110 end alike: His / Our might is not turned away from the criminal people. In 9:96 the words follow 'God is not pleased with', a different governing verb.
tree:0t2pfhc12wbygs.changes: Removed 9:96: a different governing verb. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:0t2pfhc12wbygs.relation: God's punishment is not turned from the criminals.

tree:1urmv230dgujrz.why: Khidr's condition, do not ask me about anything (18:70), and Moses' promise, if I ask you about anything after this (18:76). In 4:4 'of anything' follows 'they are pleased to give you', a different governing verb.
tree:1urmv230dgujrz.relation: The condition and the promise in Moses' journey with Khidr.

check.why: Removing 4:4 is right: there 'about anything' belongs to a different verb (being pleased to give), a structural difference.

tree:1turpva1xx6szu.why: Not too proud to worship Him: the Messiah and angels (4:172), those with your Lord (7:206, 21:19). A memorizer set.
tree:1turpva1xx6szu.relation: The closest to God are never too proud to worship Him.

tree:1iu5mqj0uxyfxb.why: He pardons much: the Messenger overlooks much of what they hid (5:15), and God pardons much of what your hands earned (42:30, 42:34).
tree:1iu5mqj0uxyfxb.relation: God's pardon covers much of what people deserve.

tree:1o99ju30gyx9wf.why: Turn away from this: Abraham told to stop pleading for Lot's people (11:76), Joseph told to overlook the matter (12:29). In 7:172 'of this' follows 'we were heedless', a different governing word.
tree:1o99ju30gyx9wf.relation: Two commands to let a matter go.

tree:08oxf871udmn25.why: Before your Lord: the People of the Book fear believers will argue against them before your Lord (2:76, 3:73), and on the Day you will dispute before your Lord (39:31).
tree:08oxf871udmn25.relation: Every argument will be settled before the Lord.

check.why: Keep is right: arguments settled 'before your Lord', one theme.

tree:188jes40lz7g90.why: Only from you followed by a preposition is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:0ueq3ov1nly96x.why: All three rows stay. 'From them until' is the same structure with the same sense in all three: turn away from them for a while (37:174, 37:178, one letter apart), and turn away from them until they change the subject (6:68). The verbs are synonyms for turning away. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0ueq3ov1nly96x.relation: Turning away from the deniers: for a while, or while they mock.

tree:1nw1b790f12wxz.why: 2:27 and 13:25 are near identical on those who break God's covenant, and 33:15 names hypocrites who broke their pledge. Same theme.
tree:1nw1b790f12wxz.relation: Breaking God's covenant: loss, curse and accountability.

check.why: Keep is right: breaking God's covenant, with a near-identical pair.

tree:0kqlvp71rsrglh.why: Wrath from your Lord: on the calf worshippers (7:152), on Musa's people asked if they wanted it (20:86), and on apostates (16:106).
tree:0kqlvp71rsrglh.relation: God's wrath on those who turn from faith after knowing it.

tree:0att1lp1y97fsn.why: All three rows stay. 'In heedlessness of' is the same word and sense in all three: we were heedless of this (21:97), you were heedless of this (50:22), and Moses entered the city at a time its people were heedless (28:15). Same words, different subject.
tree:0att1lp1y97fsn.relation: Heedlessness lifted on the Day, and a city's heedlessness in Moses' story.

tree:0n6gov11xnib9b.why: Other than the truth is a common phrase; false thoughts at Uhud, extremism and lying about God are different sentences.

tree:1nwpclb1thetur.why: We opened to them: gates of everything as a trap (6:44), a gate in the sky they would still deny (15:14), a gate of severe punishment (23:77).
tree:1nwpclb1thetur.relation: Gates of ease or punishment; the stubborn are not moved by either.

tree:1uo9zgb0zvafnl.why: A trial for those with diseased hearts or who disbelieve: what Satan casts (22:53), the believers pray not to be one (60:5), the number of Hell's keepers (74:31).
tree:1uo9zgb0zvafnl.relation: God's signs test hearts; the believers ask not to become a trial for others.

tree:1r7nfu10yu1eu9.why: What God has preferred some of you over others: do not covet it (4:32), men's responsibility (4:34), and the strivers preferred over those who stay (4:95). A memorizer set in an-Nisa.
tree:1r7nfu10yu1eu9.relation: God's distribution of favour is to be accepted, not envied.

tree:0j5ynka13vuoca.why: A great triumph: the hypocrite wishes he had shared it (4:73), whoever obeys God has won it (33:71), and the believers' entry into gardens is it (48:5).
tree:0j5ynka13vuoca.relation: The true great triumph is obedience and Paradise.

tree:1xkpt5x0n4fvx5.why: All three rows stay. 'Some above others' is the same words and sense: He raised some of you above others in degrees (6:165, 43:32), and darknesses, some above others (24:40). Same words, different subject.
tree:1xkpt5x0n4fvx5.relation: Layers: of rank among people as a test, and of darkness over the denier's deeds.

tree:15noctr1k0tp5j.why: In the wombs: He shapes you there as He wills (3:6), settles there what He wills (22:5), and knows what is there (31:34). God's power and knowledge over the unborn.
tree:15noctr1k0tp5j.relation: Only God shapes and knows what is in the womb.

check.why: Keep is right: God's power and knowledge over what is in the wombs.

tree:0gdgnuy0q10rl0.why: In the Torah and the Gospel: the Prophet described there (7:157), the promise to the martyrs (9:111), and the companions' likeness (48:29).
tree:0gdgnuy0q10rl0.relation: The earlier scriptures foretold the Prophet and his companions.

tree:0ky4f8r0gm81td.why: In Paradise is a common phrase; the happy abiding, the two groups on the Day and Pharaoh's wife's prayer are different subjects.

tree:0xacfgy01trkns.why: In creation: God increased Ad in stature (7:69), He adds to creation what He wills (35:1), He reverses the aged in creation (36:68). God changes His creation as He wills.
tree:0xacfgy01trkns.relation: God adds to creation and takes away from it.

check.why: Keep is acceptable: God adds to His creation and takes from it as He wills.

tree:0ihi8qi1lzah7c.why: The Sabbath told three times: those who transgressed (2:65), the command not to (4:154), the town by the sea (7:163). Same story, a memorizer set.
tree:0ihi8qi1lzah7c.relation: The test of the Sabbath and the fate of the transgressors.

tree:1kz96331pm6di7.why: What is in the breasts: healing for it (10:57), the hearts in the breasts go blind (22:46), its contents brought out on the Day (100:10).
tree:1kz96331pm6di7.relation: The heart is the place of healing, blindness and judgement.

tree:1t09rwi10vtef6.why: In darkness: the deniers deaf and dumb (6:39), the one who cannot leave it (6:122), and Yunus who called out from it (21:87).
tree:1t09rwi10vtef6.relation: Contrast: the deniers stay in darkness; Yunus called on God from it and was saved.

tree:15ztqtn094j6tv.why: All three rows stay. 'In knowledge' is the same words and sense: those firm in knowledge (3:7, 4:162), and Saul increased in knowledge and stature (2:247). Same words, different subject.
tree:15ztqtn094j6tv.relation: Knowledge as a qualification: for understanding revelation and for leadership.

tree:0418un81phm7t4.why: Those in the graves: raised (22:7), cannot be made to hear (35:22), scattered out (100:9). A memorizer closing set.
tree:0418un81phm7t4.relation: The dead in their graves, deaf now and raised later.

tree:1e7hjwz1memuaf.why: All three rows stay. 'In disbelief' is the same words and sense: let not those who hasten into disbelief grieve you (3:176, 5:41), and postponing the sacred months is an increase in disbelief (9:37). Same words, different subject.
tree:1e7hjwz1memuaf.relation: Hastening into disbelief, and adding to it by changing God's months.

tree:0m6hcuw1qm6tk2.why: Isa speaking in the cradle: foretold (3:46), recalled as a favour (5:110), and the people asking how they could speak to a baby (19:29).
tree:0m6hcuw1qm6tk2.relation: One miracle of Isa told as prophecy, as favour and as event.

tree:1oax7ug0p9dyoi.why: All three rows stay. 'In days ...' is the same words and structure, each followed by a plural adjective: numbered days (2:203), known days (22:28), days of misfortune (41:16). A reciter must keep the three adjectives apart; the different subject is no reason to remove 41:16.
tree:1oax7ug0p9dyoi.relation: Days for remembering God, and days of punishment for Aad.

tree:1xoan0p0h371fn.why: All three rows stay. 'In the bellies of' is the same words and sense: in your mothers' wombs (39:6, 53:32), and what is in the bellies of these cattle (6:139). Same words, different subject.
tree:1xoan0p0h371fn.relation: What is in the womb is known to God; the idolaters made rules about what is in the cattle's bellies.

tree:1luphln1h2s01l.why: The pair 2:174 and 4:10 (eating fire into their bellies) is already kept as its own card; 22:20 is the boiling water of Hell, another sentence.

tree:11upqwl1ehxoix.why: In the religion of is shared, but the king's law in Yusuf's story, the adultery ruling and people entering Islam are different subjects.

tree:16efw1v1cldu41.why: All three rows stay. 'In your religion' is the same words: do not go to extremes in your religion (4:171, 5:77), and they attack your religion (9:12). Same words, different subject.
tree:16efw1v1cldu41.relation: Two dangers to religion: extremism from within, attack from without.

tree:0qaers9014pz11.why: In His cause is a stock phrase here used in three different commands and sayings, with no closer wording to learn.

tree:1x09vbo1ajje2s.why: 3:28 and 6:159 both declare 'having nothing to do with': whoever allies with the deniers has nothing to do with God, and you have nothing to do with the sect makers. In 4:59 'in anything' follows 'you dispute', a different structure and sense.
tree:1x09vbo1ajje2s.changes: Removed 4:59: a different structure and sense.
tree:1x09vbo1ajje2s.relation: Breaking off: from God for those who ally with the deniers, from the Prophet for those who split the religion.

tree:0kocclt180y5tf.why: In the breasts of is shared in three unrelated sentences.

tree:1vdygyj0y4txo1.why: 20:128 and 32:26 are near twins (they walk through the dwellings of destroyed nations), and Saba had a sign in its dwelling (34:15).
tree:1vdygyj0y4txo1.relation: Dwellings that were once signs and are now ruins.

tree:0qeq8k509rekhr.why: In yourself is shared in three different senses; unrelated sentences.

tree:1mlcsb603w8a0c.why: All three rows stay. 'In two days' is the same words and sense: the earth in two days (41:9), the seven heavens in two days (41:12), and whoever hastens out of Mina in two days (2:203). Same words, different subject.
tree:1mlcsb603w8a0c.relation: Two days of creation, and two days of the pilgrimage.

tree:0dodqv21gpzbbo.why: All three rows stay. 'In it, that you may' is the same structure in all three: a command with 'in it', then 'that you may'. Remember what is in it that you may fear God (2:63, 7:171), and the deniers: make noise in it that you may overcome (41:26). Same words, opposite purpose. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0dodqv21gpzbbo.relation: Contrast: holding the Book to fear God, and drowning out the Quran to overcome it.

tree:0lwmq4h1ghaaer.why: Only in it followed by and whoever is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:1rh2hk11iw97qd.why: Only in it followed by except is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:100hl2j1y5evfr.why: Abiding in it, that is the great disgrace (9:63), against abiding in it, that is the great triumph (9:89, 57:12).
tree:100hl2j1y5evfr.relation: Contrast: the same words end in disgrace or in triumph.

check.why: Keep is right: 'abiding in it, that is the great ...' ends in disgrace or in triumph, a clear contrast.

tree:1d6g1210olf4id.why: Fruit in Paradise: and whatever they call for (36:57), abundant fruit to eat (43:73), fruit and palm trees (55:11). Short ayat a memorizer can mix.
tree:1d6g1210olf4id.relation: The fruits of Paradise described three ways.

tree:0fl9o8t1hhrvip.why: A messenger among them: Ibrahim's prayer (2:129), God's favour in sending him (3:164), and a messenger sent to a past people (23:32). 2:129 and 3:164 are a classic pair with a changed order.
tree:0fl9o8t1hhrvip.relation: Ibrahim's prayer answered as God's favour.

tree:0j3nfnx0cszb2x.why: Only in both of them followed by a preposition is shared; three unrelated sentences.

tree:0mwbgpw0506tos.why: The disciples said: we are God's helpers (3:52, 61:14), and can your Lord send down a table (5:112). A memorizer set in Isa's story.
tree:0mwbgpw0506tos.relation: The disciples' faith and their request for a sign.

tree:1h05mow1kfln8m.why: The disbelievers said: this is a clear sorcerer (10:2), a lying sorcerer (38:4), a strange thing (50:2), each after wondering that a warner came from among them.
tree:1h05mow1kfln8m.relation: Astonishment at a human messenger turned into accusation.

tree:14nid7p0r1nhht.why: The king said, three times in surah Yusuf: I see seven fat cows (12:43), bring him to me (12:50, 12:54, which differ after). A memorizer set in one story.
tree:14nid7p0r1nhht.relation: The king's dream leads to Yusuf's release and rise.

tree:0eml6iv1xlfkwj.why: Only he said, you are is shared; Iblis's respite, the king's trust and Khidr's warning are unrelated.

tree:0gf14xq131egtu.why: All three rows stay. 'He said: indeed you are ...' is the same words and structure: a people who are ignorant (7:138), a people unknown (15:62), and the keeper of Hell: you will remain (43:77). Same words, different speaker.
tree:0gf14xq131egtu.relation: Three answers that begin alike: Moses, Lot, and the keeper of Hell.

tree:1aaxid50tdxno5.why: Only your Lord said is shared; Musa's answer, the angels' question and the command to call on God are unrelated.

tree:1lclua41bac5cq.why: Ibrahim answering peace: to the angel guests (11:69, 51:25, which differ after), and to his father (19:47). Same word from the same prophet in two settings.
tree:1lclua41bac5cq.relation: Ibrahim's peace to guests and to his disbelieving father.

tree:0426w8v0hlk2ln.why: Only he said, indeed is shared; Musa to Pharaoh, Ibrahim to his people and Dawud's judgement are unrelated.

tree:1qqmf101665p3m.why: O my son: Yaqub to Yusuf (12:5), Yaqub to his sons (12:67), Ibrahim to Ismail (37:102). Fathers advising sons, two of them prophets.
tree:1qqmf101665p3m.relation: A prophet father's advice to his sons.

tree:1l7tlw21vhirbe.why: Only the address to Musa is shared: God choosing him (7:144), the Egyptian's accusation (28:19) and the man's warning (28:20) have no further wording in common.

check.why: Drop is right: only the address to Musa is shared.

tree:0c0u7em1iwv8po.why: The wife of Imran, of al-Aziz, of Pharaoh spoke: a vow (3:35), a confession (12:51), a plea for the child (28:9). A memorizer set and a contrast among three women.
tree:0c0u7em1iwv8po.relation: Three women's words: devotion, confession and mercy.

tree:1bqz32u0jd48fu.why: Shall we believe? like the fools (2:13), in two men like us (23:47), when the lowest follow you (26:111). The arrogant's refusal in the same words.
tree:1bqz32u0jd48fu.relation: Arrogance makes people refuse faith because of who else has it.

tree:145g18w19reeay.why: God is sufficient for us (3:173, 9:59), against what we found our fathers on is sufficient for us (5:104).
tree:145g18w19reeay.relation: Contrast: sufficiency in God, and sufficiency in ancestral custom.

tree:0ayl28c1krmoxa.why: Glory be to You: the angels confessing their limited knowledge (2:32), and the worshipped disowning their worshippers (25:18, 34:41).
tree:0ayl28c1krmoxa.relation: Those worshipped besides God will glorify Him and disown their worshippers.

tree:1430w0h114ouyn.why: We are... is a common opening; the chiefs of Saba, the angels and the wealthy boasters say different things.

tree:0sl6aq40tziy14.why: All three rows stay. 'They said: O you ...' is the same address in all three: Joseph's brothers to the Aziz twice (12:78, 12:88), and the mockers to the Prophet, 'O you to whom the Reminder was sent' (15:6). Same words, different speakers.
tree:0sl6aq40tziy14.relation: Pleading to the Aziz, mocking the Prophet.

tree:1gcp2at0g3nkyd.why: We have made the signs clear: for people of certainty (2:118), for you if you reason (3:118, 57:17). A memorizer set.
tree:1gcp2at0g3nkyd.relation: Clear signs, for those who reason and are certain.

tree:00ag51z1xztbrz.why: All three rows stay. 'There has come to you ...' is the same words and structure: a clear proof from your Lord (Salih 7:73, Shu'ayb 7:85) and an admonition from your Lord (10:57). Same words, different subject.
tree:00ag51z1xztbrz.relation: What comes from your Lord: a clear proof, and an admonition that heals hearts.

tree:0aaoghd16krlp1.why: I have come to you with a sign (Isa, 3:49), a clear proof (Musa, 7:105), wisdom (Isa, 43:63). A memorizer set on messengers' credentials.
tree:0aaoghd16krlp1.relation: Each messenger came with proof from his Lord.

tree:1q0mshw1pglpt2.why: All three rows stay. 'Each has known' is the same verb and structure: each people knew its drinking place (2:60, 7:160), and each creature knows its prayer and glorification (24:41). Same words, different subject.
tree:1q0mshw1pglpt2.relation: Each knows its share: the tribes their spring, every creature its prayer.

tree:0ftphec12ch5o8.why: If they deny you, messengers before were denied: 3:184 and 35:25 nearly identical, and nations before you denied (29:18).
tree:0ftphec12ch5o8.relation: Denial is the old fate of every messenger.

tree:0y6qohu084vuso.why: God knows: those who slip away (24:63), what you are on (24:64), those who hold others back (33:18).
tree:0y6qohu084vuso.relation: God knows the hypocrites' hidden actions.

tree:1f4h7b80h710k6.why: Those of modest gaze, with one word after each time (37:48, 38:52, 55:56). Short ayat a memorizer mixes up.
tree:1f4h7b80h710k6.relation: The companions of Paradise described with modesty.

tree:1q1qips00f8ss0.why: They will say God, so say: will you not fear Him (10:31, 23:87) or take heed (23:85). A memorizer set on one argument.
tree:1q1qips00f8ss0.relation: They admit God's lordship yet do not fear Him.

tree:1y5rpe3164trg5.why: Say, each... is a short reply used for three unrelated points: all is from God, each acts in his way, each is waiting.

tree:12orbhv0dwpvqf.why: Say, to God belongs: east and west (2:142), mercy He wrote for Himself (6:12), all intercession (39:44). A memorizer set.
tree:12orbhv0dwpvqf.relation: Direction, mercy and intercession all belong to God.

tree:1eb345a0tg59ma.why: 6:12 and 23:84 both ask: to whom belongs what is in the heavens and earth / the earth and who is in it? In 8:70 'say to those who' is a preposition with a relative, not the question 'whose is', a different structure.
tree:1eb345a0tg59ma.relation: The question that makes the deniers admit everything is God's.

tree:038r4sx0xe3ls3.why: We said to them: be apes, despised (2:65, 7:166), and do not transgress the Sabbath (4:154). The Sabbath story told with the command and its punishment.
tree:038r4sx0xe3ls3.relation: The command not to break the Sabbath, and the punishment of those who did.

tree:0l4far4142jbve.why: The people of Musa: some took the calf (7:148), some guide by the truth (7:159), and Qarun was one of them (28:76).
tree:0l4far4142jbve.relation: Contrast within one people: idolaters, the righteous and the arrogant rich.

tree:0lqib781xgcpz4.why: He will replace you with another people, and you cannot harm Him: 9:39, 11:57 and 47:38, each ending differently. A memorizer set.
tree:0lqib781xgcpz4.relation: God does not need those who turn away; He can replace them.

tree:071rz7l1y9j4s3.why: They were arrogant and were a criminal people: Pharaoh's people (7:133, 10:75), and the disbelievers on the Day (45:31). A memorizer closing set.
tree:071rz7l1y9j4s3.relation: Arrogance before the signs is the crime of every denying people.

check.why: Keep is right: 'they were arrogant and a criminal people', a closing set. The runOn flag is right.

tree:062gu74107f2ni.why: When it is said to you: march forth, and they lagged (9:38); go back, so go back (24:28); make room, so make room (58:11).
tree:062gu74107f2ni.relation: Contrast: believers who obey an instruction at once, and those who drag their feet.

check.why: Keep is right: 'when it is said to you' gives a contrast between prompt obedience and lagging.

tree:1dv6b1p1mulpmb.why: Satan was ungrateful to his Lord (17:27), a forsaker of man (25:29), and calls them to the fire (31:21).
tree:1dv6b1p1mulpmb.relation: Satan's nature: ungrateful, treacherous, and calling to Hell.

tree:12gz7dp088y6cp.why: He is aware and seeing of His servants (17:30, 17:96), seeing of His servants (35:45). A memorizer closing set.
tree:12gz7dp088y6cp.relation: God watches His servants in provision, testimony and respite.

tree:148imtx1a6jcqz.why: 4:29 and 17:66 end 'He is ever Merciful to you', after forbidding self-harm and after subjecting the ships. In 4:102 'if there is with you harm' has another structure and sense.
tree:148imtx1a6jcqz.changes: Removed 4:102: a different structure and sense. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:148imtx1a6jcqz.relation: God's mercy behind both a prohibition and a provision.

tree:1yajyqc0kwy2lw.why: All three rows stay. 'Was, with ...' is the same words and structure: Ishmael was pleasing to his Lord (19:55), Moses was honoured with God (33:69), and harming the Prophet was grave with God (33:53). Same words, different subject; 33:53 and 33:69 are in the same surah.
tree:1yajyqc0kwy2lw.relation: What stands high with God (the prophets) and what weighs heavy with Him (harming the Prophet).
