tree:05nlnyw09sgaxq.why: Dying in disbelief, four times with different consequences a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:05nlnyw09sgaxq.relation: Death in disbelief closes the door: curse, no ransom, no repentance, no forgiveness.

tree:0fhgydn0z2x7jb.why: Turning away in aversion: from the Book's judgement, from hearing, after God's bounty, from the reminder.
tree:0fhgydn0z2x7jb.relation: Aversion as a habit of those who reject guidance.

tree:04l0pay1cm64w6.why: All four rows stay. 'They, of it ...' is the same structure in all four: when Our punishment or signs came, at once they ran from it / laughed at it (21:12, 43:47), the people of the Garden will not be removed from it (15:48), they are blind to it (27:66). Same words, different subject.
tree:04l0pay1cm64w6.relation: Running from punishment, laughing at signs, blind to the Hereafter; and the believers never removed from the Garden.

tree:0x6dvms10lh93u.why: All four rows stay. 'He is the Knowing' closes all four: Jacob in his grief and Joseph at the reunion, 'He is the Knowing, the Wise' (12:83, 12:100), and 'and He is the Knowing, the Able / the Wise' (30:54, 66:2). The memorizer's point is 'indeed He' against 'and He', and the second name. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0x6dvms10lh93u.relation: Trust in God's knowledge and wisdom, in grief and in reunion.

tree:0f2yb9k0nlenza.why: A stock closing about God's knowledge after unrelated subjects; only 36:79 differs and that alone is no card.

tree:12yb6kw0tqlrki.why: God gives life and death, said with the oneness formula and different continuations a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:12yb6kw0tqlrki.relation: The One who gives life and death is the only one to worship.

tree:1s7a6ta0ni4hrc.why: The idolaters' one argument, we found our fathers so, in four places; 43:22 and 43:23 differ only in the last word.
tree:1s7a6ta0ni4hrc.relation: Blind imitation of ancestors as the answer to every prophet.

tree:19ordl61nxgd9c.why: Seeking God's face: everywhere one turns, in spending, and in 30:38 and 30:39 giving to kin and zakat set against usury.
tree:19ordl61nxgd9c.relation: Deeds done for God's face grow; usury does not.

tree:0wao9db1qcop1l.why: The address to people of understanding, each time tied to fearing God and a different command.
tree:0wao9db1qcop1l.relation: Understanding shown in mindfulness of God: in retaliation, the Hajj, choosing the good.

tree:0oy0j2i0lw2p5o.why: The denial that God has taken a son; 17:111 and 25:2 share a whole clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:0oy0j2i0lw2p5o.relation: God has no son: it does not befit Him, and He has no partner in His dominion.

tree:1lv1t8n01trc63.why: All four rows stay. 'Reciting to them' is the same words in all four: Abraham's prayer and its answer, a messenger who recites, purifies and teaches (2:129, 3:164, 62:2, with the order changed), and a messenger reciting Our signs before a town is destroyed (28:59). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1lv1t8n01trc63.relation: Every messenger recites God's signs: to purify and teach, and to warn before destruction.

tree:0u6pv5206dcidw.why: God turning in mercy: to those who repent soon, to whom He wills (twice in at-Tawba), and to the believers.

tree:1vx6qxk0r5pxpa.why: Left to God: He may forgive or punish them; four places with different order and endings.
tree:1vx6qxk0r5pxpa.relation: The fate of the wrongdoers is God's to decide, not the Prophet's.

tree:1cmazna0ewwz84.why: Arguing about God without knowledge (22:3, 22:8, 31:20) and arguing about His signs (40:4); close wording a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1cmazna0ewwz84.relation: Disputing God and His signs without knowledge.

tree:0arvs1g11tecgc.why: All four rows stay. 'Make for him' is the same verb and structure: whoever fears God, He makes for him a way out (65:2) and ease (65:4), He did not make any crookedness in the Book (18:1), or will my Lord set for it a term (72:25). Same words, different subject.
tree:0arvs1g11tecgc.relation: What God makes: a way out and ease for the God-fearing, a straight Book, and a term only He knows.

tree:191zd150j5lnoz.why: People who think they are guided or doing well while they are lost; 7:30 and 43:37 end identically.
tree:191zd150j5lnoz.relation: The deception of thinking oneself guided while astray.

tree:1whbqdl04h5921.why: The hypocrites swearing by God, four times, each oath covering a different lie.

tree:0lrrwtr10iqvat.why: God gives life to the dead, with different frames (He is the Truth, He is the Protector, He is able); close wording a memorizer must hold.
tree:0lrrwtr10iqvat.relation: The power to revive the dead as proof of the resurrection.

tree:1hyx4a10ro8t4z.why: God never breaks His covenant or promise, four times with a different noun (covenant, promise, appointment).
tree:1hyx4a10ro8t4z.relation: Certainty of God's promise against the false hopes and impatience of the deniers.

tree:1iq2oj70i7bx3n.why: God directs the whole affair, after creation and the throne; the continuations differ and a memorizer must keep them apart.
tree:1iq2oj70i7bx3n.relation: The Creator who directs every matter is the only one to worship.

tree:1xwntg5048uas5.why: Those who will enter the Garden, said three times with different endings, set against 7:40 where the arrogant deniers will not enter it.
tree:1xwntg5048uas5.relation: Contrast: who enters the Garden and who never will.

tree:10qjr9z00mhscz.why: Who provides for you from the sky and the earth: four questions to the idolaters, one with heavens in the plural.
tree:10qjr9z00mhscz.relation: The provider is the one to be worshipped.

tree:165fcde0lcl1as.why: All four rows stay. 'He sends upon you' is the same verb and sense: a storm of stones or a gale for those who feel safe (17:68, 17:69, 67:17), and guardians He sends over you (6:61). Same words, different subject.
tree:165fcde0lcl1as.relation: What God sends over people: guardians for protection or a storm for punishment.

tree:0zjufgr1mw67sp.why: All four rows stay. 'He wills; and whoever' is the same structure in all four: 'whom He wills', then a new condition with 'whoever'. 4:48 and 4:116 are the classic pair (whoever associates with God ...); 2:269 (whoever is given wisdom has been given much good) and 39:23 (whoever God leaves astray has no guide) follow the same shape. Same words, different subject.
tree:0zjufgr1mw67sp.relation: God's will gives wisdom and guidance; association with Him is the unforgivable sin.

tree:10j5eb00zk9xye.why: God strikes parables: foam and what lasts, the good tree, the niche of light, the two parties.

tree:0ihqy5a1kmfkfc.why: Hud, Salih, Shu'ayb and the messengers in general answered with the same refusal to leave what their fathers worshipped.
tree:0ihqy5a1kmfkfc.relation: Different prophets, the same reply: we will not leave our fathers' gods.

tree:0bcg9y919sninn.why: Fighting in God's way: against Satan's allies, as the believers' sale of themselves, in ranks, and as one of the excuses for lighter night prayer.
tree:0bcg9y919sninn.relation: What fighting in God's way means and how God values it.

tree:0o4sh1b0sonxvt.why: Four regrets of the lost, each saying would that I had or had not: associating, not following the Messenger, the record, the deeds.
tree:0o4sh1b0sonxvt.relation: Late regrets that teach what to do now.

tree:09i9iww1norm2o.why: Callers to God addressing their people: Ibrahim disowning idols, the believer of Pharaoh's family fearing for them twice, Noah warning.
tree:09i9iww1norm2o.relation: The callers' concern for their people.

tree:1ocbvfe0lzqjda.why: Only a short verb phrase is shared; four unrelated contexts.

tree:0zzb86k1pjuwqc.why: All four rows stay. 'That he should have' is the same words and structure: how could He have a son (4:171, 6:101), how can he have kingship over us (2:247), and it is not for a prophet to have captives (8:67). Same words, different subject.
tree:0zzb86k1pjuwqc.relation: What is unfitting: a son for God, kingship in the eyes of the envious, captives for a prophet too soon.

tree:0po24ke1qeiueu.why: What guides to the truth: God and not the idols, the revelation as the people of knowledge see it, and the jinn twice describing the Quran.
tree:0po24ke1qeiueu.relation: The Quran guides to the truth, to the straight path, to right conduct.

tree:1k4v8mg1lpnhhy.why: God guides by His word whom He wills; 6:88 and 39:23 share the same clause, and 2:26 shows the same word misleading others.
tree:1k4v8mg1lpnhhy.relation: The same revelation guides some and misleads others.

tree:0vdxc2i0net81e.why: Commands to the Prophet about what is revealed to him: follow it (10:109, 33:2), do not leave any of it (11:12). In 42:3 the verb is active ('thus God reveals to you'), a different word.
tree:0vdxc2i0net81e.changes: Removed 42:3: an active verb, a different word.
tree:0vdxc2i0net81e.relation: Follow what is revealed and do not let people's words make you leave any of it.

tree:0hkhihq12e8t28.why: Scenes of the gathering: jinn and men, the short stay, the worshipped and their worshippers questioned.
tree:0hkhihq12e8t28.relation: On the Day of gathering, the false ties are exposed.

tree:171kv9l1cx32st.why: The Day when the reckoning, the witnesses, the Spirit and the angels, and all people stand.
tree:171kv9l1cx32st.relation: The standing of the Day from four sides.

tree:050h44i00214we.why: God's call on the Day: where are My partners (28:62, 28:74, 41:47) and how did you answer the messengers (28:65).
tree:050h44i00214we.relation: The questions of the Day: about the partners and about the messengers.

tree:0161xgy0vgp0t4.why: What will not happen on that Day: intercession, excuses, questioning, a punishment like His.

tree:1pcp5p21cti1mq.why: Leave them until they meet their promised Day: 43:83 and 70:42 identical, 52:45 differs at the end.
tree:1pcp5p21cti1mq.relation: The deniers left to their play until the Day.

tree:177p2de0ynbpfq.why: How people respond to what God gave them of His bounty: the martyrs rejoice in it, misers hoard it, others hide it or envy those who have it, and the hypocrites are told to be content with it.
tree:177p2de0ynbpfq.relation: Five attitudes to God's bounty: joy, miserliness, concealment, envy, contentment.

tree:07q4kck1pcb4p4.why: The deniers' question about rising after becoming dust or bones, five times with differences a memorizer must catch (dust or bones, raised or brought out).
tree:07q4kck1pcb4p4.relation: The same denial of resurrection across the surahs, and the answers it gets.

tree:0fpq48m01glj2o.why: Declarations of faith in the revelation: the firmly grounded in knowledge, the People of the Book, the believers, the jinn; set against 34:52, the deniers who say it when it is too late.
tree:0fpq48m01glj2o.relation: Contrast: faith declared in time, and the same words said too late on the Day.

check.why: Keep is right: 'we believe in it' as a declaration of faith in several speakers, with 34:52 as the too-late contrast.

tree:0slz79a01y92hs.why: Calls to believe in what God sent down: to the People of the Book, who are told it confirms what they have (2:41, 4:47), their refusal (2:91), the hypocrites' false claim (4:60), and the believers who did believe (47:2).
tree:0slz79a01y92hs.relation: Belief in the revelation demanded, refused, claimed and fulfilled.

tree:0wp88rv1ugoprp.why: The question will we really be raised, five times, with pairs that match exactly (17:49 and 17:98; 37:16 and 56:47) and others that differ.
tree:0wp88rv1ugoprp.relation: The denial of resurrection and the answers: be stone or iron, yes and humbled, the first and the last.

tree:0n1e3ji1w8can0.why: What people follow: the command to follow what God sent (7:3), the reply that they follow their fathers (2:170, 31:21, a close pair), and those who followed the devils' magic or what angers God.
tree:0n1e3ji1w8can0.relation: Following revelation against following fathers, devils and what angers God.

check.why: Keep is right: 'they followed what', with the near-identical 2:170 and 31:21 and the command in 7:3.

tree:1jbr2mi1as61d8.why: All five rows stay. 'God took' is the same verb and sense in all five: the claim that God took a son, answered four ways (2:116, 10:68, 18:4, 23:91), and God took Abraham as a close friend (4:125). Same words, different subject. The row that reads on stays as it is.
tree:1jbr2mi1as61d8.relation: Contrast: God took Abraham as a friend; He never took a son.

tree:0uqlcsu0hs428g.why: All five rows stay. 'More worthy that' is the same words and structure: God is more worthy to be feared (9:13, 33:37), pleased (9:62), followed (10:35), and a mosque founded on piety is more worthy that you stand in it (9:108). Same words, different subject.
tree:0uqlcsu0hs428g.relation: What is most deserving: fear of God, His pleasure, His guidance, and a mosque built on piety.

tree:1gpwl060kqe4gk.why: What God made lawful: intimacy on fasting nights, marriage beyond the forbidden degrees, good things to eat (5:4, 5:5), the catch of the sea.
tree:1gpwl060kqe4gk.relation: The Quran's statements of the lawful.

check.why: Keep is right: 'made lawful for you' with different objects, a memorizer set on one theme, with 5:4 and 5:5 near-identical.

tree:0fm1vki06vhc0e.why: The covenants God took: 2:63 and 2:93 identical openings with different endings, 2:83 and 2:84 its terms, and 33:7 the covenant of the prophets.
tree:0fm1vki06vhc0e.relation: The covenants with the Children of Israel and with the prophets.

tree:1cxnqpc13d05ag.why: Only a time phrase is shared, in five unrelated contexts.

tree:0vb8lmn0suqdu1.why: All five rows stay as one card. 'When there came to them' is the same words and structure in all five: Our punishment (6:43, 7:5), the guidance (17:94, 18:55), and Moses (17:101). A split into two pairs would leave 17:101 alone and remove it only for its subject, so the card is judged whole.
tree:0vb8lmn0suqdu1.relation: What came to people, punishment, guidance or a prophet, and how they answered.

tree:10vhl0o112hxt2.why: Only a speech opener is shared, by five unrelated speakers.

tree:0aias0818jwnig.why: All five rows stay. 'When ... says' is the same words and structure in all five: the hypocrites and the sick of heart at Badr and at the Trench (8:49, 33:12, the close pair), the Prophet to his companion in the cave (9:40), the wrongdoers (17:47), and the best of them in conduct (20:104). Same words, different speaker.
tree:0aias0818jwnig.relation: Words that reveal hearts: the hypocrites' doubt against the Prophet's 'God is with us'.

tree:02qo7kn1mlmbi1.why: All five rows stay. 'When he reached' is the same words and structure: Dhul-Qarnayn's three journeys (18:86, 18:90, 18:93), and reaching puberty (24:59) and full strength (46:15). Same words, different subject.
tree:02qo7kn1mlmbi1.relation: Reaching the ends of the earth, and reaching maturity: each brings new duties.

tree:17728i70tj9iv1.why: Only a time clause is shared; what comes (the Hour, a sign, the angels, good fortune) and the subjects are unrelated.

tree:13eg5rg1ajvziy.why: All five rows stay. 'When He decrees a matter' is the same words and structure in all five: four times 'He only says to it Be, and it is' (2:117, 3:47, 19:35, 40:68), and when God and His Messenger decree a matter, the believers have no choice (33:36). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:13eg5rg1ajvziy.relation: God's decree in creation and in law: both are final.

tree:0y5sl9108zo1p5.why: All five rows stay. 'Then surely among the ...' is the same words and structure in all five: a speaker who would then be a wrongdoer or a sinner (2:145, 5:106, 5:107, 11:31), and Pharaoh's promise 'then you will surely be among those brought near' (26:42). Same words, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:0y5sl9108zo1p5.relation: Then among the wrongdoers, then among the favoured: what follows a choice.

tree:0vcdakd02g1jen.why: Only a verb of wanting is shared, in five unrelated contexts.

tree:1y3f02o04dcqsu.why: Moses sent with Our signs, five times: 11:96 and 40:23 identical, the others differing in what follows.
tree:1y3f02o04dcqsu.relation: The mission of Moses with signs and clear authority.

tree:1gcz0qk032a88e.why: God has prepared for the disbelievers a punishment, five times with a different object; 4:37 and 4:151 identical.
tree:1gcz0qk032a88e.relation: What is prepared for the disbelievers: humiliation, pain, blaze, chains.

tree:18ozvsv1mr75r7.why: The command to turn from opponents, each time with a different follow-up: admonish, rely on God, judge or not, until they change the topic, and wait.
tree:18ozvsv1mr75r7.relation: How to turn away from those who reject, without abandoning the mission.

tree:0swimoj1nrfqkt.why: Only the opener know that is shared, followed by five unrelated statements.

tree:1vulywx0413awv.why: Prophets asking forgiveness, each adding a different request: Moses for his brother, Ibrahim and Noah for parents and believers, Moses for himself, Solomon for a kingdom.
tree:1vulywx0413awv.relation: How the prophets asked forgiveness, and for whom.

tree:1euf57c1154k7g.why: Will you not be mindful: the same call by Hud, Noah and a messenger in identical words, and twice after the idolaters admit God is the Lord.
tree:1euf57c1154k7g.relation: The prophets' call to worship God alone, and the argument from what the idolaters themselves admit.

tree:1fbjgp60psxelu.why: The command to establish prayer, five times, each with its own addition: its times (11:114, 17:78), its purpose (remembrance, restraining from evil), and Luqman's advice.
tree:1fbjgp60psxelu.relation: Prayer: when, why, and what it does.

check.why: Keep is right: the command 'establish the prayer', five times, each with its own addition.

tree:1xj8l5z1qwa8hb.why: 'And I was commanded to be among the Muslims / the believers' (10:72, 10:104, 27:91), a memorizer trap. In 2:67 the words follow another verb ('I seek refuge in God from being'), and in 39:58 'then I would be' follows 'if I had another chance': different governing words.
tree:1xj8l5z1qwa8hb.changes: Removed 2:67 and 39:58: different governing words. The rows that read on are kept.
tree:1xj8l5z1qwa8hb.relation: The messenger's own submission, stated by Noah and by the Prophet.

tree:18wnfrf05pz9f5.why: They follow only conjecture: five times, with three close endings (they only guess) and two in an-Najm that add desire and the worthlessness of conjecture.
tree:18wnfrf05pz9f5.relation: Idolatry rests on conjecture, not knowledge.

tree:1yszy741vqru40.why: All five rows stay. 'Except themselves' is the same exception in all five: the plotters deceive, mislead or destroy only themselves (2:9, 3:69, 4:113, 6:26), and husbands with no witnesses except themselves (24:6). Same words and structure, different subject. The rows that read on stay as they are.
tree:1yszy741vqru40.relation: Plotters harm only themselves; a husband's own oath stands as witness.

tree:02twhnr1vcwqub.why: No soul is burdened beyond its capacity, five times in different settings: nursing, the closing prayer of al-Baqara, fair dealing, Paradise, the record.
tree:02twhnr1vcwqub.relation: God's mercy in what He asks of each soul.

tree:1u6qeze0pxuefs.why: Only two words across a clause break are shared; the real 35:40 and 46:4 pair is kept elsewhere.

tree:010krow1su1p18.why: Only two words across a clause break are shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:1qqc1ou1s3lgiw.why: Creation of the heavens and earth in six days, four times with different continuations, and 41:9 the earth in two days.
tree:1qqc1ou1s3lgiw.relation: The six days of creation, and what each passage draws from it.

tree:17fsmig1m0fk2e.why: A common phrase about the earth and whoever is on it, with different subjects (glorification, inheritance, corruption, ownership); no shared point.

tree:1t3wkwk01yp4py.why: The particle after man is a different word in each (relative, exclamation, question), so the ayat do not match in structure.

tree:1n577sy0lbd04o.why: Only a stock closing about God making the signs clear is shared; the subjects are unrelated rulings and parables.

tree:1j9crza0f5cgs2.why: Two different words share the spelling 'that I bestowed / that You bestowed'. God to the Children of Israel: remember My favour that I bestowed on you (2:40, 2:47, 2:122). A man's prayer: to thank Your favour that You bestowed on me and my parents (27:19, 46:15). The verb's person differs, so the split follows it.
tree:1j9crza0f5cgs2.changes: Split: God's reminder to Israel (2:40, 2:47, 2:122) and the prayer (27:19, 46:15). The rows that read on are kept.
tree:1j9crza0f5cgs2.relation: Favour remembered by command and favour thanked by prayer.

check.why: Right split: the reminder to the Children of Israel and the prayer to be grateful for favour on me and my parents. Every row is kept.

tree:1ra6oun1ri30gz.why: 'That which they used to' is followed by two different verbs: 'do', with the best or worst of their deeds repaid (29:7, 39:35, 41:27), and 'were promised', the Day (46:16, 70:44). Different phrases, so two cards.
tree:1ra6oun1ri30gz.changes: Split by the verb that follows: 'do' (29:7, 39:35, 41:27) and 'were promised' (46:16, 70:44). The rows that read on are kept.
tree:1ra6oun1ri30gz.relation: Deeds repaid by their best or worst, and the promised Day.

check.why: The split is right: 'the best or worst of what they used to do' and 'the Day they were promised' are two different closings. Every row is kept as it was.

tree:1sd2kib15cy847.why: All five rows stay. 'He who sent down' is the same verb and structure in all five: the Book (4:136, 7:196), the Criterion (25:1), the Reminder, in the deniers' mockery (15:6), and water from the sky in measure (43:11). Same words, different subject.
tree:1sd2kib15cy847.relation: The One who sends down revelation also sends down rain: both give life.

tree:0wim7kp13xdabv.why: The arrogant chiefs against the believers among Salih's and Shu'ayb's peoples, and the arrogant arguing with the weak in Hell.
tree:0wim7kp13xdabv.relation: The arrogant in this life and in the Fire.

tree:0tbafcz13e0fdn.why: Only a relative clause with a negation is shared, followed by unrelated verbs.

tree:0eqewch0zb2gth.why: All five rows stay. 'Those who say' is the same words in all five: people described by their prayers (3:16, 4:75, 25:65, 25:74), and the hypocrites who say do not spend on those with the Messenger (63:7). Same words, opposite saying.
tree:0eqewch0zb2gth.relation: Contrast: people known by their prayers, and people known by their stinginess.

tree:1glhchk01juku0.why: 34:2 and 57:4 are the real pair and are kept elsewhere; the others share only two common words.

tree:1d7axeu1xpgrds.why: Hearing, sight and hearts as God's gift, with endings that differ (so you may give thanks, little do you give thanks); 23:78 and 67:23 continue alike.
tree:1d7axeu1xpgrds.relation: The gift of senses, and how little thanks it gets.

tree:07s4i011pznbgv.why: God is free of need and praised, five times with different lead-ins; 57:24 and 60:6 identical.
tree:07s4i011pznbgv.relation: God needs nothing from His creatures.

tree:16w2s0c12qmens.why: Sun and moon each running to a set term, four times, and each in an orbit in 21:33.
tree:16w2s0c12qmens.relation: The ordered course of the sun and moon as a sign.

tree:1nhbaf9016wfzh.why: 'God made for you': spouses, homes, shade and shelter (16:72, 16:80, 16:81), the earth spread out (71:19). In 29:10 the two words only meet across a clause ('harmed for God, he takes people's trial as God's punishment'), with God's name in another role.
tree:1nhbaf9016wfzh.relation: Blessings God made for people, listed one after another.

tree:073ndmo1oyv8xw.why: 'God ... all together': the Day God raises them all (58:6, 58:18, identical openings), and wherever you are God will bring you all together (2:148), the same structure. In 3:103 ('the rope of God, all together') and 24:31 ('turn to God all together') God's name is governed by another word and 'all' describes you, a different structure.
tree:073ndmo1oyv8xw.changes: Removed only 3:103 and 24:31: a different structure. 2:148 stays.
tree:073ndmo1oyv8xw.relation: God gathers all of them, wherever they are, and tells them what they did.

tree:075css51oru5hb.why: Acknowledging God's favour: Yusuf twice and his brothers in the same surah, the onlookers of Qarun, and the people of Paradise.
tree:075css51oru5hb.relation: Grace recognized: by the prophet, by those who wronged him, by those spared, and in Paradise.

tree:045r2v21hby92u.why: Only the name of God before a conditional is shared; five unrelated rulings.

tree:1f7x8b905isauv.why: All five rows stay. 'God, then He is' is the same conditional structure in all five: whom God guides is the guided one (7:178, 17:97, 18:17, with small differences), whoever honours God's sanctities, that is better for him (22:30), whoever relies on God, He is sufficient for him (65:3). Same words, different subject.
tree:1f7x8b905isauv.relation: Guidance, honour and sufficiency all come from God.

tree:1v9n7bt1eb7qlz.why: 3:52 and 61:14 are the same exchange: Jesus asks who will be his helpers for God and the disciples answer. In 2:246, 5:116 and 36:47 the two words only touch across a clause break: God's name ends one sentence and a new speaker begins.
tree:1v9n7bt1eb7qlz.changes: Removed 2:246, 5:116 and 36:47: the shared words cross a clause break, a different structure.
tree:1v9n7bt1eb7qlz.relation: The disciples' answer, told twice in nearly the same words.

tree:0mfc9k21sn0vvg.why: 5:56, 58:22 and 24:13 share one shape: a phrase ending in God's name, then the pronoun 'they' as a separator, then the predicate (the victors, the successful, the liars). In 3:107 the pronoun begins a new clause, 'they will abide in it', and in 16:72 it is the subject of a verb, 'they disbelieve'.
tree:0mfc9k21sn0vvg.changes: Kept 24:13, which the first agent removed: it has the same separating pronoun before a predicate. Removed 3:107 and 16:72, where the pronoun begins a verbal or new clause.
tree:0mfc9k21sn0vvg.relation: Who they are in God's sight: His party the victors and the successful; the slanderers, the liars.

tree:0yee9zm12avzua.why: Obey God and the Messenger, four times with different consequences, and 8:27 the warning not to betray them.
tree:0yee9zm12avzua.relation: Obedience to God and the Messenger, its fruits, and its opposite.

tree:0921s0k1usfj7w.why: 3:117 and 16:33 say God did not wrong them but they wronged themselves. In 10:37 and 10:104 the words follow 'besides God' and 'but' corrects a different claim; in 3:79 'but' is part of a different sentence about a prophet. Different structures.
tree:0921s0k1usfj7w.changes: Removed 3:79, 10:37 and 10:104: the shared words sit in different structures.
tree:0921s0k1usfj7w.relation: God did not wrong them; they wronged themselves, told twice with a small change.

check.why: Checked: 3:79, 10:37 and 10:104 are kept together in tree:031040p178dyhp (W4). The pair left, 'God did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves' (3:117, 16:33), is real.

tree:18kzn0m0oys072.why: Two groups: 'God does not want injustice' (3:108 for the worlds, 40:31 for the servants), and 'God wants' with a following object or clause (4:27, 8:67). 11:34 has the same words and shape as 4:27, 'God wants to', so it belongs in the second group; the subject is Noah's warning, which does not justify removing it.
tree:18kzn0m0oys072.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 11:34 in the second group instead of removing it.
tree:18kzn0m0oys072.relation: What God does not want (injustice) and what He does want, against what people want.

tree:13elpf30p3vb6b.why: Did I not tell you: God to the angels, Ya'qub to his sons, al-Khidr to Moses twice, the best of the garden owners. Each time the one who knew is proven right.
tree:13elpf30p3vb6b.relation: The one who warned or knew is vindicated.

tree:0vdehhx03ew4lr.why: Did not messengers, news or a warner come to you: asked of jinn and men, by the keepers of Hell (39:71 and 67:8), and of people about past nations.
tree:0vdehhx03ew4lr.relation: No one is punished without a warning first.

tree:0g6gxw811ot2vy.why: All five open with the same question, 'do they not see', followed by what they should see. 7:148 has the same words and structure ('do they not see that it...'), like 27:86; only the subject, the calf, differs. That is not a reason to remove it.
tree:0g6gxw811ot2vy.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 7:148 has the same opening and structure.
tree:0g6gxw811ot2vy.relation: The question 'do they not see' asked about destroyed nations, the birds, the night, and the calf.

tree:0esfyxv1ygkkax.why: The claims about the Messiah son of Mary refuted: he is God (5:17, 5:72 identical openings), son of God, a lord; 5:75 states he was only a messenger.
tree:0esfyxv1ygkkax.relation: What the Messiah is and is not.

tree:14rage509qh3kb.why: All five use 'the chiefs from' followed by a people. 2:246 has the same words and structure ('the chiefs from the Children of Israel'); only the story differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:14rage509qh3kb.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 2:246 has the same words and structure.
tree:14rage509qh3kb.relation: The chiefs of a people: of Noah's people, of Pharaoh's, of a later messenger's, and of Israel asking for a king.

tree:151o5uv1mwmk6j.why: All five say 'the Fire which' followed by a relative clause. 56:71 has the same words and structure ('the fire which you kindle'); the contrast between the fire of this world and the Fire of the Hereafter is worth keeping. 34:42 and 52:14 read on into the next ayah.
tree:151o5uv1mwmk6j.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 56:71 has the same words and structure.
tree:151o5uv1mwmk6j.relation: The Fire prepared for the disbelievers and denied by them, against the fire people kindle.

tree:11j2cbb06pkpwx.why: In all five 'the Fire' is followed by a negation with 'and not'. 5:37 uses the same negating particle ('and they will not leave it'), so the shared words have the same structure; only what is denied differs. 29:25 and 45:34 read on into the next ayah.
tree:11j2cbb06pkpwx.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 5:37 uses the same negation after the same word.
tree:11j2cbb06pkpwx.relation: The Fire and what it denies: no helpers, no protectors, and no way out.

tree:1t8tzjs168e8ek.why: 4:170, 4:174, 10:57 and 10:108 are the vocative 'O mankind, there has come to you' with what has come. In 3:173 'mankind' is the subject of a reported statement, 'the people have gathered against you': a different structure and a different verb.
tree:1t8tzjs168e8ek.changes: Removed 3:173: not the vocative, and the verb is 'gathered', not 'came'.
tree:1t8tzjs168e8ek.relation: What has come to mankind from their Lord: the Messenger, a proof, an admonition, the truth.

check.why: In 3:173, 'the people have gathered' has 'the people' as the subject of inna, not the address 'O mankind, there has come to you'. A different structure, so removing it is right.

tree:04fch900zj65jg.why: The One, the Subduer, five times with different lead-ins: Yusuf in prison, the Day, the Prophet's declaration, the denial of a son.
tree:04fch900zj65jg.relation: God's oneness and supremacy in this world and on the Day.

tree:0q9o6xz033ktg7.why: All five use 'to the sky' with the same sense and the same preposition. 22:15 stretches a rope 'to the sky': the governing verb differs but the word keeps its sense, much like 'look to the sky'. Removing it for its subject is not allowed, and a split would only separate verbs that a memorizer reads together.
tree:0q9o6xz033ktg7.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 22:15 has the same phrase in the same sense.
tree:0q9o6xz033ktg7.relation: Toward the sky: God turning to form it, people told to look at it, and the one who would stretch a rope to it.

tree:0znxw4z18hooyb.why: 2:221, 28:41 and 40:41 share 'invite to the Fire', the same governing verb. In 14:30 the phrase completes 'your destination is to the Fire' and in 41:19 'they are gathered to the Fire': a different governing word and structure. 14:30 and 40:41 read on into the next ayah.
tree:0znxw4z18hooyb.changes: Removed 14:30 and 41:19: their governing word is not 'invite'.
tree:0znxw4z18hooyb.relation: Those who invite to the Fire: idolaters in marriage, Pharaoh's leaders, and Pharaoh's people calling the believer.

tree:18ovcph0hsvfi7.why: Disbelievers gathered or driven to Hell, five times with different endings.
tree:18ovcph0hsvfi7.relation: The driving of the disbelievers to Hell.

tree:10apmdu1plas5i.why: 25:57, 73:19, 76:29 and 78:39 say whoever wills takes a way to his Lord. In 18:87 the governing verb is passive, 'he will be returned to his Lord', a different verb and structure. The other rows read on into the next ayah.
tree:10apmdu1plas5i.changes: Removed 18:87: a different governing verb in the passive.
tree:10apmdu1plas5i.relation: Whoever wills takes a way to his Lord, said four times with small changes.

tree:0dstooe1dmww9o.why: Four ayat share 'to my Lord' after a verb of going or returning: the proud man 'if I am returned to my Lord' (18:36, 41:50), and Lot and Ibrahim 'I am going to my Lord' (29:26, 37:99). In 34:50 the word is 'to me', with my Lord as the subject of 'reveals': a different word and structure.
tree:0dstooe1dmww9o.changes: Removed 34:50: the word is 'to me', a different word. Split into the conditional pair and the departure pair.
tree:0dstooe1dmww9o.relation: Going back to the Lord: the proud man sure of good if returned, and the prophets leaving their people for Him.

tree:15n46fj0681uph.why: Two groups: 'then We force them / they are returned to a punishment' with an adjective (2:126, 31:24, 9:101), and Satan leading or calling 'to the punishment of the blaze' (22:4, 31:21). 9:101 has the same shape as 31:24 ('then' + verb + 'to a punishment' + adjective); only the subject, the hypocrites, differs. 22:4 and 31:21 read on into the next ayah.
tree:15n46fj0681uph.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 9:101 in the first group, and kept the rows that read on.
tree:15n46fj0681uph.relation: Driven to punishment after a short reprieve, and led to it by Satan.

tree:0c6cdqg1kbu5oo.why: 11:70, 15:58 and 51:32 are the angels' words 'We have been sent to a people'. In 4:90 the governing verb is 'reach (join) a people' and in 48:16 'you will be called to a people': different governing verbs, so the shared words read differently. 15:58 and 51:32 read on into the next ayah.
tree:0c6cdqg1kbu5oo.changes: Removed 4:90 and 48:16: a different governing verb.
tree:0c6cdqg1kbu5oo.relation: The angels telling Ibrahim they were sent to Lot's people, three times.

tree:1872xmk0fdh5q0.why: God sending down the Book to the Prophet, each time with a purpose: to judge, as a guardian over earlier books, as a mercy, to be believed in, to worship sincerely.
tree:1872xmk0fdh5q0.relation: What the Book was sent for.

tree:0x1gmm01vqeetc.why: The Prophet commanded to worship God and forbidden to worship what they call on: 6:56 and 40:66 identical openings, the others the positive command.
tree:0x1gmm01vqeetc.relation: What the Prophet was commanded and forbidden to worship.

tree:1vfbhrz1w7zy3v.why: The Hour is coming, five times with changes in particles and endings a memorizer must hold.

tree:1h1xc7m1vuly9q.why: Satan as a clear enemy: to Adam and his wife, to man (Ya'qub's warning, the Prophet's), disobedient to the Merciful, and an enemy to take as an enemy.
tree:1h1xc7m1vuly9q.relation: The many warnings that Satan is man's sworn enemy.

tree:1r9re960y6q51s.why: A stock opening about the wrongdoers, followed by different predicates in unrelated contexts; nothing to learn from the grouping.

tree:0kiho091qtfbt3.why: If you turn away: 5:92 and 64:12 are identical, and the others give other consequences (you cannot escape God, I ask no wage, you would spread corruption).
tree:0kiho091qtfbt3.relation: What turning away means: the Messenger has only to deliver, and the loss is yours.

tree:1g9li490ug2wxz.why: Statements about Hell: 9:49 and 29:54 end identically (it surrounds the disbelievers), and the others name it as the appointed place, the recompense and the ambush.
tree:1g9li490ug2wxz.relation: Hell waiting for those who deny.

tree:0der3h813t8bxm.why: Two groups: 'your Lord is' followed by a name of God (7:54, 10:3 'God who created', 20:90 'the Most Merciful'), and 'your Lord is Kind, Merciful' (16:7, 16:47). 20:90 has the same structure as 7:54; only the speaker, Harun, differs. 16:7 and 16:47 read on into the next ayah.
tree:0der3h813t8bxm.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 20:90 in the first group instead of removing it.
tree:0der3h813t8bxm.relation: Who your Lord is: God the Creator, the Most Merciful, and Kind and Merciful to you.

tree:0s6pwkv10e7bdf.why: In 36:29 and 36:53 the particle is the negating 'it was nothing but', followed by 'except'. In 2:94 it is conditional ('if it is'), in 2:143 and 4:11 it is conditional or emphatic: a different particle, so the shared words are a different structure.
tree:0s6pwkv10e7bdf.changes: Removed 2:94, 2:143 and 4:11: the particle there is not the negation.
tree:0s6pwkv10e7bdf.relation: The single blast in Ya-Sin, first destroying a town and then raising all.

check.why: In 36:29 and 36:53, in is a negation followed by illa ('it was only a single blast'). In the other rows, in is a conditional or the lightened inna. A different particle function, so removing them is right.

tree:18mo0uu0v282pu.why: A negation pattern followed by unrelated statements; the wording diverges at once.

tree:1paiqjb1y6j7z3.why: Two groups: 'for you there is a lesson in cattle' (16:66, 23:21), and 'for you is what' you ask, choose or judge (2:61, 68:38, 68:39). 2:61 has the same structure as 68:39 ('indeed for you is what you asked'); only the story differs.
tree:1paiqjb1y6j7z3.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 2:61 in the second group instead of removing it.
tree:1paiqjb1y6j7z3.relation: A lesson in cattle, and 'yours is what you ask': granted to Israel, mocked in the rebuke of al-Qalam.

tree:1taty201d2b04e.why: All five use the same form: the negating particle, 'of', a noun, then 'except'. Two groups: nothing whose stores are not with Us or that does not glorify Him (15:21, 17:44), and no group of people without a fate (17:58 town, 35:24 nation, 4:159 People of the Book). 4:159 has the same structure; only the subject differs.
tree:1taty201d2b04e.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 4:159 in the second group instead of removing it.
tree:1taty201d2b04e.relation: There is nothing and no people but: stores with God, praise of Him, a fate, a warner, belief before death.

tree:0wdk1cj1vw0nfr.why: Scattered conditionals with different subjects; the Anfal pair is its own card.

tree:0hhrwsb1uy2l77.why: The verb has two voices here. In 2:90, 5:112 and 6:37 it is active (God or your Lord 'sends down'), and in 2:105 and 30:49 it is passive ('be sent down upon you / them'). Splitting by voice keeps every row. The subject differences (a table, a sign) do not justify removing the rows.
tree:0hhrwsb1uy2l77.changes: Restored 5:112, 6:37 and 30:49. Split by voice: active in one card, passive in the other.
tree:0hhrwsb1uy2l77.relation: That God should send down His favour, a table, or a sign; and what is sent down upon people.

tree:0hmhdae1ya25aw.why: Then we would be: sinners, wrongdoers, losers, astray; said by witnesses, Yusuf's brothers, Yusuf, and Thamud. Endings a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:0hmhdae1ya25aw.relation: People naming what they would become if they did a thing.

tree:1gm8tgv1ilkjcx.why: To our Lord we return (the magicians twice, the traveller's prayer) and to our Lord we turn in hope (9:59, 68:32); close endings a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1gm8tgv1ilkjcx.relation: Return to God faced with certainty, and hope in Him.

tree:1l8zskj1t6p1k3.why: Yusuf's brothers promising to guard and care for him and his brother (12:11, 12:12, 12:63), then God promising to guard the Reminder (15:9) and record good deeds (21:94).
tree:1l8zskj1t6p1k3.relation: Contrast: the brothers' broken promise to guard, and God's promise to guard the Quran.

tree:1scroiq0qvze1w.why: Indeed We: sent down the Reminder and the Quran, inherit the earth, give life and death. Two clear pairs inside.
tree:1scroiq0qvze1w.relation: God's acts of majesty: revelation, life and death, inheritance.

tree:0bk8xiu19im1bm.why: What God caused to grow on the earth, with close endings a memorizer must keep apart (weighed, noble, delightful); 15:19 and 50:7 open identically.
tree:0bk8xiu19im1bm.relation: The earth spread out and every kind of plant made to grow.

tree:12h98s80p25p8c.why: In 21:55, 26:19, 26:153 and 26:185 'you are of' means 'you are one of' (the jesters, the ungrateful, the bewitched). In 79:43 the words mean 'what have you to do with mentioning it': a different sense of the particle in a question. 26:153 and 26:185 read on into the next ayah.
tree:12h98s80p25p8c.changes: Removed 79:43: a different sense of the particle.
tree:12h98s80p25p8c.relation: Accusations against prophets: you are one of the bewitched, the jesters, the ungrateful.

tree:04zm47f1qt892x.why: You cannot escape God: five times, 29:22 and 42:31 close in wording.
tree:04zm47f1qt892x.relation: No escape from God's promise and power.

tree:0tnqule0ejm28g.why: Sinning while you know: setting up rivals, mixing truth with falsehood (2:42 and 3:71 a pair), devouring wealth, betraying trusts.
tree:0tnqule0ejm28g.relation: Wrong done knowingly is the gravest.

tree:10cite70qlu10j.why: Prophets' verdicts on their peoples: Lot's three times with different words, Salih's, and the town's messengers; 7:81 and 36:19 end the same way.
tree:10cite70qlu10j.relation: How prophets named their peoples' sin.

tree:0ovtso01ujhojw.why: Two groups: a statement 'while you are Muslims' (2:132, 3:102 'do not die except as Muslims', and 3:80 'after you are Muslims'), and the question 'so will you be Muslims' (11:14, 21:108). 3:80 has the same nominal clause as 2:132; only the subject differs. All rows read on into the next ayah.
tree:0ovtso01ujhojw.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 3:80 in the first group instead of removing it.
tree:0ovtso01ujhojw.relation: Being Muslims: to die as Muslims, not to be led to disbelief after it, and the call to submit.

tree:0ps4wsf0b6i3qj.why: Idols as mere names given by the idolaters and their fathers (7:71, 12:40, 53:23, nearly identical), and Ibrahim telling his people they and their fathers were astray.
tree:0ps4wsf0b6i3qj.relation: Ancestral idolatry exposed as names without authority.

tree:0dgc2os1ten7xw.why: In 2:91, 3:84, 6:157 and 25:21 the verb is passive, 'what was sent down to us'. In 5:114 it is Jesus's imperative prayer 'send down to us a table': a different form of the verb, so the shared words are a different structure.
tree:0dgc2os1ten7xw.changes: Removed 5:114: imperative, not passive. Split into the contrast pair and the demands pair.
tree:0dgc2os1ten7xw.relation: What was sent down to us: believed in alone, believed in with all prophets, and demanded by the deniers.

tree:06ds7z70h0e0mx.why: All five use 'God favoured' in a relative clause or reported speech with the same verb and sense. 33:37 'the one whom God favoured' has the same structure as 4:69 and 19:58 'those whom God favoured'; only the subject, Zayd, differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:06ds7z70h0e0mx.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 33:37 has the same structure.
tree:06ds7z70h0e0mx.relation: Those God favoured: the prophets and the righteous, the two God-fearing men, Zayd, and the hypocrite's false claim.

tree:1yui02315v4sld.why: 2:9, 3:69, 4:113 and 6:26 say they deceive, mislead or ruin 'none but themselves, and they do not' perceive or harm. In 18:51 'themselves' is the object of 'creation' with no exception, and 'and not' begins God's own statement: a different structure. 2:9, 3:69 and 6:26 read on into the next ayah.
tree:1yui02315v4sld.changes: Removed 18:51: no exception, a different structure.
tree:1yui02315v4sld.relation: The plotters harm none but themselves, and do not perceive it.

tree:1mv965t1dsio77.why: All five say 'he is truly among' a group, with the same emphatic structure. 10:83 (Pharaoh among the transgressors) and 21:59 (the idol breaker among the wrongdoers) have the same words and structure; only the subject differs, which does not justify removing them. 12:51 and 24:6 read on into the next ayah.
tree:1mv965t1dsio77.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 10:83 and 21:59 have the same structure.
tree:1mv965t1dsio77.relation: Verdicts on a person: truthful, liar, transgressor, wrongdoer.

tree:1fitkh7004uiwx.why: How are they turned away: after the truth about the Messiah, after admitting God created all (29:61, 43:87), and in the curse on the hypocrites and those who claim a son (9:30, 63:4).
tree:1fitkh7004uiwx.relation: Wonder at people who turn from the truth they half admit.

tree:0ocopgd0i4fxp1.why: All five use 'the people of the towns' in the same sense: the inhabitants of settlements. In 12:109 and 59:7 the phrase follows 'from', but the words keep their sense. 7:96 to 7:98 are a run, and the other two add the messengers sent from them and the spoils taken from them.
tree:0ocopgd0i4fxp1.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 12:109 and 59:7 use the phrase in the same sense.
tree:0ocopgd0i4fxp1.relation: The people of the towns: had they believed, do they feel safe, messengers from among them, and spoils from them.

tree:13gjcf11l6d9iz.why: Messengers came with clear proofs: they would not believe (7:101, 10:74), God did not wrong them (9:70, 30:9), you kept doubting Yusuf (40:34). Two exact pairs a memorizer must hold.
tree:13gjcf11l6d9iz.relation: Clear proofs rejected, and the rejecters wronging themselves.

tree:1fjmtiq0yd2kv0.why: 7:200, 40:56 and 41:36 share 'seek refuge in God, indeed He'. In 24:6 and 24:8 the governing word is 'testimonies by God': an oath, not seeking refuge, and what follows is the content of the oath. A different governing verb, so the shared words read differently.
tree:1fjmtiq0yd2kv0.changes: Removed 24:6 and 24:8: an oath by God, a different governing word.
tree:1fjmtiq0yd2kv0.relation: Seek refuge in God from Satan's prompting and from the arrogant disputers.

check.why: In 24:6 and 24:8, 'by God, that he' is an oath, not seeking refuge. A different structure, and they are kept in tree:1mv965t1dsio77. Removing them is right.

tree:0z6b5xb15q0yqn.why: Whoever does this with God has then: grasped the firm handhold, been guided, invented a sin, strayed far, been barred from Paradise. 4:48 and 4:116 are the classic pair.
tree:0z6b5xb15q0yqn.relation: Holding fast to God against associating others with Him, and the outcome of each.

tree:1bgkoay0hx74ga.why: 6:28, 39:47, 39:48 and 45:33 use 'appeared to them' for what becomes visible on the Day. In 12:35 the same verb means 'it occurred to them' (a decision to imprison Yusuf): a different sense of the word.
tree:1bgkoay0hx74ga.changes: Removed 12:35: a different sense of the verb.
tree:1bgkoay0hx74ga.relation: What appears to them on the Day: what they hid, what they never reckoned, the evil of their deeds.

tree:0boybfs05ls6uw.why: Clear authority: demanded by the deniers, brought by Moses, demanded of the deniers, and even demanded of the hoopoe. The phrase means a clear proof each time.
tree:0boybfs05ls6uw.relation: Who has a clear proof, and who only demands one.

tree:15w1jmd12hxxa7.why: Only a short stock closing, give good news to the believers, is shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:03yzato1ugh99q.why: God's covenant: fulfil it, do not sell it for a small price (3:77 and 16:95), the believers who fulfil it.
tree:03yzato1ugh99q.relation: Keeping God's covenant against selling it cheap.

tree:18r4m9q0ucuwze.why: All five use 'without right' as the same adverbial phrase in the same sense. 22:40 'driven from their homes without right' has the same words and structure; only the subject differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:18r4m9q0ucuwze.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 22:40 has the same phrase in the same sense.
tree:18r4m9q0ucuwze.relation: Wrongs done without right: killing the prophets, and driving the believers from their homes.

tree:0qnt5yc10c4wts.why: Only a short particle phrase before a negation is shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:1mc5u680q2muqu.why: Rewarded for their patience: the oppressed given the land, the believers on the Day, the servants of the Merciful, the People of the Book twice over, the righteous with Paradise.
tree:1mc5u680q2muqu.relation: Patience as the cause of reward.

tree:0manr8i1me6nj4.why: All five use 'of what is in' after a verb of knowing or informing. 53:36 'informed of what is in the scrolls of Moses' has the same structure as 9:64 'inform them of what is in their hearts'; only the subject differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:0manr8i1me6nj4.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 53:36 has the same structure as 9:64.
tree:0manr8i1me6nj4.relation: What is in the hearts, the selves and the scrolls, and who knows or is told it.

tree:11o10ao0jhnq8i.why: All five use 'for what they earned' in the same causal sense. 4:88 and 6:70 have the same words and the same sense; they differ only in subject, which does not justify removing them.
tree:11o10ao0jhnq8i.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 4:88 and 6:70 have the same phrase in the same sense.
tree:11o10ao0jhnq8i.relation: Held to account for what they earned: hastened punishment, ruin, being sent back, being given up.

tree:06yxvpa0yxcyoo.why: Two groups: a messenger came 'with what your selves do not desire' (2:87, 5:70), and 'with what' a third person 'does not' know or hear (10:18, 13:33, 2:171). 2:171 'at what does not hear' has the same structure as 10:18; only the subject differs.
tree:06yxvpa0yxcyoo.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 2:171 in the second group instead of removing it.
tree:06yxvpa0yxcyoo.relation: What they did not desire, and what does not know or hear.

tree:0nlteb10gcbvsv.why: Only a pronoun and the name of God are shared; five unrelated contexts.

tree:1r0h4uj1vpr399.why: 2:27, 13:21, 13:25 and 5:117 share 'what (God / You) commanded, that': the same verb and structure. In 5:117 Jesus says 'only what You commanded me, that you worship God'. In 6:70 the verb is 'remind with it, lest': a different governing verb.
tree:1r0h4uj1vpr399.changes: Kept 5:117, which the first agent removed: the same verb of commanding. Removed 6:70: a different governing verb.
tree:1r0h4uj1vpr399.relation: What God commanded: to join what must be joined, and to worship Him alone.

tree:0d0la6e1r4q936.why: The deniers' reply, we reject what you were sent with, in several nations, with small differences.
tree:0d0la6e1r4q936.relation: One answer from every nation to its messengers.

tree:15kbcvn1ytqwnn.why: 2:121, 11:17 and 22:31 share 'in it, and whoever' with a conditional 'whoever' followed by a verb of disbelief or association and its consequence. In 6:19 and 13:10 'whoever' is a relative joined to what comes before (and whoever it reaches; and whoever is open): a different structure.
tree:15kbcvn1ytqwnn.changes: Kept 22:31, which the first agent removed: the same conditional structure. Removed 6:19 and 13:10: the particle is a relative there.
tree:15kbcvn1ytqwnn.relation: Believing in it or associating with Him, and the end of whoever does otherwise.

tree:0kl66vh0ejwjcz.why: Except those who repented after that: five places with small changes (after, before, after it) a memorizer must catch.
tree:0kl66vh0ejwjcz.relation: The door of repentance kept open.

tree:1rg725r1lozmaz.why: All five use 'you believe in God' with the same verb, object and sense: as a condition (4:59, 24:2), as a description (3:110), as the content of a bargain (61:11), and negated in a question (57:8). The shared words keep their sense and shape, so the rows stay, though the frames differ.
tree:1rg725r1lozmaz.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the shared words are the same verb and object in the same sense.
tree:1rg725r1lozmaz.relation: Believing in God: a condition for rulings, a mark of the best community, a bargain, and a rebuke.

tree:0d5bxwu0o6ny58.why: When we are dust and bones: the deniers' question five times, with endings a memorizer must hold (brought out, raised, judged).
tree:0d5bxwu0o6ny58.relation: The denial of resurrection and judgement.

tree:0bb07lo1mgsl70.why: Five surah openings with the revelation of the Book, three identical and two that differ (32:2 and 40:2).
tree:0bb07lo1mgsl70.relation: The Book from God the Mighty, the Wise.

tree:1epxevq0djn6jw.why: All five use the imperative 'turn away from them'. 27:28 is the same imperative with the same object; only the story (Solomon and the hoopoe) differs, which does not justify removing it. 37:174 and 37:178 read on into the next ayah.
tree:1epxevq0djn6jw.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 27:28 has the same imperative.
tree:1epxevq0djn6jw.relation: Turn away from them: the Prophet from the deniers, and the hoopoe from the queen's court.

tree:0jgqoe00mxw1v8.why: Then to Him you return: after life and death, after the dead are raised, after sleep, after creation is repeated, after intercession belongs to Him. The endings differ slightly (you return, they return, your return).
tree:0jgqoe00mxw1v8.relation: Every account of life, death and creation ends in the return to God.

check.why: Keep is right: 'then to Him you return' with small changes in the ending (you return, they return, your return).

tree:0o4bwm401kngyy.why: A messenger came to them, and was rejected: by the People of the Book, the Children of Israel, a town, Quraysh, and Pharaoh's people. 44:13 and 44:17 differ in one word.
tree:0o4bwm401kngyy.relation: The messenger came; the people turned away.

tree:018s8e11mphq1x.why: What the idolaters ascribed to God: partners from the jinn, a share of crops and cattle, partners who create, partners without names, rivals. Two close pairs inside (13:16 and 13:33).
tree:018s8e11mphq1x.relation: The forms of associating others with God.

tree:0mwuwqe1oef9bg.why: No blame on you if: seeking trade in Hajj, shortening prayer, entering empty houses, older women laying aside outer garments, eating together.
tree:0mwuwqe1oef9bg.relation: Dispensations that show the ease in the law.

tree:0tossab11f7mu7.why: Those who strove in God's way, five times with small differences (in His way, in God, with wealth and selves) and different rewards.
tree:0tossab11f7mu7.relation: Striving for God and its rewards.

tree:0eobmo20oamu8o.why: In 2:173, 6:119 and 16:115 the verb is active, 'He has forbidden to you', listing the foods and the exception of necessity. In 3:50 and 5:96 it is passive, 'what was forbidden to you': a different voice, so the shared words are a different structure.
tree:0eobmo20oamu8o.changes: Removed 3:50 and 5:96: the verb is passive there.
tree:0eobmo20oamu8o.relation: The forbidden foods and the exception of necessity.

tree:1srerx20jal3a4.why: Only a closing pair of divine names is shared, after unrelated subjects.

tree:1os80uk0o9qr48.why: The religion of Ibrahim, upright and not an idolater, four times in the same words and once in his own voice (6:79).
tree:1os80uk0o9qr48.relation: Ibrahim's pure monotheism as the model to follow.

tree:15tjbhw1dok6gg.why: God the best of providers: in Jesus' prayer, for those who die in His way, in the Prophet's asking no wage, in spending, and against trade and amusement. The lead-ins differ.
tree:15tjbhw1dok6gg.relation: Provision from God is better than anything people chase.

tree:1v6qq490qbmzkp.why: All five say 'better for those who' with a relative clause. 30:38 'that is better for those who seek the face of God' has the same words and structure; only the subject (giving to kin) differs, which does not justify removing it. 6:32 and 7:169 read on into the next ayah.
tree:1v6qq490qbmzkp.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 30:38 has the same structure.
tree:1v6qq490qbmzkp.relation: What is better for those who fear God or seek His face: the Hereafter, its reward, and giving to kin.

tree:0i6js1e0aju2co.why: Better and more lasting: God for the magicians, God's provision, what is with God (28:60, 42:36 a pair), the Hereafter.
tree:0i6js1e0aju2co.relation: What lasts against the passing goods of this world.

tree:1rk3w4i0xws6jg.why: All five use 'that is better' as the same nominal clause closing a command. 7:26, 30:38 and 58:12 have the same words and structure, with different continuations (the garment of piety, for those who seek God, purer for you); a subject difference does not justify removing them. 4:59 and 17:35 read on into the next ayah.
tree:1rk3w4i0xws6jg.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same clause.
tree:1rk3w4i0xws6jg.relation: After a command, 'that is better': obedience, fair measure, the garment of piety, giving to kin, charity before a private talk.

tree:0xpzcpi1ej7bfg.why: 17:58, 33:6 and 22:70 share 'that is in the Book' as a predicate ('that was written in the Book', 'that is in a Book'). In 5:32 the word is the object of 'after', and the phrase that follows is 'in the land' tied to another verb; in 48:12 it is 'made fair in your hearts': different structures. 17:58 and 33:6 read on into the next ayah.
tree:0xpzcpi1ej7bfg.changes: Kept 22:70, which the first agent removed: the same predicate 'in a Book'. Removed 5:32 and 48:12.
tree:0xpzcpi1ej7bfg.relation: What is recorded in the Book: the fate of every town, the order of kinship, and all that is in heaven and earth.

tree:13j2ov70erovbh.why: Names of the Last Day: gathering and witness, the threat, eternity, coming out, mutual loss; three in Qaf a memorizer must order.
tree:13j2ov70erovbh.relation: The Day named by what happens in it.

tree:1p2pu4916yzmrf.why: When they saw the punishment: followers and leaders disown each other, they hide regret (10:54 and 34:33), partners do not answer, they ask for a way back.
tree:1p2pu4916yzmrf.relation: The moment the punishment is seen, and what it reveals.

tree:09cpdyg05rn596.why: The particle after your Lord is a different word in each (no god but He, it will not benefit, they do not, no one changes).

tree:0arn3in11a8w0n.why: Prayers that begin our Lord, do not: do not take us to task, do not let our hearts swerve, do not place us with the wrongdoers, do not make us a trial (10:85 and 60:5).
tree:0arn3in11a8w0n.relation: What the believers ask God to spare them.

tree:13dcbji1bj05yy.why: In 12:98, 19:47, 29:26 and 34:50 'my Lord' closes a clause and 'He is' then describes the Lord (Forgiving, Gracious, Mighty, Hearing). In 10:53 'my Lord' is an oath ('yes, by my Lord') and 'it is' refers to the matter being true: a different structure. 29:26 and 34:50 have the same structure as 12:98; only the subject differs.
tree:13dcbji1bj05yy.changes: Kept 29:26 and 34:50, which the first agent removed: the same structure. Removed 10:53: an oath, a different structure.
tree:13dcbji1bj05yy.relation: A prophet names his Lord and then His attributes: forgiving, gracious, mighty, near.

tree:0wkldyx0m4hh17.why: God is pleased with them and they with Him: four times with the same clause and different endings, and 48:18 the pledge under the tree.
tree:0wkldyx0m4hh17.relation: Mutual pleasure between God and His servants.

tree:0eldibw0fmwo42.why: The evil of what they did came back on them: 16:34, 39:48 and 45:33 almost identical, 39:51 and 40:45 close.
tree:0eldibw0fmwo42.relation: Evil deeds and plots recoil on their doers.

tree:0pwed781sk17n4.why: Two structures with the same words: the exception 'except what your Lord wills' (11:107, 11:108), and the conditional 'had your Lord willed' (6:112, 10:99, 11:118). The split keeps every row, and the Fire and Garden pair stays together.
tree:0pwed781sk17n4.changes: Split by structure into the exception pair and the conditional set, as the first agent did.
tree:0pwed781sk17n4.relation: The Lord's will: an exception to eternity in the Fire and the Garden, and had He willed, all would believe.

tree:17hgoxt0sjteal.why: Only a word and a particle across a break are shared; the real pairs are their own cards.

tree:0omb3ti1wlhrq0.why: A single blast: three times in Ya-Sin and twice for past nations, with different results.
tree:0omb3ti1wlhrq0.relation: One cry ends a nation or raises all.

tree:1bgjddg16srksc.why: No power to harm or benefit: idols, the calf, the Prophet himself; the order of the words and the last word differ.
tree:1bgjddg16srksc.relation: Only God controls harm and benefit.

tree:0hpo6wb1mkuinf.why: All five use 'a party of' a group in the same sense. 24:2 (of the believers), 61:14 (of the Children of Israel) and 73:20 (of those with you) have the same words and structure; only the subject differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:0hpo6wb1mkuinf.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same phrase in the same sense.
tree:0hpo6wb1mkuinf.relation: A party of: the People of the Book scheming, the believers witnessing, Israel divided, the companions praying at night.

tree:1og6ey01llodzq.why: The verb of thinking means different things here (certainty of doom, despair, false confidence) about unrelated people; no shared point.

tree:09on7rw0iwj7jo.why: The list of past nations, Noah, Ad and Thamud, five times with different lead-ins and continuations a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:09on7rw0iwj7jo.relation: The fate of past nations as a warning to the deniers.

tree:0vmfn520m1925u.why: Taste the punishment of burning, five times with different lead-ins; three of them read on into the same next clause, that is for what your hands sent forth.
tree:0vmfn520m1925u.relation: The burning punishment and its cause: what one's own hands sent ahead.

tree:0t4r0ne0td3tyq.why: All five use 'the punishment of God' in the same sense. 14:21 (avail us against the punishment of God) and 22:2 (the punishment of God is severe) have the same words; they differ only in what is said about it, which does not justify removing them.
tree:0t4r0ne0td3tyq.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 14:21 and 22:2 use the phrase in the same sense.
tree:0t4r0ne0td3tyq.relation: God's punishment: coming suddenly, not to be warded off, and severe.

tree:15vyz0j1katbvn.why: A lasting punishment: 11:39 and 39:40 identical in Noah's words and the Prophet's, and three other places with other lead-ins.

tree:1kustv808y9guy.why: Only a stock closing pair of divine names is shared, after unrelated subjects.

tree:1p8vugq15e2t94.why: The people of Paradise reclining on couches, five places with different details; 83:23 and 83:35 identical.
tree:1p8vugq15e2t94.relation: Rest in Paradise, and the believers watching.

tree:1bjyp3512df2br.why: Illness or travel as an excuse: for fasting (2:184, 2:185) and for ablution (4:43, 5:6), plus the pledge when travelling.
tree:1bjyp3512df2br.relation: The ease God gives the sick and the traveller.

tree:0abe81q07juq8a.why: All five use 'upon knowledge' in the same sense, 'on the basis of knowledge'. 28:78 and 39:49 are man's claim to his own knowledge; 7:52, 44:32 and 45:23 are God acting with knowledge. The difference is whose knowledge, a subject difference that bears on the verdict, not a different word or structure.
tree:0abe81q07juq8a.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the phrase keeps its sense and structure.
tree:0abe81q07juq8a.relation: Acting on knowledge: God detailing the Book, choosing Israel and leaving one astray knowingly, against man's claim to his own.

tree:030rtnp1foqrtp.why: Only a preposition and the word people are shared; five unrelated contexts.

tree:0i0bve508rd36x.why: In Him I trust, said by the Prophet, Shu'ayb and Ya'qub, each followed by a different clause a memorizer must hold.

tree:0ws8fdv146ieaf.why: Satan or their own scheming made deeds look good and turned them from the way: Sheba's people, Ad and Thamud (27:24 and 29:38 a pair), Pharaoh, the idolaters.
tree:0ws8fdv146ieaf.relation: Deeds made attractive, and the way blocked.

tree:1luvc861jq9xp4.why: All five have a verb acting 'from them' on 'the punishment': lightened (2:86, 2:162, 3:88), delayed (11:8), removed (43:50). The shared words read the same, 'from them the punishment', and the different verbs are exactly what a memorizer must keep apart. 2:162 and 3:88 read on into the next ayah.
tree:1luvc861jq9xp4.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 11:8 and 43:50 have the same structure with a different verb.
tree:1luvc861jq9xp4.relation: The punishment and them: never lightened in the Hereafter, delayed or lifted in this world.

tree:0suisp51e15ahp.why: God removes their misdeeds, five times with different conditions and rewards.
tree:0suisp51e15ahp.relation: Faith and good deeds wipe out sins.

tree:1q1ao6k0efot88.why: Two groups: speech 'other than what' was said (2:59, 7:162 they changed a word, 4:81 they plot other than what you say), and deeds 'other than what we used to do' (7:53, 35:37). 4:81 has the same structure as 2:59; only the subject differs.
tree:1q1ao6k0efot88.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 4:81 in the first group instead of removing it.
tree:1q1ao6k0efot88.relation: Other than what was said, and other than what we did.

tree:08zdrb81tly5jg.why: The as-Saffat refrains are the real family and are kept in another card; 26:84 only ends the same way.

tree:08xilhc0vubshc.why: All five use 'in the lands' in the same sense. The split separates the warning not to be deceived by the disbelievers' movement (3:196, 40:4) from the past nations that roamed and tyrannized (50:36, 89:8, 89:11), and keeps every row with its run-on.
tree:08xilhc0vubshc.changes: Split into the warning pair and the past-nations set, as the first agent did.
tree:08xilhc0vubshc.relation: Movement in the lands: present disbelievers who should not deceive, and past nations destroyed.

check.why: The split is right: the warning not to be deceived by their movement in the lands, and the past nations in the lands. Every row is kept.

tree:09s5tii17e87h8.why: Two groups: 'do not address Me concerning those who did wrong' (11:37, 23:27), and something 'among those who' (33:38, 33:62 God's way among those who passed, 24:19 indecency spreading among those who believe). 24:19 has the same words and structure as 33:62; only the subject differs. 11:37 and 23:27 read on into the next ayah.
tree:09s5tii17e87h8.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 24:19 in the second group instead of removing it.
tree:09s5tii17e87h8.relation: Concerning those who did wrong, and among those who passed or believe.

tree:0y427a10x9wqnz.why: God admits whom He wills into His mercy: 42:8 and 76:31 a pair that diverge, with three other places.
tree:0y427a10x9wqnz.relation: Admission into God's mercy, set against the wrongdoers.

tree:1cxaci21lqyg6y.why: 7:43 and 15:47 are the real pair and are kept elsewhere; the others only mention what is in the chests.

tree:1k31wod1mzqy5v.why: All five use 'in darknesses' in the same sense. 2:17 (left in darknesses), 6:59 (a grain in the darknesses of the earth) and 39:6 (in three darknesses of the womb) have the same words and structure; only the image differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:1k31wod1mzqy5v.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same phrase in the same sense.
tree:1k31wod1mzqy5v.relation: In darknesses: of land and sea, of the earth, of the womb, and of those whose light is taken.

tree:14j76u30eyxrmz.why: Doubt: be not in doubt about it, said to the Prophet three times, and the deniers in doubt about it or the meeting with their Lord.

tree:1le1ykf16iq2cb.why: All five use 'in a day' followed by a description of the day. 14:18 (a stormy day), 54:19 (a day of ill omen) and 90:14 (a day of hunger) have the same words and structure; only the day described differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:1le1ykf16iq2cb.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same structure.
tree:1le1ykf16iq2cb.relation: Days described: of a thousand and fifty thousand years, of storm, of ill omen, of hunger.

tree:14buil70jik5b3.why: Firm mountains placed on the earth, five times with different companions (rivers, plants, blessing, water); 15:19 and 50:7 open alike.
tree:14buil70jik5b3.relation: The mountains as a sign of God's care for the earth.

tree:0gc9re90phwls3.why: The real pair (2:162, 3:88) is already in the card on the punishment not lightened; the others share only two words.

tree:0rleefo0kuvxei.why: All five open 'said the one who' with a relative clause naming the speaker. 12:21, 12:45 and 27:40 have the same words and structure; only the speaker and story differ, which does not justify removing them.
tree:0rleefo0kuvxei.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same structure.
tree:0rleefo0kuvxei.relation: Speakers named by what they did or had: the buyer, the freed prisoner, the one with knowledge of the Book, the believer.

tree:1aesk9o186kck2.why: The four did I not tell you ayat are already a card on their own; 26:18 is Pharaoh's different question and adds nothing.

tree:0rk7i8c0iznggu.why: Only a speech opener is shared; the Talut pair is its own card and the rest are unrelated.

tree:1rp5h1b1qzyh8l.why: Claims made with I: Iblis claiming to be better (7:12, 38:76 identical), the king claiming to give life, Pharaoh claiming lordship, set against Yusuf's I am Yusuf, followed by praise of God's favour.
tree:1rp5h1b1qzyh8l.relation: Contrast: the arrogant I of Iblis, the king and Pharaoh, and the grateful I of Yusuf.

tree:1m89uvc0l4zvlw.why: All five open 'he said: indeed it/he' followed by a predicate. 12:28 ('it is of your plotting') and 27:44 ('it is a palace paved') have the same words and structure; only the speaker and story differ, which does not justify removing them.
tree:1m89uvc0l4zvlw.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 12:28 and 27:44 have the same structure.
tree:1m89uvc0l4zvlw.relation: 'He said: it is': Moses on the cow three times, the husband on the torn shirt, Solomon on the palace.

tree:0uljv341t9mdiw.why: All five open 'he said: indeed has' followed by a perfect verb. 4:72, 7:71 and 43:63 have the same words and structure; only the speaker and what has happened differ, which does not justify removing them.
tree:0uljv341t9mdiw.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same structure.
tree:0uljv341t9mdiw.relation: 'He said: indeed has': a prayer answered, a request granted, a favour claimed, punishment fallen, wisdom brought.

tree:1isiy1i0li9tb4.why: All five open 'He said: thus' as an answer. 20:126 ('thus did Our signs come to you and you forgot them') has the same word and structure; only the subject differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:1isiy1i0li9tb4.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 20:126 has the same structure.
tree:1isiy1i0li9tb4.relation: 'Thus' as God's answer: to Zakariyya and Maryam on a wondrous birth, and to the one raised blind.

tree:1f5j6ew14tveus.why: Only a speech opener with a question is shared; five unrelated questions.

tree:02xv2n404hx87g.why: They said God (or the Merciful) has taken a son: five times with the name and the reply changing.
tree:02xv2n404hx87g.relation: The claim of a son, answered each time from a different side.

tree:0b8wxhy1veeg5m.why: False claims introduced by only: we are only reformers, trade is only like usury, you are only a forger, you are only bewitched (26:153 and 26:185 identical).
tree:0b8wxhy1veeg5m.relation: Self-justifying claims of the corrupt and the deniers.

tree:0mb13j8152ew08.why: 2:93, 2:285, 4:46 and 8:21 use 'they said: we hear' as a response to a command (and obey, and disobey, without hearing). In 21:60 'we heard a youth' takes an object: hearing of someone, a different sense of the verb.
tree:0mb13j8152ew08.changes: Removed 21:60: a different sense of the verb.
tree:0mb13j8152ew08.relation: We hear and obey, against we hear and disobey, and those who say we hear but do not.

check.why: In 21:60, 'we heard of a youth' is a different sense (heard about), not the reply 'we hear'. Removing it is right.

tree:1os9vd70vx8mgh.why: Only a speech opener with if is shared; the if-God-willed pair is its own card.

tree:0hd4a1a0a7xbkg.why: Yusuf's brothers addressing their father five times, from the first plot to the final confession; useful to follow the story.
tree:0hd4a1a0a7xbkg.relation: The brothers' words to Ya'qub, from deceit to repentance.

tree:17pjpbo0zuj25q.why: All five use the passive 'the matter was decided' in the same sense. 11:44 (the flood ended) and 12:41 (the dream's interpretation decreed) have the same words and structure; only the event differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:17pjpbo0zuj25q.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 11:44 and 12:41 have the same words in the same sense.
tree:17pjpbo0zuj25q.relation: The matter decided: on the Day, at the end of the flood, and in the dream's interpretation.

tree:04tkqye0j92b9q.why: All five use the command 'say to those who' with a relative clause. 3:20, 11:121 and 45:14 have the same words and structure; only the group addressed differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:04tkqye0j92b9q.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same structure.
tree:04tkqye0j92b9q.relation: Say to those who: disbelieve, were given the Book, do not believe, believe.

tree:09vbso70c27x2j.why: All five use 'the hearts of those who' in the same sense. 57:27 ('We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion') has the same structure as 3:151 ('We will cast into the hearts of those who disbelieved terror'); 30:59 and 39:45 also keep the phrase's shape. Subject differences do not justify removing them.
tree:09vbso70c27x2j.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same phrase and structure.
tree:09vbso70c27x2j.relation: What is put in or done to the hearts of those who: terror, a seal, aversion, compassion.

tree:0qbygrb0abtdgn.why: Hearts sealed so they do not hear, understand or know, and hearts in doubt; the endings a memorizer must hold.
tree:0qbygrb0abtdgn.relation: The sealing of hearts as the result of turning away.

tree:00uqbhl0uaq3nr.why: They were a defiantly disobedient people: Pharaoh's people (27:12, 28:32, 43:54), Noah's people, and the hypocrites.
tree:00uqbhl0uaq3nr.relation: The verdict on the nations that rejected their prophets.

tree:0ollzg61jtb0am.why: Two structures with the same words: 'your Lord would not' followed by a verb of destroying towns (11:117, 28:59), and 'your Lord is' followed by an adjective (19:64, 25:20, 25:54). The split keeps every row.
tree:0ollzg61jtb0am.changes: Split by structure into the two sets, as the first agent did.
tree:0ollzg61jtb0am.relation: Your Lord never destroys towns unjustly, and is never forgetful, all-seeing, all-able.

check.why: The split is right: your Lord would not destroy towns (11:117, 28:59), and your Lord is never forgetful, seeing, able. Every row is kept.

tree:1jpebd11ru4877.why: Only a verb of having is shared, followed by unrelated nouns.

tree:0p8r5820loqunm.why: Only a verb of having is shared; the real slip is its own card.

tree:1etqhut1r1bkf5.why: Whoever wants: the reward of this world, its life, the immediate, honour, the harvest of the Hereafter; each answered differently.
tree:1etqhut1r1bkf5.relation: What people want, and what God gives them for it.

tree:17kkxgg174q1w2.why: All five say a woman 'was among' a group, with the same words and structure. The old rows repeated 29:33 as a run-on of 29:32 and as its own row; each ayah should appear once. 7:83 reads on into the next ayah.
tree:17kkxgg174q1w2.changes: Gave 29:32 and 29:33 one row each, as the first agent did.
tree:17kkxgg174q1w2.relation: Women described by what they were among: Lot's wife left behind, the Queen of Sheba, Maryam the devout.

tree:0m0vifv08f6iv9.why: They turned from the signs or were heedless of them: 6:4 and 36:46 identical, 7:136 and 7:146 end alike.
tree:0m0vifv08f6iv9.relation: Turning from the signs as the root of ruin.

tree:1yo8mkx04s805j.why: Two groups: 'because they used to disbelieve in the signs of God and kill the prophets' (2:61, 3:112), and a punishment 'for what they used to disbelieve' (6:70, 10:4, 10:70). 10:70 has the same structure as 6:70 (the punishment, then 'for what they used to disbelieve'). 6:70, 10:4 and 10:70 read on into the next ayah.
tree:1yo8mkx04s805j.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 10:70 in the second group instead of removing it.
tree:1yo8mkx04s805j.relation: Their disbelief as the cause: of humiliation and killing the prophets, and of the boiling drink and severe punishment.

tree:1ylxw7j01dv0tr.why: What God has written: what He allowed you, the land He assigned, what befalls us, His victory, and the exile of the Nadir. One verb of decree across several outcomes.
tree:1ylxw7j01dv0tr.relation: God's decree, for the believers and against their enemies.

tree:14qs0a10g2gqez.why: Prescribed for you: retaliation, the bequest, fasting, fighting, all in al-Baqara, and 2:246 the earlier nation's test when fighting was prescribed.
tree:14qs0a10g2gqez.relation: The duties prescribed in al-Baqara, and how an earlier people failed one.

tree:096ru490jk22kf.why: Only the word many is shared; five unrelated contexts.

tree:04r5hhk0donbde.why: All five say 'many of them' with the same words and structure. The old rows repeated 57:27 as a run-on of 57:26 and as its own row; each ayah should appear once. 57:16 reads on into the next ayah.
tree:04r5hhk0donbde.changes: Gave 57:26 and 57:27 one row each, as the first agent did.
tree:04r5hhk0donbde.relation: Many of them: doing evil, blind and deaf, and defiantly disobedient three times in al-Hadid.

tree:1r5m6cr03of2cn.why: The same two words in two structures: 'thus said those who' followed by 'the like of their words' (2:113, 2:118), and the answer 'thus, said your Lord' (19:9, 19:21, 51:30), where 'thus' ends one clause and 'your Lord said' begins another. The split keeps every row.
tree:1r5m6cr03of2cn.changes: Split by structure into the two sets, as the first agent did.
tree:1r5m6cr03of2cn.relation: Thus said those without knowledge, and thus your Lord has said.

tree:1esski00vmrq28.why: The same two words with two senses of the particle: 'all were among' the righteous, the patient, the best (6:85, 21:85, 38:48), and 'all is from' our Lord or God (3:7, 4:78). The split keeps every row.
tree:1esski00vmrq28.changes: Split by the sense of the particle into the two sets, as the first agent did.
tree:1esski00vmrq28.relation: Prophets all among the righteous; and all is from God.

tree:1pkwskt13ntay1.why: Your Lord's word was fulfilled in truth and good, and became due on the disobedient and the disbelievers; close wording a memorizer must hold.
tree:1pkwskt13ntay1.relation: Contrast: the word fulfilled as a promise, and as a sentence.

tree:0aw50nn1ltudhz.why: You were a people: disobedient, transgressing, wasteful, criminal, ruined. Five verdicts in the same frame.
tree:0aw50nn1ltudhz.relation: How the Quran names the guilt of those it addresses.

tree:1p0557s1qyvioy.why: Do not consume: wealth unjustly (2:188, 4:29 a pair), usury, orphans' wealth, meat not slaughtered in God's name.
