tree:036rblt1ya3dmb.why: Two groups: what God sent down on His Messenger (9:26, 48:26 tranquillity; 4:136 the Book; 9:97 the limits of what God sent down), and what God gave as spoils to His Messenger (59:6, 59:7). 4:136 and 9:97 have the same verb of sending down and the same phrase; only the subject differs.
tree:036rblt1ya3dmb.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, but kept 4:136 and 9:97 in the first group instead of removing them.
tree:036rblt1ya3dmb.relation: What God sent down on His Messenger, and what He gave him as spoils.

tree:1q0lit602e955w.why: 'Upon himself' joins unrelated ayat; the real pair (He has written mercy upon Himself, 6:12 and 6:54) has its own card.

tree:09z8zab0m2ukir.why: Exalted is God above what they describe: closing refutations of partners and children for God, with different lead-ins (glory be to Him and exalted, Lord of the Throne, Lord of might). A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:09z8zab0m2ukir.relation: God declared far above every son and partner ascribed to Him.

tree:0pj4iuw1mre6ro.why: 12:23, 12:30, 12:32 and 12:51 use 'sought to seduce (him) from himself'. In 9:120 'prefer themselves over him' and in 47:38 'is stingy against himself' the governing verbs differ and the particle has a different sense: a different structure.
tree:0pj4iuw1mre6ro.changes: Removed 9:120 and 47:38: a different governing verb and sense.
tree:0pj4iuw1mre6ro.relation: Seeking to seduce Yusuf: the attempt, the gossip, the admission, the confession.

tree:1cg952c016oux0.why: All six use 'other than God' in the same sense. 4:82 ('had it been from other than God') has the same words and structure; only the frame differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:1cg952c016oux0.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 4:82 has the same phrase.
tree:1cg952c016oux0.relation: Other than God: no god, no creator, and no source for the Quran.

tree:1x213jw08oqhfo.why: God is full of bounty to people / to the worlds / to the believers: the endings and what follows differ. A memorizer set (partly shared with tree:1d0det50y28jd7) whose point is the three different endings.
tree:1x213jw08oqhfo.relation: God's bounty to all people, to the worlds through repelling evil, and to the believers by forgiveness.

check.why: Keep is right: 'God is full of bounty to people' with different endings is a memorizer set. It partly overlaps tree:1d0det50y28jd7, so merge should de-duplicate.

tree:1q94oat1qpejpb.why: All six use 'in their ears' in the same sense. The split separates the heaviness or deafness in their ears (6:25, 17:46, 18:57, 41:44) from the fingers put in their ears (2:19, 71:7), and keeps every row.
tree:1q94oat1qpejpb.changes: Split into the heaviness set and the fingers pair, as the first agent did.
tree:1q94oat1qpejpb.relation: Their ears: heavy and deaf to the message, and stopped with fingers against thunder and the call.

tree:14snuuc0nm5ayw.why: Those who strive against Our signs to defeat them: 22:51, 34:5, 34:38 with different endings, plus those who plunge into, distort and dispute Our signs. A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:14snuuc0nm5ayw.relation: Every way of fighting God's signs, and its end.

tree:0aic3qm1lbiaz4.why: Two groups: those carried and saved 'in the ship' (7:64, 10:73, 26:119, and 36:41 'We carried their offspring in the laden ship'), and people in a ship who pray sincerely (10:22, 29:65). 36:41 has the same structure as 26:119, even the same 'laden ship'; only the subject differs. 26:119 and 36:41 read on.
tree:0aic3qm1lbiaz4.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 36:41 in the first group instead of removing it.
tree:0aic3qm1lbiaz4.relation: Saved and carried in the ship; and calling on God sincerely while in it.

tree:0trgpn80vtk9j0.why: 'In the city' places unrelated scenes (Pharaoh's accusation, the women, Khidr's wall, nine men, Musa, the hypocrites). Nothing shared in meaning.

tree:1s68pto0oecpq0.why: 3:27, 22:61, 31:29, 35:13 and 57:6 say 'He merges the night into the day', the particle meaning 'into'. In 73:7 'in the day you have long occupation' uses it for time, 'during the day': a different sense of the particle.
tree:1s68pto0oecpq0.changes: Removed 73:7: a different sense of the particle.
tree:1s68pto0oecpq0.relation: He merges the night into the day and the day into the night.

tree:10bws0k0jh0y0w.why: The same five 'merges the night into the day' ayat are kept in tree:1s68pto0oecpq0; 6:13 (what rests in the night and day) adds nothing.

tree:1jpu1jn1bm0vof.why: All six use a verb of throwing, casting or drowning followed by 'into the sea'. 20:97 ('We will scatter it into the sea') has the same structure; only what is cast differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:1jpu1jn1bm0vof.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 20:97 has the same structure.
tree:1jpu1jn1bm0vof.relation: Into the sea: Musa as a baby, Pharaoh and his army, and the calf's ashes.

tree:1dqw51a0m2y7q0.why: Three groups, all with a verb of putting 'into the hearts of': terror into the hearts of the disbelievers (3:151, 8:12), 'thus We insert it into the hearts of the criminals' (15:12, 26:200), and calm or mercy into the hearts of the believers and followers (48:4, 57:27). 48:4 and 57:27 have the same structure and form their own pair. 15:12 and 26:200 read on.
tree:1dqw51a0m2y7q0.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, and kept 48:4 and 57:27 as a third pair instead of removing them.
tree:1dqw51a0m2y7q0.relation: What God puts into hearts: terror, denial, tranquillity, mercy.

tree:1dr5v2n1fmtvvn.why: All six use 'in your hearts' in the same sense. Two groups: what was put in or entered your hearts (48:12, 49:7, 49:14), and God knowing or testing what is in your hearts (3:154, 8:70, 33:51). The words keep their sense, so the second group is a card rather than removed.
tree:1dr5v2n1fmtvvn.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 3:154, 8:70 and 33:51 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:1dr5v2n1fmtvvn.relation: Your hearts: what was beautified or has not entered them, and what God knows in them.

tree:1av984g0gokhdk.why: 20:74, 87:13, 20:118, 20:119 and 23:108 share a verb, 'in it', then 'and not' with a second verb: 'he neither dies in it nor lives', 'you will neither hunger in it nor be naked', 'be silent in it and do not speak'. In 52:23 the particle denies a whole category ('no idle talk in it, nor sin'): a different structure. 20:74 and 87:13 read on.
tree:1av984g0gokhdk.changes: Kept 20:118, 20:119 and 23:108, which the first agent removed: the same structure. Removed 52:23.
tree:1av984g0gokhdk.relation: In it, and not: no death or life in Hell, no hunger or nakedness in the Garden, no speech for the damned.

tree:1vzy7gl08caomd.why: All six open 'he said: rather', a reply that corrects what came before. 2:259, 20:66, 21:56 and 21:63 have the same words and structure; only the speaker and story differ, which does not justify removing them.
tree:1vzy7gl08caomd.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other four have the same structure.
tree:1vzy7gl08caomd.relation: 'He said: rather': Yaqub twice, Musa to the magicians, Ibrahim twice, and the man raised after a hundred years.

tree:02b61cs0fux4jo.why: The same two words in two structures: 'when your Lord said to the angels' (2:30, 15:28, 38:71), and the answer 'thus, said your Lord' (19:9, 19:21, 51:30), where 'thus' ends one clause. The split keeps every row.
tree:02b61cs0fux4jo.changes: Split into the two families, as the first agent did.
tree:02b61cs0fux4jo.relation: Your Lord's words to the angels about Adam, and to those promised a child.

tree:1ej033a1tnnvmw.why: 7:12, 12:51 and 28:23 use 'he said: what' as a question ('what prevented you', 'what is your matter'). In 7:20 and 18:35 the particle is negation ('your Lord did not forbid', 'I do not think'), and in 18:95 it is relative ('what my Lord established me in'): a different particle.
tree:1ej033a1tnnvmw.changes: Kept 7:12, which the first agent removed: the same interrogative. Removed 7:20, 18:35 and 18:95: the particle is negation or relative.
tree:1ej033a1tnnvmw.relation: 'He said: what' as a question: to Iblis, to the women about Yusuf, to the two women at Madyan.

tree:0morugm1g2org6.why: 'They said, if / only' opens unrelated sayings (denial of resurrection, Yusuf's brothers, magicians). A particle frame, nothing to learn together.

tree:1qgv8ww00b8ijq.why: They said, O Musa: the magicians' challenge (7:115 and 20:65, nearly identical), Bani Israil refusing to enter (5:22, 5:24), asking for an idol (7:138), and Pharaoh's people begging him to pray (7:134). A memorizer set and a picture of the people Musa faced.
tree:1qgv8ww00b8ijq.relation: What Musa's people and enemies asked of him, revealing their faith or its lack.

tree:0z2kc5d1k8s7dd.why: All six say 'We sent before you' followed by 'of' messengers or warners. 34:44 ('We did not send to them before you any warner') has the same structure as 25:20; only the subject differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:0z2kc5d1k8s7dd.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 34:44 has the same structure.
tree:0z2kc5d1k8s7dd.relation: Before you We sent messengers, and to these people no warner before you.

tree:0kwl9p612w7olq.why: Has strayed: from the right way (2:108, 5:12, 60:1), far astray (4:116, 4:136), clearly astray (33:36). The ending depends on the sin, a memorizer set.
tree:0kwl9p612w7olq.relation: Disbelief, shirk and disobedience each named as straying.

tree:0uh3lv81424dem.why: All six open 'Say: O you' with the vocative. 62:6 (O you who are Jews) and 109:1 (O disbelievers) have the same words and structure; only who is addressed differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:0uh3lv81424dem.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 62:6 and 109:1 have the same structure.
tree:0uh3lv81424dem.relation: Say: O people, O Jews, O disbelievers.

tree:1d5xp781f89g7q.why: Only the closing divine names (All-Knowing with Wise, Aware or Powerful) are shared; the rulings and themes before them are unrelated.

tree:00e6zpl1g1cerz.why: They used to [deal with] Our signs: wronging them, rejecting them, not being certain of them, and in 32:24 being certain of them. Endings differ by one word, and the believers' certainty contrasts with the deniers' rejection.
tree:00e6zpl1g1cerz.relation: Contrast: leaders made by certainty in God's signs, and people ruined by rejecting them.

tree:1wuafef0m7ep35.why: All six say 'they were' followed by the separating pronoun and a predicate. In 40:21 ('they were stronger than them') and 53:52 ('they were more unjust') the predicate is a comparative, but the pronoun has the same role and the words the same structure; only the predicate differs.
tree:1wuafef0m7ep35.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 40:21 and 53:52 have the same structure.
tree:1wuafef0m7ep35.relation: They were: the losers, the victors, the wrongdoers, and stronger or more unjust than those after them.

tree:1l77obn1mfqt07.why: All six use 'a clear Book' with the same words and sense. In 5:15 it names the Quran that came with the light; in the others it names the record of all things. That is a difference of referent, which bears on the verdict, not a different word or structure. All rows read on.
tree:1l77obn1mfqt07.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 5:15 has the same phrase.
tree:1l77obn1mfqt07.relation: A clear Book: the record of every leaf, atom and creature, and the Quran that came with the light.

tree:0znpeyr13t5so7.why: Many of them: six places in Al-Ma'ida describing many of Bani Israil (transgressing, hastening to sin, increased in disbelief, allying with disbelievers). 5:64 and 5:68 share a whole clause. A memorizer set within one surah.
tree:0znpeyr13t5so7.relation: Al-Ma'ida's portrait of the many who broke the covenant, while not all did.

tree:1mzc0v71u7gmyh.why: All six say 'disbelieved in the signs of' God or their Lord with the same words and structure. The consequences differ (severe punishment, seized for sins, the losers, the meeting denied), which bears on the verdict. Cutting to one pair is cutting to the real pairs, which the brief forbids.
tree:1mzc0v71u7gmyh.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same phrase.
tree:1mzc0v71u7gmyh.relation: Those who disbelieve in the signs of God and what awaits them.

tree:0swe5hy0ktw1fi.why: All six open 'Nay, rather' followed by the correction. 34:27 ('Nay, rather He is God, the Mighty, the Wise') has the same words and structure; only the surah differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:0swe5hy0ktw1fi.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 34:27 has the same structure.
tree:0swe5hy0ktw1fi.relation: Nay, rather: the rebukes of the late surahs, and the answer to the associators.

tree:0r5aw2e0t47feu.why: Eat and drink: in this world with a limit (do not cause corruption, until dawn, do not waste) and in Paradise freely (with pleasure, for what you did). 52:19 and 77:43 identical, 69:24 a variant.
tree:0r5aw2e0t47feu.relation: Contrast: eating and drinking bound by limits now, and given without limit as reward.

tree:1y6i58k1ly9o16.why: We were wrongdoers: the confession of destroyed towns, the people of the garden and the deniers on the Day, against 26:209 'and We were not unjust'. A memorizer set with a contrast.
tree:1y6i58k1ly9o16.relation: Contrast: people confess their wrong when punishment comes; God says He was never unjust.

tree:18xkp4t0umu7r3.why: Two structures: 'if you are in doubt' (2:23, 10:104, 22:5), and being 'in' a place (3:154 in your houses, 4:78 in towers, 10:22 in the ships). 10:22 ('when you are in the ships') has the same structure as 3:154; only the place differs.
tree:18xkp4t0umu7r3.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 10:22 in the second set instead of removing it.
tree:18xkp4t0umu7r3.relation: If you are in doubt; and wherever you are, in houses, towers or ships.

tree:1rumxeg1k95beg.why: All six use the prohibition 'do not kill' with an object. 5:95 (do not kill game) and 12:10 (do not kill Yusuf) have the same words and structure; only the object differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:1rumxeg1k95beg.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 5:95 and 12:10 have the same structure.
tree:1rumxeg1k95beg.relation: Do not kill: yourselves, your children, the sacred soul, game, Yusuf.

tree:05rwl5a0n0yzee.why: All six close with 'that you may fear God', the same words and structure. A stock closing shared by many ayat; the card is kept whole as an index of where it ends a command. Cutting to the one near-identical pair is cutting to the real pairs, which the brief forbids. All rows read on.
tree:05rwl5a0n0yzee.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same closing.
tree:05rwl5a0n0yzee.relation: Commands that close with 'that you may fear God': worship, the covenant, retaliation, fasting, the straight path.

tree:1ojiblb02q3hfl.why: 'That you may remember' is a stock closing; the rulings and signs before it are unrelated.

tree:1mn5g5o07600uu.why: All six close with 'that you may be guided', the same words and structure. A stock closing; the card is kept whole as an index of what is given for guidance. Cutting to one pair is cutting to the real pairs, which the brief forbids. All rows read on.
tree:1mn5g5o07600uu.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same closing.
tree:1mn5g5o07600uu.relation: Given that you may be guided: the Book, the qibla, God's signs, the Prophet, the ways of the earth.

tree:1pir5yk086mo8e.why: 'That they may fear God' is a common closing on six unrelated ayat; 20:113 and 39:28 are already in the Arabic Quran card.

tree:0pvn7mp005uwcv.why: All six say 'God cursed them'. Three pairs by structure: with the cause 'for their disbelief' (2:88, 4:46), in a relative 'those whom God cursed' (4:52, 47:23), and as a plain statement followed by their punishment (9:68, 33:57). 9:68 and 33:57 have the same verb and form their own pair.
tree:0pvn7mp005uwcv.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, and kept 9:68 and 33:57 as a third pair instead of removing them.
tree:0pvn7mp005uwcv.relation: God's curse: for their disbelief, on those He named, and with a lasting punishment.

tree:0u9if2706hxj8r.why: Two structures: 'they are in doubt of it' (11:110, 41:45, 42:14, 4:157), and 'we are in doubt of what you call us to' (11:62, 14:9). 4:157 ('those who differed about it are in doubt of it') has the same words as 11:110; only the subject differs. Rows read on.
tree:0u9if2706hxj8r.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 4:157 in the first set instead of removing it.
tree:0u9if2706hxj8r.relation: In doubt of the Book or of Isa's end; and in doubt of what the messengers call to.

tree:17ymp2o1j9wwfs.why: All six use 'for every nation' in the same sense. 6:108 ('thus We made fair-seeming to every nation their deed') has the same words; only what is given differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:17ymp2o1j9wwfs.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 6:108 has the same phrase.
tree:17ymp2o1j9wwfs.relation: For every nation: a term, a messenger, a rite, and their deeds made fair-seeming.

tree:0xkgnjt1iiyj63.why: He made the night for you to rest in: 10:67 and 40:61 open alike and end differently, with the night as a garment (25:47), made subject (14:33, 16:12) and both night and day as mercy (28:73). A memorizer set on one sign.
tree:0xkgnjt1iiyj63.relation: Night and day as a mercy for rest and work.

tree:0a8hw3s1u4s0b6.why: For those who did wrong: taste the punishment (10:52, 34:42), all the earth as ransom (39:47), woe (43:65), a share like their companions' (51:59), a punishment before that (52:47). A memorizer set on the wrongdoers' end.
tree:0a8hw3s1u4s0b6.relation: What awaits the wrongdoers, in this life and the next.

check.why: Keep is right: 'for those who did wrong' with different punishments is a memorizer set on one theme.

tree:0xz5yxx1pnv7th.why: All six say 'we will not believe' with the same words, and 9:94 'we will not believe you' has the same structure as 2:55 and 17:90 'we will not believe you until'. Only the speaker differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:0xz5yxx1pnv7th.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 9:94 has the same structure.
tree:0xz5yxx1pnv7th.relation: We will not believe: the deniers' conditions, and the refusal to believe the hypocrites' excuses.

tree:1goq12l0itbcv1.why: All six say 'we will surely be among' a group. The split separates the promise of gratitude if saved or given (6:63, 7:189, 9:75, 10:22) from the fear of being among the losers unless forgiven (7:23, 7:149), and keeps every row with its run-on.
tree:1goq12l0itbcv1.changes: Split into the broken-promise set and the repentance pair, as the first agent did.
tree:1goq12l0itbcv1.relation: We will be among the grateful if You save us; we will be among the losers if You do not forgive us.

tree:0l9ncru0ltsoy2.why: Two structures: 'for him in' the Hereafter or this world as a predicate before its subject (2:102, 2:200 no share in the Hereafter; 22:9 for him in this world is disgrace), and 'for him' governed by a verb, then 'in' (7:145 We wrote for him in the tablets, 18:84 We established him in the land, 42:20 We increase for him in his harvest). Every row keeps its words; 2:200 reads on.
tree:0l9ncru0ltsoy2.changes: Kept 22:9 with the first group, and kept 7:145, 18:84 and 42:20 as a second card. The first agent removed 7:145, 18:84 and 22:9.
tree:0l9ncru0ltsoy2.relation: What one has in this world and the Hereafter; and what God wrote, established or increased for someone.

tree:15awl290xt382t.why: They have their reward with their Lord, no fear on them nor grief: with 'for them' and 'so for them' in different places, and 57:19 'their reward and their light'. A classic memorizer set.
tree:15awl290xt382t.relation: Faith, spending and prayer earn a reward kept with God and safety from fear.

tree:19a8zii08f799g.why: Were it not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them: 11:110 and 41:45 identical, with 10:19, 20:129, 42:14 and 42:21 varying. A key memorizer set.
tree:19a8zii08f799g.relation: God's prior decree delays the judgment between those who differ.

tree:0tmk2wa1ifflg0.why: 'He has no' in unrelated contexts (inheritance, Satan's power, idols, the deniers in Hell). Nothing to learn together.

tree:0iz8l1a0tyhio6.why: All six say 'after it had become clear to them'. 9:113 ('after it has become clear to them that they are companions of Hellfire') has the same words and structure; only what became clear differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:0iz8l1a0tyhio6.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 9:113 has the same structure.
tree:0iz8l1a0tyhio6.relation: After it became clear: the truth, the guidance, and the fate of the idolaters.

tree:1l8yju60cyso52.why: Two uses of the particle: the question 'what do you worship' (2:133, 26:70), and the relative 'what you worship' (21:98, 37:161, 109:2). 109:2 ('I do not worship what you worship') has the same relative as 21:98. In 12:40 the particle is negation ('you do not worship besides Him but names'): a different particle. Rows read on.
tree:1l8yju60cyso52.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, but kept 109:2 in the relative group. Removed 12:40: negation.
tree:1l8yju60cyso52.relation: What do you worship, asked by Yaqub and Ibrahim; and what you worship, bound for Hell and disowned.

tree:1a4i6e10zjrsov.why: All six use the relative 'what you are promised'. Two groups: what you are promised is here, is coming, is in the sky (38:53, 50:32, 6:134, 51:22), and I do not know whether it is near (21:109, 72:25). 6:134 and 51:22 have the same relative and verb; only the frame differs. Rows read on.
tree:1a4i6e10zjrsov.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, but kept 6:134 and 51:22 in the first group instead of removing them.
tree:1a4i6e10zjrsov.relation: What you are promised: here and certain, in the heaven, and of unknown time.

tree:1abxlo90hy4xf7.why: The 'eat of the good things We provided you' set (2:57, 2:172, 7:160, 20:81) is already kept in tree:1wqgque12xxzue; 30:28 and 63:10 use 'what We provided you' in other sentences.

tree:0rqc1mo1nfuzgk.why: All six use the relative 'what they did'. Three pairs: the evil of what they did (16:34, 45:33), the best of what they did (24:38, 46:16), and what they did found or turned to dust (18:49 they found what they did present, 25:23 We turned to what they did). 18:49 and 25:23 have the same relative and form their own pair. 16:34 and 45:33 read on.
tree:0rqc1mo1nfuzgk.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, and kept 18:49 and 25:23 as a third pair instead of removing them.
tree:0rqc1mo1nfuzgk.relation: What they did: its evil striking them, its best rewarded, and all of it found or scattered.

tree:093mh2y0u5w8bc.why: This is nothing but: a human like you, magic, a man, ancient tales, the deniers' dismissals of messengers. The women of Egypt say of Yusuf 'this is not a human, this is a noble angel'. A memorizer set with a sharp contrast.
tree:093mh2y0u5w8bc.relation: Contrast: deniers reduce a prophet to 'only a human'; the women raise Yusuf above humans.

tree:0684p5e0otg6w0.why: Two particles: the question 'what is it' (2:68, 2:70), and negation 'it is not' (11:83, 33:13, 45:24, 74:31). A different particle justifies separating them, but the negation rows share the same words and structure among themselves ('it is not far', 'it is not exposed', 'it is nothing but'), so they form their own card.
tree:0684p5e0otg6w0.changes: Kept the first agent's pair and added 11:83, 33:13, 45:24 and 74:31 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:0684p5e0otg6w0.relation: What is it, asked of the cow; and it is not, or nothing but: the stones, the houses, this life, the reminder.

tree:1npuwfw1l088oe.why: All six say 'and they do not perceive'. The split separates those who harm only themselves without perceiving it (2:9, 3:69, 6:26, 6:123) from those who do not perceive when they will be raised (16:21, 27:65), and keeps every row with its run-on.
tree:1npuwfw1l088oe.changes: Split into the self-harm set and the resurrection pair, as the first agent did.
tree:1npuwfw1l088oe.relation: They do not perceive: that they harm only themselves, nor when they will be raised.

check.why: Right split: 'they harm only themselves and do not perceive', and 'they do not perceive when they will be raised'. Every row is kept, and the runOn rows are right.

tree:0x1l5i70493ggd.why: God knows what they conceal and what they declare (2:77, 11:5, 16:23, 36:76) and what their breasts hide (27:74, 28:69, identical but for one word). A memorizer set on God's knowledge.
tree:0x1l5i70493ggd.relation: Nothing hidden in the heart escapes God.

tree:0i5fzbz0t9zzw5.why: 5:116, 7:13, 7:89, 10:15 and 24:16 say 'it is not for me / us / you to', with 'for' and a clause. In 58:7 'there is no secret talk of three' the verb means 'there is', followed by 'of' a noun: a different structure.
tree:0i5fzbz0t9zzw5.relation: It is not for me or us or you: to say, to be arrogant, to return, to change, to speak.

check.why: In 58:7, 'there is no secret talk' is a negation of existence, not 'it is not for me to'. A different structure, so removing it is right.

tree:1wabx0w0tay53y.why: An atom's weight: God wrongs none by it, nothing escapes Him of it (10:61, 34:3), the idols own not even it, and every atom of good or evil will be seen (99:7-8). A memorizer set and a strong theme.
tree:1wabx0w0tay53y.relation: Nothing is too small for God's knowledge, justice and reckoning.

tree:1lwg6p00i9sbgc.why: The 'so wait, I am waiting with you' set is already kept in tree:01er4ea00epyym; 3:81 and 4:47 share only 'what is with you' in another sense.

tree:0ftuox90rb2dtf.why: All six use 'of the signs of' God or their Lord with the same partitive sense. 6:4 and 36:46 cannot be removed because another card holds them; 33:34 and 53:18 have the same words and structure. Only the frame differs. 6:4 and 36:46 read on.
tree:0ftuox90rb2dtf.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same phrase.
tree:0ftuox90rb2dtf.relation: Of the signs of God: the garment of piety, the sun at the cave, signs turned from, recited in homes, seen by the Prophet.

tree:1m3g49y15zk8vq.why: 'Of the companions of' the Fire, the Blaze, the right, the graves: a common phrase on unrelated subjects. The 56:90-91 rows repeat each other through run-ons.

tree:0degqzc1nwew0q.why: All six use 'from Satan' in the same sense, the source. 58:10 ('secret talk is only from Satan') has the same words and sense as 7:200 ('a prompting from Satan'); only the frame differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:0degqzc1nwew0q.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 58:10 has the same phrase in the same sense.
tree:0degqzc1nwew0q.relation: From Satan: promptings, touches and secret talk, and refuge sought from him.

tree:0sfo7fm0gnvs6k.why: 2:35, 6:52, 7:19, 10:106 and 21:87 say 'among the wrongdoers', partitive. In 11:83 'it is not far from the wrongdoers' the particle is governed by 'far' and marks distance: a different sense. All five rows read on.
tree:0sfo7fm0gnvs6k.changes: Removed 11:83: a different sense of the particle.
tree:0sfo7fm0gnvs6k.relation: Among the wrongdoers: Adam and his wife warned, the Prophet warned, Yunus confessing.

tree:0etkh8b0e21d0n.why: All six use 'of the generations' with the same partitive sense. 11:116 ('why were there not among the generations before you people of remnant') has the same words and structure; only the frame differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:0etkh8b0e21d0n.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 11:116 has the same phrase.
tree:0etkh8b0e21d0n.relation: The generations before: how many were destroyed, and why none of them forbade corruption.

tree:01l6v8l1veigpx.why: God has conferred favour: on the believers by the Messenger, on the converts, on Yusuf and his brother, on those saved from Qarun's fate, on the people of Paradise. The same words name God's greatest gifts.
tree:01l6v8l1veigpx.relation: God's favour as the reason for every rescue and blessing.

tree:1terala1p8ssrs.why: Among the Muslims: the messengers commanded to be (10:72, 27:91), the caller to God and the grateful son declaring it (41:33, 46:15), the one house of Muslims in Lut's town (51:36), and Pharaoh claiming it while drowning (10:90).
tree:1terala1p8ssrs.relation: Contrast: submission declared in life is praised; Pharaoh's at death is refused.

tree:0ij5sdp08zyp3t.why: 'Of women' in unrelated rulings and statements (desires, marriage, prohibitions, older women, the Prophet's wives). Nothing to compare.

tree:1fdys5p0f64u01.why: Of the news of the unseen / the towns / the messengers: 3:44 and 12:102 nearly identical, 11:49 a variant, and the 'We relate to you' places. A memorizer set on the purpose of the stories.
tree:1fdys5p0f64u01.relation: The Quran's stories as proof of revelation and comfort to the Prophet.

tree:17408vi0osx14y.why: Except whoever repents, believes and does good: 19:60, 25:70, 28:67 with different rewards, and 5:39, 11:112, 25:71. A memorizer set with a hopeful theme.
tree:17408vi0osx14y.relation: Repentance with faith and good deeds opens Paradise and turns bad deeds into good.

tree:0sxap9e08g87cy.why: Whoever does good: for himself (41:46, 45:15 identical start), a good life (16:97), Paradise (40:40), and whoever does evil in ignorance then repents (6:54). A memorizer set on personal recompense.
tree:0sxap9e08g87cy.relation: Each soul reaps its own deeds, good or bad.

tree:1is0z970jaljjf.why: All six use 'from above them' in the same sense. 16:26 (the roof fell on them from above them) and 16:50 (they fear their Lord above them) have the same words; only what is above them differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:1is0z970jaljjf.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 16:26 and 16:50 have the same phrase.
tree:1is0z970jaljjf.relation: From above them: provision, punishment, coverings of fire, the falling roof, and their Lord.

tree:17t08en0xegien.why: 'From Us' gives different gifts in unrelated passages (reward, knowledge to Khidr, tenderness to Yahya, a reminder, provision for the Haram). No shared sentence.

tree:1pq4e83170thvx.why: From Yourself: prayers for mercy (3:8, 18:10), offspring and an heir (3:38, 19:5), a protector and helper (4:75), and authority (17:80). A memorizer set of prayers that ask God directly.
tree:1pq4e83170thvx.relation: What the righteous ask from God's own presence.

tree:1tsne3w0vewg3s.why: All six say 'from a place' far or near. The old rows repeated 34:52 and 34:53 as run-ons and as their own rows; each ayah appears once. The other run-ons are kept: 34:53, 41:44 and 50:41 read on into the next ayah.
tree:1tsne3w0vewg3s.changes: Gave 34:51, 34:52 and 34:53 one row each, as the first agent did, but kept the run-ons of the other rows.
tree:1tsne3w0vewg3s.relation: From a far place and a near place: the Fire seen, the seizing, the reaching, the guessing, the call.

tree:002uesi12lmzp6.why: All six use 'of fire' with the particle meaning 'made of'. 22:19 (garments of fire) and 55:35 (a flame of fire) have the same words and sense; only what is made of fire differs, which does not justify removing them. Several rows read on.
tree:002uesi12lmzp6.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 22:19 and 55:35 have the same phrase in the same sense.
tree:002uesi12lmzp6.relation: Made of fire: Iblis and the jinn, and the garments and flames of punishment.

tree:1lkj7yt1xvo1xb.why: Whoever obeys God and His Messenger: Paradise (4:13, 48:17 identical clause), the company of the prophets, the great success. A memorizer set on the reward of obedience.
tree:1lkj7yt1xvo1xb.relation: Obedience to God and the Messenger and what it earns.

tree:0lv4jvk1b3ti0g.why: Among people is one who says: we believe but are not believers (2:8), we believe but fall at the first harm (29:10), give us in this world (2:200) against give us good in both (2:201), and the hypocrites' excuses. A memorizer set and a study of types.
tree:0lv4jvk1b3ti0g.relation: Contrast: what people say about faith and what their deeds show.

tree:0dixiyj0b8z6uj.why: 6:151, 7:33, 34:2 and 57:4 say 'of it and what', with a relative pair (what is apparent of it and what is concealed; what comes out of it and what comes down). In 7:89 and 42:20 the second particle is negation ('and it is not for us', 'and he has not'): a different particle.
tree:0dixiyj0b8z6uj.changes: Removed 7:89 and 42:20: negation, not a relative. Split into the two pairs.
tree:0dixiyj0b8z6uj.relation: Indecencies, apparent and hidden; and what enters and leaves the earth and the sky.

check.why: In 7:89 and 42:20, the ma after 'from it' is a negation, not a relative 'and what'. A different structure, so removing them and splitting the two pairs is right.

tree:05bdrmq1jxm64q.why: Two uses of the particle: 'of them' followed by 'that' with a verb as the object (70:38 hope to enter, 74:52 want to be given, 4:113 a party of them resolved to mislead you), and 'of them' followed by 'that' introducing a command (10:2, 23:32, 38:6: 'warn', 'worship', 'walk on'). Each group shares its words and structure, so none is removed.
tree:05bdrmq1jxm64q.changes: Kept 4:113 with the first agent's pair, and kept 10:2, 23:32 and 38:6 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:05bdrmq1jxm64q.relation: What some of them hope or plot; and the command sent through one of them, or urged by their chiefs.

tree:0e7ev8u1u3s0sa.why: All six have 'of them' followed by the relative 'what'. 5:64 and 5:68 cannot be removed because another card holds them; 24:11 and 28:6 have the same words and structure. Only the frame differs. 6:10 and 21:41 read on.
tree:0e7ev8u1u3s0sa.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same structure.
tree:0e7ev8u1u3s0sa.relation: Of them, what: the mocked punishment, the increase in rebellion, each one's share of sin, and what Pharaoh feared.

tree:1ihpinp0bvt9mf.why: All six have 'Musa' followed by 'that' introducing a command. 26:10 ('your Lord called Musa: go to the wrongdoing people') has the same structure; the verb is 'called' instead of 'inspired', exactly what a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1ihpinp0bvt9mf.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 26:10 has the same structure.
tree:1ihpinp0bvt9mf.relation: God's commands to Musa: go, throw your staff, travel by night, strike the sea; and to his mother, nurse him.

tree:16zclpq04g8iny.why: We sent Musa with Our signs: and clear authority (11:96, 40:23 identical), to bring your people out of darkness (14:5), to Pharaoh and his chiefs. A key memorizer set.
tree:16zclpq04g8iny.relation: Musa's mission described from several sides.

tree:0bw8dkm0s7egc6.why: Remember God's favour upon you: the covenant, the prophets and kings, rescue from Pharaoh, the Confederates; you cannot count it. 5:20 and 14:6 open with Musa's call. A memorizer set.
tree:0bw8dkm0s7egc6.relation: God's favours named one by one, and the duty to remember them.

tree:1hojdxn0loabe9.why: Every soul for what it earned: recompensed (40:17, 45:22), held in pledge (74:38), and what it strives for (20:15). A memorizer set on individual recompense.
tree:1hojdxn0loabe9.relation: Each soul answers for its own earning.

tree:1jdfm7p0ezh1mz.why: Thus We detail the signs: for a people who know, reflect, understand, or that they may return. The ending fits the subject before it, which a memorizer must learn. The phrase is longer than a bare closing.
tree:1jdfm7p0ezh1mz.relation: The signs are laid out for different faculties: knowledge, reflection, reason.

check.why: Keep is right: 'thus We detail the signs' with endings that change (for a people who know, that they may return), a memorizer trap longer than a bare closing.

tree:0fued681mml6b2.why: Has the story reached you: of Musa (20:9 and 79:15 almost identical), the disputants, Ibrahim's guests, the hosts, the Overwhelming. Openings that a memorizer must link to the right story.
tree:0fued681mml6b2.relation: The Quran's way of opening a story with a question.

tree:1kalpif1v9og7z.why: Two groups with 'they are the defiantly disobedient': those who turn away, disbelieve or do not judge by what God sent, or slander (3:82, 24:55, 5:47, 24:4), and those who forgot God (9:67, 59:19). 5:47 and 24:4 have the same 'those, they are the defiantly disobedient' as 3:82. All rows read on.
tree:1kalpif1v9og7z.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, but kept 5:47 and 24:4 in the first group instead of removing them.
tree:1kalpif1v9og7z.relation: Who are the defiantly disobedient: those who turn away, do not judge by God's law, slander, and forget God.

tree:10ymmom0q11eqo.why: And of the Hereafter they are disbelievers / certain: 7:45 and 11:19 differ only in the doubled 'they', a precise memorizer pair, with the believers' 'they are certain' (27:3, 31:4). Overlaps tree:1vv0mp81nt78mo but adds 7:45.
tree:10ymmom0q11eqo.relation: Contrast: blocking God's way with denial of the Hereafter, and prayer with certainty of it.

tree:1creyw81hu8ito.why: Faces that Day: radiant and gloomy (75), bright and dusty (80), humbled and joyful (88). Short ayat in pairs a memorizer must order.
tree:1creyw81hu8ito.relation: Contrast: the faces of the saved and the lost on the Day.

tree:1148wr11o18n3d.why: The prayer-and-zakat set is kept in tree:10z54ct1eb21vr and the certain/denying pairs in tree:1vv0mp81nt78mo; this card repeats them with 7:156.

tree:1pbyfl20g10t0k.why: O Children of Israil: remember My favour (2:40, 2:47, 2:122, the last two identical), We saved you (20:80), and Isa's calls (5:72, 61:6). A key memorizer set.
tree:1pbyfl20g10t0k.relation: God's and Isa's addresses to Bani Israil: favours and the call to tawhid.

tree:1i03xep1wp0k9t.why: They call to: the Fire (2:221, 28:41), good (3:104), God's Book (3:23), and on the Day they are called to prostrate and cannot (68:42-43). A set with contrasts.
tree:1i03xep1wp0k9t.relation: Contrast: those who call to the Fire and those who call to good.

tree:1w5trnl1f4yw65.why: They hasten: in good deeds (3:114, 21:90, 23:61), in disbelief (3:176, 5:41, near-identical openings), in sin (5:62). A memorizer set built on a contrast.
tree:1w5trnl1f4yw65.relation: Contrast: racing toward good and racing toward disbelief.

tree:088j267091o7ax.why: All six use 'God knows' with the same verb. Three pairs: God has not yet made evident those who strive (3:142, 9:16), God knows those who slip away or hinder (24:63, 33:18), and God knows what is in their hearts (4:63, 8:70). 4:63 and 8:70 have the same verb and form their own pair.
tree:088j267091o7ax.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, and kept 4:63 and 8:70 as a third pair instead of removing them.
tree:088j267091o7ax.relation: What God knows: who strives, who slips away, and what is in the hearts.

tree:10z54ct1eb21vr.why: Those who establish prayer: and spend from what We provided (2:3, 8:3), and give zakat (5:55, 9:71, 27:3, 31:4, the last two identical). A core memorizer set.
tree:10z54ct1eb21vr.relation: Prayer joined to giving as the mark of the believers.

tree:0jm67hw0y8gj3o.why: The Zakariyya and Maryam set is kept in tree:0sisdh31gsxmfr, and 5:116 and 10:15 in tree:0i5fzbz0t9zzw5. This card repeats them.

tree:06bcrys1pens16.why: The 'those who spend their wealth' set is kept in tree:1jyhoa000zwqhi; this card repeats it with 8:36 in place of 3:134.

tree:1xg0tie0kvo5x6.why: They forbid wrong: the believing community (3:104, 3:114, 9:71) against the hypocrites who forbid right (9:67), with those who forbade evil saved (7:165, 11:116).
tree:1xg0tie0kvo5x6.relation: Contrast: believers enjoin right and forbid wrong; hypocrites do the reverse.

tree:1gpy99l1q239yv.why: Until the day they are raised: Iblis's request (7:14, 15:36, 38:79), the barrier after death, Ibrahim's prayer, Yunus in the whale. A memorizer set.
tree:1gpy99l1q239yv.relation: The day of raising: what Iblis was granted until, and what the righteous fear.

tree:18yig0r0y5na27.why: Whoever believes and does good: with repentance (19:60, 20:82, 25:70, 28:67) and without (18:88, 28:80, 34:37), each with a different reward. A memorizer set that overlaps tree:17408vi0osx14y and adds four places.
tree:18yig0r0y5na27.relation: Faith joined to good deeds, not wealth or children, brings near to God.

tree:11jrrrl1ajhsqf.why: 'Believed, indeed' joins words across unrelated ayat (repentance, rabbis, good news, God's defence, wide earth, families). No shared sentence.

tree:148eqi70f4nkch.why: All seven close with 'a great reward', the same words and structure. A stock closing; the card is kept whole as an index of who is promised it. Cutting to the one near-identical pair is cutting to the real pairs, which the brief forbids. All rows read on.
tree:148eqi70f4nkch.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same closing.
tree:148eqi70f4nkch.relation: A great reward: for the patient, the God-fearing, the believers, those who lower their voices, and with God against the trial of wealth.

tree:1jxynk91dddphj.why: All seven say 'I fear that' with a verb. 12:13 (Yaqub: that the wolf eats him) and 19:45 (Ibrahim: that a punishment touches you) have the same words and structure; only the speaker differs, which does not justify removing them. The old rows repeated 28:34 as a run-on of 28:33 and as its own row; it appears once.
tree:1jxynk91dddphj.changes: Restored 12:13 and 19:45, which the first agent removed. Gave 28:34 one row only, as the first agent did, and kept the run-ons.
tree:1jxynk91dddphj.relation: I fear that: Musa fears denial and death, Pharaoh fears change, Yaqub fears the wolf, Ibrahim fears for his father.

tree:1ugzpmh1ihxphf.why: 19:3, 21:76, 21:83, 21:89, 38:41 and 68:48 say 'when he called (his Lord)', with the prophet as the subject calling. In 26:10 'when your Lord called Musa' the Lord is the subject and Musa the object: a different structure.
tree:1ugzpmh1ihxphf.changes: Removed 26:10: the Lord is the subject there.
tree:1ugzpmh1ihxphf.relation: When he called his Lord: Zakariyya, Nuh, Ayyub, Yunus, each answered.

tree:1fls66c0subcxw.why: All seven say 'We sent to'. Two groups: the angels 'we have been sent to a people' (11:70, 15:58, 51:32), and God 'We sent to' nations or peoples (6:42, 16:63, 27:45 to Thamud, 73:15 to Pharaoh). 27:45 and 73:15 have the same verb and structure as 6:42; only the people differ. 15:58 and 51:32 read on.
tree:1fls66c0subcxw.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 27:45 and 73:15 in the second group instead of removing them.
tree:1fls66c0subcxw.relation: The angels sent to Lut's people; and God sending to nations, Thamud and Pharaoh.

tree:0bycqf8080u1nq.why: All seven use the verb 'rose / stood firm upon'. 48:29 ('it stood firm upon its stem') has the same verb and preposition in the sense of settling firmly on something; only the subject (a plant) differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:0bycqf8080u1nq.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 48:29 has the same verb and preposition.
tree:0bycqf8080u1nq.relation: Firm upon: God over the Throne after creating in six days, and the plant upon its stem.

tree:0lgjqft15zvnz9.why: 'Will you not remember' is a stock closing after unrelated arguments; the lead-ins have nothing in common.

tree:1buoa6s1cthouc.why: The Hereafter is better: for whoever fears God (4:77), for those who fear (6:32, 7:169, 12:109, near-identical closings), for those who believed (12:57), and more lasting (87:17). A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:1buoa6s1cthouc.relation: This world is small; the Hereafter is better and lasting for the God-fearing.

tree:0jey1sk0ie29qu.why: He created the heavens and earth in truth: seven places, each followed by a different lesson (He could replace you, exalted above partners, a sign, each soul repaid). A memorizer set.
tree:0jey1sk0ie29qu.relation: Creation has a purpose: truth, judgment and recompense.

tree:1s15vvr1afu8tx.why: All seven use 'the land and the sea' in the same sense. Two groups: 'the darknesses of the land and sea' (6:63, 6:97, 27:63), and 'in the land and sea' (6:59, 10:22, 17:70, 30:41). The words keep their sense, so the second group is a card rather than removed.
tree:1s15vvr1afu8tx.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 6:59, 10:22, 17:70 and 30:41 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:1s15vvr1afu8tx.relation: The darknesses of land and sea; and what is in them: God's knowledge, travel, carrying, corruption.

tree:14g7ejh1im00zf.why: The clear conveyance: on Our Messenger (5:92, 64:12 nearly identical), on you (16:82), on the messengers (16:35, 24:54, 29:18, 36:17). A memorizer set overlapping tree:1d18dlj06jqsiv and adding the 'if you turn away' pair.
tree:14g7ejh1im00zf.relation: If people turn away, the Messenger has done his duty.

tree:1vvvuxf1ansa6h.why: He begins creation then repeats it: seven places with different continuations, and 29:20 'then God produces the final creation'. A memorizer set on the proof of resurrection.
tree:1vvvuxf1ansa6h.relation: The first creation proves the second.

tree:0v8oyeh1xwqq8b.why: To whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth (7:158, 25:2, 43:85, 85:9) or what is in the heavens and earth (14:2, 34:1, 42:53). A memorizer must keep the two wordings apart.
tree:0v8oyeh1xwqq8b.relation: God owns the heavens and earth and all in them.

tree:1u2udgl1wo35cx.why: All seven use 'those who associated' with the same words, sense and structure. The frames differ (their claim about God's will, their love of life, their enmity, seeing their partners, God's judgement), which bears on the verdict. Cutting to the one pair is cutting to the real pairs.
tree:1u2udgl1wo35cx.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same phrase.
tree:1u2udgl1wo35cx.relation: Those who associate partners: their claims, their desires, their enmity, and their end.

tree:0kp6e2e0to2acs.why: He is the Forgiving, the Merciful closing scenes of forgiveness: Yaqub for his sons, Musa after the killing, the call not to despair (39:53), the angels' prayer (42:5). As with the 'Accepter of repentance' card, the closing ties stories of forgiveness.
tree:0kp6e2e0to2acs.relation: God's forgiveness in the stories of prophets and in the call to all sinners.

check.why: I would drop it. 'He is the Forgiving, the Merciful' is a stock divine-name closing, and the brief says those lean drop. The scenes it closes are unrelated.

tree:02pzpxd0k5jiol.why: 'The people who' joins unrelated clauses; the 'denied Our signs' set has its own cards.

tree:1kbfj021b3bvyo.why: All seven have 'the Book' within a negation or prohibition followed by 'except': did not differ except, do not know the Book except, not sent the Book except, none of the People of the Book but, do not dispute with them except. The same structure throughout; only the subject differs.
tree:1kbfj021b3bvyo.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same structure.
tree:1kbfj021b3bvyo.relation: The Book and its exceptions: who differed, who knows it, why it was sent, how to dispute with its people.

tree:1hpgg0s1tifhtg.why: He sent down the Book with the truth: confirming what came before, to judge between people, to worship God sincerely, with the balance. Seven places with similar openings and different purposes.
tree:1hpgg0s1tifhtg.relation: The purposes of the revelation, each named after the same phrase.

tree:1bvxeto0nkgypg.why: 'God, indeed He' joins unrelated ayat (peace treaty, Yusuf, despair, punishment, pardon). No shared sentence.

tree:1qxuw5h0ibaubv.why: The real pair 11:26 and 46:21 is kept in tree:0k5hkqx1sapi1b; the other rows share only 'God, I'.

tree:0zyndom1xil32e.why: 'God, or' joins unrelated ayat; the punishment-or-Hour pair (6:40, 12:107) has its own card.

tree:0eyrk791m8ps8d.why: Only the closing 'God sees' (the servants / what they do) is shared, on unrelated subjects.

tree:0i3i3bb0aqysyn.why: The 'God is my Lord and your Lord' set is kept in tree:1vzftjn11vtgjt; 18:38 and 42:10 do not add a pair.

tree:0az32f21r1n2sg.why: 7:190, 23:91, 27:63, 37:159, 52:43 and 59:23 say 'exalted is God above what' they associate or describe. In 5:95 'God pardoned what is past' the governing verb is 'pardon', and the particle marks what is pardoned, not what God is above: a different sense. All six rows read on.
tree:0az32f21r1n2sg.changes: Removed 5:95: a different governing verb and sense.
tree:0az32f21r1n2sg.relation: Exalted is God above what they associate and describe.

tree:1lllw5y0kx2y3w.why: All seven say 'God, with Him is' something. 8:28, 9:22 and 64:15 cannot be removed because another card holds them; 24:39 and 31:34 have the same words and structure. Only what is with Him differs. 8:28, 9:22 and 64:15 read on.
tree:1lllw5y0kx2y3w.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same structure.
tree:1lllw5y0kx2y3w.relation: With God: the best return and reward, a great reward, the reckoning, the knowledge of the Hour.

tree:04xw5n20406vnq.why: 5:119, 9:100, 58:22, 98:8, 3:155 and 39:35 have a verb with God as subject acting 'from them': pleased with them, pardoned them, removes from them. 3:155 and 39:35 have the same structure; only the verb differs. In 4:109 'who will dispute with God on their behalf' God is the object: a different structure.
tree:04xw5n20406vnq.changes: Kept 3:155 and 39:35, which the first agent removed: the same structure. Removed 4:109.
tree:04xw5n20406vnq.relation: What God does toward them: pleased with them, pardoned them, removes their worst deeds.

tree:0rz6nvt0b78swf.why: 8:45, 26:227, 33:21, 33:35, 62:10 and 22:40 have 'God' as what is remembered, then 'much'. 22:40 ('in which the name of God is mentioned much') has the same structure. In 4:160 'God' is the genitive of 'the way of God', and 'much' describes the blocking: a different structure. Several rows read on.
tree:0rz6nvt0b78swf.changes: Kept 22:40, which the first agent removed: the same structure. Removed 4:160.
tree:0rz6nvt0b78swf.relation: Remembering God much: in battle, in trade, in daily life, and in the houses of worship.

tree:13yu1hd0ahlp3j.why: All seven have a command with God as object, then 'that you may' succeed, be grateful or receive mercy. 7:69 (remember the favours of God) and 27:46 (seek forgiveness of God) have the same structure; the verb differs, which is what a memorizer must keep apart. Rows read on.
tree:13yu1hd0ahlp3j.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 7:69 and 27:46 have the same structure.
tree:13yu1hd0ahlp3j.relation: Fear, remember, seek forgiveness of God, that you may succeed, be grateful, receive mercy.

tree:1eijpgz0tblr5b.why: Two structures: 'God, His is the kingdom' with 'His' as predicate (2:107, 5:40, 9:116), and a verb with God as subject, 'for him', then the object (24:40 God has not made for him light, 33:38 what God ordained for him, 65:11 God has made good for him provision). In 22:9 the two words touch across a clause break: 'the way of God' ends one clause and 'for him in this world' begins another.
tree:1eijpgz0tblr5b.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 24:40, 33:38 and 65:11 as a second card. Removed 22:9: a clause break.
tree:1eijpgz0tblr5b.relation: God's kingdom; and what God makes or ordains for a person: light, a duty, provision.

tree:0f60igq0n91nue.why: All seven end a ruling with a command naming God, then 'and know that' God is or you will. In 2:244 the command is 'fight in the way of God', so 'God' is a genitive, but the closing 'and know that God is Hearing, Knowing' has the same words and form as the others. The ending is what a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:0f60igq0n91nue.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 2:244 has the same closing.
tree:0f60igq0n91nue.relation: The rulings of al-Baqara closing with 'and know that': God is with the God-fearing, severe, knowing, seeing, hearing.

tree:0xnlcwn0rmb8tf.why: The only real pair (8:72 and 8:74) is kept in tree:1l5c11x0vgvb23; the other rows share only 'God, and those who'.

tree:1ljp89x0c0dzw3.why: Two senses of the verb: 'God will judge between' them or you (2:113, 4:141, 22:69, 39:3, 60:10), and 'God decrees' what He wills with no one to reverse it (5:1, 13:41). 60:10 ('He judges between you') has the same words and sense as 22:69. 5:1 and 13:41 share a different sense of the verb and form their own card.
tree:1ljp89x0c0dzw3.changes: Kept 60:10 in the first agent's card, and kept 5:1 and 13:41 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:1ljp89x0c0dzw3.relation: God judges between those who differ; and God decrees as He wills.

tree:1uhcsq705cvmtl.why: All seven use 'the believing men and believing women' with the same words and sense. The frames differ (promised gardens, harmed, forgiven, tried), which bears on the verdict. Cutting to the three Garden rows is cutting to the real pairs, which the brief forbids.
tree:1uhcsq705cvmtl.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same phrase.
tree:1uhcsq705cvmtl.relation: The believing men and women: promised gardens, their light running before them, harmed, tried, forgiven.

tree:05994g91kpyni7.why: For a time: provision on earth after the fall (2:36, 7:24), the people of Yunus given enjoyment after believing (10:98, 37:148), furnishings (16:80), rescue at sea (36:44), a trial (21:111). Endings to keep apart.
tree:05994g91kpyni7.relation: Every worldly enjoyment is only for a while.

tree:0hnkwpe0omb3aq.why: All seven use 'to their Lord' with the same preposition and sense, toward Him. 11:23 (humble themselves to their Lord) and 17:57 (seek a means to their Lord) keep the sense; the different verbs are what a memorizer must keep apart from 'gathered to their Lord'.
tree:0hnkwpe0omb3aq.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 11:23 and 17:57 use the phrase in the same sense.
tree:0hnkwpe0omb3aq.relation: To their Lord: gathered, returning, hastening, humble before Him, seeking a means to Him.

tree:1h9apkr1xs1e73.why: All seven use 'to his people' in the same sense. The Nuh rows ('We sent Nuh to his people') have the same words; that another card holds them does not justify removing them here. The Musa pair and the Nuh rows differ in verb (returned, sent), which a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1h9apkr1xs1e73.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the Nuh rows share the same phrase.
tree:1h9apkr1xs1e73.relation: To his people: Musa returning in anger, and Nuh sent five times.

tree:0kc8vo90x81amp.why: All seven have a verb with God as subject followed by 'to Musa'. 28:44 ('when We decreed to Musa the command') has the same structure as 'We inspired to Musa'; the verb differs, which is what a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:0kc8vo90x81amp.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 28:44 has the same structure.
tree:0kc8vo90x81amp.relation: What God conveyed to Musa: the commands of his story, and the command decreed on the western side.

tree:18od91w04at304.why: Orphans and the poor: seven lists of those owed kindness and wealth, each continuing differently (the wayfarer, the neighbour, the fifth of spoils). A memorizer set and a theme of care.
tree:18od91w04at304.relation: The same weak groups named again and again as the rightful share in wealth.

tree:1i7cr4z1dcnysx.why: To Him you will be gathered: with 'know that', 'who', 'He is the One', 'and to Him'. Six places closing commands with the reminder of gathering; 23:79 and 67:24 nearly identical.
tree:1i7cr4z1dcnysx.relation: Every command tied to the gathering before God.

tree:12cm86f1s5dsqt.why: I was commanded to: be the first to submit, be of the Muslims, be of the believers, worship God, submit to the Lord of the worlds. A memorizer set (overlaps tree:03m2aih0o3ewh9) on the Prophet's own obedience.
tree:12cm86f1s5dsqt.relation: The Prophet declares what he is commanded before calling others.

tree:1y2b2ec10y1cxa.why: Two structures: 'that you say' as a noun clause, what is forbidden or allowed (2:169, 7:33 saying about God what you do not know, 61:3 saying what you do not do, 2:235 saying an honourable word), and 'lest you say' an excuse (6:156, 7:172, 5:19 'lest you say no warner came to us'). 5:19 has the same structure as 6:156; 61:3 and 2:235 the same as 2:169. 2:169 and 7:33 read on.
tree:1y2b2ec10y1cxa.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 2:235 and 61:3 in the first and 5:19 in the second instead of removing them.
tree:1y2b2ec10y1cxa.relation: What you say: about God without knowledge, what you do not do, an honourable word; and the excuse you would have said.

tree:0x9i0dy0yraeeq.why: All seven say 'indeed many' (of a group) followed by an emphatic predicate. 6:119 (many mislead), 9:34 (many of the rabbis consume) and 38:24 (many partners wrong one another) have the same words and structure; only the group differs.
tree:0x9i0dy0yraeeq.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same structure.
tree:0x9i0dy0yraeeq.relation: Indeed many: of the people, of the rabbis, of partners, transgress, mislead or are heedless.

tree:0k3dle51n2xcx1.why: Two forms: 'then for him is' Hell or a straitened life, after a condition (9:63, 20:74, 20:124, 72:23), and 'indeed he has' something (38:25, 38:40 nearness with Us; 12:78 an aged father). 12:78 has the same particle and structure as 38:25; only the subject differs. 38:25 and 38:40 read on.
tree:0k3dle51n2xcx1.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 12:78 in the second set instead of removing it.
tree:0k3dle51n2xcx1.relation: What is his: Hell for the defiant, nearness for Dawud and Sulayman, an aged father for Binyamin.

tree:16aeed00tk19vc.why: All seven say 'if He wills' with a verb. Two groups: 'if He wills He removes you and brings others' (4:133, 6:133, 14:19, 35:16), and 'if He wills' with another act (17:54 have mercy or punish, 42:24 seal your heart, 42:33 still the wind). The rows keep the same conditional, so the second group is a card rather than removed. 14:19 and 35:16 read on.
tree:16aeed00tk19vc.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 17:54, 42:24 and 42:33 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:16aeed00tk19vc.relation: If God wills: He removes you and brings a new creation; He shows mercy or punishes, seals a heart, stills the wind.

tree:02u3gv31d5a2f1.why: And I am not of: the guided if I follow you, the associators (6:79, 12:108), the pretenders; Pharaoh's 'I am of the Muslims' too late and Musa's 'I was of the astray'. A memorizer set of endings.
tree:02u3gv31d5a2f1.relation: What the prophets declare themselves to be and not to be.

tree:1c79e3g12538d6.why: And You are the best of: providers, judges, forgivers, inheritors, hosts, the merciful. Prayers closing with a fitting name, a memorizer set and a lesson in asking.
tree:1c79e3g12538d6.relation: Each prayer ends with the name of God that fits the request.

tree:06x3z2n0nn5qm5.why: You are nothing but: guessing, inventors, humans like us, falsifiers, liars, in error. Said by messengers to deniers and by deniers to messengers. A memorizer set of endings.
tree:06x3z2n0nn5qm5.relation: Contrast: messengers expose the deniers' guessing; deniers accuse the messengers.

tree:06j4p6905dcl5x.why: 'We sent down to you' is common; the real set (4:105, 5:48, 39:2) is kept in tree:1hpgg0s1tifhtg.

tree:0wbpi0k06w0ffu.why: All seven say 'travel / see how' with the same verb and question word. 29:20 ('see how He began creation') has the same words and structure; it ends with creation instead of the end of the deniers, exactly what a memorizer must keep apart. Rows read on.
tree:0wbpi0k06w0ffu.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 29:20 has the same structure.
tree:0wbpi0k06w0ffu.relation: Travel and see how: the end of the deniers, corrupters and criminals, and how creation began.

tree:06zfnjj0gfu6yt.why: You are only: a warner (11:12, 13:7, 79:45), a reminder (88:21), said by God; and a forger, one bewitched (16:101, 26:153, 26:185), said by deniers. 26:153 and 26:185 differ by one 'and' in the run-on.
tree:06zfnjj0gfu6yt.relation: Contrast: what God says the Prophet is and what the deniers call him.

tree:05a4x331spq62d.why: Only the closing 'He knows what is in the breasts' is shared; the subjects before it are unrelated.

tree:0vy2lbu14vtyny.why: Two senses of the particle: 'he is among' (12:24, 37:81, 37:111, 37:132 Our servants; 21:75 the righteous), and 'it is from' a source (12:28 from your plotting, 27:30 from Sulayman). 21:75 has the same partitive sense as 37:81. 12:28 and 27:30 share the other sense and form their own pair. 37:81, 37:111 and 37:132 read on.
tree:0vy2lbu14vtyny.changes: Kept 21:75 in the first agent's card, and kept 12:28 and 27:30 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:0vy2lbu14vtyny.relation: He is among Our servants and the righteous; it is from your plotting, from Sulayman.

tree:1f9c9xp0ll1g5j.why: They are liars: God's verdict on the hypocrites' oaths (9:42, 9:107, 59:11, 'God knows / bears witness'), on the deniers' wishes and claims (6:28, 23:90, 29:12, 37:152). A memorizer set with 'and' and without.
tree:1f9c9xp0ll1g5j.relation: God exposes the oaths and claims of hypocrites and deniers.

tree:1lzps2b0i6tl6p.why: Two structures: 'how many We destroyed' (6:6, 28:58, 38:3, 17:17, 32:26), and 'We did not destroy any town except' (15:4, 26:208). 17:17 and 32:26 have the same 'how many We destroyed of the generations' as 6:6; that another card holds them does not justify removing them here.
tree:1lzps2b0i6tl6p.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 17:17 and 32:26 in the first set instead of removing them.
tree:1lzps2b0i6tl6p.relation: How many generations and towns We destroyed; and none without a term and a warner.

tree:053ay100zls8i4.why: Only closing phrases are shared (in clear error, brought to punishment, in gardens honoured); the subjects differ and 34:38 is kept in tree:14snuuc0nm5ayw.

check.why: Drop is acceptable. I checked that the real pairs are kept elsewhere: 39:22 with 46:32 in tree:14ly8r70qqytrj and tree:0jdq9ra0ynt0ee, and 30:16 with 34:38 in tree:1xwhgfm0dkivq0.

tree:0naj2bi17rk1e6.why: None remember but those of understanding: 2:269 and 3:7 identical, 13:19 and 39:9 'only those of understanding remember', plus 14:52, 38:29, 39:18. Verb forms differ, a memorizer set on who benefits from the reminder.
tree:0naj2bi17rk1e6.relation: The reminder benefits only people of understanding.

check.why: Keep is right: 'those of understanding' after remember/reflect verbs in different forms is a real memorizer set.

tree:10sxzbm04q9ndk.why: With their wealth and their lives: the strivers praised (4:95, 8:72, 9:20, 9:88, 49:15), those who do not ask leave (9:44), and those who hated to strive (9:81). A memorizer set with a contrast.
tree:10sxzbm04q9ndk.relation: Contrast: striving with wealth and life, and the laggards who disliked it.

tree:06hn6c40f1v15u.why: All seven end with 'a painful punishment' after the same preposition. In 8:32 the deniers say 'bring us a painful punishment': the same words and sense, with a different verb, which is what a memorizer must keep apart from 'give them tidings of'. All rows read on.
tree:06hn6c40f1v15u.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 8:32 has the same phrase.
tree:06hn6c40f1v15u.relation: A painful punishment: announced to the deniers and hoarders, and demanded by the deniers themselves.

tree:133l1cv1287q2l.why: Without account: God provides whom He wills (2:212, 3:27, 3:37, 24:38), Sulayman's gift, the patient's reward, the provision of Paradise. A memorizer set on boundless giving.
tree:133l1cv1287q2l.relation: God's provision and reward beyond measure.

tree:1nfitae05sdytm.why: 24:64, 31:23, 41:50, 58:6 and 58:7 say 'He will inform them of what they did', the preposition marking what they are told. In 34:37 and 53:31 'for what they did' marks the cause of a reward or recompense: a different sense of the preposition after a different verb.
tree:1nfitae05sdytm.changes: Removed 34:37 and 53:31: a different sense of the preposition.
tree:1nfitae05sdytm.relation: He will inform them of what they did on the Day of Return.

tree:09zivky1qgjx4u.why: All seven use 'between people' in the same sense. Two groups by verb: judging between people (4:58, 4:105, 38:26, 2:213 'to judge between people'), and acting among people (2:224, 4:114 reconciling, 3:140 days alternated among people). 2:213 has the same verb as 4:105; 3:140 keeps the phrase's sense.
tree:09zivky1qgjx4u.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 2:213 in the first group and 3:140 in the second instead of removing them.
tree:09zivky1qgjx4u.relation: Judging between people, making peace between them, and days alternated among them.

tree:1rx0a3p0ku67gv.why: All seven use 'between that' in the same sense. 2:68 (a cow of middle age between that) and 25:67 (between that, moderate) are a close pair; 19:64 and 25:38 have the same words. Only the subject differs, which does not justify removing them. 4:150 and 17:110 read on.
tree:1rx0a3p0ku67gv.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same phrase.
tree:1rx0a3p0ku67gv.relation: Between that: the middle way in prayer and spending, the cow between old and young, the wavering hypocrites, the generations between.

tree:1iz3yu70xnpmth.why: 10:104, 21:67, 21:98, 29:17 and 60:4 say 'what / whom you worship besides God', with the relative and 'besides'. In 2:133 the particle is interrogative and the phrase is 'after me', a different word; in 12:40 the particle is negation, 'you do not worship besides Him but names'. A different particle in both.
tree:1iz3yu70xnpmth.relation: What you worship besides God: refused, rebuked, disowned, and fuel for Hell.

tree:1s798zh1pviqlp.why: All seven open 'then indeed' with the same words. Three groups: 'then indeed your Lord, for those who' (16:110, 16:119), 'then indeed upon Us is' (75:19, 88:26), and 'then indeed' their drink, their return, many of them (37:67, 37:68, 5:32). 5:32, 37:67 and 37:68 have the same particle and structure and form their own card.
tree:1s798zh1pviqlp.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, and kept 5:32, 37:67 and 37:68 as a third card instead of removing them.
tree:1s798zh1pviqlp.relation: Then indeed: your Lord forgives, upon Us is the explanation and the account, and their drink and return are in Hell.

tree:0uu0ap51u4uxj7.why: A recompense for what they used to: earn (the hypocrites, 9:82, 9:95), do (the believers, 32:17, 46:14, 56:24), reject (41:28), and the thief's 'for what they earned'. Endings differ by group.
tree:0uu0ap51u4uxj7.relation: Contrast: the same words for the reward of believers and the punishment of hypocrites.

tree:0wdd3231r1je7b.why: All seven say 'We placed in' something followed by what was placed: prophethood in the offspring, criminals in every town, constellations in the sky, mountains in the earth, shackles on the necks, mercy in the hearts. The same verb, preposition and structure; only the subject differs.
tree:0wdd3231r1je7b.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same structure.
tree:0wdd3231r1je7b.relation: What God placed in things: prophethood, criminals, constellations, mountains, shackles, mercy.

tree:1imf2n81tc1d6s.why: Gardens of Bliss closing promises with different lead-ins (in, for them, with their Lord). A memorizer must keep the lead-ins apart; 68:34 sets it against equating Muslims and criminals.
tree:1imf2n81tc1d6s.relation: The Gardens of Bliss promised to believers and the God-fearing.

check.why: Keep is right: 'the Gardens of Bliss' with different lead-ins (in, for them, with their Lord) is a memorizer set.

tree:1iaa08e071x1ti.why: Gardens and springs: the God-fearing in them (15:45, 44:52, 51:15) and Pharaoh's people and Thamud taken out of them or leaving them behind (26:57, 26:134, 26:147, 44:25). The same words for lost and lasting gardens.
tree:1iaa08e071x1ti.relation: Contrast: gardens and springs the tyrants lost, and those the God-fearing keep forever.

tree:0hfchbk0sqv6jq.why: Their deeds became worthless: apostates, killers of prophets, hypocrites, deniers of the meeting, idolaters at the mosques. Each with a different consequence after. A memorizer set on what voids deeds.
tree:0hfchbk0sqv6jq.relation: What makes deeds worthless: disbelief, hypocrisy and denial of the Hereafter.

tree:1c0moau01a39pu.why: 'Better than' comparisons in unrelated contexts (marriage, charity, Pharaoh's boast, the Night of Decree). Nothing shared in meaning.

tree:00ddcdo0069ruk.why: All seven use 'better for them' in the same sense. 3:180 ('let them not think it is better for them') and 9:74 ('it will be better for them') have the same words and structure; the frame differs from 'it would have been better', which is what a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:00ddcdo0069ruk.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 3:180 and 9:74 have the same phrase.
tree:00ddcdo0069ruk.relation: Better for them: belief, obedience, patience, repentance; and what the misers wrongly think is better.

tree:0vd8cvb0y1heb5.why: All seven use 'the remembrance of God' with the same words and sense. 39:22 (hardened against the remembrance of God) and 39:23 (softened to the remembrance of God) keep the sense; they are a contrast with each other and with those distracted from it. Their subject does not justify removing them.
tree:0vd8cvb0y1heb5.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 39:22 and 39:23 have the same phrase.
tree:0vd8cvb0y1heb5.relation: The remembrance of God: what distracts from it, what makes one forget it, hearts hardened against it or softened to it.

tree:176dj7o1nl4ys6.why: That is the recompense of: the wrongdoers (5:29, 59:17), the doers of good (5:85, 39:34), the disbelievers, whoever purifies himself, God's enemies. Same frame for both ends.
tree:176dj7o1nl4ys6.relation: Contrast: the recompense of the good and of the wrongdoers in one formula.

tree:1sh2xmq0ap4l3i.why: Taste the punishment of: burning (3:181, 8:50, 22:22), eternity (10:52, 32:14), the Fire (32:20, 34:42). 3:181 and 8:50 both run on to 'that is for what your hands sent forth'. A memorizer set.
tree:1sh2xmq0ap4l3i.relation: The words said to the deniers as they enter punishment.

tree:0k0cbq308sugbr.why: 7:153, 16:110 and 16:119 say 'your Lord, after that, is Forgiving', with the particle meaning 'after'. In 7:172, 8:5, 10:61 and 17:39 'your Lord' is followed by the particle in other senses (from the children of Adam, from your house, of an atom's weight, of the wisdom): a different sense of the particle.
tree:0k0cbq308sugbr.changes: Removed 7:172, 8:5, 10:61 and 17:39: a different sense of the particle.
tree:0k0cbq308sugbr.relation: Your Lord, after repentance and striving, is Forgiving, Merciful.

tree:0nwmkz704nv2vr.why: He made subject to you: the ships, rivers, sun and moon, night and day, the sea, all in the heavens and earth. Seven places with different lists, a memorizer set and a theme of God's gifts.
tree:0nwmkz704nv2vr.relation: All creation made to serve people, as a sign calling for thanks.

tree:1hr8wr71qgx5db.why: They will come to know: a threat closing the deniers' deeds (enjoyment, shirk, ingratitude, denial), with 'and' in 25:42 and the Prophet told to turn away in 43:89. A memorizer set of threat endings.
tree:1hr8wr71qgx5db.relation: The deniers will learn the truth when it is too late.

tree:0vrwf741toghcq.why: All seven have a negation, 'anything' and then 'except': there is nothing but, it availed them nothing but, he is not of God in anything unless, it is not lawful to take anything unless, their intercession avails nothing except, he harms them nothing except. The same structure throughout; only the subject differs.
tree:0vrwf741toghcq.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same structure.
tree:0vrwf741toghcq.relation: Nothing, except: God's treasuries and praise, Yaqub's need, permission for intercession, the exception in divorce, taqiyya, God's leave.

tree:0d3xter005y53n.why: 'Anything; indeed' joins unrelated ayat with different closings; nothing shared in meaning.

tree:02awsr204ijtoe.why: All seven use 'the servants of God' in the same sense. 44:18 ('hand over to me the servants of God') and 76:6 ('from which the servants of God drink') have the same words and sense; only the frame differs from 'except the sincere servants of God'. Rows read on.
tree:02awsr204ijtoe.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 44:18 and 76:6 have the same phrase.
tree:02awsr204ijtoe.relation: The servants of God: the sincere ones excepted, Israel to be released, and the righteous drinking from the spring.

tree:0b8pvfu0706xp4.why: The 'Satan is a clear enemy to you' set is already kept in cmp:1rm4ewm1v4bask and tree:1fbag1f0p0iwul, as decided for tree:0xh1f0e0r3t7em; this card repeats it.

tree:0kkwcg91wrekzr.why: All seven say 'a severe punishment' as the object. Two groups: a verb of punishing with it, 'I will punish them / punish it / punishers of them with a severe punishment' (3:56, 7:164, 17:58, 27:21), and God preparing or making them taste it (58:15, 65:10, 41:27). 3:56 and 27:21 have the same verb as 7:164; 41:27 keeps the sense.
tree:0kkwcg91wrekzr.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 3:56 and 27:21 in the first and 41:27 in the second instead of removing them.
tree:0kkwcg91wrekzr.relation: A severe punishment: inflicted on towns, on disbelievers and on the hoopoe; prepared and made to be tasted.

tree:02fbp4p0f48vvp.why: Two groups with 'against themselves': testifying against themselves (6:130, 7:37, 7:172, 9:17), and acting against themselves (6:24 they lied against themselves, 39:53 they transgressed against themselves). 7:172 and 9:17 share the verb of witnessing with 6:130. In 59:9 'they prefer others over themselves' the particle means 'over': a different sense. 6:130 and 7:37 read on.
tree:02fbp4p0f48vvp.changes: Kept 7:172 and 9:17 with the first agent's pair, and kept 6:24 and 39:53 as a second card. Removed 59:9.
tree:02fbp4p0f48vvp.relation: Witnesses against themselves; and those who lied or transgressed against themselves.

tree:09e93b3028dedl.why: All seven use 'upon their Lord' with two senses of the verb: relying on their Lord (8:2, 16:42, 16:99, 29:59, 42:36), and standing or presented before their Lord (6:30, 11:18). The split keeps every row with its run-on.
tree:09e93b3028dedl.changes: Split into the reliance set and the standing pair, as the first agent did.
tree:09e93b3028dedl.relation: The believers rely on their Lord; the deniers are made to stand before Him.

tree:03nmsqz1hzpi0l.why: He sent down to you the Book: with the truth, with clear and ambiguous verses, with wisdom, to explain, as clarification of all things, recited to them, for people. A memorizer set on the Book's purposes.

tree:1ohibyu0l9ubrk.why: From the remembrance of God / their Lord / my Lord / the Merciful: which name comes where is the memorizer point, and the set names what turns people from remembrance.
tree:1ohibyu0l9ubrk.relation: Turning from remembrance and its consequences.

tree:1vn6hpp1wwq8sj.why: All seven use 'a bounty from' the Lord or God in the same sense. Two structures: the object of 'seeking' (2:198, 5:2, 17:12, 48:29, 59:8), and the phrase standing alone as 'a bounty from your Lord / from God' (44:57, 49:8). The words keep their sense, so 44:57 and 49:8 form their own pair.
tree:1vn6hpp1wwq8sj.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 44:57 and 49:8 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:1vn6hpp1wwq8sj.relation: Seeking bounty from God; and Paradise and guidance given as a bounty from Him.

tree:16404pn19ld0x3.why: All seven use 'in this' referring to the Quran. 21:106 ('in this is a message') and 22:78 ('and in this, that the Messenger be a witness') have the same words and sense; only the frame differs from 'We diversified in this Quran'.
tree:16404pn19ld0x3.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 21:106 and 22:78 use the words in the same sense.
tree:16404pn19ld0x3.relation: In this Quran: every example set forth, a message for worshippers, and the Messenger as witness.

tree:1249kuv0h812qr.why: 16:31, 17:18, 25:16, 41:31 and 43:71 say 'in it is what' with the relative 'what' (they wish, We will, the souls desire). In 11:107 and 11:108 the particle means 'as long as' ('abiding in it as long as the heavens endure'): a different particle and structure.
tree:1249kuv0h812qr.changes: Removed 11:107 and 11:108: the particle means 'as long as'.
tree:1249kuv0h812qr.relation: In Paradise whatever they wish, against this world where God gives what He wills.

check.why: In 11:107 and 11:108, ma means 'as long as' (the heavens endure), not the relative 'whatever they wish'. A different particle function, so removing them is right.

tree:04ytcrj1hw33mb.why: Pharaoh said: his threats, his summoning of magicians, his question about the Lord, his claim to godhood and the tower (28:38, 40:36). A memorizer set and a portrait of the tyrant.
tree:04ytcrj1hw33mb.relation: Pharaoh's words reveal his arrogance step by step.

tree:0e7199m15ylsm4.why: 'He said to him' joins unrelated speakers; the Musa pair has its own card.

tree:03njyti17iv2qk.why: Two groups with 'they said: rather': a reply in this world (2:170, 26:74, 31:21 we follow our fathers; 15:63 we came with what they doubted), and the blame in Hell (37:29, 38:60). 15:63 has the same reply structure. In 5:64 'they said' ends one clause ('cursed for what they said') and 'rather' opens God's reply: a clause break.
tree:03njyti17iv2qk.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 15:63 in the first set. Removed 5:64: a clause break.
tree:03njyti17iv2qk.relation: Rather we follow our fathers, rather we bring what they doubted; and rather you were not believers.

tree:0lgovbl0wn0tvv.why: They said, yes: the covenant before birth (7:172), and the deniers' confessions in the Hereafter (6:30 and 46:34 identical, 39:71, 40:50, 57:14, 67:9). A memorizer set.
tree:0lgovbl0wn0tvv.relation: Contrast: the 'yes' of the covenant and the 'yes' of confession that comes too late.

tree:1rrdbrg0yoa9jy.why: All seven say 'they said: never'. Two groups: 'never will ... except' (2:80, 2:111, 3:24, the People of the Book's claims), and 'we will never ... (until)' (20:72, 20:91, 6:124, 17:90). 6:124 and 17:90 ('we will never believe until') have the same structure as 20:91 ('we will never cease until'); only the speaker differs.
tree:1rrdbrg0yoa9jy.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 6:124 and 17:90 in the second set instead of removing them.
tree:1rrdbrg0yoa9jy.relation: Never, except: the People of the Book's wishful claims; and never, until: the deniers' conditions and the calf worshippers' vow.

tree:1lozpoj0nri20l.why: They said, why was not sent down to him: an angel, a sign, signs, this Quran to a great man. Seven demands with different answers. A memorizer set.
tree:1lozpoj0nri20l.relation: The deniers' demands and God's answers.

tree:0s9ludc0gw6gwc.why: Before them the people of Nuh denied: which nations follow in each list (Aad, Thamud, Pharaoh, the factions). A key memorizer set.
tree:0s9ludc0gw6gwc.relation: The chain of denying nations, a comfort to the Prophet.

tree:063mtqr0pae543.why: Say: if: hypothetical answers (if there were other gods, angels on earth, you held the treasuries, the sea were ink, you were in your houses, God had willed). Three in Al-Isra. A memorizer set of arguments.
tree:063mtqr0pae543.relation: Arguments built on 'if' that expose the deniers' claims.
