tree:0sqkzmc0rt6efm.why: The people of Lut: denied the messengers / the warnings (26:160, 54:33), Ibrahim pleading for them, Shu'ayb's warning, and the lists of nations. A memorizer set.
tree:0sqkzmc0rt6efm.relation: Lut's people named among the destroyed nations as a lasting warning.

tree:081nnli0jw5zis.why: All seven say 'that is' with a prepositional phrase and a predicate. Two groups: 'that is, with God, easy / a great success' (4:30, 4:169, 33:19, 33:30, 48:5), and 'that is written in the Book' (17:58, 33:6). 48:5 ('that is, with God, a great success') has the same structure as 4:30; only the predicate differs. Most rows read on.
tree:081nnli0jw5zis.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 48:5 in the first set instead of removing it.
tree:081nnli0jw5zis.relation: That is easy for God, a great success with God; and that is written in the Book.

tree:132rbeg08fq5z0.why: How many: a prophet with many fighting beside him, a sign passed by, towns destroyed for wrongdoing (22:45, 22:48, 47:13, 65:8), a creature that carries no provision. A memorizer set with 'and' and 'so'.
tree:132rbeg08fq5z0.relation: Countless lessons: in steadfast believers, ruined towns and God's provision.

tree:1wsu2rc0m0m7va.why: 6:7, 6:25, 11:7, 25:4, 21:36 and 30:58 say 'those who disbelieved' followed by the negating particle and 'except': this is nothing but magic, they take you only in mockery, you are nothing but falsifiers. 21:36 and 30:58 have the same structure. In 8:38 the particle is conditional ('if they stop'): a different particle. 6:7 and 11:7 read on.
tree:1wsu2rc0m0m7va.changes: Kept 21:36 and 30:58, which the first agent removed: the same negation. Removed 8:38: conditional.
tree:1wsu2rc0m0m7va.relation: What the deniers say: nothing but magic, tales, a lie; you are only mocked; you are only falsifiers.

tree:04kfgzj15z4yqz.why: Eat of what: is on earth, God provided you (5:88 and 16:114 nearly identical, 6:142), what the hunting animals catch, what God's name was mentioned on, the spoils. A memorizer set on lawful food.
tree:04kfgzj15z4yqz.relation: Lawful and good provision, eaten with God's name and thanks.

tree:0p0aupo0xixf82.why: Do not follow: their desires (5:48, 5:49, 42:15), the desires of those who deny or do not know (6:150, 45:18), desire itself (38:26 to Dawud), the way of corrupters (7:142). A memorizer set with a clear theme.
tree:0p0aupo0xixf82.relation: Judging by revelation, not by people's desires.

tree:1lsn0py1nfd7ie.why: All seven use the prohibition 'do not grieve'. Three groups: 'do not grieve over them' (15:88, 16:127, 27:70), 'that her eye be comforted and she not grieve' (20:40, 28:13), and 'do not grieve, indeed' with a reason of comfort (9:40 God is with us, 29:33 we will save you). 9:40 and 29:33 have the same prohibition and form their own pair.
tree:1lsn0py1nfd7ie.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, and kept 9:40 and 29:33 as a third pair instead of removing them.
tree:1lsn0py1nfd7ie.relation: Do not grieve: over the deniers, Musa's mother comforted, the companion in the cave and Lut reassured.

tree:1qmn5wa0bc9f18.why: Do not obey: the disbelievers (25:52), the disbelievers and hypocrites (33:1, 33:48), the deniers, every swearer, the sinful. A memorizer set with 'and' and 'so'.
tree:1qmn5wa0bc9f18.relation: The Prophet commanded not to yield to deniers and hypocrites.

tree:0uayxdr056twd7.why: All seven open 'if you ask them, they will surely say'. 9:65 has the same words and structure; it answers with the hypocrites' excuse instead of 'God', exactly what a memorizer must keep apart from the creation questions.
tree:0uayxdr056twd7.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 9:65 has the same structure.
tree:0uayxdr056twd7.relation: If you ask them: about creation they say God; about their mockery they say we were only joking.

tree:07xnuz71hwr2g3.why: 'That they may remember' is a stock closing after unrelated subjects.

tree:1n023uf1rqg2lt.why: All seven close with 'is Forgiving, Merciful' after an emphatic 'indeed'. A stock closing; 7:153, 16:110 and 16:119 cannot be removed because another card holds them, and 11:41 and 16:18 have the same words. The card is kept whole as an index of the closing. All rows read on.
tree:1n023uf1rqg2lt.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same closing.
tree:1n023uf1rqg2lt.relation: Forgiving, Merciful: after punishment, after repentance, at the ship's sailing, beyond counting His favours.

tree:0iu9xmh08ydf9t.why: All seven say 'in error' with the emphatic particle, mostly 'in clear error'. A stock phrase; 12:8, 26:97, 36:24, 42:18 and 54:24 have the same words and structure (our father, we, I, those who dispute, we would be). The card is kept whole as an index. Most rows read on.
tree:0iu9xmh08ydf9t.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same phrase.
tree:0iu9xmh08ydf9t.relation: In clear error: before the Messenger, Yaqub in his sons' eyes, the idolaters in Hell, the believer of Ya-Sin, the deniers of Salih.

tree:0d3am8v17bpgql.why: All seven open 'We have certainly created' with an object: man, the heavens, seven paths. The same words and structure; that another card holds the creation-of-man rows does not justify removing them here, and the contrast between creating man and creating the heavens is worth keeping.
tree:0d3am8v17bpgql.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same opening.
tree:0d3am8v17bpgql.relation: We created man from clay, in toil, in the best stature; and the heavens and the seven paths without fatigue.

tree:1schcog0otw57y.why: 'For a people who reflect' is a stock closing on unrelated signs.

tree:1ygqcw20hbunu4.why: God makes clear to you the signs: that you may reflect (2:219, 2:266), and God is Knowing, Wise (24:18, 24:58, 24:61), We have made clear (3:118, 57:17). The ending fits the ruling, a memorizer set.
tree:1ygqcw20hbunu4.relation: Rulings and parables explained so people reflect.

check.why: Keep is right: 'God makes clear to you the signs' with endings that change, a memorizer set.

tree:1lzvyqz126q4xp.why: The Ash-Shu'ara refrain is kept in tree:0bjaods0tg1l1o; 44:18 and 63:5 do not add a pair.

tree:1x2ougp1whozft.why: The 'Satan is an enemy to you' set is already kept in cmp:1rm4ewm1v4bask and tree:1fbag1f0p0iwul; this card repeats it.

tree:0wu6kdl1dv8qh3.why: 'Was not' in unrelated ayat; nothing shared in meaning.

tree:0yqj6df0186vqj.why: Only the stock threat 'prepared for them a punishment' is shared, with different subjects; the severe-punishment pair is kept in tree:0kkwcg91wrekzr.

tree:0ctlv4c194dlqc.why: Even if the criminals / disbelievers / associators dislike it: 9:32 and 61:8 (extinguish God's light), 8:8 and 10:82 (establish the truth), 40:14. The run-ons carry 'even if the associators dislike it'. A key memorizer set.
tree:0ctlv4c194dlqc.relation: God completes His light and truth whatever the deniers dislike.

tree:1jhqdsj0yg5m6z.why: 'For me from' joins unrelated prayers and statements; the 'from Yourself' prayers are kept in tree:1pq4e83170thvx.

tree:1pyab7s0xdczwg.why: 'There is no blame on you' opens unrelated rulings (pilgrimage, debt, travel prayer, houses, names). A stock legal phrase on different subjects.

tree:0jt85hl0isjkpp.why: Two structures: 'you have no' authority or say, with a noun as subject (15:42, 17:65 no authority over My servants, 3:128 no part in the matter), and 'what you have no knowledge of' with the relative (11:46, 17:36, 29:8, 31:15). 3:128 has the same structure as 15:42; only the subject differs.
tree:0jt85hl0isjkpp.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 3:128 in the first set instead of removing it.
tree:0jt85hl0isjkpp.relation: You have no authority over My servants and no say in the matter; and do not follow what you have no knowledge of.

tree:0nsxyfr1j6bju9.why: We have not sent you except: as bringer of good news and warner (17:105, 25:56, 34:28), as mercy to the worlds; and not as guardian over them (4:80, 17:54, 42:48). A memorizer set on the Prophet's role.
tree:0nsxyfr1j6bju9.relation: The Prophet's mission: mercy and warning, not control.

tree:1awnqfh0sci4bt.why: 'What is upon' joins unrelated ayat; the messenger's duty set is kept in tree:1d18dlj06jqsiv.

tree:1m7n58m1vaauec.why: What it earned: that was a nation that passed (2:134, 2:141 identical), every soul paid in full what it earned (2:281, 3:25, 3:161), for it what it earned (2:286), 14:51. A key memorizer set.
tree:1m7n58m1vaauec.relation: Each nation and soul answers for its own earnings.

tree:0jhqzq01u4wkpm.why: Two particles: the question 'why should we not' (2:246, 5:84, 14:12, 38:62 'why do we not see men'), and negation 'we have no' (11:79 no right, 14:21 no escape, 26:100 no intercessors). 38:62 has the same question as 5:84. The negation rows share their own words and structure, so they form a card rather than being removed.
tree:0jhqzq01u4wkpm.changes: Kept 38:62 in the first agent's card, and kept 11:79, 14:21 and 26:100 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:0jhqzq01u4wkpm.relation: Why should we not fight, believe, rely on God; why do we not see those men. And we have no right, no escape, no intercessor.

tree:0qtd3361cwzpvu.why: 2:171, 2:261, 2:265, 14:18, 29:41 and 62:5 say 'the parable of those who' followed by 'is like'. In 2:214 the word means 'the like of what befell those who passed before': a different sense of the word, without a parable.
tree:0qtd3361cwzpvu.changes: Removed 2:214: a different sense of the word.
tree:0qtd3361cwzpvu.relation: Parables of those who spend, who disbelieve, who take allies, who carried the Torah.

tree:1y4oxth1t646l5.why: A legal phrase shared across unrelated rulings on marriage, slaves and household permission; no memorizer confusion in meaning.

tree:1h531oe0weyu16.why: Only the 6:4 and 36:46 pair is real and it is already kept in tree:0crx6qd1iskkdl; the rest share a stock phrase.

tree:111v7ra1j27dm0.why: All rows concern the Bedouins of Tabuk and Hudaybiya; 9:98 and 9:99 contrast the two kinds of Bedouin.

tree:0rm91fe06y0948.why: All seven use 'of the good things' with the same partitive sense. 23:51 ('eat of the good things') has the same words and sense; the verb is a command to eat instead of 'He provided you', which is what a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:0rm91fe06y0948.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 23:51 has the same phrase in the same sense.
tree:0rm91fe06y0948.relation: The good things: provided to people and Israel, and commanded to the messengers to eat.

tree:09t8qki1ql11n2.why: The shared words are a common phrase about speech across unrelated subjects; no real parallel.

tree:13tlcdd07jkain.why: Driven out of their homes: Israelites, the emigrants and Banu Nadir, with 8:47 as the contrasting march out in pride.

tree:1up2zga1mvow0g.why: A shared stock phrase across inheritance, Ahl al-Kitab, knowledge and zihar; subjects differ.

tree:1foshra04atep4.why: All seven use 'from my Lord' in the same sense. Two groups: 'I am upon clear proof from my Lord' (6:57, 11:28, 11:63, 11:88), and something revealed or given 'from my Lord' (7:203 what is revealed, 18:98 a mercy, 40:66 the clear proofs). The words keep their sense, so the second group is a card rather than removed.
tree:1foshra04atep4.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 7:203, 18:98 and 40:66 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:1foshra04atep4.relation: Clear proof from my Lord; and revelation, mercy and proofs from Him.

tree:1044kr20j5bbj8.why: All seven have a negation followed by 'any authority'. Two groups: 'I / he / we had no authority over you' (14:22, 34:21, 37:30), and 'God sent down no authority for it / you have no authority for this' (7:71, 10:68, 12:40, 53:23). That another card holds 7:71, 12:40 and 53:23 does not justify removing them here.
tree:1044kr20j5bbj8.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 7:71, 10:68, 12:40 and 53:23 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:1044kr20j5bbj8.relation: No authority over the followers; and no authority sent down for the idols' names.

tree:1lx6gq313eiwdr.why: All seven say 'from Us' with the same sense. Two groups: the truth that came 'from Us' and was rejected (10:76, 28:48, 40:25), and something given 'from Us' as an accusative noun (18:65, 21:84 a mercy; 44:5 a command; 54:35 a favour). 44:5 and 54:35 have the same structure as 21:84.
tree:1lx6gq313eiwdr.changes: Split into the two groups as the first agent did, but kept 44:5 and 54:35 in the second group instead of removing them.
tree:1lx6gq313eiwdr.relation: The truth from Us, rejected; and mercy, command and favour from Us.

tree:15xiev71ar70j5.why: All seven say 'of bounty'. Three groups: 'you have no superiority over us' (7:39, 11:27), seeking or having something 'of the bounty of God' (62:10, 73:20, 57:29 'they have no power over anything of God's bounty'), and 'this is of the bounty of God / my Lord' (12:38, 27:40). 57:29 has the same partitive structure as 62:10.
tree:15xiev71ar70j5.changes: Split into the three groups as the first agent did, but kept 57:29 in the second group instead of removing it.
tree:15xiev71ar70j5.relation: No superiority over us; seeking God's bounty; and this is from His bounty.

tree:1aj8fl108ror15.why: Water named in rain, Hell drink, rivers of Paradise and creation; the despised-water pair is covered by its own subtree.

tree:12y3f1z09fcshb.why: All seven use 'whom We will' with the same relative and verb. 6:138 ('none may eat them but whom we will', the idolaters' claim) and 42:52 ('We guide by it whom We will') have the same words and structure; only the frame differs, and the idolaters' false claim against God's will is worth keeping.
tree:12y3f1z09fcshb.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 6:138 and 42:52 have the same structure.
tree:12y3f1z09fcshb.relation: Whom We will: raised in degrees, given mercy, saved, guided; and the idolaters' claim to decide who eats.

tree:0fw298x1kl88dz.why: Real parallels in the closing: 29:25 and 45:34 share the fire as refuge, 16:37 and 30:29 share those God leaves astray, Al Imran trio share both worlds.

tree:1kdt8ft1dh196v.why: All seven use the conditional 'whoever disbelieves' with an object and a consequence: in it, in the false gods, in God and His angels, in the signs, in faith, after the table. The same structure throughout; only the object and consequence differ. Cutting to one pair is cutting to the real pairs.
tree:1kdt8ft1dh196v.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same structure.
tree:1kdt8ft1dh196v.relation: Whoever disbelieves: in the Book, in the false gods, in God and His angels, in the signs, in faith, after the table.

tree:1px28hy1l2uji2.why: Grammatical glue across unrelated contexts; the 4:43 and 5:6 purification pair belongs to its own card.

tree:1kfah3o02gfkkw.why: Shared phrase across battle, secrecy, spending and life stages; the life-stages set is covered by its own subtree.

tree:1dkaasp0rhmklb.why: Musa addressing his people: seven speeches easily confused, especially 5:20 and 14:6 on remembering God's favour.

tree:0ygrj7y09cyqh2.why: Musa and Harun: the magicians' cry in 7:122 and 26:48 and the Saffat endings are true parallels.

tree:0apy6dx1hicisd.why: All seven have 'we, to Him' followed by a predicate: Muslims, worshippers, sincere, and in 23:38 'we are not believers in him'. The shared words keep the same structure; 23:38 adds a negation, and the contrast between the believers' declaration and the deniers' refusal is worth keeping. Rows read on.
tree:0apy6dx1hicisd.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 23:38 has the same structure.
tree:0apy6dx1hicisd.relation: We are Muslims, worshippers and sincere to Him; and the deniers: we are not believers in him.

tree:1lipyo013mynxm.why: This is a straight path closings: 3:51, 19:36, 43:64 near identical, with 36:61 and 43:61 variants.

tree:163j4980s04vnw.why: This is what you were promised (38:53, 50:32) and what God promised (33:22, 36:52); the rest are close Day of Judgement sayings.

tree:1mosgd71mij61r.why: 9:55 and 9:85 near identical, and the doubled pronoun with the Hereafter in 11:19, 12:37, 41:7.

tree:0afhqlg159njwg.why: Doing wrong while they know: 3:75 and 3:78 both say lies against God knowingly; others are the same closing on knowing concealment.

tree:1tzfxy61320quk.why: The forgiving merciful closing in story settings (12:98, 28:16) and the 85:14 variant with a different second name; kept as a weak closing set.
tree:1tzfxy61320quk.unsure: stock divine-name closing, kept only for the 85:14 swap and story ties

check.why:
I would drop it. 'He is the Forgiving, the Merciful' is a stock divine-name closing over unrelated passages, and the brief says those lean drop. The agent itself marked it as weak.
إنه هو الغفور الرحيم

tree:00qo1y00sl85dw.why: All seven use 'while he is a believer' as the same circumstantial clause. 4:92 ('if he was from a people hostile to you, while he is a believer') has the same words and structure; only the ruling differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:00qo1y00sl85dw.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 4:92 has the same clause.
tree:00qo1y00sl85dw.relation: While he is a believer: good deeds rewarded, and the slain believer's expiation.

tree:00n88c30dggi1n.why: The orphan's wealth pair 6:152 and 17:34, plus the parallel commands to argue and repel with what is best.

tree:04pwfhk07t2348.why: All seven say 'it is nothing but' with negation and exception: our worldly life, our first death, Your trial, names, a reminder. 7:155, 53:23 and 74:31 have the same words and structure; only what 'it' is differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:04pwfhk07t2348.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same structure.
tree:04pwfhk07t2348.relation: It is nothing but: this life and the first death (the deniers), Your trial (Musa), names (the idols), a reminder (the Fire).

tree:1m0dnjy07b30o8.why: God's promise: 4:95 and 57:10 share the promise of the best to both, 9:68 and 9:72 contrast, 5:9, 24:55 and 48:29 promise the believers.

tree:1fw20ts110dena.why: We granted him Ishaq and Ya'qub four times, set against Harun, Yahya and his family; true parallel gifts.

tree:1gat7th1kfdjaz.why: All seven say 'they believe in it'. Two groups: those who believe in it (2:121, 11:17, 29:47, 6:92, 40:7), and the negated 'they do not believe in it' (15:13, 26:201). 6:92 (those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it) and 40:7 (the angels believe in Him) have the same words and structure as 29:47.
tree:1gat7th1kfdjaz.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 6:92 and 40:7 in the first set instead of removing them.
tree:1gat7th1kfdjaz.relation: Those who believe in it: the People of the Book, the believers in the Hereafter, the bearers of the Throne; and the criminals who do not.

tree:0w4fm0o0vblzew.why: All seven say 'He creates what' with the same verb and relative. 16:8 ('He creates what you do not know') has the same words and structure; only the relative clause differs, which is what a memorizer must keep apart from 'what He wills'.
tree:0w4fm0o0vblzew.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 16:8 has the same structure.
tree:0w4fm0o0vblzew.relation: He creates what He wills, and what you do not know.

tree:1aatvha10ibuy4.why: All seven use 'wants to' with the same verb and particle. Three groups: the accusation 'he wants to drive you out' (7:110, 26:35), 'he wants to gain over you / turn you away' (23:24, 34:43), and what God or a thing wants (4:27, 11:34 God wants; 18:77 a wall about to fall). The rows keep their words, so the third group is a card rather than removed.
tree:1aatvha10ibuy4.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, and kept 4:27, 11:34 and 18:77 as a third card instead of removing them.
tree:1aatvha10ibuy4.relation: Wanting to: drive out, gain over, turn away; God wanting to forgive or let astray; a wall about to fall.

tree:0asma5h19wpw07.why: An ordinary verb phrase leading to different aims in each place; no confusion in meaning.

tree:1esl5h310sbxen.why: Two groups: they bar from the way of God (7:45, 11:19, 14:3, 8:47, 9:34), and they bar from the Sacred Mosque (8:34, 22:25). 8:47 and 9:34 ('and they bar from the way of God') have the same words and structure as 14:3; only the subject differs.
tree:1esl5h310sbxen.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 8:47 and 9:34 in the first set instead of removing them.
tree:1esl5h310sbxen.relation: Barring from God's way: the deniers, the proud army, the rabbis; and barring from the Sacred Mosque.

tree:0t5p03f07bdc5p.why: Claims of faith in God: the hypocrites' claim in 2:8, 24:47 and 29:10, the creed in 2:136, 3:84 and 5:59, and late belief in 40:84.

tree:1qxj5id086wmpv.why: Clear signs named across unrelated contexts; only a common phrase is shared.

tree:1mndnnt1itbz67.why: Lists of recipients ending with the wayfarer; 17:26 and 30:38 and 8:41 and 59:7 are near-identical pairs.

tree:15d9sc318au2jf.why: Remember God after rites and prayer, each with a different manner; 8:45 and 62:10 share remember God much that you may succeed.

tree:0hm4f4x1hz48av.why: 6:106, 7:199, 11:76, 12:29, 15:94 and 53:29 use the imperative 'turn away from'. In 20:124 ('whoever turns away from My reminder') and 66:3 ('he turned away from some') the verb is the past tense, not a command: a different form of the word. 6:106 and 15:94 read on.
tree:0hm4f4x1hz48av.changes: Removed 20:124 and 66:3: the verb is past tense there.
tree:0hm4f4x1hz48av.relation: Commands to turn away: from the idolaters, the ignorant, this matter, and those who turn from Our reminder.

tree:120ystl1ndpljp.why: All eight say '(He / we) knows best who' with the same comparative and relative. 17:55 (who is in the heavens), 29:32 (who is in it) and 53:32 (who fears Him) have the same words and structure; only the relative clause differs. 16:125 and 68:7 read on.
tree:120ystl1ndpljp.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same structure.
tree:120ystl1ndpljp.relation: Your Lord knows best who strays and who is guided, who is in the heavens, who fears Him.

tree:0aou9lq04ygfzm.why: Only a human like you or like us: the classic swap between the messengers' words and the deniers' words.

tree:05hibr20809m70.why: The Torah and the Gospel: 3:48 and 5:110 on teaching Isa, 5:66 and 5:68 on establishing them, and the other mentions.

tree:0lrhvvt03tqdgl.why: All eight have 'the punishment' then 'for what' they did. Two forms: the address 'taste the punishment for what you used to' (3:106, 6:30, 7:39, 8:35, 46:34), and the third person 'the punishment ... for what they used to' (6:49, 6:157, 16:88). The rows keep the same causal phrase, so the second group is a card rather than removed. Rows read on.
tree:0lrhvvt03tqdgl.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 6:49, 6:157 and 16:88 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:0lrhvvt03tqdgl.relation: Taste the punishment for what you disbelieved and earned; and the punishment for what they did.

tree:0v5f8n318o2esx.why: All eight close with 'the defiantly disobedient people'. The old rows repeated 5:26 as a run-on of 5:25 and as its own row; each ayah appears once. The other rows read on into the next ayah, so their run-ons are kept.
tree:0v5f8n318o2esx.changes: Gave 5:26 one row only, as the first agent did, but kept every other row's run-on.
tree:0v5f8n318o2esx.relation: The defiantly disobedient people: whom God does not guide or approve, and from whom Musa asked to be parted.

tree:02gf34t1q7ynun.why: All eight say 'God, the Mighty' followed by the Wise or the Knowing. 3:126, 27:9, 34:27 and 42:3 have the same words and structure; the frame differs from 'the sending down of the Book', which is what a memorizer must keep apart. Rows read on.
tree:02gf34t1q7ynun.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other four have the same names.
tree:02gf34t1q7ynun.relation: God, the Mighty, the Wise: the source of the Book, of victory, of revelation; I am He, said to Musa.

tree:1sv07bh0gwdfkf.why: All eight say 'God, the Lord of' with the same words. 21:22 ('glory be to God, Lord of the Throne') has the same structure as 27:8 ('glory be to God, Lord of the worlds'), and 81:29 ('except that God, Lord of the worlds, wills') the same phrase. A split would leave them without a group, so the card stays whole. Rows read on.
tree:1sv07bh0gwdfkf.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 21:22 and 81:29 have the same phrase.
tree:1sv07bh0gwdfkf.relation: God, Lord of the worlds and of the Throne: feared, blessed, glorified, and willing.

tree:1pef6wf0saex1p.why: All eight have God's name closing a clause and 'they said' opening the reply. 4:141, 7:50 and 41:14 have the same structure ('a victory from God, they said', 'what God provided you, they said', 'worship none but God, they said'); only the story differs. A split by subject would leave them without a group.
tree:1pef6wf0saex1p.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other three have the same structure.
tree:1pef6wf0saex1p.relation: After God's name, their reply: we believe only in ours, we follow our fathers, they have strayed from us, were we not with you, God forbade it.

tree:16panj708sphhd.why: All eight have God's name closing a clause and the command 'say' opening the reply. 6:56, 10:18, 13:16, 27:64 and 48:15 have the same structure; only the frame differs. Cutting to the three 'they will say God' rows is cutting to the real pairs.
tree:16panj708sphhd.changes: Reverted to the original rows: all rows share the same structure.
tree:16panj708sphhd.relation: After God's name, the command to answer: praise God, I do not follow, bring your proof, you will not follow us.

tree:149v7oc0d5rkfk.why: God's name followed by and He, in eight unrelated contexts; a grammatical join only.

tree:00f50dh0db2du3.why: God guides whom He wills: 2:272 and 28:56 pair on not guiding, 6:88 and 39:23 on His guidance, 2:213 and 24:46 to a straight path.

tree:0p3y21o1xuori4.why: All eight use 'to the earth' in the same sense. Three groups: movement to the land (21:71, 21:81 the blessed land; 32:5 from the sky to the earth), looking to the earth (26:7, 32:27, 88:20), and clinging to the earth (7:176, 9:38). 88:20 ('and to the earth, how it was spread') has the same structure as 26:7; 32:5 keeps the sense of movement.
tree:0p3y21o1xuori4.changes: Split into the three pairs as the first agent did, but kept 32:5 in the first group and 88:20 in the second instead of removing them.
tree:0p3y21o1xuori4.relation: To the earth: carried to the blessed land, the command descending to it; look at it; and do not cling to it.

tree:0ucuqgh0praeu1.why: Verdicts on man: ungrateful, transgressing, anxious, at loss; a memorized set of predicates easily swapped.

tree:11ih1111nlu6nv.why: Mixes the 5:106 conditional with the you are nothing but set, which is covered by its own subtree.

check.why: Drop is right. I checked that the 'you are nothing but' set is kept whole in tree:06x3z2n0nn5qm5 (W4) and tree:0pb49xq0hok1zi (W2), and that 5:106 is a conditional.

tree:0ugqw130rd3nqx.why: Two particles: the emphatic 'we were indeed' with the emphatic predicate (6:156, 10:29 heedless; 12:91 sinners; 23:30 testing; 26:97 in error), and the conditional 'if we are' (7:113, 26:41 if we are the victors; 21:17 if We were to do). 7:113 and 26:41 are conditional like 21:17, so 21:17 joins them instead of being removed. 7:113 and 26:41 read on.
tree:0ugqw130rd3nqx.changes: Kept 21:17 and split the card by the particle: the emphatic group and the conditional group.
tree:0ugqw130rd3nqx.relation: We were indeed heedless, sinners, in error; and if we are the victors, if We were to do it.

tree:09f2xh006uvhsq.why: Two groups: 'if they had' all in the earth (5:36, 13:18), and 'that they have' something (2:25, 10:2, 17:9, 18:2 good news of a reward; 16:62 their false claim that they have the best; 37:67 they have a boiling mixture). 16:62 and 37:67 have the same structure as 2:25; only the subject differs.
tree:09f2xh006uvhsq.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 16:62 and 37:67 in the second set instead of removing them.
tree:09f2xh006uvhsq.relation: If they had all the earth; and what they have: gardens and reward, the best they claim, the drink of Hell.

tree:1rrtcrc0kzthk6.why: Different predicates after the demonstrative; the people pair 43:88 and 44:22 has its own tree.

tree:1wh61o515bt5mz.why: All eight say 'that (it / he) comes'. 5:52 ('that God brings victory') has the same verb with 'with', like 13:38 ('that a messenger brings a sign'); only the subject differs, which does not justify removing it.
tree:1wh61o515bt5mz.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 5:52 has the same structure.
tree:1wh61o515bt5mz.relation: Before a day comes, before death comes; no messenger brings a sign but by leave; and God may bring victory.

tree:1tfk6e51idnn23.why: We have been sent or We sent: the Lut angels pair 15:58 and 51:32 and the Qamar punishments; true parallels.

tree:0lwpval070r6cl.why: All eight say 'I am only' followed by what: a human, a warner, a messenger. 19:19 ('I am only a messenger of your Lord') has the same words and structure; only the speaker differs, which does not justify removing it. 29:50 and 67:26 read on.
tree:0lwpval070r6cl.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 19:19 has the same structure.
tree:0lwpval070r6cl.relation: I am only: a human like you, a clear warner, a messenger of your Lord.

tree:0v6l4mg1lnrqgo.why: Two structures: 'where is what you used to' worship or call (7:37, 26:92, 40:73), a question, and 'wherever' you are or they are found (57:4, 58:7, 2:148, 3:112, 19:31), a conditional of place. 2:148, 3:112 and 19:31 have the same 'wherever' as 57:4; only the subject differs.
tree:0v6l4mg1lnrqgo.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 2:148, 3:112 and 19:31 in the second set instead of removing them.
tree:0v6l4mg1lnrqgo.relation: Where are those you called on; and wherever you are, God is with you, brings you, and blesses.

tree:1xmj7321i9o6tm.why: 2:176, 8:53, 22:6, 22:61, 22:62, 31:30 and 47:11 say 'that is because God', with the preposition giving the cause. In 96:14 'does he not know that God sees' the preposition belongs to the verb 'know': a different sense, without the 'that is because' clause.
tree:1xmj7321i9o6tm.changes: Removed 96:14: a different sense of the preposition.
tree:1xmj7321i9o6tm.relation: That is because God is the Truth, sent the Book, does not change a favour, merges night and day, is the protector of the believers.

tree:1e442hz0xzvzph.why: After He guided us or after it came to me: turning back after guidance and being led astray after the reminder; parallel in meaning.

tree:02dr1uu03yj79e.why: All eight say 'some of what'. Three groups: some of what is promised (10:46, 13:40, 40:77, and 40:28 'some of what he promises you will strike you'), Isa making lawful or clear some of what (3:50, 43:63), and some of what is hastened or done (27:72, 30:41). 40:28 has the same structure as 10:46; 27:72 and 30:41 form their own pair.
tree:02dr1uu03yj79e.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, but kept 40:28 in the first group and 27:72 and 30:41 as a third pair instead of removing them.
tree:02dr1uu03yj79e.relation: Some of what is promised, made lawful, made clear, hastened, and done.

tree:1j37fte05zw6g8.why: All eight say 'rather you are' with a predicate. Two groups: 'rather you are a people' with an adjective (7:81, 26:166, 27:47, 27:55, 36:19), and 'rather you are' with another predicate (5:18 humans of His creation, 27:36 rejoicing in your gift, 38:60 the followers' blame). The rows keep their words, so the second group is a card rather than removed. 7:81 and 36:19 read on.
tree:1j37fte05zw6g8.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 5:18, 27:36 and 38:60 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:1j37fte05zw6g8.relation: Rather you are a transgressing, ignorant, tested people; and rather you are mere humans, you rejoice in your gift, you led us here.

tree:1rum6sj1ayt7x7.why: All eight say 'for what (it) earned'. Two groups: every soul for what it earned (6:70, 13:33, 40:17, 45:22, 74:38), and for what hands or hearts earned, with the earner named after the verb (30:41, 42:30, 2:225). 2:225 ('for what your hearts earned') has the same structure as 42:30; only the subject differs.
tree:1rum6sj1ayt7x7.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 2:225 in the second set instead of removing it.
tree:1rum6sj1ayt7x7.relation: Every soul for what it earned; and what hands and hearts have earned.

tree:0mvkd1p1fzenop.why: 2:164, 16:65, 29:63, 30:24, 35:9, 45:5 and 29:40 have an active verb with God as subject, 'with it', and 'the earth' as object: He revived the earth with it; We caused the earth to swallow him. 29:40 has the same structure; the verb differs. In 13:31 the verb is passive, 'the earth were cut through by it': a different voice.
tree:0mvkd1p1fzenop.changes: Kept 29:40, which the first agent removed: the same structure. Removed 13:31: the verb is passive.
tree:0mvkd1p1fzenop.relation: What God does to the earth with it: revives it after death with water, and makes it swallow the transgressor.

tree:1ed4cbl056f0qr.why: All eight say 'you be among' a group, after 'that', 'so' or 'or'. 5:29 ('so you be among the companions of the Fire') has the same structure as 26:213; 12:85, 27:41 and 28:19 have the same as 11:46 ('that you be among'). Only the speaker differs, which does not justify removing them.
tree:1ed4cbl056f0qr.changes: Reverted to the original rows: the other four have the same structure.
tree:1ed4cbl056f0qr.relation: Lest you be among: the wrongdoers, losers, ignorant, punished, the people of the Fire, the perished, the misguided.

tree:1gsn7061ie9624.why: Rely on God: 4:81, 33:3 and 33:48 end with God suffices as guardian; the others vary the name and follow-up.

check.why: Keep is right: 'rely on' God or a divine name, with the follow-up changing, is a memorizer set.

tree:0mkfee11r033en.why: All eight say 'then when' with a verb. Two groups: harm then favour then forgetting (16:53, 16:54, 30:33, 39:8, 39:49), and creation then resurrection (30:20, 30:25, 80:22 'then when He wills He raises him'). 80:22 has the same structure as 30:25. 16:53 and 16:54 each hold the words, so they stay two rows.
tree:0mkfee11r033en.changes: Split into the two sets as the first agent did, but kept 80:22 in the second set, and kept 16:53 and 16:54 as two rows instead of one.
tree:0mkfee11r033en.relation: When harm is lifted they associate; and when He calls, you come out of the earth.

tree:0rqbxhk09jrxrs.why: Then He rose over the Throne or turned to the heaven, with near identical creation lead-ins; a classic set.

tree:0wvwpti1lpl9ek.why: Return formulas to Me or to your Lord, each with a different follow-up; easily swapped.

check.why: Keep is right: the return formulas 'then to Me / to your Lord is your return' with different follow-ups are easily swapped.

tree:13n3jo217wwz50.why: All eight say 'God made'. Three groups: if God made night or day endless (28:71, 28:72), God made something a support or measure (4:5, 5:97, 65:3 'God has made for everything a measure'), and God did not make (5:103, 33:4, 4:90 'God has not made for you a way against them'). 65:3 and 4:90 have the same structures as 4:5 and 5:103.
tree:13n3jo217wwz50.changes: Split into the three pairs as the first agent did, but kept 65:3 in the second and 4:90 in the third instead of removing them.
tree:13n3jo217wwz50.relation: What God made: a support, the Kaaba, a measure for all; what He did not make: bahira, two hearts, a way against the peaceful; and if He made night endless.

tree:1ubh8zi0d2gjg2.why: Hell closings with resting place versus destination; 9:73 and 66:9 identical.

tree:1f5sti61nhl1uo.why: Those who lost themselves, with different tails: they do not believe, what they invented left them, in Hell forever; 7:9 and 23:103 are the scales pair.

tree:0521stj0k2jvqp.why: He created you from one soul, clay, dust or weakness: the origin varies by place and the one-soul trio 4:1, 7:189, 39:6 is easily swapped.

tree:164hv5j0vrya03.why: 4:48 and 4:116 differ only in their endings, and 7:168 and 72:11 both describe the righteous and those below that.

tree:1m1fb9s1jl28dq.why: That is the great, clear or great-big triumph after the gardens description; which adjective goes where is the memorizer's test.

tree:0c0yp5q0fxzo4o.why: 3:44 and 12:102 are near identical news of the unseen, 3:186 and 31:17 share resolve in affairs, 11:100 is news of the towns.

tree:0ep5n511bwfmyb.why: Magic accusations ending in clear magic, with or without the this-is-nothing-but lead-in; a classic swap.

tree:1oww3fm1ympjm2.why: Swift in reckoning closings; 14:51 and 40:17 both tie it to every soul being repaid, and the lead-in name form varies.

check.why: I would drop it. 'Swift in reckoning' is a stock closing over unrelated passages, as the agent says. Its one real pair, 14:51 with 40:17, is already kept elsewhere.

tree:01mnfth18yk8pt.why: Those who disbelieve and bar from God's way, with different fates (47:1, 47:32, 47:34), and the oaths-as-shield pair 58:16 and 63:2.

tree:1y7h17r0e1g9ql.why: Protect us from the punishment of the Fire in the prayers, against taste the punishment of the Fire in 32:20 and 34:42.
tree:1y7h17r0e1g9ql.relation: Contrast: the believers pray to be spared what the deniers are told to taste, in the same words.

tree:07m5pii15bt0ns.why: Humiliating punishment closings; 31:6 and 45:9 share taking the signs in mockery, 58:5 and 58:16 sit in one surah.

tree:03ilgvb1nz7hn1.why: Rose over the Throne with near identical creation lead-ins; 12:100 is Yusuf raising his parents on the throne, the same words in another story.

tree:1p86pjq04yazvw.why: Favoured above the worlds: 2:47 and 2:122 identical, with faddalnakum, faddalnahum and chosen variants elsewhere.

tree:1x5qxbe1rykv1y.why: Unable to do anything (2:264 and 14:18, 16:75 and 16:76) and not standing on anything (2:113, 5:68, 58:18).

tree:0jfvldv049n733.why: 3:58, 4:164, 7:101, 11:120, 16:118, 20:99 and 28:3 say We relate or recite 'to you of' news or verses. In 6:52 'upon you is nothing of their account' has no verb of relating; 'upon you' is a predicate of responsibility: a different structure and sense.
tree:0jfvldv049n733.relation: What God relates and recites to the Prophet: the news of towns, of messengers, of Musa and Pharaoh.

check.why: 6:52 'you are not accountable for them' is a different structure from 'We relate/recite to you of'. Removing it is right.

tree:1phkhj31i4ooxp.why: In 8:31, 19:73, 22:72, 34:43, 45:25 and 46:7 the verb is passive, 'when Our signs are recited to them'. In 28:45 and 28:59 it is active, 'reciting to them Our signs' (you, a messenger): a different voice. The two active rows share their own words and form a pair.
tree:1phkhj31i4ooxp.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 28:45 and 28:59 as a second card instead of removing them.
tree:1phkhj31i4ooxp.relation: When Our signs are recited to them, their reactions; and the messenger who recites them.

tree:0c066bg099bp14.why: God is not unaware of what you do against your Lord is not unaware; the classic name swap.

tree:0wgc9bs0a8o248.why: Enjoining good and forbidding evil, with the order of the qualities varying in each place.

tree:1t6nvb40pi5g2e.why: All eight use 'from His way' in the same sense, turning away from it. 6:153 (the paths divide you from His way) and 9:9 (they barred from His way) keep the sense; the verbs differ (stray, mislead, divide, bar), which is what a memorizer must keep apart. Rows read on.
tree:1t6nvb40pi5g2e.changes: Reverted to the original rows: 6:153 and 9:9 use the phrase in the same sense.
tree:1t6nvb40pi5g2e.relation: From His way: who strays, who misleads, the paths that divide, and those who bar.

tree:1xwhgfm0dkivq0.why: In the punishment brought present (30:16, 34:38), sharing (37:33, 43:39), humiliating or severe; which word where is the test.

tree:1yt4qcq0vtohgg.why: Is there not in Hell a dwelling for the disbelievers (29:68, 39:32) against for the arrogant (39:60), with other in-Hell places.

tree:0gr7z6w1go3q92.why: In doubt about what was sent, about my religion, about the Hereafter, in disquieting doubt: the tail changes by place.

tree:1yugjeu0bb806u.why: He said: it is only; 28:78 and 39:49 share I was given it for knowledge, and the other sayings of prophets and others.

tree:15cexzj1ga7989.why: Say: my Lord, with a different prayer each time; 23:93 to 23:118 cluster in one surah.

tree:0tah3h10cdw9k1.why: 10:15, 25:57, 25:77, 34:47, 38:86 and 46:9 say 'Say: not' with the negating particle (I ask no reward, it is not for me, my Lord would not care, I was not new). In 2:215 the particle is conditional ('whatever you spend') and in 62:11 relative ('what is with God is better'): a different particle.
tree:0tah3h10cdw9k1.relation: Say: I ask no reward, I may not change it, I am not new among the messengers.

tree:0hqqna60t525d8.why: What they used to differ in, doubt in, or hold cheap; differing in judgement closings recur with small changes.

tree:0kt6i6n1bvziqn.why: They used not to: 10:42 and 10:43 are a back-to-back pair on the deaf and the blind, with other ending verbs that vary.

tree:1p6xsof07pltnj.why: Two senses of the particle: 'they had been before' (2:89, 3:164, 30:49, 40:21, 62:2), and 'they were among / of' (18:9 of Our signs a wonder, 23:48 among the destroyed). The partitive rows share their own sense and form a pair. In 83:29 'they used to laugh at those who believed' the particle marks the object of laughter: a third sense.
tree:1p6xsof07pltnj.changes: Kept the first agent's card and added 18:9 and 23:48 as a second card. Removed 83:29: a different sense.
tree:1p6xsof07pltnj.relation: What they were before the Messenger came; and what they were among: a wonder of the signs, the destroyed.

tree:0lvqsee0bj8u1g.why: Indeed many of the people, the scholars or the partners are such and such: 5:49, 10:92 and 30:8 share many of the people with different verdicts.
tree:0lvqsee0bj8u1g.unsure: loose set; the many-of-the-people slip may also have its own card

tree:1xiy8l501302o7.why: From or in every nation a witness, a messenger or a group: 16:84 and 16:89 are the sharpest pair, with 4:41 and 28:75.

tree:1ivuqea1s5c2lo.why: Eat of the good things We provided (2:57, 2:172, 7:160, 20:81) against eat of His fruit or provision; which form goes where.

tree:0ohrbq31pwshp7.why: Be, and it is, after different lead-ins: when He decrees a matter, Our word, His command; 2:117, 19:35, 40:68 nearly identical.

tree:026rasi1ovkfp6.why: What you used to deny, hasten, doubt or call for: the Day of Judgement taunts, with the verb changing by place.

tree:0h89k9e0njug9g.why: Oath openings with no, so no, and no: which form opens which surah is a known memorizer test.

tree:15ylboi1sdqykm.why: Do not follow the footsteps of Satan four times, against desires, paths and patrons; the lead-ins to the footsteps set differ.

tree:0t9m0ss0q352kc.why: Do not be among the doubters, the heedless, the despairing, or like the companion of the fish: different warnings in the same form.

tree:125jah00tdcyus.why: Conjecture avails nothing against the truth in 10:36 and 53:28, with the other availing-nothing places on the Day.

tree:1e3drla07a0wxe.why: They do not understand: the hypocrites' sealed hearts in 9:87 and 63:3, and a people who do not understand in 8:65 and 59:13.

tree:1dl9p8u0odikoi.why: The false gods possess nothing: no harm or benefit, no intercession, not an atom; the objects of the verb change by place.

tree:0s8gofm18pd456.why: That you may receive mercy after obey (3:132, 24:56) and fear God (6:155, 49:10) and other commands; the lead-in is the test.

tree:0wydn671sdg749.why: That you may understand: 12:2 and 43:3 on an Arabic Quran, 2:242 and 57:17 on making the signs clear.

tree:08r04dj0fz1z8v.why: A stock closing for a people who reason, after unrelated signs; nothing to learn beyond the shared closing.

tree:0k1ypwx1wsbbz9.why: A stock closing for a people who know, after unrelated subjects from divorce to the stars; only the closing is shared.

tree:02hbkzl05egj5z.why: 2:120, 13:37, 3:128 and 60:4 share a negation, 'for you', then 'of / from' with an indefinite: no protector from God, no part in the matter, I cannot avail you anything from God. 3:128 and 60:4 have the same structure. In 28:20 (among the sincere), 33:50 (besides the believers), 56:91 (from the companions), 93:4 (better than) the particle has other senses.
tree:02hbkzl05egj5z.changes: Kept 3:128 and 60:4, which the first agent removed: the same structure. Removed 28:20, 33:50, 56:91 and 93:4.
tree:02hbkzl05egj5z.relation: You have nothing from God and no part in the matter: no protector, no say, no help from Ibrahim's prayer.

tree:03ra66n0yegezb.why: Three groups with 'for you in' X followed by what you have: a dwelling on the earth (2:36, 7:24), a lesson in cattle (16:66, 23:21), and life in retaliation, a model in the Messenger (2:179, 33:21). 2:179 and 33:21 have the same structure. In 16:13 'for you' belongs to the verb 'He multiplied', and in 4:88 'what is with you' is a question: different structures.
tree:03ra66n0yegezb.changes: Split into the two pairs as the first agent did, and kept 2:179 and 33:21 as a third pair. Removed 4:88 and 16:13.
tree:03ra66n0yegezb.relation: What you have in things: a dwelling on earth, a lesson in cattle, life in retaliation, a model in the Messenger.

tree:00c8whj0gdgyv9.why: But they wronged themselves, said seven times, against but they were the wrongdoers in 43:76.

tree:1c35brb0oolgdr.why: But they do not perceive, know, or see: the closing verb is the slip, as in 2:12 and 2:13 back to back.

tree:1pq868k0y0rakg.why: If We willed: 56:65 and 56:70 differ by one letter, 36:66 and 36:67 are back to back, and 8:31 is the deniers' boast.

tree:0axjwpe0ancylu.why: Why has no sign or angel been sent down to him, with the reply changing: 13:7 and 13:27 share the demand, then differ.

tree:0i28gs71s4mfnt.why: What availed them was nothing: 15:84 and 39:50 share what they used to earn, with wealth and gathering elsewhere.

tree:06c17vz0y4i55j.why: He knows what is before them and behind them: 20:110, 21:28, 22:76 with different tails, and the same words of warning in 36:45.

tree:06b39891n63jjd.why: Except what God or your Lord wills: 7:188 and 10:49 swap harm and benefit, 11:107 and 11:108 are back to back, 6:128 matches them.

tree:0s4hw4x1fb0yhb.why: I only follow what is revealed to me, and follow what is revealed to you: 10:109 and 33:2 against 6:50, 7:203, 46:9; 20:38 is the same words for Musa's mother.

tree:1qk9gz90lc0vfx.why: Their refuge is Hell, with a wretched bed, a wretched destination or no escape; 9:73 and 66:9 identical.

tree:19rd7zb1qk5nnx.why: Reversing the old drop: 7:80 and 29:28 are Lut's words, no one in the worlds preceded you in it; the other rows are the same negation with any one.
tree:19rd7zb1qk5nnx.unsure: the other rows add little beyond the Lut pair

check.why:
'Any one' after a negation is common, and the agent itself says the other rows add little. I would cut the card to Lot's words, 'no one in the worlds preceded you in it' (7:80, 29:28).
ما سبقكم بها من أحد من العالمين

tree:16z4ppn1f08kkn.why: Of the punishment in scattered contexts, from longevity to marriage law to rescue of Israel; only a common phrase.

tree:122oy100ju8rug.why: After the knowledge that came to you: 2:120, 2:145, 3:61, 13:37 warn the Prophet in near-same words; the other knowledge places echo it.

tree:0lvmp851p2fl3t.why: Prayers to be saved from the wrongdoing people (23:28, 28:21, 66:11) against the disbelieving people in 10:86.

tree:1crgudf07ph063.why: A messenger from the Lord of the worlds (7:61, 7:67, 7:104) and a revelation from the Lord of the worlds (56:80, 69:43, 32:2).

tree:0pihw5a0xac5xe.why: If you obey a party of those given the Book in 3:100 against those who disbelieve in 3:149.

tree:0hlsx9k0gfctn0.why: Only the believers then indeed is shared; 9:34, 29:56, 64:14 part at once.

tree:1t9ohfy0qa2868.why: Stock competent over all things closing after unrelated lead-ins; near-duplicate of a larger card.

tree:0hgpbtn13m98rz.why: God does not guide the disbelieving people: indeed in 5:67 against and that in 16:107.

tree:0rksvvl1ktiq8f.why: The fuller card tree:0mrk9a519chx65 holds every row here and is kept.

tree:1u0rjna165s77a.why: The fuller card tree:16n67xz1p08jcp holds both rows and is kept.

tree:0qegw4z1a3vyet.why: The fuller card tree:1880gg21ua7mdq holds every row here and is kept.

tree:1c63wnc094o7xs.why: The fuller card tree:1880gg21ua7mdq holds every row here and is kept.

tree:1tu9bry03ea6fs.why: The fuller card tree:0qkzihc1a2hlya holds both rows and is kept.

tree:0y6tggq1iqw3fo.why: Same two rows as tree:1nfuly20dl0jz4, which is kept.

tree:0qabpsp1vbq3yf.why: Stock knowing of all things closing after unrelated lead-ins; near-duplicate of a larger card.

tree:0berd7s192r9o4.why: Have they not seen that God who created: 17:99 with 46:33, and 41:15.

tree:00qhy2m1a5ukdg.why: Revelation of the Book from God, the Mighty: the Knowing in 40:2 against the Wise in 45:2 and 46:2.

tree:10hmzvc0v0q7nw.why: Surahs 45 and 46 open identically, then diverge.

tree:10cuy3412log20.why: Surahs 43 and 44 open by the clear Book, indeed, then diverge.

tree:0rilhul00nf36p.why: Alif Lam Ra openings: the wise, the clear, a Book, and Quran in 10, 11, 12, 14, 15.

tree:1utr93p0znp57t.why: Surah openers praise be to God who: created, sent down, to whom belongs, in 6:1, 18:1, 34:1.

tree:0t0lhoa1ngghwk.why: 57:1, 59:1 and 61:1 open with the past verb 'glorified God'. In 87:1 the same letters are the imperative 'glorify the name of your Lord': a different form of the verb. 59:1 and 61:1 read on.
tree:0t0lhoa1ngghwk.relation: The surahs that open 'whatever is in the heavens and earth glorified God'.

cmp-card:1:1|27:30.why: The basmala opening the Quran, and quoted as the opening of Solomon's letter.
cmp-card:1:1|27:30.relation: The basmala as the opening of revelation and of a prophet's letter.

cmp-card:1:6|37:118.why: 'The straight path': our prayer for it (1:6) and Moses and Aaron guided to it (37:118).
cmp-card:1:6|37:118.relation: The prayer for guidance answered for the prophets.

cmp-card:1:2|45:36.why: Al-Jathiya closes with the praise that opens al-Fatiha, spelling out the Lord of the worlds as Lord of the heavens and the earth. A small but real echo for pondering; a memorizer may also slip from one to the other.
cmp-card:1:2|45:36.relation: The brief praise of al-Fatiha is unfolded at the end of al-Jathiya.

check.why: Book card; the praise that opens al-Fatiha closes al-Jathiya with the Lord of the worlds spelled out. Keep is right.

cmp-card:2:14|2:76.why: When they meet the believers they say 'we believe', and when alone: with their devils (the hypocrites) or with one another (some of the Jews). Classic memorizer pair on the same double face.
cmp-card:2:14|2:76.relation: The same two-faced speech, among hypocrites and among some of the People of the Book.

cmp-card:2:16|2:175.why: Same description of those who bought error for guidance, different continuations.

cmp-card:2:45|2:153.why: Same command to seek help through patience and prayer, first to the Children of Israel, then to the believers, with different endings. A memorizer pair and a link worth pondering.
cmp-card:2:45|2:153.relation: The command once given to Israel is given again to the believers.

cmp-card:2:47|2:122.why: The two ayat are word for word the same. The real difference is in the next ayah, where intercession and compensation swap places. A memorizer needs the pair together with the ayah after it.
cmp-card:2:47|2:122.relation: The same reminder bookends the story of the Children of Israel in al-Baqara.

cmp-card:2:48|2:123.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:2:51|2:92.why: The same rebuke for taking the calf after Musa left, once in the story itself and once as an argument against the Jews of Madina. They open differently and continue differently.
cmp-card:2:51|2:92.relation: The calf recalled twice: first as history, then as evidence against later claims of faith.

cmp-card:2:63|2:93.why: The covenant and the mount raised over them, word for word, then two different continuations: remember what is in it, or hear (and they said: we hear and disobey). Memorizer pair and a telling contrast.
cmp-card:2:63|2:93.relation: The same covenant, recalled first as a call to remember and then as the scene of their open disobedience.

cmp-card:2:89|2:101.why: The same opening, once about a book and once about a messenger, both confirming what they had. Both times a group rejects it. A close pair for a memorizer.
cmp-card:2:89|2:101.relation: Book and messenger both came confirming the earlier scripture, and both were rejected by those who expected them.

cmp-card:2:134|2:141.why: The same refrain, word for word, closing two passages on Abraham and his sons. Memorizers need to know it occurs twice; the repeat drives home that each nation answers for its own deeds.

cmp-card:2:234|2:240.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:2:25|29:58.why: Only the generic reward formula is shared. 29:58 speaks of lofty chambers and the reward of those who work, a different picture from 2:25.

cmp-card:2:119|35:24.why: The same sentence about the Prophet's mission, sent with the truth as a bringer of good news and a warner, continuing two ways. A memorizer must know which continuation goes where.
cmp-card:2:119|35:24.relation: The Prophet's mission: he is not answerable for the people of hellfire, and every nation before had a warner.

cmp-card:2:6|36:10.why: Same sentence on the disbelievers whom warning does not move, in two surahs; 2:6 opens with a particle, 36:10 with a conjunction. A clear memorizer pair.

cmp-card:2:34|38:74.why: Same scene: Iblis was arrogant and became one of the disbelievers.

cmp-card:2:218|49:15.why: Those who believe and strive in Allah's cause: they hope for His mercy (2:218), they are the truthful (49:15).

cmp-card:2:284|59:6.why: Shared only a stock closing about God's will and His power over all things. One ayah is about the reckoning of what is in the soul, the other about spoils taken without battle; nothing to ponder together.

cmp-card:2:232|65:2.why: The same reminder closes divorce rulings in two surahs, with and without 'among you' and with 'that' in two forms. Memorizer pair on the same subject.

cmp-card:3:10|3:116.why: The same sentence that wealth and children will not help the deniers against God, in two places of one surah, ending differently: fuel of the Fire in one, companions of the Fire abiding forever in the other. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:3:22|3:56.why: The same closing that the deniers have no helpers in this world or the next, after their deeds are made void (3:22) and after they are punished severely (3:56). A memorizer pair in one surah with one lesson: nothing saves them in either life.
cmp-card:3:22|3:56.relation: Same theme: the loss of the deniers in both worlds, once in their deeds and once in their punishment.

cmp-card:3:29|3:189.why: Only the stock closing about God's power over all things is shared. One is about God knowing what is in hearts, the other about His dominion over the heavens and the earth; the rows run on into unrelated ayat.

cmp-card:3:32|3:132.why: Obey God and the Messenger: if they turn away God does not love the disbelievers (3:32), and that you may receive mercy (3:132). Same command in one surah, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:3:32|3:132.relation: Obedience brings mercy; turning away brings God's displeasure.

cmp-card:3:40|3:47.why: The same question and answer for Zakariyya and Maryam: yaf'alu set against yakhluqu.

cmp-card:3:98|3:99.why: Two adjacent rebukes, say O People of the Book, why do you: disbelieve (3:98), bar from Allah's way (3:99).
cmp-card:3:98|3:99.relation: Two rebukes to the People of the Book.

cmp-card:3:124|3:125.why: Reinforcement by angels at Badr: three thousand (3:124), then five thousand if you are patient and fear God (3:125). Consecutive ayat with the number to remember.
cmp-card:3:124|3:125.relation: God's help grows with patience and God-consciousness.

cmp-card:3:16|23:109.why: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us: the prayer of the God-fearing (3:16) and of a group of God's servants mocked by the deniers (23:109). Same prayer, different endings, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:3:16|23:109.relation: The believers' prayer for forgiveness, answered with protection and mercy.

cmp-card:3:94|61:7.why: Whoever invents a lie against Allah is a wrongdoer: after the truth about food laws (3:94), and while being called to Islam (61:7).
cmp-card:3:94|61:7.relation: Lying about Allah as the height of wrongdoing.

cmp-card:3:189|85:9.why: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and He is over all things, closing once with all-powerful and once with witness. The ending changes with the context: power in 3:189, witness over the persecutors of the believers in 85:9.
cmp-card:3:189|85:9.relation: Similarity: the same sovereignty, shown as power and as watchful witness.

cmp-card:4:5|4:8.why: Provide for them and speak to them kindly: to the weak-minded and to relatives at the division of inheritance. Same command in neighbouring ayat; worth pondering that giving is paired with kind words.
cmp-card:4:5|4:8.relation: Material help always joined to kind speech.

cmp-card:4:48|4:116.why: The same ayah on shirk twice in one surah, ending with 'invented a great sin' and 'strayed far'. The books link each ending to its context (the People of the Book, the polytheists).
cmp-card:4:48|4:116.relation: Shirk as a lie against God, and shirk as going far astray.

cmp-card:4:57|4:122.why: The same long promise to those who believe and do good, word for word, twice in one surah, then two different tails (pure spouses and deep shade, a true promise of God). In the large gardens card this tight pair is lost among nineteen rows.
cmp-card:4:57|4:122.relation: Same promise repeated, once describing the reward and once affirming God's truthfulness.

cmp-card:4:131|4:170.why: If you disbelieve, to God belongs what is in the heavens and the earth: said in one surah to the people of the Book and to all mankind, with two different endings (Free of need and Praiseworthy, Knowing and Wise) and a missing repetition in 4:170. A sharp memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:131|4:170.relation: Same theme: disbelief does not harm God, who owns everything.

cmp-card:4:137|4:168.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:4:13|5:85.why: A repeat: both ayat are already in the large gardens card and its branches, where their different tails are shown. The pair adds nothing.

cmp-card:4:43|5:6.why: The dry ablution ruling word for word, with 'from it' added only in 5:6. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:4:61|5:104.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same call (4:61, 5:104, 63:5), which shows how the hypocrites and the imitators of their fathers each refuse it.

cmp-card:4:135|5:8.why: Stand firm for justice as witnesses for God, and for God as witnesses in justice: the order is reversed. A famous memorizer pair; the books explain the reversal from the context (kin versus enemies).
cmp-card:4:135|5:8.relation: Justice even against oneself and kin, and justice even towards enemies.

cmp-card:4:97|16:28.why: Those whom the angels take while wronging themselves: those who would not emigrate (4:97) and the arrogant deniers (16:28). Same sentence, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:97|16:28.relation: The moment of death exposes those who wronged themselves.

cmp-card:4:22|17:32.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:4:124|19:60.why: The same promise that the doers of good enter Paradise and are not wronged, ending with not a speck in 4:124 and not at all in 19:60.
cmp-card:4:124|19:60.relation: Paradise for faith with deeds, and the repentant included.

cmp-card:4:110|25:70.why: Doing evil then turning back: God is Forgiving, Merciful, then and whoever.

cmp-card:4:9|33:70.why: The same command, fear God and speak a right word: to guardians of orphans (4:9) and to all believers (33:70). Each row reads on into the next ayah, which shows its fruit.
cmp-card:4:9|33:70.relation: Right speech as a fruit of fearing God, in a family duty and in general.

cmp-card:4:149|33:54.why: If you show or hide something, God is: pardoning and able (4:149), knowing all (33:54). Memorizer pair with endings fitted to their context.

cmp-card:4:133|35:16.why: If He wills He can remove you and bring others, or a new creation. A short memorizer pair that reminds that people are replaceable.
cmp-card:4:133|35:16.relation: Same theme: mankind's existence hangs on God's will.

check.why: If He wills He removes you; a short pair with a lesson. Keep.

cmp-card:4:105|39:2.why: We sent down to you the Book with the truth, then its purpose: to judge between people by what God showed you, or to worship God sincerely. A memorizer pair that names two aims of revelation.
cmp-card:4:105|39:2.relation: Same theme: the Book is for just judgment and for sincere worship.

cmp-card:4:124|40:40.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same promise (4:124, 16:97, 40:40), which shows this pair's difference beside the third.

cmp-card:4:115|47:32.why: A rare clause: opposing the Messenger after guidance has become clear, with the consequence in each. Same subject.
cmp-card:4:115|47:32.relation: The fate of those who oppose the Messenger knowingly.

cmp-card:4:13|48:17.why: Both ayat are in the four-row card of the same conditional promise (4:13, 48:17, 64:9, 65:11), which shows this pair's difference beside the other two. The pair adds nothing.

check.why: Both rows are in the kept four-row card and kept tree cards. Adds nothing. Drop.

cmp-card:4:170|48:4.why: Only the heavens-and-earth wording and the stock closing Knowing and Wise are shared. One calls mankind to believe, the other speaks of tranquillity and God's hosts; different subjects.

cmp-card:4:37|57:24.why: Those who are stingy and order people to be stingy, in the same words twice, with different tails: they hide God's bounty and a humiliating punishment awaits, or whoever turns away, God is Free of need and Praiseworthy. A memorizer pair on one fault.
cmp-card:4:37|57:24.relation: Same theme: stinginess that spreads to others, and God's independence from it.

cmp-card:4:95|57:10.why: Not equal are the strivers and others, yet to each Allah promised good. Same principle in two surahs.
cmp-card:4:95|57:10.relation: Ranks among believers, all promised good.

cmp-card:5:15|5:19.why: The same call to the People of the Book, our messenger has come making things clear, continuing once with what they hid of the Book and once with the gap between messengers. Memorizer pair four ayat apart.
cmp-card:5:15|5:19.relation: The messenger comes both to expose what they concealed and to end their excuse that no warner came.

cmp-card:5:55|5:56.why: Two consecutive ayat on loyalty to Allah, His Messenger and the believers: who your allies are, and that their party prevails.

cmp-card:5:62|5:63.why: Two consecutive ayat on the same people and their eating of the unlawful, ending with what they used to do and what they used to work, a classic memorizer difference.
cmp-card:5:62|5:63.relation: Blame on the sinners, then on the scholars who did not forbid them.

cmp-card:5:74|5:98.why: Only the stock Forgiving, Merciful closing is shared.

cmp-card:5:112|5:114.why: The disciples ask for a table from the sky, and Jesus prays for it, two ayat apart.
cmp-card:5:112|5:114.relation: The request and the prayer for the table.

cmp-card:5:88|8:69.why: Eat what is lawful and good and fear Allah: of what Allah provided (5:88), of war spoils (8:69).

cmp-card:5:51|9:23.why: The same command and the same warning clause, with different closings.

cmp-card:5:76|16:73.why: Worshipping besides God what has no power: over harm or benefit for you, or over provision from the heavens and the earth. A memorizer pair and a clear argument against idols.
cmp-card:5:76|16:73.relation: Same argument: what is worshipped besides God owns nothing.

cmp-card:5:88|16:114.why: Eat of what God has provided you, lawful and good, then: fear God in whom you believe, or be grateful for God's favour. A memorizer pair whose tails differ.
cmp-card:5:88|16:114.relation: Same command: lawful provision joined to piety and to gratitude.

cmp-card:5:85|20:76.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the large gardens card, which shows the branch of that is the reward of the doers of good and of whoever purifies himself.

cmp-card:5:76|21:66.why: Do you worship besides God what does not benefit or harm you? Asked by the Prophet of the Christians (5:76) and by Abraham of his people (21:66). The same argument in two mouths, with harm and benefit in reverse order.
cmp-card:5:76|21:66.relation: Same argument used by two prophets against two kinds of false worship.

cmp-card:5:43|24:47.why: Then they turn away after that, and those are not believers: said of the Jews who seek the Prophet's judgment while they hold the Torah, and of the hypocrites who claim obedience then refuse to be judged. Both about turning from God's judgment.
cmp-card:5:43|24:47.relation: Same theme: claiming faith while refusing God's judgment.

cmp-card:5:99|24:29.why: God knows what you show and what you hide: the closing of two rulings, the Messenger's duty is only to deliver and entering uninhabited houses. A rare exact closing that a memorizer must place; the subjects differ.

check.why: A rare exact closing in two places; a memorizer must place it. Keep.

cmp-card:5:97|58:7.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the four-row card of God knowing what is in the heavens and the earth.

cmp-card:5:8|59:18.why: Only the stock closing, fear God, God is aware of what you do, is shared. One ayah commands justice even toward enemies, the other to look at what one has sent ahead for tomorrow; different subjects.

cmp-card:5:29|59:17.why: The same closing after a mention of the Fire.

cmp-card:5:118|60:5.why: Two pleas that close with the Mighty, the Wise rather than the Forgiving, the Merciful: Jesus on his people and Abraham's followers. Worth pondering why might and wisdom close a plea for forgiveness.
cmp-card:5:118|60:5.relation: Forgiveness asked of the One who is mighty enough to forgive and wise in whom He forgives.

cmp-card:5:97|65:12.why: The same purpose clause, li-ta'lamu anna Allaha, with different knowledge closings.

cmp-card:6:27|6:30.why: If you could see when they are made to stand before the Fire (6:27) and before their Lord (6:30). Two scenes three ayat apart; memorizer pair and worth pondering together.
cmp-card:6:27|6:30.relation: Standing before the Fire they wish to return; standing before their Lord they confess.

cmp-card:6:40|6:47.why: Have you considered, if God's punishment came to you: two questions in one surah, one about whom they would call, one about who would be destroyed. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:40|6:47.relation: Same theme: what remains when the punishment comes.

cmp-card:6:143|6:144.why: Adjacent ayat with the same question on the eight mates: sheep and goats (6:143), camels and cattle (6:144). A real trap.

cmp-card:6:42|7:94.why: Seized them with hardship and affliction so they might humble themselves, with two forms of the verb. Classic memorizer pair on the same sunna.
cmp-card:6:42|7:94.relation: Hardship sent to nations to bring them to humility.

cmp-card:6:48|7:35.why: Whoever believes, or fears God, and reforms: no fear on them nor will they grieve. Both follow the sending of messengers and both are followed by the fate of those who deny Our signs. A memorizer pair with the same structure.
cmp-card:6:48|7:35.relation: Same theme: the messengers' message splits people into the reformers and the deniers.

cmp-card:6:151|7:33.why: What your Lord has forbidden: indecencies open and hidden, and associating partners. Two lists of prohibitions that overlap and differ, worth reading together.
cmp-card:6:151|7:33.relation: Same theme: the core prohibitions, listed twice.

cmp-card:6:17|10:107.why: If God touches you with harm none removes it but He; then two continuations for good (He is able over all things; none can repel His favour). Classic memorizer pair.

check.why: Book card; the same opening with two continuations for good. Keep.

cmp-card:6:37|10:20.why: A partial card of the demand for a sign from his Lord; both ayat belong in the fuller card proposed under the 6:37 and 13:27 pair.

check.why: Fully shown in the merged card of the demand for a sign. Drop.

cmp-card:6:40|10:38.why: Both end if you are truthful, otherwise different challenges and follow-ons.

cmp-card:6:62|10:30.why: Same phrase: returned to God, their true Master.

cmp-card:6:116|10:66.why: They follow nothing but conjecture and they only guess: said of the majority on earth and of those who call on partners. A clear memorizer pair with one verdict.
cmp-card:6:116|10:66.relation: Same theme: false belief rests on guessing.

cmp-card:6:50|11:31.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:6:90|12:104.why: No reward asked; it is only a reminder to the worlds, with two forms of the word reminder. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:147|12:110.why: His might is not turned back from the criminal people: a warning after mercy (6:147) and the end of the messengers' trial (12:110).
cmp-card:6:147|12:110.relation: God's mercy is wide, but His punishment of criminals is certain.

cmp-card:6:126|16:13.why: Only a stock ending, for a people who remember, after two different subjects. Both rows read on without adding a link.

cmp-card:6:145|16:115.why: The forbidden foods with the exemption for whoever is forced, not desiring nor exceeding: then your Lord is forgiving, or God is forgiving. Different framing (I find nothing forbidden but, He has only forbidden) and a different name at the end.
cmp-card:6:145|16:115.relation: Same ruling: what is forbidden to eat and the mercy for necessity.

cmp-card:6:148|16:35.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:6:149|16:9.why: Had He willed He would have guided you all, said in 6:149 and 16:9.

cmp-card:6:152|17:34.why: Do not approach the orphan's wealth except in the best way until he reaches maturity, then fulfil: the measure and the covenant, or the covenant alone. The same commandment in two lists, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:152|17:34.relation: Same commandment: guarding the orphan's wealth, joined to keeping one's word.

cmp-card:6:10|21:41.why: The two identical ayat are already in the three-row card of the same opening (with 13:32), which also shows the third variant. The pair adds nothing beyond it.

cmp-card:6:29|23:37.why: The same denial of resurrection, with and without namutu wa nahya.

cmp-card:6:101|25:2.why: Denial of a son, and wa-khalaqa kulla shay', with different closings.

cmp-card:6:11|30:42.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the fuller card of the travel-in-the-land command (6:11, 27:69, 29:20, 30:42).

cmp-card:6:159|30:32.why: The same rare clause about those who split their religion into sects, with different conclusions: the Prophet has nothing to do with them, and each faction rejoices in its own.
cmp-card:6:159|30:32.relation: The danger of sectarian division, stated twice.

cmp-card:6:4|36:46.why: The same ayah word for word in two surahs: no sign of their Lord comes to them but they turn away from it. A memorizer must know where it occurs and what follows each.
cmp-card:6:4|36:46.relation: Same theme: habitual turning away from God's signs.

cmp-card:6:5|36:30.why: Same closing: they used to mock what came to them.

cmp-card:6:15|39:13.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the three-row card of the same sentence (with 10:15).

cmp-card:6:130|39:71.why: Did messengers not come to you from among you, warning of this Day: asked of jinn and men (6:130) and by Hell's keepers (39:71).
cmp-card:6:130|39:71.relation: The same question that leaves the condemned without excuse.

cmp-card:6:135|39:39.why: My people, work according to your position, I am working; you will come to know: once with the addition about whose end will be good, once shorter. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:135|39:39.relation: Same theme: the Prophet leaves the outcome to be seen.

cmp-card:6:163|39:12.why: 'I am commanded ... the first of the Muslims' (6:163, 39:12).

cmp-card:6:164|39:7.why: No bearer of burdens bears another's burden, then to your Lord is your return and He will inform you of what you...: differed about, or did. A long shared run with a different tail.
cmp-card:6:164|39:7.relation: Same theme: individual responsibility and the final reckoning.

cmp-card:6:33|40:63.why: The same closing, bi-ayati Allahi yajhadun, a rare one.

cmp-card:6:45|40:65.why: Only the stock praise closing is shared; the lead-ins in 6:45 and 40:65 differ.

cmp-card:6:56|40:66.why: Say, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides God: then, I will not follow your desires, or since the clear proofs came to me. A memorizer pair with one stance.
cmp-card:6:56|40:66.relation: Same stance: refusing false worship, by revelation and clear proof.

check.why: The same refusal of false worship with two continuations. Keep.

cmp-card:6:102|40:62.why: That is God your Lord: 'no god but He' and 'creator of all things' in opposite order, with different endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:46|45:23.why: God seals the hearing and heart (6:46, 45:23).

cmp-card:6:30|46:34.why: Same exchange: is this not the truth, yes by our Lord, taste the punishment.

cmp-card:6:132|46:19.why: For each are degrees according to what they did: then your Lord is not unaware, or so He may pay them fully without wrong. A short memorizer pair on one principle.
cmp-card:6:132|46:19.relation: Same theme: ranks follow deeds, with full and just pay.

cmp-card:6:5|50:5.why: They denied the truth when it came to them, said in 6:5 and 50:5 with different consequences.
cmp-card:6:5|50:5.relation: Denial of the truth when it arrives.

cmp-card:6:117|68:7.why: Identical except 'who strays' in the present without the preposition (6:117) and 'who strayed' with it (68:7). A sharp memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:69|7:74.why: Remember when He made you successors and remember the favours of God: Hud to Aad (7:69) and Salih to Thamud (7:74), in one surah. A classic memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:69|7:74.relation: Two prophets remind their peoples of God's favours in the same words.

cmp-card:7:79|7:93.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:7:97|7:98.why: Do the people of the towns feel safe that Our punishment will come to them: at night while they sleep, in the morning while they play. Consecutive ayat that differ by the conjunction and the time.
cmp-card:7:97|7:98.relation: Same warning: punishment can come at any hour, in sleep or in play.

cmp-card:7:159|7:181.why: Same rare description of a community that guides by the truth and does justice by it: among the people of Moses, and among those We created.
cmp-card:7:159|7:181.relation: The righteous community, first among Moses' people and then in general.

cmp-card:7:192|7:197.why: Same surah: the idols cannot help, in near-identical wording.

cmp-card:7:39|8:35.why: Only the stock threat 'taste the punishment for what you used to' is shared, with two different endings and unrelated subjects (leaders and followers quarrelling in Hell; Quraysh's prayer at the House). Little to learn beyond the last word.

check.why:
I would keep. Two books name this pair, and it is a textbook memorizer trap: the same threat ending in two different verbs. The last word is exactly what a reciter confuses, so the difference is the lesson, not a reason to drop.
تكسبون
تكفرون

cmp-card:7:39|10:52.why: The same sentence of punishment, with a different lead-in.

cmp-card:7:54|10:3.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the five-row card of the same phrase, where their different continuations are shown.

cmp-card:7:64|10:73.why: Noah's people denied him and We saved him and those with him in the ark: two verb forms, 'who' or 'those', 'made them successors' added, and different endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:87|10:109.why: The same command to be patient until Allah judges, with the same closing.

cmp-card:7:133|10:75.why: Same verdict on Pharaoh's people: they were arrogant and a criminal people, after the plagues and after Moses' mission.

cmp-card:7:71|12:40.why: Names that you and your fathers have named, for which God sent down no authority: said by Hud, by Joseph in prison, and in an-Najm (53:23), now split into two pairs. One card shows all three.
cmp-card:7:71|12:40.relation: Same argument: idols are only names, with no proof from God.

check.why: Adding 53:23 puts the three uses of the clause on names you have named in one card. Keep with the change.

cmp-card:7:34|16:61.why: When their term comes they cannot delay it an hour nor advance it: for every nation, and for all people despite their wrong. A memorizer pair, with a spelling difference in the verb.
cmp-card:7:34|16:61.relation: Same theme: the fixed term of nations and people.

cmp-card:7:115|20:65.why: Will you throw or shall we: 'be the throwers' (7:115) or 'be the first to throw' (20:65). Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:206|21:19.why: Those with Him are not too proud to worship Him; continuations differ.

cmp-card:7:147|30:16.why: Those who denied Our ayat and the meeting of the hereafter: their deeds void (7:147), and they are brought to punishment (30:16).
cmp-card:7:147|30:16.relation: Denying the hereafter voids deeds and leads to punishment.

cmp-card:7:200|41:36.why: If an evil suggestion from Satan provokes you, seek refuge in God: He is hearing, knowing, or He is the hearing, the knowing. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:206|41:38.why: Those with your Lord glorify Him and are not too proud (7:206), and glorify Him night and day without tiring (41:38). Same statement, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:206|41:38.relation: The angels' tireless worship against human arrogance.

cmp-card:7:134|43:49.why: Call on your Lord for us by the covenant He made with you: Pharaoh's people ask Moses twice, once by name with a promise to believe, once calling him sorcerer. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:134|43:49.relation: Same story: Pharaoh's people beg Moses for relief, then break their word.

cmp-card:7:71|53:23.why: A partial card of the names-you-named clause; both ayat belong in the three-row card proposed under the 7:71 and 12:40 pair.

check.why: Fully shown in the three-row card. Drop.

cmp-card:7:176|62:5.why: The likeness of the people who deny Our signs: the panting dog (7:176), the donkey with books (62:5).
cmp-card:7:176|62:5.relation: Two parables of knowledge without benefit.

cmp-card:8:4|8:74.why: Those are the believers in truth; for them...: ranks with their Lord, forgiveness and noble provision, or forgiveness and noble provision. A memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp-card:8:4|8:74.relation: Same verdict: true believers, defined by worship and by emigration and striving.
